contributorNote: Swahili (Kiswahili: Kiunguja, Kimvita, Kiamu, Kitikuu, Kipate, Kingozi) vocabulary compiled from Rev. Dr. J. L. Krapf (1850, 1882), Bishop Edward Steere (1870, 1894, 1918), Rev. W. E. Taylor (1891), George W. Bateman (1901), A. C. Madan (1902, 1903, 1905, 1917 "English-Swahili Vocabulary", SPCK London, pp. 1–56 [PDF pp. 1–72]), Hildegarde Hinde (1904), Mrs. F. Burt (1910), Capt. C. H. Stigand (1915), Mervyn W. H. Beech (1918), Prof. Alice Werner (1918, 1919, 1933), Sir Harry H. Johnston (1919), Deo Ngonyani & Nancy Ngowa (2016), Mohamed Mwamzandi (2022), and John Goldsmith & Fidèle Mpiranya (2022). Expanded and cross-verified with Commercially Permissive Datasets (Kencorpus (KenCorpus_text, KenPOS, KenTrans, KenSwQuAD, KenSpeech Lexicon, CC-BY-4.0), Thiomi (CC-BY-4.0), Google SMOL/GATITOS (CC-BY-4.0), LughaGen (CC-BY-SA-4.0), Common Voice 25.0 (CC0-1.0), CLDF WOLD & Tsammalex (CC-BY-4.0), Kaikki.org (CC-BY-SA-4.0), Language Science Press (2016/2019/2022, CC-BY-4.0)). Further enriched with Lamu/Pate/Shela coastal Swahili terms from C. H. & N. Y. Stigand (1914) 'Black Tales for White Children' (Project Gutenberg #38992, US Public Domain) and Swahili proverbs from Wikiquote (CC-BY-SA-4.0).

entries.english: Swahili Daytime & Prayer-Time Reckoning (12-Hour Cycle from 6 a.m.)
entries.translation: Alfajiri (dawn, ~4:30–5:30 a.m.) → Asubuhi (morning, 6 a.m. = saa kumi na mbili) → Adhuhuri (noon, 12 p.m. = saa sita) → Alasiri (afternoon, ~3:30 p.m.) → Jioni (late afternoon) → Magharibi (sunset, 6 p.m. = saa kumi na mbili) → Esha (nightfall, ~7:30 p.m.)
entries.pronunciation: alfajiri  → asubuhi  → adhuhuri  → alasiri  → jioni  → magharibi  → esha

entries.english: Your skin is your largest organ, and it's important to take care of it both inside and out. Here are some tips for healthy skin:
entries.translation: Ngozi yako ndicho kiungo kikubwa zaidi mwilini, na ni muhimu kuitunza nje na ndani. Vifuatavyo ni vidokezo kuhusu utunzaji wa ngozi:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Drink plenty of water: Water is essential for healthy skin, as it helps to keep your skin hydrated and soft. Aim to drink eight glasses of water per day.
entries.translation: * Kunywa maji ya kutosha: Maji ni muhimu katika utunzaji wa ngozi, kwa sababu husaidia kuondoa ukavu na kudumisha ulaini wa ngozi. Kunywa angalau glasi nane za maji kwa siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Eat a healthy diet: Eating a healthy diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains can help to improve your skin's appearance.
entries.translation: * Kula lishe bora: Kula lishe bora linalojumuisha matunda, mboga, na fanaka kunaweza kusaidia kuboresha mwonekano wa ngozi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Get regular exercise: Exercise can help to improve your circulation and promote healthy skin. Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: * Fanya mazoezi mara kwa mara: Kufanya mazoezi kunaweza kusaidia kuboresha mzunguko wa damu mwilini na kuimarisha afya ya ngozi yako. Fanya mazoezi ya wastani kwa angalau dakika 30 karibu siku zote za wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Protect your skin from the sun: The sun's UV rays can damage your skin and lead to premature aging, wrinkles, and skin cancer.
entries.translation: * Linda ngozi yako dhidi ya jua: Miale ya UV ya jua inaweza kudhuru ngozi yako na kusababisha upate uzee wa mapema, mikunjo, na saratani ya ngozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “What is it?” I ask. “I don’t know,” Mum says. “But I don’t think it’s friendly.”
entries.translation: “Hii ni nini?” Niliuliza. “Sijui,” Mama alisema. “Lakini sidhani ni kitu kizuri.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s tall and slender, with long, spindly legs.
entries.translation: Ni kitu kirefu chembamba, chenye miguu mirefu miembamba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Its body is covered in black fur, and its head is a smooth, round ball.
entries.translation: Mwili wake una manyoya meusi, na kichwa chake ni mpira laini mviringo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has no eyes, but I can see two large, pointed ears.
entries.translation: Hakina macho, lakini kina masikio mawili makubwa yenye ncha kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “What are we going to do?” I ask.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “We need to get out of here,” Mum says. “Now.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We run out of the kitchen and into the living room.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad looks up from the TV. “What is it?” he asks.
entries.translation: Baba aliacha kutazama televisheni. “Ni nini?” aliuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “I don’t know,” Mum says. “But it’s big and it’s coming this way.”
entries.translation: “Sijui,” Mama alijibu. “Lakini ni kitu kikubwa na kinakuja huku.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad gets up from the couch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “We need to get out of here,” he says.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We all run for the front door.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mum unlocks it and we rush outside.
entries.translation: Mama akaufungua na tukatoka nje haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature is right behind us.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s so close I can feel its hot breath on the back of my neck.
entries.translation: Lilitukaribia sana na nilihisi joto la pumzi yake kwenye shingo langu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We run to the car and get in.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad starts the engine and we peel out of the driveway.
entries.translation: Baba aliwasha gari na tukachomokea barabarani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature chases after us, but we’re too fast.
entries.translation: Kiumbe hicho kilitufuata, lakini tulikwenda kwa kasi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Movies have long been a powerful force in shaping our culture and our values.
entries.translation: Filamu zimekuwa na ushawishi mkubwa mno katika kuelekeza utamaduni na maadili yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can influence our beliefs about everything from love and romance to war and violence.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kuchochea imani zetu kuhusu kila kitu kuanzia mapenzi na mahaba hadi vita na vurugu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they have a particularly strong influence on our ideas about gender roles.
entries.translation: Na zina ushawishi mkubwa hasa kwa mtazamo wetu kuhusu majukumu ya kijinsia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For decades, Hollywood has perpetuated the stereotype of the ideal wife as a beautiful, submissive, and domestic woman who puts her husband and children first.
entries.translation: Kwa miongo mingi, Hollywood imeendeleza kasumba kwamba mwanamke mkamilifu ni mrembo, mnyenyekevu na wa kukaa nyumbani ambaye ameweka mbele maslahi ya mume na wanawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This image is often reinforced by the way that female characters are portrayed in movies.
entries.translation: Taswira hii husisitizwa na jinsi wahusika wa kike husawiriwa kwenye filamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The majority of female characters were portrayed as either romantic interests or mothers.
entries.translation: Wahusika wengi wa kike walisawiriwa kuwa wazazi, au wanaofuata mahaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This narrow representation of women in film sends a powerful message to viewers about what it means to be a woman.
entries.translation: Uwakilisho huu finyu wa wanawake katika filamu unawaonyesha watazamaji nafasi ya mwanamke katika jamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It suggests that women's primary role is to be attractive and nurturing, and that their success is measured by their relationships with men and children.
entries.translation: Unapendekeza kwamba nafasi kuu ya wanawake ni kuvutia na kulea, na kwamba ufanisi wao unapimwa kutegemea uhusiano kati yao na wanaume na watoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This idealized image of the wife can be harmful to women in several ways.
entries.translation: Taswira hii iliyowekwa ya mke mkamilifu inaweza kuwaathiri wanawake kwa njia mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Doctor, I've been having this terrible stomach pain for the past few days.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Daktari, nimekabiliwa na maumivu makali ya tumbo kwa siku chache zilizopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so bad that I can't eat or sleep.
entries.translation: Maumivu ni makali mno hivi kwamba siwezi kula au kulala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a sharp, stabbing pain that comes and goes.
entries.translation: Ni maumivu makali yanayodungadunga, na yanakuja na kutoweka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Can you tell me more about the pain? Where is it located?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je, unaweza kunielezea zaidi kuhusu maumivu hayo? Unayahisi wapi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's mostly in my lower abdomen, right around my belly button, but it sometimes radiates to my back.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Nahisi haswa chini ya tumbo, karibu na kitovu changu, lakini wakati mwingine nahisi hadi mgongoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does anything make the pain worse?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je, kuna kitu chochote kinachochochea maumivu hayo kuwa makali zaidi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Eating seems to make it worse, especially fatty or greasy foods.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ninatatizika zaidi nikila chakula, hasa vyakula vilivyotumbukizwa au vilivyo na mafuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: And does anything make it better.?
entries.translation: Daktari: Na je, kuna kitu kinachotuliza maumivu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Lying down seems to help a little.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does the pain come and go, or is it constant?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je, maumivu hayo yanakuja na kutoweka, au yanadumu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's constant. It's just a dull ache, but it's really uncomfortable.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Yanadumu. Ni maumivu kidogo tu, lakini yananitatiza sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Have you had any other symptoms? Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je. umekuwa na dalili nyingine zozote? Kichefuchefu, kutapika, kuendesha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I see. Well, it sounds like you're having a case of gastritis.
entries.translation: Daktari: Naam. Vizuri, inaonekana una uvimbe tumboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining.
entries.translation: Uvimbe tumboni ni kufura kwa utando wa tumbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be caused by a number of things, including eating spicy or fatty foods, drinking alcohol, or taking certain medications.
entries.translation: Unaweza kusababishwa na mambo kadhaa, ikijumuisha ulaji wa vyakula vyenye viungo au mafuta mengi, unywaji wa pombe, au utumiaji wa dawa fulani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It can be, but in most cases it's not.
entries.translation: Daktari: Unaweza kuwa hatari, lakini katika hali nyingi sio hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to prescribe you some medication to help relieve the pain and inflammation.
entries.translation: Nitakuagiza utumie dawa fulani ili kukusaidia kutuliza maumivu na uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid eating spicy or fatty foods, and drink plenty of fluids.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kuepuka vyakula vilivyotiwa viungo vingi na mafuta mengi, na unapaswa kunywa maji kwa wingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
entries.translation: 1. Pasha oveni joto hadi digrii Farenhaiti 350 (digrii Selsiasi 175). Weka mafuta na unga kwenye sufuria la keki la inchi 8.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
entries.translation: 2. Kwenye bakuli wastani, changanya unga, sukari ya chembechembe, sukari ya kahawia, hamira, na chumvi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.
entries.translation: 3. Kwenye bakuli kubwa, changanya siagi na yai hadi iwe nyororo na laini. Ongeza lozi na sehemu ya katikati ya yai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.
entries.translation: 4. Ongeza taratibu viungo vikavu kwenye viungo vya majimaji, ukibadilishana na maziwa. Changanya hadi mchanganyiko huo ukolee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.
entries.translation: 5. Nyunyiza unga wa lozi hadi utoshee kwa usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day in July when I finally turned 16 years old.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa siku ya joto katika majira ya kiangazi mwezi wa Julai ambapo hatimaye nilifikisha umri wa miaka 16.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had been eagerly anticipating this day for as long as I could remember, and now that it was finally here, I couldn't wait to get started on my road to freedom.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa nimeisubiria sana siku hii kwa hamu na ghamu, na ilipofika, nilikuwa na matarajio makubwa kuanza maisha yangu ya utu uzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step was to take the written test.
entries.translation: Hatua ya kwanza ilikuwa ni kufanya mtihani wa kuandika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I studied hard for weeks, and I was confident that I would pass.
entries.translation: Nilisoma kwa bidii sana kwa wiki kadhaa, na nilikuwa na uhakika kuwa ningefuzu mtihani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the day of the test, I arrived at the DMV early and took my seat in the waiting room.
entries.translation: Siku ya mtihani, niliwasili mapema katika DMV na nikaketi katika chumba cha kusubiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, my name was called, and I was ushered into a small room with a computer.
entries.translation: Baada ya saa chache, jina langu liliitwa, kisha nikaelekezwa katika chumba kidogo kilichokuwa na kompyuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The test was surprisingly easy, and I finished it in no time.
entries.translation: La kushangaza ni kwamba mtihani ulikuwa rahisi sana, na niliukamilisha baada ya muda mfupi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, I received a letter in the mail informing me that I had passed the written test.
entries.translation: Siku chache baadaye, nilipokea barua pepe ikiniarifu kuwa nilikuwa nimepita mtihani huo wa kuandika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next step was to schedule a driving test.
entries.translation: Hatua iliyofuata ilikuwa ni kuratibu mtihani wa kuendesha gari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I called the DMV and made an appointment for the following week.
entries.translation: Nilipiga simu kwa DMV na kuweka miadi ya wiki iliyofuatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The day of my driving test arrived, and I was more nervous than I had ever been in my life.
entries.translation: Siku ya mtihani wangu wa kuendesha gari ilifika, na nilikuwa na wasiwasi ambao sijawahi kuhisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I drove to the DMV with my mom, who would be accompanying me on the test.
entries.translation: Niliendesha gari hadi DMV nikiwa na mama yangu, ambaye alikuwa ananipeleka kwenye mtihani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.
entries.translation: "Kuvunjika moyo," mshairi alishusha pumzi, "ni mateso ya kikatili mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a pain that pierces the soul and leaves us feeling empty and alone.
entries.translation: Ni uchungu unaochoma nafsi na kutuacha na hisia ya upweke na kutojiweza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fire that burns from within, consuming us with its flames.
entries.translation: Ni moto unaowaka kindani, na kutuangamiza kwa miale yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a storm that tears us apart, leaving us broken and scarred.
entries.translation: Ni dhoruba inayotutenganisha, na kutuacha na makovu na kutukatisha tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of our heartbreak, there is hope.
entries.translation: Lakini hata tunapovunjika moyo, lipo tumaini.

entries.english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
entries.translation: Rekodi ya kwanza iliyoandikwa kuhusu chai ilianzia karne ya 3 BC, ilipotajwa katika matini ya kimatibabu ya Kichina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni chai ilitumika kama tiba ya kiasili, lakini kwa kasi ikawa kinywaji maarufu miongoni mwa Wachina wa matabaka yote ya kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
entries.translation: Grace: Na nje ya Uchina? Chai ilianza kuenea lini katika nchi zingine?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
entries.translation: Mwalimu: Chai ilizinduliwa mara ya kwanza Ulaya katika karne ya 16 na wafanyabiashara wa Ureno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
entries.translation: Kwa kasi ikawa maarufu miongoni mwa watu wa matabaka ya juu huko Ulaya, na kufikia karne ya 18, chai ilikuwa inanywewa kote Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 19, chai ilifika pia Amerika Kaskazini, ambapo ilikuwa kinywaji maarufu miongoni mwa wakoloni na Wazaliwa wa Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
entries.translation: Grace: Hiyo inapendeza sana. Sikudhania chai ina historia ndefu hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
entries.translation: Mwalimu: Ni simulizi ya kuvutia, na ni mojawapo ambayo bado inaandikwa hadi leo hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
entries.translation: Wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, Ujerumani na Mataifa ya muungano yalitumia ndege mbalimbali kufanikisha vita vya angani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu katika kuamua matokeo ya vita ilikuwa ni usahihi wa makombora ya ndege.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
entries.translation: Kimo ambacho ndege ingepaa pia lilikuwa jambo muhimu la kuzingatia, kwa kuwa hili lilibaini umbali ambao ndege ingepaa na kiwango cha mizigo ambacho ingebeba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
entries.translation: Marekani iliunda ndege kadhaa za mashambulizi ya makombora katika miinuko ya juu wakati wa vita hivyo, ikijumuisha B-17 Flying Fortress na B-29 Superfortress.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
entries.translation: Ndege hizi ziliweza kupaa katika miinuko ya juu ya zaidi ya futi 30,000, na hili lilifanya iwe vigumu kushambulia ndege hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
entries.translation: Pia zilibeba shehena kubwa la makombora, ambayo yalitumika kushambulia ngome za maadui.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.translation: Pia, German Luftwaffe iliunda ndege kadhaa za makomboza za miinuko ya juu, ikijumuisha Heinkel He 177 Greif na Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ndege hizi hazikuwa madhubuti kama za wenzao wa Amerika, kwa sababu ya matatizo kadhaa ya kiufundi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know what you did yesterday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
entries.translation: Ulichapisha picha yako ukiwa umevalia tambara lile la kijani kwenye mtandao wa kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
entries.translation: Ninajua ulifikiri ulikuwa mzaha, lakini sivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
entries.translation: Ulimkosea heshima mama yako, na ilimuumiza sana kihisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
entries.translation: Sio eti nataka uombe msamaha kwa sababu umenikasirisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
entries.translation: Ningependa uombe msamaha kwa sababu unapaswa kufanya hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
entries.translation: Tafadhali mpigie simu leo na umwombe msamaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
entries.translation: Mwambie kuwa hukukusudia kumuumiza hisia, na kuwa unaahidi kutovalia tena tambara hilo la kijani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
entries.translation: Ninajua wewe ni mzuri, na unampenda mamako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
entries.translation: Kwa hivyo tafadhali, fanya linalostahili na uombe msamaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
entries.translation: Baada ya kumwomba mama yako msamaha, ninataka uchome tambara hilo la kijani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
entries.translation: Linaashiria utovu wako wa nidhamu, na linafaa kutoweka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
entries.translation: Ninajua huenda ikawa vigumu kuachilia tambara hilo la kijani, lakini ni muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
entries.translation: Ni ishara ya mambo yako yaliyopita, na ni wakati wa kusonga mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
entries.translation: Na huhitaji tena lile tambara kujitambulisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burn it and let it go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
entries.translation: Kisha uende umkumbatie mamako na umwambie kuwa unampenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
entries.translation: Gari lilikuwa likiendeshwa kwa kasi sana na likapoteza mwelekeo, likayumba hadi kwenye laini nyingine na kugongana ana kwa ana na gari jingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
entries.translation: Dereva wa gari la kwanza alikufa papo hapo, na dereva wa gari la pili akajeruhiwa vibaya sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.
entries.translation: Rafiki yangu Joseph alinipigia simu ili kunisimulia kisa hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."
entries.translation: "Inahuzunisha sana", alisema. "Ninawazia tu jinsi jamaa za waathiriwa wanavyohisi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.
entries.translation: "Pia mimi," nilijibu. "Inatukumbusha kuwa tunahitaji kuwa waangalifu tunapoendesha magari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."
entries.translation: Hata kosa kidogo tu linaweza kusababisha madhara makubwa mno."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."
entries.translation: "Ninakubalina nawe," Jo alijibu. "Sote tunahitajika kufuata sheria za barabarani na kuendesha gari kwa uangalifu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."
entries.translation: "Kweli," Jo alisema kwa ulegevu. "Wakati mwingine ninakosea."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the small town of Malgudi, there was a corrupt police inspector named Ramasamy.
entries.translation: Katika mji mdogo wa Malgudi, kulikuwepo na inspekta wa polisi mfisadi kwa jina Ramasamy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would often take bribes from the people he arrested, and he would also use his power to harass and intimidate people.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi angepokea hongo kutoka kwa watu aliowakamata, na pia angetumia mamlaka yake kunyanyasa na kutishia watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ramasamy arrested a young man named Krishnan for a crime he did not commit.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Ramasamy alimkamata kijana mmoja kwa jina Krishnan kwa kosa ambalo hakufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan was innocent, but Ramasamy refused to listen to him.
entries.translation: Krishnan hakuwa na hatia, lakini Ramasamy alikataa kumsikiliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He demanded a bribe from Krishnan, and when Krishnan refused to pay, Ramasamy threw him in jail.
entries.translation: Alitaka hongo kutoka kwa Krishnan, naye Krishnan alipokataa kulipa, Ramasamy alimfunga jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan's father, a poor farmer, was desperate to get his son out of jail.
entries.translation: Babake Krishnan ambaye alikuwa mkulima mchochole, alihangaikia kumtoa mwanawe jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to see Ramasamy and begged him to release Krishnan, but Ramasamy refused.
entries.translation: Alikwenda kumwona Ramasamy na kumsihi amwachilie Krishnan, lakini Ramasamy alikataa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer then went to the local temple and prayed to God for help.
entries.translation: Kisha mkulima huyo akaenda katika eneo la kuabudu lililokuwa karibu na kumwomba Mungu amsaidie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, the farmer was walking home from the temple when he saw a large snake crossing the road.
entries.translation: Siku iliyofuata, mkulima huyo akitembea kurudi nyumbani kutoka katika eneo la kuabudu, aliona joka kubwa likivuka barabara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer was afraid of snakes, but he knew that he had to do something to help his son.
entries.translation: Mkulima huyo aliogopa nyoka, lakini alifahamu kuwa lazima angefanya jambo ili kumsaidia mwanawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked up the snake and carried it to the police station.
entries.translation: Alinyanyua nyoka yule na kumpeleka hadi katika kituo cha polisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Ramasamy saw the snake, he was terrified.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.
entries.translation: Daktari wa meno: Hebu niangalie. [Anachunguza meno ya mgonjwa.] Naam, inaonekana una tundu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.
entries.translation: Nitahitaji kuondoa uozo na kujaza shimo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: It might be a little uncomfortable, but I'll do my best to make it as painless as possible.
entries.translation: Daktari wa meno: Huenda ukahisi maumivu kidogo, lakini nitajitahidi usihisi uchungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.
entries.translation: Daktari wa meno: (anampa mgonjwa dawa ya kufa ganzi) Sawa, dawa hii itatia ganzi katika sehemu hii hivyo hutahisi chochote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (drills out the decay and fills the hole) All done!
entries.translation: Daktari wa meno: (anaondoa uozo na kujaza shimo hilo) Nimemaliza!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Asante, daktari. Haikuwa mbaya sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: You're welcome. Just be sure to brush and floss regularly to prevent future cavities.
entries.translation: Daktari wa meno: Karibu. Hakikisha tu umepiga mswaki na kutumia uzi mwembamba kuondoa uchafu kila mara ili kuzuia mashimo kwenye meno siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I will Dentist: (hands the patient a list of instructions) Here are some instructions on how to care for your new filling.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear [Name], I hope this letter finds you well.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been going well this year.
entries.translation: Ninakuandikia kutoka kwenye shamba letu la familia, ambapo mavuno yamekuwa mazuri mwaka huu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're expecting a bumper crop of sugarcane, which is used to make rum.
entries.translation: Tunatarajia mazao mengi ya miwa, inayotumiwa kutengeneza ramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a distilled spirit made from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.
entries.translation: Ramu ni pombe iliyochujwa na iliyotengenezwa kutoka kwa molasi au maji ya miwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida, huhifadhiwa kwenye mapipa ya mbao na hii huipa ladha yake ya kipekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.
entries.translation: Unaweza kufarahia ramu kavu, ikiwa na barafu, au ikichanganywa na vinywaji vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.
entries.translation: Kuna aina tofauti za ramu, kila moja ina ladha yake ya kipekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya aina maarufu za ramu ni pamoja na ramu nyeupe, ramu nyeusi, na ramu iliyotiwa vikolezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida ramu nyeupe hutengenezwa kutoka kwa molasi na ina ladha tamu nyororo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.
entries.translation: Ramu nyeusi hutengenezwa kutoka kwa maji ya miwa na ina ladha nzuri, na changamano zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
entries.translation: Ramu iliyotiwa vikolezo hutengenezwa kwa kuongeza viungo, kama vile mdalasini, kungumanga, na karafuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.
entries.translation: Ramu ni mvinyo nyumbufu unaoweza kutumiwa katika michanganyiko mbalimbali ya vileo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya michanganyiko murwa ya ramu inajumuisha daiquiri, mojito, na pina colada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.
entries.translation: Pia ramu inaweza kutumika kwenye michanganyiko zaidi, kama vile Hemingway Daiquiri au Painkiller.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance.
entries.translation: Lazima tuvunje minyororo ya umaskini na kutokujua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And we must bind ourselves together in a common purpose: to build a better future for Nigeria.
entries.translation: Na lazima tuungane pamoja kwa kusudi moja: kujenga mustakabali wa Naijeria wa siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The destiny of Nigeria is not to be a land of division and conflict.
entries.translation: Hatima ya Naijeria sio kuwa nchi ya utengano na migogoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land of unity and progress.
entries.translation: Ni kuwa nchi ya umoja na maendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land where everyone has a chance to succeed, regardless of their background or circumstances.
entries.translation: Ni kuwa nchi ambapo kila mtu ana fursa ya kufaulu, licha ya historia au hali yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we cannot achieve this future without working together.
entries.translation: Lakini hatuwezi kutimiza maono haya ya siku zijazo bila kushirikiana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces that seek to divide us and come together as one people.
entries.translation: Lazima tukatae kutengana na tuje pamoja kama taifa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance that hold us back.
entries.translation: Lazima tuvunje minyonyoro ya umaskini na kutojua inayoturudisha nyuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The future of Nigeria is in our hands.
entries.translation: Hatima ya Naijeria ipo mikononi mwetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us reject, break and bind the forces that seek to control and pervert our destiny.
entries.translation: Hebu tukatae, tupinge na tuzuie kinacholenga kuteka na kupotosha hatima yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us come together as one people and build a better future for all.
entries.translation: Tuungane pamoja kama taifa moja na tujenge mustakabali wetu sote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Complete your Amazon shopping experience with our new and improved ad service!" the ad read.
entries.translation: "Boresha hali yako ya ununuzi kwenye Amazon kupitia huduma yetu mpya na iliyoboreshwa ya matangazo!" usomaji wa matangazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "With our service, you'll never have to worry about missing out on a great deal again.
entries.translation: "Kwa kutumia huduma yetu, hutapitwa na ofa yoyote maalum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sit back and relax, and we'll take care of the rest.
entries.translation: Tulia tu na ustarehe, na tutashughulikia kila kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our service is completely free to use, and it's easy to get started.
entries.translation: Huduma yetu hailipishwi, na unaweza kuanza kuitumia kwa urahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sign up for an account and start adding products to your cart.
entries.translation: Jisajili tu kwa kufungua akaunti kisha uanze kuongeza bidhaa kwenye kikapu chako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to check out, our service will automatically find the best deals for you and apply them to your order.
entries.translation: Ukiwa tayari kufanya malipo, huduma yetu itakutafutia ofa bora na kuziteua kwenye agizo lako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So what are you waiting for?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sign up for our service today and start saving money on all your Amazon purchases!"
entries.translation: Jisajili kutumia huduma yetu leo na uanze kuokoa pesa kwa ununuzi wote unaofanya kwenye Amazon!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the customer clicked on the ad, they were whisked away to a new website.
entries.translation: Mteja alipobofya tangazo, alielekezwa kwenye tovuti nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The website was full of ads for all sorts of products, all of which were supposedly on sale.
entries.translation: Tovuti hiyo ilikuwa na matangazo mengi ya bidhaa mbalimbali, na zote hizo zilikuwa zinauzwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer was tempted to buy a few things, but they hesitated.
entries.translation: Mteja alishawishika kununua vitu vichache, lakini akasita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had heard stories about people getting scammed by online ads, and they didn't want to be one of them.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amesikia kuhusu matukio ya watu kulaghaiwa kupitia matangazo ya mtandaoni, na hakutaka kuwa miongoni mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer decided to do some research on the company that was running the ad.
entries.translation: Mteja aliamua kuchunguza kampuni iliyokuwa ikiendesha tangazo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They found a few negative reviews, but most of the reviews were positive.
entries.translation: Alipata maoni machache hasi, lakini mengi yazo yalikuwa chanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The black dog came to me in the night.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had cold, wet fur and its eyes were like coals.
entries.translation: Manyoya yake yalikuwa baridi na yenye unyevunyevu, na macho yake yalikuwa kama makaa ya mawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.
entries.translation: Aliningurumia na ningehisi harufu ya pumzi yake, ilikuwa moto na yenye kunuka kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that I must run, but my legs were leaden and I could not move.
entries.translation: Nilijua kuwa lazima nikimbie, lakini miguu yangu ilikuwa mizito na nisingeweza kusonga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Mbwa alinikaribia zaidi, na meno yake yalikuwa wazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Nilifumba macho yangu na kusubiri mwisho wangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa sauti ya mwanamke, nyororo na ya upole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Nilifumbua macho yangu na nikamwona mwanamke amesimama mbele yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mrefu na mwembamba, na mwenye nywele ndefu nyeusi na macho meusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amevalia nguo nyeupe iliyokuwa imemfunika mithili ya ukungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "Wewe ni nani?" Niliuliza. "Mimi ni Malaika wa Kifo," alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Nimekuja kukuvusha hadi upande ule mwingine." Sikuhofia tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Nilijua kuwa mwanamke huyo angenipeleka mahali pasipo na dhiki wala mateso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Nilimshika mkono wake na akaniondoa pale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: Mimi ni Dkt. Boakye, daktari wa watoto katika Hospitali ya Mafunzo ya Korle Bu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: Niko hapa kukuzungumzia kuhusu chanjo mpya ya malaria ambayo imeidhinishwa kutumika nchini Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Baba: Singependa watoto wangu wapokee chanjo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Daktari: Ninaelewa kuwa una wasiwasi, lakini ningependa kuchukua dakika chache kuelezea kwa nini ninapenekeza watoto wako wapokee chanjo dhidi ya malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Baba: Sihitaji kushawishiwa. Malaria ni ugonjwa hatari, lakini sio kawaida sana katika kijiji chetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's true, but malaria is still a major public health problem in Ghana. In 2020, there were over 24 million cases of malaria in Ghana, and over 4,000 people died from the disease
entries.translation: Daktari: Kweli, lakini bado malaria ni tatizo kubwa la kiafya nchini Ghana. Mwaka wa 2020, zaidi ya watu milioni 24 waliaambukizwa malaria nchini Ghana, na zaidi ya watu 4,000 waliaga dunia kutokana na ugonjwa huo
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Baba: Lakini watoto wangu wana afya. Hajawahi kuugua malaria
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hiyo ni vizuri, lakini haimaanishi kuwa wana kinga. Mtu yeyote anaweza kupata malaria, hata iwapo hajawahi kuugua awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: "Nilikuwa nikivinjari kwenye intaneti, nikijishughulisha na mambo yangu, nilipoona tangazo hili lililojitokeza likisema kuwa kompyuta yangu ina virusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: Lakini nilibofya tangazo hilo, na likanielekeza kwenye tovuti nyingine iliyoonekana kuwa rasmi, kisha nikaona maelekezo kuwa ninahitaji kupakua programu fulani ili kuondoa virusi hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Basi nikafanya hivyo, na nikaisakinisha, kisha ikaanza kujaza programu hasidi kwenye kompyuta yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.translation: Nilijaribu kuiondoa, lakini haikuniruhusu kufanya hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Hatimaye nililazimika kupeleka kompyuta yangu kwenye karakana ya kuzitengeneza, na walilazimika kufuta kila kitu na kusakinisha Windows upya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Hivyo, ndiyo maana mimi huwa mwangalifu sana kuhusu kubofya matangazo yanayojitokeza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: Huenda yakawa na programu hasidi au yanaweza kuiba data yako binafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Wakati wowote ukiona kidirisha ibukizi kinachoonekana cha kutiliwa shaka, kifunge tu na usikibofye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: Na ikiwa huna uhakika kuhusu usalama wake, usibofye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Hiki hapa ni chakula kitamu cha nyama ya nguruwe kutoka jimbo la Lancashire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: 1. Pasha tanuri moto kwanza hadi digrii 180.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Ondoa mafuta ya ziada kwenye kipande cha nyama ya nguruwe na uikatekate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. Kwenye bakuli, changanya mafuta ya mzeituni, asalimiwa, siki, mchuzi wa Worcestershire na mafuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Paka mchanganyiko huu kwenye nyama yote ya nguruwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Weka nyama ya nguruwe kwenye sehemu ya kuchomea na uchome kwenye tanuri kwa saa 2, au hadi ngozi igeuke kuwa kahawia na nyama iwe imeiva yote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. Ukiendelea kuchoma nyama, katakata vitunguu, vitunguu saumu, majani ya mdalasini na thaimu, vipande vidogo-vidogo.
