entries.english: Nelson Mandela is a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary, political leader, and philanthropist who served as the first black president of South Africa from 1994 to 1999.
entries.translation: Nelson Mandela ni mwanamapinduzi dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi, kiongozi wa kisiasa, na mfadhili nchini Afrika Kusini aliyehudumu kama rais wa kwanza mweusi wa Afrika Kusini kuanzia mwaka wa 1994 hadi 1999.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Anafahamika pakubwa kama mmoja wa watu maarufu sana wa kihistoria duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Mandela alizaliwa mwaka wa 1918 huko Mvezo, Afrika Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Alikulia kijijini na alipata elimu katika shule ya misheni ya Wamethodisti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Baada ya shule ya upili, alisomea sheria katika Chuo Kikuu cha Fort Hare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1944, alijiunga na chama cha kisiasa cha African National Congress (ANC), kilichokuwa kikipambana dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Mandela alikamatwa kwa sababu ya harakati zake za kisiasa mwaka wa 1962 na akahukumiwa kifungo cha maisha gerezani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Alifungwa kwa miaka 27, na wakati huo akawa kielelezo kwa vuguvugu la mapambano dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1990, Mandela aliachiliwa kutoka gerezani na akachaguliwa kuwa rais wa Afrika Kusini mwaka wa 1994.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Kama rais, Mandela alijitahidi kuunganisha Afrika Kusini na kudumisha uwiano kati ya waafrika weusi na wazungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Pia alishuhudia kukomeshwa kwa ubaguzi wa rangi na mpito wa serikali ya demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Mandela ni mshindi wa Tuzo ya Amani ya Nobel na amepokea tuzo zingine nyingi za heshima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Baada ya shule, huwa ninaelekea nyumbani na kufanya kazi niliyopewa shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Kisha ninaweza kutazama televisheni au kucheza michezo ya video.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine huwa ninakwenda kujivinjari na marafiki zangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kwenda kutazama filamu, au kwenye bustani au kukutana manyumbani mwetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Kisha ninaweza kwenda kufanya ununuzi, kutazama filamu au kuzuru makavazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Pia ninapenda kutangamana na familia yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kwenda kula chajio au kucheza michezo au kutazama televisheni pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Ninafurahia sana baada ya kutoka shule.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: Nina uhuru mwingi sana na ninaweza kufanya ninachotaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Pia ninajifunza mengine kujihusu na kuhusu ulimwengu ulionizunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Nina matamanio kuhusu siku za baadaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Kutumia data kuwasaidia walio na matatizo ya kiakili ni taaluma mpya kiasi, lakini inaonyesha matumaini makubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Mfano mmoja ni matumizi ya data kubaini matibabu yanayomfaa mgonjwa kulingana na hali yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Kwa kuangalia data binafsi ya mgonjwa, daktari anaweza kuelewa vizuri mahitaji yake na kuandaa mpango wa matibabu unaomfaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Hii itawasaidia wagonjwa kutibiwa kwa njia bora kwani uwezekano ni kuwa watapokea matibabu mahususi wanayohitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Pia, utafiti huo ulibaini kuwa wagonjwa waliopokea matibabu yaliyobinafsishwa walikuwa na uwezekano zaidi wa kuendelea kupata matibabu kwa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Utafiti huu ni mfano mmoja tu wa jinsi ambavyo data inaweza kutumika kuimarisha huduma za afya ya kiakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: Kadri utafiti zaidi unavyofanywa katika taaluma hii, tunaweza kutarajia kuona maboresho zaidi ya matumizi ya data katika kuwasaidia walio na matatizo ya kiakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Dada yangu ni daktari na hutumia data kuwahudumia wagonjwa wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Maziwa ya maji safi ni makao ya mimea na wanyama mbalimbali, kuanzia mimea midogo ya mwani hadi samaki wakubwa na mamalia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Mazingira ya kipekee ya maziwa ya maji safi ni ikolojia anuwai kwa viumbe hawa, na maingiliano kati yao ni changamano na ya kuvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya sifa kuu zaidi za maziwa ya maji safi ni uwepo wa ukanda tofauti wa mimea, unaolingana na kina cha maji na kiwango cha miale ya jua kinachofika chini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: Kwenye maeneo ya kina kifupi palipo na mwangaza wa kutosha, pana mshikamano wa mimea mingi yenye mizizi uitwao "utando wa makrofaiti".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Haya ni makao kwa wanyama wasio na uti wa mgongo, samaki, na amfibia mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: Katika maeneo ya kina zaidi, pasipo na mwangaza wa kutosha, safu ya maji ina na mimea ya planktoni, ambayo ni mimea midogo ya mwani inayoelea huru majini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Viumbe hawa ni wazalishaji msingi katika mfumo wa ikolojia ya ziwa, na ndio chanzo cha msururu wa chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Pia, wapo wanyama tofautitofauti katika maziwa ya maji safi, na wanajumuisha aina mbalimbali za samaki, amfibia, wanyama wanaotambaa, ndege, na mamalia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Samaki ndio wengi zaidi miongoni mwa walio na uti wa mgongo katika maziwa ya maji safi, na wanatekeleza jukumu muhimu katika msururu wa chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya spishi za samaki wa kawaida katika maziwa ya maji safi inajumuisha tirauti, besi, mshamo, na sangara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the storage area is also equipped with a fire alarm system, so that if there is a fire, the alarm will sound and the fire department will be notified.
entries.translation: Pia, eneo la hifadhi lina king'ora cha moto, ili moto unapotokea, king'ora kinalia na idara ya wazima moto itaarifiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.
entries.translation: Pia eneo la hifadhi hukaguliwa mara kwa mara na idara ya moto, ili uwezekano wa hatari zozote za moto unaweza kutambuliwa na kushughulikiwa kabla ya kusababisha matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Kutokana na hatua hizi, eneo la hifadhi ni salama na mahali pazuri pa kuhifadhi bidhaa za thamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the fire safety measures, the storage area is also equipped with a security system to protect against theft.
entries.translation: Pamoja na hatua za usalama dhidi ya moto, eneo la hifadhi pia limewekewa mfumo wa usalama dhidi ya wizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The security system consists of a surveillance camera, a burglar alarm, and a security guard.
entries.translation: Mfumo wa usalama unajumuisha kamera za ulinzi, king'ora, na mlinzi wa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The surveillance camera monitors the area 24 hours a day, the burglar alarm is activated if anyone tries to break in, and the security guard is on duty to patrol the area and respond to any incidents.
entries.translation: Kamera ya ulinzi inafuatilia eneo hilo saa 24 kwa siku, king'ora hulia yeyote akijaribu kuvamia eneo hilo, naye mlinzi wa usalama yuko kwenye zamu akizunguka eneo hilo na kushughulikia matukio yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these security measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Kwa sababu ya hatua hizi za usalama, eneo la hifadhi ni salama na mahali pazuri pa kuhifadhia bidhaa za thamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook Users Drunkenly Post About Their Lives

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Watumiaji wa Facebook wanalewa na kuchapisha kuhusu maisha yao, na jambo hili linasababisha mvurugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The social media platform has been flooded with photos and videos of people who are clearly intoxicated, and many of them are sharing personal details about themselves that they wouldn't normally share.
entries.translation: Mtandao huu wa kijamii umefurika picha na video za watu waliolewa, na wengi wao wanashiriki maelezo yao ya kibinafsi ambayo kwa kawaida hawafai kuyashiriki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watumiaji wana wasiwasi kuwa mkondo huo ni hatari, kwa sababu unaweza kusababisha watu kufanya maamuzi mabaya au kufanya mambo ambayo watajutia baadaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.
entries.translation: Wengine wanafurahia tu vituko hivyo vya watumiaji wenza walevi wa Facebook.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."
entries.translation: Mtumiaji mmoja alichapisha picha yake akiwa amelala sakafuni na akanukuu, "Nimelewa chakari siwezi hata kunyanyuka."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"
entries.translation: Mtumiaji mwingine alishiriki video yake akicheza densi juu ya meza huku akipiga kelele, "Maisha yangu ni ya sherehe!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trend has even caught the attention of celebrities.
entries.translation: Mkondo huo pia unawahusisha watu mashuhuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comedian Amy Schumer posted a photo of herself on Twitter with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even spell my own name."
entries.translation: Mchekeshaji kwa jina Amy Schumer alichapisha picha yake kwenye Twitter na akanukuu, "Nimelewa chakari hata siwezi kutamka jina langu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook has not commented on the trend, but it's clear that it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Facebook haijatoa maoni kuhusu mkondo huo, lakini ni dhahiri kuwa unasababisha mvurugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Only time will tell whether the trend will continue or fade away.
entries.translation: Ni muda tu utadhihirisha iwapo mkondo huo utaendelea au utafifia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zambia ni nchi isiyo na bandari na inapatikana Kusini mwa Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia has a population of over 17 million people and a land area of 752,618 square kilometers.
entries.translation: Idadi ya watu nchini Zambia ni zaidi ya milioni 17 na ukubwa wake ni kilomita 752,618 mraba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's current president is Hakainde Hichilema, who was elected in August 2021.
entries.translation: Rais wa sasa wa Zambia ni Hakainde Hichilema, aliyechaguliwa mnamo Agosti 2021.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hichilema is a member of the United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.translation: Hichilema ni mwanachama wa United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The UPND is the largest opposition party in Zambia.
entries.translation: UPND ndicho chama kikubwa cha upinzani nchini Zambia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy of Zambia is based on copper mining.
entries.translation: Uchumi wa Zambia unategemea uchimbaji wa shaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Copper is the country's largest export.
entries.translation: Shaba ndiyo bidhaa kubwa inayouzwa nje ya nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important exports include cobalt, zinc, and lead.
entries.translation: Bidhaa zingine muhimu za kuuzwa nje ni kobalti, zinki, na madini ya risasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Zambian economy has been struggling in recent years due to low copper prices.
entries.translation: Uchumi wa Zambia umekuwa ukidorora katika miaka ya hivi karibuni kutokana na kushuka kwa bei za madini ya shaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).
entries.translation: Zambia ni nchi mwanachama katika Umoja wa Mataifa, Muungano wa Afrika, na Jumuiya ya Maendeleo ya Afrika ya Kusini (SADC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The signing of Lionel Messi by Paris Saint-Germain sent shockwaves through the world of soccer.
entries.translation: Kusajiliwa kwa Lionel Messi katika timu ya Paris Saint-Germain kulishtua sana ulimwengu wa soka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Argentine superstar had been one of the most coveted players in the world for years, and his arrival in Paris marked a major turning point in the club's history.
entries.translation: Nyota huyo wa Ajentina amekuwa mchezaji maarufu sana duniani kwa miaka mingi, na kuwasili kwake Paris kulileta mabadiliko makubwa sana katika historia ya klabu hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi had spent his entire professional career with Barcelona, where he had won everything there was to win.
entries.translation: Messi alitumia muda mwingi wa taaluma yake akiwa Barcelona, ambapo alishinda tuzo zote zilikuwepo za kushindaniwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But after a tumultuous few months, he decided to leave the club and sign with PSG.
entries.translation: Lakini baada ya misukosuko ya miezi michache, aliamua kuondoka katika klabu hiyo na kujisajili na PSG.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The move was a major coup for PSG, who were looking to add a superstar to their squad in order to compete for the Champions League title.
entries.translation: Hatua hiyo ilikuwa mapinduzi makubwa kwa PSG, ambao walikuwa wakitazamia kumwongeza nyota huyo kwenye kikosi chao ili kushindania kombe la Ligi ya Mabingwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi's signing was met with excitement by PSG fans, who were eager to see the world's best player in action.
entries.translation: Kusajiliwa kwa Messi kulighubikwa na furaha tele na mashabiki wa PSG, waliokuwa na shauku ya kumtazama mchezaji huyo bora duniani akicheza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there were also some concerns about how he would fit into the team.
entries.translation: Lakini kulikuwepo na wasiwasi kuhusu jinsi ambavyo angeingiliana na timu hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PSG already had a number of talented players, and it was unclear how Messi would be able to work with them.
entries.translation: Tayari PSG ilikuwa na wachezaji kadhaa hodari, na haikuwa dhahiri jinsi ambavyo Messi angeweza kushirikiana nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.
entries.translation: Of Mice and Men ni riwaya iliyoandikwa na John Steinbeck inayosimulia hadithi ya wafanyakazi wawili wahamiaji, George na Lennie, waliosafiri pamoja kutafuta kazi wakati wa Great Depression.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.
entries.translation: Riwaya hii inaangazia kipindi ambapo Ndoto ya Amerika haikuwepo tena, na njia pekee ya kuishi ilikuwa kukaa pamoja na kusaidiana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George and Lennie are both dreamers.
entries.translation: George na Lennie wote wana maono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Ndoto ya George ni kuwa siku moja amiliki shamba lake, ambapo yeye pamoja na Lennie wanaweza kuishi kwa amani na upatano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lennie dreams of petting soft rabbits and being gentle with them.
entries.translation: Ndoto ya Lennie ni kufuga sungura na kuwatunza kwa upole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their dreams are constantly thwarted by the harsh realities of the world they live in.
entries.translation: Lakini ndoto zao zinasambaratika kila wakati kutokana na hali ngumu ya mahali wanakoishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, George and Lennie find work on a ranch in California.
entries.translation: Siku moja, George na Lennie walipata kazi katika shamba fulani kule California.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are immediately befriended by Candy, an old ranch hand who is missing an arm.
entries.translation: Mara moja wakapata rafiki kwa jina Candy, mkulima mmoja shambani ambaye ni kikono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Candy tells George and Lennie about his dream of one day owning a small farm, and the three men decide to pool their money together to buy a farm.
entries.translation: Candy akawaambia George na Lennie kuhusu ndoto yake ya kumiliki shamba dogo siku moja, na wanaume hao watatu wakaamua kuchanga pesa pamoja ili kununua shamba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.
entries.translation: Mara tena, mipango yao ikasambaratika tena pale Lennie alimuua mwanamke bila kukusudia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is forced to shoot Lennie to prevent him from being lynched.
entries.translation: George analazimika kumpiga Lennie risasi ili kumwepusha kuuwawa na umati wa watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is devastated by Lennie's death, but he knows that it was the only thing he could do.
entries.translation: George anahuzunishwa sana na kifo cha Lennie, lakini anajua hakuna lingine ambalo angeweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so itchy! I think I have lice.
entries.translation: A: Ninawashwa sana! Huenda nina chawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know how to get rid of them, though.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ninajua jinsi ya kuwaondoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can use a traditional remedy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: We'll need some olive oil, some lemon juice, and a few cloves of garlic.
entries.translation: B: Tutahitaji mafuta kidogo ya mzeituni, maji kiasi ya limau, na vipande vichache vya vitunguu saumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Okay, I have all of that. What do we do with it?
entries.translation: A: Sawa, hivyo vyote ninavyo. Tunavifanyia nini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: First, we'll mix the olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic together.
entries.translation: B: Kwanza, tutachanganya mafuta ya mzeituni, maji ya limau, na kitunguu saumu pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we'll apply it to your hair and scalp.
entries.translation: Kisha, tutapaka kwenye nywele na kwenye ngozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We'll let it sit for about an hour.
entries.translation: Tutaicha hivyo kwa karibu saa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: An hour? That sounds like a long time.
entries.translation: A: Saa moja? Huo ni muda mrefu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: It is, but it's worth it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The oil will help to suffocate the lice and the lemon juice will help to kill them.
entries.translation: Mafuta yatasaidia kuwakaba chawa pumzi nayo maji ya limau yatasaidia kuwaua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garlic will help to repel them.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Mommy, what are those?" the toddler asked, pointing at the plants in the living room.
entries.translation: "Mama, hizo ni nini?" mtoto aliuliza, akinyoshea kidole mimea iliyokuwepo sebuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Those are plants," Mommy replied "They're living things, just like you and me."
entries.translation: "Hiyo ni mimea," Mama alimjibu "Ni vitu vyenye uhai, kama tu wewe na mimi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch them?" the toddler asked.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, you can, but be gentle," Mommy said "The leaves are fragile."
entries.translation: "Ndiyo, unaweza, lakini kuwa taratibu," Mama alisema "Matawi yake ni dhaifu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler reached out and touched a leaf.
entries.translation: Mtoto alinyosha mkono na kugusa tawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The leaf felt soft and smooth.
entries.translation: Tawi hilo lilikuwa nyororo na laini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm glad," Mommy said. "Plants are good for us. They help clean the air and make us feel better."
entries.translation: "Nimefurahia," Mama alisema. "Mimea ni mizuri kwetu. Inasaidia kusafisha hewa na kutufanya tujihisi vizuri."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler continued to look at the plants. Then, he noticed a cable running along the floor.
entries.translation: Mtoto aliendelea kuangalia mimea. Kisha, akagundua kebo iliyokuwa ikipita chini sakafuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's used to connect the TV to the wall."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch it?" the toddler asked.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you can't," Mommy said. "Cables can be dangerous.They can give you a shock."
entries.translation: "Hapana, huwezi," Mama alisema. "Kebo ni hatari. Inaweza kukupiga mshtuko"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler looked disappointed, but he didn't touch the cable.
entries.translation: Mtoto alikasirika, lakini hakugusa kebo hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Sherehe za kuzaliwa ni wakati wa kusherehekea siku ambayo ulizaliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: Ni siku ya kutafakari kuhusu mambo yote mazuri maishani mwako na kuwashukuru waliokufanya uwe jinsi ulivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Pia ni siku ya kuweka malengo ya mwaka ulio mbele yako na kufanya mipango ya mustakabali wa siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Ili ufurahie zaidi siku yako ya kuzaliwa, anza kwa kuorodhesha mambo yote unayoyathamini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kujumuisha familia yako, marafiki, afya, nyumba, kazi, au kitu kingine chochote ambacho ni muhimu kwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Baada ya kutayarisha orodha yako, tenga muda kuwazia kila kitu ulichoandika na jinsi kilivyochangia katika kuboresha maisha yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Pili, weka malengo ya mwaka unaokuja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Malengo haya yanaweza kuwa kitu chochote unachotaka, lakini yanapaswa kuwa mahususi, yanayopimika, yanayoweza kutimizwa, muhimu, na yanayozingatia muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, huenda ukaweka lengo la kupunguza uzani, kupanda cheo kazini, au kuzuru mahali fulani kwa mara ya kwanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, weka mipango ya kusherehekea siku yako ya kuzaliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kujumuisha kukaa na wapendwa wako, kula vyakula uvipendavyo, au kufanya kitu ambacho umetamani sana kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Romantic Comedies are so unrealistic.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 1: Vichekesho vya Kimahaba havina uhalisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I know, right? The love interests always fall in love at first sight, and they never have any problems.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 2: Naam, au sio? Wanaopendelea mapenzi kila wakati wanapendana kwa mara ya kwanza na kamwe hawana matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: And the conflicts are always so contrived.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 1: Na wakati mwingi migogoro huzuka kwa kukusudia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Like, in one movie, the couple broke up because the guy's best friend was in love with the girl.
entries.translation: Kama, katika filamu moja, wanandoa waliachana kwa sababu rafiki wa karibu wa mume alimpenda mke wa rafikiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: That's so ridiculous. It's not like that happens in real life.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 2: Hilo linachekesha sana. Sio kwamba hilo linafanyika katika maisha halisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Exactly. And even when they do get together, it's always so perfect.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 1: Kabisa. Na hata wanapochumbiana, huwa shwari kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They never have any fights or disagreements.
entries.translation: Kamwe hawana mzozano na malumbano yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: It's like the movies are trying to tell us that love is always easy and perfect.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 2: Ni kana kwamba filamu zinajaribu kutuonyesha kuwa mapenzi ni rahisi na kamilifu kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes time and effort to build a lasting relationship.
entries.translation: Inachukua muda na bidii kujenga uhusiano wa kudumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: I know. That's why I don't watch rom-coms anymore.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 1: Ninajua. Hiyo ndio sababu sitazami tena vichekesho vya kimahaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They give people unrealistic expectations about love.
entries.translation: Vinawapa watu matarajio yasio ya uhalisia kuhusu mapenzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.
entries.translation: Siku yangu ya kwanza shuleni ilikuwa siku ambayo kamwe sitaisahau.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa na furaha na pia wasiwasi, bila kujua cha kutarajia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.
entries.translation: Nilipoamka asubuhi ile, nilivalia upesi na nikanywa kiamsha kinywa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.
entries.translation: Kisha, mama yangu akanipeleka shuleni na kunielekeza darasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.
entries.translation: Nilipoingia tu darasani, nilisalimiwa na mwalimu wangu, Bi. Smith.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mwanamke mwenye sura ya ukarimu na tabasamu changamfu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.
entries.translation: Alijitambulisha kwangu kisha akanionyesha kiti changu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.
entries.translation: Niliketi karibu na msichana aitwaye Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."
entries.translation: Aliniangalia kwa tabasamu na kusema, "Hujambo, mimi ni Sarah."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."
entries.translation: Nilitabasamu pia na kusema, "Hujambo, mimi ni Vera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.
entries.translation: Tulizungumza kwa dakika chache kisha kengele ya kuanza somo ikalia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.
entries.translation: Bi. Smith alianza kwa kujitambulisha na kutueleza kuhusu kanuni za darasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she started teaching us about math.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
entries.translation: Nilikanganyikiwa kiasi mwanzoni, lakini Bi. Smith alifafanua kila kitu dhahiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After math class, we had a break.
entries.translation: Baada ya somo la hisabati, tulikwenda mapumzikoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
entries.translation: Mimi na Sarah tulikwenda nje kucheza uwanjani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
entries.translation: Tulicheza kwenye vibembea na vitelezi kwa muda, kisha tukarudi ndani kula chakula cha mchana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
entries.translation: Tishu inapojeruhiwa, mfumo wa kingamaradhi mwilini hutuma seli nyeupe za damu katika sehemu hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
entries.translation: Seli hizi hutoa kemikali zinazosababisha mishipa ya damu kupanuka na kuwa na upenyezo zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Hii huruhusu umajimaji na seli nyeupe za damu kupitia kwenye mishipa ya damu na kuingia sehemu iliyojeruhiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
entries.translation: Umajimaji huo huunda uvimbe wa uoevu unaojulikana kama tambazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
entries.translation: Seli nyeupe za damu husaidia kupambana na maambukizi na kuondoa tishu iliyoharibika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
entries.translation: Pia hutoa kemikali inayosisimua ukuaji wa tishu mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
entries.translation: Dalili kuu za uvimbe mkali ni wekundu, joto, kuvimba, na maumivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Dalili hizi zinasababishwa na ongezeko la mtiririko wa damu na utoaji wa kemikali kwenye tishu iliyojeruhiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
entries.translation: Wekundu husababishwa na kupanuka kwa mishipa ya damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
entries.translation: Joto husababishwa na ongezeko la mtiririko wa damu na utoaji wa kemikali zinazosababisha uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Uvimbe husababishwa na umajimaji unaovuja kutoka kwenye mishipa ya damu na kuingia katika tishu iliyojeruhiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
entries.translation: Maumivu yanasababishwa na utoaji wa kemikali zinazosababisha uvimbe, na shinikizo la uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
entries.translation: Uvimbe mkali ni sehemu ya kawaida ya mchakato wa kupona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, iwapo uvimbe una uchungu au umekawia, unaweza kudhuru tishu isiyo na tatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, uvimbe mkali unaweza kusababisha uvimbe sugu, ambayo ni matatizo ya muda mrefu yanayoweza kusababisha maumivu, ulemavu, na hata kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa yanayoweza kusababisha uvimbe mkali, ikijumuisha maambukizi, majeraha, na magonjwa ya kingamwili kuangamiza seli mwilini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
entries.translation: Maambukizi yanasababishwa na bakteria, virusi, au kuvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
entries.translation: Viumbe hai hawa wanapoingia mwilini, wanachochea mwili kujikinga na hivyo kusababisha uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
entries.translation: Tishu inapoharibika, hutoa kemikali inayovutia seli nyeupe za damu na seli nyingine za kingamaradhi katika sehemu hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Seli hizi hutoa kemikali inayosababisha uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
entries.translation: Magonjwa ya kinga ya mwili husababishwa pale kingamaradhi inaposhambulia tishu mwilini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha uvimbe katika tishu zilizoathirika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
entries.translation: Kawaida, uvimbe mkali hutibiwa kwa vituliza maumivu, kama vile ibuprofeni au asetaminofeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, kotikosteroidi zinaweza kutumika kupunguza uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
entries.translation: Iwapo uvimbe huo umesababishwa na maambukizi, unaweza kuagizwa na daktari utumie antibaotiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Uvimbe sugu ni hali ya muda mrefu inayoweza kusababisha maumivu, ulemavu, na hata kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi husababishwa na magonjwa ya kingamaradhi, kama vile ugonjwa wa yabisi kavu na Crohn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
entries.translation: Pia, uvimbe sugu unaweza kusababishwa na kunenepa kupita kiasi, uvutaji sigara, na uchafuzi wa hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
entries.translation: Hakuna tiba ya uvimbe sugu, lakini unaweza kudhibitiwa kwa dawa, mabadiliko ya mtindo wa maisha, na tiba ya kimwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
entries.translation: Vita vya Wenyewe kwa Wenyewe vya Msumbiji vilidumu kutoka mwaka wa 1977 hadi 1992.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilisababisha utengano na uharibifu mkubwa, na ukasababisha vifo vya takriban watu milioni 1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
entries.translation: Vita vilianza baada ya RENAMO kuzindua uasi dhidi ya FRELIMO mwaka wa 1977.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: RENAMO ilipinga sera za kijamii za FRELIMO na uhusiano wake wa karibu na Umoja wa Kisovyeti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
entries.translation: Vita vilienea kwa kasi, na mapema miaka ya 1980, RENAMO ilichukua usukani wa sehemu kubwa ya nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
entries.translation: FRELIMO ililazimika kutegemea msaada wa majeshi ya Sovyeti na Kuba kukomesha RENAMO.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 1984, FRELIMO na RENAMO walitia saini mkataba wa amani, lakini vita viliendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 1992, pande zote mbili zilitia saini mkataba mpya wa amani, uliotamatisha vita na kuandaliwa kwa uchaguzi wa vyama vingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa siku angavu na yenye jua katika kijiji kidogo cha Locksmiths, ambapo tamasha la vifuli lilikuwa limeshika kasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
entries.translation: Barabara zilikuwa na umati wa watu, wote wakiwa na hamu ya kuona teknolojia ya kisasa na mahiri zaidi ya kutengeneza vifuli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
entries.translation: Kulikuwepo na wachuuzi waliokuwa wakiuza vifuli mbalimbali kuanzia vifuli vya kawaida hadi vinavyofunguliwa kwa utaratibu maalum, na wasanii walionyesha ujuzi wao wa kuchagua na kutengeneza vifuli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
entries.translation: Katikati mwa kijiji, kulikuwa na jukwaa kubwa lililokuwa limewekwa kwa ajili ya tamasha hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
entries.translation: Kikundi cha wanamuziki kilikuwa kikicheza nyimbo za moja kwa moja, na kulikuwepo na umati wa watu hapo, wakipiga makofi na kucheza densi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
entries.translation: Kwenye jukwaa, muundaji vifuli mwenye ujuzi zaidi alikuwa akionyesha jinsi ya kuchagua kufuli, na umati ulistaajabishwa sana na ujuzi wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mimi na rafiki yangu, Abel, tulikuwa tukielekea nyumbani kutoka shuleni tulipoona shughuli ya kutoa damu ikiendeshwa katika kituo chetu cha kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
entries.translation: Sote tulikuwa na umri wa miaka 17, na kamwe hatukuwa tumewahi kutoa damu awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
entries.translation: Tukaamua kusimama ili kuona kilichokuwa kikiendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli mchakato huo wa kutoa damu ulikuwa rahisi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
entries.translation: Sote tulijaza hojaji na kujibu maswali kadhaa kuhusu historia ya afya yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.
entries.translation: Kisha, tulipimwa shinikizo la damu na mishipa yetu ilikaguliwa ili kuhakikisha kuwa inaonekana vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.
entries.translation: Tulipoidhinishwa kutoa damu, sote tulikaa kwenye kiti na kudungwa sindano kwenye mikono yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The blood was collected in a bag, and the whole process took about 15 minutes.
entries.translation: Damu ilikusanywa kwenye kifuko, na mchakato huo wote ulichukua takriban dakika 15.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It felt good to know that we were helping to save lives.
entries.translation: Tulijihisi vizuri kujua kwamba tulikuwa tunasaidia kuokoa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we donated, we were given a juice box and a cookie to help us recover.
entries.translation: Baada ya kutoa damu, tulipewa pakiti ya juisi na biskuti ili kutusaidia kupata nafuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also received a thank-you card from the blood bank.
entries.translation: Pia tulipokea kadi ya kutushukuru kutoka kwa benki ya damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm glad that Abel and I decided to donate blood.
entries.translation: Ninafurahia kuwa Abel pamoja nami tuliamua kuchangia damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a quick and easy way to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa njia ya haraka na rahisi kuleta mabadiliko duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I encourage everyone to consider donating blood if they are eligible.
entries.translation: Ninawahimiza watu wote wachangie damu iwapo wanastahiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a simple act of kindness that can help save lives.
entries.translation: Ni kitendo rahisi cha ukarimu kinachoweza kusaidia kuokoa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A solo traveler was found safe after spending two nights lost in the Swiss Alps.
entries.translation: Msafiri mmoja alipatikana salama baada ya kupotea kwa siku mbili katika Swiss Alps.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The 25-year-old woman, who has not been identified, was hiking in the mountains when she became separated from her group.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo wa miaka 25, ambaye hajatambulika, alikuwa akikwea milima alipotengana na kikundi chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was reported missing on Tuesday, and search teams were dispatched to find her.
entries.translation: Aliripotiwa kupotea Jumanne, na timu za kumtafuta zilianza shughuli ya kumsaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman was eventually found on Thursday, about 10 miles from where she had been hiking.
entries.translation: Hatimaye mwanamke huyo alipatikana Alhamisi, takriban maili 10 kutoka mahali ambapo alikuwa akikwea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was cold and dehydrated, but otherwise in good condition.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amevuta baridi na kupoteza maji mengi, lakini hata hivyo, alikuwa katika hali nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told rescuers that she had been following a trail when she got turned around.
entries.translation: Aliwaambia waokoaji kuwa alikuwa akifuata njia alipopotea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She spent the night in a cave, and she survived by eating snow and drinking from a stream.
entries.translation: Alilala pangoni, na alinusurika kwa kula theluji na kunywa maji ya mto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's experience is a reminder of the importance of being prepared when hiking in the mountains.
entries.translation: Alichopitia mwanamke huyo ni somo la kutukumbusha umuhimu wa kujiandaa unapokwea milima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hikers should always bring a map, compass, and a flashlight, and they should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return.
entries.translation: Kila wakati, wanaokwea wanapaswa kuja na ramani, dira, na tochi, na wanapaswa kujulisha jamaa zao wanakokwenda na wanapotarajia kurejea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a kid, I would spend hours poring over magazines.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa mtoto, ningechukua saa nyingi kuangalia majarida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would read every article, look at every picture, and cut out the ones I liked to put in my scrapbook.
entries.translation: Ningesoma kila makala, nitazame kila picha, na kukata zile nilizopenda ili nizibandike kwenye kitabu changu cha picha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved the way magazines could transport me to different worlds and make me think about things in new ways.
entries.translation: Nilipenda jinsi ambavyo majarida yangenizamisha katika dunia tofauti na kunifanya niwazie mambo kwa njia tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was reading an article about brain science in a magazine.
entries.translation: Siku moja, nilikuwa nikisoma makala kuhusu sayansi ya ubongo kwenye jarida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The article was really interesting, and it made me think about how my brain works.
entries.translation: Makala hayo yalikuwa ya kuvutia sana, na yalinifanya nifikirie kuhusu jinsi ambavyo ubongo wangu unavyofanya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I realized that I could use my brain to learn anything I wanted, and that was an amazing feeling.
entries.translation: Niligundua kuwa ningeweza kutumia ubongo wangu kujifunza chochote ambacho nilitaka, na hiyo ilinifanya nijihisi vizuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been reading magazines ever since, and I still love the way they can open my mind to new ideas.
entries.translation: Nimesoma majarida tangu wakati huo, na bado ninapenda jinsi yanavyonisaidia kuwa na mawazo mapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
entries.translation: Mjadala kuhusu iwapo wanyama wanafurahia zaidi kukaa porini au kwenye hifadhi za wanyama ni changamano na hapana majibu rahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
entries.translation: Kuna vigezo vingi vya kuzingatia, ikijumuisha mahitaji ya mnyama binafsi, aina ya hifadhi, na ubora wa utunzaji wanaopewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya wanyama, kama vile ndovu, wanatangamana sana na wanahitaji kutangamana na ndovu wenzao ili kustawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
