entries.english: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
entries.translation: Kule porini, ndovu wanaishi katika makundi ya hadi ndovu 100.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
entries.translation: Mchana wanashinda wakila chakula, wakicheza na kutangamana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.
entries.translation: Katika hifadhi za wanyama, huenda ndovu wasiwe na fursa sawa kutangamana na ndovu wengine, na hii inaweza kuwasababishia uchovu na matamauko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.
entries.translation: Wanyama wengine, kama vile simba, huwinda peke yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.
entries.translation: Wakiwa porini, simba huishi kwenye makundi ya hadi simba 15.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kila simba kwenye kila kikundi ana himaya yake binafsi na hatangamani na simba wengine kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
entries.translation: Katika hifadhi za wanyama, simba wanaweza kuishi katika maeneo makubwa zaidi yaliyo na nafasi zaidi ya kutembea, inayowapa fursa zaidi ya kufanya mazoezi na kuzunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
entries.translation: Aina ya hifadhi pia inachangia katika ustawi wa wanyama walioko humo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya hifadhi ni kubwa na zinawapa wanyama nafasi za kutosha, ilhali nyingine ni ndogo zaidi na huenda zisiwe na nafasi ya kutosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I'm driving down the road, I see a goat giving birth in the median.
entries.translation: Ninapoendesha katika mteremko barabarani, ninamwona mbuzi akijifungua pembeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's lying on her side and her two front legs are extended in front of her.
entries.translation: Amelalia upande mmoja na miguu yake miwili ya mbele imenyooka mbele yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat is coming out of her right side and it's head is already visible.
entries.translation: Kitoto cha mbuzi kinatokea kwenye upande wake wa kulia na kichwa chake tayari kinaonekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mother goat looks up at me and I can see the fear in her eyes.
entries.translation: Mama mbuzi ananiangalia na ninaona hofu yake machoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's probably wondering if I'm going to hurt her or her baby.
entries.translation: Pengine anashangaa iwapo nitamdhuru yeye au kitoto chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stop the car and get out.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk over to the goat and kneel down next to her.
entries.translation: Ninatembea na kuelekea alipo mbuzi na ninapiga magoti karibu naye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gently stroke her head and tell her that everything is going to be okay.
entries.translation: Ninamsugua taratibu kichwani na kumwambia kuwa kila kitu kitakuwa shwari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baby goat starts to emerge and I can see that it's a little girl.
entries.translation: Kitoto cha mbuzi kinaanza kutokea na ninaona kwamba ni cha kike.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's crying and her mother licks her clean.
entries.translation: Kinalia kisha mama yake anamramba ili awe safi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I watch as the mother goat and baby bond and I feel a sense of peace.
entries.translation: Ninatazama mbuzi na kitoto chake wakikumbatiana na ninahisi utulivu fulani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The city was a vast, sprawling metropolis, full of life and energy.
entries.translation: Jiji hilo lilikuwa kubwa linalonawiri, na kulikuwepo na shughuli na mbwembwe nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a place where anything was possible, and where dreams could come true.
entries.translation: Palikuwa mahali ambapo chochote kingewezekana, na ambapo ndoto zingeweza kutimia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for every person who found success in the city, there were many more who struggled to make ends meet.
entries.translation: Lakini ikilinganishwa na waliofaulu mjini, kulikuwepo na wengine wengi waliotaabika kukidhi mahitaji yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These people lived in the slums, in tiny apartments that were often overcrowded and in disrepair.
entries.translation: Watu hawa waliishi katika mitaa ya mabanda, kwenye vyumba vidogo vibovu ambavyo vilisitiri watu wengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They worked long hours for low pay, and they often had to go without basic necessities like food and healthcare.
entries.translation: Walifanya kazi masaa mengi lakini malipo yalikuwa duni, na hawakuweza kutimiza mahitaji muhimu kama vile chakula na matibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such person was a young woman named Amelia.
entries.translation: Mmoja wao alikuwa binti kwa jina Amelia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had come to the city with big dreams, but she quickly found that reality was much different than she had imagined.
entries.translation: Alikuja mjini akiwa na ndoto kubwa, lakini baada ya muda mfupi aligundua kuwa mambo ni tofauti sana na alivyodhania.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She worked as a waitress in a small diner, and she could barely make enough money to pay her rent.
entries.translation: Alifanya kazi kama mhudumu katika hoteli ndogo na pesa alizopata hazikutosha hata kulipa kodi yake ya nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She often went to bed hungry, and she was always worried about her future.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi alilala njaa, na alikuwa na wasiwasi sana kuhusu maisha yake ya usoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Amelia was walking home from work when she saw a man sitting on a bench.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Amelia akitembea akirudi nyumbani kutoka kazini alimwona mwanaume mmoja ameketi kwenye kiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was homeless, and he was holding a sign that said, "Will work for food." Amelia felt sorry for the man, and she decided to buy him a sandwich.
entries.translation: Hakuwa na makao, na alikuwa amebeba kibao kilichoandikwa, "Nitafanya kazi ili nipate chakula." Amelia alimhurumia mwanaume huyo na akaamua kumnunulia sandwichi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she was talking to the man, she learned that his name was Charlie.
entries.translation: Alivyokuwa akizungumza na mwanaume huyo, aligundua kuwa jina lake lilikuwa Charlie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.
entries.translation: Ubatilishaji wa pesa ni mchakato wa kuondoa pesa rasmi zinazotumika kwenye uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.
entries.translation: Nchini India, Waziri Mkuu Narendra Modi alitangaza mnamo tarehe 8 Novemba, 2016, kwamba noti zote za ₹500 na ₹1000 zingeacha kutumika kama pesa halali kuanzia usiku huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.
entries.translation: Hatua hii ililenga kukabiliana na ufisadi na shughuli za ulaghai, lakini pia ilileta usumbufu mkubwa na hali ngumu kwa watu wengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.
entries.translation: Kuna sababu nyingi za kuwa na shauku kuhusu ubatilishaji wa pesa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.
entries.translation: Kwanza, hakuna uhakika kwamba kufanya hivyo kutapunguza ufisadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.
entries.translation: Ufisadi ni tatizo changamano ambalo haliwezi kutatuliwa tu kwa kubatilisha matumizi ya pesa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, kuna ushahidi kuwa ubatilishaji wa pesa unaweza kuongeza ufisadi, kwa sababu inafanya iwe vigumu kwa watu kufuatilia pesa zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.
entries.translation: Pili, ubatilishaji wa pesa unaweza kuwaathiri wasiojiweza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.
entries.translation: Watu wengi wasiojiweza nchini India wanategemea pesa taslimu kwa miamala yao ya kila siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.
entries.translation: Kuondolewa kwa ghafla kwa kiasi kikubwa cha noti kulifanya iwe vigumu kwao kununua chakula, kulipa bili zao na kupata huduma zingine muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.
entries.translation: Tatu, ubatilishaji wa pesa umesababisha usumbufu mkubwa kwa uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.
entries.translation: Biashara nyingi zililazimika kufunga kwa siku au hata wiki kadhaa kabla ya kuzoea sarafu mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dish is said to have originated in the Philippines, where it is known as lechon.
entries.translation: Asili ya chakula hicho inasemekana kuwa nchini Ufilipino, ambako kinafahamika kama lechon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also popular in other parts of Southeast Asia, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
entries.translation: Pia ni maarufu katika sehemu nyingine za Kusini mashariki mwa Asia, kama vile Indonesia, Malesia na Thailandi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make lechon, a whole pig is gutted and cleaned, then stuffed with a mixture of garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and other spices.
entries.translation: Ili kuandaa lechon, nguruwe mzima anachinjwa na kusafishwa, kisha anatiwa mchanganyiko wa kitunguu saumu, tangawizi, limau na viungo vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pig is then roasted over a fire of charcoal or wood for several hours.
entries.translation: Nguruwe huyo kisha anachomwa kwenye moto wa makaa au kuni kwa saa kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The result is a juicy, flavorful meat that is perfect for a special occasion.
entries.translation: Matokeo yake ni nyama yenye ladha tamu inayostahiki kuliwa katika hafla maalum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lechon is often served with rice and vegetables.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi, lechon huliwa na wali na mboga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be eaten as a main course or as an appetizer.
entries.translation: Inaweza pia kuliwa kama chakula kikuu au kama kiamsha hamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are ever lucky enough to try lechon, you will not be disappointed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is truly a unique and delicious dish.
entries.translation: Ni chakula cha kipekee na kitamu kwa kweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the traditional method of cooking lechon, there are also several modern variations.
entries.translation: Kando na mbinu za jadi za kupika lechon, pia kuna mbinu kadhaa za kisasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some chefs cook the pig in a pit oven, while others use a rotisserie.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also recipes for making lechon in a slow cooker or in the oven.
entries.translation: Pia kuna mapishi ya kuandaa lechon polepole kwenye meko au tanuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how it is cooked, lechon is always a crowd-pleaser.
entries.translation: Licha ya jinsi inavyopikwa, lechon huwavutia walaji kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a hearty and flavorful dish that is perfect for any occasion.
entries.translation: Ni chakula cha kuvutia na chenye ladha kinachofaa kwa tukio lolote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you are looking for a new and exciting dish to try, lechon is definitely worth a look.
entries.translation: Kwa hivyo ikiwa unatafuta chakula kipya cha kufurahisha cha kujaribu, bila shaka jaribu lechon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Is it going to be expensive.

entries.english: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.
entries.translation: Mjomba: Huenda ikawa. Gari lenyewe ni kuukuu, na sehemu zake si rahisi kupata. Lakini natumai kuwa ni tatizo ndogo tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?
entries.translation: Mimi: Nimekumbuka jambo, unafahamu kuwa magari ya nyuklia ni bora?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.
entries.translation: Mimi: Naam, ni magari mazuri sana. Yanatumia nguvu ya nyuklia kuzalisha umeme, ambao unatumika kuendesha mota ya gari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.
entries.translation: Mjomba: Huenda magari hayo ni ghali mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.
entries.translation: Mimi: Yawezekana, lakini pia yanagharimu kidogo zaidi kuliko magari ya kawaida. Magari ya nyuklia yanaweza kwenda umbali wa mamia ya maili kwa mjazo mmoja wa tenki ya mafuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.
entries.translation: Mjomba: Aha, Nitatafuta maelezo zaidi kuhusu hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A man walks into a comedy club and orders a filet mignon.
entries.translation: Jamaa anaingia kwenye ukumbi wa ucheshi na kuagiza mnofu laini wa ng'ombe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter brings him the steak and he starts to eat it.
entries.translation: Mhudumu anamletea nyama hiyo kisha anaanza kula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few bites, he stops and says, "This steak is terrible! It's tough and tasteless."
entries.translation: Baada ya kuuma mara kadhaa, anafoka na kusema, "Nyama hii ni mbovu! Ni ngumu na haina ladha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter replies, "Well, sir, you did order a filet mignon."
entries.translation: Mhudumu akamjibu, "Naam, kaka, uliagiza mnofu laini."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, but I didn't order a raw filet mignon!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Sir, all of our steaks are served raw. We require our customers to cook them themselves."
entries.translation: "Kaka, minofu yetu yote laini huuzwa ikiwa mbichi. Wateja wetu ndio hujipikia wenyewe."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But I don't know how to cook!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's not our problem. We're a comedy club, not a restaurant."
entries.translation: "Hatujali kuhusu hilo. Hapa ni ukumbi wa ucheshi, si mkahawa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man angrily gets up and storms out of the club.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a car accident, and he was unconscious.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amehusika katika ajali ya barabarani na akapoteza fahamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents, who had been driving by when the accident happened, rushed to his side.
entries.translation: Wazazi wake ambao walikuwa wakiendesha gari ajali ilipotokea, walikimbilia mahali alikuwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paramedics arrived and loaded the boy into an ambulance.

entries.english: His parents followed in their car, their hearts pounding with fear.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At the hospital, the doctors examined the boy and determined that he had a concussion and a broken leg.
entries.translation: Kule hospitalini, madaktari walimchunguza mvulana huyo na kubaini kuwa alikuwa na majeraha kwenye ubongo na alivunjika mguu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They admitted him to the hospital and began treatment.

entries.english: The boy's parents stayed by his side, never leaving him alone.
entries.translation: Wazazi wa mvulana huyo walishinda pembeni mwake, bila kumwacha peke yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They watched over him as he slept, their hearts filled with love and hope.
entries.translation: Walimtazama akilala, mioyo yao ilijawa upendo na matumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Royalty," said the Blacksmith, "is a curious thing. It's a kind of magic, really.
entries.translation: "Ufalme," alisema Mhunzi, "ni jambo la kutaka kujua zaidi. Kwa kweli, ni aina ya ulozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People get all worked up about it, and they don't even know why.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not as if kings and queens have any real power, these days. They're just figureheads.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But people still seem to need them.

entries.english: They need someone to look up to, someone to represent the idea of the nation." The Blacksmith paused.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I suppose it's a kind of comfort," he continued.

entries.english: "To know that there's someone out there who's better than you.
entries.translation: "Kujua kuwa kuna mtu mwingine ambaye ni bora kukuliko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who's got it all sorted out.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who can make the world a better place.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, it's all an illusion. But that doesn't make it any less important.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People need their illusions. They need to believe in something.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if that something is a king or a queen, then so be it."
entries.translation: Na iwapo kitu hicho ni mfalme au malkia, basi na iwe hivyo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Blacksmith paused for a moment, then smiled.
entries.translation: Mhunzi huyo alinyamaza kidogo, kisha akatabasamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago, an old Cuban fisherman, has gone eighty-four days without catching a fish.
entries.translation: Santiago, mvuvi mkongwe wa Kuba, amekosa kupata samaki kwa siku themanini na nne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is the oldest man in the village, and the youngest, Manolin, no longer wants to fish with him because the old man is unlucky.
entries.translation: Ndiye mzee mkongwe kabisa katika kijiji hicho, naye Manolin ambaye ndiye mchanga zaidi, hataki tena kuenda kuvua samaki naye kwa sababu mzee huyo ana bahati mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Santiago sets out in his skiff and hooks a giant marlin.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Santiago alitumia mashua yake kwenda kisha akamnasa malini mkubwa.

entries.english: The marlin is so big that it pulls the skiff far out to sea.

entries.english: Santiago fights the marlin for two days and nights, but he cannot bring it in.
entries.translation: Santiago alipambana na malini huyo kwa siku mbili mchana na usiku, lakini alishindwa kumwingiza kwenye mashua.

entries.english: The marlin is too heavy, and the old man is too tired.

entries.english: Finally, the marlin begins to tire.

entries.english: Santiago is able to get a harpoon into the marlin, and he kills it.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the marlin is so big that Santiago cannot bring it into the boat.

entries.english: He ties the marlin to the side of the boat and begins to row back to shore.

entries.english: Santiago fights the sharks off, but he cannot stop them all.

entries.english: By the time he reaches shore, only the head and the tail of the marlin are left.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police will likely take the person to the station and question him.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will want to know where he got the wallet and why he was carrying it.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the person cannot provide a satisfactory explanation, he may be arrested and charged with theft.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa that has been in the midst of a civil war since 2010.
entries.translation: Kodivaa ni nchi inayopatikana Magharibi mwa Afrika ambayo imekumbwa na mapigano ya wenyewe kwa wenyewe tangu 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict began after incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo refused to accept defeat in the 2010 presidential election.
entries.translation: Mgogoro huo ulianza baada ya rais aliyekuwa uongozini Laurent Gbagbo kukataa kuwa ameshindwa katika uchaguzi wa urais mnamo 2010.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo was eventually ousted by forces loyal to Alassane Ouattara, who was declared the winner of the election.
entries.translation: Hatimaye Gbagbo aling'atuliwa uongozini na vikosi vya Alassane Outtara, ambaye alitangazwa mshindi katika uchaguzi huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, mgogoro huo umeendelea, na vurugu zimezuka katika maeneo mbalimbali nchini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2017, kulikuwepo na matumaini kuwa hatimaye vita hivyo vingekoma katika nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, matumaini haya yalitokomea pale Gbagbo aliondolewa mashtaka ya uhalifu dhidi ya binadamu na Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Jinai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
entries.translation: Kuondolewa kwa mashtaka dhidi ya Gbagbo kulionekana kama pigo kwa mchakato wa amani, na kulisababisha vurugu kuzuka upya katika nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
entries.translation: Mwaka 2018, Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa liliwawekea vikwazo Gbagbo na wafuasi wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
entries.translation: Vikwazo hivyo vilinuia kumshinikiza Gbagbo kukoma kuunga mkono vurugu nchini humo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
entries.translation: Vikwazo hivyo vimekuwa na ufanisi kiasi, na vurugu zimepungua katika nchi ya Kodivaa tangu vilipowekwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country is still far from stable.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, nchi hiyo bado haijapata amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti za kufua nguo, kuanzia kutumia mashine za kawaida za kufulia na kukaushia nguo hadi mbinu zinazojali mazingira kama vile kufua kwa mikono na kuanika nguo kwenye kamba ili zikauke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
entries.translation: Njia mojawapo ya kufua nguo bila kutumia mashine ni kufua nguo zako kwa mikono ndani ya beseni au sinki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Ili kufanya hivi, jaza maji yenye uvuguvugu kwenye beseni kisha uongeze sabuni kidogo ya kufulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
entries.translation: Lowesha nguo zako kwa dakika chache, kisha uzisugue ukitumia kifaa cha kusugulia nguo au brashi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
entries.translation: Suza nguo zako vilivyo kwenye maji safi, kisha uzianike nje kwenye kamba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
entries.translation: Anika nguo zako zikauke kwenye kamba ya kuanikia nguo au rafu ya kukaushia nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ni kutumia mashine ya kufua bila mashine ya kukausha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuokoa nishati na pesa, lakini inahitaji muda na juhudi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Ili kuosha nguo kwenye mashine bila kuzikasha, jaza maji kwenye mashine kisha uweke sabuni ya kufulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
entries.translation: Weka mzunguko ufaao kwenye mashine, kisha uiwashe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.
entries.translation: Mzunguko ukikamilika, ondoa nguo zako kwenye mashine na uzianike ili zikauke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area with a lot of rain, you may be able to use the rain to help you dry your clothes.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unakoishi pana mvua nyingi, mvua inaweza kukusaidia kukausha nguo zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes on a clothesline outside in the rain.
entries.translation: Anika nguo zako kwenye kamba nje palipo na mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only darkness.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe was a vast, empty void.
entries.translation: Ulimwengu ulikuwa kubwa mno na hakuwepo na chochote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, out of the darkness, came a spark.
entries.translation: Kisha, cheche ya moto ikatokea gizani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This spark was the first sign of life in the universe.
entries.translation: Cheche hii ilikuwa ishara ya kwanza ya maisha ulimwenguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It grew and expanded, becoming a small ball of fire.
entries.translation: Ilizidi kuwa kubwa na ikawa mpira mdogo wa moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ball of fire was the sun.
entries.translation: Mpira huu wa moto ukawa jua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Around the sun, the planets began to form.
entries.translation: Sayari zilianza kuibuka kwa kuzunguka jua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Earth was the third planet from the sun.
entries.translation: Dunia ilikuwa sayari ya tatu kutoka ilipo jua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a small, rocky planet with a thin atmosphere.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa sayari ndogo yenye miamba mingi na hewa finyu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the Earth, the first living things began to appear.
entries.translation: Duniani, viumbe hai wa kwanza walianza kuonekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These were simple organisms, such as bacteria and algae.
entries.translation: Viumbe hawa walikuwa wadogo, kama vile bakteria na miani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over time, these organisms evolved into more complex forms of life, such as plants and animals.
entries.translation: Baada ya muda, viumbe hawa hai walibadilika na kuwa changamano zaidi, kama vile mimea na wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first humans appeared on Earth about 200,000 years ago.
entries.translation: Binadamu wa kwanza walionekana Duniani takriban miaka 200,000 iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have evolved and developed to become the dominant species on Earth.
entries.translation: Binadamu wamebadilika na kuwa spishi kuu zaidi miongoni mwa viumbe hai Duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe is still expanding and evolving.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists believe that it will continue to expand for billions of years.
entries.translation: Wanasayansi wanaamini kuwa utaendelea kupanuka kwa mabilioni ya miaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will reach a point where it can no longer expand.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, ulimwengu utafika mahali ambapo hauwezi kupanuka zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At this point, the universe will begin to contract.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will collapse in on itself and disappear.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the universe may end, the story of life will continue.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ingawa ulimwengu huenda ukafika mwwisho, maisha yataendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.
entries.translation: Nina wasiwasi kuhusu mazingira na athari ambayo mabadiliko ya tabianchi yameleta kwenye sayari yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.
entries.translation: Napenda pia teknolojia na vifaa, hivyo siku zote ninatafuta njia za kupunguza utoaji wa gesijoto bila kuhitaji kubadilisha mtindo wangu wa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.
entries.translation: Hiyo ndiyo sababu ninafuraha kuhusu vyanzo safi na vyanzo mbadala vya kawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.
entries.translation: Kawi ya vyanzo safi ni kawi inayotokana na vyanzo asili, kama vile jua, upepo na maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.
entries.translation: Kawi mbadala ni kawi inayotokana na vyanzo ambavyo kwa kawaida havitumiki kuzalisha kawi, kama vile kawi kutokana na mimea na wanyama, na mvuke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.
entries.translation: Vyanzo mbadala na vyanzo safi vya kawi ni endelevu na havisababishi uchafuzi, kumaanisha havizalishi gesijoto wala vichafuzi vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya njia bora zaidi ya kuleta utofauti ni kubadilisha na kuanza kutumia vyanzo safi vya kawi nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by installing solar panels on your roof, buying a wind turbine, or signing up for a green power plan from your utility company.
entries.translation: Unaweza kufanya hivi kwa kuweka paneli za sola kwenye paa yako, kununua tabo za upepo, au kujiandikisha kwenye mpango wa utunzaji mazingira kupitia kampuni inayokupa huduma za umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kupunguza matumizi yako ya kawi kwa kuchomoa vifaa wakati huvitumii, kuzima taa unapoondoka chumbani na kutumia vifaa vinavyookoa nishati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old wooden boat sat on the shore, its sails furled and its hull weathered by the sun and the rain.
entries.translation: Mashua kuukuu ya mbao ilikuwa ufuoni, tanga zake zimekunjwa na kiwiliwili chake kimechakaa kutokana kupigwa na jua na mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had seen many years of service, carrying its owners on voyages to far-off lands.
entries.translation: Imefanyiwa ukarabati kwa miaka mingi na imesafirisha wamiliki wake kwenda safari za mbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But now, it was retired, its days of sailing over.
entries.translation: Lakini sasa, imechakaa, siku zake za kusafiri majini zimekwisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy named Thomas came to the beach.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mvulana mdogo kwa jina Thomas alikuja ufuoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had heard stories about the old boat, and he was eager to see it for himself.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amesikia kuhusu mashuaa hiyo kuukuu, na alitamani kuiona mwenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he saw the boat, he was amazed by its size and its beauty.
entries.translation: Alipoona mashua hiyo, aliduwazwa na ukubwa na urembo wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He could imagine himself sailing off on adventures in the vast ocean.
entries.translation: Aliwaza jinsi yeye mwenyewe angesafiri kujionea vitu vipya baharini kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas asked the owner of the boat if he could take a closer look.
entries.translation: Thomas alimwomba mmiliki wa mashua amruhusu aitazame kwa karibu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner smiled and said, "Of course you can. Come aboard!"
entries.translation: Mmiliki alitabasamu na kusema, "Bila shaka unaweza. Ingia ndani!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas climbed into the boat and sat down in the captain's chair.
entries.translation: Thomas alipanda kwenye mashua na kuketi kwenye kiti cha nahodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked out over the water and imagined himself sailing away to a faraway land.
entries.translation: Aliangalia majini na kuwaza jinsi ambavyo angesafiri kwenda maeneo ya mbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat watched Thomas for a moment, then said, "Do you want to learn how to sail?"
entries.translation: Mmiliki wa mashua alimtazama Thomas kwa muda, kisha akasema, "Ungependa kujifunza jinsi ya kuiendesha?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat smiled again.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scene: Two friends, Jasmine and Joseph, are sitting at a coffee shop.
entries.translation: Tukio: Marafiki wawili, Jasmine na Joseph, wameketi katika duka la kahawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm so glad you could meet me today, Joseph.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Ninafurahia umeweza kukutana nami leo, Joseph.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm having a really tough time at work.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Ninapitia wakati mgumu sana kazini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to keep my job.
entries.translation: Sina uhakika iwapo nitaweza kuendelea na kazi yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so sorry to hear that.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was even better than he had imagined, with a soft, chewy texture and a rich, flavorful taste.

entries.english: He closed his eyes and savored the moment, enjoying the feeling of contentment that came from eating something so delicious.

entries.english: The baker knew that he was lucky to have the ability to bake such delicious bread.

entries.english: He took pride in his work and was always happy to share his creations with others.

entries.english: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.
entries.translation: Aina ya samaki unayochagua inategemea mapendeleo yako binafsi na kusudi la kutumia samaki huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unatafuta samaki aliye na viwango vya juu vya madini ya omega-3, basi tunapendekeza uchague samaki apatikanaye kwenye mito mikuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically lower in contaminants than farm-raised fish.
entries.translation: Samaki hawa kwa kawaida hawakumbani na uchafu wakilinganishwa na wale wanaokuzwa shambani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, samaki wa mito mikuu huenda wakawa ghali na nadra kuwapata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unatafuta samaki ambaye ladha yake ni ya kadri na ni rahisi kupika, basi chagua samaki wanaopatikana kwenye ziwa tulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida, samaki hawa hawana viwango vya juu vya madini ya omega-3 ikilinganishwa na samaki wa mito mikuu, lakini pia wana protini na virutubishi vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.
entries.translation: Samaki wa ziwa tulivu pia kwa kawaida wanauzwa bei nafuu na wanapatikana kwa urahisi ikilinganishwa na wale wa mito mikuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unatafuta samaki wa bei ya chini ambaye ni rahisi kutunza, basi unaweza kuchagua wanaokuzwa kwenye vidimbwi mashambani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.
entries.translation: Samaki hawa kwa kawaida hukuzwa katika mazingira yaliyodhibitiwa na hupewa lishe inayochochea ukuaji wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stock pond farm raised fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river or calm lake fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Samaki wanaokuzwa kwenye vidimbwi mashambani kwa kawaida hawana madini ya juu ya omega-3 kama wanaopatikana kwenye mito mikuu au ziwa tulivu, lakini bado wana protini na virutubishi vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.
entries.translation: Cha msingi ni kuwa, aina bora ya samaki kwako itategemea mahitaji na mapendeleo yako binafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.
entries.translation: Fanya utafiti wako ili upate maelezo zaidi kuhusu aina tofauti za samaki wanaopatikana na uchague ile inayokufaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unsolved mysteries have captured the public's imagination for centuries.
entries.translation: Mambo ya ajabu ambayo hayajatatuliwa yametawala fikra za umma kwa miongo mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the disappearance of Amelia Earhart to the identity of Jack the Ripper, these cases have left us wondering what really happened.
entries.translation: Kuanzia kutoweka kwa Amelia Earhart hadi utambulisho wa Jack the Ripper, visa hivi vimetuacha tukiwaza kuhusu ni nini hasa kilifanyika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some of these mysteries may never be solved, they continue to fascinate us because they offer a glimpse into the unknown.
entries.translation: Ingawa baadhi ya mambo haya ya ajabu huenda yasitatuliwe, yanaendelea kutufikirisha kwa sababu yanatudokezea kuhusu mambo yasiyofahamika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous unsolved mysteries is the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya matukio ya ajabu ambayo hayajatatuliwa ni kutoweka kwa Amelia Earhart.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earhart was an American aviator who became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean.
entries.translation: Earhart alikuwa rubani Mmarekani ambaye alikuwa mwanamke wa kwanza kuendesha ndege akiwa pekee yake juu ya Bahari ya Atlantiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1937, she set out on an around-the-world flight with navigator Fred Noonan.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1937, alianza safari za kuzuru ulimwengu mzima kwa ndege akiwa na mwenzake Fred Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pair disappeared over the Pacific Ocean on July 2, 1937, and their fate remains unknown.
entries.translation: Wawili hao walitoweka wakipaa juu ya Bahari ya Pasifiki mnamo tarehe 2 Julai, 1937, na hatima yao bado haijulikani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many theories about what happened to Earhart and Noonan.
entries.translation: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu kilichowafanyikia Earhart na Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some believe that they crashed into the ocean, while others believe that they were captured by the Japanese.
entries.translation: Wapo wanaoamini kuwa walipata ajali ya ndege na kutumbukia baharini, nao wengine wanaamini kuwa walinaswa na Wajapani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Still others believe that they deliberately disappeared in order to escape the public eye.
entries.translation: Bado kuna wale wanaoamini kuwa walitoweka kimakusudi ili kuepuka kuonekana hadharani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mystery of Earhart's disappearance has been the subject of books, articles, and documentaries.
entries.translation: Maajabu ya kutoweka kwa Earhart yamekuwa ni suala kuu katika vitabu, machapisho, na makala ya matukio halisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, a team of researchers announced that they had found evidence that Earhart's plane crashed on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2017, timu ya watafiti walitangaza kuwa walipata ushahidi kwamba ndege ya Earhart ilipata ajali katika kisiwa cha mbali kwenye Bahari ya Pasifiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are the largest species of arachnid in the world, with some individuals reaching lengths of over 12 inches.
entries.translation: Buibui wakubwa aina ya wolf ndio araknidi wakubwa zaidi ulimwenguni, huku baadhi yao wakiwa na urefu wa zaidi ya inchi 12.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are found in tropical rainforests around the world, and are known for their aggressive behavior and venomous bite.
entries.translation: Wanapatikana katika misitu ya kitropiki kote duniani, na wanafahamika kwa tabia zao za uvamizi na sumu zao wanapouma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
entries.translation: Licha ya sifa zao za kuogofya, buibui hawa wakubwa wa aina wolf ni viumbe watulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
entries.translation: Sio wakali kwa binadamu isipokuwa wanapochokozwa, na sumu yao ni hatari kwa binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuuma kwao kunaweza kusababisha maumivu, uvimbe, wekundu na mwasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.
entries.translation: Buibui hawa wakubwa wa aina ya wolf ni wakweaji shupavu, na wanaweza kutumia silki zao kuunda utando unaoweza kufika urefu wa hadi futi 30.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
entries.translation: Pia ni wakimbiaji wepesi sana, na wanaweza kwenda kwa kasi ya hadi maili 10 kwa saa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
entries.translation: Kutokana na ukubwa, kasi na uwezo wao wa kukwea, buibui wakubwa wa aina wolf hupendelewa sana na watu wanaotaka kupata uhondo wa kuendesha araknidi mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba viumbe hawa ni wanyama wa porini na wanapaswa kuheshimiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are thinking about riding a giant wolf spider, it is important to do your research and make sure that you are properly prepared.
entries.translation: Ikiwa ungependa kuendesha buibui mkubwa wa aina ya wolf, ni muhimu kuwa na ufahamu wa kutosha na kuhakikisha umejiandaa vyema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure that you have the proper equipment, such as a harness and a leash.
entries.translation: Pia, unapaswa kuhakikisha kuwa una vifaa vinavyohitajika, kama vile kamba na kishikilio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are properly prepared, you can begin your journey by finding a suitable giant wolf spider.
entries.translation: Ukishajiandaa ipasavyo, unaweza kuanza safari yako kwa kutafuta buibui anayekufaa wa aina ya wolf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found a spider, you can approach it slowly and gently.
entries.translation: Ukishapata buibui, unaweza kumwendea polepole na taratibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the spider is comfortable with you, you can slowly climb onto its back.
entries.translation: Buibui akishakukubali, unaweza kukwea mgongo wake polepole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are on the spider's back, you can hold on tightly and enjoy the ride.
entries.translation: Ukiwa mgongoni mwa buibui, unaweza kumshikilia kwa nguvu na ufurahie kubebwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.
entries.translation: Buibui huyo atatumia silki yake kuunda utando wa kukushikilia ukibebwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.
entries.translation: Kuendesha buibui mkubwa wa aina ya wolf ni tukio lisilosahaulika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Ni njia bora ya kufurahia uhondo wa porini na kumkaribia mojawapo ya viumbe wa kustaajabisha zaidi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I'm an actor and a furniture designer. I'm also passionate about flowers, especially those that bloom in the winter.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Mimi ni mwigizaji na msanifu wa samani. Pia ninapenda sana maua, hususan yale yanayochanua katika majira ya baridi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What drew you to acting and furniture design?
entries.translation: Mhoji: Ni nini kilikuvutia kwa uigizaji na usanifu wa samani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've always loved performing and creating things.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Siku zote nilipenda kuigiza na kubuni vitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acting allows me to express myself creatively, and furniture design allows me to use my creativity to make something beautiful and functional.
entries.translation: Kuigiza kunaniruhusu kujieleza kiubunifu, na usanifu wa samani huniruhusu kutumia ubunifu wangu kuunda kitu maridadi na kinachoweza kutumika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: What are some of the challenges you've faced as an actor and a furniture designer?
entries.translation: Mhoji: Ni changamoto zipi ulizokumbana nazo kama mwigizaji na msanifu wa samani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: One of the challenges I've faced as an actor is the lack of diversity in the industry.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Mojawapo ya changamoto nilizopitia kama mwigizaji ni ukosefu wa uanuwai katika tasnia hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've often been told that I'm not the right type for a role because of my race or ethnicity.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi nimeambiwa kuwa sistahiki kuigiza katika nafasi mbalimbali kutokana na rangi au asilia yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a furniture designer, I've faced the challenge of breaking into a male-dominated industry.
entries.translation: Kama msanifu wa samani, nimekumbana na changamoto ya kuingia katika tasnia inayotawaliwa na wanaume wengi.

entries.english: Interviewer: How have you overcome these challenges?

entries.english: Another way to achieve internal consistency is to be honest with ourselves about our strengths and weaknesses.

entries.english: When we are aware of our true selves, we can make choices that are in alignment with our authentic nature.

entries.english: However, if we are willing to strive for consistency, we will eventually find our way back to peace and harmony.
