entries.english: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa wa kisukari huathiri jinsi ambavyo mwili wako humeng'enya chakula na kukupa nguvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.
entries.translation: Unapokula, mwili wako husaga wanga kwenye chakula chako na kuigeuza glukosi ambayo hufyonzwa kwenye damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.
entries.translation: Kongosho yako hutoa insulini, homoni inayosaidia seli zako kupata glukosi kutoka kwenye damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.
entries.translation: Kwa wanaougua kisukari cha aina ya 1, kongosho haitoi insulini hata kidogo au haitoi kwa kiwango kinachohitajika mwilini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuwa walio na aina 1 ya kisukari wanafaa kudungwa sindano za insulini ili kusaidia miili yao kutumia glukosi kupata nguvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.
entries.translation: Kudhibiti viwango vyangu vya sukari kunaweza kuwa na changamoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.
entries.translation: Kuna visababishi vingi vinavyoweza kuathiri kiwango cha sukari kwenye damu, ikijumuisha ninachokula, kiasi cha mazoezi ninachofanya, na kiwango cha mfadhaiko ninaopitia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
entries.translation: Ninafuatilia viwango vyangu vya sukari kwenye damu mara kwa mara na kufanya marekebisho ya dozi zangu za insulini kama inavyohitajika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
entries.translation: Utamu wa ladha yake unakithiri kinywani, na kuleta raha na furaha tela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
entries.translation: Nanasi ni tamu na chachu, tufaha ni gumu na lenye juisi, tunda la mawe ni lenye juisi na ladha, na pea ni tamu na inaburudisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
entries.translation: Ladha zimesawazishwa kikamilifu, na kila moja inaambatana na nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Mchanganyiko huo kwa kweli ni wa kuvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
entries.translation: Unaweza kufurahia saladi hii tamu ya matunda tu, au ikiwa imeongezwa mtindi au aiskrimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
entries.translation: Pia ni nyongeza nzuri kwa chakula cha kimandhari au sherehe ya majira ya kiangazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
entries.translation: Licha ya utakavyoila, bila shaka utapenda saladi hii ya matunda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
entries.translation: A: Je, wajua kuwa uharibifu wa misitu ni mojawapo ya sababu kuu za mabadiliko ya tabianchi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
entries.translation: A: Tunapokata miti, hatuangamizi miti tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
entries.translation: Pia tunaharibu makazi ya wanyama na mimea mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
entries.translation: Na tunapopoteza makazi haya, pia tunapoteza manufaa yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
entries.translation: A: Kwa mfano, miti husaidia kudhibiti tabianchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
entries.translation: Hufyonza kaboni dioksidi kutoka kwenye hewa na kutoa oksijeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
entries.translation: Pia inasaidia kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo na mafuriko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
entries.translation: Pia ni chakula na makazi kwa wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
entries.translation: B: Hivyo uharibifu wa misitu una athari nyingi hasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
entries.translation: Kila mwaka, tunapoteza mamilioni ya hekari za misitu kwa sababu ya uharibifu wa misitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
entries.translation: Na tusipochukua hatua kukomesha hali hii, matokeo yake yatakuwa na athari kubwa mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: What can we do to stop it?
entries.translation: B: Tunaweza kufanya nini ili kukomesha hali hii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a number of things we can do.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kupunguza matumizi ya bidhaa za mbao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
entries.translation: Nilibahatika kuhudhuria shule iliyokuwa na kozi mbalimbali za AP na shughuli zingine zisizo za kimasomo, na hilo lilinipa fursa ya kufanya mambo yanayonivutia na kujifunza kuhusu taaluma mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu nilivyojifunza katika shule ya upili ni jinsi ya kufikiria kwa makini na kusuluhisha matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
entries.translation: Masomo yangu ya Kiingereza na hisabati ya AP yalinifunza jinsi ya kuchanganua maandishi na data, nayo sayansi ikanifunza jinsi ya kubuni na kufanya majaribio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
entries.translation: Ujuzi huu umekuwa muhimu sana katika kozi zangu chuoni na kwenye taaluma yangu kama msanidi programu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
entries.translation: Jambo lingine muhimu ambalo nilijifunza katika shule ya upili lilikuwa ni jinsi ya kufanya kazi na wengine kwa ufanisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
entries.translation: Ujuzi huu umekuwa wa thamani sana katika taaluma yangu, ambapo mara nyingi ninashirikiana na wengine kusuluhisha matatizo changamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, hali niliyopitia katika shule ya upili imenisaidia kukuza maadili thabiti ya kazi na kufanya vizuri zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
entries.translation: Kozi ngumu za kitaaluma nilizofanya zilinifunza umuhimu wa uvumilivu na kufanya kazi kwa bidii, nazo shughuli nilizoshiriki zisizo za kimasomo zilinifunza umuhimu wa ushirikiano na kujitolea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
entries.translation: Maadili haya yamenisaidia kufanikiwa chuoni na katika taaluma yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
entries.translation: Ninashukuru kwa nafasi ya nilihudhuria shule ya upili iliyonipa msingi thabiti wa kielimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
entries.translation: Ninaamini kuwa ujuzi na maarifa niliyopata katika shule ya upili yamenisaidia kufaulu chuoni na kuwa mtaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
entries.translation: Ufinyanzi ni sanaa inayohusisha uundaji wa bidhaa kwa kutumia udongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi ufinyanzi unalenga matumizi, kama vile kuhifadhi chakula au maji, lakini pia unaweza kutumika kwa madhumuni ya mapambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
entries.translation: Mchakato wa ufinyanzi huanza kwa kukusanya udongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
entries.translation: Udongo ni nyenzo asilia inayopatikana ardhini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
entries.translation: Baada ya udongo kukusanywa, huchanganywa na maji na kukandwa hadi uwe laini na rahisi kufinyangwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
entries.translation: Kisha mfinyanzi hutumia vifaa mbalimbali kuunda maumbo ya udongo kama anavyopendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
entries.translation: Baada ya kuunda umbo la udongo, unakaushwa na kuwekwa kwenye tanuri ya moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
entries.translation: Dhoruba za mvua ni tukio la kawaida katika sehemu nyingi za dunia, na zinaweza kuathiri maisha yetu pakubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kuleta maji mengi yanayohitajika katika ardhi iliyokauka, lakini pia zinaweza kusababisha mafuriko, maporomoko ya udongo, na uharibifu mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
entries.translation: Dhoruba za mvua zinasababishwa na uvukizaji wa hewa joto, inayosababisha mvuke wa maji kuganda na kuunda mawingu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
entries.translation: Matone ya maji yanapokuwa mazito kwenye mawingu, hunyesha kama mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
entries.translation: Kiwango cha mvua inayonyesha katika dhoruba ya mvua kinapimwa kwa inchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
entries.translation: Huenda dhoruba ya mvua nyepesi ikawa ya inchi chache tu za mvua, nayo dhoruba ya mvua kali huenda ikawa na zaidi ya futi moja ya mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
entries.translation: Dhoruba za mvua zina athari mbalimbali kwa maisha yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kusafisha uchafu na vifusi, na kufunga barabara na njia za kutembelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
entries.translation: Zinaweza pia kusababisha mafuriko na kupotea kwa umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
entries.translation: Hususan mafuriko yanaweza kuwa hatari sana, kwani yanaweza kusomba watu na mali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
entries.translation: Licha ya uwezekano wa hatari, dhoruba za mvua pia zinaweza kuwa na manufaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kusaidia kuimarisha ubora wa udongo na kunyunyizia mimea maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
entries.translation: Pia, dhoruba za mvua zinaweza kuwa chanzo cha burudani, kwani watu hufurahia kuona mvua na kusikiliza ngurumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
entries.translation: Macho ni viungo changamano vinavyotuwezesha kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
entries.translation: Yapo sehemu ya mbele ya kichwa na yamelindwa kwa kope.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
entries.translation: Kila jicho lina safu tatu: kiwambo jicho, korodi na retina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Kiwambo jicho ni sehemu nyeupe ya macho, korodi ni sehemu nyeusi iliyo nyuma ya kiwambo jicho, nayo retina ni safu inayotambua mwangaza na inapatikana upande wa nyuma wa jicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
entries.translation: Retina ina mamilioni ya seli zinazotambua mwangaza zinazoitwa rodi na koni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
entries.translation: Rodi zinasaidia katika kuona nyakati za usiku, nazo koni zinatusaidia kutambua rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Mwangaza unapofika kwenye retina, unageuzwa kuwa mawimbi ya kielektroniki yanayotumwa kwenye ubongo kupitia neva ya kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My family has always kept animals.

entries.english: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa mtoto, tulikuwa na mbwa, paka, na samaki wachache.

entries.english: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
entries.translation: Nilipoendelea kukua, tuliongeza wanyama wengine wachache kwenye mchanganyiko huo, ikijumuisha sungura, nguruwe, na panyabuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
entries.translation: Nilipenda sana kuwatunza wanyama wetu wote na kujifunza kuhusu mahitaji yao tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
entries.translation: Mmoja kati ya wanyama niliowapenda miongoni mwa tuliowafuga alikuwa sungura aitwaye Cocoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
entries.translation: Cocoa alikuwa sungura wa aina ya Holland Lop na alikuwa wa rangi ya kahawia na nyeupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mnyama mzuri sana ambaye niliwahi kukutana naye na alipenda sana kupakatwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
entries.translation: Pia alikuwa mwerevu na aliweza kujifunza mamo kama vile kuketi, kutulia, na kuja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
entries.translation: Siku moja, nilikuwa nikicheza na Cocoa uani nilipogundua kuwa alikuwa akitafuna kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.
entries.translation: Nilienda kutazama na nikampata akitafuna kipande cha nyuzi kutoka kwa mojawapo ya nguo zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the fiber away from her and showed it to my mom.
entries.translation: Nilichukua nyuzi hiyo na nikamwonyesha mama yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mom explained that rabbits need to eat fiber in order to digest their food properly.
entries.translation: Mama yangu alinielezea kuwa sungura wanahitaji kula nyuzi ili kumeng'enya chakula chao vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that we should give Cocoa some hay to eat, which is a good source of fiber.
entries.translation: Alisema kuwa tunafaa kumpa Cocoa majani makavu ale, kwani ni chanzo kizuri cha nyuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gave Cocoa some hay and she loved it!
entries.translation: Nilimpa Cocoa majani makavu kiasi na aliyapenda sana!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An earthquake is a sudden and violent shaking of the Earth's crust that can cause great damage.
entries.translation: Mtetemeko wa ardhi ni mtikisiko wa ghafla na vurugu wa ganda la Dunia unaoweza kusababisha uharibifu mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common cause of earthquakes is the movement of tectonic plates, which are large pieces of the Earth's crust that ride on top of the molten rock beneath the surface.
entries.translation: Sababu kuu ya mitetemeko ya ardhi ni kusonga kwa miamba mikuu, ambayo ni sehemu kubwa ya ganda la Dunia inayosogea juu mwamba ulioyeyuka chini ya ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these plates move past or collide with each other, they can cause the Earth's crust to break and produce seismic waves.
entries.translation: Miamba hii mikuu inapopitana au kugongana na nyingine, inaweza kusababisha ganda la Dunia kuvunjika na kutoa mawimbi ya tetemeko ardhini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These waves travel through the Earth and can cause the ground to shake.
entries.translation: Mawimbi haya yanasafiri kupitia Dunia na yanaweza kusababisha mtikisiko wa ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The magnitude of an earthquake is measured on the Richter scale, which ranges from 0 to 9.
entries.translation: Ukubwa wa mtetemeko wa ardhi hupimwa kwa kipimo cha Richter, kinachoanzia 0 hadi 9.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The higher the magnitude, the more powerful the earthquake.
entries.translation: Kadri ukubwa wake ulivyo zaidi, ndivyo mtetemeko wa ardhi unakuwa na nguvu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can cause damage in a variety of ways, including ground shaking, landslides, tsunamis, building collapses, fires, and loss of life.
entries.translation: Mitetemeko ya ardhi inaweza kusababisha uharibifu katika njia mbalimbali, ikijumuisha kutikisika kwa ardhi, maporomoko ya udongo, tsunami, kuanguka kwa majengo, mioto, na kupoteza maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also trigger other hazards, such as avalanches.
entries.translation: Pia mitetemeko ya ardhi inaweza kusababisha hatari zingine, kama vile maporomoko ya theluji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The damage caused by an earthquake depends on a number of factors, including the magnitude of the earthquake, the distance from the epicenter, the type of soil, and the construction of buildings.
entries.translation: Uharibifu unaosababishwa na mtetemeko wa ardhi unategemea vigezo kadhaa, ikijumuisha ukubwa wa mtetemeko wa ardhi, umbali kutoka kwenye kiini cha tetemeko, aina ya udongo, na ujenzi wa mijengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have no idea how the real world works, and you think that everything should be handed to you on a silver platter.
entries.translation: Hufahamu mambo yalivyo kwa uhalisia, na unafikiria kuwa unafaa kupewa kila kitu kwa urahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're always complaining about something, and you never seem to be happy with anything.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're a bunch of entitled brats, and I'm sick of it.

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have to work hard to get what you want.

entries.english: The veteran sat alone in the hospital room, staring at the blank television.

entries.english: He had been in the hospital for weeks, and he was starting to go stir-crazy.

entries.english: He had been in a lot of wars, and he had seen a lot of death and destruction.

entries.english: But nothing had ever prepared him for this.

entries.english: The door to his room opened, and a young woman walked in.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was carrying a bouquet of flowers. "Hello," she said. "My name is Sarah.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm a volunteer here at the hospital."

entries.english: The veteran smiled. "It's nice to meet you, Sarah," he said.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives
entries.translation: Utafiti Mpya Umebaini Kuwa Uchunguzi wa Saratani ya Matiti Unaweza Kuonyesha Matokeo Yasiyo Sahihi
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
entries.translation: Utafiti mpya uliochapishwa katika jarida la JAMA Internal Medicine umebaini kuwa uchunguzi wa saratani ya matiti huenda ukaonyesha matokeo yasiyo sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study, which was conducted by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco, found that one in five women who underwent a mammogram had a false positive result.
entries.translation: Uchunguzi huo, uliofanywa na watafiti katika Chuo Kikuu cha California, San Francisco, ulibaini kuwa mwanamke mmoja kati ya watano ambao wamefanyiwa uchunguzi wa mamogramu wamepokea matokeo yasiyo sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
entries.translation: Matokeo yasiyo sahihi ni pale ambapo uchunguzi wa mamogramu unaonyesha kuwa mwanamke ana saratani ya matiti ilhali hana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha wasiwasi na mfadhaiko, na mhusika kupokea matibabu asiyohitaji, kama vile upasuaji ili kutoa tishu mwilini kwa lengo la uchunguzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.
entries.translation: Utafiti huo ulibaini kuwa matokeo hayo yasiyo sahihi yalihusishwa na wanawake wachanga wenye matiti magumu na wana historia ya saratani ya matiti katika ukoo wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The researchers say that these findings are important because they highlight the need for women to understand the risks and benefits of breast cancer screening before they decide whether or not to undergo a mammogram.
entries.translation: Watafiti wanasema kwamba matokeo haya ni muhimu kwa sababu yanaangazia haja kwa wanawake kuelewa hatari na manufaa ya uchunguzi wa saratani ya matiti kabla ya kuamua kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa mamogramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.
entries.translation: Uchunguzi huo pia ulibaini kwamba matumizi ya mawimbi ya sauti, maarufu kama ultrasound, kuchunguza saratani ya matiti yanaweza kusaidia kupunguza matokeo yasiyo sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultrasound is a safe and non-invasive imaging technique that can be used to identify abnormalities in the breast.

entries.english: As the twentieth century drew to a close, computers and electronics were becoming increasingly intertwined.

entries.english: Computers were large, expensive machines that were used for scientific and military purposes.

entries.english: Electronics were used in a variety of consumer products, such as radios, televisions, and telephones.

entries.english: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.

entries.english: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).

entries.english: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.

entries.english: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.

entries.english: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took his time with her, exploring her body with a tenderness that made her melt.
entries.translation: Alipeleka mambo taratibu, akimpapasa mwili wake kwa wororo ambao ulimyeyusha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when he finally touched her in that special way, she felt a wave of pleasure wash over her that was unlike anything she had ever felt before.
entries.translation: Na hatimaye alipomgusa kwa njia hiyo spesheli, alihisi mahaba si haba ambayo yalizidi chochote alichokuwa amewahi kuhisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was as if her body had been waiting for his touch all along.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa ni kana kwamba mwili wake ulikuwa ukisubiri mguso huo kwa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She felt complete, whole, and for the first time in her life, she knew what it was to be truly satisfied.
entries.translation: Alijihisi mkamilifu, mzima, na kwa mara ya kwanza maishani mwake, alijua kuwa kwa kweli angeridhishwa kikamilifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As Hakim continued to touch her, she felt herself losing control.
entries.translation: Kadri Hakim alivyoendelea kumpapasa, alijihisi mdhaifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her body was on fire, and she could feel the tension building inside of her.
entries.translation: Mwili wake ulikuwa umechemka, na angehisi msisimko kwa undani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that she was about to come, and she wanted it more than anything she had ever wanted before.
entries.translation: Alijua kuwa alikuwa karibu kuja, na aliitaka zaidi kuliko chochote ambacho alikuwa amewahi kutaka awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a once-in-a-lifetime pilgrimage to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, that is required of all Muslims who are physically and financially able to make the journey.
entries.translation: Haji ni safari ya kipekee maishani kwenda Mecca, Saudia, inayohitajika kwa Waislamu wote walio na uwezo wa kimwili na kifedha kusafiri huko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilgrimage is one of the five pillars of Islam, and it is considered to be the most important spiritual journey a Muslim can make.
entries.translation: Haji ni mojawapo ya nguzo tano za Uislamu, na inazingatiwa kuwa safari muhimu zaidi ya kiroho kwa Mwislamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj takes place over five days in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.translation: Haji hufanyika kwa zaidi ya siku tano katika mwezi wa Uislamu wa Dhu al-Hijjah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During the hajj, pilgrims perform a series of rituals that commemorate the life of Prophet Muhammad and the prophets who came before him.
entries.translation: Wakati wa haji, waumini hufanya misururu ya matambiko yanayoadhimisha maisha ya Mtume Muhammad na mitume waliomtangulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hajj is a physically and emotionally demanding journey, but it is also a time for Muslims to come together in worship and to reflect on their lives.
entries.translation: Haji ni safari inayohitaji kujitolea kimwili na kihisia, lakini pia ni wakati wa Waislamu kuja pamoja katika ibada na kutafakari maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a chance to renew their faith and to reaffirm their commitment to Islam.
entries.translation: Ni fursa ya kuweka upya imani zao na kukiri tena Uislamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For many Muslims, the hajj is a life-changing experience.
entries.translation: Kwa Waislamu wengi, haji ni tukio la kubadilisha maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to leave behind the stresses of everyday life and to focus on their spiritual journey.
entries.translation: Ni wakati wa kusahau mfadhaiko wa maisha ya kila siku na kulenga safari ya kiroho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
entries.translation: Uhuru wa wanahabari ni uhuru wa mawasiliano na kujieleza kupitia vyombo vya habari ikijumuisha machapisho na intaneti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.translation: Ni haki ya kimsingi ya binadamu iliyotambuliwa katika Kifungu cha 19 cha Azimio la Haki za Binadamu Ulimwenguni na kusisitizwa katika Kifungu cha 19 cha Mkataba wa Kimataifa kuhusu Haki za Kiraia na Kisiasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.
entries.translation: Haki ya uhuru wa kujieleza imetambuliwa kuwa kanuni muhimu katika kufurahia haki zingine zote za binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is essential for a healthy democracy.
entries.translation: Uhuru wa wanahabari ni muhimu katika kuendeleza demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.
entries.translation: Inawezesha wananchi kupata habari na kuwajibisha serikali yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also helps to ensure that all voices are heard, and that the public is informed about important issues.
entries.translation: Pia inasaidia kuhakikisha kuwa sauti zote zinasikilizwa, na kwamba wananchi wana habari kuhusu masuala muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been growing threats to freedom of the press around the world.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na ongekezo la vitisho kwa uhuru wa wanahabari kote duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Governments have been using laws to restrict the media, and journalists have been harassed and attacked.
entries.translation: Serikali zimekuwa zikitumia sheria kudhibiti vyombo vya habari, na wanahabari wamedhulumiwa na kushambuliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These threats are a serious concern, and they need to be addressed.
entries.translation: Vitisho hivi vinaleta wasiwasi mkubwa na vinahitaji kutatuliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all stand up for freedom of the press.
entries.translation: Sote tunapaswa kutetea uhuru wa vyombo vya habari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must defend the right of journalists to report the news without fear of reprisal.
entries.translation: Ni sharti tutetee haki ya wanahabari kuripoti habari bila hofu ya kisasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must also support independent media outlets, and we must encourage people to read and share news from a variety of sources.
entries.translation: Pia, sharti tuunge mkono vyombo huru vya habari, na tuwahimize watu kusoma na kusambaza habari kutoka vyanzo mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom of the press is a precious right.
entries.translation: Uhuru wa vyombo vya habari ni haki muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all do our part to protect it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Ongezeko la halijoto na kubadilika kwa mitindo ya mvua kunafanya iwe vigumu kukuza mazao katika baadhi ya maeneo, na vilevile linatoa fursa mpya za kilimo katika maeneo mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.
entries.translation: Athari kwa jumla ni kwamba mfumo wa kilimo wa kimataifa unazidi kuwa changamano na usiobashirika kwa urahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya athari kuu za moja kwa moja za mabadiliko ya tabianchi kwa kilimo ni kuongezeka na kukithiri kwa matukio mabaya ya hali ya hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
entries.translation: Mawimbi ya joto, ukame, mafuriko na dhoruba yote yanaweza kuharibu mazao na mifugo, na kufanya iwe vigumu kwa wakulima kufikisha mazao yao sokoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, matukio haya yanaweza kusababisha mazao kupotea kabisa, na kusababisha upungufu wa chakula na ongezeko la bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
entries.translation: Kando na matukio mabaya zaidi ya hali hewa, mabadiliko ya tabianchi pia yanasababisha kubadilika kwa viwango vya wastani vya joto na mitindo ya mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Mabadiliko haya yanafanya iwe vigumu kukuza baadhi ya mazao katika maeneo fulani, na vilevile yanatoa fursa mpya za kilimo katika maeneo mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.
entries.translation: Siku moja nikiendesha gari kurudi nyumbani kutoka kazini, dereva fulani alinifungia njia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.
entries.translation: Nilikasirika sana hivyo nikaanza kumfuata nyuma huku nikimwashia taa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.
entries.translation: Aliendelea tu kuendesha gari polepole, na nilizidi kuudhika zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, I couldn't take it anymore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I pulled up next to him and started yelling at him.
entries.translation: Niliendesha karibu naye na kuanza kumkaripia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He rolled down his window and started yelling back at me.
entries.translation: Alishusha kioo chake naye akaanza kunikaripia pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both so angry that we were shaking.
entries.translation: Sote tulikuwa na hasira hivi kwamba tulikuwa tukitetemeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other driver pulled over to the side of the road, and I followed him.
entries.translation: Dereva wa pili aliegesha gari pembeni mwa barabara nami nikamfuata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We got out of our cars and started yelling at each other even louder.
entries.translation: Sote tukashuka kwenye magari yetu na kuanza kukaripiana kwa sauti za juu hata zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so close to hitting him that I could smell his breath.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa karibu sana kumgonga hivi kwamba ningeweza kuhisi pumzi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, a police car pulled up.
entries.translation: Nilipodhania mambo yamefika mwisho, gari la polisi liliwasili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officer got out of his car and asked us what was going on.
entries.translation: Afisa wa polisi alishuka kwenye gari lake na kutuuliza kilichokuwa kikiendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both told him our sides of the story, and he started writing us a ticket.
entries.translation: Sote tukamsimulia yaliyotukia naye akatuandikia mashtaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was walking back to my car, I realized that I had learned my lesson.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nikirudi kwenye gari langu, nilikuwa nimejifunza jambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road rage is never worth it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not worth getting angry over, and it's not worth getting a ticket.
entries.translation: Haifai hata kidogo, na huenda ukaandikiwa mashtaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful river that flowed through a lush forest.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, palikuwa na mto wa kuvutia uliopitia katikati ya msitu uliostawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was home to many creatures, including fish, frogs, turtles, and birds.
entries.translation: Mto huo ulikuwa nyumbani kwa viumbe wengi, ikiwa ni pamoja na samaki, vyura, kasa na ndege.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was also a popular spot for humans to swim, fish, and relax.
entries.translation: Mto huo ulikuwa mahali palipofahamika sana kwa watu kuogelea, kuvua samaki na kutulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Lily was playing near the river when she saw a turtle caught in a fishing net.
entries.translation: Siku moja, msichana mdogo kwa jina Lily alikuwa akicheza kando ya mto alipoona kasa aliyekuwa amenaswa ndani ya neti ya kuvulia samaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to help the turtle, so she ran home to get her father.
entries.translation: Lily alifahamu kuwa alihitaji kumsaidia kasa huyo, hivyo akakimbia nyumbani kumwita baba yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily's father helped her to free the turtle, and the two of them returned to the river.
entries.translation: Babake Lily alimnasua kasa nao wakarudi mtoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The turtle thanked Lily for saving her life, and Lily promised to always be kind to animals.
entries.translation: Kasa huyo alimshukuru Lily kwa kuokoa maisha yake, naye Lily akaahidi kuwa mkarimu kwa wanyama siku zote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily continued to visit the river often, and she always made sure to look out for any animals that might be in danger.
entries.translation: Lily aliendelea kutembelea mto mara kwa mara na akahakikisha kuwa siku zote anawajali wanyama wowote walio hatarini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Lily saw a group of boys throwing rocks at the fish in the river.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Lily aliwaona wavulana fulani wakirushia mawe samaki kwenye mto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.
entries.translation: Lily alifahamu kuwa ni lazima angewakomesha, kwa hivyo alikimbia kuelekea walipo wavulana hao na kuwaambia kuwa wanakosea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.
entries.translation: Wavulana hao walishangaa kusikia hilo kutoka kwa Lily, lakini walimsikiliza na kuacha kutupa mawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.
entries.translation: "Je, nini maana ya kuwa malkia?" binti aliuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.
entries.translation: "Ni kujifunza kukubali mambo yote yaliyopo," ajuza alijibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
entries.translation: "Kushikilia moyoni mazuri na machungu, furaha na majonzi, mwangaza na kiza. Kuona ulimwengu jinsi ulivyo na kupenda licha ya mambo mengine."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
entries.translation: "Lakini ninawezaje kufanya hilo?" binti huyo aliuliza. "Ulimwengu umejaa matatizo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.
entries.translation: "Lakini pia imejaa mambo mazuri. Na jukumu letu ni kutafuta mema kwenye matatizo, na turuhusu mema hayo yatubadilishe.

entries.english: But what is it about horses that makes them so special?

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What is it that draws us to these magnificent creatures?
entries.translation: Ni nini kinachotuvutia kwa viumbe hawa wa ajabu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is their beauty, with their sleek coats and flowing manes.
entries.translation: Pengine ni urembo wao, na makoti yao maridadi na manyoya yanayotiririka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is their strength, as they can carry us on their backs for miles.
entries.translation: Pengine ni nguvu zao, kwani wanaweza kutubeba mgongoni kwa maili nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or perhaps it is their intelligence, as they are capable of learning a wide variety of tasks.
entries.translation: Au pengine ni werevu wao, kwani wana uwezo wa kujifunza mambo mengi tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever the reason, there is no denying the bond that exists between humans and horses.
entries.translation: Licha ya sababu yoyote ile, ni dhahiri kuwa pana uhusiano kati ya wanadamu na farasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are truly partners in life, and their companionship is a gift to be cherished.
entries.translation: Ni wenzi wa kweli maishani, na ushirikiano wao ni zawadi inayopaswa kuthaminiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most remarkable things about horses is their ability to sense our emotions.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo ya kushangaza zaidi kuhusu farasi ni uwezo wao wa kutambua hisia zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can tell when we are happy, sad, or scared, and they will often respond in kind.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kujua tunapokuwa na furaha, huzuni, au hofu, na mara nyingi huonyesha fadhila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them ideal companions for people who are lonely or who need emotional support.
entries.translation: Hiyo huwafanya wawe rafiki bora kwa watu walio wapweke au wanaohitaji msaada wa kihisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to their companionship, horses can also be used for a variety of purposes.
entries.translation: Mbali na urafiki wao, farasi pia wanaweza kutumika kwa shughuli mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be ridden for pleasure, used for work, or even raced.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kuendeshwa kwa starehe, kutumika kikazi, au hata kushiriki katika mbio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandma: What can I help you with today, my dear?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of work to do, but I can't seem to get started.
entries.translation: Nina kazi nyingi za kufanya, lakini nimeshindwa kuanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandma: I know how you feel.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes, motivation can be hard to come by.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, inaweza kuwa vigumu kupata motisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there are a few things you can do to help yourself get started.
entries.translation: Lakini kuna mambo machache unayoweza kufanya ili kujisaidia kuanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, think about why you're doing the work.
entries.translation: Kwanza, fikiria kwa nini unafanya kazi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you're working towards, it's easier to stay motivated.
entries.translation: Baada ya kujua unachotaka kutimiza, ni rahisi kuendelea kuwa na motisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, break down the task into smaller steps.
entries.translation: Pili, gawanya kazi hiyo kwa hatua ndogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it seem less daunting and more manageable.
entries.translation: Hii itakuwezesha kuidhibiti vyema na itakuwa rahisi kwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, give yourself rewards for completing each step.
entries.translation: Tatu, jipongeze kwa kukamilisha kila hatua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help you stay on track and motivated.
entries.translation: Hii itakusaidia kuendelea kupiga hatua na kuwa na motisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help if you need it.
entries.translation: Mwisho, usiogope kuomba usaidizi ikiwa unahitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes, all you need is a little encouragement to get you started.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, unachohitaji ni kutiwa moyo kidogo ili uanze.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
