entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
entries.translation: Magari ya kukodisha ni njia rahisi ya kuzunguka unapozuru jiji au nchi usiyoifahamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
entries.translation: Hukuwezesha kuzunguka upendavyo na ni chaguo nafuu zaidi kuliko usafiri wa umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
entries.translation: Unapokodisha gari, ni muhimu kulinganisha bei za makampuni mbalimbali na kusoma makubaliano ya ukodishaji, kwa uangalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
entries.translation: Hakikisha umeuliza kuhusu ada zozote za ziada, kama vile gharama za mafuta, bima, au ushuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
entries.translation: Pia ni vyema kupiga gari hilo picha kabla ya kuliendesha, ili uwe na uthibitisho wa hali yake kukitokea uharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
entries.translation: Endapo unapanga kukodisha gari kwa muda mrefu, unaweza kupata ofa nzuri kwa kulipia mpango wa kukodisha gari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
entries.translation: Kawaida, mipango hii hujumuisha idadi fulani ya siku za kukodisha, pamoja na nyongeza zingine, bila kuwekewa kikomo cha umbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kupata punguzo ukihifadhi mapema gari la kukodisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
entries.translation: Unapochukua gari ambalo umekodisha, hakikisha umelikagua kwa uangalifu kubaini ikiwa limeharibika popote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
entries.translation: Ukiona uharibifu wowote, hakikisha umerekodi kwenye makubaliano ya kukodisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
entries.translation: Pia, unapaswa kupiga gari hilo picha kabla ya kuliendesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
entries.translation: Wafiadini wa Uganda ni Wakristo 23 wa Kianglikana na 22 wa Kikatoliki wa Roma waliouawa kati ya mnamo 1885 na 1887.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
entries.translation: Waliuawa na mfalme wa Buganda, Mwanga II, kwa ajili ya kukataa kukana imani yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.
entries.translation: Wafiadini hao walitakaswa na Papa Paul VI mwaka wa 1964.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
entries.translation: Wanatambuliwa miongoni mwa watu muhimu zaidi katika historia ya Ukristo nchini Uganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.
entries.translation: Siku ya Wafiadini wa Uganda huadhimishwa tarehe 3 Juni kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.
entries.translation: Ni sikukuu ya kitaifa nchini Uganda na huadhimishwa na Wakristo duniani kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.
entries.translation: Wafiadini hao wanakumbukwa kwa ajili ya ujasiri wao na utayari wao wa kufa kwa ajili ya imani yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are an inspiration to Christians everywhere.
entries.translation: Wao ni vielelezo kwa Wakristo kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the upcoming months, I will be honored to receive an award for my work in the field of French language studies.
entries.translation: Katika miezi ijayo, nitatuzwa kwa ajili ya mchango wangu katika taaluma ya masomo ya lugha ya Kifaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The award will be presented by the Société Française de Linguistique, a prestigious organization dedicated to the advancement of French language and linguistics.
entries.translation: Tuzo hiyo itatolewa na Société Française de Linguistique, shirika maarufu linalojitolea kuendeleza lugha na isimu ya Kifaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am humbled and grateful to be recognized by such a distinguished organization, and I look forward to continuing my work in French language studies.
entries.translation: Ni heshima kubwa na ninashukuru kwa kutambuliwa na shirika maarufu kama hili, na ninatazamia kuendelea na kazi yangu katika masomo ya lugha ya Kifaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research interests lie in the area of historical linguistics, and I have focused my work on the development of French from its origins in the Gallo-Romance dialects of the early Middle Ages.
entries.translation: Mapendeleo yangu ya utafiti yanahusu isimu ya kihistoria, na nimeelekeza kazi yangu katika maendeleo ya lugha ya Kifaransa kutoka asili yake katika lahaja za Gallo-Romance mapema katika Zama za Kati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am particularly interested in the ways in which French has been influenced by other languages, such as Latin, Germanic languages, and Arabic.
entries.translation: Ninapendezwa hasa na jinsi lugha ya Kifaransa imeathiwa na lugha nyinginezo, kama vile Kilatini, lugha za Kijerumani, na kiarabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has been published in leading journals in the field of linguistics, and I have presented my work at conferences around the world.
entries.translation: Utafiti wangu umechapishwa katika majarida mashuhuri katika taaluma ya isimu, na nimewasilisha kazi yangu katika makongamano duniani kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am based at a university located near the French border, and I have had the opportunity to collaborate with scholars from France and other Francophone countries.
entries.translation: Ninapatikana katika chuo kikuu kilicho karibu na mpaka wa Ufarasa, na nilipata fursa ya kushirikiana na wasomi kutoka Ufaransa na nchi zingine zinazozungumza lugha ya Kifaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has made a significant contribution to the field of French language studies, and I am proud to have been recognized for my work.
entries.translation: Utafiti wangu umetoa mchango mkubwa katika taaluma ya lugha ya Kifaransa, na ninajuvunia kutambuliwa kwa ajili ya kazi yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: Hello, children. What can I do for you?
entries.translation: Shangazi wa Akosua: Humjambo, watoto. Niwasaidiaje?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: We need your help with a decision.
entries.translation: Binamu wa 1: Tunahitaji usaidizi wako katika kufanya uamuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're all trying to decide whether or not to cheat on a test tomorrow.
entries.translation: Sote tunajaribu kuamua iwapo tufanye au tujizuie kufanya hila kwenye mtihani kesho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 2: Yeah, we know it's wrong, but we're all really scared of failing.
entries.translation: Binamu wa 2: Ndiyo, tunajua ni makosa, lakini sote tunaogopa kufeli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: I understand that you're scared, but cheating is never the answer.
entries.translation: Shangazi wa Akosua: Ninaelewa kuwa mnaogopa, lakini kufanya hila sio suluhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that integrity is one of the most important things in life.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba uadilifu ni mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi maishani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you cheat, you're not just cheating yourself, you're also cheating everyone else who has worked hard to learn the material.
entries.translation: Unapofanya hila, hujidanganyi tu, unahadaa pia kila mtu ambaye amefanya bidii kujiandaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: But what if we really do fail?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: If you fail, then you fail. That's life.
entries.translation: Shangazi wa Akosua: Ukifeli, basi umefeli. Hayo ndio maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But at least you'll know that you did your best and you didn't cheat.
entries.translation: Lakini angalau unajua kwamba ulijitahidi kadri uwezavyo na hukufanya hila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Na hilo ndilo la maana zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to do the right thing, even if it's hard.
entries.translation: Tunastahili kufanya kinachofaa, hata ikiwa ni ngumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Dance, Henry, dance" the old woman cried "Dance and let the colors of life flow through you.
entries.translation: "Cheza densi, Henry, cheza densi" mwanamke mkongwe alisema "Cheza densi na uruhusu hisia za maisha zitiririke ndani mwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let the music fill your soul and your body will move of its own accord.
entries.translation: Muziki ukinasa roho yako, mwili wako utasonga kwa hiari kivyake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dance and be free" Henry looked at the old woman with confusion.
entries.translation: Cheza densi na uwe huru" Henry alimwangalia yule mwanamke mkongwe kwa mshangao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had never been a dancer, and he didn't understand why she was so insistent that he should start now.
entries.translation: Hakuwahi kuwa mcheza-densi, na hakuelewa kwa nini alikuwa anasisitiza kwamba aanze sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the old woman's eyes were bright and her face was filled with joy, and Henry couldn't help but be drawn in.
entries.translation: Lakini macho ya mwanamke huyo mkongwe yalikuwa yameng'aa na uso wake ulijawa na furaja, naye Henry alishindwa kujizuia kuvutiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took a deep breath and began to move.

entries.english: The recent rise of social media has given rise to a new breed of celebrities: the social media influencer.

entries.english: These individuals have amassed large followings on platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube, and they use their influence to promote products, services, and ideas.

entries.english: One of the most popular social media influencers in the world is Kim Kardashian.

entries.english: With over 200 million followers on Instagram, Kardashian is a powerful force in the fashion, beauty, and lifestyle industries.

entries.english: She has also used her platform to speak out about social issues, such as criminal justice reform and women's rights.

entries.english: However, there is a dark side to the world of social media influencers.

entries.english: Some influencers are paid by foreign governments to spread propaganda and disinformation.

entries.english: This is a serious problem, as it can greatly influence public opinion and undermine democracy.

entries.english: In 2016, it was revealed that Russian trolls used social media to spread propaganda and disinformation during the US presidential election.

entries.english: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.

entries.english: Cairo, the capital of Egypt, is the largest city in the Middle East and the third largest city in Africa.

entries.english: It is home to some of the world's most famous landmarks, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum.

entries.english: Luxor is home to the Valley of the Kings, where many of the pharaohs of ancient Egypt were buried.

entries.english: Rubber is used in a variety of places on a car, including the tires, brake pads, and seals.

entries.english: When rubber becomes worn, it can crack, split, or otherwise deteriorate.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a number of problems, such as reduced traction, decreased braking performance, and leaks.

entries.english: Missing roof rail pieces can also be a safety hazard.

entries.english: Roof rails are designed to help protect passengers in the event of a rollover accident.

entries.english: If the roof rails are missing, the roof of the car is more likely to collapse in a rollover, which can cause serious injuries or death.

entries.english: A broken fuel tank door lock can also be dangerous.

entries.english: If the fuel tank door cannot be locked, it could come open while the car is moving.

entries.english: This could spill fuel onto the road, which could cause a fire or explosion.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the safety risks, these types of damage can also be expensive to fix.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber pieces can be difficult to replace, and roof rails and fuel tank door locks can be expensive to repair or replace.

entries.english: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.

entries.english: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.
entries.translation: Atakuwa kutambua uharibifu wowote ambao usioonekana kwa macho, na anaweza kukushauri ikiwa gari ni salama au si kununua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?

entries.english: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.
entries.translation: Ghafla, uzuri na ufaafu huo wote hupotea, na baiskeli inakuwa kidukizo kisichovutia na kisichofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I once had a bike in a small room.
entries.translation: Wakati fulani nilikuwa na baiskeli kwenye chumba kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa fleti ndogo, chafu katika kitongoji duni, na baiskeli hiyo ilichukua nafasi nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: Sikuweza kuingia mlangoni bila kuisukuma, na ilinibidi kuwa mwangalifu nisijikwae katikati ya usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.
entries.translation: Lakini ingawa baiskeli hiyo ilikuwa kero, sikuweza kuiondoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa ukumbusho wa wakati bora zaidi, nilipokuwa mchanga na huru na mwingi wa matumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa naketi juu ya baiskeli na kuotea maeneo yote ambayo ningeweza kwenda, jinsi ambavyo ningefurahia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.
entries.translation: Siku moja, hatimaye niliamua kuondoa baiskeli hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.
entries.translation: Niliipeleka pembeni na kuiweka kuwa taka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 1900s, Americans were introduced to the drug “morphine” through the use of over-the-counter cough syrups.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni mwa miaka ya 1900, Wamerikani waliletwa dawa ya "morphine" kupitia matumizi ya dawa za kikohozi za umajimaji zinazouzwa dukani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this drug was initially used to treat pain, it soon became addictive and led to a rise in the number of drug addicts in the United States.
entries.translation: Ingawa awali dawa hii ilitumiwa kutibu maumivu, punde si punde ilianza kuwa ya uraibu na kusababisha ongezeko la idadi ya waraibu wa dawa za kulevya nchini Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most tragic stories of this era is that of the “Kitten Lady”.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya kisa cha kuhuzunisha zaidi katika kipindi hiki ni kumhusu "Kitten Lady".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyu alikuwa mraibu wa mofini na alikuwa na wanapaka wengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved her kittens very much and would often play with them for hours on end.
entries.translation: Aliwapenda sana paka wake na mara kwa mara alicheza nao kwa saa nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her addiction soon took over and she began to neglect her kittens.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, uraibu wake ulianza kumzidi na akaanza kuwapuuza paka wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would leave them for days at a time, only coming back to feed them and give them water.
entries.translation: Alikuwa akiwaacha kwa siku kadhaa, akirudi tu kuwalisha na kuwapa maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kittens eventually began to suffer from the neglect.
entries.translation: Paka hao hatimaye walianza kuteseka kutokana na kupuuzwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became thin and sickly, and their fur began to fall out.
entries.translation: Walikonda na kuwa wagonjwa, na manyoya yao yakaanza kuanguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One by one, they started to die.
entries.translation: Mmoja baada ya mwingine, walianza kufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Kitten Lady was devastated by the loss of her kittens, but she was unable to stop her addiction.
entries.translation: Kitten Lady alihuzunishwa na kuwapoteza paka wake, lakini hakuweza kuacha uraibu wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She eventually died of a morphine overdose, leaving her kittens behind.
entries.translation: Hatimaye alifariki kutokana na kunywa mofini kupita kiasi, na akawaacha paka wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.
entries.translation: Kisa hiki ni ukumbusho kuhusu hatari za uraibu wa dawa za kulevya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a reminder of the love and devotion that animals can have for their humans.
entries.translation: Pia ni kutukumbusha kuhusu upendo na uaminifu wa wanyama huwa kwa binadamu wanaowatunza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people are people who identify with a sexual orientation or gender identity that is different from the majority population.
entries.translation: Wasagaji, wasenge, watu wa jinsia mbili, na waliobadilisha jinsia (LGBT) ni watu wanaojitambulisha na mwelekeo na kijinsia au utambulisho wa kijinsia ambao ni tofauti na watu wengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual orientation refers to a person's romantic and sexual attraction to others, while gender identity refers to a person's internal sense of being male or female.
entries.translation: Mwelekeo wa kijinsia unarejelea hisia za kimapenzi na kingono kwa wengine, nao utambulisho wa kijinsia unarejelea hisia za ndani za mtu kuwa mwanamume au mwanamke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people face discrimination in many areas of life, including employment, housing, and healthcare.
entries.translation: Wana-LGBT hubaguliwa katika nyanja nyingi za maisha, zikiwemo ajira, makazi, na huduma za afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also more likely to experience violence and abuse.
entries.translation: Pia pana uwezekano kwao kukabiliwa na unyanyasaji na uonevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one single cause of LGBT identity.
entries.translation: Hakuna sababu hata moja ya utambulisho wa LGBT.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people are born with an innate sense of their sexual orientation or gender identity, while others develop these feelings over time.
entries.translation: Wapo wanaozaliwa wakiwa na hisia za mwelekeo wao wa kijinsia au utambulisho wa kijinsia, nao wengine hupata hisia hizi baada ya muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people are just as diverse as the rest of the population.
entries.translation: Wana-LGBT ni tofauti na watu wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They come from all walks of life and have a wide range of interests and experiences.
entries.translation: Asili zao ni tofauti wana mapendeleo na uzoefu mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The medical community recognizes that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses.
entries.translation: Wataalam wa afya wanatambua kwamba mwelekeo wa kijinsia na utambulisho wa kijinsia sio matatizo ya kiakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from its list of mental disorders in 1973.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, Jumuiya ya Wanasaikolojia wa Marekani waliondoa usenge katika orodha yake ya matatizo ya kiakili mnamo 1973.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people should be able to live their lives openly and authentically.
entries.translation: Wana-LGBT wanapaswa kuwa na uhuru wa kuishi maisha yao kwa uwazi na jinsi wapendavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many countries, there are laws that protect LGBT people from discrimination.
entries.translation: Katika nchi nyingi, kuna sheria zinazolinda wana-LGBT dhidi ya ubaguzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hujambo, na karibu kwenye uchunguzi wako wa kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.

entries.english: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa nikilala zaidi hivi majuzi, na lishe yangu imekuwa nzuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.
entries.translation: Nitaanza kwa kuchuguza vipimo vyako muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]
entries.translation: [Daktari anapima shinikizo la damu, mapigo ya moyo, na halijoto.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now, let's talk about your diet.

entries.english: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.
entries.translation: Pia hujaribu kula matunda na mboga siku nzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ninajaribu kufanya mazoezi angalau dakika 30 siku nyingi za juma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.
entries.translation: Mimi hutembea kwenda kazini, na ninacheza mpira wa kikapu mara moja au mbili kwa wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hiyo ni vizuri. Mazoezi ni sehemu muhimu ya maisha yenye afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ninajua. Ninajaribu kufanya mazoezi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is a country in Central Africa with a population of over 80 million people.
entries.translation: Jamuhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (DRC) ni nchi iliyoko Afrika ya Kati na ina idadi ya zaidi ya watu milioni 80.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, and is endowed with vast natural resources, including copper, cobalt, diamonds, and gold.
entries.translation: Ni nchi ya pili kwa ukubwa barani Afrika, na ina maliasili kwa wingi, zikiwemo shaba, kobalti, almasi, na dhahabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the DRC has been plagued by conflict for decades, which has had a devastating impact on its people and economy.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, DRC imekumbwa na migogoro kwa mika mingi, na hili limethiri vibaya raia na uchumi wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major conflict in the DRC was the First Congo War, which lasted from 1996 to 1997.
entries.translation: Mgogoro mkubwa wa kwanza nchini DRC ulikuwa Vita vya Kwanza vya Kongo, ambavyo vilidumu kutoka mwaka wa 1996 hadi 1997.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This war was fought between the government of Mobutu Sese Seko and a rebel group led by Laurent Kabila.
entries.translation: Vita hivi vilipiganwa kati ya serikali ya Mobutu Sese Seko na kundi la waasi lililoongozwa na Laurent Kabila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kabila eventually succeeded in overthrowing Mobutu and taking power.
entries.translation: Hatimaye Kabila alifanikiwa kumpindua Mobutu na kuchukua uongozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Hata hivyo, utawala wa Kabila haukuwa wa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1998, he was overthrown by a new rebel group led by Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1998, alipinduliwa na kikundi kipya cha waasi kilichoongozwa na Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to the Second Congo War, which lasted until 2003.
entries.translation: Hii ilisababisha Vita vya Pili vya Kongo, ambavyo viliendelea hadi mwaka wa 2003.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Second Congo War was the deadliest conflict in modern African history, and resulted in the deaths of over 5 million people.
entries.translation: Vita vya Pili vya Kongo vilikuwa vita vikali zaidi katika historia ya kisasa ya Afrika, na kusababisha vifo vya zaidi ya watu milioni 5.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The DRC has also been plagued by political instability.
entries.translation: DRC pia imekumbwa na misukosuko ya kisiasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Last week, my uncle was out in the field harvesting corn when he spotted a snake slithering across the ground.
entries.translation: Wiki iliyopita, mjomba wangu alikuwa shambani akivuna mahindi alipomwona nyoka akitelezateleza ardhini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to take a closer look, and as he got closer, he realized that it was a huge rattlesnake!
entries.translation: Aliamua kuangalia kwa makini, na aliposogea karibu zaidi, aligundua kuwa ni nyoka-kayamba mkubwa!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly backed away, but the snake was already on the move.
entries.translation: Alirudi nyuma haraka, lakini nyoka huyo alikuwa tayari anasonga mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It headed straight for my uncle, who started to run.
entries.translation: Alielekea moja kwa moja kwa mjomba wangu, ambaye alianza kukimbia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ran as fast as he could, but the snake was gaining on him.
entries.translation: Alikimbia kadri awezavyo, lakini nyoka huyo alimkaribia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when it seemed like the snake was going to catch him, my uncle tripped and fell.
entries.translation: Nyoka alipokaribia kumfikia, mjomba wangu alijikwaa na kuanguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed in a big pile of manure, and the snake slid right past him.
entries.translation: Alitua kwenye rundo kubwa la mbolea, na nyoka huyo akatelezateleza akampita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My uncle was so relieved that he had escaped, but he was also covered in manure.
entries.translation: Mjomba wangu alifarijika sana kwa kutoroka, lakini pia alikuwa amefunikwa na mbolea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a ubiquitous object in our modern world.
entries.translation: Mfuko wa plastiki ni kitu kinachojulikana kila mahali katika ulimwengu wetu wa kisasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Work is worship is a principle that states that all work, no matter how menial or insignificant it may seem, is sacred.
entries.translation: Kazi ni ibada ni kanuni inayosema kuwa kazi zote, licha ya kuwa duni au kutochukuliwa kuwa na umuhimu, ni takatifu.

entries.english: It is a belief that every task we perform, from cooking dinner for our children to cleaning the house, is an opportunity to honor God and our fellow man.

entries.english: When we work with this mindset, we approach our tasks with a sense of reverence and respect.

entries.english: We take pride in our work and do our best to do it well.

entries.english: We also become more mindful of the people who will benefit from our work, and we are more likely to go the extra mile to make sure that it is done well.

entries.english: Working as worship can also help us to connect with our families and communities.

entries.english: When we cook dinner for our children, we are not only providing them with nourishment, but we are also spending time with them and teaching them about the importance of food and family.

entries.english: When we clean the house, we are not only making our living space more comfortable, but we are also creating a sense of order and peace.

entries.english: "Don't judge a book by its cover" is a popular saying that means one should not make assumptions about something based on its outward appearance.

entries.english: For example, you might meet someone who has a bad reputation, but after getting to know them, you realize that they are actually a kind and gentle person.

entries.english: Or, you might see a building that looks old and rundown, but when you go inside, you find that it is actually a beautiful and historic place.

entries.english: There are many reasons why it is important not to judge things by their appearance.

entries.english: Second, it can prevent us from seeing the true value of something.

entries.english: Third, it can create unnecessary conflict and division.

entries.english: The next time you are tempted to judge something by its appearance, take a moment to pause and reflect.

entries.english: Acid rain can also kill fish and other aquatic life by making the water too acidic.
entries.translation: Pia, mvua ya asidi inaweza kuua samaki na viumbe wengine wa majini kwa kufanya maji kuwa ya asidi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, acid rain can damage buildings and statues by corroding the materials they're made of.
entries.translation: Pia, mvua ya asidi inaweza kuharibu mijengo na sanamu kwa kutia kutu kwenye nyenzo zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to reduce acid rain.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa yanayoweza kufanywa ili kupunguza mvua ya asidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One is to switch to cleaner energy sources, such as solar and wind power.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ni kubadili ili kutumia vyanzo safi vya nishati, kama vile jua na upepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another is to install pollution controls on factories and power plants.
entries.translation: Nyingine ni kuweka vidhibiti vya uchafuzi wa mazingira katika viwanda na mitambo ya umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, we can all do our part by driving less, recycling more, and using energy more efficiently.
entries.translation: Na hatimaye, sote tunaweza kuwajibika kwa kuendesha magari kiasi, kutumia vitu upya, na kutotumia nishati vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So the next time you see a rainstorm, think about acid rain.
entries.translation: Hivyo basi, utakapoona tena dhoruba ya mvua, huenda inahusiana na mvua ya asidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "College student's experiences with beer": As a college student, I have had my fair share of experiences with beer.
entries.translation: "Yanayowakumba wanafunzi chuoni baada ya kunywa pombe." Kama mwanafunzi wa chuo, nimepitia mengi kutokana na ulevi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of these experiences have been positive, while others have been less than ideal.
entries.translation: Yaliyonikumba yalikuwa mazuri na mengine mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, one experience that I will never forget is the time I got "prison beer" delivered to my dorm room.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, tukio moja nisiloweza kusahau ni wakati fulani ambapo nililetewa "bia ya jela" chumbani kwangu katika bweni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It all started when I was hanging out with some friends one night, and we decided to order a pizza.
entries.translation: Ilianza nilipokuwa nikibarizi na marafiki zangu usiku mmoja, kisha tukaamua kuagiza pizza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We placed our order online, and within minutes, we received a notification that our pizza was being delivered.
entries.translation: Tuliagiza mtandaoni, na baada ya dakika chache, tulipokea arifa kuwa pizza yetu imeletwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, when the delivery guy showed up, he was not carrying a pizza.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, msafirishaji alipofika, hakuwa amebeba pizza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, he was carrying a case of beer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all confused, but the delivery guy explained that he had gotten our order mixed up with another order.
entries.translation: Sote tulichanganyikiwa, lakini msafirishaji huyo alielezea kuwa agizo letu lilitolewa kimakosa badala ya agizo lingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He said that the other person had ordered a case of beer, and he had accidentally delivered it to us instead.
entries.translation: Alisema kuwa mhusika alikuwa ameagiza bia, na kwa bahati mbaya alikuwa ametuletea badala yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all a little hesitant at first, but we eventually decided to keep the beer.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni sote tulisitasita, lakini hatimaye tukafanya uamuzi wa kuchukua bia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After all, it was free beer.
entries.translation: Licha ya yote, hatukulipia bia ile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We opened the case of beer and started drinking.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beer was actually pretty good, and we all had a great time.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli bia ilikuwa nzuri sana, na sote tulifurahia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague was a hard worker, but she was always getting passed over for promotions.
entries.translation: Mwenzangu alikuwa mwenye bidii, lakini mara nyingi hakupandishwa cheo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was told that she needed to "work harder" or "be more visible," but it seemed like no matter what she did, she couldn't get ahead.
entries.translation: Aliambiwa kuwa anahitaji "kufanya kazi kwa bidii zaidi" au "kuonekana zaidi," lakini ilikuwa ni kana kwamba licha la juhudi zake zote, asingepandishwa cheo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The manager was also a problem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always micromanaging everyone, and he was quick to criticize.
entries.translation: Aliwafuatilia watu wote kila wakati na alikuwa mwepesi wa kukosoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't seem to care about the employees' work-life balance, and he expected them to be available 24/7.
entries.translation: Alionekana kutojali kuhusu maslahi ya waajiriwa kuhusu kazi na maisha yao, na aliwataka wawe kazini kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague eventually reached her breaking point.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She couldn't take the stress of the job anymore, and she knew that she wouldn't be able to advance her career there.
entries.translation: Alishindwa kukabiliana na mfadhaiko wa kazi, na alijua kuwa asingeweza kuendeleza taaluma yake hapo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She gave her two weeks' notice and started looking for a new job.
entries.translation: Aliwasilisha notisi yake ya wiki mbili na akaanza kutafuta kazi nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She found a new job that was a much better fit for her.
entries.translation: Alipata kazi mpya ambayo ilikuwa bora na ilimfaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pay was better, the hours were more reasonable, and the manager was supportive and understanding.
entries.translation: Mshahara ulikuwa bora, saa za kazi zilikuwa sawa, na meneja alikuwa mwenye kuelewa na kutoa usaidizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's much happier now, and she's glad that she made the decision to leave her old job.
entries.translation: Sasa anafurahia sana, na ameridhika kwa kufanya uamuzi wa kuacha kazi yake ya zamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure what the manager is doing now, but I hope that he's learned his lesson.
entries.translation: Sina uhakika kuhusu kile ambacho meneja anafanya sasa, lakini ninatumai kuwa amepata funzo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He can't treat his employees like that and expect them to stay.
entries.translation: Hawezi kuwatendea wafanyakazi wake hivyo na atarajie wataendelea kufanya kazi hapo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he wants to keep good people, he needs to change his ways.
entries.translation: Iwapo angependa kuwahifadhi watu wazuri, anahitaji kubadilisha mienendo yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for my colleague, she's doing great in her new job.
entries.translation: Mwenzangu kwa upande mwingine, anaendelea vizuri kwenye kazi yake mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's getting the recognition that she deserves, and she's finally able to advance her career.
entries.translation: Anatambuliwa jinsi inavyostahili, na hatimaye anaweza kuendeleza taaluma yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's a great example of what happens when you stand up for yourself and refuse to put up with a bad situation.
entries.translation: Ni mfano mzuri kuhusu kinachofanyika unapojitetea na kukataa kugandamizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Funny pictures and videos are a dime a dozen these days, but some of them stand out from the rest.
entries.translation: Picha na video za kuchekesha ni kawaida siku hizi, lakini baadhi yazo ni bora kuliko zingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are the ones that are so relatable or absurd that they make us laugh out loud.
entries.translation: Hizi ni zile ambazo zinahusiana kabisa au za kipuuzi zinazotufanya tucheke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is a recent video that went viral of a cat trying to fit into a small box.
entries.translation: Mfano mmoja wa video ya hivi karibuni iliyovuma mitandaoni ya paka akijaribu kuingia kwenye kijisanduku kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cat is clearly struggling, but it keeps trying, and the whole thing is just so funny.
entries.translation: Paka analemewa lakini anaendelea kung'ang'ana, na tukio lote linafurahisha sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another example is a picture of a dog wearing a hat that is way too big for it.
entries.translation: Mfano mwingine wa picha ya mbwa aliyevalia kofia kubwa mno kuliko kichwa chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog looks so ridiculous that it's impossible not to laugh.
entries.translation: Mbwa huyo anachekesha kwamba ni vigumu sana kujizuia kucheka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These types of funny pictures and videos are often shared on social media, and they can quickly become a "meme" A meme is a humorous image, video, or piece of text that is copied and shared online.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi picha na video za aina hii za kuchekesha hushirikiwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii, na kwa haraka zinaweza kuwa "meme" Meme ni picha, video, au maandishi ya kuchekesha yaliyonakiliwa na kushirikiwa mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes often use familiar images or phrases, and they can be used to express a wide range of emotions.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi meme hutumia picha au kauli maarufu, na zinaweza kutumika kuonyesha hisia mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One thing that must happen when a funny picture or video goes viral is that it is shared with others.
entries.translation: Jambo moja ambalo hufanyika picha au video ya kuchekesha inaposambaa mtandaoni ni kuwa inashirikiwa na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is what makes memes so popular.
entries.translation: Hii ndiyo sababu meme ni maarufu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People see a funny picture or video, and they want to share it with their friends so that they can laugh too.
entries.translation: Watu wanapoona picha au video ya kuchekesha, wanaishiriki na marafiki zao ili pia nao wacheke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is why memes can spread so quickly across the internet.
entries.translation: Hii ndio sababu meme husambaa upesi kwenye intaneti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, standing at 8,848 meters above sea level.
entries.translation: Mlima Everest ndio mlima mkubwa zaidi duniani, na una urefu wa mita 8,848 juu ya usawa wa bahari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
entries.translation: Unapatikana katika safu ya milima ya Mahalangur Himal ambayo ni sehemu ya Himalayas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mountain is a popular destination for mountaineers, and many people attempt to summit it each year.
entries.translation: Mlima huu ni sehemu maarufu inayotembelewa na wakweaji milima, na watu wengi hujaribu kuukwea kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the climb is dangerous, and many people have died trying to reach the top.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kukwea mlima huu ni hatari, na watu wengi wamekufa wakijaribu kufikia kilele chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first recorded attempt to summit Everest was made in 1921 by a British expedition led by George Mallory.
entries.translation: Jaribio la kwanza kurekodiwa la kukwea mlima Everest lilifanyika mwaka wa 1921 kupitia safari ya Waingereza wakiongozwa na George Mallory.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mallory and his climbing partner Andrew Irvine disappeared during their attempt, and their bodies were not found until 1999.
entries.translation: Mallory na mshirika wake wa kukwea Andrew Irvine walipotea wakati wa jaribio hilo, na miili yao haikupatikana hadi 1999.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first people to successfully summit Everest.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 1953, Edmund Hillary na Tenzing Norgay walikuwa watu wa kwanza kufanikiwa kufika kilele cha Everest.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, thousands of people have followed in their footsteps.
entries.translation: Tangia wakati huo, maelfu ya watu walifuata nyayo zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The climb to the summit of Everest is a long and arduous journey.
entries.translation: Kukwea hadi kilele cha mlima Everest ni safari ndefu na inayohitaji bidii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It typically takes climbers about two months to complete the journey, and they must overcome a number of challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida wakweaji huchukua takriban miezi miwili kukamilisha safari, na hukumbwa na changamoto si haba njiani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These challenges include altitude sickness, extreme weather conditions, and the risk of falling.
entries.translation: Changamo hizi zinajumuisha magonjwa ya altitudo, hali kali ya hewa, na hatari ya kuanguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the dangers, the climb to the summit of Everest is a rewarding experience.
entries.translation: Licha ya hatari hizo, kukwea hadi kilele cha mlima Everest kunaridhisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are amazed by how small and insignificant they feel compared to the vastness of the universe.

entries.english: Child: I can't believe how big space is.

entries.english: Mother: It is, but it's also full of amazing things.
