entries.english: I was worried that I might have contracted Lyme disease, but I went to the doctor and he said that I didn't have anything to worry about.
entries.translation: Nilihofia kuwa huenda nimeambukizwa maradhi ya Lyme, lakini nilienda kumwona daktari na akasema kuwa sikuwa na dalili za kuhofia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told me that the rash was probably just a reaction to the tick's saliva.
entries.translation: Aliniambia kuwa huenda upele ulisababishwa tu na kuumwa na kupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was relieved to hear that I didn't have Lyme disease, but I was still a little bit concerned about the rash.
entries.translation: Nilifurahi kusikia kuwa sikuwa na ugonjwa wa Lyme, lakini bado nilikuwa na wasiwasi kidogo kuhusu upele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor told me that it would go away on its own, but it took a few weeks for it to completely disappear.
entries.translation: Daktari aliniambia kuwa utatoweka wenyewe, lakini ilichukua wiki kadhaa kwa upele huo kutoweka kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, I tried to keep the rash clean and dry.
entries.translation: Wakati huohuo, nilijaribu kusafisha na kukausha upele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also applied some over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream to help relieve the itching.
entries.translation: Pia nilipaka krimu ya haidrokotisoni niliyonunua kutoka duka la dawa ili kusaidia kutuliza mwasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rash was itchy and unsightly, but it didn't cause me any other problems.
entries.translation: Upele ulikuwa ukiwasha na usiopendeza, lakini haukunisababishia matatizo mengine yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just glad that I didn't have Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Ninafurahia kuwa sina maradhi ya Lyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you find a tick attached to your body, it's important to remove it as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Ukipata kupe kwenye mwili wako, ni muhimu kumwondoa haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can use a pair of tweezers to grasp the tick as close to the skin as possible and pull it straight out.
entries.translation: Unaweza kutumia vibano kumng'ata kupe karibu zaidi na ngozi kisha uvute nje mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't twist or jerk the tick, as this could cause the head to break off and remain in your skin.
entries.translation: Usimkunje wala kumfinya kupe, kwani kufanya hivyo kunaweza kusababisha kichwa chake kupasuka na kusalia kwenye ngozi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've removed the tick, wash the area with soap and water.
entries.translation: Baada ya kumwondoa kupe, safisha sehemu hiyo kwa maji na sabuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also apply a topical antibiotic ointment to help prevent infection.
entries.translation: Pia unaweza kupaka mafuta ya krimu ya antibiotiki ili kusaidia kuzuia maambukizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to watch for signs of Lyme disease after being bitten by a tick.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuangalia dalili za maradhi ya Lyme baada ya kuumwa na kupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These symptoms can include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and a characteristic rash.
entries.translation: Dalili hizi zinajumuisha joto jingi, kuumwa kwa kichwa, uchovu, kuumwa kwa misuli, na upele usio wa kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you develop any of these symptoms, see your doctor right away.
entries.translation: Ukipata dalili yoyote kati ya hizi, mwone daktari wako mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease is a serious illness, but it can be treated with antibiotics.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa wa Lyme ni hatari, lakini unaweza kutibiwa kwa antibaotiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment is important to prevent serious complications.
entries.translation: Uchunguzi na matibabu ya mapema ni muhimu ili kuzuia matatizo makubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about ticks or Lyme disease, talk to your doctor.
entries.translation: Iwapo una swali lolote kuhusu kupe au maradhi ya Lyme, zungumza na daktari wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Three women are sitting at a table, talking about their cats.
entries.translation: Wanawake watatu wameketi mezani, wakizungumza kuhusu paka wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: My cat, Sangeetha, is always there to greet me at the door when I come home from work.
entries.translation: Constance: Paka wangu, Sangeetha, kila mara ananisalimia mlangoni ninaporudi nyumbani kutoka kazini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: Me too! I have two cats of my own. They make me feel wanted.
entries.translation: Ayanda: Nami pia! Ninamiliki paka wawili. Wananifanya nijihisi mwenye thamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I know what you mean. Sangeetha always makes me feel better when I'm having a bad day.
entries.translation: Constance: Ninajua unachosema. Kila wakati Sangeetha ananifanya nijihisi vizuri ninapokuwa na siku mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi: I've always wanted a cat, but I'm allergic.
entries.translation: Aditi: Kila mara nimetaka kuwa na paka, lakini nina mzio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: That's too bad. Cats are really great companions.
entries.translation: Ayanda: Pole sana kwa hilo. Paka ni rafiki wazuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi:I know! I've always admired people who have cats. They seem to have such a special bond with their pets.
entries.translation: Aditi: Ninajua! Nimekuwa nikivutiwa na watu walio na paka. Wanaonekana kuwa na uhusiano spesheli na wanyama wao vipenzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I think it's because cats are very independent animals. They don't need you to take care of them every minute of the day.
entries.translation: Constance: Ninafikiri ni kwa sababu paka ni wanyama wa kujitegemea sana. Hawahitaji uwashughulikie kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they still love you and enjoy your company.
entries.translation: Lakini bado wanakupenda na wanafurahia kuwa nawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Ethiopia is long and complex, with a rich and varied culture.
entries.translation: Historia ya Ethiopia ni ndefu na tata, na yenye utamaduni mwingi na tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest evidence of human settlement in Ethiopia dates back to the Paleolithic period, with the discovery of stone tools and other artifacts.
entries.translation: Ushahidi wa zamani zaidi wa makazi ya binadamu nchini Ethiopia unaanzia kipindi cha Paleolithiki, kwa uvumbuzi wa zana za mawe na michoro mingine ya sanamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major civilization in Ethiopia was the Aksumite Empire, which flourished from the 1st century BC to the 8th century AD.
entries.translation: Ustaarabu mkuu wa kwanza nchini Ethiopia ulikuwa ni Himaya ya Aksumite, iliyonawiri kutoka karne ya 1 KK hadi karne ya 8 BK.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Aksumites were a powerful trading empire that controlled much of the trade between Africa and the Middle East.
entries.translation: Aksumite walikuwa himaya yenye nguvu ya kibiashara  iliyotawala sehemu kubwa ya biashara kati ya Afrika na Mashariki ya Kati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also built many impressive monuments, including the Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.translation: Pia walijenga minara mingi ya kuvutia, ikiwemo Stelae Kuu ya Aksum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After the fall of the Aksumite Empire, Ethiopia was ruled by a series of different kingdoms and dynasties.
entries.translation: Baada ya kuanguka kwa Himaya ya Aksumite, Ethiopia ilitawaliwa na msururu wa falme na nasaba tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 16th century, Ethiopia was invaded by the Ottoman Empire, but the Ethiopians were able to defeat the Ottomans and maintain their independence.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 16, Ethiopia ilivamiwa na Himaya ya Ottoman, lakini Waethiopia waliweza kushinda Ottoman na kudumisha uhuru wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, Ethiopia was ruled by Emperor Tewodros II, who is considered one of the greatest Ethiopian rulers.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 19, Ethiopia ilitawaliwa na Mfalme Tewodros II, anayezingatiwa kuwa mmojawapo wa watawala mashuhuri zaidi wa Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tewodros II was a strong and ambitious ruler who sought to unite Ethiopia and to modernize the country.
entries.translation: Tewodros II alikuwa mtawala mwenye nguvu na maono aliyetaka kuunganisha Ethiopia na kuifanya nchi ya kisasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also fought against European colonialism, and he is remembered for his famous letter to Queen Victoria of England, in which he demanded that she stop interfering in Ethiopian affairs.
entries.translation: Pia alipigana dhidi ya ukoloni wa Uropa, na anakumbukwa kwa barua yake maarufu kwa Malkia Victoria wa Uingereza, ambamo alimtaka kukoma kuingilia masuala ya Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: What kind of style are you looking for?
entries.translation: Muuzaji: Je, unatafuta mtindo wa aina gani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I'm mostly interested in something neutral and understated.
entries.translation: Mteja: Ninapendelea zaidi kitu cha wastani na kadiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: We have a few options that might work. This one is made from wool and has a simple geometric pattern.
entries.translation: Muuzaji: Tuna chaguo kadhaa ambazo huenda zikakufaa. Hii imetengenezwa kwa sufu na ina usawazisho rahisi pande zote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I like that. It's perfect for my living room.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: Great! I'm happy to help. We can also deliver and install the rug for you if you'd like.
entries.translation: Muuzaji: Vizuri! Ninafuraha kukusaidia. Pia tunaweza kukuletea na kukuwekea mkeka ukipenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: That would be great. I'm willing to pay a little extra for that.
entries.translation: Mteja: Vizuri hivyo. Niko tayari kulipia gharama kiasi kwa hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sickness has been a part of human life since the beginning of time.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa umekuwa sehemu ya maisha ya binadamu tangu mwanzo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the common cold to the bubonic plague, countless diseases have ravaged our species, causing pain, suffering, and death.
entries.translation: Kuanzia kwa mafua ya kawaida hadi tauni ya majipu, magonjwa mengi yamevamia spishi yetu kusababisha maumivu, mateso, na kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But where did these illnesses come from?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One popular myth about the origin of sickness is that it was caused by a curse from the gods.
entries.translation: Hadithi moja maarufu kuhusu asili ya ugonjwa ni kuwa ulisababishwa na laana kutoka kwa miungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: According to this myth, the gods were angered by the behavior of humans, so they sent down a plague to punish them.
entries.translation: Kulingana na hadithi hii, miungu ilikasirishwa na tabia za wanadamu, kisha ikatuma tauni ili kuwaadhibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This myth is found in many cultures around the world, and it often features a similar story: the gods are angered by something humans have done, so they send down a plague to teach them a lesson.
entries.translation: Hadithi hii inapatikana katika tamaduni nyingi kote duniani, na mara nyingi inaangazia hadithi inayofanana: miungu hukasirishwa na kitu fulani kilichofanywa na wanadamu na kutuma tauni ya kuwaadhibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this myth is certainly a powerful story, there is no evidence to support it.
entries.translation: Ingawa hadithi hii ni nguvu, hakuna ushahidi wa kuiunga mkono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, most scientists believe that sickness is caused by natural factors, such as bacteria and viruses.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, wanasayansi wengi wanaamini kuwa ugonjwa husababishwa na mambo ya asili, kama vile bakteria na virusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These pathogens are always present in our environment, and they can cause disease when they enter our bodies.
entries.translation: Pathojeni hizi hupatikana katika mazingira yetu, na zinaweza kusababisha ugonjwa zinapoingia kwenye miili yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, the myth of the gods' curse is just one of many stories about the origin of sickness.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, hadithi ya laana ya miungu ni mojawapo ya hadithi nyingi kuhusu chanzo cha ugonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other myths and legends that attempt to explain why we get sick.
entries.translation: Kuna hadithi na hekaya nyingine nyingi ambazo zinajaribu kuelezea kwa nini huwa tunaugua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I can't believe we're going to be learning how to cook Indian food today," said 10-year-old Priya excitedly.
entries.translation: "Siamini kuwa tutajifunza jinsi ya kupika chakula cha Kihindi leo," alisema Priya mwenye umri wa miaka 10 kwa furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's delicious," said Priya "It's usually very flavorful, with a lot of spices. And there are so many different dishes to choose from."
entries.translation: "Ni kitamu," alisema Priya "Hutiwa ladha sana, kwa viungo vingi sana. Na kuna vyakula vingi tofauti unavyoweza kuchagua."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The class arrived at the kitchen, and Ms. Singh began to set up.
entries.translation: Wanafunzi walifika jikoni, na Bi. Singh akaanza matayarisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Today, we're going to be making a simple dish called dal makhani," she said.
entries.translation: "Leo tutapika chakula rahisi kiitwacho dal makhani," alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's a type of lentil soup that's very popular in India."

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Singh showed the class how to measure out the ingredients and cook the lentils.
entries.translation: Bi. Singh alionyesha wanafunzi jinsi ya kupima viungo na kupika lentili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The students helped each other chop vegetables and stir the pot.
entries.translation: Wanafunzi walisaidiana kukata mboga na kukoroga chungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they worked, they chatted about their favorite foods and what they were looking forward to trying in India.
entries.translation: Walivyofanya kazi, walipiga gumzo kuhusu vyakula wavipendavyo na walivyokuwa wakitarajia kujaribu India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the dal makhani was finished, the students sat down to eat.
entries.translation: Dal makhani ilipoiva, wanafunzi waliketi chini kula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My favorite season is the one in which all is green, the trees are in full bloom, and the birds are singing.
entries.translation: Msimu ninaoupenda ni ule ambao kila kitu ni kijani, miti inanawiri kikamilifu, na ndege wanaimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time of new beginnings, as the world wakes up from its winter slumber and begins to grow and change.
entries.translation: Ni wakati wa mwanzo mpya, dunia inapotoka katika hali tuvuli ya majira ya baridi na kuanza kukua na kubadilika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I love to spend this time outdoors, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.
entries.translation: Ninapenda kukaa nje wakati huu, nikifurahia hewa safi na jua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is nothing quite like taking a walk in the woods on a spring day, breathing in the scent of the flowers and listening to the birdsong.
entries.translation: Hakuna kitu bora kama kutembea msituni siku ya majira ya kuchipua, ukipumua hewa nzuri ya harufu ya maua na kusikiliza ndege wakiimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The assassination of Mohamed Bouazizi was a major turning point in the Tunisian Revolution.

entries.english: Bouazizi was a 26-year-old street vendor who set himself on fire in December 2010 in protest of police harassment and corruption.
entries.translation: Bouazizi alikuwa mchuuzi wa barabarani mwenye umri wa miaka 26 aliyejichoma moto mnamo Desemba 2010 katika kupinga unyanyasaji na ufisadi wa polisi.

entries.english: His death sparked a wave of protests across Tunisia that eventually led to the overthrow of President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.

entries.english: Bouazizi's death was widely seen as a symbol of the Tunisian people's frustration with the government's economic policies and its authoritarian rule.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The protests that followed his death were met with violent repression by the government, but they ultimately succeeded in toppling Ben Ali.
entries.translation: Maandamano yaliyofuatia kifo chake yalikabiliwa kwa nguvu kupita kiasi kutoka kwa serikali, lakini hatimaye walifanikiwa kumwondoa Ben Ali.

entries.english: Gift-giving is an important part of Chinese culture, and there are many different rules and customs to follow.

entries.english: Whenever you are invited to a Chinese person's home, it is customary to bring a gift.
entries.translation: Unapoalikwa nyumbani kwa Mchina, ni desturi kuleta zawadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of gift you bring will depend on the occasion and the relationship you have with the host.
entries.translation: Aina ya zawadi unayoleta itategemea tukio na uhusiano ulio nao na mwenyeji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you are attending a birthday party, you might bring a gift of flowers or fruit.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, iwapo unahudhuria sherehe ya siku ya kuzaliwa, unaweza kuleta zawadi ya maua au matunda.

entries.english: If you are visiting a friend's home, you might bring a small gift, such as a bottle of wine or a box of chocolates.
entries.translation: Iwapo unamtembelea rafiki nyumbani kwake, unaweza kuleta zawadi ndogo, kama vile chupa ya divai au kikasha cha chokoleti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to wrap the gift nicely and to present it with both hands.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kufunga zawadi vizuri na kuipeana kwa mikono miwili.

entries.english: When you receive a gift, it is customary to open it immediately and to express your appreciation.

entries.english: You should also reciprocate by giving a gift of equal value whenever you are invited to someone's home.

entries.english: If you are unsure of what to give, you can always ask a friend or family member for advice.

entries.english: Action films have undergone a major transformation in recent years.

entries.english: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.

entries.english: This transformation is often a reflection of the film's themes, which can range from the importance of family to the power of love.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi mabadiliko haya yanaonyesha mada za filamu, zinazoweza kuwa umuhimu wa familia hadi kwa nguvu za mapenzi.

entries.english: Several recent action films have featured this type of transformation.

entries.english: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.
entries.translation: Katika filamu ya "The Batman," kwa mfano, mhusika aliye kwenye mada anatoka kuwa askari doria mwenye kulipiza kisasi hadi ishara ya matumaini kwa jiji la Gotham.

entries.english: In "Black Panther," T'Challa must learn to embrace his role as king of Wakanda, even though it means giving up some of his personal freedoms.
entries.translation: Katika "Black Panther," T'Challa anapaswa kujifunza kutekeleza wajibu wake kama mfalme wa Wakanda, hata ingawa inamaanisha kupoteza baadhi ya uhuru wake wa kibinafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers must learn to control her powers and use them for good.
entries.translation: Na katika "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers anapaswa kujifunza jinsi ya kudhibiti mamlaka yake na kuyatumia kwa uzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films show that action films can be more than just mindless violence.
entries.translation: Filamu hizi zinaonyesha kuwa filamu za vita zinaweza kuwa zaidi ya ukatili usio na busara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also be used to explore complex themes and characters.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate of man vs. machine is a long-standing one, with no easy answer.
entries.translation: Mjadala wa binadamu dhidi ya mashine umekuwa wa muda mrefu, bila jibu rahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the one hand, machines are becoming increasingly sophisticated and capable, and they are already performing many tasks that were once thought to be the exclusive domain of humans.
entries.translation: Kwa upande mmoja, mashine zinazidi kuwa za kisasa na zenye uwezo, na tayari zinafanya kazi nyingi zilizodhaniwa awali kuwa za binadamu pekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the other hand, humans have a unique set of skills and abilities that machines are unlikely to ever replicate, such as creativity, empathy, and intuition.
entries.translation: Kwa upande mwingine, binadamu wana jozi ya kipekee ya maarifa na uwezo ambao mashine haziwezi kuiga, kama vile ubunifu, kutambua hisia, na uhalisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the key areas where machines are rapidly outpacing humans is in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya sehemu kuu ambapo mashine zinazidi binadamu ni katika akili bandia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is a branch of computer science that deals with the creation of intelligent agents, which are systems that can reason, learn, and act autonomously.
entries.translation: Akili bandia ni tawi la sayansi ya kompyuta linaloshughulikia kuundwa kwa mawakala wa akili, ambayo ni mifumo inayoweza kufikiria, kujifunza, na kutenda kazi kwa uhuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI is already being used in a wide range of applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis.
entries.translation: Tayari akili bandia inatumika katika programu tumizi mbalimbali, kuanzia magari yanayojiendesha hadi uchunguzi wa kimatibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And as AI continues to develop, it is likely to become even more powerful and capable.
entries.translation: Na kadri akili bandia inavyoendelea kukua, kuna uwezekano wa kuwa thabiti na yenye uwezo zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also a number of areas where humans are likely to retain a significant advantage over machines.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, pia kuna sehemu kadhaa ambapo binadamu wana uwezekano wa kuwa na umuhimu zaidi kuliko mashine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, humans are much better at dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, binadamu huwa bora zaidi katika kukabili utata na ukosefu wa uhakika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also draw on our experience and intuition to make decisions in complex situations.
entries.translation: Pia tunaweza kutumia tajiriba na uhalisia wetu kufanya maamuzi katika hali tata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, humans have a unique capacity for creativity and innovation.
entries.translation: Na hatimaye, binadamu wana uwezo wa kipekee wa ubunifu na uvumbuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two men, one in his 30s and one in his 50s, are sitting at the bar, drinking.

entries.english: Young Man: So, I heard that the new head of the liquor board is really cracking down on local stores.

entries.english: Old Man: Yeah, I heard that too. They're saying that he's going to be doing random inspections of bars and restaurants to make sure that they're not selling liquor to minors.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: That's a good thing.

entries.english: I mean, it's not fair to the responsible businesses that are following the rules when some other places are just selling liquor to anyone who walks in the door.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Man: I agree. But I'm also worried about how it's going to affect my business.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, I'm a good guy. I don't sell liquor to minors.

entries.english: Family planning in India has been a topic of debate for many years.
entries.translation: Kupanga uzazi nchini India limekuwa suala la mjadala kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1976, the Indian government passed the controversial National Emergency Act, which imposed a forced sterilization program on men and women.
entries.translation: Katika mwaka wa 1976, serikali ya India ilipitisha Sheria ya Taifa ya Dharura yenye utata, iliyoweka mpango wa lazima wa kufunga uzazi kwa wanaume na wanawake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This program was met with widespread resistance and eventually overturned by the Indian Supreme Court.
entries.translation: Mpango huo ulipingwa sana na watu wengi na hatimaye ukabatilishwa na Mahakama Kuu ya India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the Indian government has taken a more progressive approach to family planning.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, serikali ya India imechukua mbinu ya kimaendeleo zaidi kwa upangaji uzazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2010, the government launched the National Family Planning Program, which provides free contraception and sterilization services to all Indian citizens.
entries.translation: Katika mwaka wa 2010, serikali ilizindua Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Upangaji Uzazi, ambao unatoa huduma za bila malipo za kuzuia mimba na kufunga uzazi kwa raia wote wa India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program has been successful in reducing the fertility rate in India, but it still faces challenges, such as a lack of awareness and access to services.
entries.translation: Mpango huu umefanikiwa katika kupunguza kiwango cha uwezo wa kupata watoto nchini India, lakini bado unakabiliwa na changamoto, kama vile ukosefu wa uhamasisho na ufikiaji wa huduma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important challenges to family planning in India is the lack of awareness about the benefits of family planning.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya changamoto kuu za upangaji uzazi nchini India ni ukosefu wa uhamasisho kuhusu manufaa ya kupanga uzazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many Indian couples believe that it is their duty to have as many children as possible.
entries.translation: Wanandoa wengi India wanaamini kuwa ni wajibu wao kuwa na watoto wengi iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This belief is often reinforced by cultural and religious norms.
entries.translation: Imani hii huhimizwa zaidi na kanuni za kitamaduni na kidini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge to family planning is the lack of access to services.
entries.translation: Changamoto nyingine ya upangaji uzazi ni ukosefu wa ufikiaji wa huduma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, there are often few or no family planning clinics.
entries.translation: Katika maeneo ya vijijini, mara nyingi kuna kiliniki chache za kupanga uzazi au hazipo kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it difficult for couples to access the services they need.
entries.translation: Hii hufanya iwe vigumu kwa wanandoa kufikia huduma wanazohitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the Indian government is committed to providing family planning services to all its citizens.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizi, serikali ya India imejitolea kutoa huduma za kupanga uzazi kwa raia wake wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is a systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the natural world.
entries.translation: Sayansi ni kitengo cha kimfumo kinachojenga na kupanga maarifa katika mbinu ya fafanuzi zinazoweza kufanyiwa majaribio na ubashiri kuhusu dunia asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In its broadest sense, science encompasses all human knowledge and activity motivated by a desire to understand the natural world and its phenomena.
entries.translation: Katika maana pana zaidi, sayansi inajumuisha maarifa na shughuli zote za binadamu zinazochochewa na matamanio ya kuelewa dunia asilia na matukio yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is also often seen as a particular body of knowledge derived from such investigation, as well as a method of discovery.
entries.translation: Sayansi huonekana kama kiini maalum cha maarifa yanayotokana na uchunguzi kama huo, na vilevile njia ya uvumbuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest roots of science can be traced to Ancient Greek philosophy, particularly the works of Aristotle, who attempted to explain natural phenomena through observation and reason.
entries.translation: Mizizi ya zamani ya sayansi inaweza kufuatiliwa kutoka kwa falsafa ya Kale ya Ugiriki, hususan kazi za Aristotle, aliyejaribu kufafanua matukio ya kawaida kupitia uangalizi na kufikiria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over the centuries, science has developed into a more rigorous discipline, with the development of the scientific method, which emphasizes evidence, hypothesis testing, and repeatability.
entries.translation: Kwa karne nyingi, sayansi imekua na kuwa kitengo kinanchozingatiwa sana, kwa maendeleo ya mbinu ya kisayansi, inayosisitiza ushahidi, majaribio ya nadharia tete, na urudiaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science has had a profound impact on human society, leading to the development of new technologies, medicines, and understanding of the natural world.
entries.translation: Sayansi imekuwa na athari kubwa kwa binadamu, na kupelekea uvumbuzi wa teknolojia mpya, dawa, na uelewaji wa dunia asilia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has also played a role in shaping social and political thought.
entries.translation: Pia imehusika uundaji wa dhana za kijamii na kisiasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, science is a major part of modern life, and it continues to play an important role in the advancement of knowledge and understanding.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Egypt faces a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Misri inakumbana na changamoto kadhaa, ikiwemo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A rapidly growing population. Egypt's population is expected to grow from 100 million today to 140 million by 2050.
entries.translation: *Idadi ya watu inayokua haraka. Idadi ya watu ya Misri inatarajiwa kukua kutoka milioni 100 leo hii hadi milioni 140 kufikia 2050.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will put a strain on the country's resources, including its food supply, water supply, and infrastructure.
entries.translation: Hii itaweka mkazo kwenye rasilimali za nchi, ikiwemo upatikanaji wa chakula, maji, na miundomsingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A widening gap between the rich and the poor. Egypt has a high Gini coefficient, which measures inequality.
entries.translation: *Pengo linalozidi kati ya matajiri na maskini. Misri ina mgawo wa juu wa Gini, unaopima ukosefu wa usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the wealth is concentrated in the hands of a few, while the majority of the population lives in poverty.
entries.translation: Hii ina maana kuwa mali iko mikononi mwa watu wachache tu, huku idadi kubwa ya watu wakiishi katika hali ya umaskini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * High unemployment. Egypt's unemployment rate is around 12%.
entries.translation: *Kiwango cha juu cha ukosefu wa ajira. Kiwango cha ukosefu wa ajira nchini Misri ni karibu asilimia 12.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is especially high among young people.
entries.translation: Kiwango hiki kipo juu haswa miongoni mwa vijana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A lack of economic opportunity. Egypt's economy is heavily reliant on tourism and agriculture.
entries.translation: *Ukosefu wa nafasi za kiuchumi. Uchumi wa Misri unategemea pakubwa utalii na kilimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sectors are vulnerable to external shocks, such as the global financial crisis and the Arab Spring.
entries.translation: Sekta hizi zipo katika hatari ya mitikiso ya nje, kama vile matatizo ya kifedha ulimwenguni na Mapinduzi ya Uarabuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Political instability. Egypt has experienced a number of political upheavals in recent years, including the overthrow of Hosni Mubarak in 2011 and the subsequent military coup in 2013.
entries.translation: *Machafuko ya kisiasa. Misri imeshuhudia misukosuko kadhaa ya kisiasa katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, ikiwemo mapinduzi ya Hosni Mubarak mwaka wa 2011 na mapinduzi yaliyofuatia ya kijeshi mwaka wa 2013.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This instability has made it difficult for the government to implement reforms and improve the economy.
entries.translation: Hali hii ya ukosefu wa utulivu imefanya iwe vigumu kwa serikali kutekeleza mabadiliko na kuimarisha uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vehicle repair and maintenance is essential for keeping your car in good condition and preventing costly repairs down the road.

entries.english: There are a number of things you can do to maintain your vehicle, such as changing the oil and filters regularly, checking the tire pressure, and keeping the fluids topped up.

entries.english: If you're not comfortable doing these things yourself, you can take your car to a qualified mechanic.

entries.english: When it comes to vehicle repair, there are a number of different paths you can take.

entries.english: Islam is a religion that emphasizes surrender to the will of God.
entries.translation: Uislamu ni dini ambayo inatilia mkazo kujisalimisha kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender, or "Islam" in Arabic, is often misunderstood as meaning submission or defeat.
entries.translation: Dhana ya kujisalimisha, au "Uislamu" katika Kiarabu, mara nyingi hueleweka visivyo kama kujiwasilisha au kushindwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, in Islam, surrender is actually seen as a positive act, a way to achieve peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, katika Uislamu, kujisalimisha kwa kweli kunaonekana kama kitendo chanya, njia ya kuafikia amani na furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a Muslim surrenders to God, they are not giving up their own free will.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rather, they are acknowledging that God is the one who has the power to control all things, and that by surrendering to His will, they are actually finding true freedom.
entries.translation: Ila, anakiri kuwa Mungu ndiye aliye na mamlaka ya kudhibiti kila kitu, na kuwa kwa kujisalimisha kwa mapenzi yake, anapata uhuru wa kweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This concept of surrender is beautifully illustrated in the story of the Prophet Muhammad.

entries.english: When Muhammad was first called to be a prophet, he was very afraid.

entries.english: He didn't want to be responsible for spreading God's message.

entries.english: However, after much prayer and reflection, Muhammad eventually surrendered to God's will.

entries.english: He realized that it was not his own strength that would allow him to succeed, but the strength of God.

entries.english: Muhammad's story is a reminder that surrender is not about giving up.

entries.english: In a time long past, there lived a blind beggar who made his living by demonstrating the art of soil sculpting.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would sit on the street corner, surrounded by his tools and materials, and invite passersby to watch him work.
entries.translation: Angekaa katika kona ya barabara, akiwa na zana na nyenzo zake za kazi, na kuwaalika wapita njia wamtazame akifanya kazi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With his deft fingers, he would mold the soil into intricate shapes, creating animals, plants, and even entire landscapes.
entries.translation: Kwa kutumia vidole vyake hodari, angefinyanga udongo katika maumbo mbalimbali, huku akiunda wanyama, mimea, na hata mandhari yote kwa jumla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His work was so beautiful that it was said to bring tears to the eyes of even the most hardened cynic.
entries.translation: Kazi yake ilikuwa maridadi sana kiasi kwamba ilisemekana kuwafanya watu wengi kutokwa na machozi hata wale ambao hawaamini kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Amara was walking through the market when she saw the blind beggar.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanamke kijana kwa jina Amara alikuwa akitembea sokoni na kumwona mwombaji huyo kipofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was immediately captivated by his work, and she stopped to watch him for a long time.
entries.translation: Alivutiwa mara moja na kazi yake, na kusimama ili kumtazama kwa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, she approached him and asked if she could learn how to sculpt soil.
entries.translation: Alipomaliza, alimwendea na kumuuliza iwapo angejifunza kuchonga vinyagu kwa kutumia udongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beggar smiled and told her that he would be happy to teach her.
entries.translation: Mwombaji huyo alitabasamu na kumwambia kuwa angefurahia sana kumfundisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara spent the next few weeks learning from the beggar.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught her the basics of soil sculpting, and he showed her how to create different shapes and textures.
entries.translation: Alimfunza mambo ya kimsingi ya uchongaji vinyago kwa udongo, na akamwonyesha jinsi ya kuunda maumbo na unamu tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amara was a quick learner, and she soon became very skilled at the art.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
