entries.english: Vigilante justice is a term used to describe the act of taking the law into one's own hands, typically by meting out punishment to those who have been deemed to have committed crimes.
entries.translation: Kujichukulia sheria mkononi ni neno linalotumika kuelezea kitendo cha kujichukulia sheria mkononi kama mtu binafsi, kwa kawaida kwa kuwaadhibu wale ambao wameshukiwa kufanya uhalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While vigilante justice may seem like a quick and easy way to get justice, it can often lead to more problems than it solves.
entries.translation: Wakati kujichukulia sheria mkononi kunaweza kuonekana kama njia rahisi ya kupata haki, mara nyingi kunaweza kusababisha matatizo zaidi kuliko usuluhishaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest problems with vigilante justice is that it is typically not done in a fair and impartial manner.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya matatizo makubwa ya kujichukulia sheria mkononi ni kuwa kwa kawaida hakufanyiki kwa njia ya haki na isiyopendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vigilantes are often motivated by anger and emotion, which can lead them to make rash decisions and take actions that are not in the best interests of everyone involved.
entries.translation: Wanaojichukulia sheria mkononi mara nyingi huchochewa na  hasira na hisia, jambo ambalo linaweza kusababisha wafanye maamuzi ya haraka na kuchukua hatua ambazo hizipendelewi na wahusika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, vigilantes often lack the training and experience necessary to properly handle criminals.
entries.translation: Vilevile, wanaojichukulia sheria mkononi mara nyingi hawana mafunzo na tajiriba inayofaa ili kuwashughulikia wahalifu ipasavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to situations where innocent people are harmed or even killed.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kupelekea hali ambapo watu wasio na hatia wanaumizwa au hata kuuawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another problem with vigilante justice is that it can quickly spiral out of control.
entries.translation: Tatizo jingine la kujichukulia sheria mkononi ni kuwa hali inaweza kuzidi mipaka kwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When one person takes the law into their own hands, it sends a message to others that they can do the same.
entries.translation: Mtu mmoja anapojichukulia sheria mikononi, inatuma ishara kwa wengine kuwa pia nao wanaweza kufanya hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a cycle of violence and retribution that can be difficult to stop.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha misururu ya vurugu na ulipizaji kisasi ambao unaweza kuwa vigumu kukomesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the long run, vigilante justice is rarely effective in deterring crime.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, kujichukulia sheria mkononi ni njia isiyo na ufanisi katika kuzuia uhalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, it can often have the opposite effect, making criminals more likely to commit crimes in the future.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, mara nyingi inaweza kusababisha matokeo yasiyotarajiwa, kwa kuwafanya wahalifu kuwa na uwezekano zaidi wa kutekeleza uhalifu siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son, did you know that there's a new array of craters on the moon?
entries.translation: Mwanangu, unajua kuwa kuna mkusanyiko mpya wa kreta kwenye mwezi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists say that they were formed by a series of impacts from asteroids and comets.
entries.translation: Wanasayansi wanasema kuwa ziliundwa kwa msururu wa migongano kutoka kwa asteroidi na nyotamkia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The largest crater is about 100 miles across and is named after the Greek god of war, Ares.
entries.translation: Kreta kubwa zaidi ni takriban maili 100 katikati na imepewa jina la mungu wa vita wa Kigiriki, Ares.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The craters are so bright that they can be seen from Earth with the naked eye.
entries.translation: Kreta hizo zinang'aa kiasi kwamba zinaweza kuonekana kwa macho kutoka Dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They stand out against the dark surface of the moon like silver coins on a black velvet cloth.
entries.translation: Zinaonekana kwenye sehemu ya giza ya mwezi kama sarafu za fedha kwenye kitambaa cheusi cha mahameli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It makes up over 60% of our body weight and is involved in many important bodily functions, such as regulating body temperature, transporting nutrients and oxygen to cells, and removing waste products.
entries.translation: Yanachukua sehemu ya zaidi ya asilimia 60 ya uzito wa miili yetu na yanatekeleza majukumu mengi muhimu ya mwili, kama vile kudhibiti halijoto ya mwili, kusafirisha virutubishi na oksijeni kwenye seli, na kuondoa taka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Water also helps to lubricate joints and protect organs and tissues.
entries.translation: Pia maji husaidia kulainisha jointi na kulinda ogani na tishu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons why we should conserve water.
entries.translation: Kuna sababu nyingi za kuhifadhi maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One reason is that water scarcity is a growing problem around the world.
entries.translation: Sababu moja ni kuwa uhaba wa maji ni tatizo linaloongezeka duniani kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many parts of the world, people do not have access to clean water, and even in areas where water is plentiful, it is becoming increasingly scarce due to climate change.
entries.translation: Katika sehemu nyingi duniani, watu hawapati maji safi, na hata katika maeneo ambapo maji yapo kwa wingi, yanaendelea kupungua kwa sababu ya mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another reason to conserve water is that it is a valuable resource.
entries.translation: Sababu nyingine ya kuhifadhi maji ni kuwa ni rasilimali yenye thamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes a lot of energy to treat and transport water, and it is important to use water wisely so that we do not waste this precious resource.
entries.translation: Inagharimu nguvu nyingi kutibu na kusafirisha maji, na ni muhimu kutumia maji vizuri ili tusiharibu hii rasilimali muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many things we can do to conserve water.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi tunayoweza kufanya kuhifadhi maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can take shorter showers, fix leaky faucets, and water our lawns less often.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kuchukua muda mfupi bafuni, kurekebisha mifereji inayovuja, na kunyunyizia nyasi zetu maji mara chache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy products that are made with recycled water.
entries.translation: Pia tunaweza kuamua kununua bidhaa zilizotengenezwa kwa maji yaliyorejelezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making small changes in our daily lives, we can help to conserve water and ensure that this vital resource is available for future generations.
entries.translation: Kwa kufanya mabadiliko madogo katika maisha yetu ya kila siku, tunaweza kusaidia kuhifadhi maji na kuhakikisha kuwa rasilimali hii muhimu inapatikana kwa vizazi vijavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods are a natural disaster that can cause widespread damage and loss of life.
entries.translation: Mafuriko ni janga la asili linaloweza kusababisha uharibifu mkubwa na kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are often caused by heavy rainfall or snowmelt that exceeds the capacity of a river or other waterway, resulting in the overflow of water onto land.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi husababishwa na mvua kubwa na kuyeyuka kwa barafu kuzidi ukubwa wa mto au njia nyingine za maji, na kusababisha mafuriko kwenye ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also be caused by dams or levees breaking, or by tsunamis.
entries.translation: Mafuriko pia yanaweza kusababishwa na kuvunjika kwa mabwawa au kingo, au kwa tsunami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common types of floods are river floods, which occur when a river overflows its banks, and flash floods, which occur when a large amount of rain falls in a short period of time.
entries.translation: Aina kuu za mafuriko ni mafuriko ya mto, yanayotokea mto unapozidi kingo zake, na mafuriko ya ghafla, yanayotokea mvua kubwa inaponyesha kwa muda mfupi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can also occur in coastal areas due to storm surges, which are large waves that are pushed inland by strong winds.
entries.translation: Pia mafuriko yanaweza kutokea katika maeneo ya pwani kutokana na mawimbi ya dhoruba, ambayo ni mawimbi makubwa yanayosukumwa kwenye ardhi na upepo mkali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Floods can cause a wide range of damage, including loss of life, property damage, and environmental damage.
entries.translation: Mafuriko yanaweza kusababisha uharibifu mbalimbali, ikiwemo vifo, uharibifu wa mali, na uharibifu wa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also disrupt transportation and communication, and lead to food and water shortages.
entries.translation: Pia yanaweza kukatiza uchukuzi na mawasiliano, na kusababisha uhaba wa chakula na maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The resulting loss of homes and livelihoods can force people to relocate, which can lead to social and economic problems.
entries.translation: Uharibifu wa makazi na riziki utakaofuatia unaweza kulazimisha watu kuhama, jambo ambalo linaweza kusababisha matatizo ya kijamii na kiuchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our archive contains over 100 million records, including census records, birth records, death records, and marriage records.
entries.translation: Hifadhi yetu ina zaidi ya rekodi milioni 100, zikiwemo rekodi za hesabu ya idadi ya watu, rekodi za kuzaliwa, rekodi za vifo, na rekodi za ndoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also have a large collection of family group sheets and manuscripts.
entries.translation: Pia tuna mkusanyiko mkubwa wa laha na hati za makundi ya   familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To search for your ancestors, you can use our surname search tool.
entries.translation: Kutafuta mababu zako, unaweza kutumia zana yetu ya utafutaji wa jina la ukoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tool allows you to search by surname, first name, and date of birth.
entries.translation: Zana hii itakuwezesha kutafuta kwa jina la ukoo, jina la kwanza, na tarehe ya kuzaliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also search by location.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found your ancestors, you can view their records.
entries.translation: Baada ya kuwapata mababu zako, unaweza kutazama rekodi zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also print copies of their records.
entries.translation: Pia unaweza kuchapisha nakala za rekodi zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also offer a subscription service that allows you to access our entire archive.
entries.translation: Pia tunatoa huduma ya usajili inayokuwezesha kufikia hifadhi yetu nzima ya kumbukumbu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This service is perfect for genealogists who are looking for a comprehensive collection of records.
entries.translation: Huduma hii ni bora kwa wataalamu wa nasaba wanaotafuta mkusanyiko wa kina wa rekodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about our archive or our surname search tool, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Iwapo una maswali yoyote kuhusu hifadhi yetu ya kumbukumbu au zana yetu ya utafutaji kwa jina la ukoo, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to help you find your ancestors.
entries.translation: Tupo hapa ili kukusaidia kupata mababu zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Juan who loved tacos.
entries.translation: Hapo zama za kale, paliishi mvulana mdogo kwa jina Juan aliyependa sana takosi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He loved them so much that he would eat them for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
entries.translation: Alizipenda sana kiasi kwamba angezila wakati wa kiamsha kinywa, cha mchana, na chajio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Juan's mother decided to make him a special taco.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mamake Juan aliamua kumtengenezea takosi spesheli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She filled it with all of his favorite ingredients: ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.
entries.translation: Alitayarisha kwa viungo vyote alivyovipenda Juan: nyama ya ng'ombe, saladi, nyanya, jibini, na krimu ya mtindi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan was so excited for his taco that he could barely wait to eat it.
entries.translation: Juan alifurahia sana takosi yake kiasi kwamba alikuwa na hamu sana ya kuila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Juan finally took a bite of his taco, he was amazed at how delicious it was.
entries.translation: Hatimaye Juan alipouma takosi yake, alistaajabishwa na jinsi ambavyo ilikuwa tamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors of the meat, vegetables, and cheese all combined perfectly to create a taste that Juan had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Ladha ya nyama, mboga, na jibini vyote vilikuwa vimechanganywa vizuri kuleta utamu ambao Juan hakuwa ameonja awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate every bite of his taco, and then he asked his mother to make him another one.
entries.translation: Alikula takosi yake yote, na kisha akamwomba mama yake amtayarishie nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan's mother was happy to make him another taco, and she even let him help her in the kitchen.
entries.translation: Mama yake Juan alifurahia kumtengenezea takosi nyingine, na hata akamruhusu amsaidie jikoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan learned how to measure the ingredients, how to cook the meat, and how to assemble the tacos.
entries.translation: Juan alijifunza kupima viungo, kupika nyama, na kutengeneza takosi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had so much fun helping his mother that he decided that he wanted to be a chef when he grew up.
entries.translation: Alifurahia sana kumsaidia mama yake kiasi kwamba aliamua angekuwa mpishi akiwa mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juan continued to love tacos throughout his childhood.
entries.translation: Juan aliendelea kupenda takosi katika maisha yake yote ya utotoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ate them at home, at school, and at restaurants.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The federal government is considering adding a new species of colorful fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Serikali ya kitaifa inapanga kuongeza spishi mpya ya samaki wa rangi kwenye orodha ya spishi zilizolindwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fish, known as the "rainbow mouth" fish, is found only in a small area of the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Samaki, anayefahamika kama samaki wa "mdomo wa upinde wa mvua", anapatikana tu katika eneo dogo la Bahari ya Pasifiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is named for its bright colors and distinctive mouth, which is shaped like a rainbow.
entries.translation: Amepewa jina hilo kutokana na zake angavu na mdomo wa kipekee, wenye umbo la upinde wa mvua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The members of the Fish and Wildlife Service are divided on whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Wanachama wa Huduma ya Samaki na Wanyamapori wametofautiana kuhusu iwapo wataongeza samaki wa mdomo wa upinde wa mvua kwenye orodha ya spishi zilizolindwa au la.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some members argue that the fish is not in danger of extinction and does not need federal protection.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya wanachama wanasema kuwa samaki hao hawapo katika hatari ya kupotea na kwa hivyo hawahitaji ulinzi wa shirikisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others argue that the fish is unique and should be protected from overfishing.
entries.translation: Wengine wanasema kuwa samaki huyo ni wa kipekee na anafaa kulindwa dhidi ya uvuvi wa kupita kiasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The decision of whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species is likely to be a difficult one.
entries.translation: Huenda uamuazi wa iwapo wataongeza samaki wa mdomo wa upinde wa mvua kwenye orodha ya spishi zilizolindwa au la ukawa mgumu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the warmth of the blanket seeping into your body, and let your muscles relax.
entries.translation: Hisi joto la blanketi likiingia mwilini mwako, na uwache misuli yako itulie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Close your eyes and take a deep breath.
entries.translation: Fumba macho yako na uvute pumzi nzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
entries.translation: Vuta pumzi kupitia puani na uiachilie kupitia kinywani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repeat this several times, letting your mind clear and your body become still.
entries.translation: Rudia hatua hii mara kadhaa, huku ukiacha fikra zako ziwe safi na mwili wako kutulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As you relax, imagine yourself in a beautiful place.
entries.translation: Unapoendelea kutulia, jione ukiwa mahali maridadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It could be a beach, a forest, or a mountaintop.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuwa ufuoni, msituni, au kwenye kilele cha mlima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever place you choose, make it a place where you feel happy and at peace.
entries.translation: Mahali popote utakapochagua, hakikisha ni mahali utakapojihisi  mwenye furaha na amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: See the sights, hear the sounds, and smell the smells of your chosen place.
entries.translation: Tazama mandhari, sikiliza sauti, na upumue harufu ya mahali ulipochagua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the sun on your skin and the breeze in your hair.
entries.translation: Hisi jua kwenye ngozi yako na upepo mwororo katika nywele zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let yourself relax in this place for as long as you like.
entries.translation: Jitulize katika eneo hili kadri upendavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to return to the present, take a few deep breaths and open your eyes.
entries.translation: Ukiwa tayari kurudi katika hali ya sasa, vuta pumzi chache nzito  na ufumbue macho yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll feel refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to take on the day.
entries.translation: Utahisi kuburudishwa na kupata nguvu, tayari kuanza siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is just one example of a relaxation technique that you can use to relieve stress and improve your overall well-being.
entries.translation: Huu ni mfano mmoja tu wa mbinu ya mapumziko unayoweza kutumia kutuliza msongo wa mawazo na kuboresha hali njema yako kwa jumla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other relaxation techniques available, so find one that works for you and make it a part of your daily routine.
entries.translation: Kuna mbinu zingine nyingi za mapumziko, kwa hivyo tafuta moja inayokufaa na uiweke katika utaratibu wako wa kila siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to relax on command, whenever you need to.
entries.translation: Kwa mazoezi kidogo, utaweza kupumzika kwa hiari, kila unapotaka kufanya hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kukumbuka kuwa mashambulizi ya mbwa ni nadra, na kuwa mbwa wengi ni wasikivu na ni viumbe wenye upendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna hali fulani zinazoweza kuongeza hatari ya kushambuliwa na mbwa, kama vile iwapo mbwa hajapata mafunzo ipasavyo, iwapo anahisi kutishwa, au iwapo amefungiwa katika sehemu moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
entries.translation: Katika kisa cha hivi majuzi ambapo nyanya mmoja aliuawa, inaonekana kuwa mbwa huyo hakuwa amepata mafunzo ipasavyo na kwamba alihisi kutishwa na uwepo wa nyanya huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
entries.translation: Mbwa huyo alikuwa aina kubwa wenye nguvu aliyekuwa ameasiliwa miezi michache tu kabla ya shambulio hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
entries.translation: Nyanya huyo alikuwa amemtembelea mwanawe na familia yake, na alikuwa ameketi kwenye kochi mbwa huyo alipomshambulia ghafla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
entries.translation: Mbwa huyo alimuuma mara kadhaa kichwani na shingoni, na akaaga papo hapo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
entries.translation: Mmiliki wa mbwa huyo alisema kuwa hakuwa na historia yoyote kuhusu ushambulizi wa mbwa huyo, na kuwa anaamini shambulizi hilo lilitokana na kusonga kwa ghafla kwa nyanya huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kukumbuka kuwa hata mbwa waliopata mafunzo ipasavyo wanaweza kushambulia iwapo hawatangamani na watu inavyofaa au iwapo wanahisi kutishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
entries.translation: Tukio hili la kusikitisha liliangazia umuhimu wa umiliki makini wa mbwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.
entries.translation: Hamid Al-fitr, msimulizi maarufu wa hadithi, anasimulia kuhusu wakati alijeruhiwa kwenye vita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.
entries.translation: "Nilikuwa kijana, nikiwa makurutu tu, niliposhuhudia vita kwa mara ya kwanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fighting was fierce, and I was quickly overwhelmed.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilikuwa vikali sana, na nililemewa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.
entries.translation: Nilipigwa konde la kichwani, na nikaanguka chini, nikitokwa na  damu na kuchanganyikiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nimelala hapo, niliwaza kuhusu maisha yangu na jinsi yanavyoweza kukatika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.
entries.translation: Nilifikiria kuhusu familia na marafiki zangu, na jinsi watakavyonikosa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.
entries.translation: Pia niliwaza kuhusu cheo nilichokuwa nikitamani kupata, na jinsi isingewezekana sasa kufanikisha ndoto hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.
entries.translation: Nilifumba macho yangu na kujitayarisha kwa kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then, I heard a voice.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the voice of an old man, and he was saying, "Don't give up.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa sauti ya mzee, na alikuwa akisema, "Usikate tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not done yet" I opened my eyes and saw the old man standing over me.
entries.translation: Hujamaliza bado" nilifumbua macho yangu na nikamwona mzee mmoja amesimama kando yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a healer, and he had come to help me.
entries.translation: Alikuwa tabibu, na alikuwa amekuja kunisaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He treated my wounds, and he gave me some words of encouragement:
entries.translation: Alitibu vidonda vyangu, na akaniambia maneno ya kunitia moyo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let this injury define you,' he said.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're still a warrior, and you still have a lot to offer the world.
entries.translation: "Bado wewe ni shujaa, na bado una mengi ya kutimiza duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Health and fitness are important for feeling your best and living a long, happy life.
entries.translation: Afya na utimamu wa mwili ni muhimu kwa kuhisi vyema na kuishi maisha marefu na yenye furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you maintain a healthy weight, reduce your risk of chronic diseases, and improve your mood and energy levels.
entries.translation: Mlo bora na mazoezi ya mara kwa mara yanaweza kukusaidia kudumisha uzito unaofaa kiafya, kupunguza hatari ya magonjwa sugu, na kuboresha viwango vyako vya hisia na nguvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eating a healthy diet means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
entries.translation: Kula bora kiafya inamaanisha ulaji wa matunda, mboga na nafaka kwa wingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also means limiting unhealthy fats, processed foods, and sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Pia inamaanisha kupunguza mafuta yasiyofaa, vyakula vya kusindikwa, na vinywaji vyenye sukari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular exercise can include activities such as walking, running, swimming, biking, or dancing.
entries.translation: Mazoezi ya mara kwa mara yanaweza kujumuisha shughuli kama kutembea, kukimbia, kuogelea, kuendesha baskeli, au kucheza densi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kupata angalau dakika 150 za kufanya mazoezi wastani ya shughuli ya aerobiki au dakika 75 za shughuli ya aerobiki ya yenye nguvu kila wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also do muscle-strengthening activities at least twice a week.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kufanya shughuli za kuimarisha misuli angalau mara mbili kwa wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you make healthy choices for your health and fitness, you are not only improving your own life, but you are also setting a positive example for others.
entries.translation: Unapofanya maamuzi mazuri kwa ajili ya afya na utimamu wako wa mwili, huboreshi tu maisha yako pakee, lakini pia unaweka mfano bora kwa wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making healthy choices, you are helping to create a healthier community and a healthier world.
entries.translation: Kwa kufanya maamuzi mazuri kiafya, unasaidia kujenga jamii yenye afya na dunia yenye afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most recent major news event in Eritrea was the 2018 Eritrean–Ethiopian peace agreement.
entries.translation: Tukio kuu la habari za hivi karibuni nchini Eritrea lilikuwa makubaliano ya amani ya Eritrea na Ethiopia mwaka wa 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This agreement ended a 20-year war between the two countries and resulted in the reopening of borders and the resumption of trade.
entries.translation: Makubaliano haya yalisitisha vita vya miaka 20 kati ya nchi hizo mbili na kusababisha kufunguliwa upya kwa mipaka na kurejea   kwa biashara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a significant step forward for regional stability and peace.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa hatua muhimu kwa ustawi na amani ya eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another recent development is the 2019 Eritrean presidential election.
entries.translation: Tukio jingine la hivi karibuni lilikuwa uchaguzi wa urais wa Eritrea mwaka wa 2019.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isaias Afwerki, who has been president of Eritrea since 1993, was re-elected for a fifth term with 99% of the vote.
entries.translation: Isaias Afwerki, ambaye amekuwa raisi wa Eritrea tangu 1993, alichaguliwa tena kwa awamu ya tano kwa asilimia 99 ya kura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The election was widely criticized by international observers as not being free or fair.
entries.translation: Uchaguzi huo ulikosolewa pakabuwa na waangalizi wa kimataifa kuwa haukuwa wa huru na haki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to these major events, there have also been a number of smaller news stories in Eritrea over the past few years.
entries.translation: Pamoja na matukio haya makubwa, pia kumekuwa na habari ndogo ndogo Eritrea kwa miaka michache iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include the 2016 closure of the United Nations office in Eritrea, the 2017 release of several political prisoners, and the 2018 visit of Pope Francis to the country.
entries.translation: Hizi zinajumuisha kufungwa kwa ofisi ya Umoja wa Mataifa nchini Eritrea mwaka wa 2016, kuachiliwa huru kwa wafungwa mbalimbali wa kisiasa mwaka wa 2017, na ziara ya Papa Francis katika nchi hiyo mwaka wa 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the past few years have been a period of relative stability and progress for Eritrea.
entries.translation: Kwa jumla, katika miaka michache iliyopita imekuwa kipindi cha utulivu kiasi na maendeleo kwa Eritrea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has made significant steps towards peace and reconciliation with its neighbors, and there have been some positive developments on the human rights front.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyo imepiga hatua muhimu katika masuala ya amani na uwiano na jirani zake, na kumekuwa na maendeleo katika masuala ya haki za binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The distribution of beauty services and spas is changing, with a growing number of men seeking out these services.
entries.translation: Utoaji wa huduma za urembo na spa unabadilika, idadi ya  wanaume wanaotafuta huduma hizi ikiongezeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the United States, the number of male spa-goers has increased by 30% in the past five years, and men now account for 20% of all spa visits.
entries.translation: Nchini Marekani, idadi ya wanaume wanaoenda kwenye spa imeongezeka kwa asilimia 30 katika miaka mitano iliyopita, na sasa wanaume wamefikia asilimia 20 ya watu wote wanaoenda kwenye spa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the demand for male beauty services grows, spas are starting to cater more specifically to men's needs.
entries.translation: Mahitaji ya bidhaa za urembo wa wanaume yanavyoongezeka, spa zimeanza kushughulikia zaidi hususan mahitaji ya wanaume.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes offering a wider range of services, such as beard trims and massages, as well as creating a more masculine environment.
entries.translation: Hii ni ikiwemo utoaji wa huduma mbalimbali, kama vile uchongaji wa ndevu na ukandwaji wa mwili, na pia uundwaji wa mazingira ya wanaume.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some spas are even offering men-only days or hours, so that men can feel comfortable getting pampered without feeling self-conscious.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya spa hata zimetenga siku au saa za huduma za wanaume pekee, ili wanaume wajihisi huru kudekezwa bila kuwa na wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The growth of the male beauty market is a sign of a changing attitude towards men's grooming.
entries.translation: Ukuaji wa soko la mapambo ya wanaume ni ishara ya kubadilika kwa mtazamo wa kujipamba kwa wanaume.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.
entries.translation: Robini mdogo jasiri alikuwa akipaa kwenye msitu alipoona kikundi cha ndege waliaokuwa wamekusanyika kwenye mti mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.
entries.translation: Alitua kwenye tawi lililokuwa karibu na kusikiliza walichokuwa wakisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.
entries.translation: "Tumekuwa tukiufanyia mtu huu uchunguzi kwa wiki kadhaa, " kunguru alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.
entries.translation: "Hatujui kinachoufanya uiname kwa njia ya hatari hivi!" shomoro mdogo alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.
entries.translation: "Lakini tunahofia kuwa utaanguka na kumuumiza mtu!" tai alilia.

entries.english: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.
entries.translation: Robini aliangalia mti huo na akaona kwa kweli ulikuwa umeinama kabisa upande mmoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, an idea came to him.

entries.english: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.

entries.english: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.
entries.translation: Ndege waliokuwa chini walitazama kwa mshangao robini alivyokuwa akifanya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.
entries.translation: Hawakuamini kuwa ndege mdogo kama yule angekuwa na nguvu nyingi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.
entries.translation: Baada ya saa chache, robini alikuwa amejaza shimo hilo kikamilifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was now standing upright and stable.
entries.translation: Mti huo sasa ulikuwa umesimama wima na imara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.
entries.translation: Ndege wengine walishangilia na kumshukuru robini kwa kutoa suluhisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
entries.translation: Dunia imekuwa tofauti sana kuliko ilivyokuwa miongo michache iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.
entries.translation: Utaifa umekita katika nchi nyingi, na watu wamegawanyika zaidi kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.
entries.translation: Katika nchi moja, kikundi cha utaifa kimechukua serikali na sasa kinatumia mamlaka yake kukandamiza upinzani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.
entries.translation: Kimepiga marufuku aina zote za vyombo vya habari ambavyo vinaonekana kuwa visivyo vya "kizalendo" na kimewakamata na hata kuwauwa watu wanaopinga serikali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanamke kijana kwa jina Rebecca anaelekea nyumbani kutoka shuleni na kusimamishwa na kikundi cha askari wa kitaifa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.
entries.translation: Wanamsingizia kuwa msaliti, na kumpeleka kwenye jela ya siri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.
entries.translation: Rebbecca anateswa na kuhojiwa, lakini anakataa kutoa taarifa yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.
entries.translation: Baada ya wiki kadhaa, hatimaye Rebecca anaachiliwa kutoka jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.
entries.translation: Ni mdhaifu na mwenye utapiamlo, lakini amekata shauri kuwakabili wazalendo hao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.
entries.translation: Anajiunga na vuguvugu la upinzani, na kuwa mtu muhimu sana katika kusudi lao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.
entries.translation: Rebecca anatumia maarifa yake ya teknolojia kusaidia upinzani kuwasiliana na kupanga mashambulizi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.
entries.translation: Pia anatumia ujuzi wake kama mdukuzi kuingia kwenye kompyuta za  wazalendo na kuiba data yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vast archives of military photos have been digitized and made available online, allowing researchers to study them from anywhere in the world.
entries.translation: Hifadhi kubwa ya picha za kijeshi imefanywa dijitali na inapatikana mtandaoni, hivi kuwawezesha watafiti kuzichunguza kutoka mahali popote duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a number of new discoveries, as researchers are able to compare photos from different sources and identify previously unknown individuals.
entries.translation: Hii imepelekea ugunduzi mpya, kwani watafiti wanaweza kulinganisha picha kutoka kwenye vyanzo tofauti na kutambua watu wa awali wasiojulikana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one case, researchers were able to identify a soldier who had been missing for over 70 years using photos from a military archive.
entries.translation: Katika hali moja, watafiti waliweza kumtambua mwanajeshi aliyekuwa amepotea kwa zaidi ya miaka 70 kwa kutumia picha kutoka kwenye hifadhi ya kijeshi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soldier's family was overjoyed to finally learn what had happened to him, and they were able to hold a proper funeral for him.
entries.translation: Familia ya mwanajeshi huyo ilifurahia na hatimaye ikajifunza kilichokuwa kimemfanyikia, na iliweza kumuandalia matanga kamili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
entries.translation: Ushairi ni lugha ya ulimwengu wote inayozidi saa na eneo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
entries.translation: Inaweza kutumika kuonyesha hisia, kusimulia hadithi, na kuchunguza hoja ngumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
entries.translation: Kama mfasiri, nina fursa ya kusaidia kuleta ushairi kwa hadhira mpya kwa kuufasiri katika lugha nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
entries.translation: Hii ni kazi yenye changamoto lakini yenye faida, kwani sifai kuwasilisha maana ya kawaida ya shairi tu, bali pia urembo na nguvu zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu ya kuzingatia unapotafsiri shairi ni mdundo na vina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
entries.translation: Vipengele hivi ni muhimu kwa athari ya jumla ya shairi, na vinaweza kuwa vigumu kufasiriwa katika lugha nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
entries.translation: Katika hali fulani, naweza kuhitajika kurekebisha mdundo na vina kiasi ili kufanya shairi litiririke kwa uhalisia zaidi katika lugha lengwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, mimi hutahadhari sana kuhifadhi maana na kusudi asili la shairi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
entries.translation: Zingatio lingine muhimu ni kutumia lugha ya kitamathali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi malenga hutumia sitiari, mifano, na tamathali nyingine za usemi kuunda mifano iliyo wazi na kuongeza ubora kwenye kazi zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
entries.translation: Ninapotafsiri vipengele hivi, lazima nipate maneno yanayolingana katika lugha lengwa ambayo yatakuwa na athari sawa kwa msomaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls and doll accessories are a popular way for children to play and learn.
entries.translation: Wanasesere na vifaa vya wanasesere ni njia maarufu ya watoto kucheza na kujifunza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls can represent people, animals, or even imaginary creatures.
entries.translation: Wanasesere wanaweza kuwa mfano wa watu, wanyama, au hata viumbe bandia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be dressed up in different clothes, given different furniture to play with, and placed in different settings.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kuvalishwa nguo tofauti, kupewa samani tofauti za kuchezea, na kuwekwa katika mandhari tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children can use dolls to act out stories, explore different roles, and learn about the world around them.
entries.translation: Watoto wanaweza kutumia wanasesere kuigiza hadithi, kujaribu majukumu tofauti, na kujifunza kuhusu dunia inayowazunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a child might use a doll to pretend to be a doctor, a teacher, or a firefighter.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, mtoto anaweza kutumia mwanasesere kujifanya kuwa daktari, mwalimu, au mzima moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not just about what you wear, but how you wear it.
entries.translation: Siyo tu unachovaa, bali jinsi unavyokivaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're always slouching and your clothes are rumpled, it shows that you don't care about yourself.
entries.translation: Ikiwa kila mara unazembea na nguo zako zimekunjana, inaonyesha kuwa hujijali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People will notice and they'll make assumptions about you.
entries.translation: Watu watagundua na watakuwa na udhanifu fulani kukuhusu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might think that you're lazy or unkempt.
entries.translation: Huenda wakafikiria kuwa wewe ni mzembe au mchafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might even think that you're not a good person.
entries.translation: Hata wanaweza kufikiria kuwa wewe siyo mtu mzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are times when we all wear shabby clothes.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, kuna wakati ambapo sote tunavalia nguo chakavu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maybe we're just running errands or we're doing chores around the house.
entries.translation: Labda tunafanya shughuli za kawaida za hapa na pale au tunafanya kazi za nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But if you find yourself wearing shabby clothes all the time, it's time to take a look at yourself.
entries.translation: Lakini ukijipata ukivalia nguo chakavu wakati wote, ni wakati wa kujichunguza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you really happy with the way you look?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If not, then it's time to make a change.
entries.translation: Iwapo hapana, ni wakati wa kufanya mabadiliko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start by taking some time to think about your personal style.
entries.translation: Anza kwa kuchukua muda wa kufikiria kuhusu mtindo wako wa kibinafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What kind of clothes do you feel good in?
entries.translation: Je, ni aina gani ya nguo unazofurahia?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What kind of clothes make you feel confident?
entries.translation: Ni aina gani ya nguo inayokufanya ujihisi jasiri?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you like, start shopping for clothes that fit your personality.
entries.translation: Pindi unapojua unachokipenda, anza kufanya ununuzi wa nguo zinazokidhi utu wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also important to make sure that your clothes are clean and well-fitting.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kuhakikisha kuwa nguo zako ni safi na zinakutoshea vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If they're rumpled or stained, it will only make you look worse.
entries.translation: Iwapo zimekunjana au chafu, zitakufanya tu uonekane vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Take the time to iron your clothes and make sure they fit properly.
entries.translation: Chukua muda wa kupiga nguo zako pasi na kuhakikisha kuwa zinakutoshea vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to experiment with different styles.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might be surprised at what you find.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are so many different ways to dress, so don't be afraid to try new things.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti za kuvaa, kwa hivyo usiogope kujaribu vitu vipya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you experiment, the more likely you are to find a style that you love.
entries.translation: Kadri unavyojaribu, ndivyo utakavyokuwa na uwezekano wa kupata mtindo utakaoupenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you dress well, it shows that you take pride in yourself.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also makes you feel more confident.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a way to boost your self-confidence, start by taking a look at your wardrobe.
entries.translation: Kwa hivyo iwapo unatafuta njia ya kuboresha ujasiri wako, anza kwa kuchunguza kabati lako la nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few new clothes can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Nguo chache mpya zinaweza kuleta mabadiliko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is a country with a rich and diverse culture, and its traditional customs are a major part of that.
entries.translation: Ghana ni nchi yenye tamaduni tele tofauti, na desturi zake za  kitamaduni wake ni sehemu kubwa ya tamaduni hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important customs is the naming ceremony, which is held for a newborn child.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya desturi muhimu zaidi ni sherehe ya utoaji majina, inayofanyiwa mtoto mzawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically presided over by a traditional priest or elder, and it involves the naming of the child, as well as prayers and blessings for the child's future.
entries.translation: Sherehe hii huongozwa na kuhani wa jadi au mzee, na huhusisha mtoto kupewa jina, na pia maombi na baraka kwa maisha ya mtoto huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important custom is the funeral ceremony, which is held for a deceased person.
entries.translation: Desturi nyingine muhimu ni mazishi, inayofanyiwa maiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically very elaborate and involves music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Sherehe hii huwa kubwa na huwa na muziki, densi, na vyakula.

entries.english: The deceased person is typically buried with their belongings, and a shrine is often built in their honor.

entries.english: Ghana is also home to a number of traditional festivals, such as the Odwira festival, which is held in the Ashanti region.
entries.translation: Ghana pia ina tamasha kadhaa za utamaduni, kama vile tamasha ya Odwira, inayofanyika katika eneo la Ashanti.

entries.english: The festival is a time for celebration and thanksgiving, and it involves traditional music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Tamasha hii wakati wa kusherehekea na kutoa shukrani, na huwa na muziki, densi, na vyakula vya kitamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, some traditional customs in Ghana have been adapted to modern life.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, baadhi ya destruri za utamaduni nchini Ghana zimechukuliwa kwa maisha ya kisasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some naming ceremonies now include electronic devices such as computers and projectors.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, baadhi ya sherehe za utoaji majina sasa zina vifaa vya kielektroniki kama vile kompyuta na projecta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows for the ceremony to be more interactive and engaging for the participants.
entries.translation: Hii huwezeshaa sherehe hiyo kuwa na mwingiliano na yenye kuhusisha washiriki zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, traditional customs in Ghana are a major part of the country's culture, and they continue to be practiced today.
entries.translation: Kwa jumla, desturi za kitamaduni nchini Ghana ni sehemu kubwa ya utamaduni wa nchi hiyo, na zinaendelea kufanyika hadi leo.

entries.english: He smoked a pack of cigarettes a day, and he had been doing so for over 20 years.

entries.english: He knew that smoking was bad for his health, but he couldn't seem to quit.

entries.english: One day, Klaus was walking down the street when he saw a strange man.

entries.english: The man was wearing a long white coat and had a strange device in his hand.
entries.translation: Mwanamume huyo alikuwa amevalia koti refu jeupe na alikuwa na kifaa cha ajabu mkononi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me," Klaus said. "What are you doing?"

entries.english: "I'm a scientist," the man said. "I'm working on a new device that will help people quit smoking."
entries.translation: "Mimi ni mwanasayansi," mwanamume huyo alisema. "Ninashughulikia kifaa kipya kinachoweza kuwasaidia watu kuacha kuvuta sigara."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "This device will send you to another space where you will be able to see the effects of smoking on your health."
entries.translation: "Kifaa hiki kitakuelekeza katika hali nyingine ambapo utaweza kuona athari za uvutaji sigara kwa afya yako."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That sounds incredible," Klaus said. "I'd like to try it."

entries.english: The man smiled. "Very well," he said. "Just step into this device and I'll start the process."
entries.translation: Mwanamume huyo alitabasamu. "Vizuri sana," alisema. "Ingia tu kwenye kifaa hiki na nitaanza mchakato huo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus stepped into the device and the man closed the door behind him.
entries.translation: Klaus aliingia kwenye kifaa hicho na mwanamume huyo akafunga mlango.

entries.english: It was a beautiful day for a picnic, so my family and I decided to go to the park.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We packed a lunch and set out early in the morning.

entries.english: When we got to the park, we found a nice spot to spread out our blanket and eat our lunch.
entries.translation: Tulipofika mbugani, tulipata eneo zuri la kutandika blanketi yetu na kula chakula chetu cha mchana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had sandwiches, chips, fruit, and cookies.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we ate, we played some games and just enjoyed spending time together.
entries.translation: Baada ya kula, tulicheza michezo kiasi na kufurahia tu kuwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We didn't think about anything except having fun.
entries.translation: Hatukufikiria kuhusu kitu chochote isipokuwa kufurahia.

entries.english: This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a central location in Lisbon.
entries.translation: Hoteli hii ni bora kwa wanaotafuta mahali pa kati mjini Lisbon.

entries.english: It is located just a short walk from the city center and the waterfront, and it offers stunning views of the port.
entries.translation: Iko hatua chache tu kutoka katikati mwa jiji na kwenye ukingo wa habari, na inawezesha mwonekano murua kabisa wa bandari.
