entries.english: The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
entries.translation: Vyumba vyake ni vikubwa na vimepangwa vizuri, na wafanyakazi wake ni wakarimu na wenye usaidizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hotel is also very quiet, which is ideal for those who want to get a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Pia hoteli hiyo ni tulivu sana, ambayo ni bora kwa wanaotaka kupata usingizi mnono usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are soundproofed, and the hotel is located in a quiet area away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
entries.translation: Vyumba havipenyezi sauti, na hoteli iko katika eneo tulivu mbali na shughuli na kelele za katikati mwa jiji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Urejelezaji ni mchakato muhimu unaosaidia kulinda mazingira na kuhifadhi maliasili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
entries.translation: Kwa kurejeleza, tunaweza kupunguza kiwango cha taka inayoenda katika mashimo na tanuri, kuhifadhi nishati, na kuokoa pesa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Mchakato wa kurejeleza huanzia kwa ukusanyaji wa nyenzo za kurejelezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
entries.translation: Kisha nyenzo hizi zinapangwa na kutengenezwa kuwa nyenzo ghafi zinazoweza kutumika kutengeneza bidhaa mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, chupa za plastiki zinaweza kurejelezwa kuwa chupa mpya za plastiki, mikebe ya aluminiamu inaweza kurejelezwa hadi mikebe mipya ya aluminiamu, na karatasi inaweza kurejelezwa kuwa bidhaa mpya za karatasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Husaidia kupunguza kiwango cha taka inayoenda kwenye mashimo na tanuri, jambo linaloweza kusaidia kulinda mazingira na kuhifadhi maliasili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
entries.translation: Urejelezaji pia huhifadhi nishati, kwa kuwa hutumia nishati kidogo kuzalisha bidhaa kutoka kwa nyenzo zilizorejelezwa kuliko inavyochukua kwa nyenzo ghafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
entries.translation: Pia, urejelezaji unaweza kuokoa pesa, kwa kuwa unaweza kupunguza hitaji la kuopoa na kusafisha nyenzo ghafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
entries.translation: Uzinduzi wa programu mpya za urejelezaji katika nchi nyingi umeondoa mfumo wa urejelezaji wa msimbo wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu programu mpya zimebuniwa kukubali nyenzo zote za kurejelezwa, licha ya rangi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Pia programu hizo mpya ni za ufanisi zaidi, kwa kuwa zinatumia mifumo otomatiki ya kuchagua kusafisha nyenzo zinazorejelezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.
entries.translation: Niliyapanga kwenye chupa ya kutilia maua na nikayaweka mezani karibu na kitanda chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.
entries.translation: Nilitabasamu pia. "Karibu." Niliketi karibu na kitanda chake na kumshika mkono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.
entries.translation: Aliniangalia kwa macho yake makubwa, ya kahawia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.

entries.english: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cork flooring is a popular choice for many homeowners because it is durable, stylish, and easy to maintain.
entries.translation: Sakafu ya vigae vya maganda ya mti ni chaguo maarufu kwa wamiliki wengi wa nyumba kwa sababu vinadumu, ni vya kimtindo, na ni rahisi kudumisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to know how to properly care for cork flooring in order to extend its lifespan and keep it looking its best.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kufahamu jinsi ya kutunza sakafu ya vigae vya maganda ya mti ili kurefusha muda wa matumizi yake na kuendelea kuonekana bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for your cork flooring is to sweep, dust, or vacuum it regularly.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu muhimu zaidi vya kufanya ili kutunza sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti ni kufagia, kuondoa vumbi au kuvisafisha kwa mashine ya kuvuta vumbi mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove dirt and debris that can build up on the surface of the flooring and cause it to become damaged.
entries.translation: Hii itasaidia kuondoa uchafu na vifusi vinavyoweza kujikusanya kwenye sakafu na kuiharibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have pets, it is especially important to vacuum your cork flooring regularly to remove pet hair and dander.
entries.translation: Iwapo una wanyama vipenzi, ni muhimu sana kuvuta vumbi kila mara kwenye sakafu yako ya vifae vya maganda ya mti ili kuondoa manyoya na mba ya wanyama vipenzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to sweeping, dusting, or vacuuming, you should also occasionally wipe your cork flooring with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Pamoja na kufagia, kuondoa vumbi, au kuvuta vumbi kwa mashine, pia unafaa kupangusa sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti mara kwa mara kwa deki ya unyevunyevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove any dirt or grime that has been missed by the vacuum cleaner.
entries.translation: Hii itasaidia kuondoa uchafu au masizi yaliyobakia baada ya kutumia mashine ya kuvuta vumbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to use a damp mop and not a wet mop, as too much water can damage the cork flooring.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kutumia deki ya unyevunyevu na siyo deki ya majimaji, kwa kuwa maji mengi yanaweza kuharibu sakafu ya vigae vya maganda ya mti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any spills on your cork flooring, it is important to clean them up as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Iwapo kitu chochote kimemwagikia sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti, ni muhimu kukisafisha haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use a clean cloth to blot up the spill and then wipe the area with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Tumia kitambaa safi kukausha kitu kilichomwagika na kisha upanguse eneo hilo kwa deki ya unyevunyevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the spill is sticky, you may need to use a mild detergent to clean it up.
entries.translation: Iwapo kilichomwagika ni cha mnato, unaweza kuhitaji kutumia sabuni kiasi kusafisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to protect your cork flooring from scratches and dents.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kukinga sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti kutokana na mikwaruzo au mibonyeo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, you can place felt pads under furniture legs and avoid dragging heavy objects across the floor.
entries.translation: Ili kufanya hivyo, unaweza kuweka pedi za kushika chini ya miguu ya samani na kuepuka kuburuta vifaa vizito kwenye sakafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using sharp objects on your cork flooring, as this can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kuepuka kutumia vifaa vyenye ncha kali kwenye sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti, kwani vinaweza kuharibu sakafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to keep your cork flooring looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Kwa kufuata vidokezo hivi, unaweza kusaidia kufanya sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti kuonekana bora zaidi kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the tips above, there are a few other things you can do to care for your cork flooring.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya vidokezo vilivyo hapo juu, kuna mambo mengine machache unayoweza kufanya ili kutunza sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, avoid using harsh chemicals on your cork flooring, as these can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Kwanza, epuka kutumia kemikali kali kwenye sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti, kwa kuwa inaweza kuharibu sakafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, do not expose your cork flooring to direct sunlight for long periods of time, as this can cause the color to fade.
entries.translation: Pili, usiruhusu miale ya moja kwa moja ya jua kufikia sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti kwa muda mrefu, kwa kuwa hii inaweza kusababisha rangi kufifia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, if you are planning to move your furniture around, be careful not to drag it across the floor, as this can also damage the surface.
entries.translation: Mwisho, iwapo unapanga kuhamisha samani yako, tahadhari kutoiburutia kwenye sakafu, kwa kuwa hii inaweza pia kuharibu sakafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to extend the life of your cork flooring and keep it looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Kwa kufuata vidokezo hivi, unaweza kusaidia kurefusha muda wa matumizi ya sakafu yako ya vigae vya maganda ya mti na kuifanya ionekane bora zaidi kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are essential appliances for keeping food and beverages fresh.
entries.translation: Majokofu na friza ni vifaa muhimu vya kuhifadhi vyakula na vinywaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The refrigerant then passes through the condenser coils, where it releases the heat to the outside air * Thermostat: This controls the temperature inside the refrigerator and freezer.
entries.translation: Kisha vituliza joto vinapitia kwenye koili za kondenza, ambapo vinaachilia joto kwenye hewa ya nje * Kisawazisha joto: Hiki hudhibiti hali ya joto ndani ya jokofu na friza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The total amount of heat that a refrigerator or freezer can remove from its contents is called the cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Kiwango cha jumla cha joto ambacho jokofu au friza inaweza kutoa kutoka kwenye vilivyomo kinaitwa kiwango cha kuweka baridi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cooling capacity is measured in British thermal units (BTUs) per hour.
entries.translation: Kiwango cha kuweka baridi hupimwa kwa vitengo vya joto vya Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are typically rated by their total cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida majokofu na friza yanakadiriwa kwa jumla ya kiwango cha kuweka baridi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Burkina Faso is long and complex, but one of the most important events in the country's history was the 1983 coup d'état that brought Thomas Sankara to power.
entries.translation: Historia ya Bukina Faso ni ndefu na ngumu, lakini mojawapo ya matukio muhimu zaidi katika historia ya nchi hiyo ilikuwa mapinduzi ya kijeshi ya mwaka wa 1983 yaliyomweka Thomas Sankara mamlakani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara was a young military officer who was deeply committed to social justice and economic development.
entries.translation: Sankara alikuwa afisa kijana kijeshi aliyejitolea zaidi kupigania haki ya kijamii na maendeleo ya kiuchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly implemented a series of radical reforms, including nationalizing banks and industry, redistributing land, and promoting women's rights.
entries.translation: Alitekeleza haraka msururu wa mabadiliko makubwa, yakiwemo kutaifisha benki na viwanda, kugawa tena ardhi, na kuendeleza haki za wanawake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara's policies were popular with many Burkinabés, but they also alienated powerful interests, both within the country and abroad.
entries.translation: Sera za Sankara zilikuwa maarufu kwa watu wengi wa Bukina Faso, lakini pia zilipata upinzani mkubwa, ndani na nje ya nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1987, Sankara was assassinated in a coup d'état led by Blaise Compaoré.
entries.translation: Katika mwaka wa 1987, Sankara aliuawa katika mapinduzi ya kijeshi yaliyoongozwa na Blaise Compaoré.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Compaoré ruled Burkina Faso for 27 years, during which time he reversed many of Sankara's reforms and established a repressive authoritarian regime.
entries.translation: Compaoré alitawala Bukina Faso kwa miaka 27, wakati ambapo aligeuza mabadiliko mengi ya sankara na kuzindua utawala kandamizi wa kimabavu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, Compaoré was overthrown in a popular uprising, and Burkina Faso is currently in a fragile state of transition.
entries.translation: Katika mwaka wa 2014, Compaoré aliondolewa mamlakani katika maasi ya wengi, na kwa sasa Bukina Faso iko katika hali tete ya mpito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges it faces, Burkina Faso has a long history of resilience and progress.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto zinazoikumba, Bukina Faso ina historia ndefu ya ustahimilivu na maendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has a rich culture and a strong sense of national identity.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyo ina utajiri wa utamaduni na hisia kali ya utambulisho wa kitaifa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burkinabés are a proud people who are determined to build a better future for themselves and their children.
entries.translation: Wanabukina Faso ni watu wa kujivunia na wamejitolea kujenga taifa bora zaidi la siku za usoni kwa ajili yao na watoto wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, a young boy named Raman made his way home from school.
entries.translation: Jua lilipoanza kutua, mvulana mdogo kwa jina Raman alianza kurudi nyumbani kutoka shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he walked, he noticed a stray dog following him.
entries.translation: Alivyokuwa akitembea, aligundua kuwa palikuwa na mbwa koko aliyekuwa akimfuata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was dirty and skinny, but it had a friendly face.
entries.translation: Mbwa huyo alikuwa mchafu na aliyekonda, lakini uso wake ulikuwa wa kirafiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman felt sorry for the dog, so he decided to take it home with him.
entries.translation: Raman alimhurumia mbwa huyo, kwa hivyo aliamua kuenda naye nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Raman got home, he told his parents about the dog.
entries.translation: Raman alipofika nyumbani, aliwaelezea wazazi wake kuhusu mbwa huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were hesitant at first, but they eventually agreed to let him keep the dog.
entries.translation: Kwanza walisitasita, lakini hatimaye walikubali kumruhusu amfuge mbwa huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman named the dog Buddy, and they quickly became best friends.
entries.translation: Raman alimwita mbwa huyo Buddy, na haraka wakawa marafiki wakubwa zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Buddy was always there for Raman, no matter what.
entries.translation: Mara kwa mara Buddy alikuwepo kwa ajili ya Raman, liwe liwalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was there to greet him at the door when he came home from school, and he was there to comfort him when he was feeling down.
entries.translation: Alikuwepo kumsalimia mlangoni alipowasili nyumbani kutoka shuleni, na alikuwepo kumfariji alipokuwa akihisi vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Raman was playing in the park when he fell and scraped his knee.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Raman alikuwa akicheza mbugani alipoanguka na kupata mkwaruzo kwenye goti lake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He started to cry, and Buddy came running over to lick his wound.
entries.translation: Alianza kulia na Buddy akamjia mbio ili kulamba kidonda chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's gentle tongue helped to soothe Raman's pain, and he soon forgot all about his injury.
entries.translation: Ulimi laini wa mbwa huyo ulisaidia kutuliza maumivu ya Raman, na haraka alisahau kuhusu jeraha lake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman and Buddy shared many happy years together.
entries.translation: Raman na Buddy waliishi pamoja miaka mingi kwa furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They went on walks, played fetch in the park, and cuddled up on the couch together.
entries.translation: Walienda matembezini, walicheza michezo ya kujificha mbugani, na walikumbatiana kwenye kochi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
entries.translation: Tasnia ya filamu ya sci-fi imekuwa ikididimia katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, filamu chache zaidi zikitayarishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
entries.translation: Kuna sababu kadhaa zilizochangia upunguaji huu, ikiwemo kuongezeka kwa filamu za mashujaa na ongezeko la umaarufu wa huduma za utiririshaji sinema mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
entries.translation: Filamu za mashujaa zimeongeza umaarufu katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, kutokana na mafanikio ya vikundi kama Marvel Cinematic Universe na DC Extended Universe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
entries.translation: Filamu hizi hutoa kwa watazamaji mchanganyiko wa vita, shani, na tamasha, vitu ambavyo havipatikani kwenye filamu za sci-fi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
entries.translation: Pia huduma za utiririshaji filamu mtandaoni ziliathiri tasnia ya filamu ya sci-fi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
entries.translation: Huduma hizi zinatoa maudhui ya aina mbalimbali, zikiwemo filamu za sci-fi, kwa gharama nafuu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it more difficult for sci-fi films to compete in theaters, where they are often priced at a premium.
entries.translation: Hii hufanya iwe vigumu kwa filamu za sci-fi kushindana kwenye kumbi za filamu, ambapo mara nyingi zinawekewa bei ya malipo ya bonasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these factors, the sci-fi movie industry is in need of a major shake-up.
entries.translation: Kutokana na vipengele hivi, tasnia ya filamu ya sci-fi inahitaji mabadiliko makubwa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Imagine being able to enjoy your life without the constant fear of these debilitating conditions.
entries.translation: Fikiria tu kuweza kufurahia maisha bila kuhofia kila mara kuhusu hali hizi za kudhoofisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.
entries.translation: Maambukizi ya njia ya mkojo ni tatizo kuu, hasa kwa wanawake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including pain, burning, and frequent urination.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kusababisha dalili mbalimbali, zikiwemo maumivu, kuwashwa, na kukojoa mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, maambukizi ya njia ya mkojo yanaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa, kama vile maambukizi ya figo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bladder stones are another common problem.
entries.translation: Tatizo lingine ni kuwepo kwa vijiwe kwenye kibofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause pain, difficulty urinating, and blood in the urine.
entries.translation: Vinaweza kusabaisha maumivu, ugumu wa kukojoa, na damu kwenye mkojo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.
entries.translation: Wakati wingine, vijiwe kwenye kibofu vinaweza kufunga urethra, na kusababisha hali ya hatari kwa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kidney diseases are a serious problem that can affect people of all ages.
entries.translation: Magonjwa ya figo ni tatizo kubwa linaloweza kuwaathiri watu wa umri wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including fatigue, nausea, and vomiting.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kusababisha dalili mbalimbali, ukiwemo uchovu, kichefuchefu, na kutapika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.
entries.translation: Wakati mwingine, magonjwa ya figo yanaweza kusababisha figo kushindwa kufanya kazi, ambayo ni hatari kwa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are suffering from any of these conditions, there is help available.
entries.translation: Iwapo unakumbana na mojawapo ya hali hizi, kuna msaada unaopatikana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor about your symptoms and treatment options.
entries.translation: Zungumza na daktari wako kuhusu dalili zako na matibabu yaliyopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a variety of treatments available for UTIs, bladder stones, and kidney diseases.
entries.translation: Kuna matibabu mbalimbali yaliyopo ya maambukizi ya njia ya mkojo, vijiwe vya kibofu, na magonjwa ya figo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With proper treatment, you can get relief from your symptoms and prevent further complications.
entries.translation: Kwa matibabu sahihi, unaweza kupata nafuu dhidi ya dalili hizo na kuzuia matatizo zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let these conditions control your life.
entries.translation: Usiache hali hizi zidhibiti maisha yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor today and start on the path to recovery.
entries.translation: Zungumza na daktari wako leo na uanze safari ya kurejesha afya yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was admiring a particularly large dinosaur skull, he heard a voice behind him. "That's a Tyrannosaurus rex," the voice said.

entries.english: He was tall and thin, with a long beard and a kind face. "Are you a paleontologist?" the boy asked.

entries.english: Freedom is a word that has been used and abused by so many people, in so many contexts, that it has almost lost its meaning.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for me, freedom is a very simple thing.

entries.english: It is the ability to live my life on my own terms, without being controlled or oppressed by others.

entries.english: I wanted to be free to pursue my own dreams, to learn and grow, and to make a difference in the world.

entries.english: I was fortunate to have parents who supported my ambitions.

entries.english: They encouraged me to go to college, to get a job, and to live my life on my own terms.

entries.english: And I am grateful for the opportunities that I have had to travel, to meet new people, and to learn about different cultures.

entries.english: Hospitals are an important part of the healthcare system.

entries.english: Malawi is a diverse country with a rich culture and history.

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Malawi include Lake Malawi, the Shire River, and the Nyika Plateau.

entries.english: Lake Malawi is the third-largest lake in Africa and is home to a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.
entries.translation: Ziwa Malawi ndilo ziwa kubwa la tatu barani Afrika na makazi ya aina mbalimbali ya samaki na wanyamapori wengine.

entries.english: The Shire River is a major tributary of the Zambezi River and is an important source of water for irrigation and transportation.

entries.english: The Nyika Plateau is a highland region in northern Malawi and is home to a variety of wildlife, including elephants, lions, and leopards.
entries.translation: Nyika Platu ni eneo la milima katika Malawi kaskazini na ni makazi ya wanyamapori mbalimbali, wakiwemo ndovu, simba, na chui.

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Malawi include David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, and Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watu maarufu zaidi wa kihistoria nchini Malawi ni David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, na Hastings Kamuzu Banda.

entries.english: Livingstone was a Scottish missionary and explorer who was instrumental in the abolition of the slave trade in Africa.
entries.translation: Livingstone alikuwa mmishonari na mchunguzi wa Scotland aliyekuwa katika mstari wa mbele katika ukomeshaji wa biashara ya watumwa barani Afrika.

entries.english: Chilembwe was a Malawian Baptist minister who led an uprising against British colonial rule in 1915.
entries.translation: Chilemwe alikuwa mhubiri wa Kibaptisti wa Malawi aliyeongoza maasi dhidi ya utawala wa ukoloni wa Waingereza mwaka wa 1915.

entries.english: Banda was the first president of Malawi and ruled the country from 1964 to 1994.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Golden Temple, a shimmering monument to human vanity and folly, stands as a testament to the destructive power of desire.
entries.translation: Hekalu la Dhahabu, mnara unaometameta kwa ubatili na ujinga wa binadamu, linasimama kama ushahidi wa nguvu ya uharibifu ya tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place where dreams are made and broken, where hopes are raised and dashed, and where love and hate, life and death, are all inextricably intertwined.
entries.translation: Ni mahali ambapo maono hubuniwa na kuvunjwa, ambapo matumaini huinuka na kudidimishwa, na ambapo upendo na chuki, maisha na kifo, vyote vimeungana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The temple was built by a wealthy maharaja who wanted to create a place where he could worship his god in peace.
entries.translation: Hekalu hilo lilijengwa na maharaja tajiri aliyetaka kuunda eneo ambapo angeabudu mungu wake kwa amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the temple quickly became a magnet for pilgrims from all over the world, and it soon became a place of commerce and trade.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, hekalu hilo kwa haraka likawa sumaku kwa mahujaji kutoka kote duniani, na likawa eneo la biashara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maharaja's dream of a peaceful place of worship was quickly shattered, and the temple became a place of greed, corruption, and violence.
entries.translation: Ndoto ya maharaja huyo ya sehemu yenye amani ya kuabudu ilizimwa haraka, na hekalu likabadilika kuwa eneo la ulafi, ufisadi, na vurugu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young man named Amritsar arrived at the temple.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a simple man with a simple dream: to find peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mwanamume wa kawaida na ndoto ya kawaida: kupata amani na furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Amritsar soon found that the temple was no place for peace.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, baada ya muda mfupi Amritsar aligundua kuwa hekalu hilo halikuwa mahali pa amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was drawn into the vortex of greed and corruption, and he eventually lost everything he had.
entries.translation: Alijiingiza kwenye vizingia vya ulafi na ufisadi, na hatimaye akapoteza kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amritsar's story is a cautionary tale about the dangers of desire.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a reminder that the things we crave most may not be what is best for us.

entries.english: I'm glad you asked about integrity.

entries.english: It means being honest, trustworthy, and ethical.

entries.english: I think integrity is so important because it helps us build trust with others.

entries.english: When people know that we're honest and trustworthy, they're more likely to open up to us and share their thoughts and feelings.

entries.english: That can make for a richer and more fulfilling life.

entries.english: Of course, it's not always easy to do the right thing.

entries.english: Sometimes, we might be tempted to lie or cheat in order to get ahead.

entries.english: But if we want to live a life of integrity, we have to be willing to stand up for what we believe in, even when it's difficult.

entries.english: I know that integrity is something that you value, too.

entries.english: Fufu is a starchy, doughy food made from pounded plantains or cassava.

entries.english: It is a staple food in many West African countries, and is often served with soups or stews.

entries.english: Fufu is typically made by pounding the plantains or cassava in a large mortar and pestle until they are smooth and pasty.

entries.english: The resulting fufu is then shaped into balls or logs and served.

entries.english: Fufu is a very filling food, and it is often eaten as a main course.

entries.english: It is also a good source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals.

entries.english: Fufu is a traditional food that has been eaten in West Africa for hundreds of years.

entries.english: It is a part of the culture and identity of many West African societies.

entries.english: Person A: There is a lack of originality in the perfume and fragrance industry. The perfumes all smell the same, and they don't really say anything about me.
entries.translation: Mtu A: Kuna ukosefu wa uhalisia katika tasnia ya uturi na manukato. Uturi wote unanukia harufu ileile, na haudhihirishi kitu chochote kunihusu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: I know what you mean. I've been looking for a unique perfume that will make me stand out from the crowd, but I haven't had any luck.
entries.translation: Mtu B: Najua unachomaanisha. Nimekuwa nikitafuta uturi wa kipekee utakaonifanya kuwa tofauti na wengine, lakini sijawahi kufanikiwa.

entries.english: Person A: I think we should start our own perfume company. We could create fragrances that are truly original and that reflect our personality.

entries.english: The Suez Canal was a major engineering feat that connected the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
entries.translation: Mfereji wa Suez ulikuwa kazi kubwa ya uhandisi iliyounganisha Bahari ya Mediteranea na Bahari ya Shamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was built by the French and opened in 1869.
entries.translation: Ulijengwa na Wafaransa na kufunguliwa mwaka wa 1869.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The canal was a vital trade route for Egypt and the rest of the world.
entries.translation: Mfereji huo ulikuwa njia muhimu ya biashara kwa Misri na dunia yote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also allowed for the movement of troops and supplies, which was important during wartime.
entries.translation: Pia iliwezesha uhamishaji wa wanajeshi na bidhaa, ambavyo vilikuwa muhimu wakati wa vita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1956, Egypt nationalized the Suez Canal, which led to the Suez Crisis.
entries.translation: Katika mwaka wa 1956, Misri ilitaifisha Mfereji wa Suez, na kupelekea Mgogoro wa Suez.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crisis was a major international incident that was eventually resolved through a United Nations peacekeeping force.
entries.translation: Mgogoro huo ulikuwa tukio kubwa la kimataifa ambalo hatimaye lilisuluhishwa kupitia majeshi ya kudumisha amani ya Umoja wa Mataifa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Suez Canal is still a vital trade route today and is one of the most important waterways in the world.
entries.translation: Hadi leo Mfereji wa Suez ni njia muhimu ya biashara na ni mojawapo ya njia muhimu za maji ulimwenguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young man named Rajiv who lived in a small village.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, palikuwa na kijana kwa jina Rajiv aliyeishi katika kitongoji kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a poor man, and he and his mother often went hungry.
entries.translation: Alikuwa maskini, na mara nyingi yeye pamoja na mama yake walikosa chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Rajiv decided to go into the forest to find some food.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Rajiv aliamua kuenda msituni kutafuta chakula kiasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was walking through the forest, Rajiv came across a strange tree.
entries.translation: Alipokuwa akitembea msituni, Rajiv alikutana na mti wa ajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was covered in golden apples, and Rajiv had never seen anything like it before.
entries.translation: Mti huo ulikuwa umefunikwa kwa matufaha ya dhahabu, na kamwe Rajiv hakuwa amewahi kuona kitu kama hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He reached up to pick an apple, but as soon as he touched it, the tree spoke to him.
entries.translation: Alienda kuchuna tufaha, lakini mara tu alipolishika, mti ulimwongelesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not touch my apples," the tree said. "They are not for you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Rajiv was hungry, and he didn't listen to the tree.
entries.translation: Lakini Rajiv alikuwa na njaa, na hakusikiliza mti huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked an apple and took a bite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As soon as he did, he felt a strange change come over him.
entries.translation: Mara tu alipofanya hivyo, alihisi mabadiliko ya ajabu ndani mwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He felt stronger and more powerful, and he knew that he had done something wrong.
entries.translation: Alijihisi mwenye nguvu nyingi na mwenye uwezo kabisa, na akajua kuwa amekosea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I am the Golden Apple Tree," the tree said. "And now that you have eaten my apple, you will be cursed.
entries.translation: "Mimi ni Mti wa Tufaha za Dhahabu," mti ulisema. "Na kwa kuwa sasa umekula tufaha yangu, utalaaniwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You will never be satisfied with what you have, and you will always be searching for more."
entries.translation: Kamwe hutatosheka na chochote ulicho nacho, na kila wakati utakuwa ukitafuta zaidi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Open-air markets are a popular attraction in many cities and towns.
entries.translation: Soko za wazi ni za kupendelewa katika majiji na miji mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They offer a variety of goods and services, from fresh produce to handmade crafts.
entries.translation: Hutoa bidhaa na huduma mbalimbali, kuanzia kwa bidhaa za shambani hadi bidhaa za usanifu wa mikono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Visitors can find a bargain on everything from clothes to souvenirs.
entries.translation: Wageni wanaweza kujadiliana bei kwa kila kitu kuanzia kwa nguo hadi vikumbusho vya matukio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Open-air markets are also a great place to people-watch and enjoy the local culture.
entries.translation: Soko za wazi pia ni maeneo mazuri ya watu kutazama na kufurahia utamaduni wa ndani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best things about open-air markets is the atmosphere.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu bora kuhusu soko za wazi ni hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're usually bustling with activity, and there's always something to see and do.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida huwa na shughuli nyingi, na kila mara kuna jambo la kuona na kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll hear the sound of vendors calling out to customers, the smell of fresh-baked bread and pastries, and the sight of people haggling over prices.
entries.translation: Utasikia sauti za wachuuzi wakiwaita wateja, harufu safi ya mikate na mahamri yaliyookwa, na kuona watu wakijadiliana kuhusu bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another advantage of open-air markets is the variety of goods and services available.
entries.translation: Faida nyingine ya soko za wazi ni kupatikana kwa aina mbalimbali za vyakula na huduma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can find everything from fresh produce to handmade crafts.
entries.translation: Unaweza kupata chochote kuanzia kwa bidhaa za shambani hadi bidhaa za usanifu wa mikono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And because the vendors are independent businesses, they're often willing to negotiate prices.
entries.translation: Na kwa kuwa wachuuzi ni wafanyi biashara wa kujitegemea, mara nyingi wako tayari kujadiliana bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a bargain, an open-air market is the place to be.
entries.translation: Iwapo unatafuta mahali pa kujadiliana bei, eneo bora la kwenda ni katika soko la wazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, no discussion of open-air markets would be complete without mentioning the food.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, mjadala wa soko za wazi hauwezi kukamilika bila kutaja chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These markets are a great place to sample local cuisine.
entries.translation: Soko hizi ni maeneo mwafaka ya kupata vyakula tofauti vya ndani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll find everything from grilled meats to fresh seafood to traditional desserts.
entries.translation: Utapata kila kitu kuanzia nyama iliyochomwa hadi vyakula safi vya baharini na kitindamlo cha kitamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was born into a Dalit family, a group of people who were considered to be untouchables in the caste system of India.
entries.translation: Ambedkar alizaliwa katika familia ya Dalit, kikundi cha watu waliozingatiwa kuwa watu wenye nguvu wasioguswa katika mfumo wa urithi wa India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He faced discrimination and hardship throughout his life, but he never gave up on his dream of equality for all Indians.
entries.translation: Alitengwa na kupitia hali ngumu maishani mwake, lakini kamwe hakukata tamaa ya ndoto yake ya usawa kwa Wahindi wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was a brilliant student and went on to earn a doctorate in law from Columbia University in the United States.
entries.translation: Ambedkar alikuwa mwanafunzi mwerevu na aliendelea na masomo hadi akafuzu kwa shahada ya falsafa katika sheria kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Columbia nchini Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also studied at the London School of Economics and became a barrister.
entries.translation: Pia alisomea katika Chuo cha Uchumi cha London na akawa wakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After returning to India, Ambedkar became a leading figure in the Indian independence movement.
entries.translation: Baada ya kurudi India, Ambedkar alikuwa kiongozi maarufu katika vuguvugu la uhuru wa India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a member of the Indian National Congress, but he eventually broke away from the party and formed his own political organization, the Scheduled Castes Federation.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mwanachama wa Bunge la Kitaifa la India, lakini hatimaye aliondoka kwenye chama na kuunda shirika lake binafsi la kisiasa lililoitwa Shirikisho la Tabaka Lililopangwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was also a key figure in the drafting of the Constitution of India.
entries.translation: Pia Ambedkar alikuwa mhusika mkuu katika kuandika rasimu ya Katiba ya India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is the intentional infliction of pain, suffering, or death upon an animal.
entries.translation: Ukatili kwa wanyama ni kuumiza, kutesa, au kuua wanyama kimakusudi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can take many forms, from physical abuse to neglect.
entries.translation: Unaweza kuwa wa aina nyingi, kutoka unyanyasaji wa kimwili hadi kutelekezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animals may be beaten, kicked, burned, starved, or even killed for no reason other than human entertainment.
entries.translation: Wanyama wanaweza kupigwa, kupigwa teke, kuchomwa, kunyimwa chakula, au hata kuuwawa bila sababu yoyote kando na kujifurahisha kwa binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a serious problem that affects millions of animals every year.
entries.translation: Ukatili kwa wanyama ni tatizo kubwa linaloathiri mamilioni ya wanyama kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is illegal in most countries, but enforcement is often lax.
entries.translation: Ni kinyume cha sheria katika nchi nyingi, lakini mara nyingi utekelezaji wa sheria hiyo unalegea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many organizations that work to prevent and stop animal cruelty, but more needs to be done.
entries.translation: Kuna mashirika mengi yanayofanya kazi ya kuzuia na kukomesha ukatili kwa wanyama, lakini mengi yanahitajika kufanywa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to stop animal cruelty by being more aware of the issue and by speaking out against it.
entries.translation: Sote tunaweza kusaidia kukomesha ukatili kwa wanyama na kuwa na ufahamu zaidi wa suala hili na kwa kuupinga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy from businesses that do not support animal cruelty and to support organizations that work to protect animals.
entries.translation: Pia tunaweza kuamua kununua kutoka kwa biashara zisizounga mkono ukatili kwa wanyama na kusaidia mashirika yanayofanya kazi ya kuwalinda wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a terrible thing that happens every day.
entries.translation: Ukatili kwa wanyama ni jambo baya sana linalofanyika kila siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to make a difference by speaking out against it and by supporting organizations that work to stop it.
entries.translation: Sote tunaweza kuleta tofauti kwa kuupinga na kwa kusaidia mashirika yanayofanya kazi ya kuukomesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the average age of a woman's first menstrual period is 12 years old, and the average age of menopause is 45 years old.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu umri wastani wa hedhi ya kwanza kwa mwanamke ni miaka 12, na umri wastani wa kukoma hedhi ni miaka 45.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that a woman has approximately 33 years to bear children.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha mwanamke ana takriban miaka 33 kuzaa watoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, fertility begins to decline in a woman's mid-thirties, and by the time she is 40, her chances of conceiving naturally are significantly reduced.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, uwezo wa kuzaa huanza kupungua kuanzia katikati ya miaka ya thelathini ya mwanamke, na anapofikisha miaka 40, nafasi yake ya kupata ujauzito kwa njia ya kawaida inapungua pakubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of factors that can contribute to a woman's declining fertility, including age, smoking, obesity, and certain medical conditions.
entries.translation: Kuna sababu kadhaa zinazoweza kuchangia kupungua kwa uwezo wa kuzaa wa mwanamke, ikiwemo umri, uvutaji sigara, kunenepa kupita kiasi, na hali fulani za kimatibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a woman ages, her eggs become less healthy and more likely to have chromosomal abnormalities.
entries.translation: Kadri mwanamke anavyozeeka, mayai yake yanadhoofika kiafya na kuwa na uwezekano wa kasoro za kromosomu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can increase the risk of miscarriage, stillbirth, and birth defects.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuongeza hatari ya kuharibika kwa mimba, vifo vya uzazi, na kasoro za kuzaliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Smoking can also damage a woman's fertility by reducing blood flow to the uterus and ovaries.
entries.translation: Pia uvutaji sigara unaweza kuharibu uwezo wa kuzaa wa mwanamke kwa kupunguza mtiririko wa damu kwenye tumbo la uzazi na ovari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Obesity can lead to hormonal imbalances that can interfere with ovulation.
entries.translation: Unene kupita kiasi unaweza kusababisha ukosefu wa usawa wa  homoni unaoweza kuhitilafiana na ovulesheni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And certain medical conditions, such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and endometriosis, can also make it difficult for a woman to conceive.
entries.translation: Na hali fulani za kimatibabu, kama vile uvimbe wa ovari na endometriosisi, pia zinaweza kufanya iwe vigumu mwanamke kupata ujauzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are a woman who is over 30 and are thinking about having children, it is important to talk to your doctor about your fertility.
entries.translation: Iwapo wewe ni mwanamke wa zaidi ya umri wa miaka 30 na unafikiria kuhusu kupata watoto, ni muhimu uzungumze na daktari wako kuhusu uwezo wako wa kuzaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that you can do to improve your chances of conceiving, including losing weight if you are overweight or obese, quitting smoking, and getting regular exercise.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa unayoweza kufanya ili kuboresha nafasi za kupata mimba, ikiwemo kupunguza uzito iwapo una uzito mkubwa au u mnene kupita kiasi, kuacha kuvuta sigara, na kufanya mazoezi kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your doctor may also recommend fertility medications or other treatments to help you conceive.
entries.translation: Daktari wako pia anaweza kupendekeza matibabu ya uwezo wa kuzaa au matibabu mengine ili kukusaidia kupata ujauzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to remember that there are many other ways to have a family, even if you are unable to conceive naturally.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kukumbuka kuwa kuna niia nyingine nyingi za kuwa na familia, hata iwapo huwezi kupata ujauzito kiasilia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adoption and surrogacy are two options that you may want to consider.
entries.translation: Kuasili na kuwa mama mbadala ni njia mbili unazoweza kuzingatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With the help of modern medicine, there are many ways to have a family, no matter what your age or fertility.
entries.translation: Kwa msaada wa tabibu za kisasa, kuna njia nyingi za kuwa na familia, bila kujali umri wako au uwezo wa kuzaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth and can weigh up to 15,000 pounds.
entries.translation: Ndovu ndio wanyama wakubwa zaidi wa ardhini Duniani na wanaweza kuwa na hadi uzani wa pauni 15,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are herbivores and their diet consists mainly of leaves, bark, and fruit.
entries.translation: Ni wanyama wanaokula mimea na lishe yao kuu ni majani, magambamti, na matunda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants have a long trunk that they use for many purposes, including drinking, bathing, and gathering food.
entries.translation: Ndovu wana mkonga mrefu wenye matumizi mengi, ikiwemo kunywa maji, kuoga, na kukusanya chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also use their trunks to communicate with each other and to defend themselves from predators.
entries.translation: Pia hutumia mikonga yao kuwasiliana na wengine na kujilinda dhidi ya wanyama wawindaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants live in herds and are very social animals.
entries.translation: Ndovu huishi kwa vikundi na ni wanyama wanaoshirikiana na wenzao.

entries.english: But once she steps outside, the story takes on a whole new tone.

entries.english: The novel ends with the princess finding her own way in the world, and she is finally happy and content.

entries.english: She has learned that she is strong and independent, and she is no longer afraid to face whatever challenges come her way.

entries.english: The novel is a coming-of-age story, and it follows the princess as she grows from a sheltered young woman into a confident and capable adult.

entries.english: As the global economy continues to grow, so too does the demand for cotton.
entries.translation: Kadri uchumi wa dunia unavyoendelea kukua ndivyo mahitaji ya pamba yanavyozidi kukua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, the increasing popularity of sustainable fashion is driving up demand for organic cotton.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, umaarufu unaoongezeka wa mitindo endelevu unaongeza mahitaji ya pamba ya kikaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a surge in investment in the cotton industry, with new plantations being established in countries such as India and China.
entries.translation: Hii imesababisha kuongezeka kwa uwekezaji katika tasnia ya pamba, na mashamba mpya yameanzishwa katika nchi kama vile India na Uchina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, this growth has not been without its challenges.
entries.translation: Hata hvyo, ukuaji huu haujakosa changamoto.

entries.english: The increased demand for cotton has put a strain on water resources, and the use of pesticides and fertilizers has led to environmental pollution.
entries.translation: Ongezeko hili katika mahitaji ya pamba limeshinikiza rasilimali za maji, na matumizi ya viua wadudu na mbolea yamesababisha uchafuzi wa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, the low wages paid to cotton farmers in developing countries has led to concerns about labor exploitation.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, mishahara midogo ambayo wakulima wa pamba wanalipwa katika nchi zinazostawi imesababisha wasiwasi kuhusu unyanyasaji wa kikazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the cotton industry remains an important part of the global economy.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizo, tasnia ya pamba inaendelea kuwa sehemu muhimu ya uchumi wa dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It provides jobs for millions of people and is a source of vital income for many developing countries.
entries.translation: Hutoa nafasi za kazi kwa mamilioni ya watu na ni chanzo cha mapato muhimu kwa nchi nyingi zinazostawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, cotton is a versatile and sustainable material that is used in a wide range of products, from clothing to home furnishings.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, pamba ni nyenzo yenye matumizi mengi na endelevu ambayo hutumiwa katika bidhaa mbalimbali, kutoka nguo hadi vyombo vya nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the global population continues to grow, the demand for cotton is likely to remain high.
entries.translation: Kadiri idadi ya watu duniani inavyoendelea kuongezeka, huenda mahitaji ya pamba yakaendelea kuwa makubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This presents both challenges and opportunities for the cotton industry.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember the day I collected the first harvest of our family farm.

entries.english: It was a hot summer day, and the sun was beating down on us as we worked in the fields.

entries.english: But we didn't mind, because we were excited to see the fruits of our labor.

entries.english: We had been working hard all season, and it was finally time to reap the rewards.

entries.english: We picked the ripe tomatoes and peppers, and we carefully loaded them into the back of the truck.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then we drove them back to the farm, where we washed and sorted them.

entries.english: The smoke from the wood fire slowly permeated the vegetables, giving them a delicious flavor.

entries.english: Charity begins at home is a proverb that means that people should take care of their own family and community before helping others.
entries.translation: Hisani huanzia nyumbani ni methali inayomaanisha kwamba watu wanapaswa kutunza familia na jamii zao kabla ya kuwasaidia wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The phrase is often used to encourage people to be more charitable to those in need, but it can also be used to justify selfishness or inaction.
entries.translation: Msemo huo hutumika mara nyingi kuhimiza watu kuwa wafadhili zaidi kwa wale wenye mahitaji, lakini pia unaweza kutumika kuhalalisha ubinafsi na kutochukua hatua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example of how the phrase might be used is if someone is asked to donate to a charity that helps people in a foreign country.
entries.translation: Mfano mmoja wa jinsi msemo huo unavyoweza kutumika ni ikiwa mtu anaombwa kutoa mchango kwa shirika la usaidizi ambalo husaidia watu katika nchi ya kigeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The person might say that they would rather donate to a local charity that helps people in their own community.
entries.translation: Mtu huyo anaweza kusema kwamba angependelea kuchangia katika shirika la eneo lake linalosaidia watu katika jamii yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they believe that it is more important to help those who are close to them than those who are far away.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu wanaamini kuwa ni muhimu kuwasaidia walio karibu nao kuliko walio mbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The phrase "charity begins at home" can be traced back to the Bible.

entries.english: In the book of Matthew, Jesus says, "If you give to the poor, your gift will be given back to you full measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over.

entries.english: For by your standard of measure it will be measured to you in return." (Matthew 6:20).

entries.english: The hippie movement was a social and cultural phenomenon that emerged in the United States during the 1960s.

entries.english: It was characterized by its rejection of mainstream values and its emphasis on peace, love, and freedom.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Music played an important role in the hippie movement, as it helped to create a sense of community and shared identity among its members.

entries.english: The music of the hippie movement was diverse, but it was often characterized by its experimental nature and its focus on spirituality and social change.

entries.english: Some of the most popular hippie bands included the Grateful Dead, Jefferson Airplane, and the Doors.

entries.english: These bands created a new sound that was unlike anything that had come before, and their music helped to inspire the counterculture movement.

entries.english: The hippie movement has had a lasting impact on music, and its influence can still be seen today.

entries.english: Many modern bands continue to draw inspiration from the hippie era, and its values of peace, love, and freedom continue to resonate with people around the world.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
