entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Radio collars are a valuable tool for studying elephants and for helping to reduce human-elephant conflict.
entries.translation: Redio kola ni kifaa cha thamani kwa kufanya utafiti wa ndovu na kusaidia kupunguza migogoro kati ya binadamu na ndovu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide scientists with valuable information about elephant behavior, and they can help farmers to protect their crops.
entries.translation: Zinawapa wanasayansi taarifa muhimu kuhusu tabia za ndovu, na zinaweza kusaidia wakulima kulinda mimea yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to create a future where elephants and humans can live together in harmony.
entries.translation: Kwa ushirikiano, wanasayansi na wakulima wanaweza kusaidia kuweka mikakati ambapo ndovu na binadamu wanaweza kuishi pamoja kwa amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a West African empire that reached its peak in the 13th and 14th centuries.
entries.translation: Falme ya Mali ilikuwa falme ya Afrika Magharibi iliyofikia kilele chake katika karne za 13 na 14.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was founded by Sundiata Keita in 1235 and stretched from the Atlantic Ocean to the Niger River.
entries.translation: Ilianzishwa na Sundiata Keita mnamo 1235 na ilitoka Bahari ya Atlantiki hadi Mto Naija.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a major center of trade and learning, and its rulers were known for their wealth and power.
entries.translation: Falme ya Mali ilikuwa kituo kikuu cha biashara na mafunzo, na watawala wake walijulikana kwa utajiri na mamlaka yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The empire declined in the 15th century, and was eventually conquered by the Songhai Empire in the 16th century.
entries.translation: Falme hiyo ilididimia katika karne ya 15, na hatimaye kutekwa na Falme ya Songhai katika karne ya 16.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important events in Mali's history was the Battle of Kirina in 1235.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya matukio muhimu katika historia ya Mali ni Vita vya Kirina mnamo vya mwaka wa 1235.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This battle marked the end of the Ghana Empire and the rise of the Mali Empire.
entries.translation: Vita hivi viliashiria mwisho wa Falme ya Ghana na kuibuka kwa Falme ya Mali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Mali Empire, led his army to victory over the forces of the Ghana Empire.
entries.translation: Sundiata Keita, mwanzilishi wa Falme ya Mali, aliongoza jeshi lake kutwaa ushindi dhidi ya majeshi ya Falme ya Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This victory gave Sundiata Keita control of the gold mines of the Sahel region, and helped to establish the Mali Empire as a major power in West Africa.
entries.translation: Ushindi huu ulimpa Sundiata Keita udhibiti wa migodi ya dhahabu ya eneo la Sahel, na kusaidia kuzindua Falme ya Mali kama mamlaka kuu katika Afrika Magharibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important event in Mali's history was the reign of Mansa Musa.
entries.translation: Tukio lingine muhimu katika historia ya Mali lilikuwa utawala wa Mansa Musa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mansa Musa was the third ruler of the Mali Empire, and he reigned from 1312 to 1337.
entries.translation: Mensa Musa alikuwa mtawala wa tatu wa Milki ya Mali, na alitawala kutoka 1312 hadi 1337.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a Google spreadsheet, an absolute reference will always refer to the same cell, regardless of where it is copied or moved to.
entries.translation: Kwenye lahajedwali la Google, kila mara rejeleo kamili linarejelea seli sawa, licha ya mahali ambapo limenakiliwa au kuhamishiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are useful for cells that contain data that you do not want to change when you copy or move the formula.
entries.translation: Marejeleo kamili ni muhimu kwa seli zilizo na data ambayo hutaki kubadilisha unaponakili au kuhamisha fomula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you have a formula that calculates the total sales for each month, you would want to use an absolute reference for the cell that contains the starting date.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, iwapo una fomula inayokokotoa jumla ya mauzo kwa kila mwezi, utatumia rejeleo kamili kwa seli iliyo na tarehe ya kuanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This way, the formula will always refer to the same cell, even if you copy it to a different row or column.
entries.translation: Kwa njia hii, kila mara fomula itarejelea seli sawa, hata iwapo utainakili kwenye safumlalo au safuwima tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can create an absolute reference by adding a dollar sign ($) to the row number and column letter of the cell reference.
entries.translation: Unaweza kuunda rejeleo kamili kwa kuongeza ishara ya dola ($) kwenye nambari ya safumlalo na herufi ya safuwima ya rejeleo la seli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the cell A1 would be $A$1.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, rejeleo kamili kwa seli A1litakuwa $A$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also use absolute references to reference a range of cells.
entries.translation: Pia unaweza kutumia marejeleo kamili kurejelea seli mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, add a dollar sign to the row number and column letter of each cell in the range.
entries.translation: Ili kufanya hili, ongeza ishara ya dola kwenye nambari ya safumlalo na herufi ya safuwima ya kila seli katika masafa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the range A1:B1 would be $A$1:$B$1.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, rejeleo kamili kwa masafa ya A1:B1 litakuwa $A$1:$B$1.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are a powerful tool that can be used to make your formulas more flexible and easier to use.
entries.translation: Marejeleo kamili ni zana bora inayoweza kutumika kufanya fomula zako kubadilika na kuwa rahisi zaidi kutumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By understanding how to use absolute references, you can create formulas that will work even when you copy or move them to different locations.
entries.translation: Kwa kuelewa jinsi ya kutumia marejeleo kamili, unaweza kuunda fomula zitakazofanya kazi hata unapozinakili au kuzihamisha katika maeneo tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some additional tips for using absolute references:
entries.translation: Hivi hapa ni baadhi ya vidokezo vya ziada vya kutumia marejeleo kamili:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use absolute references for cells that contain data that you do not want to change.
entries.translation: * Tumia marejeleo kamili kwa seli zilizo na data ambayo hutaki kubadilisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use relative references for cells that contain data that you do want to change.
entries.translation: * Tumia marejeleo husiani kwa seli zilizo na data ambayo hutaki kubadilisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be careful when using mixed references, which are references that contain both absolute and relative references.
entries.translation: * Kuwa mwangalifu unapotumia marejeleo mchanganyiko, ambayo ni marejeleo yanayojumuisha marejeleo kamili na husiani kwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use the F4 key to toggle between absolute, relative, and mixed references.
entries.translation: * Tumia kitufe cha F4 kutogoa kati ya marejeleo kamili, husiani, na mchanganyiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can use absolute references to create powerful and flexible formulas that will make your work in Excel easier and more efficient.
entries.translation: Kwa kufuata vidokezo hivi, unaweza kutumia marejeleo kamili kuunda fomula thabiti na ya kubadilika itakayofanya kazi yako kwenye Excel kuwa rahisi na yenye ufanisi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they do not feed on blood.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu hawafyonzi damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, they feed on nectar from flowers.
entries.translation: Badala yake, wanakula nekta kutoka kwenye maua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes, on the other hand, do feed on blood.
entries.translation: Mbu wa kike, kwa upande mwingine, wanafyonza damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need blood in order to produce eggs.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Male mosquitoes are attracted to light, so they are often found near windows and doors.
entries.translation: Mbu wa kiume wanavutiwa na mwangaza, kwa hivyo mara nyingi wanapatikana karibu na madirisha na milango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also attracted to the smell of sweat and CO2.
entries.translation: Pia wanavutiwa na harufu ya jasho na dioksidi ya kaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes are attracted to the same things, but they are also attracted to the smell of certain chemicals in human blood.
entries.translation: Mbu wa kike wanavutiwa na vitu vivyo hivyo, lakini pia wanavutiwa na harufu ya baadhi ya kemikali katika damu ya binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a female mosquito bites a human, she injects saliva into the skin.
entries.translation: Mbu wa kike anapomuuma binadamu, huingiza mate yake kwenye ngozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This saliva contains anticoagulants, which prevent the blood from clotting.
entries.translation: Mate haya yana vizua kuganda, na kuzuia damu kuganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mosquito then sucks up the blood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bites can cause itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Kuumwa na mbu kunaweza kusababisha kuwashwa na kuvimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, they can also cause an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Katika hali nyingine, pia wanaweza kusababisha hisia ya mzio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common type of allergic reaction to mosquito bites is hives.
entries.translation: Aina inayopatikana sana ya hisia ya mzio ya kuumwa na mbu ni vipele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hives are red, raised bumps that appear on the skin.
entries.translation: Vipele ni vyekundu, uvimbe unaoonekana kwenye ngozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be itchy or painful.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rare cases, mosquito bites can cause more serious problems.
entries.translation: Katika hali nadra, kuumwa na mbu kunaweza kusababisha matatizo hatari zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some people can develop an infection at the site of the bite.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, baadhi ya watu wanaweza kuwa na maambukizi kwenye sehemu walipoumwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, mosquito bites can even lead to death.
entries.translation: Katika hali nyingine, kuumwa na mbu kunaweza kusababisha kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to avoid mosquito bites is to wear long sleeves and pants when you are outdoors.
entries.translation: Njia bora ya kuzuia kuumwa na mbu ni kuvaa nguo za mikono mirefu na long'i unapokuwa nje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also use insect repellent.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kutumia dawa ya kufukuza wadudu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do get bitten by a mosquito, you can apply a cold compress to the bite to relieve the itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Iwapo utaumwa na mbu, unaweza kuweka kitambaa chenye maji baridi katika sehemu uliyoumwa ili kutuliza maumivu ya kuwashwa na kuvimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also take an over-the-counter antihistamine to relieve the symptoms of an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Pia unaweza kununua dawa iitwayo antihistamini ili kutuliza maumivu ya ishara za hisia ya mzio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are important carriers of disease.
entries.translation: Mbu ni wabebaji wakuu wa ugonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can transmit a variety of diseases, including malaria, dengue fever, and yellow fever.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kusambaza aina mbalimbali ya magonjwa, ikiwemo malaria, homa ya dengi, na homa ya manjano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are responsible for the deaths of millions of people each year.
entries.translation: Mbu ni wasababishi wa vifo vya mamilioni ya watu kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi yanayoweza kufanywa ili kudhibiti idadi ya mbu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to reduce the number of places where mosquitoes can breed.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ni kupunguza idadi ya sehemu ambazo mbu wanaweza kuzaliana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by draining standing water and clearing away vegetation.
entries.translation: Hili linaweza kufanyika kwa kuondoa maji yaliyosimama na kufyeka vichaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to control mosquito populations is to use insecticides.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kudhibiti idadi ya mbu ni kutumia kiuawadudu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insecticides can be used to kill mosquitoes both indoors and outdoors.
entries.translation: Kiuawadudu kinaweza kutumika kuua mbu walio ndani na nje ya nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are a major public health problem.
entries.translation: Mbu ni tatizo kubwa kwa afya ya umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations and reduce the risk of mosquito-borne diseases.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna mambo kadhaa yanayoweza kufanywa ili kudhibiti idadi za mbu na kupunguza hatari ya magonjwa yanayosababishwa na mbu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught that all beings are caught in a cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and that this cycle is perpetuated by our attachments to things in the world.
entries.translation: Alifunza kwamba binadamu wote wanapitia mzunguko wa kuzaliwa, kufa, na kuzaliwa upya, na kwamba mzunguko huu unaletwa kwa misingi ya uhusiano wetu na vitu katika dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These attachments can be to anything, from material possessions to ideas and beliefs.
entries.translation: Uhusiano huu unaweza kuwa kitu chochote, kuanzia kwa umiliki wa mali hadi mawazo na imani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are attached to something, we become possessive and controlling, and we suffer when we lose or cannot have what we want.
entries.translation: Tunapohusishwa na kitu, tunakuwa wamiliki na wenye udhibiti, na tunateseka tunapopoteza au kukosa kupata tunachohitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Buddha taught that the way to end suffering is to let go of our attachments.
entries.translation: Bhuddha alifundisha kuwa njia ya kuacha kuteseka ni kuachilia vitu tunavyoshikilia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is not easy, but it is possible through meditation and other spiritual practices.
entries.translation: Jambo hili siyo rahisi, lakini inawezekana kupitia sala ya moyo na matendo mengine ya kiroho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we let go of our attachments, we become free from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and we can experience true peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Tunapoachilia vitu tunavyoshikilia, tunakuwa huru dhidi ya mzunguko wa kuzaliwa, kufa, na kuzaliwa upya, na tunaweza kuwa na hali ya amani na furaha ya ukweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to remember when trying to let go of our attachments is that we are not our possessions.
entries.translation: Mojwapo ya mambo muhimu ya kukumbuka tunapojaribu  kuachilia vitu tunavyoshikilia ni kwamba hatujimiliki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not our ideas or beliefs.
entries.translation: Sisi siyo mawazo au imani zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are simply beings who are experiencing the world through our senses.
entries.translation: Sisi ni binadamu tu tunaopitia hali ya maisha duniani kupitia hisia zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can see ourselves in this way, it becomes easier to let go of the things that we think we need to be happy.
entries.translation: Tunapoweza kujiona kwa namna hii, inakuwa rahisi kuachilia mambo tunayofikiria kuwa tunayahitaji ili kuwa na furaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Letting go of our attachments does not mean that we have to give up everything.
entries.translation: Kuachilia vitu tunavyoshikilia hakumaanishi kuwa tunafaa kuachana na kila kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It simply means that we need to be able to let go of things when it is time.
entries.translation: Inamaanisha tu kwamba tunahitaji kuweza kuachilia vitu wakati wake unapofika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to be able to let go of the things that are no longer serving us, and we need to be able to let go of the things that we are attached to out of fear or insecurity.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuachilia vitu ambavyo havitufai tena, na tunahitaji kuachilia vitu ambavyo tuna uhusiano navyo juu ya uoga au shaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can let go of our attachments, we open ourselves up to a new world of possibilities.
entries.translation: Tunapoweza kuachilia uhusiano wetu, tunajifungua kwa ulimwengu mpya wenye nafasi tele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We become free to live our lives in a way that is true to ourselves, and we become free to experience the joy and happiness that is our birthright.
entries.translation: Tunakuwa huru kuishi maisha yetu kwa njia ya kuwa wakweli, na tunakuwa huru kupata raha na furaha ambayo ni haki yetu ya kuzaliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trains have been a vital part of transportation for centuries.
entries.translation: Treni zimekuwa sehemu muhimu sana ya usafiri kwa karne kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a safe, efficient, and reliable way to travel long distances.
entries.translation: Ni njia salama, rahisi, na tegemezi ya kusafiri masafa marefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the railroad industry requires regular updates to keep pace with the changing needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, tasnia ya reli inahitaji visasisho vya mara kwa mara ili kukidhi mahitaji yanayobadilika ya abiria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important updates that trains need is the installation of new safety features.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya visasisho muhimu ambavyo treni zinahitaji ni usakinishaji wa vipengele vipya vya usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been a number of high-profile train accidents, which have highlighted the need for better safety measures.
entries.translation: Miaka ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na ajali mbaya kadhaa za treni, ambazo zimefanya kuwe na hitaji la hatua bora za usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New safety features such as positive train control (PTC) can help prevent accidents by automatically stopping trains that are traveling too fast or that are about to collide with another train.
entries.translation: Vipengele vipya vya usalama kama vile kidhibiti chanya cha treni kinaweza kuzuia ajali kwa kusimamisha kiotomatiki treni zinazosafiri kwa kasi au zinazokaribia kugongana na treni nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important update that trains need is the installation of new technology.
entries.translation: Kisasisho kingine muhimu ambacho treni zinahitaji ni usakinishaji wa teknolojia mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, trains were powered by steam engines.
entries.translation: Zamani, treni ziliendeshwa kwa injini za mvuke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, steam engines are inefficient and pollute the environment.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, injini za mvuke hazifai na zinachafua mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, most trains are powered by diesel engines or electric motors.
entries.translation: Leo, treni nyingi zinaendeshwa kwa injini za dizeli au mota za umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These engines are more efficient and environmentally friendly.
entries.translation: Injini hizi zina ufanisi zaidi na hazichafui mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to safety and technology updates, trains also need to be updated to accommodate the needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Pamoja na visasisho vya usalama na teknolojia, pia treni zinahitaji kusasishwa ili kukidhi mahitaji ya abiria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been an increase in the number of passengers who travel by train.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na ongezeko la idadi ya abiria wanaosafiri kwa treni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to overcrowding on trains, which can make for a less comfortable and enjoyable experience.
entries.translation: Hii imesababisha msongamano wa watu kwenye treni, hali inayoweza kusababisha ukosefu starehe na kufurahia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been a talented painter, but after her loss, she found that she was no longer interested in painting pretty landscapes or still lifes.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mpakaji rangi mwenye mweledi, lakini baada ya kupoteza kwake, aligundua kuwa hakupendelea tena kupaka rangi mandhari na michoro ya vitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, she began to create dark, brooding works of art that reflected her inner turmoil.
entries.translation: Badala yake, alianza kuunda kazi nyeusi, za sanaa zinazoonyesha kusumbuka kwake kwa ndani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of her most famous paintings, "The Death of My Son," is a stark and disturbing image of a young boy lying in a coffin.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya michoro yake maarufu, "Kifo cha Mwanangu," ni picha ya kutatanisha ya mvulana mdogo akiwa amelala kwenye jeneza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's face is peaceful, but his body is twisted and contorted in pain.
entries.translation: Uso wa mvulana huyo umetulia, lakini mwili wake umekunjwa na kupindwa kwa uchungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The painting is full of symbolism, and it is clear that Mary is using her art to process her grief and anger.
entries.translation: Mchoro huo umejaa ishara, na ni dhahiri kuwa Mary anatumia sanaa yake kuwazia majonzi na hasira yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's shift in artistic style was not without its critics.
entries.translation: Uhamiaji wa Mary katika mtindo wa kisanaa haukukosa wakosoaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people accused her of being exploitative and insensitive.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watu walimshutumu kwa kuwa mdhalimu na mwenye kutojali hisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others said that her paintings were too depressing and that they should not be shown in public.
entries.translation: Wengine walisema kuwa michoro yake ilikuwa ikisababisha mfadhaiko na kuwa isingefaa kuonyeshwa kwa umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Mary refused to back down.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She believed that her art was important, and she wanted to share it with the world.
entries.translation: Aliamini kuwa sanaa yake ilikuwa muhimu, na alitaka kuishiriki na ulimwengu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's work eventually found an audience, and she became one of the most respected artists of her time.
entries.translation: Hatimaye kazi ya Mary ilipendwa na hadhira, na akawa mmojwapo wa wasanii ambao waliheshimiwa zaidi wakati wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her paintings are now considered to be masterpieces, and they are still studied and admired by people all over the world.
entries.translation: Sasa michoro yake inazingatiwa kuwa kazi bora, na bado inafanyiwa utafiti na kupendwa na watu ulimwenguni kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's story is a reminder that art can be a powerful tool for expression.
entries.translation: Simulizi ya Mary ni kikumbusho kuwa sanaa inaweza kuwa zana thabiti ya kujieleza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to process grief, anger, and other difficult emotions.
entries.translation: Inaweza kutumika kuwazia majonzi, hasira, na hisia-moyo zingine ngumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be used to communicate important messages about the human condition.
entries.translation: Pia inaweza kutumika kuwasilisha ujumbe muhimu kuhusu hali ya binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's paintings are a testament to the power of art, and they continue to inspire people to this day.
entries.translation: Michoro ya Mary ni ushuhuda wa sanaa thabiti, na inaendelea kuwahamasisha watu hadi leo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan is a country in northeastern Africa.
entries.translation: Sudan ni nchi inayopatikana kaskazini mashariki mwa Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan has a population of over 40 million people and a land area of over 1.8 million square kilometers.
entries.translation: Sudan ina zaidi ya watu milioni 40 na ardhi ya zaidi ya kilomita mraba milioni 1.8.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan's history is long and complex.
entries.translation: Historia ya Sudan ni ndefu na tata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The area has been inhabited by humans for thousands of years, and the first known civilization in Sudan was the Kingdom of Kush, which flourished from around 750 BC to 350 AD.
entries.translation: Watu wamekuwa wakiishi katika eneo hilo kwa maelfu ya miaka, na ustaarabu wa kwanza kujulikana nchini Sudan ulikuwa Ufalme wa Kush, ulioshamiri kuanzia 750 KK hadi 350 AD.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kush was a powerful kingdom that controlled much of the Nile River valley.
entries.translation: Falme ya Kush ilikuwa yenye nguvu sana iliyotawala kiasi kikubwa cha bonde la Mto Nile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 7th century AD, Sudan was conquered by the Arabs, who brought Islam to the region.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 7 AD, Sudan ilishindwa na Waarabu, walioleta Uislamu katika eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sudan was ruled by a series of Arab sultanates for centuries, until it was conquered by Egypt in 1821.
entries.translation: Sudan ilitawaliwa na msururu wa masultani wa Kiarabu kwa karne nyingi, hadi ilipotekwa na Misri mwaka wa 1821.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Egypt ruled Sudan until 1885, when it was conquered by the Mahdi, a religious leader who led a rebellion against Egyptian rule.
entries.translation: Misri iliitawala Sudan hadi mwaka wa 1885, ilipotekwa na Mahdi, kiongozo wa kidini aliyeongoza uasi dhidi ya utawala wa Misri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mahdi's rule was short-lived, and Sudan was reconquered by the British in 1898.
entries.translation: Utawala wa Mahdi ulikuwa wa muda mfupi, na Sudan ilitekwa na Uingereza mwaka wa 1898.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My dear daughter, I know you've been wondering about the nature of light and darkness.
entries.translation: Binti yangu mpendwa, najua umekuwa ukijiuliza kuhusu asili ya mwangaza na giza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a big question, and one that scientists have been trying to answer for centuries.
entries.translation: Ni suala kubwa, na ambalo wanasayansi wamekuwa wakijaribu kulijibu kwa karne nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I think I can give you a simple explanation that will help you understand it a little better.
entries.translation: Lakini nafikiri naweza kuwapa ufafanuzi rahisi utakaowasaidia kulielewa vizuri kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is a kind of energy that travels in waves.
entries.translation: Mwangaza ni aina ya nishati inayosafiri kwenye mawimbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can see light because it enters our eyes and stimulates the retina, which is a light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kuona mwangaza kwa sababu unaingia kwenye macho yetu na kusisimua retina, ambayo ni tishu ya hisia ya mwangaza upande wa nyuma wa jicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina sends signals to our brain, which interprets them as images.
entries.translation: Retina hutuma ishara kwenye ubongo wetu, na kuzisoma kama picha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness is the absence of light.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When there is no light, we can't see anything.
entries.translation: Wakati hakuna mwangaza, hatuwezi kuona chochote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light and darkness are two opposites, but they're also two sides of the same coin.
entries.translation: Mwangaza na giza ni vitu viwili tofauti, lakini pia vinahusiana kwa karibu licha ya kuwa tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is needed for us to see, but darkness is also important.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji mwangaza ili kuona, lakini pia giza ni muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness helps us to rest and sleep.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also creates a sense of mystery and wonder.
entries.translation: Pia linasababisha hisia ya mafumbo na staajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So next time you're outside at night, take a moment to appreciate the darkness.
entries.translation: Kwa hivyo wakati mwingine utakapokuwa nje usiku, chukua muda kidogo kuthamini giza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just as important as light, and it has its own beauty.
entries.translation: Lina umuhimu tu kama mwangaza, na lina ubora wake pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His daughter, Marcela, was listening to music that he didn't approve of.
entries.translation: Binti yake, kwa jina Marcela, alikuwa akisikiliza muziki ambao babake hakuupenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The lyrics were explicit and violent, and he didn't want his daughter exposed to that kind of material.
entries.translation: Maneno ya mzikiki huo yalikuwa chafu na yenye vurugu, na hakutaka binti yake ajihusishe na nyenzo za aina hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He tried to talk to her about it, but she just shrugged him off.
entries.translation: Alijaribu kuzungumza naye kuhusu jambo hilo, lakini binti yake alimpuuza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't know what else to do.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Esteban was listening to the radio when he heard a song that he thought Marcela would like.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Esteban alikuwa akisikiliza redio aliposikia wimbo ambao alifikiria kuwa Maecela angeupenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a catchy tune with a positive message.
entries.translation: Ulikuwa wimbo wa kuvutia uliokuwa na ujumbe murua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to burn a copy of the song and give it to her.
entries.translation: Aliamua kutengeneza nakala ya wimbo na kumpatia bintiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When she got home from school, he gave her the CD and told her to listen to it.
entries.translation: Alipofika nyumbani kutoka shuleni, alimpa CD na kumwambia asikilize wimbo huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marcela was surprised by the gift, but she was also intrigued.
entries.translation: Marcela alistaajabishwa na zawadi hiyo, lakini pia ilimvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She put the CD in her stereo and listened to the song.
entries.translation: Aliweka CD hiyo kwenye kinanda chake na kusikiliza wimbo huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She liked it so much that she listened to it over and over again.
entries.translation: Aliupenda sana kiasi kwamba aliusikiliza mara kwa mara tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, Esteban asked Marcela what she thought of the song.

entries.english: ## Road Safety: A True Door to a Safer Future
entries.translation: ## Usalama Barabarani: Mlango Kamili kwa Siku Salama Zijazo
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road safety is a major public health issue.
entries.translation: Usalama wa barabarani ni suala kuu la afya ya umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2020, an estimated 38,000 people were killed in motor vehicle crashes in the United States.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 2020, takribani watu 38,000 walikufa kwenye ajali za magari nchini Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's an average of one person every 135 minutes.
entries.translation: Huo ni wastani wa mtu mmoja baada ya kila dakika 135.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many things that can be done to improve road safety, including enforcing traffic laws, educating drivers and pedestrians, and making roads safer.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi yanayoweza kufanywa kuimarisha usalama barabarani, ukiwemo utekelezaji wa sheria za trafiki, kuwaelimisha madereva na wapita njia, na kufanya barabara ziwe salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One important step is to make sure that all vehicles have properly functioning doors.
entries.translation: Hatua moja muhimu ni kuhakikisha kuwa magari yote yana milango iliyo katika hali nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A door that doesn't open or close properly can be a major safety hazard.
entries.translation: Mlango ambao haufunguki au kufungika vizuri unaweza kuwa hatari kubwa kwa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If a door is stuck, it can prevent a person from escaping from a vehicle in the event of a crash.
entries.translation: Iwapo mlango umekwama, unaweza kumzuia mtu kutoka kwenye gari endapo ajali itatokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A door that opens too easily can also be dangerous, as it could allow a person to be ejected from the vehicle in a crash.
entries.translation: Pia mlango unaofunguka rahisi sana unaweza kuwa hatari, kwa sababu unaweza kumfanya mtu arushwe nje ya gari wakati wa ajali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to make sure that all doors on your vehicle are in good working order.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuhakikisha kuwa milango yote kwenye gari lako inafanya kazi vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a door that doesn't open or close properly, you should have it repaired or replaced as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Iwapo una mlango ambao haufunguki au kufungika vizuri, unafaa kuukarabati au kuubadilisha haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making sure that all vehicles have properly functioning doors, we can help to reduce the number of traffic-related deaths and injuries.
entries.translation: Kwa kuhakikisha kuwa magari yote yana milango inayofanya kazi vizuri, tunaweza kusaidia kupunguza idadi ya vifo na majeraha yanayohusiana na trafiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was driving down a tight road in a small town when I saw a sign that said "Parking Extra Tight."
entries.translation: Siku moja, nilikuwa nikiendesha gari kwenye barabara nyembamba katika mji mdogo nilipoona ishara iliyosema  "Maegesho ni Finyu Zaidi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I laughed and thought, "That's a funny way to say it!"
entries.translation: Nilicheka na kufikiria, "Hiyo ilikuwa mbinu ya ucheshi ya kusema hivyo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I realized that it was actually a very accurate description of the parking situation.
entries.translation: Lakini pia niligundua kuwa kwa kweli yalikuwa maelezo sahihi wa hali ya maegesho hayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The spaces were so narrow that I could barely fit my car in them.
entries.translation: Nafasi zilikuwa nyembamba sana kiasi kwamba gari langu halingeweza kutoshea hapo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had to pull in and out several times before I was finally able to get parked.
entries.translation: Ilinibidi niingie na kutoka mara kadhaa kabla hatimaye kuweza kuegesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was getting out of my car, I saw a man standing next to me.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nikishuka kwenye gari langu, nilimwona mwanamume mmoja amesimama karibu na mimi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He smiled and said, "I see you found the parking extra tight!"
entries.translation: Alitabasamu na kusema, "Ninaona ulipata maegesho kuwa finyu zaidi!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I laughed and said, "Yes, I did. But I finally made it!"
entries.translation: Nilicheka na kusema, "Ndiyo, yalikuwa finyu. Lakini hatimaye nilifaulu!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man shook my hand and said, "Welcome to our town. We're glad you're here,"
entries.translation: Mwanamume huyo alinisalimia kwa mkono na kusema, "Karibu katika mji wetu. Tunafurahia kuwa umekuja,"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled and said, "Thank you. I'm glad to be here."
entries.translation: Nilitabasamu na kusema "Asante. Ninafurahia kuwa hapa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I got into my car and drove away.
entries.translation: Niliingia kwenye gari langu na kuondoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was driving, I thought about the man's words.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nikiendesha, nilifikiria kuhusu maneno ya mwanamume huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was glad to be in that town.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a friendly place, and the people were welcoming.
entries.translation: Palikuwa sehemu ya kirafiki, na watu walikuwa wakarimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Mrs. Brown stood on the porch of her small cottage, watching the children play in the yard.
entries.translation: Mzee Bi. Brown alisimama katika ukumbi wa nyumba yake ndogo, akitazama watoto wakicheza ugani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled as she saw her granddaughter, Lily, run and jump with the other children.
entries.translation: Alitabasamu alipomwona mjukuu wake wa kike, Lily, akikimbia na kuruka na watoto wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily was a bright and cheerful child, and Mrs. Brown was proud of her.
entries.translation: Lily alikuwa mtoto mwerevu na mwenye furaha, na Bi. Brown alijivunia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown had been a grandmother for many years, and she had seen many changes in the world.
entries.translation: Bi. Brown amekuwa nyanya kwa miaka mingi, na alikuwa ameona mabadiliko mengi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had seen the rise and fall of empires, the birth and death of new technologies, and the coming and going of many different fashions.
entries.translation: Alikuwa ameona kuinuka na kuanguka kwa falme, kuvumbuliwa na kufa kwa teknlojia mpya, na kuwepo na kutoweka kwa mitindo mingi tofauti ya fasheni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But through it all, one thing had remained constant: the love between a grandmother and her grandchild.
entries.translation: Lakini licha ya hayo yote, kitu kimoja kilisalia vilevile: upendo kati ya nyanya na mjukuu wake wa kike.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown knew that she was not the only grandmother who felt this way.
entries.translation: Bi. Brown alifahamu kuwa hakuwa nyanya pekee aliyejihisi hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All over the world, there were grandmothers who loved their grandchildren just as much as she loved Lily.
entries.translation: Kote duniani, kulikuwa na kina nyanya waliowapenda wajukuu wao jinsi alivyompenda Lily.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And this love was a powerful force that could stand against anything.
entries.translation: Na upendo huu ulikuwa wa dhati ambao hakuna kitu chochote kingebatilisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown had seen the love between a grandmother and her grandchild stand against the ravages of time, the cruelty of war, and even the indifference of death.
entries.translation: Bi. Brown alikuwa ameshuhudia upendo kati ya nyanya na mjukuu wake ukinawiri katika nyakati ngumu, ukatili wa vita, na bila kujali kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that this love was a precious gift, and she was grateful for every day that she could spend with her granddaughter.
entries.translation: Alifahamu kuwa upendo huu ulikuwa zawadi ya thamani, na alishukuru kila siku kuwa angekaa na mjukuu wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has been used for warmth, cooking, and protection, and it has also played a role in shaping the landscape.
entries.translation: Umetumika kwa upashaji joto, mapishi, na ulinzi, na pia umehusika katika kutengeneza mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, however, the relationship between humans and fire has become increasingly complex.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, uhusiano kati ya binadamu na moto umezidi kuwa tata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change is making fires more frequent and more intense, and this is having a devastating impact on forests, homes, and lives.
entries.translation: Mabadiliko ya tabianchi yanasababisha visa vya moto kutokea mara kwa mara na kwa kiwango kikubwa, na hii inachangia kwa uharibifu mkubwa wa misitu, makazi, na maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people argue that the best way to deal with this problem is to suppress all fires.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watu wanasema kuwa njia bora ya kushughulikia tatizo hili ni kuzuia mioto yote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach has been used for centuries, but it is not always effective.
entries.translation: Mbinu hii imetumika kwa karne nyingi, lakini kila mara haifanikiwi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, it can sometimes make things worse.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, inaweza kusababisha athari kubwa wakati mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When fires are suppressed, they build up fuel and become more likely to cause a large, destructive fire.
entries.translation: Mioto inapozuiwa, inaongezeka kwa kiasi kikubwa na kuwa na uwezekano wa kusababisha moto mkubwa zaidi wenye uharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another approach is to let fires burn naturally.
entries.translation: Mbinu nyingine ni kuacha tu mioto iwake kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach can be effective in some cases, but it is not always safe or practical.
entries.translation: Mbinu hii inaweza kufaulu katika hali fulani, lakini mara nyingi siyo mbinu salama au yenye kuwezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many cases, it is necessary to intervene to protect people and property.
entries.translation: Katika hali nyingi, ni muhimu kuingilia ili kulinda watu na mali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to deal with fire is to find a balance between suppression and natural burning.
entries.translation: Njia bora ya kushughulikia moto ni kusawazisha kati ya uzuiaji na kuchomeka kwa kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach requires planning and cooperation, but it is the most effective way to reduce the risk of wildfires.
entries.translation: Mbinu hii inahitaji mipango na ushirikiano, lakini ni njia yenye ufanisi zaidi ya kupunguza hatari ya kuenea haraka kwa mioto ya nyikani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Resilience and adaptation are key to this approach.
entries.translation: Msingi wa mbinu hii ni ustahimilivu na ukabili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Resilience is the ability to withstand and recover from a disturbance, while adaptation is the ability to adjust to a changing environment.
entries.translation: Ustahimilivu ni uwezo wa kuhimili na kupona kutokana na usumbufu, huku ukabili ni uwezo wa kuendekeza katika mazingira yanayobadilika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both resilience and adaptation are important for humans and for ecosystems.
entries.translation: Ustahimilivu na ukabili ni muhimu kwa binadamu na kwa mifumo ya ikolojia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans can build resilience to fire by taking steps to reduce the risk of wildfires, such as clearing brush and creating firebreaks.
entries.translation: Binadamu wanaweza kujenga ustahimilivu kwa moto kwa kuchukua hatua za kupunguza hatari ya kuenea kwa moto mkubwa nyikani, kama vile kufyeka misitu na kuunda njia za kusitisha moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also adapt to fire by learning how to live in fire-prone areas.
entries.translation: Pia wanaweza kukabiliana na hali ya moto kwa kujifunza jinsi ya kuishi katika maeneo yanayokabiliwa na moto mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ecosystems can also be resilient to fire.
entries.translation: Pia mifumo ya ikolojia inaweza kustahimili moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fire is a natural part of many ecosystems, and it can actually help to maintain healthy forests.
entries.translation: Moto ni sehemu asili ya mifumo mingi ya ikolojia, na kwa kweli unaweza kusaidia kudumisha misitu bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When fires are suppressed, they can disrupt the natural cycle of fire and forest growth.
entries.translation: Mioto inapozuiwa, inaweza kukatiza msururu asili wa moto na ukuaji wa msitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, humans and ecosystems can build resilience to fire.
entries.translation: Kwa ushirikiano, bidanamu na mifumo ya ikolojia vinaweza kujenga ustahimilivu wa moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to reduce the risk of wildfires and protect lives and property.
entries.translation: Hii itasaidia kupunguza hatari ya kuenea kwa moto mkubwa nyikani na kulinda maisha na mali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, further investigation revealed that he had been poisoned with cyanide.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, uchunguzi zaidi ulifichua kuwa alikuwa ametiwa  sumu ya sianidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police are now looking for the person who killed Bilici.
entries.translation: Sasa polisi wanamtafuta mtu aliyemuua Bilici.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bilici was a successful businessman who had made a lot of enemies in his time.
entries.translation: Bilici alikuwa mfanyabiashara mashuhuri aliyekuwa na maadui wengi wakati wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was known to be ruthless and ambitious, and he had no qualms about stepping on people to get what he wanted.
entries.translation: Alijulikana kuwa mtu asiye na huruma na mwenye tamaa, na hakuwa na wasiwasi wowote kuwadhulumu watu ili kupata alichokitaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is likely that one of his enemies killed him in an attempt to get revenge.
entries.translation: Kuna uwezekano kuwa mmojawapo wa maadui zake alimuua kwa jaribio la kulipiza kisasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police are currently interviewing Bilici's friends, family, and business associates in an attempt to find out who killed him.

entries.english: But I'm just not sure if I'm ready to give up my Android.
entries.translation: Lakini sina uhakika kabisa iwapo niko tayari kuacha Android yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tudor: Well, you could always try it out for a week or two and see how you like it.
entries.translation: Tudor: Naam, unaweza kuijaribu kwa wiki au wiki mbili uone jinsi utakavyoipenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't like it, you can always switch back to your Android.
entries.translation: Iwapo hutaipenda, unaweza kurejelea Android yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
