entries.english: A typical day for a person in Senegal begins early in the morning.
entries.translation: Siku ya kawaida kwa mtu nchini Senegal inaanza asubuhi na mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most people wake up before sunrise to pray and eat breakfast.
entries.translation: Watu wengi wanaamka kabla ya macheo ili kusali na kushiriki kiamsha kinywa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Breakfast is typically a simple meal of bread, tea, or porridge.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida kiamsha kinywa ni mlo mwepesi wa mkate, chai, au uji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After breakfast, people go about their daily activities, which may include working in the fields, trading in the market, or going to school.
entries.translation: Baada ya kiamsha kinywa, watu huelekea shughuli zao za kila siku, ikiwemo kufanya kazi mashambani, kufanya biashara sokoni, au kuenda shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The workday typically ends in the early evening, and people return home to eat dinner and relax.
entries.translation: Kwa kawaida siku ya kazi huisha mapema jioni, na watu wanarudi nyumbani kushiriki chajio na kupumzika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dinner is often a more elaborate meal than breakfast, and may include rice, beans, or fish.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi chajio huwa mlo mwingi kuliko kiamsha kinywa, na kinaweza kuwa wali, maharagwe, au samaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After dinner, people may spend time with their families or friends, or watch television.
entries.translation: Baada ya chajio, watu wanaweza kukaa na jamaa na marafiki zao, au watazame televisheni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most people go to bed around 10:00 PM.
entries.translation: Watu wengi wanaenda kulala karibu 10:00 usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The daily life of a person in Senegal is shaped by the country's culture and traditions.
entries.translation: Maisha ya kila siku ya mtu nchini Senegal yanategemea utamaduni na desturi za nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegalese culture is based on Islam, and most people in Senegal are Muslims.
entries.translation: Utamaduni wa Senegal unategemea Uislamu, na watu wengi nchini Senegal ni Waislamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Islamic faith plays an important role in everyday life, and many Senegalese people attend prayers five times a day.
entries.translation: Imani ya Kiislamu inatekeleza wajibu muhimu katika maisha ya kila siku, na watu wengi wa Senegal wanahudhuria maombi mara tano kwa siku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegalese culture is also influenced by the country's history, which includes a period of French colonialism.
entries.translation: Pia utamaduni wa Senegal unaathiriwa na historia ya nchi hiyo, ikiwemo kipindi cha ukoloni wa Ufaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The French language is widely spoken in Senegal, and many Senegalese people have French names.
entries.translation: Lugha ya Kifaransa inazungumzwa na watu wengi nchini Senegal, na watu wengi wa Senegal wana majina ya Kifaransa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it comes to bedroom furniture and design accessories, there are many things to consider.
entries.translation: Kuhusiana na samani na vifaa vya usanifu vya chumbani, kuna mambo mengi ya kuzingatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You want to create a space that is both stylish and functional, and that fits your personality.
entries.translation: Unataka kuunda nafasi ambayo ni ya kimtindo na kukufaa, na inayokidhi haiba yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But with so many different options available, it can be hard to know where to start.
entries.translation: Lakini kwa sababu ya chaguo nyingo tofauti zilizopo, inaweza kuwa vigumu kufahamu pa kuanzia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One important thing to keep in mind is the overall vibe you want to create in your bedroom.
entries.translation: Jambo moja muhimu la kukumbuka ni mandhari ya kiujumla unayotaka kuunda chumbani mwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do you want a space that is relaxing and inviting, or something more energetic and stimulating?
entries.translation: Je, unataka mandhari tulivu na yanayokaribisha, au yanayohitaji nguvu na msisimko zaidi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you're looking for, you can start to narrow down your choices.
entries.translation: Mara unapofahamu unachotaka, unaweza kuanza kuzingatia chaguo zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a relaxing and inviting bedroom, consider choosing neutral colors and soft fabrics.
entries.translation: Iwapo unatafuta chumba cha kulala chenye mandhari tulivu yanayopendeza, zingatia rangi za usawaziko na vitambaa laini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid anything too bright or loud, as this can create a negative atmosphere.
entries.translation: Epuka rangi yoyote yenye nuru au angavu, kwa kuwa hii inaweza kusababisha uangavu hasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure there is plenty of comfortable seating, such as a bed, armchair, or chaise lounge.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kuhakikisha kuwa kuna sehemu nyingi bora za kukaa, kama vile kitanda, sofa, au kochi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a more energetic and stimulating bedroom, you can choose bolder colors and patterns.
entries.translation: Iwapo utataka chumba kinachohitaji nguvu na msisimko zaidi, unaweza kuchagua rangi na ruwaza kolevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also add in some interesting design elements, such as a statement piece of furniture or a unique light fixture.
entries.translation: Pia unaweza kuongeza baadhi ya vipengele vinavyovutia vya usanifu, kama vile samani iliyo na maandishi au picha ya kipekee yenye mwangaza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just be careful not to overdo it, as too much stimulation can be overwhelming.
entries.translation: Tahadhari tu kutopita kiasi, kwa kuwa msisimko zaidi unaweza kuwa balaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, no bedroom is complete without a comfortable bed.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, hakuna chumba kamilifu kilisichokuwa na kitanda chenye starehe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember when you were little, you loved going to the beach during the holidays.
entries.translation: Ninakumbuka ulipokuwa mdogo ulipenda kwenda pwani wakati wa likizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You would spend hours playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.
entries.translation: Ungechukua saa nyingi ukichezea mchangani na kuogelea baharini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember one time, you were so excited to build a sandcastle that you didn't even want to go swimming.
entries.translation: Ninakumbuka siku moja, ulifurahia sana kujenga ngome ya mchanga kiasi kwamba hata hukutaka kwenda kuogelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You worked on that castle for hours, and when it was finally finished, it was the most amazing sandcastle I had ever seen.
entries.translation: Ulitumia saa nyingi kujenga ngome hiyo, na ilipokamilika, iliibuka kuwa ngome bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You were so proud of yourself, and I was so proud of you.
entries.translation: Ulijivunia sana, na pia nilijivunia wewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember taking a picture of you standing next to your castle, and you had the biggest smile on your face.
entries.translation: Nakumbuka nikikupiga picha kama umesimama kando ya ngome yako na ulikuwa na tabasamu kubwa usoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That was one of my favorite memories of our holidays together.
entries.translation: Hiyo ilikuwa mojawapo ya kumbukumbu yangu pendwa tukiwa pamoja likizoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you're older now, and you might not like the beach as much as you used to.
entries.translation: Ninajua sasa wewe ni mtu mzima, na huenda usipende tena kwenda ufuoni jinsi ilivyokuwa awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I hope you'll always remember the joy you used to find in playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.
entries.translation: Lakini najua kila mara utakumbuka furaha uliyokuwa ukipata kwa kuchezea mchanga na kuogelea baharini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Those are some of the best memories of my life, and I hope they're some of yours too.
entries.translation: Hizi ndizo baadhi ya kumbukumbu bora zaidi za maisha yangu, na natumai pia nawe unazikumbuka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kindness is one of the most important virtues that a person can possess.
entries.translation: Ukarimu ni mojawapo ya maadili muhimu zaidi ambayo mtu anaweza kuwa nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the act of being considerate and thoughtful of others, and it is something that can make a real difference in the world.
entries.translation: Ni kitendo cha kuthamini na kuwafikiria wengine, na jambo ambalo linaweza kuleta utofauti halisi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A kind word, a smile, or a helping hand can go a long way to brighten someone's day and make them feel better about themselves.
entries.translation: Neno la ukarimu, tabasamu, au kumsaidia mtu kunaweza kuangaza siku ya mtu na kumfanya ajihisi vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to show kindness.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti za kuonyesha ukarimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can volunteer your time at a local soup kitchen or homeless shelter, donate to a charity that you believe in, or simply be a good listener to someone who is going through a tough time.
entries.translation: Unaweza kujitolea muda wako katika kibanda cha supu cha mtaani au kukaa na wasio na makao, kuchangia misaada ya hisani ambayo unaiamini, au kuwa tu msikilizaji bora kwa mtu anayepitia hali ngumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how big or small the act, kindness is always appreciated.
entries.translation: Haijalishi kitendo kuwa kikubwa au kidogo, kila mara ukarimu unathaminiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a simple act that can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Ni kitendo rahisi kinachoweza kuleta utofauti mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So next time you see someone who could use a little help, don't hesitate to reach out and lend a hand.
entries.translation: Kwa hivyo wakati mwingine utakapomwona mtu anayehitaji msaada kidogo, usisite kumfikia na kumsaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might just make their day.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One classic example of kindness is the story of the Good Samaritan.
entries.translation: Mfano mmoja murwa wa ukarimu ni hadithi ya Msamaria Mwema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In this story, a man is beaten and left for dead on the side of the road.
entries.translation: Katika hadithi hii, mwanamume alipigwa na kuachwa akiwa mahututi kando ya barabara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two men pass by, but they do not help him.
entries.translation: Wanaume wawili walipita hapo, lakini hawakumsaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, a third man, who is a Samaritan, stops to help the injured man.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, mwanamume wa tatu, ambaye ni Msamaria, alisimama na kumsaidia mwanamume aliyejeruhiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I walked through the crowded festival grounds, I couldn't help but smile.
entries.translation: Kadri nilivyotembea kwenye umati wa watu katika viwanja vya tamasha, nilishindwa kujidhibiti ila kutabasamu tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sun was shining, the music was blaring, and everyone was wearing their sunglasses and eyeglasses.
entries.translation: Jua lilikuwa likiwaka, muziki ulikuwa ukicheza, na kila mmoja alikuwa amevalia miwani ya jua na miwani ya macho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like a sea of color and style, and it made me feel happy to be a part of it.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa kama bahari ya rangi na mitindo, na nilifurahia sana kujumuika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I saw people wearing all sorts of different glasses, from simple, round frames to elaborate, cat-eye shapes.
entries.translation: Niliona watu wakivalia aina mbalimbali za miwani, kutoka rahisi, zenye fremu mduara hadi sanifu, miundo ya macho ya paka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were sunglasses in every color of the rainbow, and some people even had glasses that lit up or changed colors.
entries.translation: Kulikuwa na miwani ya kila aina ya rangi ya upinde wa mvua, na watu wengine walikuwa na miwani ambayo iliweza kuwaka au kubadilisha rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like a fashion show, and I couldn't help but admire everyone's unique style.
entries.translation: Yalikuwa ni kama maonyesho ya fasheni, na niliweza kupenda kila mtindo wa kipekee wa kila mmoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stopped to talk to a woman who was wearing a pair of bright yellow sunglasses.
entries.translation: Nilisimama ili kuzungumza na mwanamke aliyekuwa amevalia miwani ya rangi ya manjano angavu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told me that she loved wearing sunglasses because they made her feel more confident and stylish.
entries.translation: Aliniambia kuwa anapenda kuvalia miwani kwa sababu inamfanya kujihisi jasiri na mwenye mtindo zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that she always felt like she was wearing a costume when she didn't have her glasses on, and that they helped her to express her personality.
entries.translation: Alisema kuwa mara kwa mara alijihisi kana kwamba anavalia maleba wakati hajavaa miwani yake, na kuwa ilimsaidia kuonyesha utu wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I continued on my way, and I couldn't help but feel more optimistic about the world.
entries.translation: Niliendelea na safari yangu, na nikaendelea tu kuwa na matumaini zaidi kuhusu dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Online shopping is the process of buying goods or services from a retailer over the Internet.
entries.translation: Ununuzi wa mtandaoni ni mchakato wa kununua bidhaa na huduma kutoka kwa muuzaji wa rejareja kupitia Intaneti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is different from traditional shopping in that the consumer does not physically visit a store to purchase the product.
entries.translation: Ni tofauti na ununuzi wa jadi kwa kuwa mtumiaji hatembelei duka ili kununua bidhaa kihalisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, the consumer browses through products and makes purchases online.
entries.translation: Badala yake, mtumiaji hukagua bidhaa na kufanya ununuzi mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The consumer then receives the product at their home address.
entries.translation: Kisha mtumiaji hupokea bidhaa kwa anwani yake ya nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to online shopping.
entries.translation: Kuna faida nyingi kwenye ununuzi wa mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is often more convenient than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Kwanza, mara nyingi ni rahisi kuliko ununuzi wa jadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers can shop from the comfort of their own home, at any time of day or night.
entries.translation: Watumiaji wanaweza kununua kutoka nyumbani kwao, wakati wowote wa siku au usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also compare prices from different retailers and read reviews of products before making a purchase.
entries.translation: Pia wanaweza kulinganisha bei kutoka kwa wauzaji wa rejareja tofauti na kusoma ukaguzi wa bidhaa kabla ya kufanya ununuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, online shopping can be more affordable than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Pili, ununuzi wa mtandaoni unaweza kuwa nafuu kuliko ununuzi wa jadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many retailers offer discounts and promotions on their online products.
entries.translation: Wauzaji wengi wa rejareja wanatoa mapunguzo na matangazo kwenye bidhaa zao za mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, online shopping can be more environmentally friendly than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Tatu, ununuzi wa mtandaoni unaweza kuwa bora kwa mazingira kuliko ununuzi wa jadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers do not have to drive to the store, which reduces emissions.
entries.translation: Watumiaji hawaendeshi magari hadi kwenye duka, jambo linalopunguza gesi za uchafuzi wa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also some drawbacks to online shopping.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, pia kuna changamoto za ununuzi wa mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, consumers cannot try on clothes or test out products before they buy them.
entries.translation: Kwanza, watumiaji hawawezi kujaribu kuvaa nguo au kujaribu bidhaa kabla ya kuzinunua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to disappointment if the product does not fit or meet the consumer's expectations.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha masikitiko iwapo bidhaa haitimizi au kukidhi matarajio ya mtumiaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, online shopping can be more risky than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Pili, ununuzi wa mtandaoni unaweza kuwa hatari kuliko ununuzi wa jadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers need to be careful about providing their credit card information online.
entries.translation: Watumiaji wanahitaji kutahadhari kuhusu kutoa maelezo yao ya kadi ya mkopo mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of space technology is a relatively short one, but it has already had a profound impact on our world.
entries.translation: Historia ya teknolojia ya anga ni fupi kiasi, lakini tayari imekuwa na athari kubwa katika dunia yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 1950s, the United States and the Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellites into orbit, ushering in a new era of space exploration.
entries.translation: Miaka ya 1950, Marekani na Urusi ziliunda setilaiti bandia kwenye uzingo, kukaribisha enzi mpya ya uchunguzi wa anga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, we have sent humans to the Moon, built space stations, and launched countless satellites into orbit.
entries.translation: Tangu wakati huo, tumewatuma binadamu kwenye Mwezi, tumejenga vituo vya angani, na kuzindua setilaiti nyingi kwenye kizingo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These achievements have not only led to new scientific discoveries, but they have also made our world more interconnected and has given us a new perspective on our place in the universe.
entries.translation: Mafanikio haya hayajasababisha tu ugunduzi mpya wa kisayansi, lakini pia yamefanya dunia yetu kuunganishwa zaidi na yametupa mtazamo mpya kuhusu nafasi yetu ulimwenguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, space technology is used for a wide variety of purposes, including telecommunications, navigation, weather forecasting, and Earth observation.
entries.translation: Leo hii, teknolojia ya angani inatumika kwa malengo mbalimbali, ikiwemo mawasiliano ya simu, uabiri, utabiri wa hali ya hewa, na uangalizi wa Dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As space technology continues to develop, it is likely to play an even greater role in our lives.
entries.translation: Kadri teknolojia ya angani inavyoendelea kukua, kuna uwezekano wa kufanya hata kitu kibwa zaidi maishani mwetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the future, we may see humans colonizing Mars, mining asteroids for resources, and using space-based solar power to generate electricity.
entries.translation: Siku zijazo, huenda tukaona binadamu wakianzisha utendakazi kwa Mirihi, kuchimbua rasilimali kwenye asteroidi, na kutumia nishati ya jua inayotegemea anga kuzalisha umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On a warm July day, a group of friends clustered outside in the shade of a large tree, enjoying the sunshine and each other's company.
entries.translation: Siku moja tulivu mwezi wa Julai, kikundi cha marafiki kilikusanyika nje chini ya kivuli cha mti mkubwa, wakifurahia jua na kuwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were talking about books, their favorite authors, and the latest releases.
entries.translation: Walikuwa wakizungumza kuhusu vitabu, waandishi wanaowapenda, na matoleo ya sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The characters were so well-developed and the plot was so intriguing.
entries.translation: Wahusika walipangiliwa vizuri na mtiririko ulikuwa wa kuvutia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I couldn't wait to find out what happened next" Her friends all agreed that they had enjoyed the book as well.
entries.translation: Nisingeweza kusubiri kufahamu kilichotokea kwenye ukurasa uliofuatia" Marafiki zake wote walikubali kuwa walikuwa wamefurahia kitabu hicho vilevile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They talked about the different things they had liked about it, and they shared their own thoughts about the characters and the plot.
entries.translation: Walizungumza kuhusu mambo tofauti walioyapenda kukihusu, na walishiriki mawazo yao binafsi kuhusu wahusika na mtiririko wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also talked about other books they had read recently, and they exchanged recommendations for new books to read.
entries.translation: Pia walizungumza kuhusu vitabu vingine walivyokuwa wamevisoma hivi karibuni, na walipendekezania vitabu vipya vya kusoma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The friends talked for hours, enjoying the sunshine and each other's company.
entries.translation: Marafiki hao walizungumza kwa saa nyingi, wakifurahia jua na hali ya kuwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They laughed and talked and shared their love of books.
entries.translation: Walicheka na kuzungumza na kushiriki kuhusu upendo wao wa vitabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmer suicides are a serious problem in many parts of the world.
entries.translation: Kujitoa uhai kwa wakulima ni tatizo kubwa katika sehemu nyingi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In India, for example, an estimated 10,000 farmers kill themselves every year.
entries.translation: Nchini India, kwa mfano, inakadiriwa kuwa wakulima 10,000 wanajitoa uhai kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many reasons for this, including debt, crop failure, and lack of government support.
entries.translation: Kuna sababu nyingi zinazochangia, zikiwemo madeni, kuharibika kwa mazao, na usokefu wa msaada wa serikali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers are often under a great deal of pressure to make ends meet.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi wakulima wanashinikizwa sana kukidhi mahitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may have large debts to repay, and they may be at the mercy of the weather and other factors beyond their control.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kuwa na madeni makubwa ya kulipa, na huenda wanategemea tu hali ya hewa na visababishi vingine ambavyo hawawezi kuvidhibiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When crops fail, farmers can lose everything they have worked for.
entries.translation: Mimea inapoharibika, wakulima hupoteza kila kitu walichokifanyia kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may be unable to pay their debts, and they may be forced to sell their land or livestock.
entries.translation: Huenda wakashindwa kulipa madeni yao, na wanaweza kulazimika kuuza shamba au mifugo yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a feeling of hopelessness and despair, which can in turn lead to suicide.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha kukata tamaa na kufa moyo, ambapo matokeo yake ni kujitoa uhai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The government can play a role in helping to prevent farmer suicides.
entries.translation: Serikali inaweza kuwajibika katika kusaidia kuzuia kujitoa uhai kwa wakulima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One important step is to provide farmers with access to credit and other financial assistance.
entries.translation: Hatua moja muhimu ni kuwawezesha wakulima kufikia mikopo na usaidizi mwingine wa kifedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The government can also provide farmers with training and education, so that they can learn new ways to farm and increase their productivity.
entries.translation: Pia serikali inaweza kutoa mafunzo na elimu kwa wakulima, ili waweze kufahamu njia mpya za kilimo na kuongeza mazao yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the government can work to improve the lives of farmers by providing them with better access to healthcare, education, and other social services.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, serikali inaweza kuboresha maisha ya wakulima kwa kuwawezesha kufikia huduma bora za afya, elimu na huduma nyingine za kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmer suicides are a tragic problem, but they are one that can be solved.
entries.translation: Kujitoa uhai kwa wakulima ni tatizo la kusikitisha, lakini ni jambo ambalo linaweza kusuluhishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only the sky god, Anu, and the earth goddess, Ki.
entries.translation: Hapo mwanzo, kulikuwa tu na mungu wa anga, Anu, na mungu wa kike wa ardhi, Ki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had many children, including the moon god, Nanna, and the sun god, Utu.
entries.translation: Walikuwa na watoto wengi, wakiwemo mungu wa mwezi, Nanna, na mungu wa jua, Utu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Nanna fell in love with a mortal woman named Ninsun.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Nanna alimpenda mwanamke mfaji kwa jina Ninsun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had a son together, Enlil, who would become the god of the wind.
entries.translation: Walipata mtoto wa kiume, Enlil, ambaye baadaye alikuwa mungu wa upepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Enlil was a powerful and ambitious god.
entries.translation: Enlil alikuwa mungu mwenye nguvu na mwenye tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He wanted to be the most important god in the world, and he was willing to do whatever it took to achieve his goal.
entries.translation: Alikuwa akitaka kuwa mungu mkuu sana duniani, na alikuwa tayari kufanya lolote ili kufanikisha lengo lake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, he decided to capture all of the other gods and lock them away in a cave.
entries.translation: Siku moja, aliamua kuwakamata miungu wengine wote na kuwafungia mbali kwenye pango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He thought that this would make him the most powerful god in the world.
entries.translation: Alidhania kuwa jambo hili lingemfanya kuwa mungu mwenye nguvu zaidi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the other gods were not happy being locked away.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, miungu wengine hawakufurahia kufungiwa mbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They decided to escape, and they asked Ninsun for help.
entries.translation: Waliamua kutoroka, na wakamwomba Ninsun msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ninsun agreed to help them, and she devised a plan.
entries.translation: Ninsun alikubali kuwasaidia, na akabuni mpango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told Enlil that she had a gift for him, and she brought him a small box.
entries.translation: Alimwambia Enlil kwamba alikuwa na zawadi yake, na akamletea kijisanduku kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Enlil opened the box, and inside he found a beautiful woman.
entries.translation: Enlil alifungua kijisanduku hicho, na ndani yake akapata mwanamke mrembo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was immediately smitten, and he forgot all about the other gods.
entries.translation: Alipagawa mara moja, na akasahau yote kuhusu miungu wale wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman was actually a trap.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli mwanamke huyo alikuwa mtego tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Battle of Isly was a decisive victory for the French against the Moroccans on 14 August 1844.
entries.translation: Vita vya Isly ulikuwa ushindi mkubwa wa Ufaransa dhidi ya Wamoroko tarehe 14 Agosti 1844.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It took place near the village of Isly, near Oujda, in northeastern Morocco.
entries.translation: Vilitokea karibu na kijiji cha Isly, karibu na Oujda, kaskazini mashariki mwa Moroko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The French army, led by General Thomas Bugeaud, was outnumbered by the Moroccan army, but the French were better armed and had superior tactics.
entries.translation: Jeshi la Ufaransa, likiongozwa na Jenerali Thomas Bugeaud, lilikuwa na idadi ndogo ikilinganishwa na jeshi la Moroko, lakini Wafaransa walikuwa wamejihami vilivyo na walikuwa na mbinu bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The French won the battle after a long and bloody fight, and the Moroccans were forced to sue for peace.
entries.translation: Ufaransa walishinda vita baada ya mapigano marefu na yenye umwagikaji damu, na Wamoroko walilazimika kusalimu amri na kutaka amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The battle was a major turning point in the French conquest of Morocco, and it helped to secure French control over the country.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilikuwa hatua kubwa ya mabadiliko katika ushindi wa Ufaransa dhidi ya Moroko, na vilisaidia kuwezesha udhibiti wa Ufaransa dhidi ya nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A mother is a person who gives you unconditional love, support, and guidance.
entries.translation: Mama ni mtu anayekuonyesha upendo usio na masharti, kukupa msaada, na mwongozo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is always there for you, no matter what.

entries.english: A mother is a teacher, a friend, a confidant.

entries.english: She is the one who teaches you how to live life and how to be a good person.

entries.english: A mother's love is a powerful force.

entries.english: It can heal the sick, it can lift the spirits, and it can make anything possible.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A mother's love is a gift that should be cherished.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama ni zawadi inayofaa kuthaminiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be celebrated and honored.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On this Mother's Day, take some time to thank your mother for everything she has done for you.
entries.translation: Siku hii ya kina Mama, chukua muda wa kumshukuru mama yako kwa kila kitu alichokufanyia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her how much you love and appreciate her.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And most importantly, show her how much you love her by being the best person you can be.
entries.translation: Na muhimu zaidi, mwonyeshe jinsi unavyompenda kwa kuwa mtu bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be damaged by light, heat, humidity, and even the slightest touch.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuharibiwa na mwangaza, joto, unyevu, na hata mguso mdogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why it's important to take care of art, especially if you're a collector.
entries.translation: Kwa sababu hiyo ni muhimu kutunza sanaa, hasa iwapo wewe ni mkusanyaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for art is to keep it in a controlled environment.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu muhimu unavyoweza kufanya ili kutunza sanaa ni kuiweka katika mazingira yanayoweza kudhibitiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means keeping the temperature and humidity at a constant level, and protecting the art from direct sunlight.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuwa kuweka viwango visivyobadilika vya halijoto na unyevu, na kukinga sanaa dhidi ya jua la moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid exposing art to dust and dirt, and make sure it's not hung too close to a heat source.
entries.translation: Pia unafaa kuepuka kuweka sanaa kwenye vumbi au uchafu, na uhakikishe kuwa haijaangikwa karibu sana kwa chanzo cha joto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about how to care for your art, you should consult with a professional conservator.
entries.translation: Iwapo una maswali yoyote kuhusu jinsi ambavyo unaweza kutunza sanaa yako, unaweza kupata ushauri kutoka kwa mhifadhi mtaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help you create a care plan that's specific to your collection.
entries.translation: Anaweza kukusaidia kuunda mpango maalum wa kutunza sanaa yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are a few additional tips for caring for art:
entries.translation: Hivi hapa ni baadhi ya vidokezo vichache vya ziada vya kutunza sanaa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Don't touch the art with your bare hands.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use gloves or tissue paper to handle it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Avoid hanging art in direct sunlight.
entries.translation: * Epuka kuangika sanaa kwenye jua la moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Keep art away from heat sources, such as fireplaces and radiators.
entries.translation: * Weka sanaa mbali na vyanzo vya joto, kama vile maeneo ya moto na redieta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Protect art from dust and dirt by dusting it regularly with a soft brush.
entries.translation: * Kinga saana dhidi ya vumbi na uchafu kwa kuipangusa mara kwa mara kwa brashi laini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dimly lit or dark places can be both mysterious and alluring.
entries.translation: Maeneo yenye mwanga hafifu au giza yanaweza kuwa ya ajabu na kuvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can provide a sense of seclusion and privacy, but they can also be dangerous and frightening.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kusababisha hali ya upekee na faragha, lakini pia yanaweza kuwa hatari na ya kuogofya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In literature, dark and dim places are often used to create a sense of suspense or horror.
entries.translation: Kwenye fasihi, mara nyingi maeneo yenye giza na mwanga hafifu yanatumika kusababisha hali ya fukuto au kuogofya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, in Edgar Allan Poe's "The Tell-Tale Heart," the narrator's description of the dark room in which he murders the old man is both chilling and evocative.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, kwenye kitabu cha Edgar Allan Poe kiitwacho "The Tell-Tale Heart," ufafanuzi wa msimulizi kuhusu chumba chenye giza ambamo anamuua mzee ni wa kutisha na kuamsha hisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In real life, dark and dim places can also be dangerous.
entries.translation: Katika maisha halisi, pia maeneo yenye giza na mwanga hafifu yanaweza kuwa hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be difficult to navigate, and they can provide cover for criminals.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kuwa vigumu kupita, na yanaweza kuwa maficho ya wahalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, dark places can make people feel vulnerable and afraid.
entries.translation: Pia, maeneo yenye giza yanaweza kuwafanya watu wajihisi wadhaifu na wenye uoga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For this reason, it is important to be aware of your surroundings and to take precautions when entering a dark or dimly lit area.
entries.translation: Kwa sababu hii, ni muhimu kufahamu mazingira yako na kutahadhari unapoingia katika eneo lenye giza au mwanga hafifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, dark and dim places can also be beautiful and inspiring.
entries.translation: Licha ya uwezekano wa hatari, pia maeneo yenye giza na mwanga hafifu yanaweza kupendeza na kuvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can provide a sense of peace and tranquility, and they can be conducive to creativity and reflection.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kusababisha hali ya amani na utulivu, na yanaweza kufaa kwa ubunifu na kutafakari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, many artists and writers have found inspiration in the darkness.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, wasanii na waandishi wengi wamepata msukumo gizani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vincent van Gogh, for example, was known for painting in the dark, and his work often reflects the beauty and mystery of the night.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, Vincent van Gogh, alifahamika kwa kupaka rangi gizani, na mara nyingi kazi yake inaonyeha urembo na maajabu ya usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change has ravaged the planet, and many major cities have been abandoned.
entries.translation: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa yameharibu sayari, na miji mingi mikubwa imetelekezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The few remaining humans live in small, isolated communities, struggling to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world.
entries.translation: Binadamu wachache wanaosalia wanaishi katika jamii ndogo, zilizotengwa, wanapambana kujikimu katika dunia katili isiyo na huruma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one of these communities, there is a young woman named Sneha who is training to be a long-distance runner.
entries.translation: Katika mojawapo ya jamii hizi, kuna mwanamke kijana kwa jina Sneha ambaye anafanya mazoezi ya kuwa mwanariadha wa masafa marefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has always been a gifted athlete, and she dreams of one day competing in the Olympics.
entries.translation: Amekuwa mwanariadha mwenye kipaji, na ndoto zake ni kuwa siku moja ashiriki katika mashindano ya Olimpiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Sneha knows that the odds are stacked against her.
entries.translation: Lakini Sneha anajua kuwa hawezi kufanikiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is from a small, impoverished community, and she has no financial support.
entries.translation: Anatoka katika jamii ndogo, yenye umaskini, na hana msaada wa kifedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Sneha is approached by a man named Silas who represents a large sportswear company.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Sneha alitembelewa na mwanamume kwa jina Silas ambaye ni mwakilishi wa kampuni kubwa ya mavazi ya michezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Silas tells Sneha that he is impressed by her running ability, and he offers to sponsor her.
entries.translation: Silas anamwambia Sneha kuwa amefurahishwa na uwezo wake wa kukimbia, na anajitolea kumfadhili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sneha is hesitant at first, but she eventually agrees to sign with Silas.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni Sneha anasita, lakini hatimaye anakubali kusajiliwa na Silas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With Silas's financial backing, Sneha is able to train full-time and travel to the best competitions.
entries.translation: Kwa msaada wa kifedha wa Silas, Sneha anaweza kufanya mazoezi siku nzima na kusafiri kwenye mashindano bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She quickly becomes one of the top long-distance runners in the world.
entries.translation: Kwa haraka anakuwa mmojawapo wa wanariadha bora wa masafa marefu duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Sneha is not content with just being a champion.
entries.translation: Lakini Sneha hatosheki kwa kuwa bingwa tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Karim and Abed had been friends since they were kids.
entries.translation: Karim na Abed walikuwa marafiki tangu utotoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They grew up together, went to the same schools, and even played on the same sports teams.
entries.translation: Walikua pamoja, wakasoma shule moja, na hata wakachezea timu moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had a bond that was like no other.
entries.translation: Walikuwa na mshikamano wa karibu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could talk about anything, and they always knew that they could count on each other.
entries.translation: Wangezungumzia jambo lolote, na walijua kuwa wangefaana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Karim was diagnosed with cancer.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Karim alifanyiwa uchunguzi na kupatikana na ugonjwa wa saratani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was devastated, but he knew that he had Abed to lean on.
entries.translation: Alihisi vibaya sana, lakini alijua kuwa alikuwa na rafiki shakiki ambaye ni Abed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Abed was there for him every step of the way, through the surgeries, the chemotherapy, and the radiation.
entries.translation: Abedi alimfaa kwa kila hatua, kuanzia upasuaji, matibabu ya kemotherapi, na mnurisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He never left Karim's side, and he always gave him hope.
entries.translation: Kamwe hakumwacha Karimu, na kila mara alimpa matumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Karim eventually beat cancer, and he and Abed were closer than ever.
entries.translation: Hatimaye Karim alipona saratani, na urafiki wake na Abed uliimarika sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had both faced a life-changing experience, and they had come out of it stronger together.
entries.translation: Wote walikuwa wamepitia hali ngumu ya maisha, na walikuwa wamefanikiwa kukabili changamoto hizo kwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that students should be actively engaged in the process of remembering what they have heard.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuwa wanafunzi wanafaa kujihusisha kiamilifu katika mchakato wa kukumbuka walichosikia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They should not simply be passive listeners, but should be actively thinking about what they are hearing and trying to remember it.
entries.translation: Hawafai kuwa wasikilizaji tu, lakini wanafaa kuwa wakifikiria kiamilifu kuhusu wanachosikia na kujaribu kukikumbuka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of ways to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi za kuhimiza kumbukumbu ya ufahamu kufanya kazi katika masomo ya ufahamu wa usikilizaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to use repetition.
entries.translation: Njia moja ni kutumia urudiaji wa maneno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by having students listen to the same passage multiple times, or by having them read a passage aloud multiple times.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanyika kwa kuwaruhusu wanafunzi kusikiliza kifungu sawa mara nyingi, au kuwaruhusu wasome kifungu hicho kwa sauti mara kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repetition helps to fix the information in students' memories.
entries.translation: Kujirudia husaidia kurekebisha maelezo katika kumbukumbu za wanafunzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to encourage conscious memory work is to have students take notes while they are listening.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kuhimiza kufanya kazi kwa kumbukumbu ya ufahamu ni kuwaruhusu wanafunzi kuandika vidokezo wakisikiliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This forces them to pay attention to what they are hearing and to think about what is important.
entries.translation: Hii huwalazimisha kumakinikia wanachokisikia na kufikiria kuhusu kilicho muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Students can also be asked to write down a summary of what they have heard.
entries.translation: Pia wanafunzi wanaweza kuombwa kuandika muhtasari wa kile walichokisikia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helps them to organize the information in their minds and to remember it more effectively.
entries.translation: Hii huwasaidia kupanga maelezo kwenye fikira zao na kuyakumbuka kwa ufanisi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to repetition and note-taking, there are a number of other strategies that can be used to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.
entries.translation: Pamoja na kurudia na kuandika vidokezo, kuna mikakati mingine kadhaa inayoweza kutumika kuhimiza kufanya kazi kwa kumbukumbu ya ufahamu katika masomo ya ufahamu wa kusikiliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include asking students questions about what they have heard, having them discuss the passage with each other, and having them create their own graphic organizers to represent the information.
entries.translation: Njia hizi ni pamoja na kuwauliza wanafunzi maswali kuhusu walichokisikia, kuwaruhusu kujadililiana kifungu na wengine, na kuwawezsha kuunda viratibu vyao binafsi vya michoro ili kuonyesha maelezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By using a variety of strategies, teachers can help students to develop their listening comprehension skills and to become more effective learners.
entries.translation: Kwa kutumia mikakati mbalimbali, walimu wanaweza kuwasaidia wanafunzi kukuza ujuzi wao wa ufahamu wa kusikiliza na kuwa wanafunzi wenye ufanisi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She holds it in her hands for a moment, then begins to read. "Dear Mama, I hope this letter finds you well.
entries.translation: Anaishika kwenye mikono yake kwa muda, kisha anaanza kusoma. "Mama mpendwa, natumai barua hii itakupata ukiwa mzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm writing to you from my new home in New York City.
entries.translation: Ninakuandikia nikiwa kwenye nyumba yangu mpya katika jiji la New York.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a big change, but I'm really enjoying it so far.
entries.translation: Ni mabadiliko makubwa, lakini ninayafurahia sana kufikia sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The city is so vibrant and exciting, and there's always something new to see and do.
entries.translation: Jiji linasisimua, na daima kuna kitu kipya cha kuona na kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been working hard at my new job, and I'm starting to make some friends.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa nikifanya kazi kwa bidii katika kazi yangu mpya, na ninaanza kupata marafiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm still getting used to living on my own, but I'm learning a lot about myself and what I'm capable of.
entries.translation: Bado najizoesha kuishi peke yangu, lakini najifunza mengi kujihusu na kile ninachoweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you're probably worried about me, but I want you to know that I'm doing well.
entries.translation: Najua pengine una wasiwasi kunihusu, lakini nataka ujue kwamba naendelea vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's so proud of her daughter for going out into the world and making a life for herself.
