entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knows that her daughter is going to do great things, and she can't wait to see what the future holds for her.
entries.translation: Anajua kwamba biti yake atafanya mambo makubwa, na anatarajia kuona jinsi maisha yake ya baadaye yatakavyokuwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mama puts the letter away and goes to the kitchen to make herself a cup of tea.
entries.translation: Mama anaiweka barua hiyo na kwenda jikoni kujitengenezea kikombe cha chai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she sits down at the table, she thinks about her daughter and all the wonderful things she's accomplished.
entries.translation: Anapoketi mezani, anafikiria kuhusu binti yake na mambo yote mazuri ambayo ametimiza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's so proud of her, and she knows that she's going to continue to make her proud in the years to come.
entries.translation: Anajivunia sana kwa ajili yake, na anajua kwamba ataendelea kumfanya ajivunie katika miaka ijayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young farmer named Omar who lived in a small village on the edge of a forest.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na mkulima mdogo aliyeitwa Omar ambaye aliishi katika kijiji kidogo kando ya msitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Omar loved to work in the fields and tend to his crops, but he also loved to explore the forest.
entries.translation: Omar alipenda kufanya kazi shambani na kutunza mazao yake, lakini pia alipenda kuchunguza msitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Omar was exploring the forest when he came across a clearing.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Omar alikuwa akichunguza msituni alipoona eneo lililo wazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the middle of the clearing was a large tree, and at the top of the tree was a golden apple.
entries.translation: Katikati ya eneo hilo wazi kuliwa na mti mkubwa, na juu ya mti huo kulikuwa na tufaha la dhahabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Omar knew that the golden apple was a gift from the forest, and he vowed to climb the tree and retrieve it.
entries.translation: Omar alijua kwamba tufaha hilo la dhahabu lilikuwa zawadi kutoka msituni, na akaapa kuupanda mti huo na kuustawisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Omar tried to climb the tree, but it was too tall.
entries.translation: Omar alijaribu kuupanda mti huo, lakini ulikuwa mrefu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He tried to throw rocks at the apple, but they were too small.
entries.translation: Alijaribu kutupa mawe kwenye tufaha hilo, lakini yalikuwa madogo sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He even tried to build a ladder, but it wasn't tall enough.
entries.translation: Alijaribu pia kujenga ngazi, lakini haikuwa na urefu wa kutosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when Omar was about to give up, he heard a voice "I can help you," the voice said.
entries.translation: Wakati tu Omar alipokuwa karibu kukata tamaa, alisikia "Naweza kukusaidia," sauti hiyo ilisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Omar turned around and saw a small, furry creature.
entries.translation: Omar aligeuka na kuona kiumbe mdogo, mwenye manyoya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature had big eyes and a long tail "Who are you?" Omar asked.
entries.translation: Kiumbe huyo alikuwa na macho makubwa na mkia mrefu "Wewe ni nani?" Omar aliuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm a squirrel," the creature said. "And I can help you get the golden apple."
entries.translation: "Mimi ni kuchakuro," kiumbe huyo alisema. "Na naweza kukusaidia kupata tufaha hilo la dhahabu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The squirrel told Omar to gather some leaves and sticks.
entries.translation: Kuchakuro huyo alimwambia Omar akusanye majani na vijiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've always wondered what they're made of and how far away they are.
entries.translation: Daima nimekuwa nikijiuliza kile ambacho wameumbwa nacho na ziko mbali kiasi gani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Well, the stars are actually huge balls of gas that are very far away from us.
entries.translation: Mama: Kweli, nyota ni mipira mikubwa ya gesi iliyo mbali sana na sisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The closest star to us is the Sun, and it's about 93 million miles away.
entries.translation: Nyota iliyo karbu sana nasi ni jua, iko umbali wa maili milioni 93.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other stars are much farther away, and some of them are so far away that it takes light years for their light to reach us.
entries.translation: Nyota zingine ziko mbali zaidi, na baadhi yazo ziko mbali sana hivi kwamba inachukua miaka mingi kwa nuru yao kutufikia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son: Wow, that's amazing! I can't even imagine how far away that is.
entries.translation: Mwana: Lo, hiyo ni ya kushangaza! Siwezi hata kufikiria huo ni umbali wa kiasi gani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: It is amazing. And the stars are so important to us.
entries.translation: Mama: Inashangaza. Na nyota ni za maana sana kwetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide us with light and heat, and they help us to grow crops.
entries.translation: Hutupatia mwangaza na joto, na hutusaidia kupanda mazao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Without the stars, we wouldn't be able to live on Earth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son: So the stars are really important to us.
entries.translation: Mwana: Kwa hivyo, nyota ni muhimu sana kwetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: They are. And they're also beautiful.
entries.translation: Mama: Ni muhimu. Na pia ni rembo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all here to learn and grow, and we need to create a safe and respectful environment in order to do that.
entries.translation: Sote tuko hapa ili kujifunza na kukua, na tunahitaji kuunda mazingira salama na yenye heshima ili kufanya hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please be respectful of your classmates and instructors, and please use discretion when sharing personal information.
entries.translation: Tafadhali kuwa na heshima kwa wanafunzi wenza na walimu, na tafadhali tumia busara unaposhiriki taarifa ya kibinafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We all have different learning styles, and we all need to find what works best for us.
entries.translation: Sote tuna njia tofauti za kusoma, na sote tunahitaji kupata njia ambayo inatufaa vyema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people learn best by listening to lectures, while others learn best by reading or doing activities.
entries.translation: Watu wengine husoma bora kwa kusikiliza mihadhara, huku wengine wakijifunza bora kwa kusoma au kufanya shughuli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no right or wrong way to learn, so find what works best for you and stick with it.
entries.translation: Hakuna njia ya kusoma ambayo ni sahihi au isiyo sahihi, kwa hivyo tafuta njia ambayo inakufaa zaidi na uitumie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to be organized and prepared for class.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kujipanga na kuwa tayari kwa darasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Make sure you have all the materials you need, and arrive on time.
entries.translation: Hakikisha una nyenzo zote unazohitaji, na ufike kwa wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taking notes will help you stay focused and remember what is being taught.
entries.translation: Kuandika matini kutakusaidia kuendelea kuwa makini na kukumbuka kitu ambacho kinafundishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also review your notes after class to help solidify your understanding of the material.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kupitia matini yako bada ya darasa ili kukusaidia kusisitiza ufahamu wako wa yaliyofundishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to learn is to ask questions.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya njia bora zaidi ya kujifunza ni kuuliza maswali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't understand something, don't be afraid to ask your instructor or classmates for clarification.
entries.translation: Usipofahamu chochote, usiogope kuuliza mwalimu wako au wanafunzi wenza ili kupata ufafanuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everyone is here to learn, and we all want to help each other succeed.
entries.translation: Kila mtu yuko hapa kusoma, na sote tunataka kusaidiana ili kufanikiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to be an active participant in class.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuwa mshiriki mchangamfu darasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Participate in discussions, ask questions, and share your thoughts and ideas.
entries.translation: Shiriki katika majadiliano, uliza maswali, na ushiriki fikra na mawazo yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you participate, the more you will learn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to make mistakes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everyone makes mistakes, and that's part of the learning process.
entries.translation: Kila mtu hukosea, na hiyo ni sehemu ya mchakato wa kujifunza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The important thing is to learn from your mistakes and move on.
entries.translation: Kitu muhimu ni kujifunza kutoka kwa makosa yako na kusonga mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you follow these tips, you will be well on your way to success in this class.
entries.translation: Ukifuata vidokezo hivi, utakuwa sawa katika njia yako ya kufanikiwa darasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young boy hid under the covers, terrified of the storm outside.
entries.translation: Mvulana huyo mdogo alijificha ndani ya nyumba, alikuwa ameogopa tufani kubwa ambayo ilikuwa nje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The thunder rumbled and the lightning flashed, and the boy could feel the electricity in the air.
entries.translation: Mngurumo wa radi ulinguruma sana na radi ikaonekana, na mvulana huyo angeweza kuhisi umeme hewani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that if he got too close to anything metal, he could get electrocuted.
entries.translation: Alijua kwamba iwapo angekaribia chuma yoyote, angeweza kuuawa kwa umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storm raged for hours, and the boy lay there, huddled in fear.
entries.translation: Tufani hiyo iliendelea kwa saa kadhaa, na mvulana huyo alilala hapo, akiwa amejawa na woga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the storm passed and the boy emerged from his hiding place.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, tufani iliisha na mvulana huyo akatoka mahali pake pa kujificha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked around at the damage the storm had caused, and he was amazed that he had survived.
entries.translation: Aliangalia uharibifu ambao tufani hiyo ilikuwa imeleta, na aliweza kushangaa kwamba alinusurika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy learned a valuable lesson that day: never underestimate the power of electricity.
entries.translation: Mvulana huyo alijifunza funzo muhimu sana siku hiyo: kamwe usidunishe nguvu ya umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a person who is angry at their boss may take it out on their spouse or children.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, mtu ambaye amemkasirikia mdosi wake anaweza kupeleka hasira hiyo kwa mchumba au watoto wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because wrath is often a secondary emotion, meaning that it is triggered by another emotion, such as fear, sadness, or anxiety.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu mara nyingi ghadhabu huwa hisia mbadala, kumaanisha kwamba huwa inachochewa na hisia nyingine, kama vile woga, huzuni, au wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are feeling these emotions, we may lash out in anger in order to protect ourselves or to feel a sense of control.
entries.translation: Wakati ambapo tunahisi hisia hizi, tunaweza kujibu kwa hasira ili kujilinda au kuhisi kwamba tuna udhibiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wrath can also be a destructive emotion.
entries.translation: Ghadhabu pia inaweza kuwa hisia ya uharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can lead to violence, abuse, and other harmful behaviors.
entries.translation: Inaweza kusababisha vurugu, dhuluma, na tabia nyingine za kudhuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are angry, we may not be thinking clearly and we may make decisions that we later regret.
entries.translation: Tukiwa na hasira, huenda hatufikirii ipasavyo n tunaweza kufanya maambuzi ambayo tutajutia baadaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We may also say or do things that hurt others, which can damage relationships and make it difficult to repair them.
entries.translation: Tunaweza pia kusema au kufanya mambo ambayo yanawaumiza wengine, ambayo yanaweza kuharibu uhusiano na kufanya kuwe vigumu kujenga upya uhusiano huo tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be able to recognize and manage wrath.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuweza kutambua na kudhibiti ghadhabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we can do this, we can avoid the negative consequences of this emotion.
entries.translation: Iwapo tunaweza kufanya hii, tunaweza kuepukana na athari hasi za hisia hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things we can do to manage wrath, such as:
entries.translation: Kuna vitu vingi ambavyo tunaweza kufanya ili kudhibiti ghadhabu, kama vile:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Identifying the triggers for our anger.
entries.translation: * Kutambua mambo ambayo yanaleta hasira yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we know what triggers our anger, we can start to avoid these situations or to develop coping mechanisms for dealing with them.
entries.translation: Baada ya kujua vichochezi vya hasira yetu, tunaweza kuanza kuepukana na hali hizi au kuwa na mbinu za kukabiliana na vichochezi hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we feel ourselves getting angry, it is important to take a few deep breaths and to try to relax our muscles.
entries.translation: Wakati ambapo tunahisi kwamba tunakasirika, ni muhimu kuvuta pumzi ndani na kujaribu kutuliza misuli yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also do something to distract ourselves, such as listening to music or taking a walk.
entries.translation: Tunaweza pia kufanya kitu ili kufanya tusahau mambo hayo, kama vile kusikiliza muziki au kwenda ziara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was impressed by how quickly they were able to fix it, and he also noticed that they were using a lot less resources than he was.

entries.english: I have been considering the science of heredity and variation in living organisms.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa nikizingatia sayansi ya urithi na uhitilafiano katika viumbe hai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a vast and complex field, and I cannot hope to do it justice in a short dialogue.
entries.translation: Ni uwanja anuwai na changamano, na siwezi kuwa na matumaini ya kuuwasilisha vizuri kwa mazungumzo mafupi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I would like to share some of my thoughts on the subject, and perhaps spark a discussion.
entries.translation: Lakini ningependa kushiriki baadhi ya mawazo yangu kuhusu mada hiyo, na pengine kuanzisha majadiliano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to understand about heredity is that it is not simply a matter of passing on genes from parents to offspring.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu muhimu zaidi vya kufahamu kuhusu urithi ni kwamba urithi si suala la kupitisha jeni kutoka kwa wazazi kwenda kwa watoto tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Genes are only one part of the story.
entries.translation: Jeni ni sehemu moja tu ya habari hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The environment also plays a major role in determining how an organism develops.
entries.translation: Mazingira pia yana jukumu muhimu katika kuamua namna ambavyo kiumbe kinakua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, two identical twins may have the same genes, but they will not necessarily look or behave the same.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, pacha wawili wa kufanana huenda wakawa na jeni sawa, lakini si lazima kwamba watakuwa na mwonekano au tabia sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they will have been exposed to different environmental factors during their development.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu watakuwa katika vipengele tofauti vya mazingira wakati wa ukuaji wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The environment can affect an organism's development in a number of ways.
entries.translation: Mazingira yanaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa kiumbe katika njia nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can influence the expression of genes, the way that genes interact with each other, and the way that the organism responds to its surroundings.
entries.translation: Yanaweza kuathiri kutokea kwa jeni, namna ambayo jeni zinaingiliana na kila moja, na njia ambayo kiumbe huyo anaingiliana na mazingira yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Variation in living organisms is the result of both heredity and the environment.
entries.translation: Uhitilafiano katika viumbe hai ni matokeo ya urithi na mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No two organisms are exactly alike, even if they are identical twins.
entries.translation: Hakuna viumbe wawili wanaofanana kabisa, hata kama ni pacha wa kufanana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This variation is essential for evolution.
entries.translation: Uhitilafiano huu ni muhimu katika evolusheni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Desserts are a popular treat for people of all ages.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Rivers are one of the most important features of the natural world.
entries.translation: "Mito ni mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu zaidi katika dunia asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide water for drinking, irrigation, and transportation.
entries.translation: Huwa inaleta maji ya kunywa, umwagiliaji, na usafiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also play a vital role in the global ecosystem, supporting a wide variety of plant and animal life.
entries.translation: Pia husaidia kwenye mfumo wa ikolojia ulimwenguni, ikisaidia aina mbalimbali ya maisha ya mimea na wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking things about rivers is their texture.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu vya wazi sana kuhusu mito ni maumbile yake asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The water flows over rocks and stones, creating a constantly changing pattern of ripples and waves.
entries.translation: Maji huwa yanatiririka juu ya miamba na mawe, na kuunda mtindo unaobadilika kila mara wa viwimbi na mawimbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This texture is not only beautiful, but it also helps to oxygenate the water and transport nutrients downstream.
entries.translation: Maumbile haya ya asili hayapendezi tu bali pia yanasaidia kuongeza oksijeni katika maji na kusafirisha virutubishi kwenye mto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important aspect of rivers is their ability to transport sediment.
entries.translation: Kipengele kingine muhimu cha mito ni uwezo wao wa kusafirisha masimbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the water flows, it carries along small pieces of rock and soil.
entries.translation: Maji yanapotiririka, huwa yanabeba vipande vidogo vidogo vya miamba na mchanga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This sediment can be deposited downstream, creating new landforms such as sandbars and deltas.
entries.translation: Masimbi haya yanaweza kuachwa katika sehemu ya chini ya mto, na kuunda maumbo mapya ya ardhi kama vile mafungu ya mchanga na delta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rivers are also home to a wide variety of plants and animals.
entries.translation: Mito pia ni nyumbani kwa aina mbalimbali ya mimea na wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms depend on the river for food, shelter, and reproduction.
entries.translation: Viumbe hawa wanategemea mto kupata chakula, makao, na kuzaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique texture and environment of rivers create a diverse and thriving ecosystem.
entries.translation: Maumbile asili na mazingira ya mito huunda mfumo anuwai wa ikolojia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their importance, rivers are also under threat from human activity.
entries.translation: Licha ya umuhimu huu, mito pia inatishiwa na shughuli za binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pollution, dams, and climate change are all taking a toll on river ecosystems.
entries.translation: Uchafuzi, mabwawa, na mabadiliko ya tabianchi yote yanaathiri mifumo ya ikolojia ya mto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Punctuality is the quality of being on time or early.
entries.translation: Kuwahi mapema ni sifa ya kufika kwa wakati au mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is an important skill in both personal and professional life.
entries.translation: Ni ujuzi muhimu katika maisha ya kibinafsi na ya kitaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being punctual shows that you respect other people's time and that you are reliable.
entries.translation: Kufika kwa wakati kunaonyesha kwamba unaheshimu muda wa watu wengine na kwamba unaweza kutegemewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to being punctual.
entries.translation: Kuna manufaa mengi ya kufika mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you are less likely to miss appointments or important events.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, una uwezekano mdogo kabisa wa kukosa miadi au matukio muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You will also be more productive, as you will not have to rush to get to places.
entries.translation: Utakuwa pia na utendaji mkubwa, kwani hautahitajika kuharakisha kufika mahali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, being punctual can help you build a positive reputation at work.
entries.translation: Isitoshe, kufika kwa wakati kunaweza kukusaidia kujenga sifa nzuri kazini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are known for being punctual, your coworkers and clients will be more likely to trust and respect you.
entries.translation: Iwapo unajulikana kwamba huwa unafika mapema, wafanyakazi wenza na wateja watakuwa na uwezekano mkubwa wa kukuamini na kukuheshimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a few things you can do to become more punctual.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa unayoweza kufanya ili kufika mapema zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, set realistic goals for yourself.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are not used to being on time, start by setting small goals, such as arriving 5 minutes early to appointments.
entries.translation: Iwapo hujazoea kufika kwa wakati, anza kwa kuweka malengo madogo, kama vile kufika dakika 5 mapema katika miadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are able to consistently meet these goals, you can gradually increase the amount of time you allow yourself.
entries.translation: Mara tu umeweza kutimiza malengo haya mara kwa mara, unaweza kuongeza polepole kiwango cha muda ambao unajiruhusu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another helpful tip is to plan ahead.
entries.translation: Kidokezo kingine muhimu ni kuweka mipango ya mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means leaving plenty of time to get ready and to travel to your destination.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kutenga muda mwingi wa kujiandaa na kuwa tayari kufika mahali unapoenda.

entries.english: The Pookalam is a way to welcome the gods and goddesses, and it is also a way to show respect to the elders.

entries.english: Onam is a time for feasting and celebration.

entries.english: There are many traditional dishes that are eaten during the festival, such as rice, fish, and vegetables.

entries.english: Chess is a game of strategy and tactics.
entries.translation: Sataranji ni mchezo wa mkakati na mbinu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Players must be able to think several moves ahead and anticipate their opponent's moves.
entries.translation: Wachezaji lazima waweze kufikiria kuhusu miondoko kadhaa mapema na kutabiri miondoko ya washindani wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They must also be able to recognize patterns in the game and exploit them to their advantage.
entries.translation: Lazima pia waweze kutambua mitindo katika mchezo na kuitumia kabisa kwa manufaa yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pattern recognition is a key skill for chess players.
entries.translation: Utambuzi wa mtindo ni ujuzi muhimu kwa wachezaji wa sataranji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows them to see the big picture and understand how the different pieces on the board interact with each other.
entries.translation: Huwa unawawezesha kuona dhana kamili na kufahamu jinsi ambavyo vipande hivyo tofauti kwenye ubao vinaingiliana na kila kimoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also helps them to spot opportunities and threats early on, so that they can make the best possible moves.
entries.translation: Unawasaidia pia kuona fursa na matishio mapema mno, hivyo wanaweza kufanya miondoko bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Intuition is another important skill for chess players.
entries.translation: Uwezo wa kuelewa haraka ni ujuzi mwingine muhimu kwa wachezaji wa sataranji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows them to make decisions quickly and decisively, even when there is not enough time to think through all of the possible options.
entries.translation: Unawawezesha kufanya maamuzi kwa haraka na kamili, hata kama hakuna muda wa kutosha wa kufikiria chaguo zote zinazoweza kufanyika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Intuition is often developed through experience, but it can also be learned through training.
entries.translation: Uwezo wa kufikiria haraka mara nyingi huwa unaundwa kutokana na uzoefu, lakini unaweza pia kusomwa kupitia mafunzo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are many other skills that are important for chess players, such as calculation, memory, and concentration.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, kuna ujuzi mwingine mwingi ambao ni muhimu kwa wachezaji wa sataranji, kama vile kupiga hesabu, kumbukumbu, na umakinifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, pattern recognition and intuition are two of the most essential skills that all good chess players have.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, utambuzi wa mtindo na uwezo wa kufikiria haraka ni baadhi ya ujuzi muhimu zaidi ambao wachezaji wote wazuri wa sataranji huwa nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some examples of how pattern recognition and intuition can be used in chess:
entries.translation: Ifuatayo ni baadhi ya mifano ya jinsi ambavyo utambuzi wa mtindo na uwezo wa kufikiria kwa haraka unaweza kutumika katika sataranji:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may recognize that their opponent is trying to set up a particular trap.
entries.translation: * Mchezaji anaweza kutambua kwamba mshindani wake anajaribu kupanga mtego maalum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By anticipating the trap, the player can avoid it and gain an advantage.
entries.translation: Kwa kutabiri mtego huo, mchezaji huyo anaweza kuepukana nao na kupata manufaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may see that their opponent is weak on one side of the board.
entries.translation: * Mchezaji anaweza kuona kwamba mshindani wake ni mnyonge katika upande mmoja wa bodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By exploiting this weakness, the player can gain control of the game.
entries.translation: Kwa kutumia vyema udhaifu huu, mchezaji huyo anaweza kupata udhibiti wa mchezo huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may have a gut feeling that a certain move is the best one to make.
entries.translation: * Mchezaji anaweza kuwa na hisia kwamba mwondoko fulani ni bora zaidi kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even if they cannot explain why they feel this way, they may be right.
entries.translation: Hata kama hawawezi kuelezea ni kwa nini wanahisi hivyo, huenda wakawa sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pattern recognition and intuition are not easy skills to develop.
entries.translation: Utambuzi wa mtindo na uwezo wa kufikiria haraka si ujuzi rahisi kuwa nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, they are essential for anyone who wants to become a good chess player.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni ujuzi muhimu kwa mtu yeyote anayetaka kuwa mchezaji mzuri wa sataranji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With practice, these skills can be honed to a razor's edge, and a player will be able to see the game in a whole new way.
entries.translation: Kwa mazoezi, ujuzi huu unaweza kunolewa kabisa, na mchezaji ataweza kuona mchezo katika njia mpya tofauti kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandparents are a special kind of people.
entries.translation: Babu na nyanya ni watu wa kipekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the ones who have seen it all, and they are always there to lend a listening ear and a helping hand.
entries.translation: Wao ndio wameona kila kitu, na huwa tayari kusikiliza na kusaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the ones who make us feel safe and loved, and they are the ones who we can always count on.

entries.english: I have been lucky to have two wonderful grandparents in my life.

entries.english: They have taught me so much about life, and they have made me a better person.

entries.english: I know that I can always count on them, and I am so lucky to have them in my life.

entries.english: One of my favorite memories with my grandparents is when we went camping together.

entries.english: We hiked in the woods, roasted marshmallows over the campfire, and stargazed at night.

entries.english: It was a magical experience, and I will never forget it.

entries.english: In a traditional household, the eldest child is often expected to take on a leadership role, while the younger children are expected to follow their older siblings' lead.
entries.translation: Katika nyumba ya kidesturi, mtoto mkubwa mara nyingi hutarajiwa kuchukua jukumu la uongozi, huku watoto wadogo wakitarajiwa kufuata mwongozo wa ndugu yao mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a dynamic where the eldest child feels a sense of responsibility for their younger siblings, while the younger children look up to their older siblings and defer to their judgement.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuleta mabadiliko ambapo mtoto mkubwa anahisi kuwa na majukumu ya ndugu zake wadogo, huku watoto wadogo wakitegemea ndugu zao wakubwa na kuridhia mawazo yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been a trend towards reducing the size of families.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na mtindo wa kupunguza ukubwa wa familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is due to a number of factors, including the rising cost of living, the increasing desire for couples to have fewer children, and the increasing availability of birth control.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu ya vipengele mbalimbali, vikiwemo kuongezeka kwa gharama ya maisha, kuongezeka kwa tamaa ya wachumba kuwa na watoto wachache, na kuongezeka kwa upatikanaji wa njia za kuzuia ujauzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, the majority of families today have only one or two children, which means that there is less of a divide between the eldest and youngest children.
entries.translation: Kutokana na hayo, familia nyingi zina mtoto mmoja au wawili pekee, kumaanisha kwamba kuna tofauti ndogo tu kati ya watoto wakubwa na wadogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a more egalitarian relationship between siblings, where each child feels like they are an equal member of the family.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuleta uhusiano wa wenye usawa zaidi kati ya ndugu hao, ambapo kila mtoto anahisi kana kwamba wana usawa katika familia hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, every family is different, and there is no one-size-fits-all approach to sibling relationships.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, kila familia ni tofauti, na hakuna mwelekeo wa mtindo moja katika uhusiano wa ndugu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
