entries.english: One day, Sarah's boss called her into his office.
entries.translation: Siku moja, bosi wa Sarah alimwita katika ofisi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her that he was impressed with her work, and he offered her a promotion.
entries.translation: Alimwambia kwamba alikuwa amefurahishwa na kazi yake, na akampandisha cheo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The horse was galloping at full speed, its hooves thundering on the ground.
entries.translation: Farasi huyo alikuwa anakimbia haraka sana, kwato zake zikiwa zinakanyaga ardhi kwa sauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rider, a young woman, was in complete control of the animal, her body swaying in rhythm with its movements.
entries.translation: Mwanamke mdgo aliyekuwa akimwendesha alikuwa anamdhibiti kamili mnyama huyo, mwili wake ukienda katika mfuatano wa miondoko yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been riding horses since she was a child, and she had an excellent understanding of their nature.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akiendesha farasi tangu alipokuwa mtoto, na alikuwa na ufahamu bora wa hali yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew how to control them without using force, and she could sense their moods and emotions.
entries.translation: Alijua namna ya kuwadhibiti bila kutumia nguvu, na angeweza kuhisi hisia zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The horse was responding to her commands perfectly, and they were moving as one.
entries.translation: Farasi huyo alikuwa anajibu amri zake vizuri sana, na walikuwa wanaenda kama kitu kimoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were a perfect team, and they were enjoying the freedom of the open plain.
entries.translation: Walikuwa timu bora, na walikuwa wanafurahia uhuru wa eneo tambarare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is awash in plastic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everywhere you look, there it is: floating in the ocean, washing up on beaches, choking sea turtles and other marine life.
entries.translation: Kila mahali ambapo unaangalia, ndiyo hiyo hapo: inaelea baharini, imetapakaa ufukoni, inanyonga kasa wa baharini na viumbe wengine wa baharini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic pollution is a major threat to the health of our oceans, and it's only getting worse.
entries.translation: Uchafuzi wa plastiki ni tishio kubwa kwa afya ya bahari zetu, na unaendelea tu kuwa mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in our oceans.
entries.translation: Kila mwaka, mamilioni ya tani za plastiki hufika baharini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most of it comes from land-based sources, such as rivers and streams.
entries.translation: Idadi yake kubwa inatoka katika vyanzo vya nchi kavu, kama vile mito na mito midogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once in the ocean, plastic can take hundreds of years to break down.
entries.translation: Zinapofika baharini, plastiki zinaweza kuchukua mamia ya miaka kuweza kuyeyuka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be ingested by marine animals, which can cause them to become sick or even die.
entries.translation: Zinaweza pia kumezwa na wanyama wa baharini, na hii inaweza kufanya wanyama hao kuwa wagonjwa au hata kufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the direct harm it causes to marine life, plastic pollution can also have a negative impact on the food chain.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya madhara ya moja kwa moja kwa viumbe wa baharini, uchafuzi wa plastiki unaweza pia kuleta athari hasi kwa masuala ya chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic can accumulate in the stomachs of fish and other marine animals, and when these animals are eaten by humans, we can end up ingesting plastic ourselves.
entries.translation: Plastiki inaweza kukusanyika katika tumbo za samaki na wanyama wengine wa baharini, na wanyama hawa wakiliwa na binadamu, tunaweza kujipata tukila plastiki sisi wenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The health effects of consuming plastic are not yet fully understood, but there is concern that it could lead to a variety of problems, including cancer, reproductive issues, and developmental disorders.
entries.translation: Athari za kukula plastiki kwa afya bado hazifahamiki kamili, lakini kuna wasiwasi kwamba inaweza kuleta shida mbalimbali, ikiwa pamoja na saratani, masuala ya uzazi, na matatizo ya ukuaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Global warming is also having a significant impact on the oceans.
entries.translation: Kuongezeka kwa joto la dunia pia kunaleta athari kubwa kwenye bahari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fashion and style are constantly evolving, as new trends emerge and old ones fade away.
entries.translation: Mtindo wa mavazi na mtindo unaendelea kukua, mitindo mingi ikichiibuka na ya kale ikipotea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But one thing that never changes is the human desire to look good.
entries.translation: Lakini kitu kimoja ambacho huwa hakibadiliki ni hamu ya binadamu kutaka kuonekana mzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whether you're dressing for a night out on the town or a day at the office, your outfit should reflect your personality and make you feel confident.
entries.translation: Iwe unavaa mavazi ya kwenda katika tamasha ya usiku mjini au ofisini saa za kazi, mavazi yako yanafaa kuakisi nafsi yako na kukufanya kuhisi jasiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest trends in fashion this year is the return of long, flowing dresses.
entries.translation: Moja kati ya mitindo mikubwa ya mavazi mwaka huu ni kurejea kwa rinda refu linaloning'inia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These dresses are perfect for any occasion, and they can be dressed up or down depending on your needs.
entries.translation: Marinda haya ni bora kwa hafla yoyote, na yanaweza kuvaliwa juu au chini kutegemea na mahitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a dress that will make you stand out from the crowd, a long, flowing dress is a great option.
entries.translation: Iwapo unatafuta rinda litakalokufanya uwe wa kipekee katika umati wa watu, rinda refu na linaloning'inia ni chaguo bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another trend that is gaining popularity is sustainable fashion.
entries.translation: Mtindo mwingine ambao unapata umaarufu ni mtindo endelevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means choosing clothing that is made from recycled materials or from brands that have a commitment to ethical manufacturing.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuchagua mavazi ambayo yametengenezwa kwa kutumia nyenzo zinazoweza kutumika upya au kutoka kwa chapa ambazo zimejitolea kufuata maadili ya utengenezaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sustainable fashion is not only good for the environment, but it's also good for your wallet.
entries.translation: Mtindo endelevu si mzuri tu kwa mazingira, bali ni mzuri pia kwa mfuko wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the world becomes more globalized, fashion trends are becoming more uniform.
entries.translation: Dunia inapoendelea kuwa kama eneo moja, mitindo ya mavazi inaanza kufanana sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What's popular in one country is quickly becoming popular in another.
entries.translation: Mtindo maarufu katika nchi moja unakuwa maarufu kwa haraka katika nchi nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that you can now find the latest fashion trends no matter where you live.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kwamba sasa unaweza kupata mitindo ya mavazi ya kisasa zaidi bila kujali eneo unaloishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment, also known as the death penalty, is the legally sanctioned killing of a person as punishment for a crime.
entries.translation: Adhabu ya kifo, inayojulikana pia kama kifungo cha kifo, ni mauaji ya mtu yanayoruhusiwa kisheria kama adhabu ya jinai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the most severe form of punishment that can be imposed in the criminal justice system.
entries.translation: Ndiyo aina kali zaidi ya adhabu ambayo inaweza kutolewa katika mfumo wa haki ya jinai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment is a controversial issue, with strong arguments on both sides.
entries.translation: Adhabu ya kifo ni suala lenye lenya utata, ambapo kila upande una hoja thabiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that it is a just punishment for certain crimes, while others believe that it is cruel and unusual punishment.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaamini kwamba ni adhabu tu ya kawaida kwa uhalifu mwingine, huku wengine wakiamini kwamba ni adhabu ya kikatili na isiyo ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is also debate about whether capital punishment is an effective deterrent to crime.
entries.translation: Pia kuna mjadala kuhusu iwapo adhabu ya kifo ni kizuio bora cha uhalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment is legal in 27 states in the United States.
entries.translation: Adhabu ya kifo ni halali katika majimbo 27 ya Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a growing movement to abolish the death penalty, and the number of executions has declined in recent years.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna vuguvugu linalokua la kukomesha hukumu ya  kifo, na idadi ya utekelezaji imepungua katika miaka ya hivi majuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The death penalty is also legal in a number of other countries around the world, but its use is declining.
entries.translation: Hukumu ya kifo pia ni halali katika nchi kadhaa duniani, lakini utumiaji wake unapungua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, there were 998 executions worldwide, down from 1,591 in 2015.
entries.translation: Mnamo mwaka wa 2016, kulikuwa na mauaji 998 ya hukumu ya, hii ni chini kutoka 1,591 mwaka wa 2015.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common method of execution in the United States is lethal injection.
entries.translation: Njia inayotumika sana kuua waliohukumiwa kifo Marekani ni kifo kwa sindano ya kuua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other methods of execution include the electric chair, the gas chamber, and the firing squad.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine za kuua waliohukumiwa kifo ni kiti cha umeme, chumba cha gesi, na kikosi cha polisi wa kuua kwa bunduki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The death penalty is a complex issue with a long and controversial history.
entries.translation: Kifungo cha kifo ni suala lenye historia ndefu na yenye utata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two people are discussing the architecture of the building.
entries.translation: Watu wawili wanajadili usanifu majengo wa jengo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: This church is so lovely. I love the colors and the way the light plays through the stained glass windows.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 1: Kanisa hili linapendeza. Napenda rangi na ambavyo mwanga unapenyeza kwenye vioo vya rangi vya madirisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I agree. It's really peaceful and serene in here.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 2: Nakubali. Hapa ndani kuna amani na utulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 3: I'm impressed by the architecture. The arches and columns are so graceful.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 3: Nimependezwa na usafinu huu. Matao na nguzo ni nzuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 4: And the ceiling is amazing! It's like being under a starry sky.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 4: Na dari linastaajabisha sana! Ni kama kuwa chini ya anga yenye nyota.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 5: I'm glad we decided to come here. This is a beautiful church.
entries.translation: Mtu wa 5: Nafurahia kwamba tuliamua kuja hapa. Hili ni kanisa zuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The group continues to admire the church.
entries.translation: Kikundi hicho linaendelea kupendezwa na kanisa hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They talk about the different elements of the architecture, and how they contribute to the overall feeling of the space.
entries.translation: Wanaongea kuhusu vipengele tofauti vya usanifu wa jengo hilo, na jinsi ambavyo vinachangia hisia ya jumla ya eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also share their own personal experiences with church architecture, and how it has impacted their lives.
entries.translation: Wanashiriki pia uzoefu wao wa kibinafsi na usanifu wa jengo la kanisa, na jinsi ambavyo umeathiri maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Student: I'm so worried about the Nigerian education system.
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi: Nahofia mfumo wa elimu nchini Naijeria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It seems like it's in a state of decline.
entries.translation: Inaonekana kwamba ipo katika hali ya kupungua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nigerian education system has a lot of problems.
entries.translation: Mfumo wa elimu nchini Naijeria una shinda nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I believe that it can be fixed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Well, for one thing, we need to invest more in education.
entries.translation: Mwalimu: Naam, kwa kitu kimoja, tunahitaji kuwekeza pesa katika elimu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to make sure that teachers are well-trained and that schools have the resources they need.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuhakikisha kwamba walimu wamefunzwa vizuri sana na kwamba shule zina rasilimali wanazohitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what else can we do?
entries.translation: Lakini ni nini tena tunaweza kufanya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: We also need to change the way we think about education.
entries.translation: Mwalimu: Tunahitaji pia kubadilisha tunavyofikiria kuhusu elimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to move away from a focus on rote learning and towards a focus on critical thinking and problem-solving.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuondoka kwenye kulenga masomo ya mbali na kuzingatia kufikiri kwa kina na kutatua matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But how do we get parents and students on board with that?
entries.translation: Na ni vipi tutawapata wazazi na wanafunzi ili wajiunge na mpango huo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: That's a challenge, but I think it's possible.
entries.translation: Mwalimu: Hiyo ni changamoto, lakini nadhani inawezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to start by talking to parents and students about the importance of a well-rounded education.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuanza kwa kuzungumza na wazazi na wanafunzi kuhusu umuhimu wa elimu iliyokamilika vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to show them that it's not just about getting good grades, but also about developing the skills they need to succeed in life.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuwaambia kwamba si tu kuhusu kupata alama nzuri, lakini pia kuhusu kuwa na ujuzi ambao wanahitaji ili kufanikiwa katika maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina Aissa was born in a small village in the mountains of Algeria.
entries.translation: Sakina Aissa alizaliwa katika kijiji kidogo katika milima ya Aljeria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her parents were Berbers, one of the many ethnic groups that make up the country.
entries.translation: Wazazi walikuwa wa kabila la Berber, moja kati ya viikundi vingi vya makabila katika nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina grew up in a close-knit community, where people of different ethnicities lived and worked together in peace.
entries.translation: Sakina alikua katika jamii ambayo watu wana uhusiano thabiti, ambapo watu wa makabila tofauti waliishi na kufanya kazi pamoja kwa amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But when Sakina was 10 years old, the civil war in Algeria broke out.
entries.translation: Lakini Sakina alipofikisha umri wa miaka 10, vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe nchini Aljeria vilianza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict was between the Arab majority and the Berber minority.
entries.translation: Mgogoro huo ulikuwa kati ya kabila kubwa la Arabu na kabila dogo la Berber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina's village was caught in the middle, and she witnessed firsthand the violence and destruction that the war brought.
entries.translation: Kijiji cha Sakina kilipatikana katika migogoro hiyo, na alishuhudia moja kwa moja vurugu na uharibifu ambao uliletwa na vita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many people were killed, and many more were forced to flee their homes.
entries.translation: Watu wengi waliuawa, na watu wengi walilazimishwa kutoroka nyumbani mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina's family was among those who were displaced.
entries.translation: Familia ya Sakina ilikuwa miongoni mwa familia ambazo zilihamishwa kutoka nyumbani mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They fled to a refugee camp in the desert, where they lived in squalid conditions.
entries.translation: Walihamia kambi ya wakimbizi katika jangwa, mahali ambapo waliishi katika hali duni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war lasted for more than a decade, and it had a devastating impact on Sakina and her family.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilidumu kwa zaidi ya muongo mmoja, na vilikuwa na athari mbaya zaidi kwa Sakina na familia yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They lost everything they had, and they were forced to live in fear for their lives.
entries.translation: Walipoteza kila kitu ambacho walikuwa nacho, na walilazimishwa kuishi kwa kuogopea maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of all the suffering, Sakina never lost hope.
entries.translation: Lakini hata wakiwa katika katikati ya mateso hayo, Sakina hakupoteza matumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that one day, the war would end and she would be able to return home.
entries.translation: Alijua kwamba siku moja, vita vingeisha na angeweza kurudi nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Horse racing is a popular sport that has been around for centuries.
entries.translation: Mbio za farasi ni spoti maarufu sana ambayo imekuwepo kwa miongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a competition between two or more horses that are ridden by jockeys.
entries.translation: Ni mashindano kati ya farasi wawili au zaidi ambao wanaendeshwa na wapanda farasi katika mashindano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The goal is to be the first horse to cross the finish line.
entries.translation: Lengo ni kuwa farasi wa kwanza kuvuka mstari wa kumalizia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Horse racing is held at tracks all over the world, and there are many different types of races, including sprints, middle distances, and endurance races.
entries.translation: Mbio za farasi huwa zinafanyika katika sehemu za mbio kote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi tofauti za mbio, ikiwemo kwenda mbio, mbio za umbali wa kati, na mbio za uvumilivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most famous horse race in the world is the Kentucky Derby, which is held every year at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky.
entries.translation: Mbio ya farasi ya kawaida zaidi ni Kentucky Derby, ambayo huwa inafanyika katika kila mwaka katika Churchill Downs kwenye Louisville, Kentucky.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Horse racing is a multi-billion dollar industry, and it is estimated that over $100 billion is wagered on horse races each year.
entries.translation: Mbio za farasi ni tasnia yenye mabilioni kadhaa ya dola, na inakadiriwa kwamba zaidi ya bilioni $100 huwa inatumika katika mbio za farasi wa mbio kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sport is also a major source of employment, and it supports jobs in the horse breeding, training, and racing industries.
entries.translation: Spoti hiyo pia ni chanzo kubwa cha ajira, na inasaidia kazi katika vitengo vya kulea farasi, kumfunza, na kuendesha farasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite its popularity, horse racing has been criticized for its treatment of animals.
entries.translation: Licha ya umaarufu wake, mbio za farasi zimepingwa kwa sababu ya namna ambavyo inawahudumia wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Critics argue that horses are forced to race at speeds that are dangerous for them, and that they are often mistreated by their trainers and jockeys.
entries.translation: Wahakiki wanadai kwamba farasi wanalazimishwa kukimbia katika kasi ambazo ni hatari kwao, na kwamba mara nyingi huwa wanahudumiwa vibaya na watu wanaowafunza na watu wa kuwalisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been a number of efforts to make horse racing more humane, including the introduction of new rules and regulations.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na idadi ya juhudi za kufanya mbio za farasi kuwa na utu zaidi, ikiwa pamoja na kuleta sheria na masharti mapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the controversy, horse racing remains a popular sport around the world.
entries.translation: Licha ya mapingano hayo, mbio za farasi zinasalia kuwa mchezo maarufu duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paul was an adolescent who was always getting into trouble.
entries.translation: Paul alikuwa kijana anayebalehe na kila mara alikuwa anajipata katika matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always getting into fights, drinking, and skipping school.
entries.translation: Kila mara alikuwa anapigana vita, anakunywa, na kutoenda shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, he was drinking with his friends when they decided to go to the Trump rally.
entries.translation: Siku moja, alikuwa anakunywa pombe na marafiki zake walipoamua kwenda katika mkutano wa kisiasa wa Trump.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They got there and started chanting "lock her up" and "build the wall" Paul was having a great time until he saw a sign that said "no minors" He realized that he was too young to be there, and he started to panic.
entries.translation: Walifika huko na kuanza kuimba "mfunge" na "jenga ukuta". Paul alikuwa anafurahia sana hadi alipoona ishara inayosema "hakuna watoto". Aligundua kwamba alikuwa mdogo sana kuwa hapo, na akaanza kuwa na wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He tried to leave, but the crowd was too big.
entries.translation: Alijaribu kuondoka, lakini umati huo ulikuwa mkubwa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was stuck there, and he didn't know what to do.
entries.translation: Alikwama pale, na hakujua jambo la kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, a woman came up to him and asked him if he was okay.
entries.translation: Kwa ghafla, mwanamke alienda kwake na kumuuliza iwapo alikuwa sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paul told her that he was lost and didn't know how to get home.
entries.translation: Paul alimwambia kwamba alikuwa amepotea na hakuwa anajua njia ya kurudi nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman helped Paul find his way out of the crowd, and she gave him her phone number in case he ever needed help again.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo alimsaidia Paul kuweza kupata njia na kutoka katika umati huo, na akampa nambari yake ya simu endapo angehitaji usaidizi tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "title": "The Importance of Sleep", "text": "Sleep is a vital part of our lives.
entries.translation: "anwani": "Umuhimu wa Usingizi", "matini": "Usingizi ni sehemu muhimu zaidi katika maisha yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows our bodies to rest and repair themselves, and it helps us to function properly both physically and mentally.
entries.translation: Unaruhusu miili yetu kupumzika na kujifanyia ukarabati, na huwa unatusaidia kufanya kazi vizuri kimwili na kiakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we don't get enough sleep, we can experience a range of negative effects, including fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and impaired decision-making.
entries.translation: Tusipopata usingizi wa kutosha, tunaweza kupitia athari mbalimbali hasi, kama vile uchovu, kukerwa, ugumu wa kutulia, na kufanya uamuzi unaoegemea upande moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the long term, chronic sleep deprivation can increase our risk of developing health problems such as obesity, heart disease, and diabetes.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, kudidimia kwa kudumu kwa usingizi kunaweza kuongeza hatari yetu ya kuwa na matatizo ya kiafya kama vile kunenepa kupita kiasi, ugonjwa wa moyo, na kisukari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of factors that can affect our sleep, including our age, our lifestyle, and our environment.
entries.translation: Kuna vipengele mbalimbali vinavyoweza kuathiri usingizi wetu, ikiwemo umri wetu, mtindo wetu wa maisha, na mazingira yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we age, our sleep patterns tend to change.
entries.translation: Tunapokuwa wakubwa, mitindo yetu ya usingizi hubadilika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, older adults may need less sleep than younger adults, and they may find it more difficult to fall asleep and stay asleep.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, watu wazee wanaweza kuhitaji usingizi mfupi ikilinganishwa na watu wazima wadogo, na wanaweza kupata ugumu mkubwa wa kupata usingizi na kuendelea kulala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our lifestyle choices can also have a big impact on our sleep.
entries.translation: Chaguo za mitindo yetu ya maisha zinaweza pia kuwa na athari kubwa kwa usingizi wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, people who work long hours or who have irregular sleep schedules are more likely to experience sleep problems.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, watu ambao wanafanya kazi kwa saa nyingi au ambao wana ratiba za usingizi ambazo si za kawaida wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuwa na shida za usingizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, our environment can also affect our sleep.
entries.translation: Na hatimaye, mazingira yetu yanaweza pia kuathiri usingizi wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Things like noise, light, and temperature can all make it difficult to get a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Vitu kama kelele, mwangaza, na halijoto vinaweza kuleta ugumu wa kupata usingizi bora usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baobab tree is a symbol of strength, resilience, and longevity.
entries.translation: Mti huo wa mkuyu ni ishara ya nguvu, ustahimilivu, na kudumu kwa muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is found in Africa, Madagascar, and Australia, and can live for up to 2,000 years.
entries.translation: Unapatikana Afrika, Madagaska, na Australia, na unaweza kuishi kwa hadi miaka 2,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Baobab trees are known for their massive trunks, which can store up to 100,000 gallons of water.
entries.translation: Miti ya mkuyu inajulikana kwa mashina yao makubwa, ambayo yanaweza kuhifadhi hadi galoni 100,000 ya maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them an important source of water for animals and humans during droughts.
entries.translation: Hii huwa inaifanya kuwa chanzo muhimu cha maji ya wanyama na binadamu katika misimu ya kiangazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baobab tree is also a symbol of progress and options.
entries.translation: Mti huo wa mkuyu ni ishara ya maendeleo na chaguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Its large, hollow trunks can be used for storage, shelter, and even as homes.
entries.translation: Mashina yake makubwa yaliyo na shimo yanaweza kutumika kuhifadhi vitu, kama makao, na hata kama nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The leaves of the baobab tree can be eaten, and the bark can be used to make rope, cloth, and medicine.
entries.translation: Majani ya mti wa mkuyu yanaweza kuliwa, na ngozi ya shina lake inaweza kutumika kutengeneza kamba, nguo, na dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baobab tree is a reminder that even in the midst of adversity, there is always hope.
entries.translation: Mti wa mkuyu ni kikumbusho kwamba hata katikati ya matatizo makubwa, huwa matumaini siku zote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Its resilience and strength are a source of inspiration to us all.
entries.translation: Ustahimilivu na nguvu zake ni chanzo cha msukumo kwetu sote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Andreas worked as an engineer for a large construction company.
entries.translation: Andreas alikuwa anafanya kazi kama mhandisi wa kampuni kubwa ya ujenzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was responsible for overseeing the construction of a new bridge.
entries.translation: Alikuwa anawajibikia usimamizi wa ujenzi wa daraja jipya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a man approached Andreas and offered him a bribe of $10,000 if he would approve a change to the plans that would benefit the man's company.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanaume alimwendea Andreas na kuahidi hongo ya $10,000 iwapo angeidhinisha mabadiliko katika ramani ambayo yangeleta manufaa kwa kampuni ya mwanaume huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Andreas was tempted by the bribe, but he knew that it was wrong.
entries.translation: Andreas alivutiwa na hongo hiyo, lakini alijua kwamba ilikuwa kitu kibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He refused the bribe and reported the man to his supervisor.
entries.translation: Alikataa hongo hiyo na kumripoti mwanaume huyo kwa msimamizi wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man was arrested and charged with bribery.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo alikamatwa na kushtakiwa na kosa la hongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Andreas's decision to stand up to corruption damaged his reputation, but he was proud of himself for doing the right thing.
entries.translation: Uamuzi wa Andreas wa kupinga ufisadi uliharibu sifa yake, lakini alikuwa anajivunia kwa kufanya kitu sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that his work had made a difference, and that was all that mattered to him.
entries.translation: Alijua kwamba kazi yake ilikuwa imeleta mabadiliko, na hiyo pekee ndiyo ilikuwa muhimu kwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mara who loved to read.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na msichana mdogo ambaye aliyeitwa anaitwa Mara na alikuwa anapenda kusoma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would read anything she could get her hands on, from fairy tales to adventure stories to historical novels.
entries.translation: Angesoma chochote ambacho angeweza kupata, kuanzia hadithi za vichimbakazi hadi hadithi za matukio hadi riwaya za kihistoria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved the way that reading could transport her to other worlds and teach her new things about the world around her.
entries.translation: Alipenda namna ambavyo kusoma kungempeleka katika dunia nyingine na kumfunza mambo mapya kuhusu dunia anamoishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Mara was reading a book about a faraway land when she came across a passage that described a magical library.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Mara alikuwa anasoma kitabu kuhusu nchi ya mbali sana alipokutana na aya ambayo ilielezea kuhusu maktaba ya kiajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The library was said to contain every book ever written, and it was said that anyone who could find the library would be granted one wish.
entries.translation: Maktaba hiyo ilisemekana kwamba ilikuwa na kila kitabu ambacho kimewahi kuandikwa, na ilisemekana kwamba kila mtu ambaye angeweza kupata maktaba hiyo angetimiziwa tamaa yake moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mara was determined to find the library, so she set off on a journey.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mara traveled for many days, and she faced many challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Mara alisafiri kwa siku nyingi, na alikumbana na changamoto nyingi njiani.

entries.english: She had to cross a dark forest, climb a treacherous mountain, and swim across a raging river.

entries.english: But she never gave up, and eventually she found the library.

entries.english: The library was even more amazing than Mara had imagined.

entries.english: It was filled with shelves upon shelves of books, and each book was more beautiful than the last.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa imejaa rafu za vitabu, na kila kitabu kilikuwa kizuri zaidi ya kingine.

entries.english: Mara spent hours exploring the library, and she soon found the book that she had been looking for.
entries.translation: Mara alikaa huko kwa saa kadhaa akiangalia maktaba hiyo, na mwishowe akapata kitabu ambacho alikuwa akitafuta sana.

entries.english: The book was called "The Book of Wishes," and it contained a single wish.

entries.english: "Son, I'm really proud of you for being so responsible with your energy use.
entries.translation: "Mwana, nina fahari sana na wewe kwa sababu unawajibukia namna unavyotumia kawi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You always turn off the lights when you leave a room, and you unplug appliances when you're not using them.
entries.translation: Huwa unazima mataa wakati wowote unatoka katika chumba, na huwa unatoa vifaa kwenye umeme wakati ambapo huvitumii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I think there are a few more things you can do to help conserve energy.
entries.translation: Lakini nadhani kuna vitu vingine vichache ambavyo unaweza kufanya ili uhifadhi kawi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, try to take shorter showers.
entries.translation: Kwanza, jaribu kuoga kwa muda mfupi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you like to relax in the shower, but a five-minute shower uses a lot less water and energy than a ten-minute shower. Second, cook your food in the microwave instead of the oven whenever possible.
entries.translation: Najua unapenda kutulia katika bafu, lakini kuoga kwa dakika tano kunatumia maji na umeme kiasi sana ikilinganishwa na kuoga kwa dakika kumi. Pili, pika chakula chako kwenye maikrowevu badala ya oveni panapowezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Microwaves use a lot less energy than ovens.
entries.translation: Mikrowevu zinatumia umeme kiasi zikilinganshwa na oveni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, wash your clothes in cold water instead of hot water.
entries.translation: Tatu, fua nguo zako katika maji baridi badala ya maji ya moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hot water uses more energy to heat up.
entries.translation: Maji ya moto hutumia umeme mwingi ili kuchemka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, try to open your windows and let in natural light instead of turning on the lights.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, jaribu kufungua madirisha yako na utumie mwangaza wa asili badala ya kuwasha mataa kwa nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Natural light is free, and it's good for your health.
entries.translation: Mwangaza asili ni wa bila malipo, na ni mzuri kwa maisha yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know these are just a few small things, but they can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Najua hivi ni vitu vichache vidogo tu, lakini vinaweza kuleta tofauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If everyone makes an effort to conserve energy, we can help protect the environment and save money."
entries.translation: Kila mtu akifanya juhudi ya kutunza kawi, tunaweza kusaidia kulinda mazingira na kuokoa pesa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thanks, Mom. I'll try to do all those things."
entries.translation: "Asante, Mama. Nitajaribu kufanya vitu hivi vyote."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The venom from the snake is a neurotoxin, which means that it affects the nervous system.
entries.translation: Sumu ya nyoka ni sumu ya neva, ambayo inamaanisha kwamba huwa inaathiri mfumo wa neva.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can cause paralysis, respiratory failure, and eventually death.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuleta kupooza, mfumo wa kupumua kukosa kufanya kazi, na hatimaye kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The venom works by binding to receptors on the surface of nerve cells and preventing them from working properly.
entries.translation: Sumu hiyo huwa inafanya kazi kwa kuunganisha vipokezi kwenye sehemu ya seli za neva na kuvizuia kufanya kazi vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can cause a variety of symptoms, including muscle weakness, numbness, tingling, and difficulty breathing.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuleta dalili mbalimbali, zikiwemo udhaifu wa misuli, kukufa ganzi, mwasho, au ugumu wa kupumua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In severe cases, the venom can cause death.
entries.translation: Katika hali kali, sumu hiyo inaweza kusababisha kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The evil dude in the story was probably feeling the effects of the venom as he was dying.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo mwovu katika hadithi hiyo huenda alikuwa anahisi athari za sumu alipokuwa anakufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He may have felt weak, numb, and tingling.
entries.translation: Huenda alihisi udhaifu, ganzi, na kuwashwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He may have also had difficulty breathing.
entries.translation: Huenda pia alikuwa na ugumu wa kupumua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the venom continued to affect his nervous system, he would have eventually lost consciousness and died.
entries.translation: Sumu hiyo ilipokuwa inaendelea kuathiri mfumo wake wa neva, hatimaye huenda alipoteza ufahamu na kukufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The venom from the snake is a powerful toxin that can cause serious harm or death.
entries.translation: Sumu kutoka kwa nyoka huyo ni sumu kali ambayo inaweza kuleta madhara au kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be aware of the risks of snakes and to take precautions to avoid being bitten.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kufahamu hatari za nyoka na kutahadhari ili kuepuka kuumwa na nyoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are bitten by a snake, it is important to seek medical attention immediately.
entries.translation: Nyoka akikuuma, ni muhimu kutafuta matibabu mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The question of "who am I?" is one that has been asked by philosophers and thinkers for centuries.
entries.translation: Suali la "mimi ni nani?" ni swali ambalo limeulizwa na wanafalsafa na wafikiriaji kwa miongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one answer that will satisfy everyone, as our sense of self is constantly evolving and changing.
entries.translation: Hakuna jibu moja ambalo litamridhisha kila mtu, kwa sababu fahiwa yetu kutuhusu inaendelea kukua na kubadilika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are some things that we can say about who we are.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna vitu vingine ambavyo tunaweza kusema kuhusu suala la sisi ni nani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all individuals, with our own unique thoughts, feelings, and experiences.
entries.translation: Sisi sote ni watu binafsi, na fikra, hisia, na uzoefu wetu wa kipekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are also part of a larger community, and our sense of self is shaped by our interactions with others.
entries.translation: Sisi pia ni sehemu ya jamii kubwa, na fahiwa yetu kutuhusu binafsi inaongozwa na mitagusano yetu na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all born into a particular time and place, and our experiences in this world help to define who we are.
entries.translation: Sisi sote tumezaliwa katika wakati na mahali maalum, na uzoefu wetu katika dunia hii huwa unasaidia kufasili sisi ni nani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the essential "I" that lies at the core of our being?
entries.translation: Lakini "Mimi" muhimu ambayo ipo katika msingi wa ubinadamu wetu ni nini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
