entries.english: Or is it something else entirely?
entries.translation: Au ni kitu kingine tofauti kabisa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps the "I" is simply a collection of memories, experiences, and beliefs.
entries.translation: Pengine "Mimi" ni mkusanyiko tu wa kumbukumbu, uzoefu, na imani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is a narrative that we create about ourselves, in order to make sense of the world around us.
entries.translation: Pengine ni hadithi ambayo tunabuni kuhusu sisi wenyewe, ili kufanya dunia tunamoishi kuwa na maana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or perhaps the "I" is something more ephemeral, something that cannot be pinned down or defined.
entries.translation: Au pengine "Mimi" ni kitu ambacho ni cha kupita tu, kitu ambacho hakiwezi kuelezewa au kufafanuliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the question of "who am I?" is a mystery that we may never fully understand.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, swali la "mimi ni nani?" ni fumbo ambalo huenda hatutawahi kuelewa kamili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the ninth day of Navratri, a young woman named Parvati was told that she would give birth to a son who would become a great king.
entries.translation: Katika siku ya tisa ya Navratri, mwanamke mdogo kwa jina Parvati aliambiwa kwamba angemzaa mtoto mvulana ambaye angekuwa mfalme mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was overjoyed, and she began to prepare for her delivery.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na furaha tele, na alianza kujiandaa kujifungua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the tenth day of Navratri, Parvati went into labor.
entries.translation: Siku ya tisa ya Navratri, Pervati alianza kuhisi uchungu wa uzazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She labored for many hours, and finally, she gave birth to a beautiful baby boy.
entries.translation: Alihisi uchungu huo kwa saa kadhaa, na hatimaye, alijifungua mtoto mvulana mtanashati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She named him Shiva, and she knew that he would fulfill his destiny to become a great king.
entries.translation: Alimpa jina la Shiva, na alijua kwamba angetimiza hatma yake ya kuwa mfalme mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shiva grew up to be a strong and courageous young man.
entries.translation: Shiva alikua na akawa mwanaume mdogo ambaye anga nguvu na ujasiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always willing to help others, and he was known for his fairness and compassion.
entries.translation: Sikuzote alikuwa tayari kuwasaidia wengine, na alikuwa anajulikana kwa usawa na utulivu wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly became a popular figure among the people, and they looked to him for guidance and leadership.
entries.translation: Kwa haraka alikuwa mtu maarufu miongoni mwa watu, na walikuwa wanamtegemea kupata mwongozo na uongozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Shiva was walking through the forest when he came across a group of bandits who were attacking a village.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Shiva alikuwa anatembea katika msitu alipokutana na kikundi cha magaidi ambao walikuwa wanavamia kijiji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shiva quickly jumped into action, and he fought off the bandits.
entries.translation: Shiva kwa haraka akaamua kuchukua hatua, na akapigana na majangili hao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The villagers were grateful to Shiva for saving them, and they asked him to become their king.
entries.translation: Wanakijiji walimshukuru sana Shiva kwa kuwaokoa, na walimuomba awe mfalme wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shiva agreed to become king, and he ruled the kingdom wisely and justly for many years.
entries.translation: Shiva alikubali kuwa mfalme, na alitawala ufalme huo kwa hekima na usawa kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a kind and compassionate ruler, and he always put the needs of his people first.
entries.translation: Alikuwa kiongozi mwenye huruma na upole, na kila mara alikuwa anapatia mahitaji ya watu wake kipaumbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Good manners are the habits and actions that show respect for other people.
entries.translation: Tabia nzuri ni mienendo na vitendo ambavyo vinaonyesha heshima kwa watu wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are learned behaviors that are based on the Golden Rule, which says to treat others the way you want to be treated.
entries.translation: Ni tabia za kujifunza ambazo zinaegemea Kanuni Bora, inayosema tuhudumie wengine jinsi ambavyo tunataka kuhudumiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Good manners are important because they make the world a more pleasant place to live.
entries.translation: Tabia nzuri ni muhimu kwa sababu zinafanya dunia kuwa mahali pazuri zaidi kuishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They help to create a sense of community and make people feel more comfortable and respected.
entries.translation: Huwa zinasaidia kuwa na hisia ja jamii na kufanya watu kuwa na starehe zaidi na kuheshimika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of good manners, but some of the most important ones include being polite, being respectful, being honest, being considerate of others, and being responsible.
entries.translation: Kuna aina nyingi tofauti za tabia nzuri, lakini baadhi ya zile muhimu zaidi zinajumuisha kuwa mpole, kuwa na heshima, kuwa mwaminifu, kuwajali wengine, na kuwajibika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being polite means being courteous and respectful to others.
entries.translation: Kuwa mpole kunamaanisha kuwa na adabu na heshima kwa wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes saying "please" and "thank you," holding the door open for others, and listening attentively when someone is speaking.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kusema "tafadhali" na "asante," kuwafungulia wengine mlango, na kusikiliza kwa umakini wakati ambapo mtu anaongea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being respectful means treating others with dignity and respect, regardless of their age, race, gender, religion, or social status.
entries.translation: Kuwa na heshima kunamaanisha kuwahudumia wengine kwa hadhi na heshima, licha ya umri, mbari, jinsia, dini, au hali yao katika jamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes not making fun of others, not interrupting them when they are speaking, and listening to their opinions even if you disagree with them.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kutochekelea wengine, kutowakatiza wanapoongea, na kusikiliza maoni yao hata kama hukubaliani nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being honest means being truthful and sincere.
entries.translation: Kuwa mwaminifu kunamaanisha kusema ukweli na kuwa na moyo safi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes not lying or cheating, and being upfront about your intentions.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kutosema ukweli au kudanganya, na kujua malengo yako mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being considerate of others means being thoughtful and helpful.
entries.translation: Kuwajali wengine kunamaanisha kuwafikiria na kuwasaidia wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes being aware of the needs of others and doing what you can to make them feel comfortable.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kufahamu mahitaji ya wengine na kufanya yote unayoweza kufanya ili kuwafanya wahisi vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have colonized the solar system, but they are still searching for a way to travel faster than the speed of light.
entries.translation: Binadamu wametawala mfumo wa jua na sayari zake, lakini bado wanatafuta njia ya kusafiri haraka kuliko kasi ya mwangaza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of scientists are working on a new project that they believe will revolutionize space travel.
entries.translation: Kikundi cha wanasayansi wanafanya kazi katika mradi mpya ambao wanaamini kwamba utabadilisha kabisa usafiri wa angani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Einstein-Rosen Bridge is a theoretical concept that allows for the creation of a shortcut through space-time.
entries.translation: Einstein-Rosen Bridge ni dhana ya kinadharia ambayo inaruhusu uundaji wa njia ya mkato kupitia muda wa anga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If it can be created, it would allow humans to travel to distant stars in a matter of seconds.
entries.translation: Iwapo inaweza kuundwa, itaruhusu binadamu kusafiri kwenda kwa nyota za mbali kwa sekunde chache tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The scientists are working on a prototype of the Einstein-Rosen Bridge in a secret laboratory on the moon.
entries.translation: Wanasayansi hao wanashughulikia sampuli kifani ya Einstein-Rosen Bridge katika maabara ya kisiri kwenye mwezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have been working on the project for years, but they have not yet been able to create a stable wormhole.
entries.translation: Wamekuwa wakishughulikia mradi huo kwa miaka, lakini bado hawajaweza kuunda daraja imara la kuunganisha maeneo ya angani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, one of the scientists, Dr. Sarah Jones, makes a breakthrough.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mmoja kati ya wanasayansi hao, Dkt. Sarah Jones, aliweza kufaulu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She figures out a way to stabilize the wormhole.
entries.translation: Anawazia njia ya kuimarisha daraja la kuunganisha maeneo ya angani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She takes the prototype to the other scientists, and they are all amazed by her work.
entries.translation: Anapelekea wanasayansi wengine sampuli kifani, na wote wanafurahia kazi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The scientists are now confident that they can create a stable Einstein-Rosen Bridge.
entries.translation: Wanasayansi hao sasa wana ujasiri kwamba wanaweza kuunda Einstein-Rosen Bridge imara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are excited about the possibilities that this new technology could bring.
entries.translation: Wamefurahia uwezekano ambao teknolojia hii mpya inaweza kuleta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ donation is the process of giving organs or tissues to someone else after death.
entries.translation: Kutoa mchango wa kiungo cha mwili ni mchakato wa kumpa mtu viungo au tishu baada ya kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can save lives and improve the quality of life for people who are waiting for transplants.
entries.translation: Kunaweza kuokoa maisha na kuboresha ubora wa maisha kwa watu ambao wanasubiri viungo au tishu watakazochangiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of organs that can be donated, including kidneys, livers, hearts, lungs, and pancreases.
entries.translation: Kuna aina nyingi za viungo ambavyo vinaweza kuchangiwa, vinajumuisha figo, maini, mioyo, mapafu, na kongosho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tissues that can be donated include bone, skin, heart valves, and corneas.
entries.translation: Tishu ambazo zinaweza kuchangiwa zinajumuisha mfupa, ngozi, valvu za moyo, na konea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to organ donation.
entries.translation: Kuna manufaa mengi ya kuchangisha kiungo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For the recipient, organ donation can mean a new lease on life.
entries.translation: Kwa anayepokea, mchango wa kiungo unaweza kumaanisha fursa mpya ya maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For the donor, organ donation can be a way to make a difference in the world and help to save lives.
entries.translation: Kwa mchangiaji, kuchangia kiungo kunaweza kuwa njia ya kuleta mabadiliko katika dunia na kusaidia kuokoa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a few things to keep in mind if you are considering organ donation.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo machache ya kukumbuka iwapo unazingatia mchango wa kiungo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, you must be over the age of 18 and in good health.
entries.translation: Kwanza, lazima uwe na umri wa zaidi ya miaka 18 na uwe na afya nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, you must have a valid driver's license or state ID.
entries.translation: Pili, lazima uwe na leseni halali ya dereva au kitambulisho cha jimbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, you must sign a consent form to donate your organs.
entries.translation: Tatu, lazima utie saini kwenye fomu ya ridhaa ili kuchangisha viungo vyako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are interested in learning more about organ donation, there are many resources available to you.
entries.translation: Iwapo unapendelea kujifunza mengi kuhusu kuchangia kiungo, kuna rasilimali nyingi zinazopatikana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can visit the website of the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) at www.unos.org.
entries.translation: Unaweza kutembelea tovuti ya Mtandao wa Umoja wa Kushiriki Viungo (UNOS) katika www.unos.org.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also contact your local organ procurement organization (OPO).
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kuwasiliana na shirika lako la ndani la kupata viungo (OPO).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apartheid was a system of racial segregation that existed in South Africa from 1948 to 1994.
entries.translation: Siasa ya ubaguzi wa rangi ilikua ubaguzi wa rangi ambao ulikuwepo Afrika Kusini kuanzia 1948 hadi 1994.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was characterized by the separation of people of different races into different areas, schools, and other public facilities.
entries.translation: Ulikuwa na sifa ya kutenganishwa kwa watu wa rangi mablimbali katika maeneo, shule, na vituo tofauti vya umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The system was enforced by the South African government through a series of laws and regulations that discriminated against black people.
entries.translation: Mfumo huo uliwezeshwa na serikali ya Afrika Kusini kupitia misururu ya sheria na masharti ambayo yalibagua watu weusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apartheid was a brutal and oppressive system that denied black people their basic human rights.
entries.translation: Siasa ya ubaguzi wa rangi ilikuwa mfumo wa kikatili na ukandamizaji ambao uliwanyima watu weusi haki zao za msingi za kibinadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It resulted in the deaths of many people and the displacement of millions more.
entries.translation: Ilisababisha vifo vya watu wengi na kuhamishwa kwa mamilioni zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The end of apartheid came about through a combination of internal and external pressure.
entries.translation: Mwisho wa siasa za ubaguzi wa rangi ulitokea kupitia mchanganyiko wa shinikizo la ndani na nje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Nelson Mandela was released from prison and negotiations began between the government and the African National Congress.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1990, Nelso Mandela waliachiliwa kutoka gerezani na mazungumzo yalianza kati ya serikali na chama cha siasa cha Africa National Congress.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1994, South Africa held its first free and fair elections, and Nelson Mandela was elected president.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1994, Afrika Kusini ilifanya uchaguzi wake wa kwanza ambao ulikuwa huru na wa haki, na Nelson Mandela alichaguliwa kama rais.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gingerol is a powerful antioxidant that can help to reduce inflammation and improve circulation.
entries.translation: Gingerol ni kizuiaji cha uoksidishaji ambacho kinaweza kusaidia kupunguza uvimbe na kuboresha mzunguko wa damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also thought to have anti-emetic properties, which means that it can help to prevent vomiting.
entries.translation: Inadhaniwa kwamba pia ina sifa za kuzuia kutapisha, kumaanisha kwamba inaweza kusaidia kuzuia kutapika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root has been used for centuries to treat nausea and vomiting.
entries.translation: Mzizi wa tangawizi umetumika kwa miongo mingi kutibu kichefuchefu na kutapika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a popular remedy for morning sickness, motion sickness, and nausea caused by chemotherapy.
entries.translation: Ni suluhisho maarufu kwa magonjwa ya asubuhi, ugonjwa wa mwendo, na kichefuchefu kinachosababishwa na tibakemikali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is also effective in treating nausea that is caused by pregnancy, food poisoning, and other medical conditions.
entries.translation: Mzizi wa tangawizi pia ni faafu katika kutibu kichefuchefu ambacho kinasababishwa na ujauzito, kuharibikiwa na chakula, na hali nyingine za tiba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study participants who took ginger root reported significantly less nausea and vomiting than the participants who took a placebo.
entries.translation: Washiriki wa utafiti huo ambao walitumia mzizi wa tangawizi waliripoti kiwango cha chini cha kichefuchefu na kutapika ikilinganishwa na washiriki waliotumia kipozauongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is a safe and effective way to treat nausea.
entries.translation: Mzizi wa tangawizi ni njia salama na yenye ufanisi ya kutibu kichefuchefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is available in a variety of forms, including capsules, tablets, teas, and extracts.
entries.translation: Unapatikana katika njia mbalimbali, ikiwemo kapsuli, tembe, chai, na dondoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is also a common ingredient in many over-the-counter nausea medications.
entries.translation: Mzizi wa tangawizi pia ni kiambato cha kawaida katika dawa nyingi za kichefuchefu ambazo huwa zinanunuliwa katika maduka ya dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are experiencing nausea, ginger root may be a safe and effective way to relieve your symptoms.
entries.translation: Iwapo una kichefuchefu, mzizi wa tangawizi unaweza kuwa njia salama na yenye ufanisi ya kuondoa dalili zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to talk to your doctor before taking ginger root if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have any other medical conditions.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kuongea na daktari wako kabla ya kutumia mzizi wa tangawizi iwapo wewe ni mjamzito, unanyonyesha, au una hali nyingine ya kimatibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most common myths about improvement is that it is a linear process.
entries.translation: Moja kati ya uwongo wa kawaida zaidi kuhusu maendeleo ni kwamba ni mchakato wa mstari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are told that we should always be striving to improve ourselves, that we should never be satisfied with our current state.
entries.translation: Tunaambiwa kwamba huwa tunafaa kujikaza ili tujiboreshe, kwamba kamwe hatufai kuridhika na hali yetu ya sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This myth is often reinforced by the stories we tell ourselves about success.
entries.translation: Uwongo huu mara nyingi huwa unasisitizwa na hadithi ambazo huwa tunajiambia kuhusu mafanikio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are told that the successful person is the one who never gives up, who always keeps moving forward.
entries.translation: Tunaambiwa kwamba mtu aliyefanikiwa ni yule ambaye huwa hakati tamaa, ambaye kila mara huwa anasonga mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what if this myth is wrong?
entries.translation: Lakini uwongo huu si sahihi kwa nini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if improvement is not a linear process?
entries.translation: Na je, iwapo mabadiliko si mchakato wa mstari?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if it is more cyclical, or even chaotic?
entries.translation: Je, iwapo ni wa kujirudia, au hata wenye vurugu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if there are times when we need to step back and take stock of what we have achieved, rather than always striving for more?
entries.translation: Je, iwapo kuna wakati ambapo tunahitaji kurudi nyuma na kustahimili mshangao wa kitu ambacho tumefaulu kufanya, badala ya kila mara kung'ang'ana kufanya makubwa zaidi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that this is a more realistic view of improvement.
entries.translation: Naamini kwamba huu ni mtazamo wa kihalisia zaidi kuhusu maendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all human, and we all make mistakes.
entries.translation: Sisi sote ni binadamu, na sote huwa tunafanya makosa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There will be times when we fall back, when we doubt ourselves.
entries.translation: Kutakuwa na wakati ambapo tunarudi nyuma, tunapojishuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But these are also opportunities for growth.
entries.translation: Lakini hizi pia ni fursa za maendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts are a major cause of crop failure, and can have a devastating impact on food security and livelihoods.
entries.translation: Ukame ni vyanzo vikubwa vya mazao kufanya vibaya, na unaweza kuwa na athari mbaya kwa utoshelevu wa chakula na riziki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2019, a severe drought in the Horn of Africa left millions of people without food.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 2019, ukame mkali katika Pembe la Afrika uliwaacha mamilioni ya watu bila chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought was caused by a combination of factors, including El Niño and climate change.
entries.translation: Ukame huo ulisababishwa na mchanganyiko wa vipengele, ikiwa pamoja na El Niño na mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought killed livestock, destroyed crops, and forced people to flee their homes.
entries.translation: Ukame huo uliua mifugo, ukaharibu mazao, na kuwalazimisha watu kutoroka nyumbani mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some areas, the drought was so severe that it caused famine.
entries.translation: Katika maeneo mengine, ukame huo ulikuwa mkali sana kiasi kwamba ulisababisha baa la njaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Pacific Ocean is a major driver of global climate patterns.
entries.translation: Bahari Pasifiki ni kiendeshaji kikubwa cha mitindo ya tabianchi ya ulimwengu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: El Niño is a natural climate pattern that occurs every few years.
entries.translation: El Niño ni mtindo asili wa tabianchi ambao huwa unafanyika kila baada ya miaka michache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During El Niño, the ocean surface temperature in the Pacific Ocean rises, which can cause droughts in some parts of the world and floods in others.
entries.translation: El niño, halijoto ya eneo la bahari katika Bahari Pasifiki huwa inaongezeka, hii inaweza kusababisha ukame katika baadhi ya sehemu za dunia na mafuriko katika sehemu nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change is also causing the Earth's temperature to rise, which is leading to more extreme weather events, such as droughts.
entries.translation: Mabadiliko ya tabianchi pia yanafanya halijoto ya Dunia kuongezeka, hali hii inaleta matukio makali ya hali ya hewa, kama vile ukame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birds are sensitive to changes in their environment.
entries.translation: Ndege huwa nyeti sana kwa mabadiliko katika mazingira yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts can cause a shortage of food and water for birds, which can lead to death or migration.
entries.translation: Ukame unaweza kuleta upungufu wa chakula na maji kwa ndege, hali hii inaweza kusababisha kifo au uhamiaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am a huge fan of your work, and I was inspired by your essay "No Extra Movement", where you discuss the difference between cool weather and freezing cold weather.

entries.english: Cool weather is refreshing and invigorating.

entries.english: It can be a welcome relief from the heat of summer, and it can create a sense of calm and tranquility.

entries.english: Freezing cold weather, on the other hand, is harsh and unforgiving.
entries.translation: Hali ya hewa yenye baridi tele kiasi ya kugandisha, kwa upande mwingine, ni kali na isiyovutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be dangerous, and it can make it difficult to stay warm and comfortable.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuwa hatari, na inaweza kufanya iwe vigumu kuwa na joto na starehe mwilini.

entries.english: One of the biggest differences between cool weather and freezing cold weather is the way it affects our bodies.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya tofauti kubwa kabisa kati ya hali ya baridi na hali ya baridi tele ni kwa njia ambayo inaathiri miili yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it is cool, our bodies are able to maintain their temperature relatively easily.

entries.english: We may need to wear a sweater or jacket, but we can still stay active and comfortable.

entries.english: When it is freezing cold, our bodies have to work much harder to stay warm.

entries.english: We may need to bundle up in layers of clothing, and we may even need to stay indoors.

entries.english: Another difference between cool weather and freezing cold weather is the way it affects our mood.
entries.translation: Tofauti nyinginge kati ya hali ya baridi na hali ya baridi ya kupindukia ni njia ambayo huwa inaathiri hisia zetu.

entries.english: Patriotism is the love of one's country and the willingness to defend it.

entries.english: It can be expressed in many ways, from serving in the military to volunteering in your community.

entries.english: Patriotism is important because it helps to create a sense of unity and common purpose among citizens.
entries.translation: Uzalendo ni muhimu kwa sababu huwa unatusaidia kuunda dhana ya umoja na lengo la pamoja miongoni mwa raia.

entries.english: It also helps to promote democracy and protect the rights of all citizens.

entries.english: One example of patriotism is the story of George Washington crossing the Delaware River.

entries.english: In December 1776, Washington and his troops were in a difficult position.

entries.english: They had been defeated in several battles and were in danger of being captured by the British.

entries.english: However, Washington knew that he had to keep fighting for the cause of American independence.

entries.english: On Christmas night, he led his troops across the Delaware River in a surprise attack on the British.

entries.english: The attack was a success, and it helped to turn the tide of the war in favor of the Americans.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is an example of patriotism because it shows the willingness of Americans to fight for their country, even when the odds were stacked against them.
entries.translation: Hadithi hiyo ni mfano wa uzalendo kwa sababu inaonyesha utayari wa Wamarekani kupigania nchi yao, hata kama walikuwa wanaonekana kwamba hawawezi kushinda vita hivyo.

entries.english: It is also an example of how patriotism can help to achieve a common goal.

entries.english: In this case, the goal was to win the American Revolution and establish a free and independent nation.

entries.english: After a long and tiring year of work, two engineers decided to take a solo romantic honeymoon.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They traveled to a beautiful island in the middle of the ocean, where they spent their days swimming, sunbathing, and making love.
entries.translation: Walisafiri kwenda katika kisiwa kizuri kinachopatikana katikati mwa bahari, mahali ambapo walikuwa wakiogelea, wakiota jua, na kufanya mapenzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One night, as they were lying on the beach, gazing up at the stars, the engineer asked his wife to tell him a story.
entries.translation: Usiku moja, walipokuwa wamelala kwenye ufuo wa bahari, wakitazama nyota juu angani, mhandisi huyo alimuagiza mkewe amwambie hadithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled and began to tell him a story about two engineers who fell in love.
entries.translation: Alitabasamu na kuanza kumwambia hadithi kuhusu wahandisi wawili ambao walipendana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The engineer listened intently, and as he listened, he realized that the story was about him and his wife.
entries.translation: Mhandisi huyo alisikiliza kwa makini, na alipokuwa anasikiliza, aligundua kwamba hadithi hiyo ilikuwa inamhusu yeye na mke wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the story was over, he turned to his wife and said, "That was the most beautiful story I've ever heard."
entries.translation: Hadithi hiyo ilipoisha, alimgeukia mkewe na kumwambia, "Hiyo ndiyo ilikuwa hadithi nzuri zaidi ambayo nimewahi kusikia."

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The topic I would like to write about is artificial intelligence.
entries.translation: Mada ambayo ningependa kuandika kuhusu ni akiliunde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.
entries.translation: Akiliunde (AI) ni uigaji wa michakato ya akili ya binadamu na mashine, hasa mifumo ya kompyuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI research has been highly successful in developing effective techniques for solving a wide range of problems, from game playing to medical diagnosis.
entries.translation: Utafiti wa AI umekuwa na mafanikio mengi katika kuunda mbinu faafu za kutatua masafa marefu ya matatizo, kuanzia kucheza mchezo hadi utambuzi wa magonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are still many challenges to be overcome before AI systems can achieve human-level intelligence.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, bado kuna changamoto nyingi za kushindwa kabla ya mifumo ya AI kufanikisha akili ya kiwango cha akili ya binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest challenges facing AI researchers is the problem of generalization.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya changamoto kubwa zaidi ambazo watafiti wa AI wanakumbana nazo ni shida ya kufanya mambo kuwa ya jumla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are often able to learn to solve specific problems very well, but they often struggle to generalize their knowledge to new problems.
entries.translation: Mifumo ya AI mara nyingi huwa inaweza kujifunza kutatua matatizo maalum vizuri sana, lakini mara nyingi huwa zinang'ang'ana na kufanya maarifa yao kuwa ya jumla katika kutatua matatizo mapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because AI systems are typically trained on a large dataset of examples, and they may not be able to generalize to new situations that are not represented in the training data.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu mifumo ya AI kimsingi imefundishwa kwenye mifano kutoka kwa seti kubwa ya data, na huenda isiweze kufanya mambo kuwa ya jumla kwenye hali mpya ambazo hazijawakilishwa katika data ya mafunzo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge facing AI researchers is the problem of robustness.
entries.translation: Changamoto nyingine inayowakumba watafiti wa AI ni shida ya kuwa imara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are often brittle, meaning that they can be easily fooled by small changes to the input data.
entries.translation: Mifumo ya AI mara nyingi huwa rahisi kubadilika, kumaanisha kwamba inaweza kudanganywa na mabadiliko madogo kwenye data iliyoingizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can make AI systems dangerous in safety-critical applications, such as self-driving cars.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanya mifumo ya AI kuwa hatari katika programu zinazohitaji usalama wa juu, kama vile magari yanayojiendesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, AI research is making great progress.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizi, utafiti wa AI unapiga hatua kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are becoming increasingly powerful and capable, and they are already having a major impact on our world.
entries.translation: Mifumo ya AI inaendelea kuwa thabiti na yenye uwezo, na tayari inakuwa na athari kubwa katika ulimwengu wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
entries.translation: Mfumuko wa bei ni ongezeko la kwa jumla na kushuka kwa thamani ya pesa ya kununua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often measured as a change in the consumer price index (CPI), which tracks the prices of a basket of goods and services that are commonly purchased by households.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi huwa unapimwa kama mabadiliko katika fahirisi ya bei ya mtumiaji (CPI), ambayo huwa inafuatilia bei za kikapu cha bidhaa na huduma ambazo huwa zinanunuliwa sana katika familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inflation can be caused by a number of factors, including increases in the money supply, higher demand for goods and services, and supply shocks.
entries.translation: Mfumuko wa bei unaweza kusababishwa na vipengele mbalimbali, kama vile kuongezeka kwa usambazaji wa pesa, bidhaa na huduma kuwa na madai ya juu, na mishtuko ya usambazaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the economy is growing rapidly, businesses may be able to raise prices without losing customers.
entries.translation: Wakati ambapo uchumi unakua kwa haraka, biashara zinaweza kuongeza bei bila kupoteza wateja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a rise in inflation.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuleta ongezeko la mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also factors that can help to offset the inflationary effects of faster economic growth.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, pia kuna vipengele vinavyoweza kusaidia kutatua athari za mfumuko wa bei wa uchumi unaokua kwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if the labor market is tight, wages may rise more slowly than prices, which can help to keep inflation in check.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, iwapo soko la leba ni ngumu, mishahara inaweza kuongezeka polepole zaidi ya bei, hii inaweza kusaidia katika kudhibiti mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the relationship between economic growth and inflation is complex.
entries.translation: Kwa jumla, uhusiano kati ya maendeleo ya kiuchumi na mfumuko wa bei ni changamano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no simple rule that can predict how faster economic growth will affect inflation.
entries.translation: Hakuna kanuni sahili inayoweza kutabiri jinsi ambavyo maendeleo ya haraka ya kiuchumi yatakavyoathiri mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to be aware of the potential for inflation when the economy is growing rapidly.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kufahamu uwezekano wa mfumuko wa bei wakati ambapo uchumi unakua kwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the factors mentioned above, there are a number of other factors that can affect inflation.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya vipengele ambavyo vimetajwa hapo juu, kuna vipengele vingine ambavyo vinaweza kuathiri mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include the exchange rate, interest rates, and government policies.
entries.translation: Vipengele hivi vinajumuisha kiwango cha kubadilisha sarafu, viwango vya riba, na sera za serikali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The exchange rate can affect inflation by making imported goods more or less expensive.
entries.translation: Kiwango cha kubadilisha sarafu kinaweza kuathiri mfumuko wa bei kwa kufanya bidhaa zinazotolewa nje ya nchi kuwa ghali au nafuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if the value of the dollar falls, imported goods will become more expensive, which can lead to higher inflation.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, iwapo thamani ya dola itapungua, bidhaa zinazotolewa nje ya nchi zitakuwa ghali mno, na hali hii inaweza kuleta mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interest rates can also affect inflation.
entries.translation: Viwango vya riba pia vinaweza kuathiri mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When interest rates are high, businesses and consumers are less likely to borrow money, which can slow economic growth and reduce inflation.
entries.translation: Viwango vya riba vikiwa juu, biashara na watumiaji wana uwezekano wa chini wa kukopa pesa, hali hii inaweza kuleta maendeleo ya polepole ya kiuchumi na kupunguza mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Government policies can also affect inflation.
entries.translation: Sera za serikali zinaweza pia kuathiri mfumuko wa bei.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, government spending can increase demand for goods and services, which can lead to higher prices.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, serikali inavyotumia pesa inaweza kuongeza madai ya bidhaa na huduma, hali hii inaweza kufanya bei kuongezeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Government regulations can also affect the price of goods and services.
entries.translation: Masharti ya serikali yanaweza pia kuathiri bei ya bidhaa na huduma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The relationship between economic growth and inflation is complex and depends on a number of factors.
entries.translation: Uhusiano kati ya maendeleo ya kiuchumi na mfumuko wa bei ni changamano na unategemea vipengele mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalist thought is the belief that the only way to acquire knowledge is through reason and logic.
entries.translation: Fikra ya kirazini ni imani kwamba njia pekee ya kupata maarifa ni kupitia sababu na mantiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is based on the idea that the world is governed by natural laws that can be understood through observation and experimentation.
entries.translation: Inategemea wazo kwamba ulimwengu unaongozwa na sheria asili ambazo mtu anaweza kufahamu kupitia uchunguzi na majaribio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalists believe that the only way to truly understand the world is to strip away all of our preconceived notions and biases and look at things objectively.
entries.translation: Warazini wanaamini kwamba njia pekee ya kufahamu ulimwengu kwa kweli ni kusahau kabisa dhana au mapendeleo yetu ambayo tayari tuko nayo na kuangalia mambo bila upendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be a difficult task, but it is one that is essential for making progress in science and philosophy.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa kazi ngumu, lakini ni kazi ambayo ni muhimu katika kupiga hatua katika sayansi na falsafa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalists believe that the only way to make good decisions is to base them on facts and evidence.
entries.translation: Warazini wanaamini kwamba njia pekee ya kufanya maamuzi mazuri ni kufanya maamuzi yanayotokana na ukweli na ushahidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They reject the idea that intuition or emotion can ever be a reliable guide to truth.
entries.translation: Wanakataa wazo kwamba hisia kamwe haiwezi kuwa mwongozo wa ukweli wa kutegemewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This does not mean that rationalists are cold and unfeeling; they simply believe that it is important to separate our feelings from our thoughts when making decisions.
entries.translation: Hii haimaanishi kwamba warazini ni watu ambao hawana hisia; wanaamini tu kwamba ni muhimu kutenganisha hisia zetu na fikra zetu tunapofanya maamuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalism has been a major force in the development of Western thought.
entries.translation: Urazini umekuwa msukumo mkubwa katika ukuaji wa fikra ya Magharibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has led to many important advances in science, philosophy, and technology.
entries.translation: Umeleta hatua nyingi muhimu katika sayansi, falsafa, na teknolojia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it has also been criticized for being too narrow and rigid.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, urazini pia umeweza kupingwa kwa kuwa mwembamba sana na usioshawishika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people argue that it ignores the importance of emotion and intuition, and that it can lead to a dehumanizing view of the world.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanadai kwamba urazini hupuuza umuhimu wa hisia, na kwamba unaweza kuleta mtazamo unaodhalilisha dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these criticisms, rationalism remains a powerful force in Western thought.
entries.translation: Licha ya kukosolewa, urazini unasalia kuwa msukumo mkubwa katika fikra ya Magharibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Nigeria include Lagos, Kano, and Port Harcourt.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya maeneo muhimu zaidi nchini Nijeria yanajumuisha Lagos, Kano, na Port Harcourt.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lagos is the largest city in Nigeria and the economic capital of the country.
entries.translation: Lagos ni jiji kubwa zaidi nchini Nijeria na ni kituo cha uchumi wa nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kano is the second largest city in Nigeria and an important center for Islamic culture.
entries.translation: Kano ni jiji la pili kwa ukubwa nchini Nijeria na kituo muhimu cha utamaduni wa Uislamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Port Harcourt is a major port city and the center of the oil industry in Nigeria.
entries.translation: Port Harcourt ni jiji kubwa la bandari na kituo cha kiwanda cha mafuta nchini Naijeria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Nigeria include Usman dan Fodio, Muhammad Bello, and Nnamdi Azikiwe.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watu muhimu zaidi katika historia ya Naijeria ni Usman dan Fodio, Muhammad Bello, na Nnamdi Azikiwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Usman dan Fodio was a religious leader who founded the Sokoto Caliphate in the 19th century.
entries.translation: Usman dan Fodio alikuwa kiongozi wa kidini ambaye alianzisha Milki ya Khalifa ya Sokoto katika karne ya 19.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Muhammad Bello was the son of Usman dan Fodio and the second sultan of the Sokoto Caliphate.
entries.translation: Muhammad Bello alikuwa mwana wa Usman dan Fodio na sultani wa pili wa Milki ya Khalifa ya Sokoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nnamdi Azikiwe was a nationalist leader who played a key role in the independence of Nigeria from British rule.
entries.translation: Nnamdi Azikiwe alikuwa kiongozi ambaye alipigania uhuru na alitekeleza jukumu muhimu katika uhuru wa Naijeria kutoka kwa watawala wa Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Labour Day is a day to honour the contributions and achievements of workers.
entries.translation: Siku ya Leba ni siku ya kuadhimisha michango na mafanikio ya wafanyakazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to reflect on the importance of hard work and dedication, and to appreciate the intelligence and skill of those who have made our country great.
entries.translation: Ni wakati wa kuwazia umuhimu wa bidii na kujitolea kazini, na kushukuru werevu na ujuzi wa wale ambao wamefanya nchi yetu kuwa bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such example is the story of Henry Ford.
entries.translation: Mfano moja kama huo ni hadithi ya Henry Ford.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford was a brilliant engineer and businessman who revolutionized the automobile industry.
entries.translation: Ford alikuwa mhandisi shupavu na mfanyabiashara ambaye alibadilisha kabisa kiwanda cha magari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is credited with inventing the assembly line, which made it possible to produce cars more efficiently and cheaply.
entries.translation: Anapewa sifa ya kuvumbua karakara ya kuunganisha pamoja sehemu za magari, hali ambayo iliwezesha kutengeneza magari kwa urahisi na bei nafuu mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to a boom in the auto industry and helped to create millions of jobs.
entries.translation: Hii ilichangia kuongezeka kwa kiwanda cha magari na kusaidia kuleta mamilioni ya nafasi za kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford was also a strong advocate for workers' rights.
entries.translation: Ford alikuwa mtetezi mkubwa wa haki za wafanyakazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He believed that all workers should be paid a fair wage and have safe working conditions.
entries.translation: Aliamini kwamba wafanyakazi wote wanafaa kulipwa mshahara wenye haki na kuwa na hali salama za kufanya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also established a profit-sharing plan for his employees, which made them shareholders in the company.
entries.translation: Alianzisha pia mpango wa kushiriki faida na waajiriwa wake, hii ilifanya waajiriwa hao kuwa wahisa katika kampuni hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford's intelligence and dedication helped to create a better world for workers.
entries.translation: Werevu na kujitolea kwa Ford kulisaidia katika kuunda dunia bora kwa wafanyakazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is an inspiration to us all, and his legacy continues to inspire workers today.
entries.translation: Yeye ni himizo kwetu sote, na sifa zake zinaendelea kuhimiza wafanyakazi leo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertiveness is the ability to stand up for your rights in a confident and direct way, without being aggressive or passive-aggressive.
entries.translation: Utetezi ni uwezo wa kutetea haki zako kwa njia ya ujasiri na ya moja kwa moja, bila kuwa mshari au mshari bila kuonyesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are assertive, you are able to express your thoughts and feelings clearly and respectfully, and you are able to set boundaries and say no when necessary.
entries.translation: Ukiwa mtetezi, unaweza kuonyesha fikra na hisia zako kwa njia ya wazi na yenye heshima, na unaweza kuweka mipaka na kusema hapana panapofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aggressiveness, on the other hand, is the tendency to be forceful or hostile in a way that is intended to intimidate or hurt others.
entries.translation: Ushari, kwa upande mwingine, ni mwelekeo wa kulazimisha mambo au kuwa na ujeuri kwa njia ambayo inalenga kudhihaki au kuumiza wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are aggressive, you may try to control others through intimidation or threats, and you may be quick to anger and lash out.
entries.translation: Ukiwa mshari, unaweza kujaribu kuwadhibiti wengine kupitia dhihaki na vitisho, na unaweza kuwa mwepesi wa hasira na ugomvi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Arrogant behavior is characterized by a feeling of superiority and a lack of respect for others.
entries.translation: Tabia ya ufidhuli ina sifa ya hisia ya kiburi na ukosefu wa heshima kwa wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are arrogant, you may brag about your accomplishments, put others down, or act entitled.
entries.translation: Ukiwa mfidhuli, unaweza kuwa na majivuno kuhusu mafanikio yako, kudunisha wengine, au kujifanya kuwa una haki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be able to distinguish between assertiveness, aggressiveness, and arrogance, as each behavior has its own set of consequences.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuweza kutofautisha kati ya utetezi, ushari, na ufidhuli, kwa sababu kila tabia ina athari zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertiveness is generally seen as a positive trait, while aggressiveness and arrogance are often seen as negative traits.
entries.translation: Utetezi kwa kawaida huonekana kama sifa chanya, huku ushari na ufidhuli mara nyingi huwa unaonekana kama sifa hasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertive people are more likely to be successful in their personal and professional lives, as they are able to stand up for themselves and get their needs met.
entries.translation: Watu watetezi wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kufanikiwa zaidi katika maisha yao ya kibinafsi na kitaalamu, kwa sababu wanaweza kujitetea na kuhakikisha mahitaji yao yametimizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aggressive people, on the other hand, are more likely to alienate others and have difficulty forming healthy relationships.
entries.translation: Watu walio na ushari, kwa upande mwingine, wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kutenganisha wengine na kuwa na ugumu wa kuwa na uhusiano mzuri na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And arrogant people are often seen as conceited and unlikable.
entries.translation: Na watu wafidhuli mara nyingi huwa wanaonekana kama wana kiburi na hawapendeki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are struggling to be assertive, there are a few things you can do to improve your assertiveness skills.
entries.translation: Iwapo unapambana ili uwe mtetezi, kuna mambo machache ambayo unaweza kufanya ili kuboresha ujuzi wako wa utetezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is important to be aware of your own feelings and needs.
entries.translation: Kwanza, ni muhimu kufahamu hisia na mahitaji yako mwenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you want, you can start to express yourself more clearly and directly.
entries.translation: Mara tu umejua kile ambacho unataka, unaweza kuanza kujielezea kwa uwazi na moja kwa moja zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to be respectful of others, even when you are disagreeing with them.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu pia kuheshimu wengine, hata kama hukubaliani na wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, it is important to be confident in yourself and your abilities.
entries.translation: Na hatimaye, ni muhimu kujiamini na kuamini uwezo wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you believe in yourself, others are more likely to believe in you too.
entries.translation: Ukijiamini, wengine watakuwa na uwezekano mkubwa wa kukuamini pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so glad we're having this conversation about conservation of biodiversity.
entries.translation: A: Nafurahi kwamba tuna mazungumzo haya kuhusu hifadhi ya bioanuwai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so important to protect our planet's natural resources.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu sana kulinda rasilimali asili katika sayari yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Biodiversity is essential for the health of our planet.
entries.translation: Bioanuwai ni muhimu kwa afya ya sayari yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It provides us with food, water, and other resources that we need to survive.
entries.translation: Huwa inatupatia chakula, maji, na rasilimali nyingine ambazo tunahitaji ili kuishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: And it also provides us with beauty and inspiration.
entries.translation: A: Na pia huwa inatupatia urembo na himizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we protect biodiversity, we're protecting the very foundation of life on Earth.
entries.translation: Tukilinda bioanuwai, tunalinda msingi wa maisha Duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So what can we do to help?
entries.translation: B: Hivyo tunaweza kufanya nini ili kusaidia?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a lot of things we can do.
entries.translation: A: Kuna mambo mengi ambayo tunaweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our consumption of resources, recycle and compost, and support sustainable businesses.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kupunguza matumizi yetu ya rasilimali, kutumia upya na kutengenezea mbolea, na kusaidia biashara endelevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also get involved in local conservation efforts.
entries.translation: Tunaweza pia kujihusisha katika juhudi za hifadhi katika eneo letu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I'm already doing some of those things.
entries.translation: B: Tayari nafanya baadhi ya vitu hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I recycle and compost, and I try to buy local produce.
entries.translation: Huwa natumia upya na kutengenezea mbolea, na kujaribu kununua mazao ya eneo letu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: That's great! Every little bit helps.
entries.translation: A: Hiyo ni nzuri! Kila kidogo huwa kinasaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I'd like to do more, though. What else can I do?
entries.translation: B: Ningependa kufanya mengi. Naweza kufanya nini tena?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: You could volunteer for a conservation organization, or donate to one.
entries.translation: A: Unaweza kujitolea katika shirika la hifadhi, au kuchangia shirika moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first day of school is always a little nerve-wracking, but it's also exciting.
entries.translation: Siku ya kwanza shuleni huwa na wasiwasi mwingi, lakini pia huwa ya kusisimua pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a chance to meet new people, learn new things, and start fresh.
entries.translation: Ni nafasi ya kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza vitu vipya, na kuanza upya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This year, I was especially excited for my first day of school because I was starting at a new school.
entries.translation: Mwaka huu, nilikuwa nimefurahia sana siku yangu ya kwanza shuleni kwa sababu nilikuwa naanza shule mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had just moved to a new town, and I didn't know anyone.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa nimehamia mji mpya, na sikuwa namjua yeyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I was determined to make a good impression and make some new friends.
entries.translation: Lakini nilikuwa nimejitolea kuwa na wazo zuri na kupata marafiki wapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I got to school, I was immediately impressed by how big it was.
entries.translation: Nilipofika shuleni, mara moja nikafurahishwa na namna ambavyo shule hiyo ilikuwa kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was much bigger than my old school, and there were so many students.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa kubwa sana kuliko shule yangu ya awali, na kulikuwa na wanafunzi wengi mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I felt a little lost and overwhelmed at first, but I soon found my way to my classroom.
entries.translation: Nilihisi nimepotea kidogo na kulemewa kwa mara ya kwanza, lakini nikapata njia ya kwenda darasani mwangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My teacher, Ms. Smith, was really nice.
entries.translation: Mwalimu wangu, Bi. Smith, alikuwa mzuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to the class and then told us what we would be learning that year.
entries.translation: Alijitambulisha kwa darasa na kisha akatuambia yale ambayo tutasoma mwaka huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was excited to start learning new things.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa na furaha ya kuanza kusoma mambo mapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After Ms. Smith introduced herself, she told us to introduce ourselves to the person sitting next to us.
entries.translation: Baada ya Bi. Smith kujitambulisha, alituambia kwamba sisi pia tujitambulishe kwa mtu anayeketi kando yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the process of evaluating and judging the quality of something, and it can be a valuable tool for improving the work of art, literature, music, or other creative endeavor.
