entries.translation: Ni mchakato wa kutathmini na kuamua ubora wa kitu, na ni unaweza kuwa zana muhimu ya kuboresha kazi ya sanaa, fasihi, muziki, au vinginevyo kazi ya ubunifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, criticism can also be destructive, tearing down what others have created without offering any constructive feedback.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ukosoaji unaweza kuleta uharibifu, na kuharibu kitu ambacho wengine wameunda bila kutoa maoni yoyote ya kujenga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The perfect criticism is one that is both fair and helpful.
entries.translation: Ukosoaji bora ni ule ambao ni wa haki na unasaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It should be based on sound reasoning and evidence, and it should offer specific suggestions for how to improve the work in question.
entries.translation: Unafaa kutegemea hoja yenye mantiki na ushahidi, na unafaa kutoa mapendekezo maalum ya namna ya kuboresha kazi husika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The perfect critic is someone who is knowledgeable about the subject matter and who is able to articulate their thoughts clearly and concisely.
entries.translation: Mkosoaji bora ni yule ambaye ana ufahamu kuhusu mada husika na ambaye anaweza kuelezea fikra zake kwa uwazi na muhtasari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Criticism is a skill that can be learned and improved with practice.
entries.translation: Ukosoaji ni ujuzi ambao unaweza kusomwa na kuboreshwa kupitia matendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are interested in becoming a better critic, there are a few things you can do.
entries.translation: Iwapo unapendelea kuwa mkosoaji bora, kuna mambo machache ambayo unaweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, read widely and develop a strong understanding of the different forms of art and literature.
entries.translation: Kwanza, soma kwa mapana na uwe na ufahamu thabiti wa aina tofauti za sanaa na fasihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, learn to think critically about the work you are consuming.
entries.translation: Pili, jifunze kufikiria kwa njia ya uhakiki kuhusu kazi ambayo unatumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ask yourself questions about the author's purpose, the audience for the work, and the techniques used by the artist.
entries.translation: Jiulize maswali kuhusu madhumuni ya mwandishi, hadhira inayolengwa na kazi hiyo, na mbinu zinazotumika na msanii huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, be willing to share your opinions with others, even if they are not popular.
entries.translation: Tatu, kuwa tayari kushiriki maoni yako na wengine, hata kama maoni hayo si maarufu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to improve your critical skills is to practice them.
entries.translation: Njia bora ya kuboresha ujuzi wako wa uhakiki ni kuutumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sierra Leone is a country in West Africa with a rich history.
entries.translation: Sierra Leone ni nchi inayopatikana Afrika Magharibi na ina historia kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important events in Sierra Leone's history was the founding of Freetown in 1787.
entries.translation: Moja kati ya matukio muhimu zaidi katika historia ya Sierra Leone lilikuwa kuundwa kwa jiji la Freetown mwaka wa 1787.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freetown was founded by the British as a colony for freed slaves from the United States.
entries.translation: Jiji la Freetown lilianzishwa na Waingereza kama ukoloni wa watumwa walioachiliwa huru kutoka Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The colony grew rapidly, and by the 19th century, Freetown was a major center of commerce and culture.
entries.translation: Ukoloni huo ulikua kwa haraka, na kufikia karne ya 19, Freetown ilikuwa kituo kikubwa cha biashara na utamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1896, Sierra Leone became a British protectorate.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1896, Sierra Leone ilikuwa chini ya ulinzi wa Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During the colonial period, Sierra Leone experienced significant economic and social development.
entries.translation: Wakati wa kipindi cha ukoloni, Sierra Leone ilipitia maendeleo makubwa kiuchumi na kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country also faced challenges, such as poverty, disease, and political instability.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, nchi hiyo ilikumbana na changamoto, kama vile umaskini, ugonjwa, na kutokuwa imara kisiasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1961, Sierra Leone gained its independence from Britain.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1961, Sierra Leone ilipata uhuru wake kutoka Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country's first president was Sir Milton Margai.
entries.translation: Rais wa kwanza wa nchi hiyo alikuwa Bw. Milton Margai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Margai was a moderate politician who sought to build a multi-ethnic and multi-religious state.
entries.translation: Margai alikuwa rais wa wastani ambaye aliamua kujenga taifa ambalo ni la makabila mbalimbali na dini mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, his policies were opposed by some groups, including the militant Revolutionary United Front (RUF).
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, sera zake zilipingwa na baadhi ya vikundi, vikiwemo wanajeshi wa Revolutionary United Front (RUF).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1991, the RUF launched a civil war against the Sierra Leonean government.
entries.translation: Mnamo 1991, RUF ilizindua vita vya watu wenyewe kuipinga serikali ya Sierra Leone.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war lasted for 11 years and caused widespread death and destruction.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilikaa kwa miaka 11 na kusababisha vifo vingi na uharibifu mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war ended in 2002 with the signing of a peace agreement.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo viliisha mwaka wa 2002 baada ya kutiwa saini mapatano ya amani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tattoo artist, a burly man with a thick beard, looked over his inventory of art.
entries.translation: Msanii huyo wa michoro ya mwili, mwanaume mwenye miraba minne ambaye ana ndevu nyingi, aliangalia orodha yake ya sanaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had a wide variety of designs to choose from, but he was struggling to find the perfect one for his next client.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na miundo anuwai ya kuchagua, lakini alikuwa anang'ang'ana kupata muundo bora wa mteja wake anayefuata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The client, a young woman with long, dark hair, was sitting in the chair, looking at the wall of tattoos.
entries.translation: Mteja huyo, mwanamke mdogo aliye na nywele ndefu nyeusi, alikuwa ameketi kwenye kiti, akitazama ukuta ulio na michoro ya mwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been thinking about getting a tattoo for a long time, but she couldn't decide what she wanted.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akifikiria kuhusu kuwekewa mchoro wa mwili kwa muda mrefu sana, lakini hangeweza kuamua muundo ambao alikuwa anataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm not sure what I want," she said. "I just want something that's meaningful."
entries.translation: "Sina uhakika na kile ambacho nataka," alisema. "Nataka tu kitu kilicho na maana."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tattoo artist nodded. "I understand," he said.
entries.translation: Msanii huyo wa michoro alitikisa kichwa. "Naelewa," alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's important to find a design that you'll love for the rest of your life."
entries.translation: "Ni muhimu kupata muundo ambao utapenda maisha yako yote."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He thought for a moment, then turned to the wall and pointed to a design of a rose.
entries.translation: Aliwaza kwa muda, kisha akageuka na kuangalia ukuta kisha akaonyesha muundo wa waridi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What about this?" he asked. "It's a symbol of love and beauty."
entries.translation: "Hii je?" aliuliza. "Ni ishara ya upendo na urembo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman looked at the design for a moment, then nodded.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo aliangalia muundo huo kwa muda, kisha akatikisa kichwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I like it," she said. "I'll take it." The tattoo artist smiled and got to work.
entries.translation: "Naupenda," alisema. "Nitauchukua." Msanii huyo wa michoro alitabasamu na kuanza kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
entries.translation: Dunia imekuwa eneo tofauti kuliko ilivyokuwa miongo michache iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Technology has advanced at an unprecedented rate, and with it, our understanding of the universe.
entries.translation: Teknolojia imeendelea katika kiwango ambacho hakina kifani, na kwa teknolojia hiyo, ufahamu wetu wa ulimwengu pia umeongezeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We now know that there are countless other planets out there, and that some of them may even be inhabited.
entries.translation: Sasa tunajua kwamba kuna sayari kadhaa hapo nje, na kwamba binadamu anaweza hata kuishi katika baadhi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has given rise to a new genre of science fiction: space opera.
entries.translation: Hii imeleta ongezeko la utanzu mpya wa sayansi ya kubuniwa: opera ya angani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Space operas are big, sweeping adventure stories that take place in the vastness of space.
entries.translation: Opera za angani ni kubwa, zinafagia hadithi za kutaka kujua mengi ambazo huwa zinafanyika katika ukubwa wa anga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They often feature interstellar travel, alien civilizations, and other fantastical elements.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi huwa zina usafiri wa baina ya nyota, ustaarabu mgeni, na vipengele vingine vya kuwazika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular space operas include Star Wars, Star Trek, and Battlestar Galactica.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya opera za angani ambazo ni maarufu zaidi ni Star Wars, Star Trek, na Battlestar Galactica.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These shows have captivated audiences for decades with their thrilling stories, memorable characters, and stunning visuals.
entries.translation: Filamu hizi zimenasa hadhira kwa miongo kupitia kwa hadithi zao za kufurahisha, wahusika wa kukumbukwa, na mambo mazuri ya kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Space operas are a great way to escape the everyday world and explore a new and exciting universe.
entries.translation: Opera za angani ni njia bora za kuhepa dunia ya kila siku na kuchunguza ulimwengu mpya na wa kufurahisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also be thought-provoking and inspiring, as they often deal with big questions about life, the universe, and everything.
entries.translation: Pia zinaweza kuwa za kuibua mawazo na za kuhimiza, kwa sababu mara nyingi zinakabiliana na maswali makubwa kuhusu maisha, ulimwengu, na kila kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're a fan of science fiction, then space operas are definitely worth checking out.
entries.translation: Iwapo wewe ni shabiki wa sayansi ya kubuniwa, basi opera za anga ni za kuangalia bila shaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're sure to provide you with hours of entertainment and leave you wanting more.
entries.translation: Zina uhakika wa kukupa saa za burudani na kukuacha ukihitaji mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2015, I visited Liberia with a group of students from New York University.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2015, nilitembelea Liberia na kikundi cha wanafunzi kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha New York.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were there to learn about the challenges facing women in the country, and to work with local organizations to help address them.
entries.translation: Tulienda huko kujifunza kuhusu changamoto zinazoikumba wanawake katika nchi, na kufanya kazi na mashirika ya eneo hilo ili kuzitatua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most pressing issues we learned about was the high rate of sexual violence against women.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya masuala yanayogandamiza zaidi ambayo tulijifunza lilikuwa kiwango cha juu ya dhuluma ya kingono dhidi ya wanawake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, a 2013 study found that 65% of women in Liberia had experienced sexual violence at some point in their lives.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, utafiti wa mwaka wa 2013 ulipata kwamba 65% ya wanawake walipitia vurugu ya kingono wakati fulani katika maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This violence has a devastating impact on women's physical and mental health, and it can also lead to poverty and social isolation.
entries.translation: Vurugu hii ina athari hasi katika afya ya wanawake ya kiakili na kimwili, na inaweza pia kuchangia umaskini na kujitenga na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the organizations we worked with was Women United Liberia, which provides support and services to survivors of sexual violence.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mashirika ambayo tulifanya kazi nayo lilikuwa Women United Liberia, ambalo huwa linatoa misaada na huduma kwa walioponea wa vurugu za kiakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We helped the organization to conduct a survey of survivors, and we also worked with them to develop a new method for providing counseling to survivors.
entries.translation: Tulisaidia shirika hilo kufanya utafiti wa wanusurika, na pia tulifanya kazi nao ili kuunda njia mpya ya kuwashauri walioponea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The method we developed was based on the principles of trauma-informed care, which is a type of therapy that has been shown to be effective in helping survivors of trauma to heal.
entries.translation: Njia ambayo tuliunda ilikuwa inategemea kanuni za utunzaji wa mtu aliyepitia kiwewe, ambayo ni aina ya tiba ambayo imeonyeshwa kwamba inafanya kazi katika kusaidia manusuru wa kiwewe ili kupata uponyaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were proud to be able to work with Women United Liberia, and we believe that the method we developed will make a real difference in the lives of survivors of sexual violence in Liberia.
entries.translation: Tulikuwa tunajivunia kuweza kufanya kazi na Women United Liberia, na tunaamini kwamba njia hiyo ambayo tuliunda italeta tofauti kubwa katika maisha ya manusuru wa vurugu za kingono chini Liberia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher, I think friends are one of the most important things in life.
entries.translation: Mwalimu, nadhani marafiki ni mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi maishani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're the people who are there for us when we need them, who make us laugh, and who help us grow as people.
entries.translation: Hao ndio watu ambao huwa wanapatikana wakati ambapo tunawahitaji, ambao huwa wanatuchekesha, na wale ambao huwa wanatusaidia kukua kama watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was younger, I was kind of immature.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I didn't really understand the importance of friendship.
entries.translation: Sikufahamu kwa kweli umuhimu wa urafiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought it was all about having fun and doing things together.
entries.translation: Nilidhani ilikuwa inahusu tu kuwa na burudani na kufanya vitu pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But as I've gotten older, I've realized that friendship is so much more than that.
entries.translation: Lakini ninavyokuwa mzee, nimegundua kwamba urafiki ni muhimu zaidi ya hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's about having someone to talk to who understands you, who you can trust, and who you can count on.
entries.translation: Unahusu kuwa na mtu wa kuongea naye ambaye anakufahamu, ambaye unaweza kumuamini, na yule ambaye unaweza kumtegemea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friends have been there for me through thick and thin.
entries.translation: Marafiki zangu wamekuwa wakisimama nami katika mambo magumu na mazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They've seen me at my best and my worst, and they've always loved and supported me.
entries.translation: Wameniona katika hali yangu mbaya zaidi na bora zaidi, na wamekuwa wamenipenda na kuniunga mkono kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They've helped me through tough times, and they've made me laugh when I've needed it most.
entries.translation: Wamenisaidia wagati mgumu, na wamefanya nicheke nilipohitaji kicheko zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that I can always count on my friends.
entries.translation: Najua kwamba huwa naweza kutegemea marafiki zangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're the people who I can be myself around, and who I know will always be there for me.
entries.translation: Ni watu ambao mimi mwenyewe naweza kuwa nao, na ambao najua watakuwepo kwa ajili yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so grateful for their friendship, and I know that my life would be much poorer without them.
entries.translation: Nashukuru sana kwa urafiki wao, na najua kwamba maisha yangu maskini zaidi bila viti hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My dad was telling me about our new neighbors today.
entries.translation: Baba yangu alikuwa ananiambia kuhusu majirani zetu leo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They moved in a few weeks ago, and we haven't had a chance to meet them yet.
entries.translation: Walihamia huku wiki chache zilizopita, na bado hatukuwa tumepata nafasi ya kukutana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad said that they are a family of four, with two kids around my age.
entries.translation: Baba aliniambia kwamba wako wanne katika familia yao, wana watoto wawili wa rika yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dad is a doctor, and the mom is a lawyer.
entries.translation: Baba yao ni daktari, mama yao ni wakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They seem like a nice family, and I'm looking forward to getting to know them better.
entries.translation: Wanaonekana kuwa ni familia nzuri, na natazamia kuwajua vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad also told me that the kids are both in the competitive academy at their school.
entries.translation: Baba pia aliniambia kwamba watoto hao wote wapo katika kitengo cha mashindano ya masomo katika shule yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The academy is a special program for students who are interested in pursuing a career in medicine or law.
entries.translation: Kitengo hicho cha masomo ni programu ya wanafunzi ambao wanapendelea kusomea udaktari au uwakili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kids have to take a lot of extra classes and do a lot of extracurricular activities, but it's a great opportunity for them to learn and grow.
entries.translation: Watoto hao ni lazima wafanye masomo ya ziada na wafanye shughuli nyingi za nje ya masomo, lakini ni fursa kubwa ya wao kusoma na kukua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm impressed by the kids' ambition, and I'm excited to see what they accomplish in the future.
entries.translation: Nimependezwa na tamaa ya watoto ya kupata makuu, na nimefurahia kuona watakachotimiza katika siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was a farmer who grew corn and soybeans.
entries.translation: John alikuwa mkulima ambaye alikuwa anapanda mahindi na soya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been farming for over 30 years and was well-respected in the community.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akifanya ukulima kwa zaidi ya miaka 30 na alikuwa anaheshimika sana katika jamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, John was approached by a group of government officials who were leading an initiative to help farmers adopt new technologies.
entries.translation: Siku moja, John aliendewa na kikundi cha maafisa wa serikali ambao walikuwa wanaongoza mpango wa kuwasaidia wakulima kuanza kutumia teknolojia mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officials told John that they could help him increase his crop yields and reduce his costs if he would agree to use their new methods.
entries.translation: Maafisa hao walimwambia John kwamba wangemsaidia kuongeza mazao ya shamba lake na kupunguza gharama zake iwapo angekubali kutumia njia zao mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was hesitant at first, but he eventually agreed to give it a try.
entries.translation: John alikuwa anasitasita mara ya kwanza, lakini hatimaye alikubali kuijaribu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officials provided John with a new set of equipment and training on how to use it.
entries.translation: Maafisa hao walimpatia John seti mpya ya vifaa na kumfunza jinsi ya kuvitumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was surprised at how easy it was to use the new equipment and he was quickly able to see the benefits.
entries.translation: John alishangazwa na namna ambavyo ilikuwa rahisi kutumia vifaa hivyo vipya na aliweza kuona manufaa kwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His crop yields increased significantly and his costs went down.
entries.translation: Mazao yake yaliongezeka pakubwa na gharama zake zikapungua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was so happy with the results that he recommended the new program to his fellow farmers.
entries.translation: John alikuwa na furaha sana na matokeo kiasi kwamba akapendekezea wakulima wenzake programu hiyo mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program was a success and helped many farmers improve their operations.
entries.translation: Programu hiyo ilileta mafanikio na ikawasaidia wakulima wengi kuboresha utendakazi wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate about ecology, the environment, and human-caused climate change is a complex and multifaceted one.
entries.translation: Mjadala kuhusu ikolojia, mazingira, na mabadiliko ya tabianchi ambayo yanasababishwa na binadamu ni mjadala tata na wenye pande nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different social issues that intersect with this debate, including poverty, inequality, and race.
entries.translation: Kuna masuala mengi tofauti ya kijamii ambayo huwa yanaingiliana na mjadala huu, yakiwa pamoja na umaskini, ukosefu wa usawa, na mbari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poverty is a major driver of environmental degradation.
entries.translation: Umaskini ni kichochezi kikubwa cha kudorora kwa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People living in poverty often have to resort to environmentally destructive practices in order to survive.
entries.translation: Watu wanaoishi katika umaskini wamekimbilia matendo yanayoharibu mazingira ili kuendelea kuishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, they may burn wood for cooking or heating, which releases harmful pollutants into the air.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, wanaweza kutumia kuni kupika au kupata joto, hii hutoa vichafuzi hatari ambavyo huwa vinaenda katika hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may also cut down trees to produce arable farmland, leading to deforestation and the spread of deserts.
entries.translation: Wanaweza pia kukata miti ili wawe na shamba ambalo wanaweza kutumia katika ukulima, hii huleta ukataji wa misitu na kuenea kwa majangwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Income inequality is also a major factor in environmental degradation.
entries.translation: Ukosefu wa usawa wa mapato ni kipengele kikubwa katika kuharibika kwa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The richest people in the world consume a disproportionately large share of the world's resources, while the poorest people often have to live with the consequences of environmental pollution.
entries.translation: Watu matajiri zaidi duniani hutumia bila usawa mgao mkubwa wa rasilimali za dunia, huku watu maskini zaidi mara nyingi wanalazimika kuishi kwa athari za uchafuzi wa mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the richest 10% of the world's population produce over half of global greenhouse gas emissions, while the poorest 50% produce only a fraction of that amount.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, 10% ya watu matajiri zaidi duniani wanatoa zaidi ya nusu ya gesi za kivungulio duniani, huku 50% ya watu maskini zaidi wanatoa sehemu kidogo tu ya kiwango hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Race is another important factor in the debate about ecology, the environment, and climate change.
entries.translation: Mbari ni kipengele kingine muhimu katika mjadala kuhusu ikolojia, mazingira, na mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The live performances of classical music are a unique and special experience.
entries.translation: Upigaji muziki kwenye jukwaani wa muziki wa classic ni uzoefu wa kipekee na maalum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The combination of the beauty of the music, the skill of the performers, and the energy of the audience creates an atmosphere that is unlike anything else.
entries.translation: Mchanganyiko wa uzuri wa muziki, ujuzi wa wapigaji muziki, na bidii ya hadhira huleta hali ambayo haifanani na kitu chochote kingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such event that perfectly captures the magic of live classical music is the annual return of the Boston Symphony Orchestra to Tanglewood.
entries.translation: Tukio moja kama hilo ambalo linanasa vyema mvuto wa muziki wa classic unaopigwa jukwaani ni kurejea kwa tamasha la kila mwaka la Boston Symphony Orchestra katika Tanglewood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This summer festival, which has been running for over 100 years, brings together some of the world's greatest musicians to perform in a beautiful outdoor setting.
entries.translation: Tamasha la majira haya ya joto, ambalo limekuwa likifanyika kwa zaidi ya miaka 100, linaleta pamoja baadhi ya wanamuziki wakubwa zaidi duniani ili kupiga muziki katika mazingira yanayopendeza ya nje ya nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a recent article, one music critic described the experience of attending a concert at Tanglewood as "being transported to another world."
entries.translation: Katika makala ya hivi majuzi, mchanganuzi mmoja wa muziki alielezea hali ya kuhudhuria maonyesho ya muziki katika Tanglewood kama "kusafirishwa kwenda katika dunia nyingine."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went on to say that "the sound of the orchestra, the smell of the trees, and the sight of the stars overhead all combined to create a truly unforgettable experience."
entries.translation: Aliendelea kusema kwamba "sauti ya okestra, harufu ya miti, na mwonekano wa nyota angani zote ziliungana na kuunda hali ambayo kwa kweli haiwezi kusahaulika."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The return of the Boston Symphony Orchestra to Tanglewood is just one example of the many live performances of classical music that take place around the world each year.
entries.translation: Kurejea kwa Boston Symphony Orchestra katika Tanglewood ni mfano moja tu wa upigaji wa muziki wa classic mbele ya hadhira ambao huwa unafanyika kote duniani kila mwaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These events are a testament to the enduring popularity of classical music and the important role it plays in our culture.
entries.translation: Matukio haya ni wosia wa umaarufu wa muziki wa classic unaokua mkubwa na jukumu lake muhimu katika utamaduni wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whether you are a seasoned classical music fan or a newcomer to the genre, I encourage you to experience a live performance of classical music.
entries.translation: Uwe shabiki mkubwa wa muziki wa classic au wewe ni mgeni katika utanzu huu wa muziki, nakuhimiza uhudhurie onyesho hili la muziki wa classic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They would do this by building roads, bridges, and canals to make travel and transportation easier.
entries.translation: Wangefanya hii kwa kujenga barabara, madaraja, na mifereji ili kufanya usafiri na uchukuzi uwe rahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They would also establish markets and fairs where merchants could come to buy and sell goods.
entries.translation: Pia wangejenga masoko na sehemu za maonyesho ambapo wafanyabiashara wangekuja kununua na kuuza bidhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, they would provide protection for traders from bandits and other criminals.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, wangewapa wafanyabiashara ulinzi dhidi ya magaidi na wahalifu wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these efforts, trade flourished throughout the Roman Empire.
entries.translation: Kutokana na juhudi hizo, biashara ilisitawi sana katika Milki ya Roma nzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Goods and ideas flowed freely from one end of the empire to the other.
entries.translation: Bidhaa na mawazo yalisafirishwa kwa urahisi kutoka upande mmoja hadi upande mwingine wa milki hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helped to spread Roman culture and technology throughout the empire and beyond.
entries.translation: Hii ilisadia katika kueneza utamaduni na teknolojia ya Warumi katika milki nzima na maeneo mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also made the empire more prosperous and powerful.
entries.translation: Pia ilifanya milki hiyo kuwa na mafanikio na mamlaka zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Roman Empire was a vast and complex entity.
entries.translation: Milki ya Roma ilikuwa taasisi kubwa na changamano mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was home to a diverse population of people from all over the world.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa nyumbani mwa aina mbalimbali ya watu kutoka sehemu zote za dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Romans were able to maintain control over this vast empire by creating a system of roads, bridges, canals, markets, fairs, and protection for traders.
entries.translation: Warumi waliweza kudumisha udhibiti wa milki hii kubwa mno kwa kuunda mfumo wa barabara, madaraja, mifereji, masoko, sehemu za maonyesho, na ulinzi wa wauzaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This system helped to encourage trade throughout the empire and made it possible for goods and ideas to flow freely from one end of the empire to the other.
entries.translation: Mfumo huu ulisaidia katika kuhimiza biashara katika milki nzima na kuwezesha bidhaa na mawazo kutiririka kwa urahisi kutoka upande mmoja wa milki hadi upande mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The coffee shop was bustling with activity as people came and went, grabbing a quick cup of coffee or tea to start their day.
entries.translation: Duka la kahawa lilikuwa na pilkapilka za shughuli wakati ambapo watu walikuwa wanakuja na kwenda, wakichukua kwa haraka kikombe cha kahawa au chai ili kuanzisha siku yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baristas were working hard to keep up with the demand, but they were also taking the time to chat with their customers and get to know them.
entries.translation: Watu hao wa kuandaa kahawa walikuwa wanafanya kazi kwa bidii ili kukidhi mahitaji, japo walikuwa pia wanachukua muda wa kupiga gumzo na wateja wao na kuweza kuwajua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the baristas, a young woman named Sarah, was particularly friendly and outgoing.
entries.translation: Mmoja wa watengeneza kahawa hao, mwanamke mdogo anayeitwa Sarah, alikuwa anapenda urafiki na ni mchangamfu mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved getting to know her customers and learning about their lives.
entries.translation: Alipenda kuwajua wateja wake na kujifunza kuhusu maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a man came in who looked like he was having a bad day.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanaume ambaye alikuwa anaonekana kuwa siku yake ilikuwa mbaya aliingia kwenye duka hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was pale and his eyes were bloodshot.
entries.translation: Alikuwa anaonekana hafifu na macho yake yalikuwa mekundu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah could tell that he was sick, so she offered him a free cup of tea.
entries.translation: Sarah angeweza kujua kwamba alikuwa mgonjwa, hivyo alimpa kikombe cha chai bila malipo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man gratefully accepted the tea and took a sip.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo alikubali chai hiyo kwa shukrani na akanywa kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He immediately started to feel better.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told Sarah that he had been feeling sick for a few days, but he hadn't been able to get to the doctor.
entries.translation: Alimwambia Sarah kwamba amekuwa mgonjwa kwa siku chache, lakini hakuwa ameweza kwenda kumwona daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah told him that he should go see a doctor as soon as possible, but she also offered to make him some more tea to help him feel better in the meantime.
entries.translation: Sarah alimwambia kwamba angeenda amwone daktari haraka iwezekanavyo, lakini pia alijitolea kumpa chai zaidi ili imsaidie kuhisi vizuri kwa wakati huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man ended up staying at the coffee shop for a while, drinking tea and talking to Sarah.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo hatimaye aliketi kwenye duka hilo la kahawa kwa muda, akinywa chai na kuongea na Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her about his job and his family.
entries.translation: Alimwambia kuhusu kazi na familia yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robots are machines that are capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically, especially one programmable by a computer.
entries.translation: Roboti ni mashine ambazo zinaweza kufanya misururu changamano ya vitendo otomatiki, hasa kitendo kinachoweza kupangwa kwenye kompyuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robotics has become increasingly important in recent years, as robots have been used to automate a wide variety of tasks, from manufacturing to surgery.
entries.translation: Matumizi ya roboti yameendelea kuwa muhimu katika miaka ya hivi majuzi, huku roboti zikitumika kufanya kazi mbalimbali kuwa otomatiki, kuanzia utengenezaji hadi upasuaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robots are also being used in more and more applications, such as search and rescue, space exploration, and military combat.
entries.translation: Roboti zinatumika pia katika programu nyingi zaidi, kama vile kutafuta na kuopoa, uchunguzi wa anga, na mapigano ya kijeshi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The field of robotics is constantly evolving, and new advances are being made all the time.
entries.translation: Uwanja wa roboti unaendelea kukua, na hatua mpya zinatengenezwa wakati wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As robots become more sophisticated, they will be able to perform an ever-wider range of tasks.
entries.translation: Roboti zinapoendelea kuwa na ustaarabu zaidi, zitaweza kufanya kazi nyingi mbalimbali zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the modern field of robotics is generally considered to have begun in the 1940s, with the work of George Devol and Victor Scheinman.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, uwanja wa kisasa wa matumizi ya roboti unazingatiwa kwa jumla kuwa ulianza miaka ya arobaini, kwa kazi ya George Devol na Victor Scheinman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crystal was a beautiful thing, a pure white that seemed to glow from within.
entries.translation: Fuwele hiyo ilikuwa kitu kizuri, nyeupe halisi ambayo ilionekana kung'aa kutoka ndani yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had been found in a cave deep in the mountains, and it was said to have magical powers.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa imepatikana katika pango lililopo ndani ya milima, na ilisemakana kwamba ilikuwa na mamlaka ya kiajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Nyala was exploring the cave when she came across the crystal.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanamke mdogo anayeitwa Nyala alikuwa anatalii pango hilo alipokutana na fuwele hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was immediately drawn to its beauty, and she reached out to touch it.
entries.translation: Ghafla akapenda urembo wake, na akafika karibu nayo na kuigusa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As soon as her fingers brushed against the crystal, she felt a surge of energy flow through her body.
entries.translation: Mara tu vifole vyake viligusa fuwele hiyo, alihisi ongezeko la mzunguko wa nguvu katika mwili wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nyala knew that the crystal was special, and she decided to take it home with her.
entries.translation: Nyala alijua kwamba fuwele hiyo ilikuwa ya kipekee, na akaamua kuenda nayo nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She carefully wrapped it in a cloth and carried it with her everywhere she went.
entries.translation: Aliifungia vizuri kwa nguo na kuibeba mahali popote alipoenda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crystal soon began to develop a strange power.
entries.translation: Fuwele hiyo ikaanza kuwa na nguvu za kiajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It seemed to be able to sense Nyala's thoughts and feelings, and it would respond to them in different ways.
entries.translation: Ilionekana kwamba iliweza kuhisi fikra na hisia za Nyala, na ingeweza kuzijibu katika njia tofauti tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If Nyala was happy, the crystal would glow brighter.
entries.translation: Iwapo Nyala alikuwa na furaha, fuwele hiyo ingeng'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If she was sad, the crystal would dim.
entries.translation: Iwapo alikuwa na huzuni, fuwele hiyo ingefifia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nyala soon realized that the crystal could be used to help people.
entries.translation: Nyala akagundua kwamba fuwele hiyo ingetumika kuwasaidia watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She began to use it to heal the sick and injured, and she even used it to bring peace to warring factions.
entries.translation: Alianza kuitumia kuwasaidia wagonjwa na watu walioumia, na aliitumia hata kuleta amani kati ya watu ambao walikuwa wanagombana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crystal's power was great, but it was also dangerous.
entries.translation: Nguvu za fuwele hiyo zilikuwa kubwa, lakini ilikuwa hatari pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A typical day for a person in Morocco starts early in the morning, around 6 or 7am.
entries.translation: Siku ya kawaida ya mtu anayeishi Moroko huanza mapema asubuhi, saa 12 au saa 1 asubuhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many people will wake up to the sound of the call to prayer from the local mosque.
entries.translation: Watu wengi wataamshwa na mwito wa sala kutoka kwa mskiti wa eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After praying, people will eat a simple breakfast of bread, olives, and tea.
entries.translation: Baada ya kuomba, watu watakula staftahi ya mkate, zeituni, na chai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, they will get ready for work or school.
entries.translation: Kisha, watajiandaa ili kwenda kazini au shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For those who work in the city, the commute can be long.
entries.translation: Kwa wanaofanya kazi jijini, usafiri unaweza kuwa mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Traffic is often congested, especially during rush hour.
entries.translation: Msongamano wa magari mara nyingi huwa umeshikana sana, hasa wakati kila mtu ana harakisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once they arrive at work, people will spend the day working in offices, shops, or factories.
entries.translation: Mara tu wamefika kazini, watu watafanya kazi kwenye ofisi, maduka, au viwanda siku nzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After work, people will often go home to eat dinner with their families.
entries.translation: Baada ya kazi, watu mara nyingi wataenda nyumbani kula chakula cha usiku pamoja na familia zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dinner is typically a large meal, with many different dishes.

entries.english: After dinner, people will relax and spend time with their families or friends.
entries.translation: Baada ya chakula cha usiku, watu watatulia na kukaa na familia au marafiki zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the evening, many people will go out to socialize.
entries.translation: Jioni, watu wengi wataenda maeneo tofauti ili kutangamana na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of venues to choose from, including cafes, restaurants, and bars.
entries.translation: Kuna aina kadhaa tofauti za kumbi za kuchagua, zikiwa pamoja na mikahawa, na mabaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People will often stay out until late at night, talking and laughing with friends and family.
entries.translation: Watu mara nyingi watakaa nje hadi usiku sana, wakiongea na kucheka na marafiki na familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The weekend is a time for rest and relaxation.
entries.translation: Wikendi ni muda wa kupumzika na kutulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many people will spend the weekend with their families, visiting friends, or going on trips.
entries.translation: Watu wengi watakaa pamoja na familia zao, watatembelea marafiki, au wataenda katika ziara siku za wikendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also many cultural events and festivals to attend during the weekend.
entries.translation: Kuna matukio mengi ya kitamaduni pamoja na tamasha kadhaa za kuhudhuria wikendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Same-sex marriage is a legal union of two people of the same sex.
entries.translation: Ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja ni ndoa halali ya watu wawili wa jinsia moja.
