entries.english: The legal recognition of same-sex marriage has been the subject of much debate in recent years.
entries.translation: Utambuzi halali wa ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja umekuwa mada ya mijadala mingi katika miaka ya hivi majuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that same-sex marriage should be legal, while others believe that it should not be.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaamini kwamba ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja inafaa kuwa halali, huku wengine wakiamini kwamba inafaa kuwa haramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of arguments for and against same-sex marriage.
entries.translation: Kuna majadiliano mengi ya kutetea na ya kupinga ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is a matter of equality.
entries.translation: Majadiliano ya kuunga mkono ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja ni kwamba ni suala la usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All people, regardless of their sexual orientation, should have the same rights and responsibilities.
entries.translation: Watu wote, bila kujali mwelekeo wao wa kingono, wanafaa kuwa na haki na majukumu sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marriage is a fundamental right, and same-sex couples should be able to enjoy this right just like heterosexual couples.
entries.translation: Ndoa ni haki ya msingi, na wachumba wa jinsia moja wanafaa kuweza kufurahia haki hii sawa tu na wachumba wa jinsia tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is beneficial for children.
entries.translation: Hoja nyingine ya kutetea ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja ni kwamba ndoa hiyo ni muhimu kwa watoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Studies have shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents are just as well-adjusted as children who are raised by heterosexual parents.
entries.translation: Utafiti umeonyesha kwamba watoto ambao wamelelewa na wazazi waliopo katika ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja wako sawa tu na watoto waliolelewa na wazazi wliopo katika ndoa ya watu wa jinsia tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, some studies have even shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents may be more tolerant and accepting of others.
entries.translation: Kwa hakika, utafiti mwingine umeonyesha kwamba watoto ambao wamelelewa na wazazi waliopo katika ndoa ya jinsia moja huenda wakawavumilia zaidi na kuwakubali wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are also arguments against same-sex marriage.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, pia kuna majadiliano yanayopinga ndoa ya watu wa jinsia moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that marriage is a union between a man and a woman, and that same-sex couples should not be allowed to marry.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaamini kwamba ndoa ni mapatano kati ya mwanaume na mwanamke, na wachumba wa jinsia moja hawafai kuruhusiwa kuoana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a farmer was walking through his field when he saw a dark cloud approaching.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mkulima alikuwa anatembea katika shamba lake alipoona wingu jeusi likimkaribia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that a storm was coming, so he ran to his barn to get his animals to safety.
entries.translation: Alijua kwamba mvua kubwa ilikuwa inakuja, hivyo alikimbia kwenda kwenye banda lake ili kuweka wanyama wake katika eneo salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He gathered up his cows, pigs, and chickens and brought them inside.
entries.translation: Aliwakusanya ng'ombe, nguruwe, na kuku wake na kuwaweka ndani ya banda hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the storm raged, the farmer watched from the window as the wind and rain whipped through the trees.
entries.translation: Mvua mkubwa ilipokuwa inasukasuka, mkulima huyo alitazama kupitia kwa dirisha huku upepo na mvua ikinyesha sana kwenye miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was worried about his crops, but he knew that there was nothing he could do.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu mimea yake, lakini alijua kwamba hakuna chochote ambacho angeweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next morning, the sun came out and the storm was over.
entries.translation: Asubuhi iliyofuata, jua lilichomoza na mvua ilikuwa imeisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer went outside to survey the damage.
entries.translation: Mkulima huyo alienda nje ili kuongalia uharibifu uliofanyika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His crops were ruined, but he saw something else that made him smile.
entries.translation: Mimea yake iliharibika, lakini aliona kitu kingine ambacho kilimfanya atabasamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the middle of the field, there was a beautiful rainbow.
entries.translation: Katikati ya shamba hilo, kulikuwa na upinde wa mvua unaopendeza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer knew that the rainbow was a sign of hope.
entries.translation: Mkulima huyo alijua kwamba upinde huo ulikuwa ishara ya matumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It reminded him that even though there are storms in life, there is always a silver lining.
entries.translation: Ulimkumbusha kwamba ijapokuwa kuna mvua kubwa katika maisha, huwa kuna faraja baada yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The railway station is a place where people come and go.
entries.translation: Kituo cha treni ni mahali ambapo watu huwasili na kuondoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are always people rushing to catch their trains, and others waiting for their loved ones to arrive.
entries.translation: Huwa kuna watu wanaoharakisha ili wapate treni zao, na wengine wanasubiri wapendwa wao wawasili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place of constant activity, and there is always something to see.
entries.translation: Ni mahali pa shughuli za kila mara, na sikuzote huwa kuna kitu cha kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the things that you might see at a railway station is a meme.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vitu unavyoweza kuona katika kituo cha treni ni meme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes are images or videos that are copied and shared online, often with slight variations.
entries.translation: Meme ni picha au video ambazo zimenakiliwa na kusambazwa kwenye mtandao, mara nyingi huwa zina tofauti kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be funny, serious, or anything in between.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kuwa za kuchekesha, zisizo ckehesha, au chochote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At a railway station, you might see memes about traveling, waiting for trains, or meeting new people.
entries.translation: Katika kituo cha treni, unaweza kuona meme kuhusu kusafiri, kusubiri treni, au kukutana na watu wapya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another thing that you might see at a railway station is a store.
entries.translation: Kitu kingine ambacho unaweza kuona katika kituo cha treni ni duka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are usually a variety of stores at a railway station, including convenience stores, newsstands, and bookstores.
entries.translation: Huwa kuna maduka mbalimbali katika kituo cha treni. yakiwemo maduka ya kusaidia watu, maduka ya habari, na maduka ya vitabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These stores sell a variety of items, such as food, drinks, newspapers, magazines, and books.
entries.translation: Maduka haya yanauza vipengee mbalimbali, kama vile chakula, vinywaji, magazeti, na vitabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The railway station is a place where people come together, and it is a place where anything can happen.
entries.translation: Kituo cha treni ni mahali ambapo watu huwa wanakuja pamoja, na ni mahali ambapo chochote kinaweza kutokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might see a meme, you might buy a snack, or you might even meet your future spouse.
entries.translation: Unaweza kuona meme, unaweza kununua kumbwe, au unaweza hata kukutana na atakayekuwa mchumba wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports call to us from our youth, urging us to join in the fun and excitement.
entries.translation: Spoti huwa zinatuita kuanzia ujana wetu, zikituhimiza tujiunge na burudani na furaha hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They promote physical fitness and teamwork, and teach us how to work together as a pack.
entries.translation: Zinaendeleza ustawi wa kimwili na kufanya kazi kama timu, na kutufundisha jinsi ya kufanya kazi kama kitu kimoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports also help us to develop our bodies and minds, and to learn how to deal with both victory and defeat.
entries.translation: Spoti pia zinatusaidia kuendeleza miili na akili zetu, na kujifunza jinsi ya kukabiliana na ushindi na kushindwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we play sports, we are not only competing against others, but also against ourselves.
entries.translation: Tunapocheza spoti, hatushindani tu na wengine, bali tunashindana pia na sisi wenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are pushing ourselves to be our best, and we are learning what we are capable of.
entries.translation: Tunajisukuma ili tuwe katika hali yetu bora zaidi, na tunajifunza jambo ambalo tunaweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports are a great way to stay healthy and active, and they can also be a lot of fun.
entries.translation: Spoti ni njia bora ya kuwa na afya nzuri na kuwa amilifu, na zinaweza kuwa burudani kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So lace up your shoes and get out there!
entries.translation: Hivyo funga kamba za viatu vyako na uingie kwenye spoti!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a young man, I was always fascinated by the stories that my grandmother used to tell me.
entries.translation: Kama mwanaume mdogo, kila mara nilikuwa navutiwa sana na hadithi ambazo bibi yangu alikuwa ananiambia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had a wonderful gift for storytelling, and her tales always seemed to transport me to another world.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na zawadi ya ajabu ya kuhadithia, na hadithi zake kila mara zilikuwa zinanipeleka katika dunia nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite stories was about a man named Srinivasa, who was a great scholar and philosopher.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya hadithi ambazo nilipenda sana ilikuwa inahusu mwanaume anayeitwa Srinivasa, ambaye alikuwa msomi na mwanafalsafa mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Srinivasa was so wise that he could answer any question that was put to him.
entries.translation: Srinivasa alikuwa mwerevu sana kiasi kwamba angejibu swali lolote ambalo aliulizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The purpose of life is to give it away" The king was so impressed with Srinivasa's answer that he gave him a large reward.
entries.translation: Lengo la maisha ni kupeana maisha" Mfalme huyo alifurahishwa mno na jibu la Srinivasa kiasi kwamba alimpa tuzo kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Srinivasa refused the reward, saying that he had already been rewarded enough by the knowledge that he had helped someone else.
entries.translation: Lakini Srinivasa alikataa zawadi hiyo, akisema kwamba tayari alikuwa amepokea tuzo ya kutosha kwa maarifa ambayo alisaidia nayo mtu mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story taught me that the most important thing in life is not to seek material possessions, but to find your gift and share it with others.
entries.translation: Hadithi hii ilinifundisha kwamba jambo muhimu zaidi katika maisha si kutafuta mali ya dunia, bali ni kutafuta zawadi yako na kuishiriki na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's an opportunity to help those in need and make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Ni fursa ya kuwasaidia walio na mahitaji na kuleta tofauti ulimwenguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But sometimes, charity can have unexpected consequences.
entries.translation: Lakini wakati mwingine, hisani inaweza kuwa na athari zisizotarajiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most common unintended consequences of charity is that it can create a dependency on the giver.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya athari ya hisani isiyotarajiwa ya kawaida zaidi ni kwamba inaweza kufanya anayetoa hisani hiyo kuwa wa kutegemewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When people are given help without having to work for it, they can start to expect that help to continue.
entries.translation: Watu wakipewa msaada bila kuhitajika kufanya kazi, wanaweza kuanza kutarajia msaada huo kuendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a lack of motivation and a sense of entitlement.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuleta ukosefu wa motisha na dai la kuwa na haki ya msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another unintended consequence of charity is that it can create a divide between the giver and the receiver.
entries.translation: Athari nyingine ya hisani isiyotarajiwa ni kwamba inaweza kuleta mgawanyiko kati ya mtoaji na mpokeaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The giver may feel superior to the receiver, while the receiver may feel inferior or ashamed.
entries.translation: Mtoaji anaweza kuhisi kwamba yuko juu ya mpokeaji, huku mpokeaji anaweza kuhisi kwamba yuko chini au kuona aya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can make it difficult for both parties to build a relationship based on mutual respect.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanya iwe vigumu kwa pande zote mbili kujenga uhusiano unaotegemea heshima kutoka pande zote mbili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, charity can sometimes do more harm than good.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, hisani wakati mwingine inaweza kuleta athari nyingi zaidi ya wema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the help that is given is not appropriate or if it is not given in a way that is respectful, it can actually make the situation worse.
entries.translation: Iwapo msaada ambao umetolewa si mwafaka au iwapo haujatolewa kwa njia ya heshima, inaweza kufanya hali hiyo kuwa mbaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, giving food to a homeless person without also providing them with shelter or job training may only enable their homelessness.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, kupeana chakula kwa mtu ambaye hana makao bila pia kumpa makao au mafunzo ya kazi huenda tu ikawezesha kuendeleza hali yake ya kutokuwa na makao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, these are just a few of the unintended consequences of charity.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, hizi tu ni baadhi ya athari chache zisizotarajiwa za hisani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other ways that charity can backfire.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingine kadhaa ambazo hisani inaweza kwenda kinyume na matarajio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you see that new logo for the water scarcity awareness campaign?
entries.translation: A: Je, uliona nembo hiyo mpya ya kampeni ya ufahamu wa uhaba wa maji?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I like how they used the shape of a water droplet to form the word "scarcity."
entries.translation: Napenda jinsi ambavyo walitumia umbo la tone la maji kuunda neno "scarcity."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, it's a really clever design. And it's definitely a relevant issue.
entries.translation: A: Naam, ni muundo mzuri sana. Na bila shaka ni suala muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I know, right? Water scarcity is a major problem in many parts of the world.
entries.translation: B: Najua, sio? Uhaba wa maji ni tatizo kubwa katika sehemu nyingi za dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, it's something that we all need to be aware of and working to address.
entries.translation: A: Naam, ni kitu ambacho sote tunahitaji kufahamu na kujituma ili tukitatue.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I agree. We can all do our part to conserve water and use it wisely.
entries.translation: B: Nakubaliana nawe. Sote tunaweza kufanya upande wetu ili kutunza maji na kuyatumia vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, even small changes can make a big difference.
entries.translation: A: Naam, hata mabadiliko madogo yanaweza kuleta tofauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I'm glad that people are starting to talk about this issue more.
entries.translation: B: Nafurahia kwamba watu wanaanza kuongea kuhusu suala hili zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's something that we need to address sooner rather than later.
entries.translation: Ni jambo ambalo tunahitaji kutatua haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I agree. We need to act now before it's too late.
entries.translation: A: Nakubaliana nawe. Tunahitaji kuwajibika sana kabla ya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi.

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a man named Ahmed who was married to a woman named Fatima.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had been married for many years, but they were not happy together.
entries.translation: Walikuwa wameoana kwa miaka mingi, lakini hawakuwa na furaha pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ahmed was a very strict man, and he always wanted things to be done his way.
entries.translation: Ahmed alikuwa mwanaume mkali, na sikuzote alikuwa anataka mambo yafanyike anavyotaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima was a kind and gentle woman, but she found it difficult to live with Ahmed's constant demands.
entries.translation: Fatima alikuwa mwanamke mkarimu na mpole, lakini alipata ugumu wa kuishi na mahitaji ya Ahmed ya kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ahmed and Fatima decided to get a divorce.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Ahmed na Fatima waliamua kupata talaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They went to see a divorce consultant, who helped them to understand the relevant laws and regulations.
entries.translation: Walienda kumwona mshauri wa talaka, ambaye aliwasaidia kufahamu sheria na masharti mwafaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The consultant also helped them to reach an agreement on how to divide their assets and share custody of their children.
entries.translation: Mshauri huyo pia aliwasaidia kufikia makubaliano kuhusu jinsi ya kugawanya mali yao na kugawanya malezi ya watoto wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The divorce was finalized, and Ahmed and Fatima went their separate ways.
entries.translation: Talaka hiyo ilikamilishwa, na Ahmed na Fatima wakaenda njia tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ahmed was relieved to be free from the marriage, but Fatima was sad to see her family break up.
entries.translation: Ahmed alifarijika kuwa nje ya ndoa, lakini Fatima alihuzunika kuona familia yake ikitengana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that it would be difficult for her to raise her children on her own, but she was determined to make the best of it.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima found a job and started to rebuild her life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She enrolled her children in school and made sure that they had everything they needed.
entries.translation: Aliwasajili watoto wake katika shule na akahakikisha kwamba walikuwa na kila kitu ambacho walikuwa wanataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also started to see a therapist, who helped her to deal with the emotional pain of the divorce.
entries.translation: Alianza pia kwenda kumwona mtaalamu wa matibabu, ambaye alimsaidia kukabiliana na maumivu ya kihisia kutokana na talaka hiyo.

entries.english: Dictators are often seen as ruthless and bloodthirsty rulers who have no regard for human life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While there is some truth to this stereotype, it is important to remember that not all dictators are the same.
entries.translation: Huku kuna ukweli fulani katika unyanyapaa huu, ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba madikteta wote hawafanani.

entries.english: Some have been responsible for great atrocities, while others have actually improved the lives of their people.

entries.english: One of the most famous dictators in history is Adolf Hitler.
entries.translation: Mmoja wa madikteta maarufu zaidi katika historia ni Adolf Hitler.

entries.english: Hitler was the leader of Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1945.
entries.translation: Hitler alikuwa kiongozi wa Nazi Germany kuanzia mwaka wa 1933 hadi mwaka wa 1945.

entries.english: Under his rule, Germany invaded several countries and committed genocide against the Jews and other minority groups.
entries.translation: Chini ya utawala wake, Ujerumani ilivamia nchi nyingi na kuua halaiki ya watu wa Wayahudi na vikundi vingine vidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hitler is responsible for the deaths of millions of people, and he is considered one of the most evil men in history.
entries.translation: Hitler anawajibikia vifo vya mamilioni ya watu, na anazingatiwa kama mmoja kati ya watu waovu zaidi katika historia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another famous dictator is Joseph Stalin.
entries.translation: Dikteta mwingine maarufu ni Joseph Stalin.

entries.english: Stalin was the leader of the Soviet Union from 1924 to 1953.
entries.translation: Stalin alikuwa kiongozi wa Muungano wa Sovieti kuanzia mwaka wa 1924 hadi 1953.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Under his rule, the Soviet Union became a superpower, but it also experienced a great deal of repression and violence.
entries.translation: Chini ya utawala wake, Muungano wa Sovieti ulikuwa nchi iliyo na nguvu, bali pia ulikumbana na kiwango kikubwa cha uonevu na vurugu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Millions of people were killed or imprisoned under Stalin's regime.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While Hitler and Stalin are two of the most infamous dictators in history, there have been many others who have committed atrocities.
entries.translation: Huku Hitler na Stalin ni wawili kati ya madikteta maarufu zaidi katika historia, kumekuwa na wengine wengi ambao wamefanya maovu mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm always congested and I can't seem to shake the cough.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Huwa nimezibana koo na siwezi kukohoa vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It sounds like you might have a fungal infection.
entries.translation: Daktari: Inaonekana huenda una maambukizo ya kuvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fungi are a type of microorganism that can cause a variety of diseases in humans.
entries.translation: Kuvu ni aina ya viumbehai wadogo wanaoweza kuleta magonjwa mbalimbali kwa binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can live in the environment, on our skin, and even in our bodies.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kuishi katika mazingira, ngozi yetu, na hata katika miili yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: What kind of fungi could be causing my symptoms?
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ni aina gani ya kuvu huenda inasababisha dalili zangu?

entries.english: Doctor: There are many different types of fungi that can cause infections in humans.
entries.translation: Daktari: Kuna aina nyingi tofauti za kuvu zinazoweza kusababisha maambukizo katika binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common include Aspergillus, Candida, and Cryptococcus.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya zile za kawaida zaidi zinajumuisha Aspergillus, Candida, na Cryptococus.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fungi can enter the body through the nose or mouth and travel to the upper respiratory tract.
entries.translation: Kuvu hizi zinaweza kuingia mwilini kupitia pua au mdomo na kusafiri kwenda katika njia ya juu ya kupumua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: How are these fungi treated?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Fungal infections are treated with antifungal medications.
entries.translation: Daktari: Maambukizo ya kuvu yanatibiwa kwa kutumia dawa za kupambana na kuvu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of medication and the length of treatment will depend on the type of fungus causing the infection.
entries.translation: Aina ya dawa na urefu wa matibabu utategemea aina ya kuvu ambazo zinaleta shida hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm glad to hear that there's a treatment for this. I'm tired of feeling so sick.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Nimefurahia kusikia kwamba kuna matibabu ya hii. Nimechoka sana na kuhisi kwamba mimi ni mgonjwa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The declaration of Zambia's independence from Britain on October 24, 1964, was a momentous occasion in the country's history.
entries.translation: Azimio la uhuru wa Zambia kutoka kwa Waingereza tarehe 24 Oktoba 1964, lilikuwa tukio la maana sana katika historia ya nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It marked the end of colonial rule and the beginning of a new era of self-determination.
entries.translation: Liliadhimisha mwisho wa utawala wa wakoloni na mwanzo wa enzi mpya ya kujitawala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The road to independence was not easy, however.
entries.translation: Njia ya kupata uhuru haikuwa rahisi, hata hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambians had to fight for their freedom, and they faced many challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Wananchi wa Zambia walilazimika kupigana ili kupata uhuru wao, na walikumbana na changamoto nyingi katika safari hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important figures in Zambia's independence struggle was Kenneth Kaunda.
entries.translation: Mmoja wa watu muhimu sana katika mapambano ya kupata uhuru wa Zambia alikuwa Kenneth Kaunda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaunda was a charismatic leader who mobilized the Zambian people to fight for their rights.
entries.translation: Kaunda alikuwa kiongozi mwenye haiba kubwa ambaye aliwahamasisha watu wa Zambia kupigania haki zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was also a skilled diplomat who was able to negotiate a peaceful settlement with the British government.
entries.translation: Alikuwa pia mwanadiplomasia mwenye ujuzi ambaye aliweza kufanya ushauri wa amani na kuafikiana na serikali ya Uingereza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1964, Kaunda became the first president of Zambia.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ruled the country for 27 years, during which time he oversaw Zambia's transition from a colony to a modern independent nation.
entries.translation: Aliiongoza nchi hiyo kwa miaka 27, ambapo wakati huo aliongoza mpito wa Zambia kutoka kwa ukoloni na kuwa taifa la kisasa linalojitegemea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaunda was a strong advocate for pan-Africanism and played a leading role in the Organization of African Unity (OAU).
entries.translation: Kaunda alikuwa mtetezi imara wa mambo ya Afrika na alikuwa na jukumu la muhimu katika Shirika la Umoja wa Afrika (OAU).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also helped to establish the Non-Aligned Movement, a group of countries that are not aligned with either the United States or the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: Pia alisaidia katika kuanzisha Vuguvugu la Nchi Zisizoegemea Upande Wowote, ambalo ni kikundi cha nchi ambazo hazikuwa zinaegemea upande wa Marekani au Muungano wa Sovieti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's independence was a major victory for the Zambian people.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a dark and stormy night.

entries.english: Inside, a young woman sat by the fire, her face pale and her eyes filled with sadness.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tall and handsome, with kind eyes and a warm smile. "I'm sorry for your loss," he said. "I know how you're feeling.

entries.english: I lost my wife a few years ago." The woman invited the stranger in, and they talked for hours.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her about his life, and she told him about hers.

entries.english: They laughed and cried together, and by the time the stranger left, the woman felt much better.

entries.english: She realized that she wasn't alone in her grief.

entries.english: There were other people who understood what she was going through.

entries.english: And even though her husband was gone, she still had a lot to be grateful for.

entries.english: And she knew that she would get through this.

entries.english: Volcanic eruptions are a powerful and destructive force of nature.
entries.translation: Kufoka kwa volkano ni nguvu ya kimazingira yenye msukumo mkubwa na huleta uharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause widespread devastation, loss of life, and environmental upheaval.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kusababisha uharibifu mkubwa sana, vifo, na madhara makubwa ya mazingira kwa ghafla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While volcanic eruptions are often associated with danger, they can also be a source of beauty and wonder.
entries.translation: Licha ya kuwa kufoka kwa volkano mara nyingi huhusishwa na hatari, tukio hili linaweza pia kuwa la kuvutia na la kushangaza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sight of a erupting volcano is a awe-inspiring sight, and the resulting lava flows can create stunning landscapes.
entries.translation: Mwonekano wa kufoka kwa volkano ni mwonekano unaovutia mno, na mitiririko ya lava baada ya kufoka kwa volkano inaweza kuunda mandhari yanayovutia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Volcanic eruptions are caused by the build-up of pressure beneath the Earth's surface.
entries.translation: Kufoka kwa volkano husababishwa na mrundiko wa shinikizo Ardhini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When this pressure becomes too great, the magma is forced up through the crust and erupts onto the surface.
entries.translation: Shinikizo hili likiwa kubwa mno, magma husukumwa kuja juu kupitia ganda la dunia na kufoka kwenye ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The size and intensity of a volcanic eruption can vary greatly.
entries.translation: Ukubwa na ukali wa kufoka kwa volkano unaweza kutofautiana pakubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some eruptions are relatively small and localized, while others can be massive and have a devastating impact on entire regions.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya kufoka kwa volkano huwa ndogo kwa kiasi na kulenga eneo moja, huku nyingine zinaweza kuwa kubwa mno na kuwa na athari ya uharibifu katika kanda nzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most destructive volcanic eruptions can cause widespread ashfall, mudflows, and tsunamis.
entries.translation: Kufoka kwa volkano ambako kunaleta uharibifu mkubwa mno kunaweza kusababisha kumwagika kwa majivu, mitiririko ya matope, na vimbunga vya tsunami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also trigger earthquakes and landslides.
entries.translation: Kunaweza pia kuchochea tetemeko la ardhi na maporomoko ya ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the worst cases, volcanic eruptions can claim thousands of lives and cause billions of dollars in damage.
entries.translation: Katika hali mbaya zaidi, kufoka kwa volkano kunaweza kuwaua maelfu ya watu na kusababisha uharibifu wa mabilioni ya dola.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the risks, volcanic eruptions are an important part of the Earth's geological processes.
entries.translation: Licha ya hatari hizo, kufoka kwa volkano ni sehemu muhimu ya michakato ya kijiolojia ya Dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They help to recycle the Earth's crust and create new landforms.
entries.translation: Kunaweza kusaidia kutumia upya ganda la Dunia na kuunda maumbo mapya ya ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also provide a home for a variety of plants and animals.
entries.translation: Pia, huwa makao kwa wanyama fulani na huwezesha mimea mbalimbali kustawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young engineer, Erica, was excited to start her new job at the automotive recruitment center.
entries.translation: Mhandisi mdogo, Erica, alifurahia kuanza kazi yake mpya katika kituo cha uandikishaji wa magari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been fascinated by cars, and she was eager to learn more about the industry.
entries.translation: Sikuzote alikuwa anavutiwa na magari, na alikuwa anataka sana kujifunza mengi kuhusu kiwanda hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On her first day, Erica was greeted by her manager, who gave her a tour of the center.
entries.translation: Katika siku yake ya kwanza, Erica alisalimiwa na meneja wake, ambaye alimtembeza kwenye kituo hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was amazed by the size of the facility, which was filled with rows of cars.
entries.translation: Erica alifurahia ukubwa wa kituo hicho, ambacho kilikuwa kimejaa na safu za magari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She learned that the center was responsible for recruiting new employees for all of the major automakers in the area.
entries.translation: Alijifunza kwamba kituo hicho kilikuwa kinawajibikia kuwaajiri waajiriwa wapya katika viwanda vyote vikubwa vya kutengeneza gari katika eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was assigned to a team that was working on recruiting engineers for a new electric vehicle project.
entries.translation: Erica aliwekwa katika timu ambayo ilikuwa inafanya kazi ya kuwaajiri wahandisi wapya kwa ajili ya mradi mpya wa gari la kielektroniki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was quickly up to speed on the project, and she was soon meeting with potential candidates.
entries.translation: Alielewa taarifa yote kuhusu mradi huo kwa haraka mno, na haikumchukua muda kukutana na watu ambao walikuwa na uwezo wa kuajiriwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the candidates that Erica met was a young man named David.
entries.translation: Mmoja kati ya watu waliokuwa wanaomba kazi ambao Erica alikutana nao alikuwa mwanaume mdogo anayeitwa David.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: David had a degree in engineering from a top university, and he had a lot of experience working on electric vehicles.
entries.translation: David alikuwa na shahada ya uhandisi kutoka chuo kikuu bora, na alikuwa na uzoefu mwingi wa kufanya kazi katika magari ya kielektroniki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was impressed by David's knowledge and skills, and she was confident that he would be a valuable asset to the team.
entries.translation: Erica alifurahisha na maarifa na ujuzi wa David, na alikuwa na ujasiri kwamba David angeleta thamani kwa timu hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica eventually convinced David to join the project, and he was a huge success.
entries.translation: Hatimaye Erica alimshawishi David kujiunga na mradi huo, na alikuwa manafikio makubwa mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He helped the team to develop a new electric vehicle that was both efficient and affordable.
entries.translation: Alisaidia timu kuunda gari mpya ya kielektroniki ambayo ilikuwa na utendaji bora na yenye bei nafuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zimbabwe is a country in southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zimbabwe ni nchi inayopatikana kusini mwa Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by South Africa to the south, Botswana to the west, Mozambique to the east, and Zambia to the north.
entries.translation: Inapakana na nchi ya Afrika Kusini upande wa kusini, Botswana upande wa magharibi, Msumbiji upande wa mashariki, na Zambi kaskazini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city is Harare.
entries.translation: Jiji kuu na jiji kubwa zaidi ni Harare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zimbabwe has a long and complex history.
entries.translation: Zimbabwe ina historia ndefu na yenye utata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The area was first inhabited by Bantu peoples in the 11th century.
entries.translation: Watu wa Bantu ndio waliishi katika eneo hilo kwa mara ya kwanza katika karne ya 11.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, the Ndebele people migrated to the area from South Africa.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 19, watu wa Ndebele walihamia eneo hilo wakiwa wametoka Afrika Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 1880s, the British colonized Zimbabwe and named it Southern Rhodesia.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya themanini, Waingereza walitawala Zimbabwe na kuipa jina la Rhodesia Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1965, Southern Rhodesia declared independence from Britain as a white-minority-ruled state.
entries.translation: Mnamo mwaka wa 1965, Rhodesia Kusini ilitangaza uhuru kutoka kwa Uingereza kama taifa linaloongozwa na wazungu wachache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country was renamed Rhodesia in 1970.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyo ikapewa jina upya la Rhodesia mnamo mwaka wa 1970.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1979, a civil war broke out between the Rhodesian government and the Zimbabwe African National Liberation Army (ZANLA).
entries.translation: Mnamo mwaka wa 1979, vita vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe vilitokea kati ya serikali ya Rhodesia na Jeshi la Ukombozi wa Kitaifa wa Waafrika Zimbabwe (ZANLA).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war ended in 1980, when Rhodesia was granted independence as Zimbabwe.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo viliisha mwaka wa 1980, wakati ambapo Rhodesia ilipewa uhuru kama Zimbabwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert Mugabe became the first president of Zimbabwe.
entries.translation: Robert Mugabe akawa rais wa kwanza wa Zimbabwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a controversial figure who was accused of human rights abuses and corruption.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mtu mwenye kuleta mabishano ambaye alishutumiwa kuhusu ukandamizaji wa haki za kibinadamu na ufisadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is to ensure that your account is not used for any unauthorized activity.
entries.translation: Hii ni kuhakikisha kwamba akaunti yako haitumiki katika shughuli yoyote ambayo haijaidhinishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any pending transactions that you would like to complete, please do so before closing your account.
entries.translation: Iwapo una miamala yoyote ambayo haijakamilika na ungependa kuikamilisha, tafadhali fanya hivyo kabla ya kufunga akaunti yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once your account is closed, we will not be able to process any further transactions.
entries.translation: Mara tu akaunti yako imefungwa, hatutaweza kuchakata miamala yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please note that we may also be required to cancel pending transactions by law.
entries.translation: Tafadhali kumbuka kwamba huenda sheria ikatuhitaji pia tukatishe miamala ambayo haijakamilika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if we are notified by a law enforcement agency that a pending transaction is related to illegal activity, we will be required to cancel the transaction.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, shirika la kutekeleza sheria likituarifu kwamba muamala ambao haujakamilika unahusiana na shughuli haramu, tutahitajika kukatisha muamala huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about our account closure policy, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Ikiwa una maswali yoyote kuhusu sera yetu ya kufunga akaunti, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will be happy to answer any questions you may have.
entries.translation: Tutafurahia kujibu maswali yoyote ambayo huenda uko nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to canceling any pending transactions, we will also close your account and remove any of your personal information from our records.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya kukatisha miamala yoyote ambayo haijakamilika, tutafunga pia akaunti yako na kuondoa taarifa yako yoyote ya kibinafsi kwenye rekodi zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is to protect your privacy and to ensure that your account is not used by anyone else.
entries.translation: Hatua hii ni ya kulinda faragha yako na kuhakikisha kwamba mtu yeyote mwingine hatumii akaunti yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once your account is closed, you will no longer be able to access your account or use any of the services that are associated with your account.
entries.translation: Mara tu akaunti yako imefungwa, hutaweza tena kufikia akaunti yako au kutumia huduma zozote zinazohusiana na akaunti yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you need to access your account for any reason after it has been closed, please contact us and we will be happy to assist you.
entries.translation: Iwapo unahitaji kufikia akaunti yako kutokana na sababu yoyote baada ya kufungwa, tafadhali wasiliana nasi na tutafurahia kukusaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We appreciate your business and thank you for choosing our company.
entries.translation: Tunathamini sana biashara yako na asante kwa kuchagua kampuni yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hope to serve you again in the future.
entries.translation: Tuna matumaini ya kukuhudumia tena baadaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this may seem like a gross habit, it is actually quite beneficial to the pig.
entries.translation: Huku hii huenda ikaonekana kama tabia mbaya, kwa kweli ni muhimu sana kwa nguruwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mud helps to keep the pig cool and clean, and it also provides a natural sunscreen.
entries.translation: Matope humsaidia nguruwe kupunguza joto na kuwa safi, na pia husaidia nguruwe kuzuia miale ya jua kiasili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the mud helps to protect the pig’s skin from parasites and bacteria.
entries.translation: Isitoshe, matope husaidia katika kulinda ngozi ya nguruwe dhidi ya wadudu na bakteria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that pigs are dirty because they eat garbage.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaamini kwamba nguruwe ni wachafu kwa sababu huwa wanakula takataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, pigs are actually very clean animals.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, nguruwe kwa hahika ni wanyama safi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They only eat what they find in their environment, and they will not eat anything that is rotten or diseased.
entries.translation: Huwa wanakula tu kile ambacho wamepata katika mazingira yao, na hawatakula chochote ambacho kimeoza au kina ugonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, pigs are often used to clean up garbage dumps because they are so good at eating trash.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, nguruwe mara nyingi hutumika katika kusafisha malundo ya taka kwa sababu ni wazuri sana katika kula takataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pigs are also very intelligent animals.
entries.translation: Nguruwe pia ni wanyama werevu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are able to solve problems and learn new things quickly.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kutatua shida na kujifunza mambo mapya kwa urahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pigs have been known to use tools, and they can even be trained to do tricks.
entries.translation: Nguruwe wamejulikana kwamba huwa wanatumia zana, na wanaweza hata kufunzwa kufanya vitimbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their reputation, pigs are actually very gentle and social animals.
entries.translation: Licha ya sifa yao, nguruwe kwa kweli ni wanyama watulivu na waliochangamka sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are very affectionate with their owners, and they enjoy being around people.
entries.translation: Wana uhusiano wa ndani na wamiliki wao, na wanafurahia kuwa karibu na watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a beautiful sight to behold, and it reminded me of how much I love living in this part of the world.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa mwonekano mzuri ajabu, na ilinikumbusha kuhusu kiasi ambacho napenda kuishi katika dunia hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've always been a fan of sunsets.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's something about the way the light fades from the sky that's always struck me as incredibly poetic.
entries.translation: Kuna jambo kuhusu njia ambayo mwangaza hufifia kwenye anga jambo ambalo huwa naona kama ushairi mkubwa mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's like a metaphor for life, I think.
entries.translation: Ni kama sitiari ya maisha, nadhani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We all start out with bright, shining beginnings, but as time goes on, we inevitably fade away.
entries.translation: Sote tunaanza kwa mwanzo angavu unaong'aa, lakini muda unavyoenda, tunafifia bila kuepukika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But that's not necessarily a bad thing.
entries.translation: Lakini hilo si jambo baya vile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, I think it's kind of beautiful.
entries.translation: Kwa kweli, nadhani ni jambo zuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a reminder that we should all cherish the time we have, and make the most of every moment.
entries.translation: Ni kikumbusho kwamba sote tunafaa kuthamini muda tulio nao, na kutumia kila muda vizuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sunset that I saw last week was especially beautiful.
entries.translation: Machweo ambayo niliona wiki jana yalikuwa mazuri mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like something out of a painting.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa ni kama kitu ambacho kimepakwa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stood there for a long time, just watching the colors change and fade.
entries.translation: Nilisimama hapo kwa muda mrefu, nikitazama tu rangi hizo zikibadilika na kufifia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a truly magical experience.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa ni hali ya kiajabu kwa kweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so glad that I was able to witness that sunset.
entries.translation: Nimefurahi sana kwamba niliweza kushuhudia machweo hayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of all the beauty that exists in the world, even when things are tough.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa kikumbusho cha urembo wote uliopo duniani, hata wakati ambapo mambo ni magumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a reminder that we should always appreciate the good things in life, and never take anything for granted.
entries.translation: Ni kikumbusho kwamba sikuzote tunafaa kushukuru mambo mazuri katika maisha, na kamwe tusichukulia chochote kama mzaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, you know how hurricanes are huge storms that form over the ocean?
entries.translation: Kwa hiyo, unajua jinsi ambavyo vimbunga ni upepo mkubwa unaofantika baharini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cyclones are the same thing, but they happen in the Indian Ocean and the South Pacific.
entries.translation: Tufani ni kitu sawa na kimbunga, lakini huwa zinafanyika katika Bahari ya Hindi na Pasifiki Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cyclones are really powerful storms, and they can cause a lot of damage.
entries.translation: Tufani ni upepo mkali sana, na zinaweza kuleta uharibifu mkubwa mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring strong winds, heavy rain, and flooding.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kuleta upepo mkali, mvua kubwa, na mafuriko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cyclones can also cause power outages, and they can make it hard to get around.
entries.translation: Tufani zinaweza pia kufanya umeme upotee, na zinaweza kufanya kuwe kugumu kutembea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area that's prone to cyclones, it's important to be prepared.
entries.translation: Iwapo unaishi katika eneo ambalo huwa linapokea tufani sana, ni muhimu uwe umejianda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should have a plan for what to do if a cyclone warning is issued.
entries.translation: Unafaa kuwa na mpango wa jambo la kufanya iwapo onyo la tufani limetolewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure that your home is well-built and that you have a safe place to go if the cyclone hits.
entries.translation: Unafaa pia kuhakikisha kwamba nyumba yako imejengwa vizuri sana na kwamba una mahali salama pa kuenda tufani ikitokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The internet has become an integral part of our lives.
entries.translation: Intaneti imekuwa sehemu muhimu ya maisha yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We use it to stay connected with friends and family, to learn new things, to be entertained, and to conduct business.
entries.translation: Huwa tunaitumia ili kuendelea kuunganishwa na jamaa na marafiki, kujifunza mambo mapya, kupata burudani, na kufanya biashara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the internet has become so important that we now share more than 3 billion pieces of content every week.
entries.translation: Kwa hakika, intaneti imekuwa muhimu sana kiasi kwamba sasa tunashiriki zaidi ya bilioni 3 ya vipande vya maudhui kila wiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes everything from photos and videos to news articles and blog posts.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kila kitu kuanzia picha na video hadi makala ya habari na machapisho ya blogu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, the internet has made it possible for people to connect with others from all over the world, which has led to a greater understanding of different cultures and perspectives.
entries.translation: Isitoshe, intaneti imewezesha watu kuungana na wengine kutoka sehemu zote za dunia, jambo ambalo limeleta ufahamu mkubwa wa utamaduni na mitazamo tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some of the ways that the internet has changed our lives:
entries.translation: Hizi hapa ni baadhi ya njia ambazo intaneti imebadilisha maisha yetu:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Communication: The internet has made it easier for us to stay connected with friends and family who live far away.
entries.translation: * Mawasiliano: Intaneti imeturahisisha kuendelea kuunganishwa na marafiki na familia ambao wanaishi mbali nasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can now communicate with them instantly via email, text message, or video chat.
entries.translation: Sasa tunaweza kuwasiliana nao papo hapo kupitia barua pepe, ujumbe wa matini, au gumzo la video.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Education: The internet has made it possible for us to learn about anything we want, whenever we want.
entries.translation: * Elimu: Intaneti imetuwezeshea kujifunza chochote tunachotaka kujifunza, wakati wowote ambao tunataka kujifunza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can access educational resources from all over the world, and we can even take online courses from top universities.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kufikia rasilimali za elimu kutoka kote duniani, na tunaweza hata kufanya kozi zinazofundishwa kwenye mtandao kutoka vyuo bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Entertainment: The internet has given us access to a vast amount of entertainment options.
entries.translation: * Burudani: Intaneti imetupatia ufikiaji wa chaguo kadhaa za burudani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, there was a time when the Earth was abundant with natural resources.
entries.translation: Katika siku zilizopita, kulikuwa na wakati ambapo Dunia ilikuwa imejaa na rasilimali asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vast forests, plentiful fish in the sea, and clean air to breathe.
entries.translation: Kulikuwa na misitu mingi mno, samaki wengi baharini, na hewa safi ya kupumua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But over time, humans have depleted these resources to the point where they are now scarce.
entries.translation: Lakini kwa muda, binadamu wamepunguza sana rasilimali hizi kwa kiasi kwamba rasilimali hizo sasa ni adimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The forests have been cut down to make way for farms and cities.
entries.translation: Misitu imekatwa ili mashamba na majiji yapate nafasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fish in the sea have been overfished.
entries.translation: Samaki baharini wamevuliwa kwa kiwango cha kupita kiasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And the air has been polluted with chemicals and gases.
entries.translation: Na hewa imechafuliwa kwa kemikali na gesi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, the Earth is now facing a number of environmental problems, such as climate change, deforestation, and pollution.
entries.translation: Kutokana na hayo, Dunia sasa inakabiliana na idadi kubwa ya shida za mazingira, kama vile mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, kukatwa kwa miti, na uchafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we do not take action to conserve our natural resources, they will eventually be depleted and we will face a number of serious consequences.
entries.translation: Tusipochukua hatua ya kutunza rasilimali zetu asili, hatimaye zitaisha na tutakumbana na idadi kubwa ya cathari kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will have to find alternative sources of energy, we will have to deal with the effects of climate change, and we will have to find ways to clean up the pollution we have created.
entries.translation: Tutalazimika kutafuta vyanzo mbadala vya kawi, tutalazimika kukabiliana na athari za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, na tutalazimika kutafuta njia za kusafisha uchafu ambao tumeunda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The time to act is now.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must conserve our natural resources and protect the environment for future generations.
entries.translation: Lazima tutunze rasilimali zetu asili na tulinde mazingira kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Carter is an avid sports fan and loves to stay active.
