entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He often plays basketball with his friends at the local gym, and he also enjoys playing street hockey in his neighborhood.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi huwa anacheza mpira wa kikapu na marafiki zake katika chumba cha zoezi katika eneo lao, na huwa anafurahia kucheza magongo ya barabarani katika mtaa wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Carter is also a member of a flag football team, and he loves to compete in tournaments.
entries.translation: Dr. Carter pia ni mwanachama wa timu ya kandanda, na huwa anapenda kushindana katika mashindano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He has been playing golf for many years, and he enjoys the challenge of the game.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akicheza gofu kwa miaka mingi, na anafurahia changamoto ya mchezo huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Carter also enjoys running, and he often runs on the weekends.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is a very active person, and he loves to stay fit.
entries.translation: Ni mtu mwenye shughuli nyingi, na anapenda kuwa mzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I went shopping for a new horse, I mentioned the colour I was looking for and asked the attendant if they had anything in stock.
entries.translation: Nilipoenda kununua farasi mpya, nilitaja rangi ambayo nilikuwa natafuta kisha nikamuuliza muuzaji iwapo walikuwa na farasi kama huyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She showed me a few different horses, but none of them were quite right.
entries.translation: Alinionyesha farasi wachache tofauti, lakini hakuna yeyote ambaye alikuwa sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she mentioned that they had just received a new horse in that colour.
entries.translation: Kisha, aliniambia kwamba walikuwa wamepokea farasi mpya ambaye alikuwa na rangi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went to take a look and I was immediately smitten.
entries.translation: Nilienda kuangalia na papo hapo nikapendezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The horse was a beautiful chestnut mare with a long, flowing mane and tail.
entries.translation: Farasi huyo alikuwa mrembo na anavutia sana na alikuwa na manyoya ya shingoni na mkia mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very well-behaved and seemed to be quite intelligent.
entries.translation: Pia alikuwa na tabia nzuri na alionekana kuwa mwerevu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to buy her and I'm so glad I did.
entries.translation: Niliamua kumnunua na nafurahia kwamba nilimnunua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's been a wonderful addition to my family and I'm so happy to have her in my life.
entries.translation: Amekuwa ongezeko mzuri katika familia yangu na nafurahia sana kuwa naye katika maisha yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I first brought her home, I took her to the vet for an inspection.
entries.translation: Nilipomleta nyumbani kwa mara ya kwanza, nilimpeleka kwa daktari wa mifugo ili afanyiwe uchunguzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The vet said that she was in good health and that she was a very sound horse.
entries.translation: Daktari huyo wa mifugo alisema kwamba afya yake ilikuwa nzuri na kwamba alikuwa farasi mzuri sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was relieved to hear that she was healthy and I was excited to start riding her.
entries.translation: Nilitulia niliposikia kwamba alikuwa na afya nzuri na nikafurahia kuanza kumwendesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been riding my horse for a few weeks now and I'm really enjoying it.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa nikimwendesha farasi wangu kwa wiki chache sasa na nafurahia mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's a very easy horse to ride and she's very responsive to my commands.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Action speaks louder than words, and this is especially true in the world of adventure.
entries.translation: Muungwana ni kitendo, na hii ni hasa ni muhimu kwa ulimwengu wa kutaka kujua mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're out in the wilderness, you need to be able to rely on your own skills and abilities to get you through.
entries.translation: Ukiwa nje katika pori, unahitaji kuweza kutegemea ujuzi na uwezo wako mwenyewe ili kujikimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Words won't help you if you're lost, or if you're injured.
entries.translation: Maneno hayatakusaidia iwapo umepotea, au iwapo umeumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've seen this principle in action time and time again.
entries.translation: Nimeona kanuni hii ikitumika kwa muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On one of my early adventures, I was hiking with a group of friends when we got lost.
entries.translation: Katika moja ya matukio yangu ya mapema, nilikuwa natembea na kikundi cha marafiki wakati ambapo tulipotea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We wandered around for hours, trying to find our way back to the trail.
entries.translation: Tulizurura kwa saa kadhaa, tukijaribu kutafuta njia ya kurudi kwa njia rasmi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But no matter what we said or did, we just couldn't seem to find our way.
entries.translation: Lakini licha ya jambo ambalo tulisema au kufanya, hatukuweza tu kupata njia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, one of our friends decided to take action.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, rafiki yetu mmoja aliamua kuchukua hatua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He started walking in a particular direction, and we all followed him.
entries.translation: Alianza kutembea katika mwelekeo maalum, na sote tukamfuata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, we came to a road, and we were able to find our way back to the trailhead.
entries.translation: Baada ya saa chache, tulifika kwenye barabara, na tuliweza kupata njia ya kurudi mahali ambapo tulianzia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we had just sat around and talked about what to do, we would never have found our way back.
entries.translation: Iwapo tungekaa tu hapo na kuongea kuhusu jambo la kufanya, kamwe hatungepata njia ya kurudi tulikotoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But because one of us took action, we were able to get out of a dangerous situation.
entries.translation: Lakini kwa sababu mmoja wetu alichukua hatua, tuliweza kutoka katika hali hiyo ngumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is just one example of how action can save the day.
entries.translation: Hii ni mfano tu ya jinsi kitendo kinaweza kuokoa katika hali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Coronavirus Symptoms: What You Need to Know
entries.translation: Dalili za Virusi vya Korona: Jambo Ambalo Unahitaji Kujua
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The coronavirus, also known as COVID-19, is a respiratory illness that can cause mild to severe symptoms.
entries.translation: Virusi vya korona vinavyojulikana pia kama COVID-19, ni ugonjwa wa njia ya kupumua ambao unaweza kuleta dalili kati ya kiasi na kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common symptoms of coronavirus include fever, cough, shortness of breath, and sore throat.
entries.translation: Dalili za kawaida zaidi za virusi vya korona ni homa, kikohozi, ugumu wa kupumua, na vidonda vya koo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other symptoms can include fatigue, muscle aches, headache, and a runny nose.
entries.translation: Dalili nyingine zinaweza kujumuisha uchovu, maumivu ya misuli, maumivu ya kichwa, na makamasi kwenye pua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, coronavirus can also lead to pneumonia, kidney failure, and death.
entries.translation: Katika hali nyingine, virusi vya korona vinaweza pia kusababisha nimonia, figo kukosa kufanya kazi, na kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The symptoms of coronavirus can vary depending on the individual.
entries.translation: Dalili za virusi vya korona zinaweza kutofautiana kutegemea mtu husika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people may experience only mild symptoms, while others may experience more severe symptoms.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaweza kuwa na dalili kidogo, huku wengine wanaweza kuwa na dalili kali zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The severity of symptoms is also related to the person's age and underlying health conditions.
entries.translation: Ukali wa dalili unahusiana pia na umri wa mtu na hali za afya ambazo zimekuwepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are experiencing any of the symptoms of coronavirus, it is important to see a doctor right away.
entries.translation: Iwapo unapitia dalili zozote za virusi vya korona, ni muhimu kumwona daktari mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment can help to prevent the illness from becoming more serious.
entries.translation: Utambuzi na matibabu ya mapema yanaweza kusaidia katika kuzuia maradhi hayo kuwa hatari zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for coronavirus, but there are treatments that can help to relieve symptoms.
entries.translation: Hakuna tiba ya virusi vya korona, lakini kuna matibabu ambayo yanaweza kusaidia kupunguza dalili zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most people who are infected with coronavirus will recover completely.
entries.translation: Watu wengi ambao wameambukizwa virusi vya korona watapona kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some people may experience long-term health problems.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, watu wengine wanaweza kuwa na matatizo ya kiafya kwa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to prevent coronavirus is to practice good hygiene and social distancing.
entries.translation: Njia bora ya kuzuia virusi vya korona ni kuwa na usafi mzuri na kukaa mbali na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wash your hands frequently with soap and water, and avoid touching your face.
entries.translation: Nawa mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji, na uepukane na kugusa uso wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid close contact with people who are sick.
entries.translation: Epukana na mgusano wa karibu na watu ambao ni wagonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fundamental rights are the essential freedoms that all human beings are entitled to, regardless of their race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or any other status.
entries.translation: Haki za msingi ni uhuru muhimu ambao binadamu wote wana haki ya kupata, licha ya mbari, dini, jinsia, mwelekeo wa kingono, au hali yao nyingine yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These rights are enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, which was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948.
entries.translation: Haki hizi zinapatikana katika Azimio la Wote la Hati za Binadamu, ambalo lilikubaliwa na Baraza Kuu la Umoja wa Mataifa mnamo mwaka wa 1948.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fundamental rights are essential for the protection of human dignity and the promotion of human flourishing.
entries.translation: Haki hizi za msingi ni muhimu katika kulinda hadhi ya binadamu na kuendeleza maendeleo ya binadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the foundation of a just and equitable society, and they are essential for the maintenance of peace and security.
entries.translation: Haki hizo ndizo msingi wa jamii yenye haki na usawa, na ni muhimu katika kudumisha amani na usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The protection of fundamental rights is a never-ending task.
entries.translation: Ulinzi wa haki za msingi ni kazi ambayo huwa haiishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are always those who would seek to deny or undermine these rights, and we must always be vigilant in their defense.
entries.translation: Huwa kuna wale ambao wangependa kutafuta kunyimana au kudhoofisha haki hizi, na lazima tuwe waangalifu katika kuzitetea kila mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we must never give up hope.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The struggle for fundamental rights is a noble one, and it is a struggle that we must never abandon.
entries.translation: Mapambano ya kuwa na haki za msingi ni ya uadilifu, na ni mapambano ambayo kamwe hatufai kuacha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all work together to ensure that the fundamental rights of all people are respected and protected.
entries.translation: Sote lazima tufanye kazi pamoja ili kuhakikisha kwamba haki hizo za msingi za watu wote zimeheshimiwa na kulindwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: I've been looking forward to it all week.
entries.translation: Mtu A: Nimekuwa nikiitazamia wiki nzima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: Me too! I've heard great things about this band.
entries.translation: Mtu B: Mimi pia! Nimesikia mambo makubwa kuhusu bendi hii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: I'm just hoping the sound is good. I hate when you can't hear the music over the crowd noise.
entries.translation: Mtu A: Nina matumaini kwamba sauti ni nzuri. Nachukia wakati ambapo huwezi kusikia muziki kwa sababu ya kelele ya umati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: Yeah, that's the worst. But I think this venue is supposed to be pretty good.
entries.translation: Mtu B: Naam, hicho ndicho kitu kibaya zaidi. Lakini nadhani ukumbi huu unafaa kuwa mzuri zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: So, what other concerts have you been to lately?
entries.translation: Mtu B: Hivyo, umehudhuria tamasha zipi tena hivi majuzi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: I went to a music festival last month. It was a lot of fun, but it was also really crowded.
entries.translation: Mtu A: Nilihudhuria tamasha ya muziki mwezi uliopita. Kulikuwa na burudani tele, lakini watu walikuwa wamejaa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: Yeah, I can imagine. Music festivals can be a lot to take in.
entries.translation: Mtu B: Ndiyo, naweza kuwazia. Tamasha za muziki zinaweza kuwa na mambo mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: But it was worth it to see all the different bands.
entries.translation: Mtu A: Lakini ilikuwa sawa kwa sababu ya kuona bendi zote tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: Definitely. I'm always looking for new music to listen to.
entries.translation: Mtu B: Bila shaka. Huwa natafuta muziki mpya wa kusikiliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The bright light of the sun shone down on the desert, illuminating the endless dunes of sand.
entries.translation: Mwanga wa jua unaong'aa uling'aa kwenye jangwa, na kumulika chungu za mchanga zisizo na kikomo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The only other source of light came from the stars in the sky, which twinkled in the distance.
entries.translation: Chanzo kingine pekee cha mwangaza kilitoka kwa nyota kwenye mbingu, ambao ulimeta kwa mbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The vision of a beautiful woman appeared in the air, her long hair flowing in the wind.
entries.translation: Sura ya mwanamke mrembo ilionekana kwenye hewa, nywele zake ndefu zikipepea kwenye upepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was wearing a white dress that was covered in jewels, and her skin was as fair as snow.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amevaa rinda jeupe ambalo lilikuwa limefunikwa kwa kito, na ngozi yake ilikuwa nyororo kama theluji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked at me with her piercing blue eyes, and I felt a sense of peace wash over me.
entries.translation: Aliniangalia kwa macho yake ya buluu, na nikahisi hisia ya amani kuingia ndani yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I reached out to touch her, but she vanished before my fingers could brush against her skin.
entries.translation: Nilimsogea ili nimguse, lakini alipotea kabla ya vidole vyangu kugusa ngozi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was left standing alone in the desert, wondering what had just happened.
entries.translation: Nilibaki kama nimesimama pekee yangu kwenye jangwa, nikishangaa kitu ambacho kimefanyika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took a deep breath and began to walk back to my camp, my mind filled with thoughts of the beautiful woman I had seen.
entries.translation: Nilivuta pumzi ya ndani na nikaanza kutembea nikirudi kwenye kambi yangu, akili yangu ilikuwa imejazwa na mawazo ya mwanamke huyo mrembo ambaye nimemuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I walked, I thought about what she had meant to me.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nikitembea, niliwazia maana yake kwangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a symbol of hope, a reminder that there was still beauty in the world, even in the darkest of times.
entries.translation: Alikuwa ishara ya matumaini, kumbusho kwamba bado kulikuwa na urembo duniani, hata nyakati ngumu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a vision of what could be, and I vowed to never forget her.
entries.translation: Alikuwa maono ya jambo ambalo lingetokea, na niliapa kutomsahau kamwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I continued to walk, and as I did, the sun began to set.
entries.translation: Niliendelea kutembea, na nilipokuwa natembea, jua lilianza kutua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there were two pilots who were very good friends.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na rubani wawili ambao walikuwa marafiki wazuri mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They loved to fly together and share funny stories.
entries.translation: Walipenda sana kusafiri pamoja na kushiriki hadithi za kufurahisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, they were flying over the ocean when they saw a large fish jump out of the water.
entries.translation: Siku moja, walikuwa wanapita na ndege juu ya bahari walipoona samaki mkubwa akiruka juu ya maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilot on the left said, "Did you see that big fish?"
entries.translation: Rubani katika upande wa kushoto alisema, "Je, ulimwona samaki huyo mkubwa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilot on the right said, "Yes, I did! It was huge!"
entries.translation: Rubani katika upande wa kulia alisema, "Ndiyo, nilimwona! alikuwa mkubwa sana!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They laughed and continued on their flight.
entries.translation: Walicheka na kuendelea na safari yao ya ndege.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they were flying, they passed by a large airport.
entries.translation: Walipokuwa wanaendesha ndege, walipita juu ya uwanja mkubwa wa ndege.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilot on the left said, "I wonder how many people are at that airport right now."
entries.translation: Rubani katika upande wa kushoto alisema, "Nashangaa ni watu wangapi wako katika uwanja huo wa ndege sasa hivi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pilot on the right said, "I don't know, but it must be a lot."
entries.translation: Rubani katika upande wa kulia alisema, "Sijui, lakini ni wengi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They laughed again and continued on their flight.
entries.translation: Walicheka tena na kuendelea kuendesha ndege yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, there are many signs that our society is obsessed with beauty and fitness.
entries.translation: Leo, kuna ishara nyingi za kuonyesha kwamba jamii yetu imeshikilia sana urembo na ustawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This obsession with beauty can have a number of negative consequences, including body image issues, eating disorders, and depression.
entries.translation: Tamaa hii ya urembo inaweza kuleta athari kadhaa mbaya, ikiwa pamoja na masuala ya mwonekano wa mwili, matatizo ya kula, na majonzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to remember that beauty is not just about physical appearance.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba urembo hauhusu tu mwonekano wa kimwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also about our inner qualities, such as our kindness, intelligence, and strength.
entries.translation: Unahusu pia sifa zetu za ndani, kama vile ukarimu, hekima, na uwezo wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we focus on these qualities, we are more likely to find true happiness and fulfillment.
entries.translation: Tukilenga sifa hizi, tuna uwezekano mkubwa wa kupata furaha wa kweli na kuridhika kwa kweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We should also be aware of the ways in which we are compensating for our lack of self-care.
entries.translation: Tunafaa pia kufahamu njia ambazo tunatumia kulipia ukosefu wetu wa kujijali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if we are constantly dieting or spending money on beauty products in an attempt to improve our appearance, we may be trying to cover up our insecurities.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead of trying to change our appearance, we should focus on loving and accepting ourselves for who we are.

entries.english: Taking care of our physical and mental health is essential for living a happy and fulfilling life.
entries.translation: Kujali afya yetu ya kimwili na kiakili ni muhimu katika kuishi maisha yenye furaha na ya kuridhisha.

entries.english: When we take care of ourselves, we are sending a message to the world that we are worthy of love and respect.

entries.english: Nigeria is home to a rich and diverse culture, with many different traditional customs and practices.
entries.translation: Nijeria ni nyumbani mwa tamaduni nyingi na anuwai, yenye mila na desturi nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important customs is the respect for elders.
entries.translation: Moja kati ya desturi muhimu zaidi ni kuwaheshimu wazee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elders are considered to be wise and knowledgeable, and their advice is often sought out by younger people.
entries.translation: Watu wazee wanazingatiwa kuwa na hekima na maarifa, na watu wadogo huwa wanatafuta ushauri wao mara nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important custom is the importance of family.
entries.translation: Desturi nyingine muhimu ni umuhimu wa familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Family ties are very strong in Nigeria, and extended families often live together in the same compound.
entries.translation: Umoja wa familia ni thabiti sana nchini Nijeria, na familia za kando mara nyingi huishi pamoja katika eneo moja maalum.

entries.english: Traditional customs also play an important role in Nigerian weddings and funerals.
entries.translation: Desturi za kitamaduni pia zina nafasi muhimu katika harusi na mazishi nchini Nijeria.

entries.english: Weddings are often large and elaborate affairs, and funerals are seen as a time to celebrate the life of the deceased.
entries.translation: Harusi mara nyingi huwa ni kubwa na hufafanua masuala, na matanga huwa yanaonekana kama wakati wa kusherehekea maisha ya marehemu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most well-known traditional customs in Nigeria is the Igbo people's practice of female genital mutilation (FGM).
entries.translation: Moja kati ya desturi inayofahamika zaidi nchini Nijeria ni mila ya jamii ya Igbo ya kuwatairi wasichana (FGM).

entries.english: FGM is the ritual cutting or removal of some or all of the external female genitalia.
entries.translation: FGM ni mila ya kukata au kuondoa baadhi ya au sehemu yote ya kinembe cha nje cha mwanamke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a harmful practice that has no medical benefits and can lead to a number of health problems, including pain, infection, infertility, and even death.
entries.translation: Ni kitendo chenye uchungu ambacho hakina manufaa ya kimatibabu na kinaweza kuleta matatizo mengi ya kiafya, yakiwemo uchungu, maambukizo, utasa, na hata kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the fact that FGM is illegal in Nigeria, it is still practiced in some parts of the country.
entries.translation: Licha ya ukweli kwamba FGM ni haramu nchini Nijeria, bado inafanywa katika baadhi ya sehemu za nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another traditional custom that is common in Nigeria is the use of traditional medicine.
entries.translation: Desturi nyingine ya kale ambayo inapatikana sana Nijeria ni matumizi ya dawa ya kienyeji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Traditional medicine is based on the use of plants, herbs, and other natural substances to treat illnesses.
entries.translation: Dawa ya kienyeji inategemea kutumia mimea, mitishamba, na vifaa vingine asili ili kutibu ugonjwa.

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in South Africa include Nelson Mandela, Mahatma Gandhi, and Desmond Tutu.

entries.english: It was also very expensive, and we had to save up for several months to be able to afford it.

entries.english: My husband was very excited about his new computer, and he spent hours learning how to use it.

entries.english: I was not as interested in using the computer, but I did appreciate the convenience of being able to use it to pay bills and do other tasks that used to require a trip to the library or store.

entries.english: As the years went by, computers became more and more affordable and accessible.

entries.english: This made them more popular with people of all ages, including women.

entries.english: I eventually became interested in using computers to do things like create presentations for work and manage my finances.

entries.english: Today, computers and electronics are a part of our everyday lives.

entries.english: We use them for work, school, entertainment, and communication.

entries.english: They have made our lives easier and more convenient in many ways.

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful young girl named Luna who lived in a small village on the edge of a forest.

entries.english: She was the subject of many poems and songs, and all the young men in the village were in love with her.

entries.english: Every night, Luna would sit outside and gaze up at the moon, dreaming of one day being with him.

entries.english: She would write poems and songs about him, and she would often dance in the moonlight.

entries.english: Flowers have been used for centuries to communicate messages, and the art of flower arranging is a way to create beautiful and meaningful works of art.

entries.english: There are many different schools of thought on flower arranging, but all share a common goal: to create a balanced and pleasing composition.

entries.english: The most important elements to consider when arranging flowers are shape, color, and texture.

entries.english: The flowers can be arranged in a symmetrical or asymmetrical pattern, and they can be grouped together in clusters or placed individually.

entries.english: Color is another important element of flower arranging.

entries.english: Colors can be used to create a sense of harmony or contrast, and they can also be used to evoke specific emotions.

entries.english: Texture is the third element of flower arranging.

entries.english: Texture can be created by using flowers with different types of petals, leaves, and stems.

entries.english: When arranging flowers, it is important to consider the overall effect that you want to create.

entries.english: Once you know what you want, you can start to choose the flowers and arrange them in a way that will achieve your desired effect.

entries.english: Flower arranging is a creative art form that can be enjoyed by people of all ages.

entries.english: For example, red roses are often given to express love, while white lilies are often given to express sympathy.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, waridi mwekundu mara nyingi hupeanwa ili kuashiria upendo, huku yungiyungi nyeupe mara nyingi huashiria huruma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The meaning of flowers can vary depending on the culture and the context in which they are given.
entries.translation: Maana ya maua yanaweza kutofautiana kutegemea utamaduni na muktadha ambamo yamepeanwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, in some cultures, the color purple is associated with royalty, while in other cultures, it is associated with mourning.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, katika baadhi ya utamaduni, rangi ya zambarau inahusishwa na hadhi, huku katika utamaduni mwingine, rangi hiyo inahusishwa na kuomboleza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are not sure what the meaning of a particular flower is, it is always best to ask the person who gave it to you.
entries.translation: Iwapo huna uhakika na maana ya maua maalum, ni vyema uulize mtu ambaye alikupatia maua hayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flower arranging is a beautiful and meaningful art form that can be enjoyed by people of all ages.
entries.translation: Kupanga maua ni njia ya sanaa nzuri na yenye maana ambayo watu wa umri wote wanaweza kufurahia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kenya faces a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Kenya inakumbana na changamoto nyingi, zikiwemo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Poverty: Kenya is one of the poorest countries in the world, with a per capita GDP of just over $1,000.
entries.translation: * Umaskini: Kenya ni moja kati ya nchi maskini zaidi duniani, GDP ya kila mtu ikiwa kiasi juu ya $1,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This poverty is due to a number of factors, including a lack of economic development, high population growth, and inequality.
entries.translation: Umaskini huu unatokana na vipengele mbalimbali, vikiwemo ukosefu wa maendeleo ya kiuchumi, ongezeko kubwa la watu, na ukosefu wa usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Inequality: Kenya is also a very unequal country, with a small elite controlling the majority of the wealth.
entries.translation: * Ukosefu wa usawa: Kenya ni nchi ambayo haina usawa, huku kikundi kidogo cha watu wakidhibiti sehemu kubwa ya utajiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This inequality has been exacerbated by the recent economic crisis, which has disproportionately affected the poor.
entries.translation: Ukosefu huu wa usawa umeongezwa na majanga ya sasa ya kiuchumi, ambayo imeathiri watu maskini bila usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Corruption: Kenya is also plagued by corruption, which undermines the government's ability to provide basic services and improve the lives of its citizens.
entries.translation: * Ufisadi: Kenya pia inataabishwa na ufisadi, ambao unadhoofisha uwezo wa serikali wa kutoa huduma za msingi na kuboresha maisha ya raia wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Violence: Kenya has also experienced a number of episodes of violence, including the 2007-08 post-election violence.
entries.translation: * Vurugu: Kenya pia imekumbana na idadi fulani ya vipindi vya vurugu, ikijumuisha vurugu za baada ya uchaguzi wa mwaka wa 2007-08.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This violence has been caused by a number of factors, including ethnic tensions, political grievances, and poverty.
entries.translation: Vurugu hii imeletwa na vipengele fulani, kama vile migogoro ya kikabila, malalamiko ya kisiasa, na umaskini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Climate change: Kenya is also vulnerable to the effects of climate change, such as droughts, floods, and rising sea levels.
entries.translation: * Mabadiliko ya tabianchi: Kenya pia inaweza kudhurika na athari za mabadiliko ya tabianchi, kama vile ukame, mafuriko, na kupanda kwa viwango vya bahari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These effects are already having a negative impact on the country's economy and environment.
entries.translation: Athari hizi tayari zinaleta athari chanya kwenye uchumi na mazingira ya nchi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Ethiopian farmer is a resilient figure who has faced severe drought and famine for years.
entries.translation: Mkulima wa Ethiopia ni mtu imara ambaye amekumbana na ukame na ukavu mkali kwa miaka kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, they have shown great resolve in the face of adversity and continue to work hard to provide for their families.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, wameonyesha ukakamavu mkubwa katika shida kubwa na wanaendelea kufanya kazi kwa bidii ili kukidhi familia zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such farmer is Abebech Gidey, who lives in the village of Dengelat.
entries.translation: Mmoja kati ya wakulima kama hao ni Abebech Gidey, ambaye anaishi katika kijiji cha Dengelat.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has been farming for over 20 years and has seen firsthand the effects of the drought.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akifanya ukulima kwa zaidi ya miaka 20 na ameona athari za ukame kwa njia ya moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2015, her crops failed and she was forced to sell her livestock in order to buy food.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2015, mazao yake hayakufanya vizuri na alilazimika kuuza mifugo yake ili kuweza kununua chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, she did not give up and continued to farm, even though the odds were stacked against her.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, hakukata tamaa na aliendelea kufanya ukulima, hata kama matatizo magumu yalikuwa yanamkabili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This year, Abebech's crops are doing well and she is hopeful that she will be able to harvest a good crop.
entries.translation: Mwaka huu, mazao ya Abebech yanafanya vizuri na ana matumaini kwamba ataweza kuvuna mazao mazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is also working hard to improve her farming practices and learn new ways to grow crops that are more resistant to drought.
entries.translation: Pia, anafanya kazi kwa bidii ili kuboresha njia zake za kufanya ukulima na anajifunza njia mpya za kupanda mazao ambayo yanaweza kustahimili ukame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Abebech is an inspiration to all Ethiopian farmers.
entries.translation: Abebech ni msukumo kwa wakulima wote nchini Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She shows that it is possible to overcome adversity and succeed, even in the most difficult of circumstances.
entries.translation: Anajua kwamba inawezekana kushinda matatizo makali na kufaulu, hata katika hali ngumu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is a true example of the resolve and determination of the Ethiopian people.
entries.translation: Yeye ni mfano wa kweli wa ukakamavu na ushupavu wa wananchi wa Ethiopia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The orange clay of the earthen walls was close to the elements, cheap and traditional.
entries.translation: Udongo wenye rangi ya chungwa wa kuta za dunia ulikuwa karibu na vipengele, ulikuwa wa bei nafuu na wa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a common sight in this region in Ghana, where many people lived in simple homes made from natural materials.
entries.translation: Ulikuwa mambo ya kawaida kuona katika eneo hili la Ghana, ambapo watu wengi waliishi katika nyumba zilizojengwa na nyenzo za asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The walls were often decorated with colorful paintings, which added a touch of beauty to the otherwise humble dwellings.
entries.translation: Kuta hizo mara nyingi zilikuwa zimepambwa kwa kutumia michoro yenye rangi nyingi, ambayo iliongeza urembo kwenye makao hayo duni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Ama was walking through her village when she saw a group of children playing in the dirt.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mwanamke mdogo anayeitwa Ama alikuwa anatembea katika kijiji hicho alipoona kikundi cha watoto wakicheza katika uchafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were laughing and having fun, and Ama couldn't help but smile.
entries.translation: Walikuwa wanacheka na kufurahia, na Ama hangeweza kufanya chochote ila kutabasamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She thought about how lucky she was to live in such a beautiful place, where the people were so kind and welcoming.
entries.translation: Aliwaza kuhusu namna ambavyo alikuwa na bahati nzuri ya kuishi katika eneo hilo linalopendeza, mahali ambapo watu walikuwa wakarimu na wenye furaha sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ama continued on her way, and as she walked, she thought about the traditional customs of her people.
entries.translation: Ama aliendelea na safari yake, na alipokuwa akitembea, aliwazia desturi za kale za watu wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She thought about the way they celebrated their festivals with music and dancing, and the way they respected their elders.
entries.translation: Aliwazia namna ambavyo walikuwa wanasherehekea tamasha zao kwa muziki na kucheza, na namna ambavyo walikuwa wanawaheshimu wakubwa wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was proud to be Ghanaian, and she knew that she would always cherish the traditional customs of her culture.
entries.translation: Alijivunia kuwa raia wa Ghana, na alijua kwamba angeendelea kuthamini na kutunza desturi za kale za utamaduni wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, Ama went to the market to buy some food.
entries.translation: Siku iliyofuata, Ama alienda sokoni kununua chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she was walking through the stalls, she saw a woman selling oranges.
entries.translation: Alipokuwa anatembea akipita mabanda, alimwona mwanamke ambaye alikuwa anauza machungwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The oranges were bright and juicy, and Ama couldn't resist buying a few.
entries.translation: Machungwa hayo yalikuwa yanang'aa na kuvutia, ama hangeweza kujizuia kununua machache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy is in a state of flux, and it is unclear when things will improve.
entries.translation: Uchumi upo katika hali ya mfululizo wa mabadiliko, na si wazi ni lini mambo yatakuwa sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, we need to do everything we can to save money and make our resources stretch as far as possible.
entries.translation: Kwa sasa, tunahitaji kufanya kila kitu tunachoweza kufanya ili kuokoa pesa na kufanya rasilimali zetu kutumika zaidi kadri inavyowezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do this is to be diligent in our work.
entries.translation: Njia moja ya kufanya hii ni kuweka bidii katika kazi yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means putting in extra effort and being productive.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuweka juhudi za ziada na kuwa na uzalishaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to make sure that we are getting the most out of our time and that we are not wasting any resources.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuhakikisha kwamba tunatumia muda wetu vizuri sana na kwamba hatutumii rasilimali zozote vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to save money is to be stingy in our purchases.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kuokoa pesa ni kuwa wachoyo katika manunuzi yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means being careful about what we buy and only buying things that we need.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kwamba tunakuwa waangalifu kuhusu kitu ambacho tunanunua na kununua vitu ambavyo tunahitaji pekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to avoid impulse purchases and think carefully about every dollar we spend.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji kuepukana na kufanya manunuzi ya bila kupanga na kufikiria kwa umakini kuhusu kila shilingi tunayotumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that it is not easy to be diligent and stingy, but it is necessary in the current economic climate.
entries.translation: Najua kwamba si rahisi kuwa mtu mwenye bidii na mchoyo, lakini ni muhimu katika hali ya sasa ya kiuchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we all do our part, we can weather this storm and come out stronger on the other side.
entries.translation: Sisi sote tukifanya wajibu wetu, tunaweza kumaliza tatizo hili sugu na kuibuka washindi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to being diligent and stingy, we also need to be patient and resilient.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya kuwa na bidii na wachoyo, tunahitaji pia kuwa wenye subira na watu imara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy is not going to improve overnight, and there will be times when we feel discouraged.
entries.translation: Uchumi hautakuwa bora kwa siku moja tu, na kutakuwa na wakati ambapo tutahisi kukatishwa tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, we need to keep our heads up and keep working hard.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, tunahitaji kuendelea na moyo huo na kufanya kazi kwa bidii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we give up now, we will only make things worse.
entries.translation: Tukikata tamaa sasa, tutafanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that we can get through this together.
entries.translation: Najua kwamba tunaweza kushinda hii pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are a strong community, and we will support each other through thick and thin.
entries.translation: Sisi ni jamii imara, na tutasaidiana katika kila hali ya aina yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us all do our part to make our community a better place.
entries.translation: Sisi sote tufanye wajibu wetu ili tufanye jamii yetu iwe mahali pazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's nothing quite like sharing a meal with loved ones, and savoring the flavors of a delicious dish.

entries.english: It can also be a way to learn about different cultures and traditions.

entries.english: The pasta was perfectly al dente, the sauce was rich and creamy, and the bacon was perfectly crispy.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can make us feel happy, sad, angry, or nostalgic.
entries.translation: Kinaweza kutufanya tuwe na furaha, hasira, husuni, au hamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can bring us together, or tear us apart.
entries.translation: Kinaweza kutuleta pamoja, au kututenganisha kabisa.

entries.english: So next time you're feeling down, or you're just looking for a way to connect with someone, share a meal together.

entries.english: They are full of energy, creativity, and passion, and they are eager to make a change.

entries.english: When young people are given the opportunity to participate in nation building, they can do incredible things.

entries.english: They can start new businesses, create new technologies, and solve some of the world's most pressing problems.

entries.english: They can also inspire others to get involved and make a difference.

entries.english: One example of how young people are making a difference in nation building is through the work of the Malala Fund.

entries.english: Malala Yousafzai, a Pakistani activist for female education, was shot in the head by the Taliban in 2012 for speaking out in favor of education for girls.
entries.translation: Malala Yousafzai, mwanaharakati wa Pakistani wa masuala ya elimu, alipigwa risasi kwenye kichwa na Taliban mwaka wa 2012 kwa kuongeza na kutetea elimu ya wasichana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After surviving the attack, Malala became a global advocate for girls' education and founded the Malala Fund to support education for girls around the world.
entries.translation: Baada ya kunusurika kwenye shambulio hilo, Malala alikuwa mtetezi wa elimu ya wasichana kote ulimwenguni na aliasisi Malala Fund ili kusaidia elimu ya wasichana kote ulimwenguni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Malala Fund has registered incredible progress in its mission to provide 130 million girls with 12 years of free, safe, quality education by 2030.
entries.translation: Malala Fund imekuwa na maendeleo mazuri katika lengo lake la kuwapa wasichana milioni 130 miaka 12 ya elimu ya bila malipo, ambayo ni salama, na ya bora kufikia mwaka wa 2030.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These words are often used to describe people who are perceived as being unintelligent or slow-witted.
entries.translation: Maneno haya mara nyingi yanatumika kuelezea watu ambao wanachukuliwa kuwa si werevu au wana akili inayofanya kazi polepole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, they can also be used in a more derogatory way to insult or belittle someone.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, yanaweza kutumika pia katika njia ya matusi zaidi ili kumtukana au kumdunisha mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be aware of the power of words and to use them carefully.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kufahamu nguvu ya maneno na kuyatumia kwa uangalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calling someone names can be hurtful and can have a lasting impact on their self-esteem.
entries.translation: Kumtukana mtu kunaweza kuumiza sana na kunaweza kuwa na athari ya kudumu kwa kujiamini kwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are feeling angry or frustrated, it is better to take a deep breath and walk away than to say something you might regret.
entries.translation: Iwapo unahisi kwamba umekasirika au umevunjwa moyo, ni vyema uvute pumzi ya kina na uondoke hapo badala ya jambo ambalo huenda ukajutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other ways to express yourself without resorting to name-calling.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingine nyingi za kujieleza bila kuamua kutoa matusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can say "I disagree with you" or "I don't understand your point of view".
entries.translation: Unaweza kusema "sikubaliani nawe" au "sifahamu mtazamo wako".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also ask questions to try to understand the other person's perspective.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kuuliza maswali ili kujaribu kufahamu mtazamo wa mtu mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By using kind and respectful language, you can create a more positive and productive dialogue.
entries.translation: Kwa kutumia lugha yenye ukarimu na heshima, unaweza kuleta mazungumzo chanya na yenye matunda zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to remember that everyone is different and has their own unique strengths and weaknesses.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu pia kukumbuka kwamba kila mtu ni tofauti na ana uwezo na udhaifu wake wa kipekee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one right way to be intelligent or successful.
entries.translation: Hakuna njia yoyote sahihi ya kuwa mwerevu au mwenye mafanikio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We should all be accepting of each other's differences and celebrate our individual talents and abilities.
entries.translation: Sisi sote tunafaa kukubali tofauti za kila mmoja na kusherehekea vipaji na uwezo wetu wa kibinafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are struggling with feelings of anger or frustration, it is important to talk to someone you trust.
entries.translation: Iwapo unapambana na hisia za hasira au kuvunjika moyo, ni muhimu uongee na mtu ambaye unamuamini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A therapist or counselor can help you to identify the root of your feelings and develop healthy coping mechanisms.
entries.translation: Mtaalamu wa tiba au mshauri anaweza kukusaidia kutambua chanzo cha hisia zako na kuunda mbinu salama za kuzoea hali hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also find support groups online or in your community.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kupata vikundi vya kutoa msaada kwenye mtandao au katika jamii yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world was shocked when it was revealed that the popular children's television presenter, Mr. Snuggles, was actually a puppet of the Russian government.
entries.translation: Dunia ilishtuka ilipotangazwa kwamba mtangazaji maarufu wa televisheni ya watoto, Bw. Snuggles, alikuwa kibaraka wa serikali ya Urusi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Snuggles had been using his show to spread pro-Russian propaganda to children all over the world.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one episode, Mr. Snuggles told children that it was a good idea to turn off the electricity in their homes to save energy.
entries.translation: Katika kipindi kimoja, Bw. Snuggles aliwaambia watoto kwamba ilikuwa wazo zuri kuzima umeme katika nyumba zao ili kutunza kawi.

entries.english: This was actually an attempt by the Russian government to sabotage the electrical grid in the United States.

entries.english: Mr. Snuggles was eventually arrested and charged with treason.

entries.english: The Mahdist War was a major conflict in Sudan that lasted from 1881 to 1899.

entries.english: It was fought between the forces of the Mahdi, Muhammad Ahmad, and the British Empire.

entries.english: The Mahdi was a religious leader who claimed to be the Mahdi, or the expected redeemer of Islam.

entries.english: He led a revolt against the Egyptian-controlled Sudan and established a state based in Omdurman.

entries.english: The British intervened in the war in 1884 and eventually defeated the Mahdists in 1898.

entries.english: I was so worried about my cat, but she was a trooper and didn't even flinch when the vet was cleaning her paw.

entries.english: The ocean is a vast and mysterious place, home to all sorts of creatures.

entries.english: From the smallest plankton to the largest whales, the ocean is teeming with life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And no two places in the ocean are the same.

entries.english: Each ocean ecosystem has its own unique set of plants and animals, adapted to the specific conditions of its environment.

entries.english: One of the most biodiverse places on Earth is the coral reef.

entries.english: Coral reefs are found in warm, shallow waters around the world, and they are home to a wide variety of creatures.
entries.translation: Miamba tumbawe inapatikana katika maji ya moto ambayo si ya kina kote duniani, na ni nyumbani mwa viumbe mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Coral reefs are made up of tiny animals called coral polyps.
entries.translation: Miamba tumbawe ina wanyama wadogo wanaoitwa polipu wa miamba tumbawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These polyps secrete a hard, calcium carbonate skeleton, which builds up over time to form a reef.
entries.translation: Polipu hawa hutoa skeletoni ngumu ya kalsiamu kaboneti, ambayo huwa inajikusanya na kuwa mwamba tumbawe baada ya muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Coral reefs provide a home for a wide variety of fish, invertebrates, and other marine life.
entries.translation: Miamba tumbawe ni makao ya aina mbalimbali ya samaki, wanyama wasio na uti wa mgongo, na viumbe wengine baharini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also important for tourism and recreation.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kwa utalii na shughuli za kuburudika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unfortunately, coral reefs are under threat from a number of factors, including climate change, pollution, and overfishing.
entries.translation: Kwa bahati mbaya, miamba tumbawe inatishiwa sana na vipengele mbalimbali, vikiwemo mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, uchafuzi, na kuvua samaki kupita kiasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we do not take action to protect coral reefs, they will be lost forever.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Michelle was exploring the coral reef near her home.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was looking for shells to add to her collection.
