entries.english: Alcoholism is a complex disease that affects people of all ages, races, and socioeconomic backgrounds.
entries.translation: Ulevi ni ugonjwa changamano ambao huathiri watu wa rika, mbari, na asili zote za kijamii na kiuchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a chronic relapsing brain disease that is characterized by compulsive alcohol use, despite negative consequences.
entries.translation: Ni ugonjwa sugu wa ubongo unaojirudia ambao una sifa ya matumizi ya pombe ya kulazimisha, licha ya kuwa na matokeo mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While there is no single cause of alcoholism, it is believed to be caused by a combination of genetic, environmental, and psychological factors.
entries.translation: Ingawa hakuna sababu moja ya ulevi, inaaminika kusababishwa na mchanganyiko wa mambo ya jenitiki, kimazingira, na kisaikolojia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alcoholism is a progressive disease that can lead to a number of health problems, including liver damage, heart disease, stroke, cancer, and mental health problems.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa ni ulevi unaendelea ambao unaweza kusababisha matatizo kadhaa ya kiafya, yakiwemo uharibifu wa ini, kiharusi, saratani, na matatizo ya akili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also lead to social problems, such as job loss, relationship problems, and financial difficulties.
entries.translation: Inaweza pia kusababisha matatizo ya kijamii, kama vile kupoteza kazi, matatizo ya mahusiano, na matatizo ya kifedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the negative consequences of alcoholism, it is a treatable disease.
entries.translation: Licha ya ulevi kuwa na matokeo mabaya, ni ugonjwa unaoweza kutibiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of effective treatments available, including individual therapy, group therapy, and medication.
entries.translation: Kuna matibabu kadhaa yanayofaa ambayo yanapatikana, yakiwemo matibabu binafsi, matibabu ya kikundi, na dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With treatment, people who are struggling with alcoholism can achieve long-term sobriety and live healthy, fulfilling lives.
entries.translation: Kwa matibabu, watu ambao wanakabiliwa na ulevi wanaweza kukosa kulewa kwa muda mrefu na kuishi maisha yenye afya na kuridhisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The disease of alcoholism is often compared to a vicious cycle.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi ulevi hulinganishwa na mzunguko mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step in breaking the cycle is to recognize that you have a problem.
entries.translation: Hatua ya kwanza ya kuvunja mzunguko huo ni kutambua kuwa una tatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have acknowledged your problem, you can begin to take steps to get help.
entries.translation: Mara baada ya kukubali tatizo lako, unaweza kuanza kuchukua hatua ili kupata msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of resources available to help you on your journey to recovery, including support groups, addiction specialists, and medications.
entries.translation: Kuna rasilimali kadhaa zinazopatikana za kukusaida katika safari yako ya kupata nafuu tena, zikiwemo vikundi vya usaidizi, wataalamu wa dawa za kulevya, na dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a small village in India, there lived a young boy named Ram.
entries.translation: Katika kijiji kidogo huko India, kulikuwa na mvulana mdogo anayeitwa Ram.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ram was a bright and curious boy, and he loved to learn about the world around him.
entries.translation: Ram alikuwa mwerevu na mwenye kutaka kujua, na alipenda kujifunza kuhusu ulimwengu unaomzunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ram was walking through the village when he saw a group of men working on a large pit.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Ram alikuwa akitembea kijijini alipoona kundi la wanaume wakifanya kazi kwenye shimo kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're building a rainwater harvesting tank," one of the men said.
entries.translation: "Tunajenga tangi la kuhifadhi maji ya mvua," mmoja wa wanaume hao alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "This will help us to collect rainwater during the monsoon season, so that we can use it during the dry season."
entries.translation: "Hii itatusaidia kukusanya majia ya mvua wakati wa msimu wa mvua, ili tuweze kuyatumia wakati wa kiangazi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had never heard of rainwater harvesting before.
entries.translation: Hakuwa amewahi kuskia kuhusu kuhifadhi maji ya mvua hapo awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He asked the men many questions, and they were happy to answer them.
entries.translation: Aliwauliza wanaume hao maswali mengi, na walifurahi kuyajibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ram learned that rainwater harvesting is a simple and effective way to collect and store rainwater.
entries.translation: Ram alijifunza kuwa ni rahisi kuhifadhi maji ya mvua na njia mwafaka ya kukusanya na kuhifadhi maji ya mvua.

entries.english: The rainwater is collected in a large pit, which is usually dug in the ground.
entries.translation: Maji ya mvua hukusanywa kwenye shimo kubwa, ambalo kwa kawaida kuchimbwa ardhini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pit is lined with a waterproof material, such as clay or concrete, to prevent the water from seeping out.
entries.translation: Shimo hilo kuwekwa nyenzo zisizopitisha maji, kama vile udongo au saruji, ili kuzuia maji yasitoke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rainwater harvesting tank is usually located near the village well, so that the water can be easily accessed.
entries.translation: Tangi la kuhifadhi maji ya mvua kwa kawaida liko kariubu na kisima cha kijiji, ili maji yaweze kupatikana kwa urahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The water can be used for drinking, cooking, bathing, and watering crops.
entries.translation: Maji hayo yanweza kutumika kunywa, kupika, kuoga, na kunyunyiza kwenye mimea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Getting lost at sea is a terrifying experience that can quickly lead to death if not properly prepared for.
entries.translation: Kupotea baharini ni tukio la kutisha ambalo linaweza kusababisha kifo haraka ikiwa halijatayarishwa vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a single moment, you can find yourself surrounded by vast expanses of water and no land in sight.
entries.translation: Kwa muda mfupi, unaweza kujikuta umezungukwa na eneo pana la maji na hakuna ardhi inayoonekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to remember that even if you are lost at sea, there are still things you can do to increase your chances of survival.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba hata ikiwa umepotea baharini, bado kuna mambo unayoweza kufanya ili kuongeza uwezekano wako wa kuishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to do is to stay calm.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi unayopaswa kufanya ni kuwa mtulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Panicking will only make things worse.
entries.translation: Kushikwa na hofu kutafanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, take a deep breath and focus on what you need to do to survive.
entries.translation: Badala yake, vuta pumzi na uzingatie kile unachohitaji kufanya ili uendelee kuishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next step is to assess your situation.
entries.translation: Hatua inayofuata ni kutathmini hali yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How far are you from land?

entries.english: What resources do you have available?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you're dealing with, you can start to make a plan.
entries.translation: Mara tu unapojua unachokabiliana nacho, unaweza kuanza kufanya mpango.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to do is to signal for help.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi ya kufanya ni kutoa ishara ya kuomba msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by using a variety of methods, such as flares, a mirror, or a signal fire.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanyika kwa kutumia njia mbalimbali, kama vile miali, kioo, au ishara ya moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a radio, you can also try to contact a passing ship or aircraft.
entries.translation: Iwpao una redio, unaweza pia kujaribu kuwasiliana na meli au ndege inayopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to stay hydrated and fed.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kuendela kunywa maji na kula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any food or water, ration it carefully.
entries.translation: Iwapo una chakula au maji yoyote, yagawanye kwa uangalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there were two twin sisters who were as different as night and day.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One sister, named Mary, was very studious and ambitious.
entries.translation: Dada mmoja, anayeitwa Mary, alikuwa mwenye bidii ya masomo na anayetaka makuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved to read and learn new things, and she dreamed of one day becoming a successful scientist.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her twin sister, named Jane, was more outgoing and adventurous.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved to play sports and explore new places, and she dreamed of one day becoming a famous athlete.

entries.english: The two sisters were very close, but they often disagreed about what was important in life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary thought that success was all about achieving your goals, while Jane thought that success was about having fun and enjoying life.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, the two sisters were walking home from school when they came across a strange old man.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old man was sitting on a bench, and he was wearing a long white beard and a pointy hat. "Hello," said the old man. "My name is Merlin, and I am a wizard.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been watching you two for some time, and I can see that you are both very talented."

entries.translation: Uchaguzi huo unatarajiwa kuwa kinyang'anyiro cha karibu, huku Rais wa sasa Cyril Ramaphosa akikabiliwa na changamoto ya kiongozi wa upinzani Mmusi Maimane.

entries.english: South Africa has been one of the hardest-hit countries in Africa by the pandemic, with over 3 million confirmed cases and over 90,000 deaths.
entries.translation: Afrika kusini imekuwa moja wapo ya nchi zilizoathiriwa zaidi na janga hili barani Afrika, na zaidi ya visa milioni 3 vilivyothibitishwa na zaidi ya vifo 90,000.

entries.english: The government has implemented a number of measures to try to contain the spread of the virus, including lockdowns and social distancing restrictions.

entries.english: However, the pandemic has had a devastating impact on the economy, with millions of people losing their jobs.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, janga hili limekuwa na athari mbaya kwa uchumi, huku mamilioni ya watu wakipoteza kazi zao.

entries.english: In addition to the COVID-19 pandemic, South Africa is also facing a number of other challenges, including poverty, inequality, and crime.
entries.translation: Mbali na janga la COVID-19, Afrika Kusini pia inakabiliwa na changamoto kadhaa, zikiwemo umaskini, ukosefu wa usawa, na uhalifu.

entries.english: The country has one of the highest rates of inequality in the world, and many people live in poverty.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important for waiters to remain professional and courteous, even when they are being treated poorly.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kwa wahudumu kuendelea kuwa wataalamu na wenye adabu, hata wakati wanatendewa vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge of being a waiter is dealing with long hours.
entries.translation: Changamoto nyingine ya kuwa mhudumu kufanya kazi kwa saa nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many waiters work long shifts, often on their feet for the entire time.
entries.translation: Wahudumu wengi hufanya kazi kwa muda mrefu ya kupokezana zamu, mara nyingi wakiwa wamesimama kwa muda wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be physically demanding, and it can also be difficult to stay focused and alert after working for many hours.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa ngumu kimwili, na pia inaweza kuwa vigumu kukazia fikra na kuwa macho baada ya kufanya kazi kwa saa nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges, being a waiter can be a rewarding job.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto, kuwa mhudumu inaweza kuwa kazi ya kuthawabisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be a great way to meet new people and learn about different cultures.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuwa njia nzuri ya kukutana na watu wapya na kujifunza kuhusu tamaduni tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be a good way to earn money and gain experience in the hospitality industry.
entries.translation: Inaweza pia kuwa njia nzuri ya kupata pesa na kupata uzoefu katika tasnia ya ukarimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are interested in becoming a waiter, there are a few things you can do to prepare.
entries.translation: Ikiwa ungependa kuwa mhudumu, kuna mambo machache ambayo unaweza kufanya ili kujiandaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, you should develop your customer service skills.
entries.translation: Kwanza, unafaa kuendeleza ujuzi wako wa huduma kwa wateja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by working in a customer service role, such as retail or food service.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanyika kwa kufanya jukumu la huduma kwa wateja, kama vile katika rejareja au huduma ya chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also learn about the different types of restaurants and the different types of food and drink that are served in them.
entries.translation: Unapaswa kujifunza pia kuhusu aina tofauti ya mikahawa na aina tofauti ya chakula na vinywaji ambavyo vinauzwa huko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, you should practice your skills in a mock interview setting.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, unapaswa kufanya mazoezi ya ujuzi wako katika mazingira ya mahojiano ya majaribio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have prepared yourself, you can start applying for waiter jobs.
entries.translation: Baada ya kujiandaa, unaweza kuanza kuomba kazi za kuwa mhudumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to find waiter jobs, such as online job boards, classified ads, and word-of-mouth.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti za kutafuta kazi ya kuwa mhudumu, kama vile bodi za kazi mtandaoni, matangazo yaliyoainishwa, na kuambiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found a few jobs that you are interested in, you can apply for them and start the interview process.
entries.translation: Mara tu umepata kazi kadhaa ambazo umependa, unaweza kutuma maombi na kuanza mchakato wa mahojiano ya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being a waiter can be a challenging and rewarding job.
entries.translation: Kuwa mhuduma kunaweza kuwa na changamoto na kazi ya kuthawabisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The two groups of people had been enemies for centuries.
entries.translation: Makundi hayo mawali ya watu yamekuwa maadui kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had different religions, different cultures, and different languages.
entries.translation: Yalikuwa na dini tofauti, tamaduni tofauti, na lugha tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had fought many wars, and each side had committed atrocities against the other.
entries.translation: Yalikuwa yamepigana vita vingi, na kila upande ulikuwa umefanya ukatili dhidi ya mwenzie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hatred between them was deep and bitter.
entries.translation: Chuki kati yao ilikuwa kubwa na kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young man from one of the groups was walking through the forest when he came across a woman from the other group.
entries.translation: Siku moja, kijana mmoja kutoka kwa kikundi kimoja alikuwa akitembea msituni alipokutana na mwanamke kutoka kwa kikundi kingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young man took pity on her and helped her find her way home.
entries.translation: Kijana huyo alimhurumia na akamsaidia kupata njia yake ya kurudi nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they traveled together, they began to talk and learn about each other.
entries.translation: Waliposafiri pamoja, walianza kuzungumza na kujuana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They realized that they were not so different after all.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They fell in love, and their love helped to bridge the gap between their two groups.
entries.translation: Walipendana, na upendo wao ulisaidia kuziba pengo kati ya makundi hayo mawili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young man and woman's love story was a powerful example of how love can overcome hate.
entries.translation: Hadithi ya upendo ya kijana na msichana hiyo ilikuwa mfano mzuri wa jinsi upendo unaweza kushinda chuki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It showed that even the most bitter enemies can learn to love and respect each other.
entries.translation: Ilionyesha kwamba hata maadui wabaya zaidi wanaweza kujifunza kupendana na kuheshimiana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Before the invention of the light bulb, people used candles and oil lamps to light their homes.
entries.translation: Kabla ya uvumbuzi wa balbu, watu walikuwa wanatumia mishumaa na taa za mafuta kuwasha mwangaza majumbani mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sources of light were not very efficient and they often produced a lot of smoke.
entries.translation: Vyanzo hivi vya mwangaza havikiwa na ufanisi sana na mara nyingi vilitoa moshi nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The invention of the light bulb changed everything.
entries.translation: Uvumbuzi wa balbu ulibadilisha kila kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allowed people to have more light at night and it also made it possible to work and play in the dark.
entries.translation: Iliruhusu watu kuwa na mwangaza zaidi usiku na ikawezesha kufanya kazi na kucheza gizani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to save electricity is to turn off lights when you leave a room.
entries.translation: Njia moja ya kuokoa umeme ni kuzima balbu unapoondoka chumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to save electricity is to use energy-efficient light bulbs.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kuokoa nishati ni kutumia balbu zisizotumia nishati nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Energy-efficient light bulbs use less electricity than regular light bulbs and they last longer.
entries.translation: Balbu zisizotumia nishati nyingi hutumia nishati kidogo kuliko balbu za kawaida na hudumu kwa muda mrefu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children can help save electricity by turning off lights when they leave a room and by unplugging appliances when they are not in use.
entries.translation: Watoto wanaweza pia kusaidia kuokoa nishati kwa kuzima balbu wanapoondoka chumbani na kwa kuchomoa vifaa vya umeme wakati havitumiwi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also help by being aware of the amount of electricity they use.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kusaidia kwa kufahamu kiasi cha umeme ambacho wanatumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Saving electricity is important because it helps to reduce our carbon footprint.
entries.translation: Kuokoa nishati ni muhimu kwa sababu husaidia kupunguza utoaji wa kaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we use less electricity, we produce less greenhouse gases.
entries.translation: Tunapotumia umeme ndogo, tunatoa gesi chafu kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Greenhouse gases are one of the main causes of climate change.
entries.translation: Gesi chafu ni mojawapo ya sababu kuu za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By saving electricity, we can help to protect the environment and we can also save money.
entries.translation: Kwa kuokoa nishati, tunaweza kusaidia kulinda mazingira na pia tunaweza kupunguza gharama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegal's history is long and complex, dating back to the Stone Age.
entries.translation: Historia ya Senegal ni ndefu na changamano, ikiturudisha nyuma katika enzi ya kutumia vifaa vya mawe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The area was first inhabited by the Serer people, who established a number of kingdoms in the region.
entries.translation: Eneo hilo kwanza lilikuwa na wakaaji wa Serer, ambao walianzisha flame kadhaa katika eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 15th century, the Portuguese arrived in Senegal and established trading posts along the coast.
entries.translation: Katika Karne ya 15, Wareno walifika Senegal na wakanzisha vituo vya biashara kwenye ufuo wa bahari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The French arrived in the 17th century and began to colonize the region.
entries.translation: Wafaransa walifika katika Karne ya 17 na wakaanza kutawala eneo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegal became a French colony in 1895.
entries.translation: Senegal ikawa koloni ya Ufaransa mwaka wa 1895.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 20th century, Senegal was a major center of the African independence movement.
entries.translation: Mapema katika karne ya 20, Senegal ilikuwa kituo kikuu cha harakati za kupigania uhuru wa Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Léopold Sédar Senghor, a poet and politician, was one of the leaders of the movement.
entries.translation: Léopold Sédar Senghor, mtunga shairi mwanasiasa, alikuwa mmoja wa viongozi wa harakati hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegal gained independence from France in 1960.
entries.translation: Senegal ilipata uhuru wao kutoka Ufaransa mwaka wa 1960.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since independence, Senegal has been a stable and democratic country.
entries.translation: Yangu kupata uhuru, Senegal imekuwa nchi iliyostawi na ya kidemokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has been ruled by a series of democratically elected presidents.
entries.translation: Imekuwa ikitawaliwa na msururu wa Marais waliochaguliwa kidemokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegal is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation.
entries.translation: Senegal ni mwanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa, Umoja wa Afrika, na Shirika la Ushirikiano wa Waislamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Senegal is a diverse country with a rich culture.
entries.translation: Senegal ni nchi yenye watu tofauti na tamaduni nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The population is made up of a variety of ethnic groups, including the Wolof, Serer, Diola, Mandinka, and Fula.
entries.translation: Idadi ya watu ina makabila tofauti, yakiwemo Wolof, Serer, Diola, Mandinka, na Fula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The official language of Senegal is French, but Wolof is the most widely spoken language.
entries.translation: Lugha rasmi ya Senegal ni Kifaransa, lakini Wolof nido lugha inayozungumzwa zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Peer pressure is a significant issue that can have a major impact on a person's life.
entries.translation: Msongo wa marika ni suala kubwa mbalo linaweza kuwa na athari kuwbwa kwa maisha ya mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be defined as the influence that a group of people has on an individual to conform to their norms and values.
entries.translation: Unaweza kufafanuliwa kama ushawishi ambao kundi la watu linalo kwa mtu binafsi kufuata kanuni na maadili yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Peer pressure can be both positive and negative, but it is often seen as a negative force that can lead people to make poor choices.
entries.translation: Msongo wa marika unaweza kuwa mzuri au mbaya, lakini mara nyingi huonekana kama nguvu hasi inayoweza kusababisha watu kufanya maamuzi mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways that peer pressure can manifest itself.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti ambazo msongo wa marika unaweza kujidhihirisha yenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One common form is through direct pressure, such as when a group of friends tries to convince someone to do something they do not want to do.
entries.translation: Njia moja ya kawaida ni kupitia shinikizo la moja kwa moja, kama vile wakati ambapo kikundi cha marafiki kinajaribu kumshawishi mtu kufanya jambo ambalo hataki kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another form of peer pressure is indirect pressure, which can occur when a person feels like they need to do something in order to fit in with a group.
entries.translation: Aina nyhingine ya msongo wa marika ni shinikizo lisilo la moja kwa moja, ambalo linaweza kufanyika wakati mtu anahisi kuwa anahitaji kufanya jambo fulani ili kuingiliana na kikundi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be especially damaging when it comes to issues such as drug use or sexual activity.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa na madhara hasa inapohusu suala la matumizi ya dawa za kulevya au shughuli za ngono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The intensity of peer pressure can vary depending on the situation.
entries.translation: Ukali wa msongo wa marika unaweza kutofautiana kulingana na kila hali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, someone who is trying to fit in with a new group of friends may feel more pressure to conform than someone who is already well-established in a group.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, mtu anayejaribu kuingiliana na kikundi kipya cha marafiki anaweza kuhisi shinikizo zaidi ya kubalika kuliko mtu ambaye amejiimarisha kabisa katika kikundi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The intensity of peer pressure can also depend on the individual's personality and self-esteem.
entries.translation: Ukali wa msongo wa marika unaweza pia kutegemea utu wa mtu binafsi na kujiamini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People who are more confident and assertive are less likely to be swayed by peer pressure than those who are more insecure.
entries.translation: Watu wanaojiamini zaidi na wanaojitetea wana uwezekano mdogo wa kushawishiwa na msongo wa marika kuliko wale ambao hawajiamini zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fishing is a great way to spend time outdoors and enjoy nature.
entries.translation: Uvuvi ni njia nzuri ya kutumia wakati nje na kufurahia mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also a great way to learn about the different types of fish that live in your area.
entries.translation: Pia ni njia nzuri ya kujifunza kuhusu aina tofauti za samaki wanaoishi katika eneo lako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When fishing, it's important to be responsible and follow all the local regulations.
entries.translation: Wakati unafanya uvuvi, ni muhimu kuwajibika na kufuata kanuni zote za eneo lako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means making sure you have a valid fishing license, and that you're fishing in the right areas.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuhakikisha kuwa una leseni halali ua uvuvi, na kwamba unavua katika maeneo sahihi.

entries.english: It also means releasing any fish that you catch that are too small or that you don't want to eat.

entries.english: These droughts have caused widespread hunger, poverty, and displacement.
entries.translation: Ukame huu umesababisha njaa, umaskini, na watu wengi kuhama kwenye makazi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must act now to address this crisis."
entries.translation: Ni lazima tuchukue hatua sasa ili kukabiliana na tatizo hili."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's words were met with a round of applause.
entries.translation: Maneno ya mwanamke huyo yaliambatana na makofi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been invited to speak at a conference on climate change, and she had used her platform to raise awareness of the devastating impact of droughts.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amealikuwa kuzungumza kwenye mkutano kuhusu mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, na alitumia jukwaa lake kuongeza ufahamu kuhusu athari mbaya za ukame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She called on governments and businesses to take action to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and mitigate the effects of climate change.
entries.translation: Alitoa wito kwa serikali na wafanyabiashara kuchukua hatua ili kupunguza uzalishaji wa gesi zinazoongeza joto duniani na kupunguza athari za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also urged individuals to make changes in their own lives, such as reducing their energy consumption and recycling.
entries.translation: Pia aliwataka batu binafsi kufanya mabadiliko katika maisha yao, kama vile kupunguza matumizi yao ya nishati na kutengeneza tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman's speech was a powerful reminder of the urgent need to address climate change.
entries.translation: Hotuba ya mwanamke huyo ilikuwa ukumbusho mzuri wa hitaji la dharura la kushughulikia mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts are just one of the many impacts of climate change that we are already seeing, and they are only going to get worse if we do not take action.
entries.translation: Ukame ni moja tu athari nyingi za mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ambayo tayari tunaziona, na zitakuwa mbaya zaidi ikiwa hatutachukua hatua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must all work together to create a more sustainable future for our planet.
entries.translation: Ni lazima tufanye kazi pamoja ili tuunde mustakabali endelevu zaidi wa sayari yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "The news is a vital part of our lives, keeping us informed about the world around us.
entries.translation: "Habari ni sehemu muhimu katika maisha yetu, kutufahamisha kuhusu ulimwengu unaotuzunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But with so many different sources of news available, it can be difficult to know where to start.
entries.translation: Lakini kwa kuwa kuna vyanzo vingi tofauti vya habari, inaweza kuwa vigumu kujua pa kuanzia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a few different ways to get your news.
entries.translation: Kuna njia tofauti za kupata habari zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can read newspapers, watch the news on TV, or listen to the radio.
entries.translation: Unaweza kusoma magazetu, kutazama habari kwenye televisheni, au kusikiliza redio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also get your news online from websites or apps.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kupata habari zako mtandaoni kutoka kwenye tovuti na programu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each of these sources of news has its own advantages and disadvantages.
entries.translation: Kila moja ya vyanzo hivi vya habari vina manufaa na hasara zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers offer in-depth coverage of stories, but they can be slow to report on breaking news.
entries.translation: Magazeti hutoa habari za kina, lakini zinaweza kuchelewa kuripoti habari za hivi punde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: TV news is more immediate, but it can be superficial.
entries.translation: Habari za televisheni ni za haraka zaidi, lakini zinaweza kuwa za juujuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Radio news is often a good option for catching up on the day's events, but it can be difficult to find a station that covers the news you're interested in.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi redio ni chaguo nzuri ya kupata habari kuhusu matukio ya siku hiyo, lakini inaweza kuwa vigumu kupata kituo ambacho kupata kituo ambacho kinatangaza habari zinazokuvutia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Online news sources offer a wide range of content, but it can be difficult to find reliable sources.
entries.translation: Vyanzo vya habari vya mtandaoni hutoa maudhui mbalimbali, lakini inaweza kuwa vigumu kupata vyanzo vinavyoaminika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to get your news is to use a variety of sources and to be critical of the information you're consuming.
entries.translation: Njia bora ya kupata habari zako ni kutumia vyanzo mbalimbali na kuwa mkosoaji wa habari unazosikiliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ask yourself who is providing the information, what their biases are, and whether the information is accurate.
entries.translation: Jiulize ni nani anayetoa taarifa hizo, upendeleo wake ni upi, na iwapo taarifa hizo ni sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Ella who was very sick.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na msichana anayeitwa Ella ambaye alikuwa mgojwa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been to the doctor many times, but they couldn't figure out what was wrong with her.
entries.translation: Alitembelea daktari mara nyingi, lakini hakuweza kujua kile ambacho kilikuwa kinamsumbua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ella's parents were very worried about her.
entries.translation: Wazazi wa Ella walikuwa na wasiwasi sana kumhusu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ella's mother took her to a health fair.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mamake Ella alimpeleka kwenye maonyesho kuhusu afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were many different booths set up, each one with information about a different health topic.
entries.translation: Kulikuwa na vibanda vingi sana vilivyowekwa, kila moja kikiwa na taarifa kuhusu mada tofauti ya afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ella and her mother visited each booth, and Ella learned a lot about healthy eating, exercise, and staying safe.
entries.translation: Ella na mama yake walitembelea kila kibanda, na Ella akajifunza mengi kuhusu kula lishe ya afya, kufanya mazoezi, na kuwa salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ella also met a doctor at the fair who was very interested in her case.
entries.translation: Ella pia alikutana na daktari katika maonyesho hayo ambaye alipendezwa sana na kesi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He asked her a lot of questions about her symptoms, and he did some tests.
entries.translation: Alimuuliza maswali mengi kuhusu dalili zake, na akafanya vipimo kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few days, the doctor finally figured out what was wrong with Ella.
entries.translation: Baada ya siku chache, hatimaye daktari huyo alitambua tatizo la Ella.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her that she had a vitamin deficiency, and he prescribed her some vitamins to take.
entries.translation: Alimwambia kuwa alikuwa na upungufu wa vitamini, na akampa maagizo ya kutumia vitamini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ella started taking the vitamins, and she started to feel better right away.
entries.translation: Ella alianza kutumia vitamini, na akaanza kupata nafuu mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was able to eat more food, and she had more energy.
entries.translation: Aliweza kula chakula zaidi, na alikuwa na nguvu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was so happy that she had gone to the health fair, and she was grateful to the doctor for helping her get better.
entries.translation: Alifurahi sana kwamba alikuwa ameenda kwenye maonyesho hayo kuhusu afya, na alimshukuru daktari kwa ajili ya kumsaidia kupata nafuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ella's story is a reminder of the importance of health education.
entries.translation: Hadithi ya Ella ni ukumbusho wa umuhimu wa elimu ya afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food and wine festivals and tasting events are a popular way to enjoy food and wine.
entries.translation: Sherehe za chakula na divai na hafla za kuonja ni njia maarufu ya kufurahia chakula na divai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are often held in conjunction with other events, such as music festivals or art fairs.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi hufanyika pamoja na matukio mengine, kama vile tamasha za muziki au maonyesho ya sanaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food and wine festivals and tasting events can be found in all parts of the world, and they typically take place during the summer months.
entries.translation: Sherehe za chakula na divai na hafla za kuonja zinaweza kupatikana katika sehemu zote za dunua, na kwa kawaida hufanyika katika miezi ya majira ya joto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular food and wine festivals include the Napa Valley Wine Festival in California, the Sonoma County Harvest Festival in California, and the New York City Wine and Food Festival.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya sherehe maarufu za chakula na divai zinajumuisha Sherehe ya Divai la Napa Valley huko California, Sherehe ya Mavuno la Kaunti ya Sonoma huko Carlifornia, na Sherehe ya Divai na Chakula ya Jiji la New York.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food and wine festivals and tasting events offer a variety of experiences for attendees.
entries.translation: Sherehe za chakula na divai na hafla za kuonja hutoa uzoefu tofauti kwa waliohudhuria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can sample a wide range of wines and foods, learn about the culinary arts, and meet with winemakers and chefs.
entries.translation: Wanaweza kuonja aina mbalimbali za divai na vyakula, kujifunza kuhusu sanaa za upishi, na kukutana na watengenezaji divai na wapishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many food and wine festivals also feature live music and other entertainment.
entries.translation: Sherehe nyingi za chakula na divai pia huwa na muziki wa moja kwa moja na burudani zingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are planning to attend a food and wine festival, it is important to do some research in advance.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unapanga kuhudhuria sherehe ya chakula na divao, ni muhimu kufanya utafiti mapema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help you to choose the right festival for your interests and budget.
entries.translation: Hii itakusaidia kuchagua sherehe sahihi kulingana na mapendeleo na bajeti yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure to book your transportation and accommodations in advance, as these can become scarce during peak festival season.
entries.translation: Unapaswa pia kuhakikishwa kuwa umeweka nafasi ya usafiri na malazi mapema, kwani zinaweza kuwa chache wakati wa msimu wa kilele wa tamasha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food and wine festivals and tasting events can be a great way to enjoy food, wine, and culture.
entries.translation: Sherehe za chakula na divai na hafla za kuonja zinaweza kuwa njia nzuri ya kufurahia chakula, divai, na tamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a fun and festive way to spend a day or weekend.
entries.translation: Ni njia ya kufurahisha ya kutumia siku na wikendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mother is a fantastic cook.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has been cooking for our family for as long as I can remember, and her food is always delicious.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akiipikia familia yetu kadri niwezavyo kukumbuka, na chakula chake huwa kitamu kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is always experimenting with new recipes and techniques, and she is always willing to share her knowledge with others.
entries.translation: Huwa anajaribu mapishi na mbinu mpya kila wakati, yuko tayari kushiriki maarifa yake na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the things that makes my mother's cooking so special is the fact that she uses fresh, high-quality ingredients.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo yanayofanya upishi wa mama yangu uwe wa kipekee sana ni ukweli kwamba anatumia viambato vibichi na vya hali ya juu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She never uses processed or pre-packaged foods, and she always takes the time to cook her food properly.
entries.translation: Hatumii kamwe vyakula vilivyochakatwa na vilivyopakiwa mapema, na huchukua muda kupika chakula chake ipasavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This attention to detail results in dishes that are full of flavor and nutrients.
entries.translation: Uangalifu wake wa mambo madogo madogo husababisha apike vyakula ambavyo vimejaa ladha na virutubisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another thing that sets my mother's cooking apart is her ability to create dishes that appeal to everyone.
entries.translation: Jambo lingine ambalo hufanya upishi wa mama yangu kuwa tofauti ni uwezo wake wa kupika vyakula ambavyo vinavutia kila mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is always willing to accommodate different dietary restrictions, and she is always willing to experiment with new flavors.
entries.translation: Kila wakati yuko tayari kushughulikia vizuizi tofauti vya lishe, na yuko tayari kujaribu ladha mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes her a great cook for large families or groups of people with different tastes.
entries.translation: Hii inamfanya awe mpishi mzuri wa familia kubwa au vikundi vya watu walio na ladha tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mother's cooking is also a great way to bring people together.
entries.translation: Upishi wa mama yangu ni njia nzuri ya kuwaleta watu pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When she cooks for us, it is a time for us to relax and enjoy each other's company.
entries.translation: Anapotupikia, huwa ni wakati wetu wa kupumzika na kufurahia kuwa pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talk about our day, laugh, and share stories.
entries.translation: Huwa tunazungumza kuhusu siku yetu, kucheka na kushiriki hadithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are some of my fondest memories, and I am grateful to my mother for creating them.
entries.translation: Hizi ni baadhi ya kumbukumbu zangu nzuri, na ninamshukuru mama yangu kwa kuziumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son, have you heard of artificial intelligence?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a type of computer program that can learn and think for itself.
entries.translation: Ni aina ya programu ya kompyuta inayoweza kujifunza na kujifikiria yenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's still in its early stages, but it has the potential to revolutionize many industries.
entries.translation: Bado iko katika hatua zake za mwanzo, lina ina uwezo wa kuleta mapinduzi katika tasnia nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, artificial intelligence is already being used to develop self-driving cars, medical diagnosis tools, and even customer service chatbots.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, akili bandia tayari inatumika kutengeneza magari yanayojiendesha yenyewe, zana za utambuzi wa kimatibabu, na hata mazungumzo ya huduma kwa wateja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important components of artificial intelligence is machine learning.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu vya akili bandia ni mafunzo ya mashine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn without being explicitly programmed.
entries.translation: Mafunzo ya mashine ni aina ya akili bandia ambayo huruhusu kompyuta kujifunza bila kupangwa kwa njia dhahiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Machine learning algorithms are able to identify patterns in data and make predictions based on those patterns.
entries.translation: Kanuni za mafunzo ya mashine zinaweza kutambua ruwaza katika data na kufanya ubashiri kulingana na ruwaza hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them ideal for tasks like spam filtering, fraud detection, and image recognition.
entries.translation: Hii inazifanya kuwa bora kwa kazi kama vile kuchuja barua taka, kutambua ulaghai, na kutambua taswira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As artificial intelligence continues to develop, it will have a major impact on our lives.

entries.english: The other birds were all different colors, and they were very curious about the newly-hatched bird.

entries.english: Drunk driving is a serious problem that affects people from all walks of life.

entries.english: It is estimated that over 10,000 people are killed in drunk driving accidents each year in the United States alone.

entries.english: The effects of drunk driving are far-reaching and devastating, not only for the individual who is killed or injured, but also for their families and friends.

entries.english: In addition to the human toll, drunk driving also has a significant economic impact.

entries.english: Despite the clear dangers of drunk driving, it continues to be a problem.

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to address the problem of drunk driving.

entries.english: These include stricter enforcement of drunk driving laws, public awareness campaigns, and education programs.

entries.english: This is a phrase that has been used for centuries to describe the importance of having someone to rely on when times are tough.

entries.english: A true friend is someone who is there for you through thick and thin, no matter what.

entries.english: They are someone who you can trust with your secrets and who will always be there to support you.

entries.english: They may offer emotional support, financial assistance, or practical help.

entries.english: They may simply be there to listen to you vent or to offer a shoulder to cry on.

entries.english: No matter what you are going through, a true friend will be there for you.

entries.english: The extent to which a friend will help you in need can vary depending on the situation.

entries.english: In the past, sending a message meant waiting for a letter to arrive by snail mail, or hoping that your recipient would be available to answer their phone.

entries.english: Today, we can send messages instantaneously, regardless of time or location.

entries.english: This has had a profound impact on our lives, making it easier to stay in touch with friends and family, conduct business, and access information.

entries.english: However, the speed and convenience of digital messaging has also come with some challenges.
