entries.translation: Mojawapo ya masuala muhimu ni suala la faragha ya data.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more and more of our personal information is transmitted online, it is becoming increasingly important to protect ourselves from identity theft and other cybercrimes.
entries.translation: Kadri taarifa zetu nyingi za kibinafsi zinavyosambazwa mtandaoni, inazidi kuwa muhimu kujilinda kutokana na wizi wa utambulisho na uhalifu mwingine wa mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge is the problem of spam.
entries.translation: Changamoto nyingine ni tatizo la barua taka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unwanted messages, often containing malicious software or fraudulent links, can be a nuisance and even a danger to our devices and our data.
entries.translation: Ujumbe usiotakikana, ambao mara nyingi huwa na programu hasidi na viungo vya ulaghai, unaweza kuwa kero au hata hatari kwa vifaa na data yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, digital messaging remains an essential part of our lives.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizi, utumaji ujumbe wa kidijitali unaendelea kuwa sehemu muhimu katika maisha yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a powerful tool that we can use to connect with others, learn new things, and make our lives more convenient.
entries.translation: Ni zana nzuri ambayo tunaweza kutumia ili kuungana na wengine, kujifunza mambo mapya, na kufanya maisha yetu kuwa rahisi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I grew up in a small town in the middle of nowhere.
entries.translation: Nililelewa katika mji mdogo katikati ya mahali pasipojulikana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The town was so small that everyone knew everyone else, and there was nothing to do but go to school, play sports, and hang out with friends.
entries.translation: Mji huo ulikuwa mdogo sana hivi kwamba kila mtu alifahamu kila mtu mwingine, na hakukuwa na la kufanya ila kwenda shuleni, kucheza michezo, na kuwa pamoja na marafiki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, when I was in high school, a new family moved to town.
entries.translation: Siku moja, nilipokuwa katika shule ya upili, familia mpya ilihamia mjini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had two kids, a boy and a girl, who were about my age.
entries.translation: Walikuwa na watoto wawili, na kiume na kike, ambao walikuwa na rika langu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's name was David, and the girl's name was Sarah.
entries.translation: Jina la mvulana huyo lilikuwa David, na jina la msichana lilikuwa Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: David and Sarah were very different from me.
entries.translation: David na Sarah walikuwa tofauti sana na mimi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were both from big cities, and they had a lot more money than I did.
entries.translation: Wote walikuwa wanatoka katika miji mikubwa, na walikuwa na pesa nyingi kuniliko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also had a lot more experience with things like drugs and alcohol.
entries.translation: Pia walikuwa na uzoefi zaidi wa mambo kama vile dawa za kulevya na pombe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, I was a little intimidated by David and Sarah.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni, David na Sarah walinitishia kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they were actually really nice, and we quickly became friends.
entries.translation: Lakini kwa kweli walikuwa wazuri sana, na tukawa marafiki haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We started hanging out all the time, and we did everything together.
entries.translation: Tulianza kubarizi kila wakati, na tulifanya kila kitu pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, David and Sarah invited me to a party.
entries.translation: Siku moja, David na Sarah walinialika kwenye sherehe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had never been to a party before, so I was really excited.
entries.translation: Sikuwa nimewahi kwenda kwenye sherehe hapo awali, kwa hivyo nilifurahi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But when I got there, I realized that it wasn't like any party I had ever seen before.
entries.translation: Lakini nilipofika huko, niligundua kwamba haikuwa sherehe ambayo nimewahi kuona hapo awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were people everywhere, and they were all doing drugs and drinking alcohol.
entries.translation: Kulikuwa na watu kila mahali, na wote walikuwa wakitumia dawa za kulevya na kunywa kileo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm so glad I could help you," said the African American woman.
entries.translation: "Nimefurahi sana kuwa ningeweza kukusaidia," mwanamke huyo Mmarekani mwenye asili ya Kiafrika alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know how hard it is to be a single mother, especially when you're struggling to make ends meet.
entries.translation: "Ninafahamu jinsi ilivyo ngumu kuwa mama asiye na mume, hasa wakati unatatizika kupata riziki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But you're doing a great job, and I'm proud of you."
entries.translation: Lakini unafanya kazi nzuri, na ninajivunia kwa ajili yako."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It means a lot to me to hear that. I'm just trying to do what's best for my children."
entries.translation: "Inamaana sana kwangu kusikia hivyo. Ninajaribu tu kufanya kile ambacho ni bora kwa ajili ya watoto wangu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're doing a great job," the woman repeated.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "And I'm here to help if you need anything. Just ask."
entries.translation: "Na niko hapa kukusaidia ikiwa unahitaji chochoye. Uliza tu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you," the young woman said again. "I really appreciate it."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The two women chatted for a few more minutes, and then the young woman left.
entries.translation: Wanamke hao wawili walizungumza kwa dakika chache zaidi, kisha mwanamke huyo akaondoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The African American woman watched her go, and then she turned and went back into her own home.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo Mmarekani mwenye asili ya Kiafrika alimtazama akiondoka, na kisha akageuka na kurudi nyumbani kwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As she walked through her house, she thought about the young woman and her children.
entries.translation: Alipokuwa akitembea akielekea nyumbani kwake, alifikiria kuhusu mwanamke huyo na watoto wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that they were struggling, but she also knew that they were strong and resilient.
entries.translation: Alifahamu kwamba walikuwa wakikumbana na matatizo, lakini pia alifahamu kwamba walikuwa na nguvu na ni wastahimilivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was proud of them for their determination, and she was glad that she could be there to help them.
entries.translation: Alijivunia kwa ajili ya kwa azimio lao, na alifurahi kwamba angeweza kuwa hapo kuwasaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: National integration is the process by which a country's different regions, cultures, and peoples are brought together into a single, unified nation.
entries.translation: Ushirikiano wa kitaifa ni mchakato ambapo mikoa, tamaduni na watu mbalimbali wa nchi huletwa pamoja na kuwa taifa moja lenye umoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a complex and often challenging process, but it is essential for the long-term stability and prosperity of any country.
entries.translation: Ni mchakato mgumu na wenye changamoto nyingi, lakini ni muhimu kwa uthabiti na usitawi kwa muda mrefu wa nchi yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors that can contribute to national integration, including common language, religion, history, and culture.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi yanayoweza kuchangia kwa ushirikiano wa kitaifa, ikiwemo lugha ya kawaida, dini, historia, na utamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, no single factor is essential, and national integration can be achieved even in countries with significant diversity.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, hakuna sababu moja muhimu, na ushirikiano wa kitaifa unaweza kupatikana hata katika nchi zilizo na tofauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in national integration is a strong sense of national identity.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi katika ushirikiano wa kitaifa ni hisia kali ya utambulisho wa kitaifa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be fostered through shared symbols, such as a flag or anthem, and through common experiences, such as military service or participation in national sports teams.
entries.translation: Hii pia inaweza kuendelezwa kupitia ishara zinazoshirikiwa, kama vile bendera au wimbo wa taifa, na kupitia matukio ya kawaida, kama vile huduma ya kijeshi au kushiriki katika timu za kitaifa za michezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important factor is a commitment to democratic values, such as freedom of speech and assembly.
entries.translation: Jambo lingine muhimu ni kujitolea kwa maadili ya kidemokrasia, kama vile uhuru wa kuzungumza na kukutanika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These values allow for the open expression of different views and help to create a sense of belonging among citizens.
entries.translation: Maadili haya huruhusu kuzungumza wazi kuhusu mitazamo tofauti na kusaidia kuunda hisia ya kuwa sehemu ya jamii miongoni mwa wananchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are also limitations to national integration.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, pia kuna vizuizi katika ushirikiano wa kifaifa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, it can be difficult to overcome deep-seated prejudices and discrimination.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, inaweza kuwa vigumu kuondokana na chuki na ubaguzi mkali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, national integration can be threatened by external factors, such as war or economic crisis.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, ushirikiano wa kitaifa unaweza kutishiwa na mambo ya nje, kama vile vita au matatizo ya kiuchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hey dude, have you heard about environmentalism?
entries.translation: Hujambo, umesikia kuhusu ulinzi wa mazingira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's all about protecting the environment and making sure we don't do anything to hurt it.
entries.translation: Ni kuhusu ulinzi wa mazingira na kuhakikisha kwamba hatufanyi chochote kuyadhuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You know, like recycling, using less energy, and driving less.
entries.translation: Unajua, kama vile kutengeneza upya, kutumia nishati kidogo, na kuendesha gari mara chache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That sounds like a good idea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, we need to take care of our planet, right?
entries.translation: Namaanisha, tunahitaji kutunza sasyari yetu, sivyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And there are a lot of easy things we can do to make a difference.
entries.translation: Na kuna mambo mengi rahisi ambayo unaweza kufanya ili kuleta mabadiliko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Well, we can start by recycling more.
entries.translation: Kweli, tunaweza kuanza kwa kutengeneza upya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so easy to do, and it makes a big difference.
entries.translation: Ni rahisi sana kufanya, na inaleta tofauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also turn off lights when we leave a room, and unplug appliances when we're not using them.
entries.translation: Tunaweza pia kuzima taa tunapoondoka chumbani, na kuchomoa vifaa vyote wakati hatuvitumii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And we can walk or bike instead of driving whenever possible.
entries.translation: Na tunaweza kutembea au kuendesha baiskeli badala ya kuendesha gari wakati wowote inawezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start doing them right away.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elections are a vital part of democracy.
entries.translation: Uchaguzi ni sehemu muhimu sana ya demokrasia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They allow citizens to choose their leaders and have a say in how their country is run.
entries.translation: Huruhusu wananchi kuchagua viongozi wao na kuwa na usemi wa jinsi nchi yao inavyoendeshwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are many challenges to holding fair and transparent elections.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna changamoto nyingi za kufanya uchaguzi wa haki na wenye uwazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One challenge is voter suppression, which can take many forms, such as voter ID laws, gerrymandering, and intimidation.
entries.translation: Changamoto moja ni ukandamizaji wa wapigakura, ambao unaweza kuwa wa aina nyingi, kama vile sheria za vitambulisho vya wapiga kura, kufanya hila katika uchaguzi, na vitisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge is misinformation, which can be used to spread false information about candidates or to discourage people from voting.
entries.translation: Changamoto nyingine ni taarifa isiyofaa, ambayo inaweza kutumika kueneza taarifa isiyofaa kuhusu wagombeaji au kuwakatisha tamaa wapiga kura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to combat these challenges is to make sure that elections are transparent.
entries.translation: Njia moja ya kukabiliana na changamoto hizi ni kuhakikishwa kuwa uchaguzi unafanywa kwa uwazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the process of voting should be open to scrutiny, and there should be mechanisms in place to check for fraud.
entries.translation: Hii ina maana kwamba mchakato wa upigaji kura unapaswa kuwa wazi kufanyiwa uchunguzi, na kuwe na mbinu za kukagua kama kuna ulaghai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also means that the results of elections should be made public quickly and accurately.
entries.translation: Pia ina maana kwamba matokeo ya uchaguzi yanapaswa kuwekwa hadharani kwa haraka na kwa usahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to combat these challenges is to increase voter participation.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kukambiliana na changamoto hiizi ni kuongeza ushiriki wa wapigakura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by making it easier to register to vote, providing transportation to polling places, and holding elections on weekends.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanywa kwa kurahisisha usajili wa kupiga kura, kutoa usafiri hadi maeneo ya kupiga kura, na kufanya uchaguzi wikendi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to educate voters about the importance of their vote and how to cast it.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kuwaelimisha wapiga kura kuhusu umuhimu wa kura zao na jinsi ya kuipiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By addressing these challenges, we can make sure that elections are fair and transparent, and that all citizens have a voice in their government.
entries.translation: Kwa kukabiliana na changamoto hizi, tunaweza kuhakikisha kuwa uchaguzi ni wa haki na wenye uwazi, na kwamba wananchi wote wana sauti katika serikali yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have you ever been to a farm or ranch?
entries.translation: Je, umewahi kwenda shambani au kwenye ranchi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I grew up on a small farm in the Midwest, and I have so many fond memories of working on the land with my family.
entries.translation: Nililelewa katika shamba dogo huko Mashariki ya Kati, na nina kumbukumbu nyingi za kupendeza za kufanya kazi kwenye shamba hilo pamoja na familia yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's nothing quite like the feeling of fresh air and sunshine on your face, the smell of the earth after a rain, and the sound of animals grazing in the field.
entries.translation: Hakuna kitu kinachofanana na hisia ya hewa safi na mwanga wa jua usoni mwako, harufu ya dunia baada ya mvua kunyesha, na sauti ya wanyama wakiwa malishoni shambani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite things to do on the farm was to help my dad milk the cows.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo niliyopenda kufanya shambani ilikuwa ni kumsaidia baba yangu kukamua ng'ombe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved the feeling of the warm milk in my hands, and I always thought it was amazing that we could get food from the cows just by milking them.
entries.translation: Nilipenda hisia ya maziwa yenye ujoto mikononi mwangu, na daima nilifikiri ilikuwa ya kushangaza kwamba tunaweza kupata chakula kutoka kwa ng'ombe kwa kukamua tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also loved playing with the barn cats and dogs, and I would often spend hours just watching the animals interact with each other.
entries.translation: Pia nilipenda kucheza na paka na mbwa, na mara nyingi nilitumia saa kadhaa kuwatazama wanyama wakiingiliana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farming is hard work, but it's also incredibly rewarding.
entries.translation: Kilimo ni kazi ngumu, lakini pia ni ya kuthawabisha sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I learned a lot about responsibility and hard work on the farm, and I'm grateful for the experiences I had.
entries.translation: Nilijifunza mengi kuhuhu uwajibikaji na kufanya kazi kwa bidii shambani, na ninashukuru kwa uzoefu niliopata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever get the chance to visit a farm or ranch, I highly recommend it.
entries.translation: Ukiwahi pata nafasi ya kutembelea shamba au ranchi, ninapendekeza sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day, and the streets of Baghdad were bustling with activity.
entries.translation: Ilikuwa siku yenye joto kali, na mitaa ya Baghdad ilikuwa na shughuli nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People were going about their daily business, haggling with merchants in the market, and visiting friends and family.
entries.translation: Watu walikuwa wakiendelea na shughuli zao za kila siku, wakijadiliana bei na wafanyabiashara sokoni, kuwatembelea marafiki na familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the midst of all this chaos, a young man named Ali was walking down the street.
entries.translation: Katikati ya shughuli hizi zote, kijana mmoja aitwaye Ali allikuwa akitembea mtaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was feeling lost and alone.
entries.translation: Alikuwa anahisi kwamba amepotea na mpweke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had just arrived in Baghdad from a small village, and he didn't know anyone.
entries.translation: Alikuwa amewasili tu Baghdad kutoka kwa kijiji kidogo, na hakuwa anamfahamu mtu yeyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As Ali walked, he saw a man standing in front of a shop.
entries.translation: Ali alipokuwa akitembea, aliona mtu akiwa amesimama mbele ya duka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man was talking to a group of people, and he was gesturing wildly with his hands.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo alikuwa akizungumza na kundi la watu, na alikuwa akionyesha ishara akitumia mikono yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali stopped to listen, and he heard the man telling a story.
entries.translation: Ali alisimama kusikiliza, na akasikia mwanaume huyo akisimulia hadithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man's story was about a clever animal who had outsmarted a group of bandits.
entries.translation: Hadithi ya mwanaume huyo ilihusu mnyama mwerevu ambaye alikuwa amewashinda majambazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali was captivated by the story, and he listened intently until the end.
entries.translation: Ali alivutiwa na hadithi hiyo, na akasikiliza kwa makini hadi mwisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the man was finished, Ali clapped his hands and said, "That was a wonderful story" The man smiled and said, "Thank you.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo alipomaliza, Ali alipiga makofi na kusema, "Hiyo ilikuwa hadithi nzuri sana." Mwanaume huyo alitabasamu na kusema, "Asante.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm glad you enjoyed it" Ali then asked the man if he could teach him how to tell stories.
entries.translation: Nimefurahi uliweza kuifurahia" kisha Ali akamuuliza mtu huyo kama angeweza kumfundisha jinsi ya kusimulia hadithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man agreed, and he spent the next few hours teaching Ali the basics of storytelling.
entries.translation: Mwanaume huyo alikubali, na alitumia saa chache kumfudisha Ali misingi ya kusimulia hadithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother's love is a special kind of love that is unconditional and everlasting.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama ni aina maalum na upendo ambao hauna masharti na wa milele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a love that is patient and kind, that never fails or gives up.
entries.translation: Ni upendo wenye ustahimilivu na fadhili, usioshindwa wala kukata tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A mother's love is a source of comfort and strength for her children, and it is a bond that can never be broken.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama ni chanzo cha faraja na nguvu kwa watoto wake, na ni muunganisho ambao hauwezi kutenganishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways that a mother shows her love for her children.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi tofauti ambazo mama huonyesha upendo kwa watoto wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She may hug them and kiss them, tell them she loves them, or simply be there for them when they need her.
entries.translation: Anaweza kuwakumbatia na kubusu, kuwaambia kuwa anawapenda, au tu kuwa pale kwa ajili yao wanapomhitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A mother's love is often expressed through her actions, and it is a love that her children can feel deep in their hearts.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama mara nyingi huonyeshwa kupitia vitendo vyake, na ni upendo ambao watoto wake wanaweza kuhisi ndani ya mioyo kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother's love is a precious gift that should be cherished.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama ni zawadi ya thamani ambayo inapaswa kuthaminiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a gift that can help children grow up to be happy and well-rounded adults.
entries.translation: Ni zawadi ambayo inaweza kusaidia watoto kukua na kuwa watu wazima wenye furaha na burasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A mother's love is a gift that lasts a lifetime.
entries.translation: Upendo wa mama ni zawadi inayodumu maishani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Balance is the ability to maintain equilibrium.
entries.translation: Usawaziko ni uwezo wa kudumisha ulinganifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is essential for all living things, as it allows them to stay upright and move without falling over.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kwa viumbe vyote vilivyo hai, kwani huwaruhusu kuwa wima na kusonga bila kuanguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Balance is also important for coordination and motor skills.
entries.translation: Usawaziko pia ni muhimu kwa ujuzi wa kuratibu na kutuma misuli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many ways to improve balance.
entries.translation: Kuna njia nyingi za kuboresha usawaziko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to exercise regularly.
entries.translation: Njia moja ni kufanya mazoezi mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Exercise helps to strengthen the muscles and joints that are involved in balance, and it also helps to improve coordination.
entries.translation: Mazoezi husaidia kuimarisha misuli na viungo ambavyo vinahusika katika usawaziko, na pia husaidia kuboresha uratibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to improve balance is to practice yoga or tai chi.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kuboresha usawaziko ni kufanya mazoezi ya yoga au tai chi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These exercises focus on body awareness and coordination, and they can help to improve balance in a gentle and effective way.
entries.translation: Mazoezi haya yanazingatia ufahamu na uratibu wa mwili, na yanaweza kusaidia kuboresha usawaziko kwa upole na ufanisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Balance is important for people of all ages.
entries.translation: Usawaziko ni muhimu kwa watu wa umri wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children need good balance in order to learn to walk and run.
entries.translation: Watoto wanahitaji usawaziko mzuri ili kujifunza kutembea na kukimbia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adults need good balance to avoid falls, which can be a serious health risk.
entries.translation: Watu wazima wanahitaji usawaziko mzuri ili kuepuka kuanguka, jambo ambalo linaweza kuwa hatari kubwa ya afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The elderly are especially at risk for falls, and balance exercises can help to reduce their risk.
entries.translation: Watu wazee wako katika hatari kubwa ya kuanguka, na mazoezi ya usawaziko yanaweza kusaidia kupunguza hatari yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to having good balance.
entries.translation: Kuna faida nyingi za kuwa na usawaziko mzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Improved balance can help to reduce the risk of falls, it can improve coordination and motor skills, and it can also help to prevent injuries.
entries.translation: Usawaziko ulioboreshwa unaweza kusaidia kupunguza hatari za kuanguka, unaweza kusaidia katika ujuzi wa kuratibu na kutumia misuli, na unaweza pia kusaidia kuzuia majeraha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want to improve your balance, there are many exercises and activities that you can do.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unataka kuboresha usawaziko wako, kuna mazoezi na shughuli nyingi ambazo unaweza kufanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor or a physical therapist to learn more about how to improve your balance.
entries.translation: Zungumza na daktari wako au mtaalamu wa kimwili ili ujifunze zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kuboresha usawaziko wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 20th century, agriculture was a major industry in the United States.
entries.translation: Mwanzoni mwa karne ya 20, kilimo kilikuwa tasnia kuu nchini Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers grew a variety of crops, including wheat, corn, and soybeans.
entries.translation: Wakulima walipanda mazao mbalimbali, yakiwemo ngano, mahindi na soya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also raised livestock, such as cattle, pigs, and chickens.
entries.translation: Pia walifuga mifugo, kama vile ng'ombe, nguruwe, na kuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dust bowl was a period of severe drought and dust storms that occurred in the Great Plains region of the United States during the 1930s.
entries.translation: Kipindi cha dhoruba ya vumbi kilikuwa kipindi cha ukame mkali na dhoruba za vumbi zilizotokea katika eneo la Great Plains huko nchini Marekani wakati wa miaka ya 1930.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought caused the soil to dry out and become loose.
entries.translation: Ukame huo ulisababisha udongo kukauka na kulegea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the wind blew, the dust would pick up and form large dust storms.
entries.translation: Upepo ulipovuma, vumbi lingeweza kushikana na kutengeneza dhoruba kubwa za vumbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These storms could be very destructive, and they could damage crops and homes.
entries.translation: Dhoruba hizi zinaweza kusababisha ukaribifu mkubwa, na zinaweza kuharibu mazao na nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many farmers in the dust bowl lost their farms because of the drought and the dust storms.
entries.translation: Wakulima wengi katika kipindi cha dhoruba ya vumbi walipoteza mashamba yao kwa sababu ya ukame na dhoruba hizo za vumbi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were forced to move to other parts of the country in search of work.
entries.translation: Walilazimika kuhamia maeneo mengine ya nchi ili kutafuta kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dust bowl was a devastating event that had a major impact on the lives of millions of people.
entries.translation: Kipindi hicho cha dhoruba ya vumbi kilikuwa mbaya ambacho kilikuwa na athari kubwa kwa maisha ya mamilioni ya watu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges of the dust bowl, many farmers continued to work hard to grow crops and raise livestock.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto za kipindi cha dhoruba ya vumbi, wakulima wengi waliendelea kufanya kazi kwa bidii kupanda mazao na kufuga mifugo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They often worked long hours in difficult conditions.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi walifanya kazi kwa muda mrefu katika mazingira magumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also had to deal with the challenges of pests and diseases.
entries.translation: Pia walilazimika kukabiliana na changamoto za wadudu na magonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges, many farmers were able to succeed in agriculture.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizo, wakulima wengi waliweza kufanikiwa katika kilimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Friend: I can't believe that something like this is happening in the 21st century.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Rafiki; Hata mimi. Inaonekana kama kila wakati kuna migogoro fulani inayoendelea mahali duniani. Inasikitisha sana.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Friend: It can be, but it's also a beautiful place. There are so many good people in the world who are working to make it a better place.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Sarah who loved to ride her bicycle.

entries.english: She would often go for long rides in the countryside, enjoying the fresh air and the freedom of being on her own.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi ilikuwa akienda safari ndefu katika maeneo ya mashambani, akifurahia hewa safi na uhuru wa kuwa pekeyake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Sarah was riding her bike when she saw a sign for a Samsung store.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been wanting a new bike for a while, so she decided to stop in and take a look.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akitaka baiskeli mpya kwa muda, kwa hivyo aliamua kusimama na kuangalia.

entries.english: Casteism is a social system in India in which people are divided into rigid social classes, called castes.

entries.english: If you're looking to create a bright and airy space, there are a few things you can do.
