entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, make sure the room is well-lit with natural light.
entries.translation: Kwanza, hakikisha kuwa chumba hicho kina mwangaza wa kutosha na asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't have a lot of natural light, you can use light fixtures to brighten up the space.
entries.translation: Ikiwa huna mwangaza kwa kutosha na asili, unaweza kutumia taa kuangaza nafasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also add mirrors to reflect light around the room.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kuongeza vioo ili kuakisi mwangaza kwenye chumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to create a bright and airy space is to choose light-colored finishes for your walls, floors, and furniture.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine ya kuunda nafasi angavu ni yenye hewa ni kuchagua rangi nyepesi kwenye ukuta, sakafu, na fanicha zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light colors will reflect light and make the room feel more open.
entries.translation: Rangi nyepesi zitaakizi mwangaza na kufanya kuhizi wazi zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, you can add plants to the space.
entries.translation: Mwishowe, unaweza kuongeza mimea kwenye nafasi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plants help to purify the air and can also add a touch of natural light.
entries.translation: Mimea husaidia kusafisha hewa na inaweza pia kuongeza mwangaza asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Music has always played an important role in religion, from the chanting of monks in ancient temples to the soaring hymns of modern gospel choirs.
entries.translation: Daima muziki umekuwa na jukumu muhimu katika dini, kuanzia matawa kuimba katika mahekalu ya kale hadi nyimbo zinazovuma za kwaya za kisasa za injili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to create a sense of community, to inspire devotion, and to bring people closer to God.
entries.translation: Unaweza kutumika kuunda hisia ya kuwa sehemu ya jamii, kuhamasisha kujitolea, na kuwaleta watu karibu na Mungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gospel music is a particularly powerful form of religious music, combining elements of blues, jazz, and spirituals to create a unique sound that is both uplifting and soulful.
entries.translation: Muziki wa injini ni aina ya muziki wa kidini yenye nguvu sana, ukichanganya vipengele vya blues, jazz, na kiroho ili kuunda sauti ya kipekee yenye kuinua na kutia moyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gospel music has its roots in the African-American church, and it has been used for centuries to spread the message of Christianity.
entries.translation: Muziki wa injili una mizizi yake katika kanisa la Wamerikani wenye asili ya Kiafrika, na umetumika kwa karne nyingi kueneza ujumbe wa Ukristo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, gospel music is enjoyed by people of all races and religions, and it continues to be a powerful force for good in the world.
entries.translation: Leo, muziki wa injili unafurahiwa na watu wa mbari a dini zote, na unaendela kuwa wenye nguvu kwa ajili ya mema duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking things about gospel music is its ability to bring people together.
entries.translation: Mojawapo wa mambo ya kushangaza zaidi kuhusu muziki na uwezo wa kuleta watu pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whether it's a small church congregation or a large stadium full of fans, gospel music has a way of creating a sense of community and fellowship.
entries.translation: Iwe ni kutaniko dogo la kanisa au uwanja mkubwa uliojaa mashabiki, muziki wa injili una njia ya kuunda hisia ya kuwa sehemu ya jamii na ushirika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because gospel music is not just about singing and dancing; it's about expressing one's faith and emotions.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu muziki wa injili hauhusu tu kuimba na kudensi; unahusu kueleza imani na hisia za mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When people come together to sing gospel music, they are not only sharing their love of music, they are also sharing their love of God.
entries.translation: Watu wanapokusanyika pamoja kuimba muziki wa injili, hawashiriki tu upendo wao wa muziki, wanashiriki pia upendo wao wa Mungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The air is thick with pollution from the fireworks that have been set off in celebration of the festival.
entries.translation: Hewa imechafuka kutokana na fataki ambazo zimewashwa katika kusherehekea tamasha hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets are littered with trash, and the noise from the music and the crowds is deafening.
entries.translation: Barabara zimejaa takataka, na kelele za muziki na umati unatoa sauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People are packed in tightly, and it is difficult to move around.
entries.translation: Watu wamejaa sana, ni vigumu kuzunguka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pollution is making it hard to breathe, and the noise is making it hard to think.
entries.translation: Uchafuzi huo unafanya iwe vigumu kupumua, na kelele hizo zinafaya iwe vigumu kufikiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People are starting to get irritable and impatient.
entries.translation: Watu wanaanza kuwa na hasira na kukosa subira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are all looking forward to the end of the festival so that they can go home and get some peace and quiet.
entries.translation: Wote wanatazamia tamasha kuisha ili waweze kurudi nyumbani na kupata amani na utulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa.
entries.translation: Ivory Coast ni nchi iliyoko Afrika Magharibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by Liberia to the west, Guinea to the northwest, Mali to the northeast, Burkina Faso to the east, and Ghana to the southeast.
entries.translation: Imepakana na Liberia upande wa magharibi, Guinea upande wa kaskazini-magharibi, Mali upande wa kaskazini-mashariki, Burkina Faso upande wa mashariki, na Ghana upande wa kusini-mashariki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast has a population of over 25 million people.
entries.translation: Ivory Coast ina idadi ya watu zaidi ya milioni 25.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The official language is French, but many people also speak local languages such as Dioula, Bambara, and Akan.
entries.translation: Lugha rasmi ni Kifaransa, lakini watu wengi pia wanazungumza lugha za wenyeji kama vile Dioula, Bambara, na Akan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Ivory Coast include Abidjan, the capital city; Yamoussoukro, the former capital city; and Grand-Bassam, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya maeneo muhimu zaidi huko Ivory Coast yanajumuisha Abidjan, mji mkuu; Yamoussoukro, mji mkuu wa zamani; na Grand-Bassam, Kituo cha UNESCO cha Urithi wa Dunia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Abidjan is the largest city in Ivory Coast and the economic capital of the country.
entries.translation: Abidjan ni jiji kubwa huko Ivory Coast na mji mkuu wa kiuchumi wa nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yamoussoukro is the seat of government and is home to the Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, the largest church in the world.
entries.translation: Yamoussoukro ni makao makuu ya serikali na nyumbani kwa Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, kanisa kubwa zaidi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grand-Bassam is a popular tourist destination and is known for its beautiful beaches and colonial architecture.
entries.translation: Grand-Bassam ni kivutio maarufu cha watalii na inajulikana kwa fukwe zake nzuri na majengo ya kikoloni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl sat on the edge of her bed, staring at the blank wall in front of her.
entries.translation: Msichana huyo mdogo aliketi kwenye ukingo wa kitanda, akitazama ukuta uliokuwa tupu mbele yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been sitting there for hours, unmoving.
entries.translation: Alikuwa ameketi pale kwa saa nyingi, bila kusonga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her parents had tried to talk to her, but she wouldn't respond.
entries.translation: Wazazi wake walikuwa wamejaribu kuzungumza naye, lakini hakujibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had taken her to the doctor, but the doctor couldn't find anything wrong with her.
entries.translation: Walikuwa wamempeleka kwa daktari, lakini daktari hakupata chochote kibaya kwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl was in a state of shock.
entries.translation: Msichana huyo mdogo alikuwa katika hali ya mshtuko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her best friend had died just a few days ago, and she couldn't seem to come to terms with it.
entries.translation: Rafiki wake wa karibu alikuwa amekufa siku chache zilizopita, na hakuweza kukabiliana na jambo hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She felt like a part of her had died, and she didn't know how to go on without her friend.
entries.translation: Alihisi kana kwamba sehemu yake ilikuwa imekufa, na hakujua jinsi ya kuendela bila rafiki yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The little girl's parents knew that she needed time to grieve, so they gave her space.
entries.translation: Wazazi wa msichana huyo ndogo walijua kuwa alihitaji muda wa kuomboleza, kwa hivyo walimpa nafasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They let her come and go as she pleased, and they didn't pressure her to talk about her feelings.
entries.translation: Walimruhusu kukuja na kutoka alivyotaka, na hawakumshikiza kuzungunzia hisia zake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They knew that she would eventually come to terms with her grief, and they were there for her when she did.
entries.translation: Walijua kwamba hatimaye atakabiliana na huzuni yake, na walikuwepo kwa ajili yake alipokabiliana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, the little girl came home from school and went straight to her room.
entries.translation: Siku moja, msichana huyo mdogo alitoka shuleni na akaenda moja kwa moja chumbani kwake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She closed the door and sat on her bed.
entries.translation: Alifunga mlango na akaketi kwenye kitanda chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She stared at the blank wall for a long time, and then she started to cry.
entries.translation: Alitazama ukuta uliokuwa tupu kwa muda mrefu, na kisha akaaza kulia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide a safe and supportive environment where former inmates can learn to live independently and avoid relapse.
entries.translation: Hutoa mazingira salama na saidizi ambapo wafungwa wa zamani wanaweza kujifunza kuishi wakijitegemea na kuepuka kurudia tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sober living homes typically offer a variety of services, such as counseling, job training, and addiction support groups.
entries.translation: Nyumba za kuishi bila kunywa kileo hutoa huduma mbalimbali, kama vile ushauri, mafunzo ya kazi, na vikundi vya usaidizi wa uraibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also provide a sense of community and support, which can be invaluable for people who are reentering society after a period of incarceration.
entries.translation: Pia hutoa hisia na usaidizi wa jumuiya, ambao unaweza kuwa wa thamani sana kwa watu ambao wanaingia tena kwenye jamii baada ya kipindi cha kufungwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to living in a sober living home.
entries.translation: Kuna faida nyingi za kuishi katika nyumba za kuishi bila kunywa kileo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For one, it provides a structured environment where former inmates can learn to live independently.
entries.translation: Kwanza, hutoa mazingira yenye muundo ambapo wafungwa wa zamani wanaweza kujifunza kuishi wakijitegemea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are expected to follow a set of rules and regulations, which can help them to develop good habits and routines.
entries.translation: Wanatarajiwa kufuata seti ya sheria na kanuni, ambazo zinaweza kuwasaidia kuwa na tabia na mazoea mazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, sober living homes offer a variety of services that can help former inmates to get back on their feet.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya hayo, nyumba za kuishi bila kunywa kileo hutoa huduma mbalimbali ambazo zinaweza kuwasaidia wafungwa wa zamani kujitegemea tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These services may include counseling, job training, and addiction support groups.
entries.translation: Huduma hizi zinaweza kujumuisha ushauri, mafunzo ya kazi, na vikundi vya usaidizi wa uraibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sense of community and support that is found in sober living homes can also be very beneficial.
entries.translation: Hisia ya jumuiya na usaidizi ambao unapatikana katika nyumba za kuishi bila kunywa kileo unaweza kuwa na manufaa sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Former inmates often feel isolated and alone after being released from prison or jail.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi wafungwa wa zamani huhisi wametengwa na wapweke baada ya kuachiliwa kutoka gerezani au jela.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Living in a sober living home can help them to connect with others who are going through a similar experience.
entries.translation: Kuisha katika nyumba isiyoruhusu kunywa kileo kunaweza kuwasaidia kuungana na wengine wanaopitia hali kama hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also receive support from staff and other residents, which can help them to stay on track with their recovery.
entries.translation: Wanaweza pia kupokea usaidizi kutoka kwa wafanyakazi na wakaazi wengine, jambo ambalo linaweza kuwasaidia kuendela kukupata nafuu tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are a recently released inmate, living in a sober living home can be a great way to transition back into society.
entries.translation: Ikiwa wewe ni mfungwa aliyeachiliwa hivi majuzi, kuishi katika nyumba isiyoruhusu kutumia kileo kwa kiasi kunaweza kuwa njia nzuri ya kurejea kwenye jamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can provide you with the support and structure that you need to succeed.
entries.translation: Inaweza kukupa usaidizi na muundo ambao unahitaji ili ufanikiwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many sober living homes available, so you can find one that meets your needs and budget.
entries.translation: Kuna nyumba nyingi za kuishi bila kunywa leo zinazopatikana, kwa hivyo unaweza kupata inayokidhi mahitaji na bajeti yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A typical day for a person in South Africa will vary depending on their location and occupation.
entries.translation: Siku ya kawaida ya mtu aliye nchini Afrika Kusini itatofautiana kulingana na eneo na kazi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are some general trends that can be observed.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna baadhi ya mitindo ya jumla ambayo inaweza kuzingatiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the morning, many people will wake up to the sound of roosters crowing and the smell of fresh bread baking.
entries.translation: Asubuhi, watu wengi wataamka wakiskia sauti ya jogoo wakiwika na harufu ya mkate mpya ambao unaokwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a quick breakfast, they will head to work or school.
entries.translation: Baada ya kula kifungua kinywa haraka, wataenda kazini au shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The workday typically begins at 8am and ends at 5pm, with a one-hour lunch break in between.
entries.translation: Siku ya kazi kwa kawaida huanza saa 8am na kukamilika saa 5pm, na mapumziko ya saa moja ya chakula cha mchana kati yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After work, people will often spend time with their families and friends.
entries.translation: Baada ya kazi, mara nyingi watu watatumia wakati wao wakiwa na familia na marafiki wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might go out for dinner, watch a movie, or play games.
entries.translation: Wanaweza nje kula chakula cha jioni, kutazama filamu, au kucheza michezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the evening, many people will go to bed early in order to get a good night's sleep before starting the cycle all over again the next day.
entries.translation: Jioni, watu wengi wataenda kulala mapema ili kuwa na usingizi mzuri kabla ya kuanza tena mzunguko wa siku inayofuata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are many different ways to spend a day in South Africa.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, njia nyingi tofauti za kutumia siku huko nchini Akfika Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people might prefer to spend their time outdoors hiking, swimming, or fishing.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanaweza kupendelea kutumua wakati wao nje kwenda matembezi marefu, kuogelea, au kuvua samaki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others might enjoy visiting museums, art galleries, or historical sites.
entries.translation: Wengine wanaweza kufurahia kutembela majumba ya makumbusho, majumba ya sanaa, au maeneo ya historia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And still others might prefer to stay home and relax with a good book or movie.
entries.translation: Na wengine pia wanaweza kupendelea kukaa nyumbani au kupumzika kwa kusoma kitabu kizuri au kutazama filamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you choose to spend your day, you're sure to have a memorable experience in South Africa.
entries.translation: Haijalishi jinsi unavyochagua kutumia siku yako, una uhakika kwamba utakuwa na tukio utakalokumbuka nchini Afrika Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beautiful thing about collective organizations is that they can pull together the power of thousands of workers to fight for their common interests.
entries.translation: Jambi nzuri kuhusu mashirika ya pamoja ni kwamba wanaweza kuunganisha nguvu ya maelfu ya wafanyakazi ili kupigania mapendeleo yao ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In South Africa, trade unions have a long history of fighting for better wages, working conditions, and benefits for workers.
entries.translation: Nchini Afrika Kusini, vyama vya wafanyakazi vina historia ndefu ya kupigania mishahara bora, mazingira ya kazi, na manufaa ya wafanyakazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous examples of this is the 1973 Durban strikes, in which thousands of workers from across the city walked off the job in protest of low wages and poor working conditions.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ni mgomo wa mwaka wa 1973 huko Durban, ambapo maelfu ya wafanyakazi kutoka kote jijini waliacha kazi ili kupinga mishahara duni na mazingira duni ya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The strikes lasted for over a month and eventually led to the government increasing the minimum wage and improving working conditions for workers across the country.
entries.translation: Migomo hiyo ilidumu kwa zaidi ya mwezi mmoja na hatimaye kusababisha serikali kuongeza kima cha chini cha mishahara na kuboresha mazingira ya kazi ya wafanyakazi kote nchini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trade unions are not just about fighting for better wages and working conditions.
entries.translation: Vyama vya wafanyakazi havihusu tu kupigania mishahara bora na mazingira bora ya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also about building solidarity between workers and fighting for social justice.
entries.translation: Pia vinahusu kuunda umoja baina ya wafanyakazi na kupigania haki ya kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In South Africa, trade unions have played a leading role in the fight against apartheid and for a more democratic and just society.
entries.translation: Nchini Afrika Kusini, vyama vya wafanyakazi vimechukua nafasi kubwa katika vita dhidi ya ubaguzi wa rangi na kwa jamii yenye demokrasia na haki zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have also been at the forefront of the fight against poverty, inequality, and racism.
entries.translation: Pia wamekuwa mstari wa mbele katika vita dhidi ya umaskini, ukosefu wa usawa na ubaguzi wa rangi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trade unions are a beautiful thing because they bring people together to fight for a common cause.
entries.translation: Vyama vya wafanyakazi ni jambo nzuri kwa sababu vinaleta watu pamoja ili kupigania mambo ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a child, I loved playing in the fields near my house.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa mtoto, nilipenda kucheza kwenye shamba lililo karibu na nyumba yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would spend hours running around, exploring the nooks and crannies, and making up stories about the different plants and animals I found.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa natumia saa nyhingi kukimbia kimbia, nikichunguza vipembe na mianya, na kutunga hadithi kuhusu mimea na wanyama tofauti ambao nilipata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing in a field when I saw a group of men in military uniforms.
entries.translation: Siku moja nilipokuwa nikicheza shambani, niliona kikundi cha wanaume waliovalia sare za kijeshi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were carrying guns and talking in hushed voices.
entries.translation: Walikuwa wamebeba bunduki huku wakiongea kwa sauti ya chini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was curious, so I hid behind a tree to listen in.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa na hamu ya kutaka kujua, kwa hivyo nilijificha nyuma ya mti ili nisikilize.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I learned that they were from the defense industry, and they were testing new weapons.
entries.translation: Niligundua kwamba walikuwa wanatoka sekta ya ulinzi, na walikuwa wanajaribu silaha mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Nneka who was afraid of death.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na anayeitwa Nneka ambaye alikuwa anaogopa kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been a curious and adventurous person, but the thought of her own mortality filled her with dread.
entries.translation: Kila wakati alikuwa mtu mdadisi na mchunguzi, lakini wazo la kifo chake lilimjaza hofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Nneka was walking through the forest when she came across a wise old woman.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Nneka alipokuwa akitembea msituni, alikutana na mwanamke mzee mwenye busara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman was sitting on a rock, and she seemed to be waiting for Nneka.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo alikuwa amekaa juu ya jiwe, alionekana kuwa anamsubiri Nnkeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Hello," said Nneka "Can you help me? I'm afraid of death."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old woman smiled. "There is nothing to be afraid of," she said.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo mzee alitabasami. "Hakuna kitu cha kuogopa," alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Death is a natural part of life. It is the end of one journey, but it is also the beginning of another."
entries.translation: "Kifo ni sehemu ya kawaida ya maisha. Ni mwisho wa safari moja, lakini pia ni mwanzo wa safari nyingine."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But I don't want to die," said Nneka "I want to live forever!"
entries.translation: "Lakini sitaki kufa," Nneka alisema, "Nataka kuishi milele!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You cannot live forever," said the old woman "But you can live a full and meaningful life. And when your time comes to die, you can do so with peace and acceptance."
entries.translation: "Huwezi kuishi milele," mwanamke huyo mzee alisema "Lakini unaweza kuishi maisha kamili na yenye maana. Na wakati wako wa kufa utakapowadia, unaweza kufanya hivyo kwa amani na ukubalifu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nneka thought about what the old woman had said.
entries.translation: Nneka alifikiria kuhusu kila mwanamke huyo mzee alisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She realized that she was right.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Death was a part of life, and it was something that she would have to face one day.
entries.translation: Kifo ni sehemu ya maisha, na ni kitu ambacho atakabiliana nacho siku moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burundi's history is a complex one, with many important events that have shaped the country into what it is today.
entries.translation: Historia ya Burundi ni tata, yenye matukio mengi muhimu ambayo yameifanya nchi hiyi kuwa ilivyo sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most significant events in Burundi's history was the Hutu Revolution of 1972, which resulted in the deaths of an estimated 200,000 Tutsi people.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya matukio mengi zaidi katika historia ya Burundi yalikuwa Mapinduzi ya Wahutu ya mwaka wa 1972, ambayo yalisababisha vifo vya takriban Watutsi 200,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The revolution was led by Hutu soldiers who were angry at the Tutsi monarchy for its oppression of the Hutu majority.
entries.translation: Mapinduzi hayo yaliongozwa na wanajeshi wa Kihutu waliokuwa na hasira dhidi ya Ufalme wa Watutsi kwa kuwakandamiza watu wengi ambao ni Wahutu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The revolution led to the overthrow of the monarchy and the establishment of a Hutu-dominated government.
entries.translation: Mapinduzi hayo yalisababisha kupinduliwa kwa utawala wa kifalme na serikali inayotawaliwa na Wahutu kuanzishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important event in Burundi's history was the Burundi Civil War, which lasted from 1993 to 2005.
entries.translation: Tukio lingine muhimu katika historua ya Burundi ilikuwa Vita vya Wenyewe kwa Wenyewe vya Burundi, vilivyodumu kuanzia mwaka wa 1993 hadi 2005.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The civil war was fought between the Hutu and Tutsi peoples, and resulted in the deaths of an estimated 300,000 people.
entries.translation: Vita hivyi vya wenyewe kwa wenyewe vilipiganwa kati ya Wahutu na Watutsi, na kusababisha vifo vya watu wanaokaridia kufikia 300,000.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war ended with the signing of a peace agreement that called for the establishment of a power-sharing government between the Hutu and Tutsi.
entries.translation: Vita hivyo vilimalizika kwa kutia saini makubaliano na amani yaliyotoa wito wa kuanzisha serikali ya kushiriki madaraka kati ya Wahutu na Watutsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, Burundi has made progress in terms of peace and stability.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, Burundi imepata maendeleo katika suala la amani na utulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country still faces challenges, such as poverty, unemployment, and ethnic tensions.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, bado nchi hiyo inakabiliwa na changamoto, kama vile umaskini, ukosefu wa ajira, na mizozo ya kikabila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burundi is a small country with a population of about 11 million people.
entries.translation: Burundi ni nchi ndogo yenye watu taktiban milioni 11.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mali is facing a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Mali inakabiliwa na changamoto mbalimbali zikiwemo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Political instability: Mali has experienced a number of coups and political crises in recent years, which have destabilized the country and made it difficult to implement reforms.
entries.translation: * Ukosefu wa utulivu wa kisiasa: Mali imekumbana na mapinduzi kadhaa na migogoro ya kisiasa katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, ambayo yamevuruga nchi na kuifanya kuwa ngumu kutekeleza mageuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Economic problems: Mali is one of the poorest countries in the world, and its economy is heavily dependent on agriculture.
entries.translation: * Matitizo ya kiuchumi: Mali ni mojawapo ya nchi maskini zaidi duniani, na uchumi wake unategemea sana kilimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country is also vulnerable to climate change, which is expected to have a negative impact on its agricultural production.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyo pia iko katika hatari ya kukabiliwa na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, ambayo yanatarajiwa kuwa na athari mbaya kwa uzalishaji wake wa kilimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Security threats: Mali is home to a number of armed groups, including jihadist groups such as Ansar Dine and Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM).
entries.translation: * Vitisho vya usalama: Mali ni nyumbani kwa idadi ya makundi yenye silaha, yakiwemo makundi ya jihadi kama vile Ansar Dine na Al-Qaeda katika Maghred ya Kiislamu (AQIM).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These groups have carried out attacks against the Malian government and security forces, as well as against civilians.
entries.translation: Makundi haya yameendesha mashambulizi dhidi ya serikali ya Mali na vikosi vya usalama, na pia dhidi ya raia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Humanitarian crisis: Mali is facing a humanitarian crisis, with millions of people displaced from their homes due to conflict and insecurity.
entries.translation: * Mgogoro wa kibinadamu: Mali inakabiliwa na mzozo wa kibinadamu, huku mamilioni ya watu wakikimbia kutoka kwa makazi yao kwa sababu ya migogoro na ukosefu wa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country is also experiencing a food crisis, as a result of poor harvests and the high cost of food.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyi inakabiliwa na mgogoro wa chakula, kwa sababu ya mavuno duni na gharama ya juu ya chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These challenges are making it difficult for Mali to achieve its development goals.
entries.translation: Changamoto hizi zinaifanya kuwa vigumu kwa Mali kufikia malengo yake ya maendeleo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country is in need of international assistance to address these challenges and to build a more stable and prosperous future.
entries.translation: Nchi hiyi inahitaji usaidizi wa kimataifa ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizo na kujenga mustakabali ulio imara na wenye mafanikio zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to comply with the training requirements in order to ensure that you are properly prepared for the job.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kuzingatia mahitaji ya mafunzo ili kuhakikisha kuwa umejiandaa vyema kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes attending all training sessions, completing all assignments, and following all instructions.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kuhudhuria vipindi vyote vya mafunzo, kukamilisha kazi zote, na kufuata maagizo yote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to be receptive to feedback and suggestions from your trainers and supervisors.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu pia kuwa msikivu kwa maoni na mapendekezi kutoka kwa walimu na wasimamizi wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help you to improve your skills and knowledge, and it will also help you to develop a positive work ethic.
entries.translation: Hii itakusaidia kuboresha ujuzi na maarifa yako, na pia itakusaidia kukuza maadili chanya ya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you receive feedback or criticism, it is important to take it in a positive manner.
entries.translation: Unapopokea maoni au kukosolewa, ni muhimu kuyapokea kwa njia chanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This does not mean that you have to agree with everything that is said, but it does mean that you should be open to hearing different perspectives.
entries.translation: Hii haimaanishi kwamba unapaswa kukubaliana na kila kitu kinachosemwa, lakini ina maana kwamba kuwa wazi kusikia mitazamo tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to be respectful of the person giving you feedback.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu kumheshimu mtu anayekupa maoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, they are trying to help you, so it is important to listen to what they have to say.
entries.translation: Kumbuka, wanajaribu kukusaidia, kwa hivyo ni muhimu kusikiliza wanachosema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have received feedback, it is important to take some time to think about it.
entries.translation: Mara baada ya kupokea maoni, ni muhimu kuchukua muda wa kufikiria kuhusu ulichoambiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider what was said, and how you can apply it to your work.
entries.translation: Fikiria kile walichosema, na jinsi unavyoweza kukitumia katika kazi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask your trainer or supervisor.
entries.translation: Ikiwa una maswali yoyote, usisite kumuuliza mwalimu au msimamizi wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to be open to making changes to your work habits or procedures.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu pia kuwa wazi kufanya mabadiliko kwa tabia au taratibu yako ya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are not willing to change, then you will not be able to improve.
entries.translation: Ikiwa hauko tayari kufanya mabadiliko, basi hutaweza kuwa bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make you a valuable asset to any team, and it will help you to achieve your career goals.

entries.english: She has a wealth of experience in choosing, designing, and installing cabinets for homes of all shapes and sizes.
entries.translation: Ana uzoefu katika kuchagua, kubuni, na kusakinisha kabati za nyumba zenye maumbo na ukubwa mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In this article, she shares her insights on how to choose the right cabinets for your home, and how to incorporate some form of personalization into your design.
entries.translation: Katika makala haya, anashiriki maarifa yake kuhusu jinsi ya kuchagua kabati zinazofaa kwa nyumba yako, na jinsi ya kujumuisha aina fulani ya ubinafsishaji katika muundo wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When choosing cabinets for your home, there are a few things you need to keep in mind.
entries.translation: Unapochagua makabati ya nyumba yako, kuna mambo machache ambayo unahitaji kukumbuka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, consider the size and layout of your space.
entries.translation: Kwanza, zingatia ukubwa na mpangilio wa nafasi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You need to make sure that the cabinets you choose will fit in your space and that they will be functional for your needs.
entries.translation: Unahitaji kuhakikisha kwamba makabati unayochagua yatafaa katika nafasi yako na kwamba yatatumika kulingana na mahitaji yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, think about the style of your home.
entries.translation: Pili, fikiria kuhusu mtindo wa nyumba yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do you want traditional cabinets, modern cabinets, or something in between?
entries.translation: Je, unataka kabati za kitamaduni, kabati za kisasa, au kitu kingine chochote kati yao?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have a good idea of what you want, you can start shopping for cabinets.
entries.translation: Mara baada ya kuwa na wazo nzuri la kile unachotaka, unaweza kuanza kufanya ununuzi wa kabati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're shopping for cabinets, it's important to compare different brands and styles.
entries.translation: Unapofanya ununuzi wa kabati, ni muhimu kulinganisha cha na mitindo tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also read reviews to get an idea of what other people have to say about the cabinets you're considering.
entries.translation: Unapaswa pia kusoma maoni ili upate wazo wa kile watu wengine wanasema kuhusu kabati ambazo unazingatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also a good idea to visit a showroom so you can see the cabinets in person.
entries.translation: Pia ni wazo nzuri kutembelea chumba cha maonyesho ili uweze kuona kabati hizo mwenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While there are still challenges to be overcome, the potential benefits of nuclear energy are significant.
entries.translation: Ingawa bado kuna changamoto za kushinda, manufaa yanayoweza kupatikana kwa nishati ya nyuklia ni kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest advantages of nuclear energy is its stability.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya manufaa kubwa ya nishati ya nyuklia ni uthabiti wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nuclear power plants can operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, regardless of the weather or other conditions.
entries.translation: Viwanda vya umeme vya nyuklia vinaweza kufanya kazi kwa saa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki, bila kujali hali ya hewa au hali nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that they can provide a reliable source of electricity, even when other sources are unavailable.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuwa inaweza kutoa chanzo cha kuaminika cha kuaminika cha umeme hata wakati vyanzo vingine havipo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nuclear energy also has a relatively low carbon footprint.
entries.translation: Nishati ya nyuklia pia ina kiwango cha chini ya kaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When compared to fossil fuels, nuclear energy produces much less greenhouse gas emissions.
entries.translation: Ikilinganishwa na fueli ya kisukuku, nishati ya nyuklia hutoa uzalishaji mdogo zaidi wa gesi chafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it a more environmentally friendly option for generating electricity.
entries.translation: Hii hufanya kuwa chaguo nzuri la kimazingira la kuzalisha umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are also challenges to be overcome with nuclear energy.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, pia kuna changamoto zinazopaswa kutatuliwa na nishati ya nyuklia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most significant of these is the issue of nuclear waste.
entries.translation: Jambo muhimu zaidi ni suala la taka za nyuklia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nuclear waste is radioactive and must be stored safely for many years.
entries.translation: Taka za nyuklia zina mnururishi na lazima zihifadhiwe salama kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are a number of promising technologies being developed to deal with this issue.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna teknolojia kadhaa za zinazoweza kuleta matokeo mazuri ambazo zinatengenezwa kushughulikia suala hili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges, the potential benefits of nuclear energy are significant.
entries.translation: Licha ya changamoto hizo, manufaa yanayoweza kutokana na nishati ya nyuklia ni kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a clean, reliable, and efficient source of energy that can help us to meet our growing energy needs.
entries.translation: Ni chanzo safi, kinachoweza kutegemewa, na chenye ufanisi ambacho kinaweza kutusaidia kukidhi mahitaji yetu ya nishati yanayokua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a dreary day, and he was feeling even more down than usual.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been working long hours for weeks, and he was starting to feel the strain.
entries.translation: Alikiwa amefanya kazi kwa muda wa saa nyingi, na alikuwa ameanza kuhisi mkazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He sighed and turned away from the window.
entries.translation: Alipumia na kugeuka akatoka kwenye dirisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had a patient to see, and he needed to focus.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na mgonjwa wa kuona, na alihitaji kuhisi sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took a deep breath and opened the door to his office.
entries.translation: Alivuta pumzi kwa kina na akafungua mlango wa ofisi yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The patient was a young woman, and she looked scared.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa huyo alikuwa mwanamke mchanga, na alionekna kuwa ana hofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She sat on the edge of the chair, her hands clasped tightly in her lap.
entries.translation: Alikaa ukingoni mwa kiti, mikono yake ikiwa imeshikamana kwenye mapaja yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What can I do for you?" the doctor asked. "I'm pregnant," the woman said.

entries.english: As the sun came up, I opened my eyes and saw the pretty, cream-colored curtains billowing in the breeze.
entries.translation: Jua lilipochomoza, nilifungua macho yangu na nikaona mapazia maridadi ya rangi ya malai yakipeperushwa na upepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The light from the sun was streaming in through the window, and it felt so good to be alive.

entries.english: I got out of bed and stretched, then went to the kitchen to make some coffee.
