entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was pouring the water into the coffee maker, I thought about the nature of light and darkness.
entries.translation: Nilipokuwa nikimimina maji ndani ya kitengenezaji cha kahawa, nilikuwa nafikiria kuhusu asili ya mwangaza na giza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light is a powerful force that can both illuminate and obscure.
entries.translation: Mwangaza ni nguvu thabiti ambayo inaweza kuangaza au kuficha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can bring joy and warmth, but it can also be blinding and dangerous.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuleta furaha na joto, lakini pia inaweza kuwa ya kushurutisha na hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Darkness, on the other hand, is often seen as a negative force, but it can also be a source of peace and tranquility.
entries.translation: Giza, kwa upande mwingine, mara nyingi huonekana kama nguvu isiyofaa, lakini pia inaweza kuwa chanzo cha amani na utulivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes are a natural phenomenon that can cause widespread damage and loss of life.
entries.translation: Matetemeko ya ardhi ni jambo la kawaida linaloweza kusababisha uharibifu mkubwa na kupoteza maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are caused by the sudden release of energy in the Earth's crust, and can range in size from minor tremors to major catastrophes.
entries.translation: Husababishwa na utoaji wa nishati kwa ghafla katika tabaka la juu la Dunia, na inaweza kutofautiana kulingana na ukubwa kutoka kwa mitetemo ndogo hadi majanga makubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The largest earthquakes can cause entire cities to be leveled, and can even trigger tsunamis and other secondary hazards.
entries.translation: Matetemeko makubwa zaidi yaaweza kusababisha miji nzima kuzama, na hata yanaweza kusababisha tsunami na hatari nyinginezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes are a major threat to human life and infrastructure, and can have a devastating impact on economies and societies.
entries.translation: Matetemeko ya ardhi ni tishio kubwa kwa maisha ya binadamu na miundombinu, na yanaweza kuwa na madhaba mabaya kwenye uchumi na jumuiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of factors that can contribute to the severity of an earthquake, including the depth of the earthquake, the proximity to population centers, and the type of soil or rock that the earthquake occurs in.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa ambayo yanaweza kuchangia ukali wa tetemeko la ardhi, ikiwemo kina cha tetemeko hilo, ukaribu na vituo vilivyo na watu, na aina ya udongo au miamba ambayo tetemeko la ardhi hutokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also be triggered by human activity, such as the construction of dams or the injection of fluids into the ground.
entries.translation: Matetemeko ya ardhi pia yanaweza kuchochewa na shughuli za binadamu, kama vile ujenzi wa mabwawa au kuweka vioevu ndani ya ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The scientific study of earthquakes is known as seismology.
entries.translation: Utafiti wa kisayansi wa matetemo ya ardhi unajulikana kama elimu ya tetemeko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Seismologists use a variety of tools to study earthquakes, including seismographs, which measure the ground shaking caused by an earthquake.
entries.translation: Wataalamu wa matetemeko hutumia zana mbalimbali kuchunguza tetemeko la ardhi, ikiwemo kipimatetemeko, ambacho hupima mtetemeko unaosababishwa na tetemeko la ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Seismologists also use computer models to help them understand the causes and effects of earthquakes.
entries.translation: Mtaalamu wa matetemo pia hutumia miundo ya kompyuta ili kuwasaidia kuelewa sababu na athari za matetemeko ya ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The early warning systems that are used to alert people to impending earthquakes are based on the information that seismologists collect from seismographs.
entries.translation: Mifumo ya tahadhari ya mapema hutumiwa kutahadharisha watu kuhusu matetemeko ya ardhi ambayo yanakaribia kulingana na maelezo ambayo wataalamu ya tetemeko hukusanya kutoka kwa kipimatetemeko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Procrastination is the act of delaying or postponing something that needs to be done.
entries.translation: Kuahirisha ni kitendo cha kuchelewesha au kuahirisha jambo ambalo linahitaji kufanywa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many theories about why people procrastinate, but one of the most common is that it is a way to avoid feeling anxious or stressed about a task.
entries.translation: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu kwa nini watu huahirisha, lakini mojawapo ya kawaida ni kwamba ni njia ya kuepuka kuhisi wasiwasi au mfadhaiko kuhusu kazi fulani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might procrastinate on writing a paper because you are worried about getting a bad grade.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, unaweza kuahirisha kuandika karatasi kwa sababu una wasiwasi utapata alama mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Procrastination can also be a way to escape from boredom or unpleasantness.
entries.translation: Kuahirisha pia inaweza kuwa njia ya kuepuka kuchoka au kutopendezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might procrastinate on cleaning your room because you would rather watch TV.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, unaweza kuahirisha kusafisha chumba chako kwa sababu ungependa kutazama televisheni badala yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can lead to missed deadlines, lower grades, and even job loss.
entries.translation: Inaweza kusababisha kutofikia makataa, alama za chini na hata kupoteza kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also damage your relationships with others.
entries.translation: Inaweza pia kuharibu mahusiano yako na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you keep canceling plans with your friends because you are too busy procrastinating, they may eventually stop inviting you to things.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, ukiendendelea kughairi mipango uliyopanga na marafiki wako kwa sababu ya kuahirisha, wanaweza kuacha kukualika kwa matukio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things you can do to overcome procrastination.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa ambayo unaweza kufanya ili uepuke kuahirisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One is to break down the task into smaller, more manageable steps.
entries.translation: Moja ni kugawanya kazi katika hatua ndogo na zinazoweza kudhibitiwa zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it seem less daunting and more achievable.
entries.translation: Hii itafanya isiwe ngumu kushughulikia na inayoweza kufanikishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another is to set deadlines for yourself and stick to them.
entries.translation: Nyingine ni kujiwekea tarehe ya mwisho na kuizingatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, find a support system of friends or family members who can help you stay on track.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, tafuta mfumo wa msaada wa marafiki au wanafamilia ambao wanaweza kukusaidia kuendelea kuzingatia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are struggling with procrastination, don't despair.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unatatizika na kuahirisha, usikate tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many resources available to help you.
entries.translation: Kuna rasilimali nyingi zinazopatikana za kukusaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Yvonne who lived in a small village.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na msichana anayeitwa Yvonne ambaye aliishi katika kijiji kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a talented blacksmith, and she loved to work with precious metals.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mhunzi hodari, na alipenda kufanya kazi na madini yenye thamani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, she was working on a new design for a necklace when she had an idea.
entries.translation: Siku moja, alikuwa ashughulikia kubuni muundo mpya wa mkufu alipopata wazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She decided to create a necklace that would be made entirely of stones, but she would use a new technique to ensure that the stones were held securely in place.
entries.translation: Aliamua kutengeneza mkufu ambao uliundwa na vito kabisa, lakini alitumia mbinu mpya kuhakikisha kwamba vito hivyo vimeshikiliwa kwa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yvonne worked on her necklace for many weeks, and when she was finally finished, she was thrilled with the results.
entries.translation: Yvonne alitengeneza mkufu wake kwa majuma mengi, na hatimaye alipomaliza, alifurahishwa na matokeo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The necklace was beautiful, and it was unlike anything anyone had ever seen before.
entries.translation: Mkufu huo ulikuwa unapendeza, na haukuwa unafanana na kitu chochote ambacho mtu yeyote alikuwa amewahi kuona hapo awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yvonne decided to call it the "Innovative Necklace". Yvonne took her necklace to the market, and she was immediately met with a flurry of excitement.
entries.translation: Yvonne alimua kuuita "Mkufu wa Kubuni". Yvonne aliupelekea mkufu wake sokoni, na alikutana na msisimko mwingi punde tu alipofika huko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everyone wanted to know where she had gotten such a unique and beautiful necklace.
entries.translation: Kila mtu alitaka kujua mahali ambapo amepata mkufu huo wa kipekee na unaopendeza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yvonne told them about her new technique, and she soon had many orders for more necklaces.
entries.translation: Yvonne aliwaambia kuhusu mbinu yake mpya, muda si muda akapa maagizo mengi na mikufu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yvonne's innovative necklace was a huge success, and she quickly became one of the most famous blacksmiths in the land.
entries.translation: Mkufu wa kubuni wa Yvonne ulikuwa na mafanikio makubwa, na kwa haraka akawa mmoja wa wahunzi mashuhuri katika nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She used her newfound wealth to help her village, and she soon became known as a kind and generous woman.
entries.translation: Alitumia mali yake mpya kusaidia kijiji chao, na upesi akajulikana kuwa ni mwanamke mkarimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the words of William Wordsworth, “The child is the father of the man.”
entries.translation: Kwa maneno ya William Wordsworth, “Mtoto ndiye baba wa mwanamme.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the experiences and relationships we have in childhood shape who we become as adults.
entries.translation: Hii ina maana kwamba uzoefu na mahusiano tuliyo nayo utotoni huunda jinsi tutakavyokuwa watu wazima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Our parents, siblings, and friends teach us about the world and how to interact with it.
entries.translation: Wazazi, ndugu, na warafiki wetu hutufundisha kuhusu ulimwengu na jinsi ya kuingiliana nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help us develop our values and beliefs.
entries.translation: Pia hutusaidia kusitawisha maadili na imani zetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The relationships we form in childhood can have a lasting impact on our emotional well-being and our ability to form healthy relationships in adulthood.
entries.translation: Mahusiano tunayokuwa nayo utotoni yanweza kuwa na athari ya kudhuru kwa hali yetu ya kihisia na uwezo wetu wa kuunda mahusiano mazuri tukiwa watu wazima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, not all childhood experiences are positive.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, sio uzoefu wote wa utotoni ni mzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some children are raised in homes where they experience neglect, abuse, or other forms of trauma.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watoto wamelelewa kwenye nyumba ambamo wanatelekezwa, kunyanyasawa na aina zingine za kiwewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These experiences can have a devastating impact on a child's development.
entries.translation: Matukio haya yanaweza kuwa na athari mbaya kwa ukuaji wa mtoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, even in the most difficult circumstances, children can find ways to overcome their challenges and thrive.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, katika hali ngumu, watoto wanweza kutafuta njia za kushinda matatizo haya na kusitawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child is the father of the man, but the man is also the father of the child.
entries.translation: Mtoto ndiye baba wa mwanaume, lakini mwanaume pia ndiye baba wa mtoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we grow older, we have the opportunity to learn from our experiences and to make choices that will help us become the kind of people we want to be.
entries.translation: Tunapoendelea kuwa watu wazima, tunapata fursa ya kujifunza kutokana na matukio yetu na kufanya maamuzi ambayo yatatusaidia kuwa aina ya watu tunaotaka kuwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can choose to be kind, compassionate, and understanding.
entries.translation: Tunaweza kuchagua kuwa mtu mkarimu, mwenye huruma, na anayeelewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can choose to make a difference in the world.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want to have clean beauty, you should start by eating a healthy diet.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unataka kuwa mrembo, upaswa kuanza kwa kula lishe yenye afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means avoiding processed foods and eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuepuka vyakula vilivyotengenezwa viwandani na kula matunda, mboga, na nafaka kwa wingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also drink plenty of water to stay hydrated.
entries.translation: Unapaswa pia kunywa maji mengi ili uwe na maji ya kutosha mwilini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to eating a healthy diet, you should also get regular exercise.
entries.translation: Pamoja na kula chakula chenye afya, unapaswa pia kufanya mazoezi mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Exercise helps to improve your circulation and lymphatic drainage, which can help to clear your skin and reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: Mazoezi husaidia kuboresha mzunguko wako wa damu na mtiririko wa maji ya limfu, ambayo inaweza kusaidia kusafisha ngozi yako na kupunguza uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using harsh chemicals on your skin.
entries.translation: Pia unapaswa kuepuka kutumia kemikali kali kwenye ngozi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, use gentle cleansers and moisturizers that are designed for your skin type.
entries.translation: Badala yake, tumia visafishaji laini na mafuta ya kulainisha ngozi amabyo yameundwa kwa ajili ya aina ya ngozi yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using products that contain sulfates, parabens, and phthalates, as these chemicals can irritate your skin and damage your hair.
entries.translation: Unapaswa pia kutumia bidhaa ambazo zina sulfati, parabanes, na phthalates, kwa kuwa kemikali hizi zinaweza kudhuru ngozi yako na kuharibu nywele zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want to achieve clean beauty, you should also take care of your mental health.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unataka kuwa mrembo kamili, unapaswa pia kutunza afya yako ya akili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stress can wreak havoc on your skin, so it's important to find healthy ways to manage stress.
entries.translation: Mfadhaiko unaweza kuharibu ngozi yako, kwa hivyo ni muhimu kutafuta njia bora za kudhibiti mfadhaiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Getting enough sleep, eating a healthy diet, and exercising regularly can all help to reduce stress levels.
entries.translation: Kulala vizuri, kula chakula chenye afya, na kufanya mazoezi mara kwa mara kunaweza kusaidia kupunguza viwango vya mfadhaiko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you follow these tips, you can achieve clean beauty from the inside out.
entries.translation: Ukifuata vidokezo hivi, unaweza kuwa mrembo ndani na nje.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ethiopia is a country with a long and rich history.
entries.translation: Ethopia ni nchi yenye historia ndefu na yenye mambo mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is one of the oldest countries in the world, with evidence of human habitation dating back to the Paleolithic period.
entries.translation: Ni mojawapo ya nchi ya zamani zaidi ulimwenguni, na ushahidi wa makazi ya wanadamu yalianza kipindi cha Paleolithic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major kingdom in Ethiopia was Aksum, which flourished from the 1st to the 8th centuries CE.
entries.translation: Ufalme mkubwa wa kwanza nchini Ethiopia ulikuwa Aksum, ambao ulisitawi kutoka karne ya 1 ya 8 CE.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aksum was a major trading center and a center of Christianity.
entries.translation: Aksum ilikuwa kituo kikuu cha biashara na kituo cha Ukristo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 16th century, Ethiopia was conquered by the Muslim Ottoman Empire, but it regained its independence in the 19th century.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 16, Ethiopia ilitekwa na Miliki ya Ottoman ya Kiislamu, lakini ilipata uhuru wake tena katika karne ya 19.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 20th century, Ethiopia was ruled by a series of emperors, until it was overthrown in a revolution in 1974.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 20, Ethiopia ilitawalia na msururu wa wafalme, hadi ilipopinduliwa mwaka wa 1974.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, Ethiopia has been a federal republic.
entries.translation: Tangu wakati huo, Ethiopia imekuwa jamuhuri ya muungano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The current prime minister, Abiy Ahmed, has been in office since 2018.
entries.translation: Waziri mkuu wa sasa, amekuwa kwenye madaraka tangu mwaka wa 2018.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He has been working to promote peace and reconciliation in Ethiopia, and to improve the country's economy.
entries.translation: Amekuwa akijitahidi kuendeleza amani na maridhiano nchini Ethiopia, na kuboresha uchumi wa nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An ongoing research project at the University of York is studying the history of Ethiopia from the Aksumite period to the present day.
entries.translation: Mradi wa utafiti unaoendelea katika Kituo Kikuu cha York kinatafiti historia ya Ethiopia kutoka enzi ya Aksumite hadi leo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The project is using a variety of sources, including written documents, oral histories, and archaeological evidence.
entries.translation: Mradi huo unatumia vyanzo kadhaa, vikiwemo hati zilizoandikwa, historia simulizi, na ushahidi wa kiakiolojia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superstition is the belief in supernatural forces that can influence events and be influenced by human actions.
entries.translation: Ushirikina ni imani katika nguvu zisizo za kibinadamu ambazo zinaweza kuathiri matukio na kuathiriwa na matendo ya wanadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is often based on folklore and tradition, and can vary widely from culture to culture.
entries.translation: Hii mara nyingi inatokana na mila na tamaduni, na inaweza kutofautiana kutoka kwa desturi hadi desturi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some common superstitions include avoiding walking under a ladder, breaking a mirror, and spilling salt.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya ushirikina wa kawaida unajumuisha kuepuka kutembea chini ya ngazi, kuvunja kioo, na kumwaga chumvi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superstitions can have a significant impact on people's lives, causing them to avoid certain activities or objects out of fear of bad luck.
entries.translation: Ushirikina unaweza kuwa na athari kubwa kwa maisha ya watu, na hivyo kuwafanya waepuke shughuli au vitu fulani kwa kuhofia kukumbana na bahati mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also lead to irrational beliefs and behaviors, such as the belief that a certain charm or ritual can bring good luck.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kusababisha imani na tabia zisizo na maana, kama vile imani kwamba hirizi na kaida fulani za dini zinaweza kusababisha bahati nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no scientific evidence to support the existence of supernatural forces, and many people believe that superstitions are simply a way for people to cope with uncertainty and fear.
entries.translation: Hakuna uthibitisho wa kisayansi unaounga mkono kuwepo kwa nguvu zisizo za kibinadamu, na watu wengi wanaamini kwamba ushirikina ni njia ya watu kukabiliana na kutokuwa na uhakika na hofu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, superstitions can be harmful, as they can lead to anxiety, stress, and even self-harm.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ushirikina unaweza kuwa na madhara, kwa kuwa unaweza kusababisha wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, na hata kujidhuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be aware of the potential dangers of superstitions and to be able to challenge them when they arise.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kufahamu hatari zinazoweza kusababishwa na ushirikina na kuweza kupinga unapotokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are struggling with superstitions, there are a few things you can do to help yourself.
entries.translation: Ikiwa unapambana na ushirikina, kuna mambo machache ambayo unaweza kufanya ili ujisaidie.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, try to identify the sources of your superstitions.
entries.translation: Kwanza, jaribu kutambua ushirikina ambao unakumbana nao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are they based on your culture, your family, or your own personal experiences?
entries.translation: Je, unatokana na tamaduni yako, familia yako, au mambo ambayo umekumbana nayo kibinafsi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Gold Coast was a British colony from 1821 to 1957.
entries.translation: Pwani ya Dhahabu ilikuwa chini ya utawala wa Uingereza kuanzia 1821 hadi 1957.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1957, it became the first sub-Saharan African country to gain independence from a European colonial power.
entries.translation: Mwaka wa 1957, ilikuwa nchi ya Afrika ya kwanza inayopatikana chini ya Sahara kupata uhuru kutoka kwa mtawala wa Ulaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana's first president, was a leading figure in the Pan-African movement.
entries.translation: Kwame Nkrumah, rais wa kwanza wa Ghana, alikuwa kiongozi katika vuguvugu la Afrika Yote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He promoted African unity and helped to establish the Organization of African Unity (OAU) in 1963.
entries.translation: Alikuza umoja wa Afrika na kusaidia kuanzisha Shirika la Umoja wa Afrika (OAU) mwaka wa 1963.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana's independence was a major turning point in African history.
entries.translation: Uhuru wa Ghana ulikuwa sehemu kuu ya mabadiliko katika historia ya Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It inspired other African countries to fight for their own independence, and it helped to establish Ghana as a leader in the African continent.
entries.translation: Ulihimiza nchi nyingine za Afrika kupigania uhuru wao, na kusaidia kuweka Ghana kama kiongozi katika bara la Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana has also played a significant role in international affairs, serving as a member of the United Nations Security Council and the Non-Aligned Movement.
entries.translation: Ghana pia ilitekeleza jukumu muhimu katika masuala ya kimataifa, ikihudumu kama mwanachama wa Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa na Vuguvugu Lisiloegemea Upande Wowote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, Ghana is a vibrant democracy with a growing economy.
entries.translation: Leo, Ghana ni demokrasia kubwa iliyo na uchumi unaokua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a popular tourist destination, and it is home to many important historical and cultural sites.
entries.translation: Ni mahali maarufu ambao watalii huwa wanatua, na ni nyumbani mwa vitu vingi muhimu vya kihistoria na utamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is also a major producer of cocoa, and it is a major exporter of gold.
entries.translation: Ghana pia ni mzalishaji mkubwa wa kakao, na huwa inauza dhahabu kwa nchi nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana's history is a complex and fascinating one.
entries.translation: Historia ya Ghana ni changamano na ya kufurahisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a story of struggle, resistance, and triumph.
entries.translation: Ni hadithi ya mapambano, ustahimilivu, na ushindi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reservation in India is a system of positive discrimination that aims to provide opportunities to historically disadvantaged groups.
entries.translation: Akiba nchini India ni mfumo wa ubaguzi chanya ambao unalenga kutoa fursa kwa vikundi ambavyo vimetengwa kihistoria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is based on the idea that these groups have been discriminated against in the past, and that they need special help in order to achieve equality.
entries.translation: Inaegemea dhana kwamba vikundi hivi vimebaguliwa katika siku zilizopita, na kwamba vinahitaji usaidizi wa kipekee ili kufanikisha usawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reservations are used in a number of areas, including education, employment, and government.
entries.translation: Akiba hutumika katika maeneo mengi, yakiwemo elimu, ajira, na serikali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can take the form of quotas, which set aside a certain number of places for members of a particular group, or of preferences, which give members of a particular group an advantage in selection.
entries.translation: Zinaweza kuchukua muundo wa sehemu ya haki, ambayo imetenga idadi fulani ya maeneo ya wanachama wa kikundi maalum, au ya mapendeleo, ambayo huwa yanapatia kikundi fulani manufaa katika uteuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reservations are controversial, and there are a number of arguments for and against them.
entries.translation: Akiba huleta mabishano mengi, na kuna hoja za kuziunga mkono na za kuzipinga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people argue that they are necessary to correct the effects of past discrimination, and that they provide an important opportunity for members of disadvantaged groups to improve their lives.
entries.translation: Watu wengine wanadai kwamba ni muhimu kutatua athari za ubaguzi uliopita, na kwamba zinaleta fursa muhimu kwa wanachama wa vikundi ambavyo vimetengwa ili kuboresha maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others argue that reservations are unfair to other groups, and that they create a sense of entitlement among the beneficiaries.
entries.translation: Wengine wanadai kwamba akiba hazina haki kwa vikundi vingine, na kwamba zinaleta dhana ya kuwa na haki miongoni mwa wanaopata akiba hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate over reservations is likely to continue for many years to come.
entries.translation: Mjadala huo wa akiba una uwezekano wa kuendelea kwa miaka mingi ijayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a growing consensus that reservations are an important tool for achieving equality in India.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kuna makubaliano ambayo yanawekwa kwamba akiba ni zana muhimu katika kutimiza ubora nchini India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Indian Constitution guarantees the right to equality for all citizens, regardless of their caste, religion, or gender.
entries.translation: Katiba ya India inatoa haki ya usawa kwa raia wote, licha ya tabaka, dini, au jinsia yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a humble tailor named Ali who lived in a small village.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na fundi wa kushona nguo ambaye alikuwa anaitwa Ali na alikuwa anaishi katika kijiji kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a kind and hardworking man, but he was not very successful.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mwanaume mkarimu tena mwenye bidii, lakini hakuwa na mafanikio mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a wealthy merchant came to Ali's shop and asked him to make a new suit of clothes.
entries.translation: Siku moja, mfanyabiashara tajiri alikuja katika duka la Ali na akamwambia amshonee suti mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali was overjoyed, but he knew that he could not afford the expensive materials that the merchant wanted.
entries.translation: Ali alijawa na furaha tele, lakini alijua kwamba hangeweza kumudu vitambaa ghali ambavyo mfanyabiashara huyo alikuwa anataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali decided to take a risk.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to the market and bought the cheapest materials he could find.
entries.translation: Alienda sokoni na kununua vitambaa vyenye bei nafuu ambayo aliweza kupata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He then went home and began to work on the suit.
entries.translation: Kisha alienda nyumbani na akaanza kushughulikia suti hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He worked for hours, and when he was finished, he had created a beautiful suit of clothes.
entries.translation: Alifanya kazi kwa saa nyingi, na alipomaliza, alikuwa ameshona suti nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, Ali brought the suit to the merchant.
entries.translation: Siku iliyofuata, Ali alipelekea mfanyabiashara huyo suti aliyoshona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The merchant was very impressed with the suit, and he paid Ali a handsome price for it.
entries.translation: Mfanyabiashara huyo alifurahia sana suti hiyo, na alimlipa Ali pesa nyingi kwa ajili ya suti hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali was so happy that he had been able to use his creativity and skill to make a profit.
entries.translation: Ali alikuwa na furaha mno kwamba aliweza kutumia ubunifu na ujuzi wake kutengeneza faida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ali continued to make clothes for his clients, and he soon became known as the best tailor in the village.
entries.translation: Ali aliendelea kutengenezea wateja wake nguo, na haraka alijulikana kama fundi bora wa kushona nguo katika kijiji chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People came from all over to buy his clothes, and Ali was able to provide for his family and live a comfortable life.
entries.translation: Watu walitoka sehemu zote kuja kununua nguo zake, na Ali aliweza kutafutia familia yake riziki na kuishi maisha mazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a famous traveler came to the village.
entries.translation: Siku moja, msafiri maarudu alikuja katika kijiji hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a country in West Africa with a population of over 200 million people.
entries.translation: Nijeria ni inayopatikana Afrika Magharibi na ina zaidi ya watu milioni 200.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the most populous country in Africa and the 7th most populous country in the world.
entries.translation: Nijeria ndiyo nchi yenye watu wengi zaidi Afrika na nchi ya 7 yenye wetu wengi zaidi duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a diverse country with over 250 ethnic groups and languages.
entries.translation: Nijeria ni nchi anuwai yenye zaidi ya makabila na lugha 250.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The official language of Nigeria is English, but many people speak other languages, including Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, and Fulani.
entries.translation: Lugha rasmi nchini Nijeria ni Kiingereza, lakini watu wengi huongea lugha nyingine, kama vile Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, na Fulani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nigeria is a major oil producer and has the 10th largest proven oil reserves in the world.
entries.translation: Nijeria ni nchi inayozalisha mafuta mengi na ipo katika nafasi ya 10 duniani kwa akiba za mafuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country has been plagued by corruption and economic instability for many years.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, nchi hiyo imesumbuliwa sana na ufisadi na kutokuwa thabiti kwa uchumi kwa miaka mingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2015, Muhammadu Buhari was elected president of Nigeria on a platform of fighting corruption and improving the economy.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2015, Muhammadu Buhari alichaguliwa kuwa rais wa Nijeria kwenye jukwaa la kupigana na ufisadi na kuboresha uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Buhari has made some progress in these areas, but Nigeria still faces many challenges.
entries.translation: Buhari amepiga hatua fulani katika maeneo haya, lakini Nijeria bado inakumbana na changamoto nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, Nigeria has been plagued by a wave of violence by the militant group Boko Haram.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, Nijeria imesumbuliwa na mawimbi ya vurugu kutoka kwa kundi linalopambana la Boko Haram.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Boko Haram is a terrorist group that wants to establish an Islamic state in Nigeria.
entries.translation: Boko Haram ni kundi la magaidi ambao wanataka kuanzisha jimbo la Kiislamu nchini Nijeria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The group has been responsible for the deaths of thousands of people and the displacement of millions more.
entries.translation: Kundi hilo limewajibikia vifo vya maelfu ya watu na kuhamishwa kwa mamilioni zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2015, the Nigerian military launched an offensive against Boko Haram, and the group has been weakened significantly.
entries.translation: Mnamo 2015, jeshi la Nijeria lilizindua mapigano dhidi ya Boko Haram, na kundi hilo limefanywa kuwa dhaifu kwa kiasi kikubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the moments after a great battle, when the smoke has cleared and the dead have been counted, there are often moments of great beauty to be found in the natural world.
entries.translation: Muda baada ya mapigano makubwa, wakati ambapo moshi umeisha na waliokufa wameweza kuhesabiwa, huwa kuna muda ambapo urembo mwingi huwa unapatikana katika dunia asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such moment occurred in the aftermath of the Battle of the Somme, when a group of British soldiers came across a field of poppies that had been untouched by the fighting.
entries.translation: Mmoja kati ya muda huo ulitokea baada ya Vita vya Somme, wakati ambapo kikundi cha maaskari wa Uingereza walikutana na shamba la mipopi ambalo halikuwa limeguswa na vita hivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soldiers were moved by the beauty of the flowers, and they took time to stop and appreciate them.
entries.translation: Maaskari hao walipendezwa na urembo wa maua hayo, na walichukua muda wa kusimama na kuyashukuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, the poppy is a symbol of remembrance for all those who have died in war.
entries.translation: Leo, mpopi ni ishara ya ukumbusho wa watu wote ambao wamekufa katika vita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I laughed and pushed him back, and we played like that for a while.
entries.translation: Nilicheka na kumsukuma nyuma, na tulicheza hivyo kwa muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was so full of energy and life, it was hard not to be happy around him.
entries.translation: Alikuwa na nguvu na uchangamfu mwingi, ilikuwa ngumu kutokuwa na furaha ukiwa naye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a while, we got tired of playing and sat down on the couch together.
entries.translation: Baada ya muda, tulichoka na kucheza na tukaketi kwenye kochi pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I put my arm around him and he leaned his head on my shoulder.
entries.translation: Niliweka mkono wangu kwake na akaegemeza kichwa chake kwenye mabega yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We just sat there for a while, enjoying each other's company.
entries.translation: Tuliketi tu hapo kwa muda, tukifurahia uwepo wa kija mmoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about how lucky I was to have him in my life.
entries.translation: Nilifikiria jinsi ambavyo nilikuwa na bahati ya kuwa naye katika maisha yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was such a special little boy, and I loved him more than anything in the world.
entries.translation: Alikuwa mvulana mdogo wa kipekee, na nilimpenda zaidi ya kitu chochote duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that we would have many more adventures together, and I couldn't wait to see what the future held for us.
entries.translation: Nilijua kwamba tungekuwa na mambo mengi kwa pamoja, na singeweza kusubiri kuona mambo yatakavyotuendea katika siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children are constantly learning and growing, and it is important to teach them about appropriate and safe behavior.
entries.translation: Kila mara watoto wanaendelea kujifunza na kukua, na ni muhimu kuwafunza kuhusu tabia mwafaka na salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes teaching them about the difference between right and wrong, how to respect others, and how to stay safe.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisha kuwafunza tofauti kati ya mambo sahihi na mabaya, jinsi ya kuwaheshimu wengine, na jinsi ya kuwa salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to teach children about appropriate and safe behavior is by setting a good example.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya njia bora za kufunza watoto wako kuhusu tabia mwafaka na salama ni kuweka mfano mzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children learn by watching the adults in their lives, so it is important to model the behavior that you want to see in them.
entries.translation: Watoto hujifunza kwa kutazama watu wazima katika maisha yao, hivyo ni muhimu kuwa kielelezo mzuri wa tabia ambayo unataka kuona kwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you want your child to be honest, then you need to be honest with them.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, iwapo unataka mtoto wako awe mwaminifu, basi unahitaji kuwa mwaminifu na wao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want your child to be respectful, then you need to be respectful of them.
entries.translation: Iwapo unataka mtoto wako awe na heshima, basi unahitaji kuwaheshimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important way to teach children about appropriate and safe behavior is to talk to them about it.
entries.translation: Njia nyingine muhimu ya kuwafunza watoto kuhusu tabia mwafaka na salama ni kuongea na wao kuhusu tabia hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Explain to them what is right and wrong, and why it is important to behave in a certain way.
entries.translation: Waelezee kitu sahihi na kitu kisicho sahihi, na kwa nini ni muhimu kuwa na tabia fulani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to them about the consequences of their actions, both good and bad.
entries.translation: Ongea nao kuhusu matokeo ya vitendo vyao, matokeo mazuri na mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to give children opportunities to practice appropriate and safe behavior.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu pia kuwapa watoto wako fursa za kuwa na tabia mwafaka na salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done through games, role-playing, and other activities.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kufanyika kupitia michezo, kuwa na jukumu, na shughuli nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you can play a game of "What would you do?" with your child and ask them how they would respond to different situations.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, unaweza kucheza mchezo wa "Utafanya nini?" na mtoto wako na umuulize watakavyojibu hali tofauti tofauti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also role-play different scenarios, such as how to talk to a stranger or how to cross the street safely.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kucheza mchezo wa kuchukua jukumu la matukio tofauti, kama vile jinsi ya kuongea na mtu usiyemjua au jinsi ya kuvuka barabara salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By teaching children about appropriate and safe behavior, you can help them to become responsible and well-rounded individuals.
entries.translation: Kwa kuwafunza watoto wako kuhusu tabia mwafaka na salama, unaweza kuwasaidia kuwa watu wanaowajibika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also help them to avoid dangerous situations and make good choices.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kuwasaidia kuepukana na hali hatari na kufanya chaguo nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to teaching children about appropriate and safe behavior, it is also important to provide them with a safe and secure environment.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya kuwafunza kuhusu tabia mwafaka na salama, ni muhimu pia kuwapa mazingira salama na mazuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means making sure that your home is safe, that your child is supervised when they are playing outside, and that they are not exposed to violence or other harmful situations.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kuhakikisha kwamba nyumba yako ni salama, mtoto wako anaangaliwa wakati ambapo anacheza nje, na kwamba hawapo maeneo yenye vurugu au hali nyingine hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By providing your child with a safe and secure environment, you can help them to feel safe and loved.
entries.translation: Kwa kumpa mtoto wako mazingira salama na mazuri, unaweza kuwasaidia kuhisi kwamba wako salama na wanapendwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help them to develop a healthy self-esteem and to make good choices.
entries.translation: Hii itawasaidia kujiamini kwa njia nzuri na kufanya chaguo nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teaching children about appropriate and safe behavior is an important part of parenting.
entries.translation: Kuwafunza watoto tabia mwafaka na salama ni sehemu muhimu ya ulezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By setting a good example, talking to your child about behavior, and providing them with a safe and secure environment, you can help them to become responsible and well-rounded individuals.
entries.translation: Kwa kuweka mfano mzuri, kuongea na mtoto wako kuhusu tabia, na kuwapa mazingira salama na mazuri, unaweza kuwasaidia kuwa watu wanaowajibika katika kila jambo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Studies have shown that people who are married or in a committed relationship are more likely to be physically active than those who are single.
entries.translation: Utafiti umeonyesha kwamba watu ambao wameoana au wapo katika uhusiano wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuchangamka kimwili zaidi ya wale ambao hawana wachumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of possible explanations for this finding.
entries.translation: Kuna matarajio mengi yanayoweza kutokana na matokeo haya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One possibility is that married people have more social support, which can make it easier to stick to an exercise routine.
entries.translation: Uwezekano mmoja ni kwamba watu katika ndoa wana msaada zaidi wa kijamii, ambao unaweza kurahisisha kufuatilia sana utaratibu wa mazoezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, married people may have more financial resources, which can make it easier to afford gym memberships or other fitness-related expenses.
entries.translation: Isitoshe, watu katika ndoa huenda wakawa na rasilimali za kifedha, ambazo zinaweza kuwarahisishia kumudu kujiandikisha katika chumba cha mazoezi au gharama nyingine zinazohusiana na ustawi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, married people may simply have more time to exercise, as they may not have to worry about the same time constraints as single people.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, watu katika ndoa huenda wakawa na muda zaidi wa kufanya mazoezi, kwani huenda wasiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu vikwazo sawa vya muda vinavyofanana na vya watu ambao hawajaoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are also some studies that have found no relationship between relationship status and exercise.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, pia kuna utafiti mwingine ambao umepata kwamba hakuna uhusiano kati ya hali ya uhusiano na kufanya mazoezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These studies suggest that other factors, such as personality or socioeconomic status, may be more important in determining whether or not someone is physically active.
entries.translation: Utafiti huu unapendekeza kwamba vipengele vingine, kama vile nafsi na hali ya kiuchumi na jamii, huenda ni muhimu zaidi katika kuamua kama mtu atachangamka kimwili au la.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the research on the relationship between relationship status and exercise is mixed.
entries.translation: Kwa jumla, utafiti kuhusu uhusiano kati ya hali ya mapenzi na zoezi umechanganyana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the majority of studies suggest that married people are more likely to be physically active than those who are single.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, idadi kubwa ya utafiti inaonyesha kwamba watu katika ndoa wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuchangamka kimwili zaidi ya watu ambao hawajao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This finding may be due to a number of factors, including social support, financial resources, and time availability.
entries.translation: Matokeo haya yanaweza kutokana na vipengele kadhaa, vikiwemo msaada wa kijamii, rasilimali za kifedha, na upatikanaji wa muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to note that the relationship between relationship status and exercise is not always straightforward.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba uhusiano kati ya hali ya mapenzi na zoezi kila mara huwa si wa moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, the relationship between relationship status and exercise may vary depending on other factors, such as age, gender, and socioeconomic status.
entries.translation: Isitoshe, uhusiano kati ya hali ya mapenzi na zoezi unaweza kutofautiana kutegemea vipengele vingine, kama vile umri, jinsia, na hali ya kiuchumi na kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the mixed findings, the research on the relationship between relationship status and exercise suggests that married people may be more likely to be physically active than those who are single.
entries.translation: Licha ya matokeo haya, utafiti kuhusu uhusiano kati ya hali ya kimapenzi na zoezi unapendekeza kwamba watu katika ndoa huenda wakawa na uwezekano zaidi wa kuchangamka kimwili zaidi ya wale ambao hawajaoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are single and looking to get more exercise, there are a number of things you can do to make it easier.
entries.translation: Iwapo huna mpenzi na unataka kufanya mazoezi zaidi, kuna vitu kadhaa unavyoweza kufanya ili kurahisisha kufanya mazoezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, try to find a friend or family member who is also interested in getting more active.
entries.translation: Kwanza, jaribu utafute rafiki au mwanafamilia ambaye pia anapendelea kuwa amilifu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Having someone to support you can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Kuwa na mtu wa kukusaidia kunaweza kuleta tofauti kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also join a fitness class or club, which can provide you with the motivation and accountability you need to stick to your exercise routine.
entries.translation: Unaweza pia kujiunga na darasa au klabu ya kufanya mazoezi, ambayo inaweza kukupa motisha na uwajibikaji unaohitaji ili kufuatilia utaratibu wako wa zoezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make sure to set realistic goals for yourself.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, hakikisha umeweka malengo unayoweza kutimiza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to do too much too soon can be counterproductive.
entries.translation: Kujaribu kufanya kazi nyingi zaidi kwa haraka mno huenda kusizae matunda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Cleopatra who was very good at math.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na mwanamke mdogo kwa jina la Cleopatra ambaye alikuwa mzuri sana katika hisabati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved to solve problems and find patterns in numbers.
entries.translation: Alipenda kutatua matatizo na kupata miundo katika nambari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Cleopatra was working on a difficult math problem when she came across a solution that seemed too good to be true.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Cleopatra alikuwa anashughulikia swali gumu la hisabati alipokutana na jibu ambalo lilionekana kuwa zuri sana kuwa kweli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The solution was so simple and elegant that Cleopatra couldn't believe it was correct.
entries.translation: Jibu hilo lilikuwa rahisi na kubwa mno kiasi kwamba Cleopatra hakuweza kuamini kwamba lilikuwa sahihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But she checked her work over and over again, and it was always the same.
entries.translation: Lakini aliangalia kazi yake mara kadhaa tena, na jibu lilikuwa lile lile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cleopatra was so excited about her discovery that she couldn't wait to share it with her professor.
entries.translation: Cleopatra alifurahia sana kuhusu uvumbuzi wake kiasi kwamba hangeweza kusubiri kumwambia profesa wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But when she showed him her solution, he was skeptical.
entries.translation: Lakini alimuonyesha jibu lake, na alikuwa anashuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told Cleopatra that she must have made a mistake, because the solution she found was impossible.
entries.translation: Alimwambia Cleopatra kwamba ni lazima alikosea, kwa sababu jibu alilopata halikuwa linawezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cleopatra was disappointed, but she didn't give up.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that she had found the correct solution, and she was determined to prove it to her professor.
entries.translation: Alijua kwamba alikuwa amepata jibu sahihi, na alikuwa amejitolea kuidhinishia profesa wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She spent the next few weeks working on the problem, and she eventually found a way to explain it in a way that her professor could understand.
entries.translation: Alitumia wiki chache zilizofuata akitatua swali hilo, na hatimaye alipata njia ya kulieleza kwa namna ambayo profesa wake angeweza kuelewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Cleopatra finally showed her professor her new proof, he was amazed.
entries.translation: Cleopatra hatimaye alipoonyesha profesa wake ithibati yake mpya, alishangaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had to admit that she was right, and he apologized for doubting her.
entries.translation: Alilazimika kukubali kwamba alikuwa sahihi, na akaomba msamaha kwa kumshuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young man named Krishna who was always pessimistic.
entries.translation: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na mwanaume mdogo ambaye alikuwa anaitwa Krishna na sikuzote alikuwa msorajua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He never thought anything good would happen to him.
entries.translation: Hakuwahi kufikiria kwamba chochote kizuri kingewahi kumfanyikia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Krishna was walking through the forest when he came across a beautiful woman.
entries.translation: Siku moja, Krishna alikuwa anatembea katika msitu alipokutana na mwanamke mrembo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was sitting on a rock, crying.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishna asked her what was wrong.
entries.translation: Krishna alimuuliza tatizo ambalo alikuwa nalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm lost," she said. "I was following a path, but it disappeared.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now I don't know how to get home."
entries.translation: Sasa sijui namna ya kufika nyumbani."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishna felt sorry for the woman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her not to worry, that he would help her find her way home.
entries.translation: Alimwambia asijali, kwamba angemsaidia kupata njia na kufika nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishna and the woman walked through the forest for many hours.
entries.translation: Krishna na mwanamke huyo walitembea katika msitu huo kwa saa kadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, they came to a clearing.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, walifika katika eneo ambalo lilikuwa limefwekwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the middle of the clearing was a small village.
entries.translation: Katikati ya eneo hilo ambalo limefyekwa kulikuwa na kijiji kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's my village!" the woman said. "Thank you so much for helping me."
entries.translation: "Hicho ni kijiji changu"! mwanamke huyo alisema. "Asante sana kwa kunisaidia."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishna smiled. "You're welcome," he said. "I'm glad I could help."
entries.translation: Krishna alitabasamu. "Karibu," alisema. "Nina furaha kwamba nimeweza kusaidia."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishna turned to leave, but the woman stopped him. "Wait," she said. "I want to give you something."
entries.translation: Krishna aligeuka ili aende zake, lakini mwanamke huyo alimsimamisha. "Subiri," alisema. "Nataka nikupe kitu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman reached into her pocket and pulled out a small, golden object.
entries.translation: Mwanamke huyo alitia mkono kwenye mfuko wake na kutoa kifaa kidogo chenye rangi ya dhahabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
