entries.english: Educational opportunities and resources available for students who are not physically present at a school, typically for the purpose of completing a degree, have been increasing in recent years.
entries.translation: Fursa za elimu na rasilimali zinazopatikana kwa wanafunzi ambao hawaendi shuleni wao wenyewe, kimsingi kwa madhumuni ya kukamilisha digrii fulani, zimekuwa zikiongezeka katika miaka ya hivi majuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is due in part to the growth of online learning, which has made it possible for students to take courses from anywhere in the world.
entries.translation: Hii ni kwa sababu ya kukua kwa masomo ya mtandaoni, ambayo yamewezeshea wanafunzi kufanya kozi wakiwa mahali popote duniani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of different online learning platforms that students can use to complete their degrees.
entries.translation: Kuna majukwaa mengi tofauti ya kusoma mtandaoni ambayo wanafunzi wanaweza kutumia ili kukamilisha digrii zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular platforms include Coursera, edX, and Udacity.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya majukwaa maarufu zaidi ni Coursera, edX, na Udacity.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These platforms offer a variety of courses from top universities and colleges, and students can choose to take courses for credit or audit them for free.
entries.translation: Majukwaa haya yanatoa kozi mbalimbali kutoka vyuo vikuu na vyuo bora duniani, na wanafunzi wanaweza kuchagua kufanya kozi hizi ili kupata alama au kuzikagua bila malipo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to online learning platforms, there are also a number of other resources available to students who are not physically present at a school.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya majukwaa ya mtandaoni, pia kuna rasilimali nyingine nyingi zinazopatikana kwa wanafunzi ambao hawahudhurii masomo shuleni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These resources include online libraries, tutoring services, and writing centers.
entries.translation: Rasilimali hizi zinajumuisha maktaba, huduma za ukufunzi, na vituo vya kuandika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Students can also find support from online communities of other students who are also working to complete their degrees.
entries.translation: Wanafunzi wanaweza pia kupata msaada kutoka kwa jamii za mtandaoni za wanafunzi wengine ambao pia wanafanya kazi ili kukamilisha digrii zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The following is a quote from someone else about the benefits of online learning: "Online learning is a great option for students who want to earn a degree or certificate without having to attend classes on campus.
entries.translation: Ifuatayo ni dondoo kutoka kwa mtu mwingine kuhusu manufaa ya kusoma mtandaoni: "Masomo ya mtandaoni ni chaguo bora kwa wanafunzi ambao wanataka kupata digrii au cheti bila kuhitaji kuhudhuria madarasa chuoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also a good option for students who have busy schedules or who live in remote areas.
entries.translation: Pia ni chaguo zuri kwa wanafunzi ambao wana ratiba ngumu au wanaoishi katika meneo ya mashambani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If I had known that my best friend was cheating on me, I would have killed him with my belt.
entries.translation: Iwapo ningejua kwamba rafiki yangu bora alikuwa ananicheza, ningemuua kwa mshipi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would have wrapped it around his neck and strangled him until he was dead.
entries.translation: Ningeufunga kwenye shingo lake na kumnyonga nao hadi afe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would have felt no remorse, because he had betrayed my trust and broken my heart.
entries.translation: Singehisi huruma yoyote, kwa sababu alisaliti uaminifu wangu na kuvunja moyo wangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would have been filled with rage and hatred, and I would have wanted to make him suffer as much as he had made me suffer.
entries.translation: Ningejawa na ghadhabu na chuki tele, na ningetaka kumfanya ateseke kadri ambavyo amefanya niteseke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would have wanted to show him that there are consequences for cheating on your best friend, and that you can't get away with it.
entries.translation: Ningetaka kumuonyesha kwamba kuna athari za kumchezea rafiki yako bora, na kwamba huwezi kuponea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Crops and seeds are essential to life.
entries.translation: Mazao na mbegu ni muhimu kwa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide us with food, clothing, and shelter.
entries.translation: Huwa zinatupatia chakula, nguo, na makao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In order to grow healthy crops, we need to select the right seeds for our climate and soil conditions.
entries.translation: Ili kupanda mazao yenye ustawi, tunahitaji kuchagua mbegu mwafaka kwa hali yetu ya hewa na hali za mchanga wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also need to take care of our crops by watering them, fertilizing them, and protecting them from pests.
entries.translation: Tunahitaji pia kutunza mazao yetu kwa kuyamwagilia maji, kuyawekea mbolea, na kuyalinda dhidi ya wwadudu waharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers have been selecting and breeding crops for thousands of years.
entries.translation: Wakulima wamekuwa wakichagua na kupanda mazao kwa maelfu ya miaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have learned how to grow crops that are resistant to pests and diseases, and that produce high yields.
entries.translation: Wamejifunza jinsi ya kupanda mazao ambayo yanayostahimili wadudu na magonjwa, na ambayo huwa yanazalisha mavuno mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, farmers have also begun to use genetic engineering to improve crop yields and resistance to pests.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi majuzi, wakulima wameanza pia kutumia uhandisi wa jeni kuboresha mavuno ya mazao yao na ustahimilivu kwa wadudu waharibifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of growing crops is not without its challenges.
entries.translation: Mchakato wa kupanda mazao haukosi kuwa na changamoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers often have to deal with unpredictable weather conditions, pests, and diseases.
entries.translation: Wakulima mara nyingi huwa wanakabiliana na hali ya hewa isiyoweza kutabiriwa, wadudu, na magonjwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the rewards of growing crops can be great.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, tuzo za kupanda mazao zinaweza kuwa bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers can provide food for their families and communities, and they can also earn a living from their work.
entries.translation: Wakulima wanaweza kulisha familia zao na jamii zao, na wanaweza pia kupata riziki kutokana na kazi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to providing food, crops can also be used to create other products.
entries.translation: Zaidi ya kutoa chakula, mazao yanaweza pia kutumika kutengeneza bidhaa nyingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, cotton can be used to make clothing, and corn can be used to make ethanol.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, pamba inaweza kutumika kutengeneza nguo, na mahindi yanaweza kutumika kutengeneza ethanoli.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Crops can also be used to create biofuels, which can help to reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
entries.translation: Mazao yanaweza pia kutumika kuunza mafuta ya viumbehai, ambayo yanaweza kusaidia kupunguza kiwango ambacho tunategemea mafuta ya kisukuku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The importance of crops and seeds is undeniable.
entries.translation: Umuhimu wa mazao na mbegu hauwezi kukataliwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been waiting for this day for what feels like an eternity, and now it is finally here.
entries.translation: Umekuwa ukisubiri siku hii kwa kitu ambacho kinahisi kuwa ni cha milele, na hatimaye kiko hapa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can't wait to start your new life together as a family.
entries.translation: Huwezi kusubiri kuanza maisha mapya pamoja kama familia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The adoption process can be long and arduous, but it is all worth it in the end.
entries.translation: Mchakato wa kupanda mtoto unaweza kuwa mrefu na wa kuchosha, lakini unafaa juhudi zote mwishowe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you finally hold your child in your arms and say, "I'm your mom/dad now," you will know that it was all worth it.
entries.translation: Hatimaye ukimshika mtoto wako kwenye mikono yako na kusema, "Mimi ni mama/baba yako sasa," utajua kwamba juhudi zote zilifaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the gift of giving a child a loving home and the opportunity to grow up in a safe and stable environment.
entries.translation: Ni zawadi ya kumpa mtoto makao mazuri na fursa ya kukua katika mazingira salama na imara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a gift to the parents, who are given the chance to experience the joys of parenthood.
entries.translation: Pia ni zawadi kwa wazazi, ambao wamepewa fursa ya kupitia furaha za uzazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering adoption, I encourage you to do your research and find a reputable adoption agency.
entries.translation: Iwapo unazingatia kupanga mtoto, nakuhimiza ufanye utafiti wako na kupata shirika la kupanga mtoto lenye sifa nzuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of adoption agencies, so it is important to find one that is a good fit for you.
entries.translation: Kuna aina nyingi tofauti za mashirika ya kupanga mtoto, kwa hiyo ni muhimu kupata moja ambalo linakufaa vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The adoption process can be complex, so it is important to have a good support system in place.
entries.translation: Mchakato wa kupanga mtoto unaweza kuwa changamano, kwa hiyo ni muhimu kuwa na mfumo mzuri wa msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Kupanga mtoto ni kitendo kinachobadilisha maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a journey that is filled with love, laughter, and tears.
entries.translation: Ni safari ambayo imejawa na upendo, kicheko, na machozi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But it is a journey that is worth taking.
entries.translation: Lakini ni safari ambayo inafaa mtu achukue.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering adoption, I encourage you to take the leap.
entries.translation: Iwapo unazingatia kupanga mtoto, nakuhimiza uchukue hatua hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The government is a complex system that is responsible for managing a country's affairs.
entries.translation: Serikali ni mfumo changamano ambao unawajibikia kusimamia masuala ya nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is made up of different branches, each with its own set of responsibilities.
entries.translation: Ina matawi tofauti, kila tawi likiwa na majukumu yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The legislative branch makes laws, the executive branch enforces them, and the judicial branch interprets them.
entries.translation: Tawi la bunge hutunga sheria, tawi la serikali kuu hutekeleza sheria hizo, na tawi la mahakama hufasiri sheria hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The government also plays a role in regulating the economy, providing public services, and protecting the country from threats both foreign and domestic.
entries.translation: Serikali pia ina jukumu muhimu katika kudhibiti uchumi, kutoa huduma za umma, na kulinda nchi dhidi ya vitisho kutoka nje na ndani ya nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is an essential part of any society, and its effectiveness is critical to the well-being of its citizens.
entries.translation: Ni sehemu muhimu ya jamii yoyote, na ufaafu wake ni muhimu sana katika ustawi wa raia wake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the government can also be a source of oppression and corruption.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, serikali inaweza pia kuwa chanzo cha dhuluma na ufisadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it is not accountable to the people, it can become a tool for the wealthy and powerful to exploit the poor and marginalized.
entries.translation: Serikali kama haiwajibikii watu wake, inaweza kuwa zana ya matajiri na walio na mamlaka kunyonya watu maskini na waliotengwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is why it is so important to have a strong system of checks and balances in place to prevent the government from becoming too powerful.
entries.translation: Hii ndiyo sababu ni muhimu sana kuwa na mfumo thabiti wa kuchunguza na kuhakikisha serikali inawajibika ili kuzuia serikali dhidi ya kuwa na mamlaka kupika kiasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ideal government is one that is responsive to the needs of its people, while also being strong enough to protect them from harm.
entries.translation: Serikali nzuri ni ile ambayo inashughulikia mahitaji ya watu wake, huku ikiendelea pia kuwa nguvu ya kutosha ya kuwalinda dhidi ya hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I will have been collecting antiques for 20 years by the time I retire.
entries.translation: Nitakuwa nakusanya tunu kwa miaka 20 kufikia wakati ambapo nitastaafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have always been fascinated by the history and stories behind old objects, and I love the feeling of finding a unique piece that no one else has.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa nikifurahishwa mno na historia na hadithi za vitu vya kale, na napenda hisia ya kupata kipande cha kipekee ambacho hakuna mtu mwingine alicho nacho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My collection includes everything from furniture to jewelry to books, and I enjoy sharing it with others.
entries.translation: Mikusanyiko yangu inajumuisha kila kitu kuanzia fanicha hadi kito hadi vitabu, na nafurahia kuishiriki na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been a member of the Antiques Club for many years, and I often attend auctions and shows.
entries.translation: Nimekuwa mwanachama wa Chama cha Tunu kwa miaka mingi, na mara nyingi huwa nahudhuria minada na maonyesho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am always looking for new additions to my collection, and I am always learning new things about the history of antiques.
entries.translation: Huwa natafuta tunu mpya za kuongeza katika mkusanyiko wangu, na huwa najifunza vitu vipya kuhusu historia ya tunu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was once walking through the streets of Mysore when I saw a young boy sitting on the steps of a temple.
entries.translation: Nilikuwa nikitembea katika mitaa ya Mysore nilipomuona kijana mdogo akiwa ameketi kwenye ngazi za hekalu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was crying bitterly, and when I asked him what was wrong, he told me that he had lost his way.
entries.translation: Alikuwa akilia kwa uchungu, na nilipomuuliza kilichokuwa kibaya, aliniambia kuwa amepotea njia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took pity on him and offered to help him find his way home.
entries.translation: Nilimuonea huruma na nikajitolea kumsaidia kutafuta njia ya kurudi nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We walked together for a while, and I asked him about his life.
entries.translation: Tulitembea pamoja kwa muda, nikamuuliza kuhusu maisha yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told me that he lived with his parents and siblings in a small village outside of Mysore.
entries.translation: Aliniambia kwamba alikuwa anaiishi na wazazi na ndungu zake katika kijiji kidogo cha Mysore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He said that he loved to play cricket and that he dreamed of one day becoming a professional cricketer.
entries.translation: Alisema kuwa alipenda kucheza kriketi na kwamba alikuwa na ndoto ya kuwa mcheza kriketi mtaalamu siku moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I told him that I was sure he would achieve his dream if he worked hard and never gave up.
entries.translation: Nilimwambia kwamba nina uhakika atatimiza ndoto yake ikiwa atafanya kazi kwa bidii na kutokata tamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We eventually found his way home, and I was glad to see that his parents were so relieved to see him.
entries.translation: Hatimaye tukipata njia yake ya kurudi nyumbani, na nilifurahi kuona wazazi wake wakifarijika sana kumuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a small town in the middle of nowhere, there was a young girl named Sarah who had big dreams.
entries.translation: Katika mji mdogo uliokuwa katikati ya jiji, kulikuwa na msichana mdogo aliyeitwa Sarah ambaye alikuwa na ndoto kubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wanted to be a doctor, but there was no one in her town who could help her achieve her goal.
entries.translation: Alitaka kuwa daktari, lakini hakuna mtu yeyote katika mji wake ambaye anaweza kumsaidia kutimiza lengo lake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She decided to move to the city to attend college, but she soon realized that she was not the only one who wanted to leave.
entries.translation: Aliamua kuhamia jiji ni ili kwenda chuo kikuu, lakini punde si punde alitambua kwamba sio yeye pekee aliyetaka kuondoka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many of the brightest and most talented people in her town were moving away in search of better opportunities.
entries.translation: Watu wengi werevu na wenye talanta zaidi katika mji wake walikuwa wakienda mbali kutafuta maisha bora.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This "brain drain" was having a devastating effect on the town, as it was losing its best and brightest minds.
entries.translation: "Utoaji huu wa mawazo" ulikuwa na athari mbaya kwa mji, kwani ilikuwa inapoteza akili zake bora na angavu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah knew that she had to do something to help, so she started a program to encourage young people to stay in town and pursue their dreams.
entries.translation: Sarah alijua kwamba ni lazima afanye kitu ili kusaidia, kwa hivyo alianza mpango wa kuwahimiza vijana kubaki mjini na kutumiza ndoto zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program was a success, and many young people decided to stay in town and attend college.
entries.translation: Mpango huo ulifanikiwa, na vijana wengi waliamua kubaki mjini na kwenda chuo kikuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah's program helped to reverse the brain drain and revitalize the town.
entries.translation: Mpango wa Sarah ulisaidia kubadilisha utoaji wa mawazo na kufufua mji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A good mattress is essential for getting a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Godoro nzuri ni muhimu ili kupata usingizi mzuri usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A comfortable mattress can help to relieve pain, improve sleep quality, and boost your mood.
entries.translation: Godoro nzuri linaweza kukusaidia kupunguza maumivu, kuvoresha ubora wa usingizi, na kukuza hisia zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first mattresses were developed in ancient Egypt, where they were made from straw, reeds, and other natural materials.
entries.translation: Magodoro ya kwanza yalitengenezwa huko Misri ya kale, ambako yalitengenezwa kwa kutumia majani makavu, matete, na nyenzo zingine asili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the Middle Ages, mattresses were made from wool, feathers, and other animal products.
entries.translation: Katika Enzi za Kati, magodoro yalitengenezwa kwa pamba, manyoya, bidhaa zingine za wanayama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, mattresses began to be made from springs and other metal components.
entries.translation: Katika karne ya 19, magodoro yalianza kutengenezwa kutoka kwa springi na vifaa vingine vya chuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of mattress that is best for you depends on your individual needs and preferences.

entries.english: Some people prefer a firm mattress, while others prefer a soft mattress.
entries.translation: Baadhi ya watu hupendelea godoro imara, na wengine hupendelea godoro nyororo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to find a mattress that provides you with the support you need and that is comfortable for you to sleep on.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A good mattress can help to protect you from serious health problems, such as back pain, neck pain, and headaches.
entries.translation: Godoro nzuri linaeza kukuasidia kukulinda kutokana na matatizo makubwa ya kiafya, kama vile maumivu ya mgongo, shingo na kichwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also help you to get a better night's sleep, which can improve your mood, your energy levels, and your overall health.
entries.translation: Linaweza pia kukusaidia kupata usingizi bora usiku, ambao unaweza kuboresha hali yako ya hisia, viwango vyako vya nguvu, na afya yako kwa ujumla.

entries.english: Malawi is a country in southeastern Africa.

entries.english: It is bordered by Mozambique to the east, Tanzania to the north, and Zambia to the west.
entries.translation: Imepakana na Msumbuji kwa upande wa Mashariki, Tanzania kaskazini, na Zambia upande wa magharibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city is Lilongwe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is a developing country with a population of over 18 million people.
entries.translation: Malawi ni nchi inayoendelea iliyo na idadi ya watu zaidi ya milioni 18.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country's economy is based on agriculture, which employs more than 80% of the population.
entries.translation: Uchumi wa nchi unatokana na kilimo ambacho, ambao unaajiri zaidi ya asilimia 80 ya watu wote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The main crops are maize, tobacco, and sugarcane.
entries.translation: Mazao makuu ni mahindi, tumbaku, na miwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is also a major producer of tea and coffee.
entries.translation: Malawi pia ni wazalishaji wakuu wa majani ya chai na kahawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, Malawi has made progress in reducing poverty and improving living standards.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi majuzi, Malawi imepata maendeleo katika kupunguza umaskini na kuboresha hali ya maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country still faces a number of challenges, including high levels of corruption, unemployment, and HIV/AIDS.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, bado nchi inakabiliwa na changamoto kadhaa, ikiwemo viwango vya juu vya rishwa, ukosefu wa ajira, na HIV/AIDS.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2019, Malawi held its fifth presidential election.
entries.translation: Mnamo mwaka wa 2019, Malawi ilifanya uchaguzi wake wa tano wa urais.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The election was won by Lazarus Chakwera, who defeated incumbent Peter Mutharika.
entries.translation: Lazarus Chakwera alishinda uchaguzi huo, ambaye alimshinda aliyekuwa akishikilia nafasi hiyi Peter Mutharika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chakwera's victory marked a change in government after Mutharika had been in power for five years.
entries.translation: Ushindi wa Chakwera aliashiria mbadiliko ya serikali baada ya Mutharika kuwa madarakani kwa muda wa miaka mitano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chakwera has pledged to focus on improving the economy and reducing poverty.
entries.translation: Chakwera ameahidi kujitahidi kuboresha uchumi na kupunguza umaskini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He has also promised to address the country's high levels of corruption and unemployment.
entries.translation: Pia ameahidi kukabiliana na viwango vya juu vya ufisadi na ukosefu wa ajira nchini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is a beautiful country with a rich culture and history.
entries.translation: Malawi ni nchi nzuri iliyo na tamaduni na historia yenye mambo mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a post on Twitter, Gaiman wrote, "Had a great time at the concert tonight with my friends.
entries.translation: Katika chapiisho kwenye Twitter, Gaiman aliandika, "Nilikuwa na wakati mzuri kwenye tamasha leo usiku na marafiki wangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The music was amazing, and the atmosphere was electric.
entries.translation: Muziki ulikuwa mzuri, na angahewa ilikuwa ya umeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It reminded me of the power of music to bring people together," he wrote.
entries.translation: Ilinikumbusha kuhusu nguvu ya muziki kuleta watu pamoja," aliandika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gaiman's comments reflect the growing body of research that suggests that music can have a positive impact on our social and emotional well-being.
entries.translation: Maonu ya Gaiman yanaonyesha ongezeko kubwa la utafiti unaopendekeza kwamba muziki unaweza kuwa na matokeo chanya kwa hali yetu ya kijamii na kihisia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Studies have shown that music can help to reduce stress, improve mood, and increase feelings of connection with others.
entries.translation: Uchunguzi unaonyesha kwamba muziki unaweza kusaidia kupunguza msongo wa mawazo, kuboresha hali ya moyo, na kuongeza hisia za uhusiano na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Music can also be a powerful tool for healing and resilience.
entries.translation: Muziki pia unaweza kuwa zana yenye nguvu ya uponyaji na ustahimilivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In his post, Gaiman also shared some of the specific ways that the concert impacted him.
entries.translation: Katika chapisho lake, Gaiman pia alishiriki baadhi ya njia mahususi ambazo tamasha hilo lilimathiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Junk food is a type of food that is high in calories, fat, and sugar, and low in nutrients.
entries.translation: Chakula kisicho la lishe ni aina ya chakula ambacho kina kalori nyingi, mfuta, sukari nyingi, na virutubishi vidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often made with processed ingredients and is typically consumed in large quantities.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi hutengenezwa na viambato vilivyochakatwa na kawaida huliwa kwa kiasi kikubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Junk food can be addictive, and it can lead to a number of health problems, including obesity, heart disease, and type 2 diabetes.
entries.translation: Vykula visivyi na lishe vinaweza kuraibisha, na vinaweza kusababisha matatizo kadhaa ya kiafya, ikiwemo kuwa mnene sana, ugonjwa wa moyo, na ugonjwa wa kisukari cha aina ya 2.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of junk food, including candy, chips, soda, and fast food.
entries.translation: Kuna aina nyingi tofauti za vyakula visivyo la lishe, vikiwemo peremende, chipsi, soda, na vyakula vinavyotengenezwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These foods are often brightly colored and heavily marketed to children.
entries.translation: Mara nyingi vyakula hivi huwa na rangi angavu na huuzwa sana kw watoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also typically very cheap, which makes them a popular choice for people on a budget.
entries.translation: Pia kwa kawaida huwa ya bei nafuu, ambayo inawafanya kuwa chaguo maarufu kwa watu wanaozingatia bajeti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Junk food can be a problem for people of all ages, but it is especially harmful to children.
entries.translation: Chakula kisicho na lishe kinaweza kuwa tatizo kwa watu wa rika zote, lakini ni hatari sana kwa watoto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children who eat a lot of junk food are more likely to be overweight or obese, and they are also more likely to develop health problems later in life.
entries.translation: Watoto wanaokula chakula kisicho na lishe wana uwezekano mkubwa wa kuwa na uzito au unene kupita kiasi, na pia wana uwezekano wa kupata matatizo ya kiafya baadaye maishani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to help reduce the consumption of junk food.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa ambayo yanaweza kudanywa ili kusaidia kupunguza ulaji wa vyakula visivyo na lishe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Parents can talk to their children about the importance of eating healthy foods, and they can make sure that healthy foods are available in the home.
entries.translation: Wazazi wanaweza kuzungumza na watoto wao kuhusu umuhimu wa kula vyakula vyenye lishe, na wanaweza kuhakikisha kuwa vyakula hivyo vinapatikana nyumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Schools can offer healthier options in their cafeterias, and they can educate students about the dangers of junk food.
entries.translation: Shule zinaweza kutoa machaguo ya vyakula vyenye lishe kwenye mikahawa yao, na zinaweza kuelimisha wanafunzi kuhusu hatari za vyakula visivyo na lishe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Arranged marriages have been a part of the Indian culture for centuries.
entries.translation: Ndoa za kupanga zimekuwa sehemu ya tamaduni ya India kwa karne nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While they are often seen as a relic of the past, they are still practiced by a significant portion of the population today.
entries.translation: Ingawa mara nyingi huonekana kama kumbukumbu ya zamani, bado ya yanatekelezwa na watu wengi leo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, arranged marriages have come under fire from some critics who argue that they are outdated and discriminatory.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi majuzi, ndoa za kupangwa zimeshutumiwa na wakosoaji fulani ambao wanasema kwamba zimepitwa na wakati na zina ubaguzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, proponents of arranged marriage argue that they can be a positive way for two people to find happiness and fulfillment.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, watetezi wa ndoa iliyopangwa husema kwamba kunaweza kuwa na njia nzuri kwa watu wawili kupata furaha na uradhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the decision of whether or not to have an arranged marriage is a personal one.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, uamuzi wa kuwa na ndoa iliyopangwa au la ni wa mtu binafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no right or wrong answer, and what works for one person may not work for another.
entries.translation: Hakuna jibu sahihi au lisilo sahihi, na huenda kuwa kinachofaa kwa mtu mmoja kisifae kwa mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One anecdote that illustrates the complex and nuanced nature of arranged marriages is the story of Anju and Amit.
entries.translation: Hadithi moja inayoonyesha hali changamano na nyenye utata ya ndoa zilizopangwa ni hadithi ya Anju na Amit.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Anju was a young woman from a small village in India.
entries.translation: Anju alikuwa mwanamke kijana kutoka kijiji kidogo huko India.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always dreamed of finding a husband who loved her for who she was.
entries.translation: Daima alikuwa na ndoto ya kupata mume ambaye anampenda jinsi alivyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her parents had other plans for her.
entries.translation: Walakini, wazazi wake walikuwa na mipango mingine kwa ajili yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fashion can be defined as a constantly changing style in clothing, footwear, accessories, makeup, hair, and interior design.
entries.translation: Mitindo inaweza kufafanuliwa kama mtindo unaobadilika kila wakati katika mavazi, viati, vifaa, vipodozi, nywele, ubunifu wa mambo ya ndani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a form of self-expression and can be used to convey a person's personality, mood, and social status.
entries.translation: Ni aina ya kujieleza na inaweza kutumika kuonyesha utu, hisia, na hadhi ya kijamii ya mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fashion industry is a multi-billion dollar industry that employs millions of people around the world.
entries.translation: Sekta ya mitindo ni tasnia ya mabilioni ya dola inayoajiri mamilioni ya watu ulimwenguni kote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a major source of profit for many businesses.
entries.translation: Pia ni chanzo kikuu cha faida kwa wafanyabiasha wengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fashion industry is driven by a number of factors, including social media, celebrity culture, and economic conditions.
entries.translation: Sekta ya mitindo inaendeshwa na mambo kadhaa, yakiwemo mitandao ya kijamii, utamaduni wa watu mashuhuri, na hali ya uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Social media has become a powerful tool for fashion brands to reach new customers and promote their products.
entries.translation: Mitandao ya kijamii imekuwa zana madhubuti ya chapa za mitindo kufikia wateja wapya na kutangaza bidhaa zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Celebrity culture also plays a major role in shaping fashion trends.
entries.translation: Utamaduni wa matu maarufu pia una jukumu kubwa katika kuunda mitindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When celebrities wear a particular item of clothing, it often quickly becomes popular with the general public.
entries.translation: Wakati watu maarufu wanavaa kipengee fulani cha nguo, mara nyingi inakuwa maarufu kwa umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Economic conditions can also have a significant impact on the fashion industry.
entries.translation: Hali za kiuchumi pia zinaweza kuwa na athari kubwa katika sekta ya mitindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During periods of economic growth, people tend to spend more money on clothing and other fashion items.
entries.translation: Katika kipindi cha ukuaji wa uchumi, watu hutumia pesa nyingi kwa mavazi na vitu vingine vya mtindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During periods of economic recession, people tend to spend less money on fashion.
entries.translation: Katika nyakati za matatizo ya kiuchumi, watu hutumia pesa kidogo kwenye mitindo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fashion industry has a number of external influences, including the environment, politics, and culture.
entries.translation: Sekta ya mitindo ina vishawishi kadhaa vya nje, vikiwemo mazingira, siasa, na utamaduni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The environment can affect the fashion industry in a number of ways.
entries.translation: Mazingira yanaweza kuathiri tasnia ya mitindo kwa njia mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, environmental pollution can damage the materials used to make clothing.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, uchafuzi wa mazinfira unaweza kuharibu nyenzo zinazotumiwa kutengeneza nguo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "These long-distance walks and excursions are a great way to get away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life and enjoy nature.
entries.translation: "Matembezi haya ya muda mrefu na safari fupi ni njia nzuri ya kijiepusha na hekaheza za maisha ya kila siku na kufurahia mazingira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spending prolonged periods in the outdoors, typically in a tent or recreational vehicle, allows you to truly immerse yourself in the beauty of your surroundings.
entries.translation: Kutumia muda mrefu nje, kwa kawaida nje ya nyumba au gari la burudani, hukuruhusu kutafakari kabisa uzuri wa mazingira yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fresh air, exercise, and lack of pressure can do wonders for your mental and physical health.
entries.translation: Hewa safi, mazoezi, ukosefu wa shinikizo kunaweza kufanya mambo makuu kwa afya yako ya akili na kimwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are some challenges that come with these types of trips.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, kuna changamoto zinazotokana na aina hizi za safari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The weather can be unpredictable, the terrain can be difficult, and you may have to go days without seeing another person.
entries.translation: Huenda hali ya hewa haiwezi kutabirika, ardhi inaweza kuwa ngumu, na unaweza kulazimika kupita siku bila kuonana na mtu mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But these challenges are also part of the fun.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When they entered the cottage, they found the mean old woman sitting by the fire.
entries.translation: Walipoingia ndani ya nyumba hiyo, walimkuta mwanamke huyo mzee akiwa ameketi kando ya moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was knitting a scarf, and she didn't look up when the children entered.
entries.translation: Alikuwa akifuma skafu, na hakutazama watoto hao walipoingia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Hello," said one of the children. "Is anyone home?"
entries.translation: "Hujambo," mmoja wa watoto alisema. "Kuna mtu nyumbani?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mean old woman didn't say anything.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're just looking for a place to play," said another child. "Can we stay here?"
entries.translation: "Tunatafuta tu mahali pa kucheza," mtoto mwingine alisema. "Tunaweza kukaa hapa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mean old woman finally looked up at the children.
entries.translation: Hatimaye mwanamke huyo mzee aliwatazama watoto hao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can have a significant impact on a person's physical and mental health.
entries.translation: "Kukosa usingizi ni tatizo la kawaida la kulala ambalo linaweza kuwa na athari kubwa kwa afya ya mwili na akili ya mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is estimated that up to 30% of adults experience insomnia at some point in their lives.
entries.translation: Inakadirikiwa kuwa hadi asilimia 30 ya watu wazima hukosa usingizi wakati fulani maishani mwao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insomnia can be caused by a variety of factors, including stress, anxiety, depression, and medical conditions.
entries.translation: Kukosa usingizi kunaweza kusababishwa na mambo mbalimali, yakiwemo msogo wa mawazo, mfadhaiko, na hali ya kiafya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of different treatments for insomnia, including cognitive-behavioral therapy, relaxation techniques, and medication.
entries.translation: Kuna idadi ya matibabu tofauti ya kukosa usingizi, ikiwemo matibabu ya utambuzi wa kitabia, mbinu za kupumzika, na dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, for some people, insomnia may be so severe that it interferes with their ability to work, go to school, or socialize.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, kwa baadhi ya watu, kukosa usingizi kunaweza kuwa kali sana hivi kwamba kunatatiza uwezo wao wa kufanya kazi, kwenda shule, au kuingiliana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In these cases, it may be necessary to seek professional help.
entries.translation: Katika hali kama hizo, inaweza kuwa muhimu kutafuta msaada wa mtaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Researchers are currently studying the potential role of commerce in the development of insomnia.
entries.translation: Watafiti kwa sasa wanasoma kuhusu jukumu linalowezekana la biashara katika maendeleo ya kukosa usingizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One study found that people who were exposed to more commercial activity at night were more likely to experience insomnia.
entries.translation: Utafiti mmoja uligundua kuwa watu ambao walifanya shughuli nyingi za kibiashara wakati wa usiku walikuwa na uwezekano mkubwa wa kukosa usingizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This may be because commercial activity can create noise and light pollution, which can disrupt sleep.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa kwa sababu shughuli za kibiashara zinaweza kusababisha kelele na uchafuzi wa mwangaza, jambo ambalo linaweza kutatiza usingizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another study found that people who were exposed to more commercial activity during the day were more likely to experience insomnia at night.
entries.translation: Utafiti mwingine uligundua kuwa watu ambao walifanya shughuli za kibiashara wakati wa mchana walikuwa na uwezekano wa kukosa usingizi usiku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This may be because commercial activity can increase stress levels, which can make it difficult to fall asleep.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kuwa kwa sababu shughuli za kibiashara zinaweza kuonyesha viwango vya msogo wa mawazo, jambo ambalo linaweza kufanya iwe ngumu kulala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The findings of these studies suggest that there may be a link between commerce and insomnia.
entries.translation: Matokeo ya utafiti huu unapendekeza kwamba kunaweza kuwa na kiungo kati ya biashara na kukosa usingizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts and crop failure can have a devastating impact on food security, livelihoods, and the economy.
entries.translation: Ukame na kuharibika kwa mazao kunaweza kuwa na athari mbaya kwa usalama wa chakula, maisha, na uchumi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the world has experienced a number of severe droughts, which have led to crop failures and food shortages.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi majuzi, dunia imekumbwa na ukame mwingi, ambao umesababisha mazao kuharibika na uhaba wa chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These droughts have caused widespread fear and anxiety, as people worry about how they will feed their families.
entries.translation: Ukame huu umesababisha hofu na wasiwasi ulioenea, huku watu wakiwa na wasiwasi wa jinsi watakavyolisha familia zao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, governments have been forced to take drastic measures to address the impact of droughts.
entries.translation: Katika baadhi ya matukio, serikali zimelazimika kuchukua hatua madhubuti ili kukabiliana na athari za ukame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, in 2011, the government of Ethiopia declared a state of emergency in response to a severe drought that had caused widespread crop failure.
entries.translation: Kwa mfano, mwaka wa 2011, serikali ya Ethiopia ilitangaza hali ya hatari katika kukabiliana na ukame mkubwa ambao ulikuwa umesababisha uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The government provided emergency food aid to millions of people, and it also implemented a number of measures to help farmers cope with the drought.
entries.translation: Serikali ilitoa msaada wa dharura wa chakula kwa mamilioni ya watum na pia ilitekeleza idadi kadhaa ya hatua za kuwasaidia wakulima kukabiliana na ukame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These measures included providing seeds and fertilizers, and building irrigation canals.
entries.translation: Hatua hizi zilijumuisha kutoa mbegu na mbolea, na kujenga mifereji ya kumwaga maji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these measures, the drought had a devastating impact on the country's economy.
entries.translation: Licha ya hatua hizo, ukame huo uliathiri vibaya uchumi wa nchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The agricultural sector was severely affected, and many farmers were forced to abandon their land.
entries.translation: Sekta ya kilimo iliathiriwa sana, na wakulima wengi walilazimika kutelekeza ardhi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought also led to a sharp increase in food prices, which made it difficult for many people to afford food.
entries.translation: Ukame huo pia ulisababisha bei ya chakula kuongezeka kwa kasi, jambo ambalo lilifanya iwe vigumu kwa watu wengi kumudu kununua chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The impact of droughts and crop failure is not limited to the countries that are directly affected.
entries.translation: Athari ya ukame na mimea kuharibika haziko tu kwa nchi ambazo zimeathirika moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear Sonya, I hope this letter finds you well.
entries.translation: Mpendwa Sonya, natumai barua hii itakupata ukiwa vyema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been good this year.
entries.translation: Ninakuandikia kutoka kwenye shamba la familia yetu, ambapo mavuno yamekuwa mazuri mwaka huu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are grateful for the bountiful crops, and we are working hard to ensure that they are distributed to those who need them most.
entries.translation: Tunashukuru kwa mazao mengi, na tunajitahidi kuhakikisha kwamba yanagawiwa wale wanaohitaji zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As you know, food production is a complex issue.
entries.translation: Kama unavyojua, uzalishaji wa chakula ni suala tata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors that contribute to the rate at which food is produced, including the availability of land, water, and other resources.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi yanayochangia kiwango cha uzalishaji wa chakula, yakiwemo upatikanaji wa ardhi, maji na rasilimali nyinginezo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the global population has been growing rapidly, which has put a strain on our ability to produce enough food to meet the demand.
entries.translation: Katika miaka ya hivi karibuni, idadi ya watu duniani imekuwa ikiongezeka kwa kasi, jambo ambalo limeweka mkazo kwenye uwezo wetu wa kuzalisha chakula cha kutosha ili kukidhi mahitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to address this challenge is to build sustainable food systems.
entries.translation: Njia mojawapo ya kukabiliana na changamoto hii ni kuunda mifumo endelevu ya chakula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sustainable food systems are those that are able to meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
entries.translation: Mifumo endelevu ya chakula ni ile ambayo inaweza kukidhi mahitaji ya sasa bila kuathiri uwezo wa vizazi vijavyo kukidhi mahitaji yao wenyewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that sustainable food systems must be environmentally sound, economically viable, and socially just.
entries.translation: Hii inamaana kwamba lazima mifumo endelevu ya chakula iwe inafaa kimazingira, yenye manufaa kiuchumu, na inayozingatia haki za kijamii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here on our farm, we are working to build a sustainable food system by using organic farming practices, conserving water, and reducing our carbon footprint.
entries.translation: Hapa kwenye shamba letu, tunajitahidi ili kuunda mfumo endelevu wa chakula kwa kutumia mbinu za kilimo asili, kuhifadhi maji, na kupunguza utoaji wa kaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are also working to connect with local consumers so that we can sell our produce directly to them.
entries.translation: Pia tunajitahidi kuungana na watumiaji wa ndani ili tuweze kuwauzia mazao yetu moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexuality is a fundamental part of human experience, and it plays a positive role in many aspects of our lives.
entries.translation: Ujinsia ni sehemu msingi ya maisha ya binadamu, na una nafanzi nzuri katika nyanja nyingi za maisha yetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be a source of pleasure, intimacy, and connection with others.
entries.translation: Unaweza kuwa chanzo cha furaha, urafiki wa karibu na muunganisho na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be a way to express ourselves and our creativity.
entries.translation: Pia inaweza kuwa njia ya kujieleza sisi wenyewe na ubinifu wetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many cultures, sexuality is celebrated as a natural and beautiful part of life.
entries.translation: Katika tamaduni nyingi, ujinsia husherehekewa kama sehemu ya asili na nzuri ya maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to more open and honest communication about sex, which can help to reduce shame and stigma.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha kuwa na mawasiliano wazi kuhusu ngono, ambayo yanaweza kusaidia kupunguza aibu na shutuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also create a more supportive environment for people who are exploring their sexuality or who are experiencing sexual difficulties.
entries.translation: Pia inaweza kuunda mazingira yanayofaa kwa watu ambao wanachunguza jinsia zao au wanaokabiliwa na matatizo ya kijinsia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, sexuality can also be a source of pain and difficulty.
entries.translation: Bila shaka, ujinsia pia unaweza kuwa chanzo cha maumivu na matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual abuse, assault, and harassment are all too common, and they can have a devastating impact on victims.
entries.translation: Dhuluma, shambulio, na unyanyasaji wa kingono ni mambo ya kawaida sana, na yanaweza kuwa na matokeo mabaya kwa waathiriwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these experiences are not the norm.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba matukio haya sio ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For most people, sexuality is a positive force in their lives.
entries.translation: Kwa watu wengi, ujinsia ni nguvu chanya katika maisha yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is one example of how sexuality can play a positive role in human culture: In many cultures, sexuality is used as a way to connect with the divine.
entries.translation: Huu hapa ni mfano mmoja wa jinsi ujinsia unavyoweza kuwa na manufaa katika utamaduni wa binadamu: Katika tamaduni nyingi, ujinsia hutumiwa kama njia ya kuungana na Mungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In Hinduism, for example, the god Shiva is often depicted in sexual union with his consort, Parvati.
entries.translation: Katika Uhindu, kwa mfano, mungu Shiva mara nyingi huonyeshwa katika muungano wa kingono na mke wake, Parvati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The newspaper is a vital part of any community.
entries.translation: Gazeti ni sehemu muhimu katika jumuiya yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It provides information on local events, news, and weather.
entries.translation: Hutoa taarifa kuhusu matukio ya ndani, habari, na hali ya hewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a source of entertainment, with crossword puzzles, comics, and advice columns.
entries.translation: Pia ni chanzo cha burudani, lililo na mafumo ya kujaza maneno, vichekesjo, na makala ya ushauri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, newspapers were the only way to get this information.
entries.translation: Hapo awali, magazeti yalikuwa njia ya pekee ya kupata taarifa hizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, we have many other sources of information, such as blogs and websites.
entries.translation: Leo, kuna vyanzo vingi vya taarifa, kama vile blogu na tovuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the newspaper still has an important role to play.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, bado gazeti lina jukumu muhimu la kutekeleza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a trusted source of information, and it is often the first place people go to learn about what is happening in their community.
entries.translation: Ni chanzo kinachoaminiwa cha taarifa, na mara nyingi ni mahali pa kwanza ambapo watu huenda kujua kuhusu mambo ambayo yanatokea katika jumuiya yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things about the newspaper is its availability.
entries.translation: Mojawapo ya mambo muhimu zaidi kuhusu gezeti ni upatikanaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers are available in stores, libraries, and online.
entries.translation: Magazeti yanapatikana katika maduka, maabara, na mtandaoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them easy to access for people of all ages and income levels.
entries.translation: Hii inafanya iwe rahisi kupatikana na watu wote na viwango vyote vya mapato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Blogs and websites, on the other hand, are not always as accessible.
entries.translation: Blogu na tovuti, kwa upande mwingine, hazipatikani kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may be difficult to find, and they may not be available to everyone.
entries.translation: Inaweza kuwa vigumu kuzipata, na hazipatikani kwa kila mtu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing about the newspaper is its longevity.
entries.translation: Jambo lingine muhimu kuhusu gazeti ni maisha yake marefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers can be saved and read for years to come.
entries.translation: Majarida yanweza kuhifadhiwa na kusomwa kwa miaka mingi ijayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them a valuable resource for historians and researchers.
entries.translation: Hii inafanya yawe rasilimali yenye thamani kwa wanahistoria na watafiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Blogs and websites, on the other hand, are often deleted or archived after a few years.
entries.translation: Blogu na tovuti, kwa upande mwingine, mara nyingi hufutwa au kuwekwa kwenye kumbukumbu baada ya miaka michache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes them less valuable for historical research.
entries.translation: Hii inafanya visiwe na thamani kwa ajili ya utafiti wa kihistoria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the newspaper is a physical object.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.
entries.translation: Furaha ni hali ya ustawi na uradhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a feeling of joy, satisfaction, and fulfillment.
entries.translation: Ni hisia ya furaha, uradhi, na utimilifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Happiness is often associated with positive emotions, such as love, gratitude, and hope.
entries.translation: Maranyingi furaha huhusishwa na hisia chanya, kama vile upendo, shukrani, na tumaini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to note that happiness is not the same as pleasure.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kutambua kwamba furaha sio sawa na ridhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pleasure is a temporary state of happiness that is often associated with physical sensations, such as eating a delicious meal or taking a warm bath.
entries.translation: Ridhaa ni hali ya muda ya furaha ambayo mara nyingi huhusihwa na hisia za kimwili, kama vile kula chakula chenye ladha au kuoga kwa maji moto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Happiness, on the other hand, is a more lasting state of well-being that is often associated with things like relationships, accomplishments, and personal growth.
entries.translation: Furaha, kwa upande mwingine, ni hali ya kudumi zadi ya ustawi ambayo mara nyingi huhusishwa na mambo kama vile mahusiano, mafanikio, na maendeleo ya kibinafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Oil and gas are fossil fuels that are derived from the remains of ancient plants and animals.
