entries.translation: Mafuta na gesi ni nishati ya kisukuku inayotokana na mabaki ya mimea na wanyama wa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fuels are found in sedimentary rocks and are composed primarily of hydrocarbons, which are compounds that contain hydrogen and carbon.
entries.translation: Mafuta haya kupatikana katika miamba mashapo na huundwa kimsingi na hidrokaboni, ambayo ni misombo ambayo ina hidrojeni na kaboni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Oil and gas are used to generate electricity, power vehicles, and heat homes and businesses.
entries.translation: Mafuta na gesi hutumiwa kuzalisha umeme, kuakisha magari, na kupasga joto nyumba na biashara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The global demand for oil and gas is growing rapidly, and this has led to increased exploration and production activities.
entries.translation: Mahitaji ya kimataifa ya mafuta na gesi yanakua kwa kasi, na hii imesababisha shughuli za utafutaji na uzalishaji kuongezeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the extraction of oil and gas can have a negative impact on the environment, including air pollution, water contamination, and land degradation.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, uchimbaji wa mafuta na gesi unaweza na athari mbaya kwa mazingira, ikiwemo uchafuzi wa hewa, uchafuzi wa maji, na uharibifu wa ardhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of alternative energy sources that are being developed, such as solar, wind, and nuclear power.
entries.translation: Kuna vyanzo kadhaa vya nishati mbadala ambayo inatengenezwa na vile nishati ya jua, upepo, na nishati ya nyuklia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sources of energy do not produce greenhouse gases, and they are therefore considered to be more environmentally friendly than oil and gas.
entries.translation: Vyanzo hivi vya nishaiti havitoi gesi chafu, na kwa hivyo huzingatiwa kufaa kimazingira kuliko mafuta na gesi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The future of oil and gas is uncertain.
entries.translation: Mustakabali wa mafuta na gesi hauna uhakika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The situation in South Sudan remains volatile, with continued fighting between government forces and rebel groups.
entries.translation: Hali nchini Sudan Kusini badi tet, huku mapigano yakiendelea kati ya wanajeshi wa serikali na makundi ya waasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict has caused a humanitarian crisis, with millions of people displaced from their homes.
entries.translation: Mzozo huo umesababisha mzozo wa kibinadamu, huku mamilioni ya watu wakilazimika kuhama katika makazi yao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United Nations has called for an immediate ceasefire and has warned that the country is on the brink of famine.
entries.translation: Umoja wa Mataida umetoa wito wa kusitisha mapigano mara moja na kuonya kuwa nchi hiyo iko kwenye ukingo wa baa la njaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent months, there have been some positive developments.
entries.translation: Katika miezi ya hivi karibuni, kumekuwa na baadhi ya maendeleo chanya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In March, the government and rebel groups signed a peace agreement, but this has yet to be implemented.
entries.translation: Mnamo mwezi wa Machi, serikali na makundi ya waasi walitia saini makubaliano ya amani, lakini bado hayajatekelezwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In April, the UN Security Council voted to impose sanctions on South Sudan, in an effort to pressure the government to end the violence.
entries.translation: Mnamo mwezi wa Aprili, Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa lilipiga kura ya kuiwekea vikwazo nchini Sudan Kusini, katika juhudi za kuishinikiza serikali kukomesha ghasia hizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The situation in South Sudan remains precarious, and it is unclear what the future holds for the country.
entries.translation: Hali nchini Sudan Kusini inaendelea kuwa na mashaka, na haijulikani jinsi mustakabali wa nchi hiyo itakavyokuwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is still hope for peace, and the international community must continue to work to support the people of South Sudan.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, bado kuna matumaini ya amani kuwepo, na lazima jumuiya ya kimataifa iendelee kufanya kazi ili kusaidia watu wa Sudan Kusini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Obesity is a major public health problem, affecting one in three adults in the United States.
entries.translation: Kunenepa sana ni tatizo kubwa la afya ya umma, linaloathiri mtu mzima mmoja kati ya watatu nchini Marekani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors that contribute to obesity, including genetics, diet, and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Kuna mambo mengi yanayochangua kunenepa sana, yakiwemo jenitiki, lishe, na mtindo wa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While there is no one-size-fits-all solution to weight loss, there are a number of things that people can do to adopt healthier habits and lose weight.
entries.translation: Ingawa hakuna suluhisho moja la kupoteza uzito, kuna mambo kadhaa ambayo watu wanaweza kufanya ili kuafuata mazoea yenye afya na kupunguza uzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One important step is to see a specialist, such as a doctor or dietitian, who can help you develop a personalized weight loss plan.
entries.translation: Hatua moja muhimu ni kutenbelea mtaalamu, kama vile daktari au mtaalamu wa lishe, ambaye anaweza kukusaidia kuunda mpango uliobinafsishwa wa kupunguza uzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This plan will take into account your individual needs and goals, and will help you make gradual changes to your diet and lifestyle that are sustainable over the long term.
entries.translation: Mpango huu utazingatia mahitaji na malengo yako binafsi, na utakusaidia kufanya mabadiliko ya polepole kwa lishe na mtindo wako wa maisha ambao ni endelevu kwa muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important step is to adopt healthier habits.
entries.translation: Hatua nyingine muhimu ni kuwa na mazoea yenye afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes eating a healthy diet, getting regular exercise, and getting enough sleep.
entries.translation: Hii inajumuisja kula vyakula vyenye lishe, kufanya mazoezi mara kwa mara, na kupata usingizi wa kutosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Making small changes to your lifestyle, such as cutting out sugary drinks and processed foods, and walking for 30 minutes every day, can make a big difference over time.
entries.translation: Kufanya mabadiliko madogo kwenye mtindo wako wa maisha, kama vile kupunguza vinywaji vyenye sukari na vyakula vilivyochakatwa, na kutembea kwa dakika 30 kila siku, kunaweza kuleta mabadiliko makubwa baada ya muda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, it is important to be patient and persistent.
entries.translation: Hatimaye, ni muhimu kuwa mvumilivu na mstahimilivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Weight loss is a journey, not a destination.
entries.translation: Kupunguza uzito ni safari, sio mafikio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There will be setbacks along the way, but it is important to stay focused on your goals and keep moving forward.
entries.translation: Kutakuwa na vikwazo njiani, lakini ni muhimu kuendelea kuzingatia malengo yako na kusonga mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Human African Trypanosomiasis is primarily found in rural Africa and is transmitted through the bite of the tsetse fly.
entries.translation: Human African Trypanosomiasis kwa kawaida hupatikana vijijini mwa Afrika na huenezwa kupitia kuumwa na mbung'o.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have you recently travelled to sub-Saharan Africa?
entries.translation: Je, umesafiri kwenda Afrika Kusini mwa Sahara hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial to see a doctor to get a proper diagnosis.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu sana kumtembelea daktari ili kupata utambuzi sahihi wa tatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will likely ask you detailed questions about your symptoms, medical history, travel history, and lifestyle.
entries.translation: Yamkini atakuuliza maswali ya kina kuhusu dalili, historia ya matibabu, historia ya kusafiri na mtindo wako wa maisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might also recommend some tests, like blood work, to rule out other potential causes.
entries.translation: Anaweza pia kupendekeza vipimo fulani kama vile vipimo vya damu ili kutupilia mbali sababu nyingine zinazowezekana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not self-treat or attempt to diagnose yourself with sleeping sickness.
entries.translation: Usijitibu au kujaribu kubaini mwenyewe kwamba una ugonjwa wa malale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a serious disease that requires specialized medical care and specific medications.
entries.translation: Ni ugonjwa hatari unaohitaji matibabu maalum na dawa maalum.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to treat it yourself could delay a proper diagnosis and treatment for the real cause of your symptoms.
entries.translation: Kujaribu kuutibu mwenyewe kunaweza kuchelewesha utambuzi na matibabu yanayofaa ya sababu halisi ya dalili zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, to manage your fatigue and sleep disturbances, your first and most important step is to schedule an appointment with your doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Hivyo, ili kudhibiti uchovu na matatizo yako ya kulala, hatua yako ya kwanza na muhimu zaidi ni kuratibu miadi na daktari wako haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Explain your concerns and be honest about your symptoms.
entries.translation: Eleza wasiwasi wako na uwe mkweli kuhusu dalili zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the best resource to help you figure out what's going on and recommend the right course of action.
entries.translation: Yeye ndiye rasilimali bora zaidi ya kukusaidia kutambua kinachoendelea na kupendekeza hatua inayofaa ya kuchukua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, try to practice good sleep hygiene: maintain a regular sleep schedule, create a relaxing bedtime routine, and avoid caffeine and alcohol before bed.
entries.translation: Kwa sasa, jaribu kudumisha mazoea mema ya kulala: dumisha utaratibu wa kulala wa mara kwa mara, unda utaratibu wa kutuliza wa wakati wa kulala, na uepuke kafeini na pombe kabla ya kulala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female friend complains of bleeding, neck pain and thinks she has Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever and asks, I hope it is not a dreadful thing?
entries.translation: Swali: Rafiki yangu wa kike analalamika kuhusu kutokwa na damu, maumivu ya shingo na anafikiri ana Homa ya Kutokwa na Damu ya Kraimiani-Kongo na anauliza, Ninatumai si kitu kibaya sana?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to immediately go to a hospital or doctor.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie rafiki yako aende hospitalini au kwa daktari mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever (CCHF) is a serious viral disease and requires prompt medical attention.
entries.translation: Homa ya Kutokwa na Damu ya Kraimiani-Kongo (CCHF) ni ugonjwa mbaya wa virusi na inahitaji huduma za matibabu za haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to take chances with.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trying to self-diagnose or treat it is dangerous.
entries.translation: Kujaribu kutambua ugonjwa au kujitibu mwenyewe ni hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While bleeding and neck pain can be symptoms of CCHF, they are also symptoms of many other illnesses, some far less serious.
entries.translation: Ingawa kutokwa na damu na maumivu ya shingo yanaweza kuwa dalili za CCHF, pia ni dalili za magonjwa mengine mengi, baadhi ambayo si hatari sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor will be able to determine what's actually causing her symptoms and provide appropriate treatment.
entries.translation: Daktari ataweza kubaini hasa kinachosababisha dalili zake na kutoa matibabu yanayofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reassure her that getting checked out is the best course of action, regardless of the cause.
entries.translation: Mhimize tena kwamba kufanyiwa uchunguzi ndiyo hatua bora zaidi ya kuchukua, bila kujali sababu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial for CCHF and many other conditions.
entries.translation: Utambuzi na matibabu ya mapema ni muhimu sana katika CCHF na maradhi mengine mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My male neighbor complains of jaundice, fever, bleeding and thinks he has Yellow Fever and asks, What are the causes
entries.translation: Swali: Jirani yangu wa kiume analalamika kuhusu homa ya nyongo ya manjano, joto jingi mwilini, kutokwa na damu na anafikiri ana Homa ya Manjano na anauliza, Sababu ni zipi
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: While your neighbor's symptoms do overlap with Yellow Fever, it's crucial to understand that self-diagnosing is dangerous, especially with a serious illness like Yellow Fever.
entries.translation: Jibu: Ingawa dalili za jirani yako zinalingana na Homa ya Manjano, ni muhimu sana kuelewa kuwa kubaini ugonjwa mwenyewe ni hatari, hasa kwa ugonjwa hatari kama Homa ya Manjano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to see a doctor immediately for proper testing and diagnosis.
entries.translation: Anahitaji kutembelea daktari mara moja ili kufanyiwa vipimo vinavyofaa na kubaini ugonjwa unaohusika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus, which is spread through the bite of an infected Aedes aegypti mosquito.
entries.translation: Homa ya manjano husababishwa na virusi vya homa ya manjano, ambavyo huenezwa kupitia kuumwa na mbu wa Aedes aegypti aliyeambukizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These mosquitoes also transmit diseases like Zika and Dengue.
entries.translation: Mbu hawa pia hueneza magonjwa kama Zika na Kidingapopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not contagious from person to person.
entries.translation: Haiambukizwi kutoka kwa mtu mmoja hadi mwingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Essentially, the only cause of Yellow Fever is infection with the yellow fever virus transmitted by the bite of an infected mosquito.
entries.translation: Kimsingi, chanzo cha pekee cha Homa ya Manjano ni maambukizi ya virusi vya homa ya manjano vinavyoambukizwa kwa kuumwa na mbu aliyeambukizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no other way to contract it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to reiterate that your neighbor needs professional medical attention.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kurudia kwamba jirani yako anahitaji huduma za matibabu za kitaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms could be from a number of other illnesses, some serious, and delaying proper diagnosis and treatment can have serious consequences.
entries.translation: Dalili zake zinaweza kuwa zinatokana na magonjwa mengine kadhaa, mengine ambayo ni hatari, na kuchelewesha utambuzi na matibabu yanayofaa kunaweza kusababisha madhara mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills, headache and thinks she has Malaria and asks, Malaria is more common with people coming from Mozambique.
entries.translation: Swali: Mwanafunzi mwenzangu wa kike analalamika kuhusu joto jingi mwilini, baridi, maumivu ya kichwa na anafikiri ana Malaria na anauliza, Malaria hutokea sana kwa watu wanaotoka Msumbiji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So are you from there and how do you know you got it?
entries.translation: Je, unatoka huko na unajuaje kuwa unayo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "I understand you're not feeling well and are worried about malaria.
entries.translation: Jibu: "Ninaelewa kuwa hujihisi mzima na una wasiwasi kuhusu malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely important to take symptoms like fever, chills, and headache seriously.
entries.translation: Bila shaka ni muhimu kuchukulia kwa uzito dalili kama joto jingi mwilini, baridi na maumivu ya kichwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I can't diagnose you, and self-diagnosing can be risky.
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, siwezi kubaini tatizo lako, na kubaini tatizo mwenyewe kunaweza kuwa hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lots of illnesses share those symptoms.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for your question about where I'm from and my health, I’d prefer not to share personal details.
entries.translation: Kwa swali lako kuhusu ninakotoka na afya yangu, ningependelea kutoshiriki taarifa za binafsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most important thing right now is for you to see a doctor to figure out what's going on and get the right treatment.
entries.translation: Jambo muhimu zaidi kwa sasa ni wewe kumtembelea daktari ili kubaini kinachoendelea na kupata matibabu yanayofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can run tests to determine if it’s malaria or something else and give you the best advice.
entries.translation: Anaweza kufanya vipimo ili kubaini ikiwa ni malaria au kitu kingine na kukupa ushauri bora zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can be harmful, so please make an appointment as soon as possible."
entries.translation: Kuchelewesha matibabu yanayofaa kunaweza kuleta madhara, kwa hivyo tafadhali panga miadi haraka iwezekanavyo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, "What specific precautions or measures should I take to prevent malaria recurrence?"
entries.translation: Swali: Mwanafunzi mwenzangu wa kike analalamika kuhusu joto jingi mwilini, baridi na anafikiri ana Malaria na anauliza, "Ninapaswa kuchukua tahadhari au hatua gani mahususi ili kuzuia kupata malaria tena?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your classmate that it's crucial she doesn't self-treat and sees a doctor immediately for diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie mwanafunzi mwenzako kwamba ni muhimu sana kwake kutojitibu na kumtembelea daktari mara moja kwa ajili ya utambuzi wa tatizo na matibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria can be serious, even fatal, if not treated promptly.
entries.translation: Malaria inaweza kuwa hatari, hata kusababisha kifo, isipotibiwa haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suspecting malaria isn't the same as having a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.translation: Kushuku kuwa una malaria si sawa na kuwa na uwepo wa maradhi uliothibitishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once she has seen a doctor and if she is diagnosed with malaria and completes her prescribed medication, these are some precautions she can take to prevent recurrence:
entries.translation: Baada ya kumtembelea daktari na ikibainika kuwa ana malaria na kumaliza dawa zake zilizoagizwa na daktari, hizi hapa ni baadhi ya tahadhari anazoweza kuchukua ili kuzuia kuipata tena:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue preventative medication as prescribed: Her doctor may prescribe medication to be taken regularly during and after travel to malaria-endemic areas.
entries.translation: Kuendelea kutumia dawa za kinga kama zilivyoagizwa na daktari: Daktari wake anaweza kuagiza dawa za kutumia mara kwa mara wakati na baada ya kusafiri kwenda maeneo ambapo malaria hutokea mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s crucial to adhere to the prescribed regimen.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu sana kufuata kanuni za kutumia dawa alivyoagizwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Kuzuia kuumwa na mbu ni muhimu mno:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets (ITNs): Ensure the net is properly tucked in and has no holes.
entries.translation: Kulala ndani ya neti za mbu zilizotiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu (ITNs): Hakikisha neti imechomekwa vizuri na haina mashimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wear long-sleeved clothing and long pants, especially during dawn and dusk: Mosquitoes are most active during these times.
entries.translation: Kuvaa mavazi yenye mikono mirefu na suruali ndefu, hasa wakati wa mapambazuko na machweo: Mbu huzunguka zaidi katika nyakati hizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellents containing DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, or IR3535: Follow the instructions on the product label.
entries.translation: Kutumia kemikali za kuzuia wadudu zenye DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, au IR3535: Fuata maelekezo yaliyo kwenye lebo ya bidhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider using mosquito coils or insecticide-treated vaporizers indoors.
entries.translation: Kuzingatia kutumia koili za mbu au vivukisho vilivyotiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu ndani ya nyumba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate mosquito breeding grounds around her home: This includes removing standing water from flower pots, buckets, and other containers.
entries.translation: Kuondoa maeneo ya mbu kuzaana karibu na nyumba yake: Hii inajumuisha kuondoa maji yaliyotuama kutoka kwenye vyungu vya maua, ndoo, na vyombo vingine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, the most important first step is to encourage her to seek immediate medical attention.
entries.translation: Tena, hatua muhimu zaidi ya kwanza ni kumhimiza atafute huduma za matibabu mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: What precautions should I take to prevent the spread of typhoid fever to others, particularly my household members or close contacts?
entries.translation: Swali: Ninapaswa kuchukua tahadhari zipi ili kuzuia homa ya matumbo kuenea kwa wengine, hasa watu walio nyumbani kwangu au ninaoingiliana nao kwa karibu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Typhoid fever is a serious bacterial infection that can spread easily to others through contaminated food and water or close contact.
entries.translation: Homa ya matumbo ni maambukizi hatari ya bakteria yanayoweza kuenezwa kwa wengine kwa urahisi kupitia chakula na maji yaliyochafuka au kuingiliana kwa karibu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a breakdown of the precautions:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Handwashing: This is the single most important measure.
entries.translation: Kunawa mikono: Hii ndiyo hatua muhimu zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thorough handwashing with soap and water, especially after using the toilet and before handling food, removes bacteria and prevents transmission.
entries.translation: Kunawa mikono vizuri kwa sabuni na maji, hasa baada ya kutumia choo na kabla ya kushughulikia chakula, huondoa bakteria na kuzuia maambukizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Disinfecting Contaminated Surfaces: Typhoid bacteria can survive on surfaces.
entries.translation: Kusafisha Sehemu Chafu kwa Kemikali ya Kuua Vijidudu: Bakteria wa homa ya matumbo anaweza kuendelea kuwa hai juu ya sehemu mbalimbali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food Handling Precautions: Individuals with typhoid fever should not prepare or serve food for others while they are ill and for a period after recovery as determined by a healthcare professional.
entries.translation: Tahadhari za Kushughulikia Chakula: Watu wenye homa ya matumbo hawapaswi kuandaa au kuwapakulia wengine chakula wakati bado ni wagonjwa na kwa muda baada ya kupona kama itakavyoamuliwa na mtaalamu wa huduma za afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid Sharing Personal Items: Sharing personal items like towels, utensils, and drinking glasses can spread the bacteria.
entries.translation: Epuka Kutumia Vitu vya Binafsi na Wengine: Kutumia vitu vya binafsi kama taulo, vyombo vya kulia chakula, na glasi za kunywea vinywaji na wengine kunaweza kueneza bakteria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each individual should use their own dedicated items.
entries.translation: Kila mtu anapaswa kutumia vitu vyake mahususi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination: Typhoid vaccines are available and can provide substantial protection against the disease.
entries.translation: Chanjo: Chanjo za homa ya matumbo zinapatikana na zinaweza kutoa ulinzi mkubwa dhidi ya ugonjwa huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination is recommended for travelers to areas where typhoid is common and for individuals with close contact with a typhoid carrier.
entries.translation: Kuchanjwa kunapendekezwa kwa wasafiri wanaoenda kwenye maeneo ambapo homa ya matumbo hutokea mara kwa mara na kwa watu wanaoingiliana kwa karibu na mtu anayeweza kueneza homa ya matumbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prompt Treatment: Getting prompt medical treatment with appropriate antibiotics helps shorten the duration of illness and reduces the risk of complications and spread to others.
entries.translation: Matibabu ya Haraka: Kupata matibabu ya haraka kwa dawa za kuua vijasumu zinazofaa husaidia kufupisha muda wa ugonjwa kuwepo na kupunguza hatari ya matatizo na kuenea kwa wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also crucial to complete the full course of antibiotics even if symptoms improve.
entries.translation: Pia ni muhimu sana kumaliza kipimo kizima cha dawa za kuua vijasumu hata kama utapata nafuu kwa dalili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "It sounds pretty rough dealing with what you think is malaria multiple times.
entries.translation: Jibu: "Linasikika kuwa jambo gumu sana kukumbwa na unachofikiri ni malaria mara nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely worth getting checked out by a doctor each time to confirm the diagnosis and get the right treatment, because recurring fevers can be a sign of other things too.
entries.translation: Bila shaka ni jambo zuri kufanyiwa uchunguzi na daktari kila wakati ili kuthibitisha tatizo linalohusika na kupata matibabu yanayofaa, kwa sababu homa zinazotokea tena na tena zinaweza kuwa ishara ya mambo mengine pia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can sometimes mask the real problem.
entries.translation: Kujitibu mwenyewe wakati mwingine kunaweza kuficha tatizo halisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for prevention, there are a few things you can do, especially if you're in an area where malaria is common.
entries.translation: Kuhusiana na kinga, kuna mambo machache unayoweza kufanya, hasa ikiwa uko katika eneo ambapo malaria hutokea mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using mosquito nets, especially ones treated with insecticide, is really important.
entries.translation: Kutumia neti za mbu, hasa ambazo zimetiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu ni muhimu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, wearing long sleeves and pants, particularly during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active, can help.
entries.translation: Pia, kuvaa nguo zenye mikono mirefu na suruali ndefu, hasa wakati wa mapambazuko na machweo wakati mbu wanazunguka zaidi kunaweza kusaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also insect repellents containing DEET or picaridin that are effective.
entries.translation: Pia kuna kemikali za kuzuia wadudu zenye DEET au picaridin ambazo zina ufanisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can assess your individual risk and make sure you're aware of any potential side effects."
entries.translation: Anaweza kutathmini hatari yako binafsi na kuhakikisha unafahamu madhara yoyote yanayoweza kutokea."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor he needs to see a doctor immediately to get a proper diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie jirani yako kwamba anahitaji kutembelea daktari mara moja ili kupata utambuzi wa tatizo na matibabu yanayofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rift Valley Fever can be serious, and self-treating is dangerous.
entries.translation: Homa ya Bonde la Ufa inaweza kuwa hatari, na kujitibu mwenyewe ni hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for medical attention, he should take the following precautions to minimize the risk of spreading the disease (if it is indeed RVF):
entries.translation: Huku akisubiri kupata matibabu, anapaswa kuchukua tahadhari zifuatazo ili kupunguza hatari ya kueneza ugonjwa huo (ikiwa ni RVF kwa kweli):
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is paramount.
entries.translation: Kuzuia kuumwa na mbu: Hii ni muhimu mno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should use mosquito repellent containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 liberally.
entries.translation: Anapaswa kutumia kemikali ya kuzuia mbu yenye DEET, picaridin au IR3535 nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should wear long sleeves, long pants, and socks whenever possible, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Anapaswa kuvaa nguo zenye mikono mirefu, suruali ndefu na soksi kila inapowezekana, hasa wakati wa mapambazuko na machweo wakati mbu wanapozunguka zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito netting around his bed would also be helpful.
entries.translation: Kufunika kitanda chake kwa neti ya mbu pia kutasaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate standing water around his home where mosquitoes breed (e.g., flower pots, buckets, discarded tires).
entries.translation: Kuondoa maji yaliyotuama kandokando ya nyumba yake ambapo mbu wanazaana (k.m., vyungu vya maua, ndoo, matairi yaliyotupwa).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal contact precautions: Avoid contact with any animals, especially livestock, that appear sick or are dead.
entries.translation: Tahadhari kuhusu kugusa wanyama: Epuka kugusa wanyama wowote, hasa mifugo, wanaoonekana kuwa wagonjwa au waliokufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he must handle animals (e.g., he's a farmer), he should wear protective clothing, including gloves and a mask.
entries.translation: Ikiwa analazimika kushughulikia wanyama (k.m., yeye ni mkulima), anapaswa kuvaa mavazi ya kinga, ikiwemo glavu na barakoa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should not slaughter any animals himself and should report any suspicious animal deaths to the local veterinary authorities.
entries.translation: Hapaswi kuchinja wanyama wowote mwenyewe na anapaswa kuripoti vifo vyovyote vya wanyama vya kutilia shaka kwa mamlaka za afya ya wanyama za eneo lake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raw milk should not be consumed – it must be pasteurized.
entries.translation: Maziwa mabichi hayapaswi kunywewa - lazima yapashwe moto ili kuondoa vijidudu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hygiene: Frequent handwashing with soap and water is crucial, especially after handling animals or animal products.
entries.translation: Usafi: Kunawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji ni muhimu sana, hasa baada ya kushughulikia wanyama au bidhaa za wanyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid touching his eyes, nose, and mouth with unwashed hands.
entries.translation: Kuepuka kugusa macho, pua na mdomo wake kwa mikono ambayo haijaoshwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should also practice good hygiene when coughing or sneezing, covering his mouth and nose with a tissue or his elbow.
entries.translation: Anapaswa pia kudumisha mazoea mema ya usafi anapokohoa au kupiga chafya, kwa kufunika mdomo au pua yake kwa shashi au kiwiko chake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should avoid sharing personal items like towels, eating utensils, and drinking glasses.
entries.translation: Anapaswa kuepuka kutumia vitu vya binafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo vya kulia chakula na glasi za kunywea vinywaji na wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is particularly important for pregnant women, who are at higher risk of severe complications from RVF.
entries.translation: Hii ni muhimu hasa kwa wanawake wajawazito, ambao wana hatari ya juu ya kupata matatizo mabaya kutokana na RVF.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize to your neighbor again that these are precautionary measures and do not replace the need to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Msisitizie jirani yako tena kwamba hizi ni hatua za tahadhari na haziondoi hitaji la kumtembelea daktari mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A blood test is needed to confirm the diagnosis and appropriate treatment will be necessary.
entries.translation: Kipimo cha damu kinahitajika ili kuthibitisha ugonjwa na matibabu yanayofaa yatahitajika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, if he suspects he has RVF, he needs to inform local health authorities so they can monitor the situation and take appropriate public health measures.
entries.translation: Pia, ikiwa anashuku kwamba ana RVF, anahitaji kujulisha mamlaka za afya za eneo lake ili waweze kufuatilia hali hiyo na kuchukua hatua zinazofaa za afya ya umma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While malaria is a possibility, especially with travel to a malaria-endemic region, several other illnesses can cause fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Ingawa kuna uwezekano wa malaria, hasa kutokana na kusafiri kwenda eneo ambapo malaria hutokea mara kwa mara, magonjwa mengine kadhaa yanaweza kusababisha joto jingi mwilini, baridi na maumivu ya kichwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Depending on where she traveled, some of the possibilities include:
entries.translation: Kulingana na alikosafiri, baadhi ya matatizo yanayowezekana ni pamoja na:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other mosquito-borne illnesses: Dengue fever, Zika virus, Chikungunya virus, and West Nile virus all share similar symptoms with malaria.
entries.translation: Magonjwa mengine yanayoenezwa na mbu: Homa ya Kidingapopo, virusi vya Zika, virusi vya Chikungunya, virusi vya Nile Magharibi vyote vina dalili zinazofanana na za malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Viral infections: Influenza, common cold, COVID-19, and other viral infections can cause these symptoms.
entries.translation: Maambukizi ya virusi: Homa ya mafua, mafua ya kawaida, COVID-19 na maambukizi mengine ya virusi yanaweza kusababisha dalili hizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bacterial infections: Typhoid fever, urinary tract infections, and bacterial pneumonia can also present with fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Maambukizi ya bakteria: Homa ya matumbo, maambukizi ya mfumo wa mkojo na nimonia ya bakteria pia vinaweza kusababisha joto jingi mwilini, baridi na maumivu ya kichwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick-borne illnesses: Lyme disease, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, and other tick-borne illnesses can cause these symptoms, though headache is less prominent in some.
entries.translation: Magonjwa yanayoenezwa na kupe: Ugonjwa wa Lyme, homa ya vipele ya Rocky Mountain, na magonjwa mengine yanayoenezwa na kupe yanaweza kusababisha dalili hizi, ingawa maumivu ya kichwa hayatokei sana kwa baadhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat stroke/heat exhaustion: If she was in a hot climate and exerted herself, this could be a cause.
entries.translation: Mwili kupata joto kupita kiasi/mwili kuishiwa nguvu kutokana na joto jingi sana: Ikiwa alikuwa katika hali ya hewa yenye joto na kutumia nguvu nyingi, inaweza kuwa sababu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other less common infections: Depending on the region of travel, things like leptospirosis or brucellosis could be considered, although these are less common.
entries.translation: Maambukizi mengine yasiyo ya kawaida: Kulingana na eneo alikosafiri, mambo kama leptospairosisi au bruselosisi yanaweza kuzingatiwa ingawa haya si ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial that she tell her doctor exactly where she traveled and what she did there (e.g., hiking, swimming in fresh water, eating street food).
entries.translation: Ni muhimu sana kumwambia daktari wake mahali hasa alikosafiri na alichofanya huko (k.m., matembezi marefu, kuogelea kwenye maji yasiyo ya bahari, kula chakula cha mtaani).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information will help the doctor narrow down the possibilities and order the appropriate tests.
entries.translation: Taarifa hii itamsaidia daktari kuchuja sababu zinazowezekana na kuagiza vipimo vinavyofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important she doesn't self-treat and seeks professional medical advice.
entries.translation: Ni muhimu kwake kutojitibu mwenyewe na kutafuta ushauri wa matibabu wa kitaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to see a doctor immediately to get tested and treated if he does have malaria.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie rafiki yako amtembelee daktari mara moja ili apimwe na kutibiwa ikiwa ana malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to mess around with.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for his question about prevention, here's what you can tell him:
entries.translation: Kwa swali lake kuhusu kinga, hapa ni unachoweza kumwambia:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria prevention is multi-pronged and depends heavily on where he's travelling, as different regions have different mosquito species and resistance patterns.
entries.translation: Uzuiaji wa malaria unahusisha mikakati tofauti inayofanya kazi pamoja na unategemea mno anakosafiri, kwa kuwa maeneo tofauti yana aina tofauti za mbu na mielekeo tofauti ya kusikia na kutosikia dawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should consult a travel health specialist or his doctor for personalized recommendations, but generally speaking, here are the key precautions:
entries.translation: Anapaswa kushauriana na mtaalamu wa afya ya usafiri au daktari wake kwa mapendekezo yake binafsi, lakini kwa ujumla, hizi hapa ndizo tahadhari kuu:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Dawa za kuzuia malaria: Hizi ni muhimu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several different types, and the best one for him will depend on his destination, medical history, and other factors.
entries.translation: Kuna aina kadhaa tofauti, na bora kwake itategemea anakoenda, historia ya matibabu na mambo mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor needs to prescribe this, and it's often taken before, during, and after the trip.
entries.translation: Daktari anahitaji kuagiza hii, na mara nyingi hutumiwa kabla, wakati na baada ya safari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is the cornerstone of malaria prevention and includes:
entries.translation: Kuzuia kuumwa na mbu: Hili ndilo jambo la msingi katika kuzuia malaria na linajumuisha:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insect repellent: Use repellents containing DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%), or IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.translation: Kemikali ya kuzuia wadudu: Tumia kemikali za kuzuia wadudu zenye DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%) au IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apply to exposed skin and clothing, following product instructions.
entries.translation: Jipake kwenye ngozi ambayo haijafunikwa na mavazi, ukifuata maelekezo ya bidhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Long-sleeved clothing and pants: Wear loose, light-colored clothing that covers most of your body, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Mavazi yenye mikono mirefu na suruali ndefu: Vaa mavazi yasiyobana yenye rangi angavu yanayofunika sehemu nyingi za mwili wako, hasa wakati wa mapambazuko na machweo wakati mbu wanapozunguka sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Treat clothing with permethrin insecticide for added protection (don't apply directly to skin).
entries.translation: Nyunyizia mavazi dawa ya kuua wadudu ya permethrin kwa ulinzi wa ziada (usijipake kwenye ngozi moja kwa moja).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito nets: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets, ensuring they are properly tucked in and have no holes.
entries.translation: Neti za mbu: Lala ndani ya neti za mbu zilizotiwa dawa ya kuua wadudu, ukihakikisha kwamba zimechomekwa vyema na hazina mashimo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito-proof accommodation: Stay in places with screened windows and doors, or use air conditioning to keep mosquitoes out.
entries.translation: Nyumba ambayo mbu hawawezi kuingia: Kaa katika maeneo ambayo yana madirisha na milango iliyowekwa utando wa kinga au utumie kiyoyozi kuzuia mbu kuingia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider mosquito coils or vaporizers if needed.
entries.translation: Zingatia kutumia koili au vivukisho vya mbu ikiwa inahitajika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Environmental control: While this is more of a public health measure, being aware helps.
entries.translation: Udhibiti wa kimazingira: Ingawa hii kwa kiwango kikubwa ni hatua ya afya ya umma, kufahamu husaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Minimizing standing water around accommodations can reduce breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
entries.translation: Kupunguza maji yaliyotuama kandokando ya nyumba kunaweza kupunguza maeneo ya mbu kuzaana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of symptoms: Even with precautions, there's a small risk of contracting malaria.
entries.translation: Fahamu dalili: Hata ukichukua tahadhari, kuna hatari ndogo ya kupata malaria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Knowing the symptoms (fever, chills, sweats, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, nausea, vomiting) is crucial.
entries.translation: Kujua dalili (joto jingi mwilini, baridi, kutokwa na jasho, maumivu ya kichwa, maumivu ya misuli, uchovu, kichefuchefu, kutapika) ni muhimu sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he develops any of these during or after travel to a malaria-endemic area, he should seek medical attention immediately.
entries.translation: Akipata yoyote kati ya hizi wakati au baada ya kusafiri kwenda aneo ambapo malaria hutokea mara kwa mara, anapaswa kutafuta huduma za matibabu mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are essential.
entries.translation: Utambuzi na matibabu ya mapema ni muhimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, emphasize to your friend that seeing a doctor right away is the most important step right now for his health.
entries.translation: Tena, msisitizie rafiki yako kwamba kutembelea daktari mara moja ndiyo hatua muhimu zaidi sasa hivi kwa afya yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These prevention tips are for future trips.
entries.translation: Vidokezo hivi vya kinga ni vya safari za siku zijazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that since he suspects dengue fever, it's crucial he see a doctor immediately for proper diagnosis and management.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie jirani yako kwamba kwa kuwa anashuku kuwa ana homa ya kidingapopo, ni muhimu sana kwake kutembelea daktari mara moja kwa ajili ya utambuzi sahihi wa tatizo na udhibiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dengue can be dangerous, and complications can arise quickly.
entries.translation: Kidingapopo kinaweza kuwa hatari na matatizo yanaweza kuibuka haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for his appointment, he should:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: This helps the body fight the infection.
entries.translation: Kupumzika: Hii husaidia mwili kupambana na maambukizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to avoid strenuous activities.
entries.translation: Anahitaji kuepuka shughuli zinazohitaji nguvu nyingi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hydrate: Drink plenty of fluids, like water, electrolyte solutions, or broths, to prevent dehydration, which is a common dengue complication.
entries.translation: Kunywa Vinywaji: Kunywa vinywaji vingi kama maji, vinywaji vya elektroliti au michuzi ya nyama ili kuzuia kuishiwa maji mwilini, ambalo ni tatizo la kawaida linalotokana na kidingapopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain Relief: He can take over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen (Tylenol) to manage fever and pain.
entries.translation: Kutuliza Maumivu: Anaweza kutumia dawa za kutuliza maumivu za kununua bila agizo la daktari kama acetaminophen (Tylenol) ili kudhibiti homa na maumivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolutely avoid ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin, and naproxen (Aleve) as these can increase the risk of bleeding, a serious dengue complication.
entries.translation: Epuka ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin na naproxen (Aleve) kabisa kwani hizi zinaweza kuongeza hatari ya kutokwa na damu, tatizo baya linalotokana na kidingapopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Monitor for Warning Signs: He should watch closely for any warning signs like severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums, rapid breathing, or fatigue/restlessness.
entries.translation: Kufuatilia Ishara za Onyo: Anapaswa kufuatilia kwa karibu ishara zozote za onyo kama maumivu makali ya tumbo, kutapika tena na tena, kutokwa na damu kwenye fizi, kupumua kwa kasi sana, au uchovu/kuwa na wahaka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If any of these occur, he should seek immediate medical attention, potentially going to the emergency room.
entries.translation: Ikiwa lolote kati ya haya litatokea, anapaswa kutafuta huduma za matibabu mara moja, yamkini kwenda kwenye chumba cha dharura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito Control: Even though he's already likely infected, he should prevent further mosquito bites to avoid spreading dengue to others.
entries.translation: Udhibiti wa Mbu: Hata ingawa kuna uwezekano kwamba ameambukizwa tayari, anapaswa kuzuia kuumwa zaidi na mbu ili kuepuka kueneza kidingapopo kwa wengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means using mosquito repellent, wearing long sleeves and pants, and sleeping under a mosquito net.
entries.translation: Hii inamaanisha kutumia kemikali ya kuzuia mbu, kuvaa nguo zenye mikono mirefu na suruali ndefu, na kulala ndani ya neti ya mbu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize again that he needs to see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Sisitiza tena kwamba anahitaji kutembelea daktari haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This advice is not a substitute for professional medical care.
entries.translation: Ushauri huu hauchukui nafasi ya huduma za matibabu za kitaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: It's important to preface this by saying I am not a medical professional.
entries.translation: Jibu: Ni muhimu kuanza hili kwa kusema kwamba mimi si mtaalamu wa matibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to see a doctor, not ask the internet, especially since she believes she has multiple diseases.
entries.translation: Rafiki yako anahitaji kutembelea daktari, si kuuliza intaneti, hasa kwa sababu anaamini kuwa ana magonjwa mengi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-diagnosing zoonotic diseases is particularly dangerous as some can be serious if left untreated.
entries.translation: Kubaini mwenyewe kwamba ana magonjwa yanayoambukizika kati ya wanyama na wanadamu ni hatari sana kwani baadhi yanaweza kuwa hatari yasipotibiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can give some general information, but it should not be taken as medical advice.
entries.translation: Ninaweza kutoa baadhi ya taarifa za jumla lakini hazipaswi kuchukuliwa kama ushauri wa kimatibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To answer her question properly, she needs to provide more information to a doctor.
entries.translation: Ili kujibu swali lake vyema, anahitaji kumpatia daktari taarifa zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some common zoonotic diseases and associated risk factors include:
entries.translation: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya magonjwa ya kawaida yanayoambukizika kati ya wanyama na wanadamu na sababu za hatari zinazohusiana ni pamoja na:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Common Zoonotic Diseases & Associated Risk Factors:
entries.translation: Magonjwa ya Kawaida Yanayoambukizika Kati ya Wanyama na Wanadamu na Sababu za Hatari Zinazohusiana:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Ugonjwa wa Lyme: Huenezwa na kupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include spending time in wooded or grassy areas, having pets that go outdoors, and not performing regular tick checks.
entries.translation: Sababu za hatari ni pamoja na kukaa katika maeneo yenye miti au nyasi nyingi, kuwa na wanyama vipenzi wanaoenda nje, na kutoangalia ikiwa kuna kupe mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rocky Mountain spotted fever: Also tick-borne.
entries.translation: Homa ya vipele ya Rocky Mountain: Pia huenezwa na kupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Similar risk factors to Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Sababu za hatari zinafanana na za ugonjwa wa Lyme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Toxoplasmosis: Caused by a parasite often found in cat feces and undercooked meat.
entries.translation: Toksoplasmosisi: Husababishwa na kimelea ambacho mara nyingi hupatikana kwenye kinyesi cha paka na nyama ambayo haijaiva vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pregnant women and individuals with weakened immune systems are at higher risk.
entries.translation: Wanawake wajawazito na watu wenye mifumo dhaifu ya kingamaradhi wako katika hatari ya juu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gardening and handling cat litter are risk factors.
entries.translation: Kilimo cha bustani na kushughulikia takataka ya paka ni sababu za hatari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rabies: Transmitted through the bite of an infected animal (e.g., bats, raccoons, skunks).
entries.translation: Kichaa cha mbwa: Huambukizwa kupitia kuumwa na mnyama aliyeambukizwa (k.m., popo, rakuni, vinyegere).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include contact with wildlife, especially if the animal is behaving strangely.
entries.translation: Sababu za hatari zinajumuisha kugusa wanyama wa porini, hasa ikiwa mnyama anaonyesha tabia isiyo ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salmonella and Campylobacter: Bacterial infections often acquired through contact with contaminated food (especially poultry, eggs, and unpasteurized milk), reptiles, or contaminated water.
entries.translation: Salmonela na Kamplobakta: Maambukizi ya bakteria ambayo mara nyingi hupatikana kupitia chakula chafu (hasa nyama ya kuku, mayai na maziwa ambayo hayajapashwa moto ili kuua vijidudu), wanyama watambazi au maji chafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ringworm: A fungal infection that can be transmitted from animals (especially cats and dogs) to humans through direct contact.
entries.translation: Choa: Maambukizi yanayosababishwa na kuvu yanayoweza kuambukizika kutoka kwa wanyama (hasa paka na mbwa) hadi kwa wanadamu kupitia kugusana moja kwa moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psittacosis (Parrot Fever): A bacterial infection spread by birds, particularly parrots, parakeets, and pigeons.
entries.translation: Sitakosisi (Homa ya Kasuku): Maambukizi ya bakteria ambayo huenezwa na ndege, hasa kasuku, parakiti na njiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include handling infected birds or inhaling dust from their droppings.
entries.translation: Sababu za hatari zinajumuisha kushughulikia ndege walioambukizwa au kuvuta kwa pumzi vumbi kutoka kwa kinyesi chao.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Leptospirosis: A bacterial infection spread through contact with the urine of infected animals (e.g., rodents, livestock).
entries.translation: Leptospirosisi: Maambukizi ya bakteria yanayoenezwa kupitia kugusa mkojo wa wanyama walioambukizwa (k.m., wanyama wagugunaji, mifugo).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include exposure to contaminated water or soil.
entries.translation: Sababu za hatari zinajumuisha kugusa maji au udongo mchafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General preventative measures for zoonotic diseases often include:
entries.translation: Hatua za jumla za kinga kwa magonjwa yanayoambukizika kati ya wanyama na wanadamu mara nyingi hujumuisha:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular handwashing: Especially after handling animals, their food, or waste.
entries.translation: Kunawa mikomo mara kwa mara: Hasa baada ya kushughulikia wanyama, chakula chao au takataka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Safe food handling: Cook meat thoroughly, wash fruits and vegetables, and avoid unpasteurized dairy products.
entries.translation: Ushughulikiaji salama wa chakula: Pika nyama hadi iive kabisa, osha matunda na mboga, na kuepuka bidhaa za maziwa ambayo hayajapashwa moto ili kuua vijidudu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick checks: After spending time outdoors, thoroughly check yourself, your children, and your pets for ticks.
entries.translation: Kuangalia ikiwa kuna kupe: Baada ya kukaa nje, jiangalie, waangalie watoto wako na wanyama vipenzi wako kwa makini ili kuona ikiwa kuna kupe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccinations: Vaccinate your pets against rabies and other diseases.
entries.translation: Chanjo: Wapatie wanyama vipenzi wako chanjo ya kichaa cha mbwa na magonjwa mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also human vaccines for some zoonotic diseases (e.g., rabies).
entries.translation: Pia kuna chanjo za wanadamu za baadhi ya magonjwa yanayoambukizika kati ya wanyama na wanadamu (k.m., kichaa cha mbwa).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pest control: Control rodent and insect populations in and around your home.
entries.translation: Udhibiti wa wadudu na wanyama waharibifu: Dhibiti wanyama wagugunaji na wadudu ndani na nje ya nyumba yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid contact with wildlife: Do not handle or feed wild animals.
entries.translation: Epuka kugusa wanyama wa porini: Usishughulikie au kulisha wanyama wa porini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be cautious around unfamiliar animals, especially those exhibiting unusual behavior.
entries.translation: Kuwa mwangalifu unapokuwa karibu na wanyama usiowajua, hasa wanaoonyesha tabia isiyo ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Protective clothing: Wear long sleeves, pants, and closed-toe shoes in areas where ticks or other disease-carrying insects may be present.
entries.translation: Mavazi ya kinga: Vaa nguo zenye mikono mirefu, suruali ndefu na viatu vinavyofunika mguu mzima katika maeneo ambapo kupe na wadudu wengine wanaoeneza magonjwa wanaweza kuwepo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Tumia kemikali ya kuzuia wadudu yenye DEET.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, this is not medical advice.
entries.translation: Tena, huu si ushauri wa kimatibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to consult a doctor.
entries.translation: Rafiki yako anahitaji kushauriana na daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her concerns about having multiple zoonotic illnesses warrant professional medical evaluation.
entries.translation: Wasiwasi wake kuhusu kuwa na magonjwa mengi yanayoambukizika kati ya wanyama na wanadamu unahitaji tathmini ya kitaalamu ya matibabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's possible her symptoms have a different underlying cause altogether.
entries.translation: Inawezekana kwamba dalili zake zina sababu nyingine tofauti kabisa iliyopo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Encourage her to seek medical attention as soon as possible.
