entries.translation: Mhimize atafute huduma za matibabu haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, What is the best way to treat malaria?
entries.translation: Swali: Mwanafunzi mwenzangu wa kike analalamika kuhusu joto jingi mwilini, baridi na anafikiri ana Malaria na anauliza, Njia bora zaidi ya kutibu malaria ni ipi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: She needs to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Jibu: Anahitaji kutembelea daktari mara moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria is a serious illness and requires a proper diagnosis and prescription medication.
entries.translation: Malaria ni ugonjwa hatari na unahitaji utambuzi sahihi na dawa zinazoagizwa na daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can be dangerous and delay effective treatment, leading to complications.
entries.translation: Kujitibu mwenyewe kunaweza kuwa hatari na kuchelewesha matibabu yanayofaa, hivyo kusababisha matatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her to go to a doctor or clinic as soon as possible to get tested and receive the appropriate care.
entries.translation: Mwambie aende kwa daktari au kliniki haraka iwezekanavyo ili kupimwa na kupata matibabu yanayofaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that he absolutely should not attempt to self-treat suspected onchocerciasis with over-the-counter supplements.
entries.translation: Jibu: Mwambie jirani yako kwamba hapaswi kamwe kujaribu kutibu mwenyewe onkosaikayasisi inayoshukiwa kwa virutubisho vya kununua bila agizo la daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are no over-the-counter supplements that prevent or treat river blindness.
entries.translation: Hakuna virutubisho vya kununua bila agizo la daktari vinavyozuia au kutibu upofu wa mtoni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms (severe itching, blindness) are serious and warrant immediate medical attention from a qualified doctor.
entries.translation: Dalili zake (kuwashwa vibaya, upofu) ni mbaya na zinahitaji huduma za matibabu mara moja kutoka kwa daktari aliyehitimu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to be properly diagnosed and, if he does have onchocerciasis, receive the appropriate prescription medication.
entries.translation: Tatizo lake linahitaji kutambuliwa inavyofaa na, ikiwa ana onkosaikayasisi, kupokea dawa zinazofaa zinazoagizwa na daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can lead to permanent vision loss and other serious complications.
entries.translation: Kuchelewesha matibabu yanayofaa kunaweza kusababisha upofu wa kudumu na matatizo mengine mabaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: No, schistosomiasis is not a genetic disease and cannot be passed directly from parents to their children through genes.
entries.translation: Jibu: Hapana, shistosomayasisi si ugonjwa wa kijenetiki na haiwezi kurithiwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwa wazazi hadi kwa watoto wao kupitia jeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a parasitic infection caused by flatworms called schistosomes.
entries.translation: Ni maambukizi ya vimelea yanayosababishwa na minyoo bapa wanaoitwa shistosoma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You get it by coming into contact with contaminated freshwater where the parasite larvae live.
entries.translation: Unaipata kwa kugusa maji chafu yasiyo ya bahari ambapo viluwiluwi wa kimelea wanaishi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These larvae penetrate the skin and develop inside the body.
entries.translation: Viluwiluwi hawa huingia ngozini na kukua ndani ya mwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, while family members might be at higher risk if they share the same contaminated water source, it's due to shared environmental exposure, not inheritance.
entries.translation: Hivyo, ingawa wanafamilia wanaweza kuwa katika hatari ya juu ikiwa wanatumia chanzo sawa cha maji chafu, ni kwa sababu ya hatari ya mazingira ya pamoja, si urithi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should definitely see a doctor to get diagnosed and treated properly, as untreated schistosomiasis can lead to serious long-term health issues.
entries.translation: Bila shaka anapaswa kutembelea daktari ili tatizo lake litambuliwe na kutibiwa inavyofaa, kwa sababu shistosomayasisi ambayo haijatibiwa inaweza kusababisha matatizo mabaya ya afya ya muda mrefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reasons for visit: Peripheral vision loss
entries.translation: Sababu za kutembelea: Upotevu wa uwezo wa kuona pembeni
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You came to the urgent care clinic today because you noticed a sudden loss of vision in your side vision, also known as peripheral vision.
entries.translation: Umekuja kwenye kliniki ya huduma ya dharura leo kwa sababu umeona upotevu wa ghafla wa uwezo wa kuona kwa upande, pia unajulikana kama uoni wa pembeni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor examined your eyes and found that your visual fields, or the total area you can see, are restricted. This means you are having trouble seeing things out of the corners of your eyes.
entries.translation: Daktari amepima macho yako na kugundua kuwa eneo lako la kuona, au eneo lote unaloweza kuona, limepungua. Hii inamaanisha unapata shida kuona vitu kwenye pembe za macho yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several possible causes for peripheral vision loss, including:
entries.translation: Kuna sababu kadhaa zinazoweza kusababisha upotevu wa uoni wa pembeni, ikiwa ni pamoja na:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Glaucoma: A condition where increased pressure in the eye damages the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Glakoma: Hali ambapo shinikizo lililoongezeka ndani ya jicho huharibu mshipa wa macho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Retinal detachment: A serious condition where the retina pulls away from the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Kutoka kwa retina: Hali mbaya ambapo retina hujitenga kutoka nyuma ya jicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stroke or other neurological issues: Sometimes vision loss can be a sign of a problem in the brain.
entries.translation: Kiharusi au masuala mengine ya neva: Wakati mwingine upotevu wa uwezo wa kuona unaweza kuwa ishara ya tatizo kwenye ubongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Migraine aura: Temporary vision changes that can happen before or during a migraine headache.
entries.translation: Aura ya kipandauso: Mabadiliko ya muda ya uwezo wa kuona ambayo yanaweza kutokea kabla au wakati wa maumivu ya kichwa ya kipandauso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eye injury or inflammation: Trauma or swelling can affect your vision.
entries.translation: Jeraha la jicho au uvimbe: Kiwewe au uvimbe unaweza kuathiri uwezo wako wa kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor has referred you to an ophthalmologist, a specialist eye doctor, for further testing to determine the exact cause of your vision loss. It is important to see the ophthalmologist as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Daktari amekuelekeza kwa daktari wa macho, mtaalamu wa macho, kwa vipimo zaidi ili kubaini sababu halisi ya upotevu wako wa uwezo wa kuona. Ni muhimu kumuona daktari wa macho haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, please follow these instructions:
entries.translation: Wakati huo huo, tafadhali fuata maagizo haya:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do not drive until you have been cleared by the ophthalmologist. Your peripheral vision is crucial for safe driving.
entries.translation: Usiendeshe gari hadi utakapopewa ruhusa na daktari wa macho. Uoni wako wa pembeni ni muhimu kwa kuendesha gari kwa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be careful when walking or moving around, as you may not see obstacles in your path.
entries.translation: Kuwa mwangalifu wakati unatembea au kuzunguka, kwani unaweza usione vikwazo kwenye njia yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We understand this can be worrying, but please know that we are here to help you get the care you need. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Tunaelewa kuwa hii inaweza kuwa ya kutisha, lakini tafadhali jua kwamba tuko hapa kukusaidia kupata huduma unayohitaji. Ikiwa una maswali yoyote au wasiwasi, tafadhali usisite kuuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Ugh, more pills? I'm already rattling when I walk.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Lo, vidonge zaidi? Tayari natoa sauti kama kengele ninapotembea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Alright, doc. Just don't make me any more wheezy than I already am. This cashier job keeps me on my feet all day, and I can't afford to be out of breath.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Sawa, daktari. Usinifanye nipumue kwa shida zaidi kuliko nilivyo tayari. Kazi hii ya ukarani inanifanya nisimame siku nzima, na siwezi kumudu kuishiwa pumzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll definitely keep that in mind. Let's listen to your lungs and see if we can figure out what's causing the wheezing as well. It could be related to your heart or maybe even allergies.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hakika tutazingatia hilo. Hebu tusikilize mapafu yako na tuone kama tunaweza kugundua kinachosababisha kupumua kwa shida pia. Inaweza kuhusiana na moyo wako au labda hata mizio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Allergies? Maybe. The store has been really dusty lately.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Mizio? Labda. Duka limekuwa na vumbi sana hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's a possibility. We'll do a thorough exam and get to the bottom of both your foot pain and the wheezing. We want to make sure you can stay on your feet and keep working comfortably.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hiyo inawezekana. Tutafanya uchunguzi wa kina na kupata chanzo cha maumivu ya mguu wako na kupumua kwa shida. Tunataka kuhakikisha unaweza kusimama na kuendelea kufanya kazi kwa raha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thanks, doc. I appreciate it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Omari: Good morning, Mr. Adeyemi. It's good to see you again.
entries.translation: Dkt. Omari: Habari za asubuhi, Bwana Adeyemi. Ni vizuri kukuona tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: Good morning, Doctor. How are you?
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Habari za asubuhi, Daktari. Habari yako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Omari: I'm doing well, thank you. I see here you're scheduled for your flu shot and pneumonia vaccine today. How have you been feeling lately?
entries.translation: Dkt. Omari: Ninaendelea vizuri, asante. Naona hapa umepangiwa chanjo yako ya homa na chanjo ya pneumonia leo. Umekuwa ukijisikiaje hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: Not too bad, Doctor, not too bad. But I must admit, my memory isn't what it used to be. I've been forgetting things more often.
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Siyo mbaya sana, Daktari, siyo mbaya sana. Lakini lazima nikiri, kumbukumbu yangu siyo kama ilivyokuwa zamani. Nimekuwa nikisahau mambo mara kwa mara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Omari: I understand. We've talked about that a bit before. Memory changes can happen as we age, but it's good that you're bringing it up. Have there been any specific instances that worried you?
entries.translation: Dkt. Omari: Naelewa. Tumezungumza kidogo juu ya hilo hapo awali. Mabadiliko ya kumbukumbu yanaweza kutokea tunapozeeka, lakini ni vizuri kwamba unalitaja. Je, kumekuwa na matukio maalum yaliyokutia wasiwasi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: Well, the other day I went to the market and completely forgot what I needed to buy. And sometimes I struggle to find the right words when I'm talking to my grandkids.
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Kweli, siku nyingine nilienda sokoni na nikasahau kabisa kile nilichohitaji kununua. Na wakati mwingine ninapata shida kupata maneno sahihi ninapozungumza na wajukuu wangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: That sounds like a good idea, Doctor. I'd like to get to the bottom of this.
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Hilo linaonekana kama wazo nzuri, Daktari. Ningependa kujua undani wa hili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Omari: Excellent. We can set that up before you leave. In the meantime, getting these vaccinations is still important for your overall health, especially as we head into flu season.
entries.translation: Dkt. Omari: Vizuri sana. Tunaweza kupanga hilo kabla uondoke. Wakati huo huo, kupata chanjo hizi bado ni muhimu kwa afya yako kwa ujumla, hasa tunapoelekea msimu wa homa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: Yes, of course. I want to stay healthy for my family.
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Ndiyo, bila shaka. Nataka kubaki na afya njema kwa ajili ya familia yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Omari: That's the spirit. Let's get those shots taken care of first, and then we'll arrange that follow-up appointment.
entries.translation: Dkt. Omari: Hiyo ndiyo roho. Wacha tupate hizo chanjo kwanza, na kisha tutapanga miadi hiyo ya ufuatiliaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adeyemi: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Bwana Adeyemi: Asante, Daktari. Nashukuru kwa msaada wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Well hello there, Mrs. Mensah! It's been a while, hasn't it? How have you been holding up? It's 3 AM, what brings you here so late?
entries.translation: Daktari: Hujambo, Bibi Mensah! Umepotea sana, sivyo? Umekuwa ukiendeleaje? Ni saa tisa alfajiri, nini kimekuleta hapa usiku sana?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Mensah: Oh, Dr. Perez, it's my back again. It's been acting up something fierce, and I just couldn't sleep. I figured I'd try this free clinic since I heard they do those injections that helped me last time.
entries.translation: Bibi Mensah: Oh, Daktari Perez, ni mgongo wangu tena. Umekuwa ukinisumbua sana, na sikuweza kulala kabisa. Nimefikiria kujaribu kliniki hii ya bure kwani nimesikia wanatoa zile sindano zilizonisaidia mara ya mwisho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Ah, I see. Back pain can be a real nuisance, especially at night. Let's take a look and see what we can do. How long has it been bothering you this time?
entries.translation: Daktari: Ah, nimeelewa. Maumivu ya mgongo yanaweza kuwa kero kweli, hasa usiku. Hebu tuangalie tuone tunaweza kufanya nini. Umekuwa ukikusumbua kwa muda gani sasa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Mensah: Oh, it's been a few weeks now, but it really flared up tonight. I tried taking some ibuprofen, but it didn't touch it.
entries.translation: Bibi Mensah: Oh, ni wiki chache sasa, lakini leo usiku yamezidi sana. Nilijaribu kumeza ibuprofen, lakini haikusaidia chochote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand. Let's get you comfortable and see if we can get that pain under control. Have you been having any other symptoms, like numbness or tingling?
entries.translation: Daktari: Naelewa. Hebu tukupumzishe vizuri na tuone kama tunaweza kudhibiti maumivu hayo. Je, umekuwa na dalili nyingine zozote, kama kufa ganzi au kuwasha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Mensah: No, just this awful ache in my lower back. It radiates down my leg sometimes, but mostly it's just right there in the center.
entries.translation: Bibi Mensah: Hapana, ni maumivu tu haya mabaya kwenye mgongo wangu wa chini. Wakati mwingine yanasambaa hadi kwenye mguu wangu, lakini zaidi yanakuwa hapo hapo katikati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay, that's helpful to know. We'll do a quick exam and then discuss some options for pain relief. Don't worry, Mrs. Mensah, we'll get you feeling better soon.
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa, hiyo inasaidia kujua. Tutafanya uchunguzi wa haraka na kisha tutajadili chaguzi za kupunguza maumivu. Usijali, Bibi Mensah, tutakufanya ujisikie vizuri hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hey, Clara! Gosh, how long has it been? I swear you haven't aged a day since I first saw you for that stubborn ear infection back when you were... what, six? Seven?  My goodness, time flies!
entries.translation: Hujambo, Clara! Jamani, imepita muda gani? Naapa hujazeeka hata siku moja tangu nilipokuona kwa mara ya kwanza kutokana na maambukizi sugu ya sikio wakati ukiwa... na miaka mingapi, sita? Saba? Jamani, muda unakimbia!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Kuelewa Maumivu Yako ya Mgongo wa Chini
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Ni Nini Husababisha Maumivu ya Mgongo wa Chini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In your case, the most likely cause is muscle strain or sprain. This happens when you overwork your back muscles or ligaments, which support your spine. Other possible causes include:
entries.translation: Kwa upande wako, sababu inayowezekana zaidi ni mkazo wa misuli au mshtuko. Hii hutokea unapozidisha kazi misuli ya mgongo au mishipa, ambayo inasaidia uti wa mgongo wako. Sababu zingine zinazowezekana ni pamoja na:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Sitting or standing for long periods without taking breaks
entries.translation: * Kukaa au kusimama kwa muda mrefu bila kupumzika
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several things you can do to relieve your lower back pain:
entries.translation: Kuna mambo kadhaa unaweza kufanya ili kupunguza maumivu ya mgongo wa chini:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Rest: Take breaks throughout your shift to stretch and move around. Avoid activities that make your pain worse.
entries.translation: * Pumzika: Pumzika wakati wote wa zamu yako ili kunyoosha na kuzunguka. Epuka shughuli zinazofanya maumivu yako kuwa mbaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Over-the-Counter Pain Relievers: Medications like ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or acetaminophen (Tylenol) can help reduce pain and inflammation. Always follow the instructions on the label.
entries.translation: * Dawa za Kupunguza Maumivu: Dawa kama ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) au acetaminophen (Tylenol) zinaweza kusaidia kupunguza maumivu na uvimbe. Fuata maagizo kwenye lebo kila wakati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Stretching and Exercise: Gentle stretching and strengthening exercises can help improve flexibility and support your back. Talk to a physical therapist or doctor for specific recommendations.
entries.translation: * Kunyoosha na Kufanya Mazoezi: Mazoezi ya upole ya kunyoosha na kuimarisha yanaweza kusaidia kuboresha unyumbufu na kuutegemeza mgongo wako. Zungumza na mtaalamu wa viungo au daktari kwa mapendekezo mahususi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Good Posture: Pay attention to your posture when you're lifting, sitting, and standing. Keep your back straight and avoid slouching.
entries.translation: * Mkao Mzuri: Zingatia mkao wako unapoinua, unapokaa na kusimama. Weka mgongo wako sawa na uepuke kulegea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Proper Lifting Techniques: When lifting heavy objects, bend your knees and keep your back straight. Lift with your legs, not your back.
entries.translation: * Mbinu Sahihi za Kuinua: Unapoinua vitu vizito, piga magoti na uweke mgongo wako sawa. Inua kwa miguu yako, sio mgongo wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While most lower back pain goes away on its own with self-care, you should see a doctor if:
entries.translation: Ingawa maumivu mengi ya mgongo wa chini huondoka yenyewe kwa kujitunza, unapaswa kuona daktari ikiwa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Your pain is severe or doesn't improve after a few weeks.
entries.translation: * Maumivu yako ni makali au hayaimariki baada ya wiki chache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * You have numbness, tingling, or weakness in your legs.
entries.translation: * Una kufa ganzi, kuwashwa, au udhaifu kwenye miguu yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * You have difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels.
entries.translation: * Una ugumu wa kudhibiti kibofu chako au matumbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * You have a fever or other signs of infection.
entries.translation: * Una homa au dalili nyingine za maambukizi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * You have a history of cancer or osteoporosis.
entries.translation: * Una historia ya saratani au osteoporosis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, taking care of your back is essential for your overall health and well-being. By following these tips, you can help manage your pain and prevent future problems.
entries.translation: Kumbuka, kutunza mgongo wako ni muhimu kwa afya yako na ustawi wako kwa ujumla. Kwa kufuata vidokezo hivi, unaweza kusaidia kudhibiti maumivu yako na kuzuia shida za baadaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Hi, how can I help you today?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Michael: Hi, I'd like to get screened for breast cancer. I'd like a mammogram.
entries.translation: Michael: Habari, ningependa kuchunguzwa saratani ya matiti. Ningependa mamogramu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Michael: No symptoms, just wanted to get checked out since it's been on my mind lately. My aunt was diagnosed recently.
entries.translation: Michael: Hakuna dalili, nilitaka tu kuchunguzwa kwani nimekuwa nikiwaza kuhusu hilo hivi karibuni. Shangazi yangu aligunduliwa hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Michael: Oh, I didn't realize. I thought I could just walk in. Where should I go then?
entries.translation: Michael: Oh, sikujua. Nilifikiri naweza tu kuingia. Basi niende wapi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Michael: Thank you, I appreciate the help. I'll give them a call.
entries.translation: Michael: Asante, nashukuru kwa msaada. Nitawapigia simu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Karibu sana. Kuna kitu kingine naweza kukusaidia nacho leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Michael: No, that's all. Thanks again.
entries.translation: Michael: Hapana, ni hayo tu. Asante tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Hi, Mrs. Rodriguez, I see we're starting a bit later than scheduled, but thank you for coming in," I began, trying to ease the tension in the room.
entries.translation: "Habari, Bi. Rodriguez, naona tunaanza tumechelewa kidogo kuliko ilivyopangwa, lakini asante kwa kufika," nilianza, nikijaribu kupunguza hali ya wasiwasi chumbani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, Doctor, traffic was terrible, and we got lost finding the building," she replied, her hands fidgeting in her lap.
entries.translation: "Ndiyo, Daktari, msongamano wa magari ulikuwa mbaya sana, na tulipotea wakati wa kutafuta jengo," alijibu, mikono yake ikicheza kwenye mapaja yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her husband, Mr. Wu, chimed in, his voice trembling slightly, "We were so worried we'd miss the appointment entirely. Is everything okay?"
entries.translation: Mumewe, Bw. Wu, aliingilia kati, sauti yake ikitetemeka kidogo, "Tulikuwa na wasiwasi sana kwamba tungeikosa miadi kabisa. Je, kila kitu kiko sawa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Just a little soreness, but mostly just anxious about the procedure," she admitted, glancing at her husband for support.
entries.translation: "Maumivu kidogo tu, lakini hasa nina wasiwasi kuhusu utaratibu," alikiri, akimtazama mumewe kwa msaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's completely normal. The biopsy is a routine procedure to check the lump we found. It will help us understand what's going on," I explained gently.
entries.translation: "Hiyo ni kawaida kabisa. Biopsi ni utaratibu wa kawaida wa kuangalia uvimbe tulioupata. Utatusaidia kuelewa kinachoendelea," nilielezea kwa upole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Wu leaned forward, his brow furrowed. "Will it hurt her? How long will it take?"
entries.translation: Bw. Wu aliinamia mbele, paji la uso wake likikunjamana. "Je, itamuumiza? Itachukua muda gani?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Rodriguez took a deep breath. "Okay, that sounds manageable. What happens after?"
entries.translation: Bi. Rodriguez alivuta pumzi ndefu. "Sawa, hiyo inaonekana inawezekana. Kipi kitatokea baada ya hapo?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "After the biopsy, we'll send the sample to the lab. Results usually take a few days. We'll call you as soon as we have them," I said.
entries.translation: "Baada ya biopsi, tutatuma sampuli kwenye maabara. Majibu huchukua siku chache. Tutawapigia simu mara tu tutakapoyapata," nilisema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you, Doctor. We just want to know what we're dealing with," Mr. Wu said, squeezing his wife's hand.
entries.translation: "Asante, Daktari. Tunataka tu kujua tunakabiliana na nini," Bw. Wu alisema, akimkamua mkono mkewe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Of course. We'll take good care of you, Mrs. Rodriguez. Do you have any other questions before we get started?" I asked, giving them a moment to think.
entries.translation: "Bila shaka. Tutamtunza vizuri, Bi. Rodriguez. Je, una maswali mengine yoyote kabla hatujaanza?" Niliuliza, nikiwapa muda wa kufikiria.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, I think we're ready," she said, giving a small, brave smile.
entries.translation: "Hapana, nafikiri tuko tayari," alisema, akitoa tabasamu dogo la ujasiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Alright, let's get you prepped then. The nurse will be in shortly to help you get ready," I concluded, standing up to give them some privacy.
entries.translation: "Sawa, basi acha tukuandae. Muuguzi atakuja punde kukusaidia kujiandaa," nilimalizia, nikisimama kuwapa faragha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Lyimo. It's good to see you again, although I'm sorry to hear you're still not feeling well. Let's see how we can get to the bottom of this.
entries.translation: Daktari: Habari za asubuhi Bwana Lyimo. Nimefurahi kukuona tena, japo nasikitika kusikia kuwa bado hujisikii vizuri. Wacha tuone jinsi tunavyoweza kutatua hili tatizo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Lyimo: Good morning, Doctor. Yeah, I was hoping the medication would kick in by now, but my stomach still feels like it's tied in knots. I'm starting to worry something more serious is going on.
entries.translation: Bw. Lyimo: Habari za asubuhi, Daktari. Ndio, nilitumaini kuwa dawa ingeanza kufanya kazi kufikia sasa, lakini tumbo langu bado linahisi kama limefungwa fundo. Ninaanza kuwa na wasiwasi kuwa kuna jambo zito linaendelea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Lyimo: But what about the biopsy results? Did they show anything? I've been anxious about that.
entries.translation: Bw. Lyimo: Lakini vipi kuhusu matokeo ya biopsi? Yalionyesha chochote? Nimekuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu hilo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Lyimo: Well, I have been under a lot of stress at work lately, and I admit my diet hasn't been the best. I tend to grab whatever's quick and easy.
entries.translation: Bw. Lyimo: Sawa, nimekuwa na mfadhaiko mwingi kazini hivi karibuni, na ninakiri mlo wangu haujawa bora zaidi. Huwa nanyakua chochote kilicho cha haraka na rahisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Lyimo: Okay, that sounds reasonable. I just want to feel better. This constant discomfort is really wearing me down.
entries.translation: Bw. Lyimo: Sawa, hilo linaonekana kuwa sawa. Nataka tu kujisikia vizuri. Usumbufu huu wa mara kwa mara unaniweka chini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Lyimo: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Bw. Lyimo: Asante Daktari. Ninashukuru kwa msaada wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome. Let's schedule a follow-up appointment in a couple of weeks to see how you're doing. And please don't hesitate to call if your symptoms worsen or if you have any new concerns.
entries.translation: Daktari: Karibu. Wacha tupange miadi ya ufuatiliaji katika wiki chache ili kuona jinsi unavyoendelea. Na tafadhali usisite kupiga simu ikiwa dalili zako zitazidi kuwa mbaya au ikiwa una wasiwasi wowote mpya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Well, hello there, Martha! Good to see you again. I hear you're here with your mom, Eleanor, for her upcoming spinal cord stimulation surgery. How are you holding up?
entries.translation: Daktari: Hujambo Martha! Nimefurahi kukuona tena. Nimesikia kuwa uko hapa na mamako, Eleanor, kwa ajili ya upasuaji wake ujao wa kuchochea uti wa mgongo. Unaendeleaje?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Martha: Hi, Dr. Esposito. It's nice to see you too. I'm doing okay, just a little nervous for Mom. It's a big procedure.
entries.translation: Martha: Hujambo, Dkt. Esposito. Nimefurahi kukuona pia. Naendelea vizuri, ila nina wasiwasi kidogo kuhusu Mama. Ni utaratibu mkubwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Martha: That's reassuring to hear. What exactly does the surgery involve?
entries.translation: Martha: Hiyo inatia moyo kusikia. Je, upasuaji huo unahusisha nini hasa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Martha: And what about recovery? Will she be in a lot of pain afterwards?
entries.translation: Martha: Na vipi kuhusu kupona? Je, atakuwa na maumivu mengi baadaye?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Martha: That sounds promising. Is there anything specific I need to do to help her prepare?
entries.translation: Martha: Hiyo inaonekana kuahidi. Je, kuna jambo lolote mahususi ninalohitaji kufanya ili kumsaidia kujiandaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Martha: Thank you, Dr. Esposito. I'll do my best.
entries.translation: Martha: Asante, Dkt. Esposito. Nitajitahidi niwezavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I know you will. Eleanor is lucky to have you. Now, let's go over some more details about the surgery and answer any other questions you might have.
entries.translation: Daktari: Najua utafanya hivyo. Eleanor ana bahati kuwa nawe. Sasa, hebu tupitie maelezo zaidi kuhusu upasuaji na kujibu maswali mengine yoyote ambayo unaweza kuwa nayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Aravind: Hello, Mr. Pillay. How are you feeling today? I understand you've been experiencing some blurred or double vision.
entries.translation: Dkt. Aravind: Hujambo, Bw. Pillay. Unajisikiaje leo? Nimeelewa umekuwa ukipata kutoona vizuri au kuona vitu mara mbili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pillay: Yes, doctor. It's been a bit concerning, honestly. Is this normal after the surgery?
entries.translation: Bw. Pillay: Ndiyo, daktari. Kwa kweli imekuwa jambo la kuhofisha. Je, hii ni kawaida baada ya upasuaji?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pillay: Oh, really? That's a relief to hear. I was starting to worry something went wrong.
entries.translation: Bw. Pillay: Lo, kweli? Hayo ni maneno ya kutuliza moyo. Nilikuwa nimeanza kuwa na wasiwasi kwamba kuna kitu kilienda vibaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pillay: That's good to know. Is there anything I can do to help with the recovery?
entries.translation: Bw. Pillay: Hilo ni jambo zuri kujua. Je, kuna chochote ninaweza kufanya kusaidia katika kupona?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pillay: Okay, I'll make sure to do that. Thank you, doctor. I feel much better knowing this is part of the process.
entries.translation: Bw. Pillay: Sawa, nitahakikisha ninafanya hivyo. Asante, daktari. Ninahisi vizuri zaidi kujua hii ni sehemu ya mchakato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pillay: Thank you, Dr. Aravind. I appreciate your reassurance. I'll see you then.
entries.translation: Bw. Pillay: Asante, Dkt. Aravind. Ninashukuru uhakikisho wako. Tutaonana basi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Gonzalez. I'm Dr. Ramirez. I understand you're here for a routine physical exam focusing on motor disorders. Is that correct?
entries.translation: Daktari: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Gonzalez. Mimi ni Dkt. Ramirez. Ninaelewa uko hapa kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa kawaida wa kimwili unaozingatia matatizo ya motor. Je, ni sahihi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gonzalez: Yes, that's right, Doctor. I haven't noticed any major problems, but my family has a history of Parkinson's, so I just want to be safe.
entries.translation: Bw. Gonzalez: Ndiyo, ni kweli, Daktari. Sijaona matatizo makubwa, lakini familia yangu ina historia ya Parkinson, kwa hivyo nataka tu kuwa salama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's a very proactive approach, Mr. Gonzalez. It's always good to be mindful of family history. Now, have you experienced any tremors, stiffness, or difficulty with movement lately?
entries.translation: Daktari: Hiyo ni mbinu nzuri sana, Bw. Gonzalez. Daima ni vizuri kukumbuka historia ya familia. Sasa, umepata mitetemo, kukakamaa, au ugumu wa kusogea hivi majuzi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gonzalez: Not really. Sometimes my hands feel a bit shaky when I'm holding something heavy, but I think that's just old age.
entries.translation: Bw. Gonzalez: Si kweli. Wakati mwingine mikono yangu huhisi kutetemeka kidogo ninaposhika kitu kizito, lakini nadhani huo ni uzee tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. And have you noticed any changes in your balance or coordination?
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa. Na umegundua mabadiliko yoyote katika usawa au uratibu wako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gonzalez: No, I feel pretty steady on my feet. I still play tennis every week with my friends.
entries.translation: Bw. Gonzalez: Hapana, ninajisikia utulivu kwa miguu yangu. Bado ninacheza tenisi kila wiki na marafiki zangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Excellent. Now, can you please walk across the room in a straight line, heel to toe?
entries.translation: Daktari: Bora. Sasa, unaweza tafadhali kutembea kwenye chumba katika mstari wa moja kwa moja, kisigino hadi vidole?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Very good. Your balance and coordination seem perfectly normal. Now, I'm going to check your reflexes. Just relax your arm and let it hang loose.
entries.translation: Daktari: Vizuri sana. Mizani yako na uratibu unaonekana kuwa wa kawaida kabisa. Sasa, nitaangalia maoni yako. Pumzika tu mkono wako na uiruhusu kuning'inia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gonzalez: That sounds like a good plan, Doctor. Thank you for your time.
entries.translation: Bw. Gonzalez: Huo unaonekana kama mpango mzuri, Daktari. Asante kwa muda wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Mr. Gonzalez. It was a pleasure meeting you. Take care.
entries.translation: Daktari: Karibu, Bw. Gonzalez. Ilikuwa ni furaha kukutana nawe. Kuwa mwangalifu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let's chat about the lab results we've been waiting for regarding celiac disease. It seems like some changes are happening in your body, and it's important we understand them together.
entries.translation: Hebu tuzungumze kuhusu matokeo ya maabara ambayo tumekuwa tukisubiri kuhusu ugonjwa wa celiac. Inaonekana kuna mabadiliko yanayotokea katika mwili wako, na ni muhimu tuyaelewe pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What does this mean for you?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a lot to take in, so please ask any questions you have. We're here to help you navigate this and feel your best.
entries.translation: Hii ni nyingi ya kuchukua, kwa hivyo tafadhali uliza maswali yoyote uliyo nayo. Tuko hapa kukusaidia kupitia hili na kujisikia vizuri zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Changing your diet can be challenging, but there are many delicious gluten-free options available these days. We can connect you with a dietitian who can guide you.
entries.translation: Kubadilisha lishe yako kunaweza kuwa changamoto, lakini kuna chaguzi nyingi za ladha zisizo na gluteni zinazopatikana siku hizi. Tunaweza kukuunganisha na mtaalamu wa lishe ambaye anaweza kukuongoza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most importantly, we're in this together! We'll work with you to create a plan that fits your lifestyle and helps you stay healthy.
entries.translation: Jambo la muhimu zaidi, tuko pamoja katika hili! Tutashirikiana nawe kuunda mpango unaolingana na mtindo wako wa maisha na kukusaidia uwe na afya njema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let's schedule a follow-up appointment soon to discuss the next steps in more detail. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if anything comes up.
entries.translation: Hebu tupange miadi ya ufuatiliaji hivi karibuni ili kujadili hatua zinazofuata kwa undani zaidi. Wakati huo huo, jisikie huru kuwasiliana ikiwa chochote kitatokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Hello, I'm Omoyele, a physician assistant. Can I speak with Maria?
entries.translation: PA: Hujambo, mimi ni Omoyele, daktari msaidizi. Naweza kuongea na Maria?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Hi Maria. I understand you're having some chest pain. Can you tell me a little more about it?
entries.translation: PA: Hujambo Maria. Naelewa kuwa una maumivu ya kifua. Unaweza kuniambia zaidi kuhusu hayo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maria: It feels like a tightness in my chest, right in the middle. It started about an hour ago.
entries.translation: Maria: Ninahisi kubanwa kifuani, katikati haswa. Imeanza kama saa moja iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Okay. Does the pain spread anywhere else, like your arm or jaw?
entries.translation: PA: Sawa. Je, maumivu yanasambaa mahali pengine, kama mkono wako au taya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maria: No, just in the chest.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Are you having any other symptoms, like shortness of breath or nausea?
entries.translation: PA: Je, una dalili nyingine zozote, kama vile upungufu wa kupumua au kichefuchefu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maria: I feel a little short of breath, but no nausea.
entries.translation: Maria: Najisi upungufu wa kupumua kidogo, lakini sina kichefuchefu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Have you ever had chest pain like this before?
entries.translation: PA: Umewahi kuwa na maumivu ya kifua kama haya hapo awali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Do you have any medical conditions, like high blood pressure or diabetes?
entries.translation: PA: Je, una hali yoyote ya matibabu, kama shinikizo la damu au kisukari?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maria: I have high blood pressure.
entries.translation: Maria: Nina shinikizo la juu la damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Okay. Are you taking any medications for that?
entries.translation: PA: Sawa. Je, unatumia dawa zozote kwa hilo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Thanks for letting me know. Is your husband there with you?
entries.translation: PA: Asante kwa kunijulisha. Mume wako yuko pamoja nawe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maria: Yes, he's right here. He's very worried.
entries.translation: Maria: Ndio, yuko hapa. Ana wasiwasi sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: It's understandable that he's worried. Chest pain can be scary. Can I speak with him for a moment?
entries.translation: PA: Inaeleweka kuwa ana wasiwasi. Maumivu ya kifua yanaweza kutisha. Naweza kuongea naye kwa muda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: Hi, I'm Omoyele. I'm talking to Maria about her chest pain. I just wanted to reassure you that we're going to figure out what's going on and get her the help she needs.
entries.translation: PA: Hujambo, mimi ni Omoyele. Ninazungumza na Maria kuhusu maumivu ya kifua chake. Nilitaka tu kukuhakikishia kuwa tutagundua nini kinaendelea na kumpa msaada anaohitaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Husband: Thank you. She's never had anything like this before.
entries.translation: Mume: Asante. Hajawahi kuwa na kitu kama hiki hapo awali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: I understand. Can you tell me if she's been under a lot of stress lately?
entries.translation: PA: Naelewa. Unaweza kuniambia ikiwa amekuwa na msongo wa mawazo hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Husband: Yes, she has. Her mother passed away recently.
entries.translation: Mume: Ndio, amekuwa nao. Mama yake amefariki hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Husband: Okay, we'll go right now. Thank you.
entries.translation: Mume: Sawa, tutaenda sasa hivi. Asante.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PA: You're welcome. Please drive safely.
entries.translation: PA: Karibu. Tafadhali endesha kwa usalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical student: Hello, I'm Anika Patel, a medical student working with the team today. I see you're here to discuss weight management. Can you tell me a bit about what brings you in?
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi wa utabibu: Habari, mimi ni Anika Patel, mwanafunzi wa utabibu anayefanya kazi na timu leo. Naona uko hapa kuzungumzia usimamizi wa uzito. Unaweza kuniambia kidogo kuhusu kilichokuleta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical student: That sounds frustrating. It's important to remember that weight is influenced by many factors, not just diet and exercise. Tell me more about your daily routine and eating habits.
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi wa utabibu: Hiyo inasikika kukatisha tamaa. Ni muhimu kukumbuka kuwa uzito huathiriwa na mambo mengi, sio tu lishe na mazoezi. Niambie zaidi kuhusu ratiba yako ya kila siku na tabia zako za kula.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical student: It sounds like you have a busy schedule. Snacking and skipping meals can definitely impact weight. Have you noticed any patterns to your snacking or specific triggers?
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi wa utabibu: Inaonekana una ratiba yenye shughuli nyingi. Kula vitafunio na kuruka milo kunaweza kuathiri uzito. Je, umegundua mifumo yoyote ya kula kwako vitafunio au vichochezi maalum?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yoga instructor: Yeah, I tend to snack when I'm feeling overwhelmed or anxious. And sometimes I just grab whatever is convenient, even if it's not the healthiest option.
entries.translation: Mkufunzi wa yoga: Ndiyo, huwa nakula vitafunio ninapohisi kulemewa au kuwa na wasiwasi. Na wakati mwingine nachukua tu chochote kilicho rahisi kupata, hata kama si chaguo bora zaidi kiafya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yoga instructor: Not really, no major changes. I just feel like my body is fighting against me.
entries.translation: Mkufunzi wa yoga: Hapana, hakuna mabadiliko makubwa. Ninahisi tu kama mwili wangu unanipinga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yoga instructor: That sounds good. I just want to feel like myself again.
entries.translation: Mkufunzi wa yoga: Hilo linaonekana zuri. Ninataka tu kujisikia kama mimi tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical student: We'll do our best to help you get there. Let's start by setting some realistic goals and coming up with a plan that works for you.
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi wa utabibu: Tutafanya tuwezavyo kukusaidia kufika huko. Hebu tianze kwa kuweka malengo halisi na kuja na mpango unaokufaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm hoping you can help me figure out what's going on. Lately, I've been feeling really off, and I'm wondering if it might be connected to the medication I'm taking.
entries.translation: Natumai unaweza kunisaidia kuelewa kinachoendelea. Hivi majuzi, nimekuwa nikijisikia vibaya sana, na ninashangaa ikiwa huenda ikahusiana na dawa ninayotumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's getting harder to focus at work too. I find myself zoning out during meetings or forgetting simple tasks. It's like my brain is in a fog.
entries.translation: Inazidi kuwa vigumu kuzingatia kazi pia. Ninajikuta nikitoka nje wakati wa mikutano au kusahau kazi rahisi. Ni kama ubongo wangu uko kwenye ukungu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a dialog between the patient, **Bethlehem Mekonnen**, and the nurse, **Wulandari Pratiwi**:
entries.translation: Haya hapa ni mazungumzo kati ya mgonjwa, **Bethlehem Mekonnen**, na muuguzi, **Wulandari Pratiwi**:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wulandari Pratiwi: "Bethlehem, I know you're uncomfortable, but we need to do this lung function test right now. It's crucial to assess your breathing."
entries.translation: Wulandari Pratiwi: "Bethlehem, najua unajihisi vibaya, lakini tunahitaji kufanya kipimo hiki cha mapafu sasa hivi. Ni muhimu kutathmini kupumua kwako."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bethlehem Mekonnen: "I don't trust doctors. They always find something wrong just to make money."
entries.translation: Bethlehem Mekonnen: "Siwaamini madaktari. Daima hupata kitu kibaya ili tu wapate pesa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bethlehem Mekonnen: "Fine, but make it quick. I don't want to be here any longer than necessary."
entries.translation: Bethlehem Mekonnen: "Sawa, lakini fanya haraka. Sitaki kuwa hapa muda mrefu kuliko inavyohitajika."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wulandari Pratiwi: "We'll make it as quick as possible. Just follow my instructions, and we'll be done before you know it. Ready? Deep breath in... and blow!"
entries.translation: Wulandari Pratiwi: "Tutafanya haraka iwezekanavyo. Fuata tu maagizo yangu, na tutamaliza kabla ya wewe kujua. Uko tayari? Vuta pumzi ndefu... na upulize!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're sorry to see that your yoga practice has led to an injury. Rest assured, we're here to help you get back on the mat as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Tunasikitika kuona kwamba mazoezi yako ya yoga yamesababisha jeraha. Uwe na hakika, tuko hapa kukusaidia kurudi kwenye mkeka haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some tips for managing your injury:
entries.translation: Hapa kuna vidokezo kadhaa vya kukabiliana na jeraha lako:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: Give your body the time it needs to heal. Avoid activities that cause pain or discomfort.
entries.translation: Pumzika: Upe mwili wako wakati unaohitaji kupona. Epuka shughuli zinazosababisha maumivu au usumbufu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ice: Apply ice to the injured area for 15-20 minutes at a time, several times a day. This can help reduce swelling and inflammation.
entries.translation: Barafu: Weka barafu kwenye eneo lililojeruhiwa kwa dakika 15-20 kwa wakati, mara kadhaa kwa siku. Hii inaweza kusaidia kupunguza uvimbe na kuvimba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Compression: Wrap the injured area with a bandage or compression sleeve to help support the joint and reduce swelling.
entries.translation: Kubana: Funga eneo lililojeruhiwa na bandeji au kitambaa cha kubana ili kusaidia kiungo na kupunguza uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elevation: Keep the injured area elevated above your heart whenever possible. This can also help reduce swelling.
entries.translation: Kuinua: Weka eneo lililojeruhiwa juu ya moyo wako iwezekanavyo. Hii pia inaweza kusaidia kupunguza uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medication: Over-the-counter pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen, can help manage pain and inflammation.
entries.translation: Dawa: Dawa za kupunguza maumivu za dukani, kama vile ibuprofen au acetaminophen, zinaweza kusaidia kudhibiti maumivu na uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Physical therapy: Once the initial pain and swelling have subsided, physical therapy can help you regain strength and flexibility in the injured area.
entries.translation: Tiba ya mwili: Mara tu maumivu ya awali na uvimbe unapopungua, tiba ya mwili inaweza kukusaidia kurejesha nguvu na kubadilika katika eneo lililojeruhiwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Listen to your body: Pay attention to your pain levels and stop any activity that causes discomfort. Don't push yourself too hard too soon.
entries.translation: Sikiliza mwili wako: Zingatia viwango vya maumivu yako na uache shughuli yoyote inayosababisha usumbufu. Usijilazimishe sana haraka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hope this information helps you on your road to recovery. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Tunatumahi kuwa habari hii itakusaidia kwenye njia yako ya kupona. Ikiwa una maswali au wasiwasi wowote, tafadhali usisite kuuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Good morning, Mrs. Wambui. What brings you in today?
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Habari za asubuhi, Bi. Wambui. Ni kipi kimekuleta leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: Good morning, doctor. My husband insisted I come. He's worried about my heart.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Habari za asubuhi, daktari. Mume wangu alisisitiza nije. Ana wasiwasi kuhusu moyo wangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: I see. It's good that he's looking out for you. Can you tell me more about your heart condition?
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Naona. Ni vyema anakuangalia. Je, unaweza kunieleza zaidi kuhusu hali ya moyo wako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: I was born with a hole in my heart. It's called an atrial septal defect.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Nilizaliwa na tundu kwenye moyo. Inaitwa kasoro ya septamu ya atriamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: I understand. How has this affected you?
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Ninaelewa. Hii imekuathiri vipi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: I get tired easily, and sometimes I have shortness of breath. But honestly, I haven't had any major issues recently.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Ninachoka haraka, na wakati mwingine ninaishiwa na pumzi. Lakini kwa kweli, sijapata matatizo makubwa hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Okay. Have you seen a cardiologist before?
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Sawa. Umewahi kumuona daktari wa moyo hapo awali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: Yes, a few years ago. They said the hole was small and didn't need surgery at the time.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Ndiyo, miaka michache iliyopita. Walisema tundu lilikuwa dogo na halikuhitaji upasuaji wakati huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Alright. Well, it's important to monitor congenital heart defects, even if they seem stable. Let's start by checking your blood pressure and listening to your heart.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Sawa. Ni muhimu kufuatilia kasoro za moyo za kuzaliwa, hata kama zinaonekana kuwa shwari. Tuanze kwa kupima shinikizo la damu na kusikiliza moyo wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Your blood pressure is a bit high, 140 over 90. And I do hear a murmur.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Shinikizo la damu yako liko juu kidogo, 140 juu ya 90. Na ninasikia mvumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Je, hilo ni mbaya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Not necessarily, but it warrants further investigation. Given your history and current symptoms, I'd like to order an echocardiogram to get a better look at your heart structure and function.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Si lazima, lakini inahitaji uchunguzi zaidi. Kutokana na historia yako na dalili za sasa, ningependa kuagiza echocardiogram ili kupata picha nzuri ya muundo na kazi ya moyo wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: An echocardiogram? Is that like an ultrasound?
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Echocardiogram? Je, ni kama ultrasound?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Yes, exactly. It uses sound waves to create images of your heart. It's non-invasive and painless.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Ndiyo, haswa. Inatumia mawimbi ya sauti kutengeneza picha za moyo wako. Si vamizi na haina maumivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: Okay, I suppose that's fine.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Sawa, nadhani hilo ni sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Great. We'll schedule that for you. In the meantime, I'd also like to discuss some lifestyle changes that could benefit your heart health, such as diet and exercise.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Vizuri. Tutakupangia hiyo. Kwa sasa, ningependa pia kujadili mabadiliko ya mtindo wa maisha ambayo yanaweza kufaidisha afya ya moyo wako, kama vile lishe na mazoezi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: I know, I know. I need to lose weight.
entries.translation: Bi. Wambui: Najua, najua. Ninahitaji kupunguza uzito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: Weight management can certainly help reduce the strain on your heart. But let's focus on small, sustainable changes first. Would you be open to meeting with a nutritionist?
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Udhibiti wa uzito kwa hakika unaweza kusaidia kupunguza msongo kwenye moyo wako. Lakini hebu tuzingatie mabadiliko madogo na endelevu kwanza. Je, ungekuwa tayari kukutana na mtaalamu wa lishe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: Maybe. I'll think about it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Adetutu: That's fair. Let's get the echocardiogram done first and see where we stand. Then we can discuss a more comprehensive plan.
entries.translation: Dkt Adetutu: Hiyo ni haki. Hebu tufanye echocardiogram kwanza na tuone wapi tunasimama. Kisha tunaweza kujadili mpango mpana zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Wambui: Alright, doctor. Thank you.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Aravindh Kumar: Good morning, Mr. Peretz. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Daktari Aravindh Kumar: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Peretz. Je, unahisije leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Gideon Peretz: Oh, just grand, Dr. Kumar. My knee feels much better already.
entries.translation: Bw. Gideon Peretz: Oh, njema sana, Daktari Kumar. Goti langu ni zuri zaidi tayari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Kumar: That's wonderful to hear! I see here you had a total knee replacement a few weeks ago. How has your recovery been going?
entries.translation: Dkt Kumar: Hiyo ni habari njema! Naona hapa kuwa ulifanyiwa upasuaji wa goti wiki chache zilizopita. Je, umekuwa ukiendeleaje?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Peretz: It's been a bit slow, to be honest. But my physical therapist says I'm making good progress.
entries.translation: Bw. Peretz: Ukweli ni kwamba nimekuwa nikiendelea taratibu. Lakini mtaalamu wa tibamaungo anasema kuwa ninafanya vyema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Kumar: Excellent. And how about your pain levels? Are you managing okay with the medication?
entries.translation: Dkt Kumar: Vizuri sana. Na vipi kuhusu viwango vya maumivu? Je, unaendelea vyema na dawa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Peretz: Yes, the pain pills seem to be doing the trick. Although, I try not to take them too often. Don't want to get hooked on anything, you know?
entries.translation: Bw. Peretz: Ndiyo, vidonge vya kupunguza maumivu vinaonekana kufanya kazi. Ingawa, najaribu kutokuvitumia mara nyingi. Sitaki kuzoea dawa hizo, unajua?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Peretz: No, nothing like that. Everything looks clean and healing nicely.
entries.translation: Bw. Peretz: Hapana, hakuna kitu kama hicho. Kila kitu kinaonekana safi na kupona vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Peretz: Thank you, Dr. Kumar. I appreciate your time.
entries.translation: Bw. Peretz: Asante, Daktari Kumar. Ninashukuru kwa muda wako.
