entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Kumar: You're very welcome, Mr. Peretz. Take care now.
entries.translation: Dkt Kumar: Karibu sana, Bw. Peretz. Jihadhari sasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good evening, this is the telehealth line, my name is Aisha, how can I help you today?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Habari ya jioni, hii ni laini ya huduma ya afya kwa njia ya simu, jina langu ni Aisha, nikusaidie aje leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Good evening? What's so good about it? I've been trying to reach someone for an hour! This is ridiculous!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Habari ya jioni? Kuna uzuri gani katika hilo? Nimekuwa nikijaribu kumpata mtu kwa saa nzima! Huu ni mzaha!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I'm so sorry for the wait, ma'am. We are experiencing higher than usual call volumes tonight. Can I have your name please?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Samahani sana kwa kusubiri, ma'am. Tunapokea idadi kubwa ya simu kuliko kawaida usiku wa leo. Naweza kupata jina lako tafadhali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: My name is Consuelo Ramirez, and I'm not happy! I'm having hot flashes, I can't sleep, and my mood swings are out of control! This menopause is driving me crazy!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Jina langu ni Consuelo Ramirez, na sina furaha! Nina joto kali la ghafla mwilini, siwezi kulala, na mabadiliko yangu ya hisia hayawezi kudhibitiwa! Kukoma hedhi huku kunanichanganya!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I understand your frustration, Ms. Ramirez. Menopause can be a very difficult time. Can you tell me a little more about your symptoms? How long have you been experiencing them?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Naelewa kuchanganyikiwa kwako, Bi Ramirez. Kukoma hedhi kunaweza kuwa wakati mgumu sana. Unaweza kuniambia zaidi kidogo kuhusu dalili zako? Umeanza kuzipata kwa muda gani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: For months! And it's getting worse! I feel like I'm losing my mind! And nobody seems to care! My doctor just brushed me off and told me it's 'normal'! Normal?! This is torture!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Kwa miezi! Na inazidi kuwa mbaya! Nahisi kama napoteza akili! Na hakuna anayejali! Daktari wangu alinipuuza tu na kuniambia ni 'kawaida'! Kawaida?! Huu ni mateso!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I hear you, Ms. Ramirez. It sounds like you're going through a lot. Let's see what we can do to help. Are you taking any medications or supplements currently?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Nakusikia, Bi Ramirez. Inaonekana unapitia mengi. Tuone kile tunachoweza kufanya kusaidia. Je, unatumia dawa au virutubisho vyovyote kwa sasa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Just some vitamins, nothing else. But I need something that actually works! I can't live like this anymore!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Vitamini tu, hakuna kingine. Lakini nahitaji kitu kinachofanya kazi kweli! Siwezi kuishi hivi tena!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, Ms. Ramirez. I'm going to ask you a few more questions to better understand your situation, and then we can discuss some options. Is that okay?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa, Bi Ramirez. Nitakuuliza maswali machache zaidi ili kuelewa hali yako vizuri, na kisha tunaweza kujadili baadhi ya chaguzi. Ipo sawa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Fine, just hurry up! I don't have all night!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Sawa, fanya haraka! Sina usiku mzima!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I understand. Can you tell me about your sleep patterns? Are you having trouble falling asleep or staying asleep?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Naelewa. Unaweza kuniambia kuhusu mpangilio wako wa kulala? Unapata shida kupata usingizi au kuendelea kulala?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Both! I wake up sweating, and then I can't go back to sleep. It's exhausting!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Vyote! Naamka nikiwa natokwa na jasho, na kisha siwezi kurudi kulala. Inachosha!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: And the mood swings? Can you describe them?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Na mabadiliko ya hisia? Unaweza kuyaelezea?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: One minute I'm fine, the next I'm crying or yelling at my husband for no reason! I feel like I'm losing control!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Dakika moja niko sawa, inayofuata ninalia au kumfokea mume wangu bila sababu! Nahisi kama napoteza udhibiti!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That sounds very challenging, Ms. Ramirez. Have you noticed any other changes, like irregular periods or vaginal dryness?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hiyo inasikika kuwa changamoto sana, Bi Ramirez. Umeona mabadiliko mengine yoyote, kama hedhi isiyo ya kawaida au ukavu wa uke?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, all of it! It's like my body is falling apart! Can you just prescribe me something already?
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ndiyo, yote hayo! Ni kama mwili wangu unasambaratika! Unaweza kuniandikia dawa tayari?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Ms. Ramirez, I can't prescribe medication over the phone, but I can connect you with a doctor who can evaluate your symptoms and discuss treatment options. Would you like me to do that?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Bi Ramirez, siwezi kuandika dawa kwa simu, lakini naweza kukuunganisha na daktari anayeweza kutathmini dalili zako na kujadili chaguzi za matibabu. Je, ungependa nifanye hivyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Yes, please! Anything to make this stop!
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Ndiyo, tafadhali! Chochote cha kufanya hili likome!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, I'm going to transfer you to Dr. Sukhum. Please hold for just a moment.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa, nitakuhamishia kwa Dkt. Sukhum. Tafadhali subiri kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical Student (Mario Reyes): Good morning! How are you doing today?
entries.translation: Mwanafunzi wa Udaktari (Mario Reyes): Habari ya asubuhi! Unaendeleaje leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient (Alistair McCloud): I've been better. Dealing with these kidney stones again.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa (Alistair McCloud): Nimekuwa bora zaidi. Nashughulikia mawe haya ya figo tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Nasikitika kusikia hivyo. Unaweza kunieleza zaidi kuhusu kinachoendelea?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: It's just this recurring pain in my lower back and side. It gets pretty unbearable sometimes.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Ni maumivu haya ya mara kwa mara kwenye sehemu ya chini ya mgongo na ubavuni. Wakati mwingine huwa makali sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: I understand. That sounds very uncomfortable. Have you seen a doctor about this before?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Naelewa. Inaonekana kuwa na maumivu sana. Umemwona daktari kuhusu hili hapo awali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: Yes, I've been treated for kidney stones in the past. It seems to be a recurring issue for me.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Ndiyo, nimetibiwa mawe ya figo huko nyuma. Inaonekana kuwa tatizo la mara kwa mara kwangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: Okay, I see. And you mentioned needing a doctor's note for work?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Sawa, naona. Na umetaja unahitaji barua ya daktari kwa ajili ya kazi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: Yeah, my boss is asking for one because I've missed a few days due to the pain.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Ndiyo, mwajiri wangu anaulizia kwa sababu nimekosa siku chache kazini kutokana na maumivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: I can certainly help with that. Could you tell me specifically which days you missed work?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Hakika naweza kukusaidia kwa hilo. Unaweza kuniambia ni siku gani hasa ulizokosa kuingia kazi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: Sure, it was last Tuesday and Wednesday.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Sawa, ilikuwa Jumanne na Jumatano iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: Alright, noted. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss regarding your symptoms or treatment?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Sawa, nimeandika. Kuna lingine lolote ungependa kujadili kuhusu dalili zako au matibabu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: Not really, just hoping to get this sorted out so I can get back to work without worrying about my job.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Hapana, natumai tu kutatua hili ili niweze kurejea kazini bila kuwa na wasiwasi kuhusu kazi yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: Of course. Let me just double-check everything with my attending physician, and we'll get that note sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can do for you in the meantime?
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Bila shaka. Acha nikague kila kitu na daktari wangu anayenisimamia, na tutakuandalia barua hiyo. Kuna lingine lolote naweza kukufanyia kwa sasa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alistair McCloud: No, that's all. Thanks for your help.
entries.translation: Alistair McCloud: Hapana, hilo tu. Asante kwa msaada wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mario Reyes: You're welcome. I'll be back shortly with the note. Hang in there.
entries.translation: Mario Reyes: Karibu. Nitarudi punde na barua hiyo. Jipe moyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Samuel Cohen: Miss Elara Thorne, please have a seat.
entries.translation: Dkt. Samuel Cohen: Bi Elara Thorne, tafadhali keti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: Thank you, Dr. Cohen. I apologize for my impatience, but I'm eager to hear the results for my grandfather, Arthur.
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Asante, Dkt. Cohen. Samahani kwa kukosa uvumilivu, lakini nina hamu ya kusikia majibu ya babu yangu, Arthur.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Cohen: I understand your concern, Elara. I wish I had better news to share. The lab results indicate some concerning abnormalities.
entries.translation: Dkt. Cohen: Naelewa wasiwasi wako, Elara. Ningependa ningekuwa na habari njema zaidi za kukueleza. Majibu ya maabara yanaonyesha baadhi ya hitilafu za kutia wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: Abnormalities? What kind of abnormalities?
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Hitilafu? Hitilafu za aina gani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: Kidney failure? But he seemed fine just a few weeks ago!
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Figo kushindwa kufanya kazi? Lakini alionekana kuwa mzima wiki chache zilizopita!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: Is there anything we can do? Is it treatable?
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Je, kuna chochote tunaweza kufanya? Je, inatibika?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: So, what does this mean for him? How much time does he have?
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Kwa hiyo, hii ina maana gani kwake? Ana muda gani wa kuishi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elara Thorne: I... I don't know what to say. This is all so sudden.
entries.translation: Elara Thorne: Mimi... Sijui la kusema. Hii yote imekuja ghafla sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Cohen: Take your time to process this information, Elara. We are here to support you and Arthur every step of the way. If you have any questions or need further clarification, please don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Dkt. Cohen: Chukua muda wako kuelewa taarifa hii, Elara. Tuko hapa kukusaidia wewe na Arthur kila hatua ya njia. Ikiwa una maswali yoyote au unahitaji ufafanuzi zaidi, tafadhali usisite kuuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Ms. Sim. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Daktari: Habari za asubuhi, Bi. Sim. Unajisikiaje leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: (clutching stomach) Good morning, doctor. I'm okay, but my stomach hurts a bit.
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: (akishikilia tumbo) Habari za asubuhi, daktari. Nipo salama, lakini tumbo langu linauma kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. We'll take a look at that shortly. Can you tell me how you've been since your last appointment?
entries.translation: Daktari: Pole sana kusikia hivyo. Tutaangalia hilo hivi punde. Je, unaweza kuniambia hali yako imekuwaje tangu miadi yako ya mwisho?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: Overall, I've been doing well. My workouts are going great, and I feel strong. But this stomach pain started a few days ago.
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: Kwa ujumla, nimekuwa nikiendelea vizuri. Mazoezi yangu yanakwenda vyema, na ninahisi nina nguvu. Lakini maumivu haya ya tumbo yalianza siku chache zilizopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good to hear about your workouts. We'll definitely investigate the stomach pain. Now, regarding the neonatal stroke, have you noticed any changes or new symptoms?
entries.translation: Daktari: Hizo ni habari njema kuhusu mazoezi yako. Kwa hakika tutachunguza maumivu ya tumbo. Sasa, kuhusu kiharusi cha watoto wachanga, umeona mabadiliko yoyote au dalili mpya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: No, nothing new. I've been keeping up with my physical therapy, and my movement seems to be improving.
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: Hapana, hakuna jipya. Nimekuwa nikiendelea na tiba yangu ya viungo, na mwendo wangu unaonekana kuboreka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's excellent news. Consistent therapy is crucial. Have you experienced any headaches, vision problems, or seizures?
entries.translation: Daktari: Hizo ni habari njema sana. Tiba thabiti ni muhimu. Je, umepata maumivu ya kichwa, matatizo ya kuona, au kifafa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: No, none of those. Just the stomach pain recently.
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: Hapana, hakuna lolote kati ya hayo. Ni maumivu ya tumbo tu hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay, good. We'll do a thorough check-up today, including addressing your stomach pain. Any questions or concerns you'd like to discuss?
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa, vizuri. Tutafanya uchunguzi wa kina leo, ikiwa ni pamoja na kushughulikia maumivu yako ya tumbo. Je, kuna maswali au wasiwasi wowote ungependa kujadili?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: Just the stomach pain really. Could it be related to the stroke somehow?
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: Ni maumivu ya tumbo tu kwa kweli. Je, inaweza kuhusishwa na kiharusi kwa namna fulani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It's unlikely, but we'll rule out any connections. It could be something unrelated, perhaps dietary or stress-related. We'll figure it out together.
entries.translation: Daktari: Kuna uwezekano mdogo, lakini tutaondoa uhusiano wowote. Inaweza kuwa kitu kisichohusiana, labda lishe au kinachohusiana na msongo wa mawazo. Tutagundua pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hui En Sim: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate it.
entries.translation: Hui En Sim: Asante, daktari. Ninashukuru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Of course. Let's get started with the examination.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Hello, you've reached the Telehealth Line. My name is Bopha. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Opareta: Hujambo, umepiga namba ya Telehealth Line. Jina langu ni Bopha. Nikusaidie nini leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mei Ling: Hi Bopha, my name is Mei Ling. My husband, Kenji, has some blisters on his arm that are worrying us.
entries.translation: Mei Ling: Habari Bopha, ninaitwa Mei Ling. Mume wangu, Kenji, ana malengelenge kwenye mkono wake ambayo yanatutia wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kenji: (Sounding anxious) They just appeared out of nowhere! They're red and itchy, and I'm afraid they might be something serious.
entries.translation: Kenji: (Akiwa na wasiwasi) yametokea tu bila kutarajia! Ni mekundu na yanawasha, na nina hofu yanaweza kuwa ishara ya ugonjwa mbaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I understand your concern, Kenji. Let's see if we can figure out what's going on. Mei Ling, can you describe the blisters a bit more?
entries.translation: Opareta: Ninaelewa wasiwasi wako, Kenji. Hebu tuone kama tunaweza kutambua tatizo ni nini. Mei Ling, unaweza kuelezea zaidi kuhusu malengelenge hayo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mei Ling: Sure. They are small, fluid-filled bumps, mostly clustered together. The skin around them is red and slightly swollen.
entries.translation: Mei Ling: Sawa. Ni vidonda vidogo vilivyojaa maji, vilivyojikusanya pamoja. Ngozi inayozunguka ni nyekundu na imevimba kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay, that helps. Have you been exposed to any new plants, chemicals, or insects recently?
entries.translation: Opareta: Sawa, hiyo inasaidia. Je, umegusa mimea mipya, kemikali, au wadudu hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kenji: Not that I can think of. We haven't been hiking or anything like that.
entries.translation: Kenji: Hapana, sikumbuki chochote. Hatujawahi kwenda kutembea msituni au kufanya kitu kama hicho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Alright. It's possible that it could be a reaction to something you touched or even a mild allergic reaction. However, without seeing them, it's hard to say for sure.
entries.translation: Opareta: Sawa. Inawezekana kuwa ni athari ya kitu ulichogusa au hata mzio mdogo. Hata hivyo, bila kuiona, ni vigumu kusema kwa uhakika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mei Ling: Is there anything we can do to help relieve the itching and discomfort?
entries.translation: Mei Ling: Je, kuna chochote tunaweza kufanya kupunguza kuwasha na usumbufu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kenji: Thank you, Bopha. We'll try those suggestions and keep an eye on them.
entries.translation: Kenji: Asante, Bopha. Tutajaribu mapendekezo hayo na kuyafuatilia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: You're welcome, Kenji. Take care, and feel free to call back if you have any other questions.
entries.translation: Opareta: Karibu, Kenji. Jihadhari, na jisikie huru kupiga simu tena ikiwa una maswali mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good morning, Mr. Martinez. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Habari za asubuhi Bwana Martinez. Unajisikiaje leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: I'm doing alright, thank you. Just a bit tired.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Niko sawa, asante. Nimechoka kidogo tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's understandable. I'm here today to check on your safety and make sure everything is going smoothly at home. Do you have a few minutes to talk?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hiyo inaeleweka. Niko hapa leo kuangalia usalama wako na kuhakikisha kuwa mambo yanaenda vizuri nyumbani. Je, unayo dakika chache ya kuzungumza?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: Of course, take a seat.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Thank you. So, have you had any falls or near falls since my last visit?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Asante. Je, umewahi kuanguka au nusura uanguke tangu ziara yangu ya mwisho?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: No, thankfully not. I've been using my walker like you showed me, and it's really helped.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Hapana, nashukuru sijawahi. Nimekuwa nikitumia kitembezi changu kama ulivyonionyesha, na kimenisaidia sana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's great to hear! And have you been taking your medications as prescribed?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Nimefurahi kusikia hivyo! Na je, umekuwa ukimeza dawa zako kama ulivyoagizwa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: Yes, I have a pill organizer now, so it's much easier to keep track.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Ndio, nina mpangilio wa vidonge sasa, kwa hivyo ni rahisi sana kufuatilia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's a smart idea. It's important to stay on top of your medications. Now, let's talk about your home environment. Are there any loose rugs or cords that could be tripping hazards?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hilo ni wazo la busara. Ni muhimu kuendelea kutumia dawa zako. Sasa, hebu tuzungumze kuhusu mazingira yako ya nyumbani. Je, kuna rugs au kamba zozote zilizolegea ambazo zinaweza kusababisha kujikwaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: I did notice one rug in the hallway that tends to slip.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Niligundua zulia moja kwenye barabara ya ukumbi ambayo inaelekea kuteleza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, we can secure that with some double-sided tape. And how about the lighting? Is it bright enough for you to see clearly, especially at night?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa, tunaweza kulinda hilo kwa mkanda wa pande mbili. Na vipi kuhusu taa? Je, ni mkali kiasi cha wewe kuona vizuri, hasa usiku?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: The hallway light is a bit dim. Maybe we could replace the bulb with a brighter one?
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Mwangaza wa barabara ya ukumbi ni hafifu kidogo. Labda tunaweza kubadilisha balbu na kuweka nyingine angavu zaidi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Absolutely, I can help you with that. And do you have a list of emergency contacts handy?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hakika, ninaweza kukusaidia kwa hilo. Na je, unayo orodha ya wasiliani wa dharura?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: Yes, it's right by the phone.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Ndio, iko karibu na simu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Perfect. It sounds like you're doing a great job taking care of yourself, Mr. Martinez. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss or any questions you have for me?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa kabisa. Inaonekana unafanya kazi nzuri ya kujitunza, Bw. Martinez. Je, kuna jambo lingine ungependa kujadili au maswali yoyote unayo kwangu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Martinez: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for checking in on me.
entries.translation: Bwana Martinez: Hapana, nadhani hiyo inatosha. Asante kwa kunijulia hali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're very welcome. I'll see you again next week. Take care!
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Karibu sana. Tutaonana tena wiki ijayo. Kila la kheri!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Elias Thorne: Good morning, Mr. Calloway. I understand you're here for a second opinion regarding the surgery recommended by Dr. Vance.
entries.translation: Dk. Elias Thorne: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Calloway. Ninaelewa uko hapa kwa ajili ya maoni ya pili kuhusu upasuaji uliopendekezwa na Dk. Vance.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calloway: I've done some physical therapy, but it hasn't provided much relief. I haven't tried injections yet.
entries.translation: Calloway: Nimefanya tiba ya mwili kidogo, lakini haijatoa unafuu mkubwa. Sijajaribu sindano bado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calloway: That makes sense. Dr. Vance mentioned the laminectomy involves removing part of the bone to relieve pressure. Are there other surgical options?
entries.translation: Calloway: Hiyo inaleta maana. Dkt. Vance alitaja kuwa upasuaji unahusisha kuondoa sehemu ya mfupa ili kupunguza shinikizo. Je, kuna chaguzi nyingine za upasuaji?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calloway: Thank you, Dr. Thorne. I appreciate your thorough explanation and willingness to consider alternatives. It gives me peace of mind knowing I have options.
entries.translation: Calloway: Asante, Dkt. Thorne. Ninashukuru maelezo yako ya kina na utayari wako wa kuchunguza njia nyingine. Inanipa amani ya moyo kujua nina chaguzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Elias Thorne: You're welcome, Mr. Calloway. My goal is to help you make an informed decision that aligns with your needs and preferences. We'll work together to find the best treatment plan for you.
entries.translation: Dkt. Elias Thorne: Karibu, Bw. Calloway. Lengo langu ni kukusaidia kufanya uamuzi wenye taarifa unaoendana na mahitaji na mapendeleo yako. Tutashirikiana kutafuta mpango bora wa matibabu kwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your spouse's concern is a reflection of their love and care. Lean on each other for support and encouragement. Together, you can overcome any challenge.
entries.translation: Wasiwasi wa mwenzi wako ni onyesho la upendo na utunzaji wao. Tegemeeni kwa usaidizi na kutiana moyo. Pamoja, mnaweza kushinda changamoto yoyote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Believe in yourself, Njeri. You have the power to achieve your goals and live a fulfilling life. Embrace this opportunity to prioritize your health and well-being. You are capable of remarkable things.
entries.translation: Jiamini, Njeri. Una uwezo wa kufikia malengo yako na kuishi maisha yenye kuridhisha. Kubali fursa hii ya kupea kipaumbele afya na ustawi wako. Una uwezo wa kufanya mambo ya ajabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Hi there, this is Isaac Osei, the pharmacist. I understand you're calling about your lung disease. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Mfamasi: Hujambo, huyu ni Isaac Osei, mfamasi. Ninafahamu unapiga simu kuhusu ugonjwa wako wa mapafu. Je, ninawezaje kukusaidia leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: I'm sorry to hear that, Taufik. Can you tell me a little more about your symptoms? Are you wheezing or coughing? Do you have any chest pain?
entries.translation: Mfamasi: Pole sana, Taufik. Unaweza kuniambia zaidi kidogo kuhusu dalili zako? Je, unapiga mluzi au kukohoa? Je, una maumivu yoyote ya kifua?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taufik Hidayat: Yes, I've been wheezing a lot, especially at night. And I've had a dry cough that won't go away. No chest pain, though.
entries.translation: Taufik Hidayat: Ndiyo, nimekuwa nikipiga mluzi sana, hasa usiku. Na nimekuwa na kikohozi kikavu ambacho hakitaisha. Hakuna maumivu ya kifua, ingawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: Okay, thanks for sharing that. Have you been using your inhaler regularly?
entries.translation: Mfamasi: Sawa, asante kwa kushiriki hilo. Je, umekuwa ukitumia dawa yako ya kuvuta pumzi mara kwa mara?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taufik Hidayat: To be honest, I haven't been as consistent with it as I should be. Work has been crazy lately, and I've forgotten a few doses.
entries.translation: Taufik Hidayat: Kusema kweli, sijakuwa thabiti nayo kama ninavyopaswa kuwa. Kazi imekuwa nyingi sana hivi majuzi, na nimesahau dozi chache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: That's understandable, Taufik. But it's really important to take your medication as prescribed, especially when you're having symptoms like this. Missing doses can make your condition worse.
entries.translation: Mfamasi: Hiyo inaeleweka, Taufik. Lakini ni muhimu sana kumeza dawa yako kama ilivyoelekezwa, haswa unapokuwa na dalili kama hizi. Kukosa dozi kunaweza kufanya hali yako kuwa mbaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taufik Hidayat: I know, I know. I'll try to be better about it. But is there anything else I can do in the meantime? I'm really struggling to catch my breath.
entries.translation: Taufik Hidayat: Najua, najua. Nitajaribu kuwa bora zaidi kuhusu hilo. Lakini kuna kitu kingine ninaweza kufanya kwa sasa? Kwa kweli ninajitahidi kupata pumzi yangu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taufik Hidayat: Okay, I'll do that. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
entries.translation: Taufik Hidayat: Sawa, nitafanya hivyo. Asante kwa msaada wako, Isaac.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: You're welcome, Taufik. And please, don't hesitate to call back if you have any other questions or concerns. We're here to help.
entries.translation: Mfamasi: Karibu, Taufik. Na tafadhali, usisite kupiga simu tena ikiwa una maswali mengine au wasiwasi. Tuko hapa kusaidia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Taufik Hidayat: Thanks, I appreciate it. Bye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good afternoon, Sipho. I'm Doctor Catarina Dias. I understand you're here because of an injury at work. Can you tell me what happened?
entries.translation: Daktari: Habari za mchana, Sipho. Mimi ni Daktari Catarina Dias. Naelewa uko hapa kwa sababu ya jeraha la kazini. Unaweza kuniambia nini kimetokea?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: Yeah, I was lifting some heavy boxes and felt a sharp pain in my stomach. It hurts pretty bad right now.
entries.translation: Sipho: Ndio, nilikuwa nanyanyua masanduku mazito na nikahisi maumivu makali tumboni. Inauma sana sasa hivi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. Where exactly does it hurt? Can you point to the area?
entries.translation: Daktari: Pole sana kusikia hivyo. Inauma wapi haswa? Unaweza kunyooshea eneo hilo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: It's right here, in the middle. (Points to abdomen)
entries.translation: Sipho: Iko papa hapa, katikati. (Anaashiria tumboni)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. And how would you describe the pain? Is it sharp, dull, throbbing?
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa. Na unawezaje kuelezea maumivu hayo? Ni makali, ya kawaida, au ya kupiga?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: It's a sharp pain, like a stabbing sensation.
entries.translation: Sipho: Ni maumivu makali, kama vile kuchomwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does anything make it better or worse?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je, kuna kitu chochote kinachofanya iwe afadhali au mbaya zaidi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: Moving around definitely makes it worse. Sitting still helps a little bit.
entries.translation: Sipho: Kutembea kunafanya iwe mbaya zaidi. Kukaa kimya kunasaidia kidogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Have you experienced any other symptoms, like nausea or vomiting?
entries.translation: Daktari: Je, umepata dalili zingine zozote, kama kichefuchefu au kutapika?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. I'm going to examine your stomach now. Is that alright?
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa. Nitakwenda kuchunguza tumbo lako sasa. Je, ni sawa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does it hurt when I press here?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. Based on what you've told me and my examination, I think you might have strained a muscle in your abdomen. It's a common injury from heavy lifting.
entries.translation: Daktari: Sawa. Kulingana na ulichoniambia na uchunguzi wangu, nadhani huenda umepata mkazo wa misuli tumboni mwako. Ni jeraha la kawaida kutokana na kunyanyua vitu vizito.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: Oh no! Is it serious? Will he need surgery?
entries.translation: Mke/Mume: Oooh hapana! Je, ni mbaya? Atahitaji upasuaji?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: That's a relief. So I don't need surgery?
entries.translation: Sipho: Hiyo ni afadhali. Kwa hiyo sitahitaji upasuaji?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Not at this point. We'll keep an eye on it, but surgery is usually reserved for more severe injuries.
entries.translation: Daktari: Si kwa wakati huu. Tutaliangalia, lakini upasuaji kwa kawaida huwekwa kwa ajili ya majeraha makubwa zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: Thank goodness! Thank you, Doctor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sipho: Sounds good. I just want to get back to work as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Sipho: Sawa kabisa. Nataka tu kurudi kazini haraka iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll do our best to get you back on your feet quickly. But it's important to let your body heal properly so you don't re-injure yourself.
entries.translation: Daktari: Tutafanya kila tuwezalo kukurudisha kwenye hali yako ya kawaida haraka. Lakini ni muhimu kuruhusu mwili wako upone vizuri ili usijeruhi tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: No problem. Let's get you set up with some appointments and get you on the road to recovery.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hakuna shida. Hebu tukupangie miadi na kukuweka kwenye njia ya kupona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Hello, Ms. Addo. It's good to see you again. How are you feeling today?"
entries.translation: Mfamasi: "Hujambo, Bi. Addo. Nimefurahi kukuona tena. Unahisije leo?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Honestly, not much better. I'm still having the same symptoms as before."
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: "Kiukweli, sikuyo sawa sana. Bado nina dalili zile zile kama hapo awali."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "I'm sorry to hear that. Let's take a closer look at your medication history. Have you been taking the antihistamine as prescribed?"
entries.translation: Mfamasi: "Pole kwa hilo. Hebu tuangalie kwa makini historia yako ya dawa. Umekuwa ukimeza dawa ya mzio kama ulivyoelekezwa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Yes, I have. But it doesn't seem to be doing anything."
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: "Ndiyo, nimekuwa nikimeza. Lakini inaonekana haifanyi kazi yoyote."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Okay. Have you experienced any other side effects?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Just some drowsiness, but nothing too bad."
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: "Kuhisi usingizi tu, lakini si sana."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Alright. Let's try a different antihistamine. This one is less likely to cause drowsiness. I'll also recommend some over-the-counter eye drops to help with the itching."
entries.translation: Mfamasi: "Sawa. Hebu tujaribu dawa nyingine ya mzio. Hii haina uwezekano mkubwa wa kusababisha usingizi. Pia nitakupendekezea matone ya macho ya kununua dukani ili kusaidia kutuliza mwasho."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "You're welcome. Please let me know if you have any other questions or concerns."
entries.translation: Mfamasi: "Karibu. Tafadhali nifahamishe ikiwa una maswali au wasiwasi wowote mwingine."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good afternoon, Mr. Pothier. I see that you're scheduled for a pericardiocentesis today. How are you feeling?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Habari ya mchana, Bwana Pothier. Ninaona kuwa umepangiwa kuondoa maji yanayozunguka moyo wako. Unajisikiaje?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pothier: Hello, Nurse. Honestly, I'm a bit anxious about the procedure. It sounds quite daunting.
entries.translation: Bwana Pothier: Hujambo, Muuguzi. Kwa kweli, nina wasiwasi kidogo kuhusu utaratibu. Inasikika kutisha kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I understand your concern, Mr. Pothier. It's completely natural to feel nervous. Can you tell me more about your symptoms leading up to today?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Ninaelewa wasiwasi wako, Bwana Pothier. Ni jambo la kawaida kabisa kuhisi wasiwasi. Je, unaweza kuniambia zaidi kuhusu dalili zako hadi leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pothier: Well, I've been experiencing shortness of breath and some chest pain, especially when lying down. It's been quite uncomfortable.
entries.translation: Bwana Pothier: Kweli, nimekuwa nikipata upungufu wa kupumua na maumivu ya kifua, haswa wakati wa kulala. Imekuwa mbaya kabisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I'm sorry to hear that. Those are common symptoms associated with pericardial effusion, which is the condition we're addressing today. Before we proceed, I need to check your vital signs. May I?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Samahani kusikia hivyo. Hizo ni dalili za kawaida zinazohusiana na ugonjwa wa moyo, ambayo ndiyo hali tunayoshughulikia leo. Kabla hatujaendelea, nahitaji kuangalia dalili zako muhimu. Naweza?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pothier: No significant changes, just trying to manage my weight as advised by Dr. Dubois.
entries.translation: Bwana Pothier: Hakuna mabadiliko makubwa, ninajaribu tu kudhibiti uzito wangu kama nilivyoshauriwa na Dkt Dubois.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pothier: Thank you, Nurse. I appreciate your reassurance.
entries.translation: Bwana Pothier: Asante, Muuguzi. Ninashukuru uhakikisho wako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Understandable. We'll do a thorough check. How have you been feeling lately? Any pain or swelling?
entries.translation: Daktari: Inaeleweka. Tutafanya ukaguzi kamili. Umejisikiaje hivi karibuni? Maumivu yoyote au uvimbe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's been a little sore, but not too bad. My wife's just worried sick about it.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Imekuwa na kidonda kidogo, lakini sio mbaya sana. Mke wangu ana wasiwasi sana juu yake.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spouse: I can't help it! I just want to make sure he's safe to drive again.
entries.translation: Mke/Mume: Siwezi kuzuia! Ninataka tu kuhakikisha yuko salama kuendesha tena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We'll do our best to get you both some answers. Let's start with the exam.
entries.translation: Daktari: Tutafanya kila tuwezalo kuwapa majibu. Wacha tuanze na mtihani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a potential explanation of the patient's symptoms, delivered in a calm and steady manner, as if speaking to a doctor:
entries.translation: Hapa pana maelezo yanayoweza kutolewa kwa dalili za mgonjwa, yakitolewa kwa utulivu na utaratibu, kana kwamba unazungumza na daktari:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flu vaccines can save lives. While most people recover from the flu, older adults and those with chronic conditions are at higher risk of complications, hospitalization, and even death.
entries.translation: Chanjo za mafua zinaweza kuokoa maisha. Ingawa watu wengi hupona mafua, watu wazima na wale walio na hali sugu wako katika hatari kubwa ya shida, kulazwa hospitalini, na hata kifo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We understand that managing multiple health conditions can be overwhelming. That's why we want to make getting your flu shot as easy as possible.
entries.translation: Tunaelewa kuwa kudhibiti hali nyingi za afya kunaweza kuwa kubwa. Ndio sababu tunataka kufanya kupata sindano yako ya mafua iwe rahisi iwezekanavyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist today about getting vaccinated. It's a simple step that can make a big difference in your health.
entries.translation: Ongea na daktari wako au mfamasi leo kuhusu kupata chanjo. Ni hatua rahisi ambayo inaweza kuleta mabadiliko makubwa katika afya yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Kaa na afya msimu huu wa mafua!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Timu yako ya Huduma ya Afya
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Farhana Islam's Instructions for Allergy Testing
entries.translation: Maelekezo ya Dkt. Farhana Islam kwa ajili ya Kipimo cha Mzio
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inform the nurse immediately if you experience any chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, or palpitations.
entries.translation: Mjulishe muuguzi mara moja ikiwa unahisi maumivu yoyote kifuani, kukosa pumzi, kizunguzungu, au mapigo ya moyo kwenda mbio.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us know if you have taken any antihistamines or other allergy medications in the past week.
entries.translation: Tujulishe ikiwa umetumia dawa zozote za mzio (antihistamines) au dawa zingine za mzio katika wiki iliyopita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue taking your regular medications unless specifically instructed otherwise.
entries.translation: Endelea kutumia dawa zako za kawaida isipokuwa ukiagizwa vinginevyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inform us of any recent illnesses or changes in your health.
entries.translation: Tujulishe kuhusu magonjwa yoyote ya hivi karibuni au mabadiliko katika afya yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will be performing a skin prick test on your back or forearm.
entries.translation: Tutakuwa tunafanya kipimo cha kuchomwa ngozi kwenye mgongo wako au kwenye mkono wa mbele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Small amounts of allergens will be placed on your skin and then pricked with a sterile lancet.
entries.translation: Viasi vidogo vya vizio (aleji) vitawekwa kwenye ngozi yako na kisha kuchomwa na sindano tasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This may cause mild discomfort, itching, or redness.
entries.translation: Hii inaweza kusababisha usumbufu kidogo, kuwashwa, au uwekundu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please remain still during the testing process.
entries.translation: Tafadhali tulia wakati wa mchakato wa kupima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us know immediately if you experience any severe reactions, such as difficulty breathing or swelling.
entries.translation: Tujulishe mara moja ikiwa unapata athari zozote mbaya, kama vile ugumu wa kupumua au uvimbe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will monitor you for at least 30 minutes after the test to ensure no delayed reactions occur.
entries.translation: Tutakufuatilia kwa angalau dakika 30 baada ya kipimo ili kuhakikisha hakuna athari zilizochelewa kutokea.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may experience some itching or redness at the test sites. This is normal and should subside within a few hours.
entries.translation: Unaweza kupata kuwashwa au uwekundu kwenye sehemu za kipimo. Hii ni kawaida na inapaswa kupungua ndani ya masaa machache.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apply a cool compress if needed to relieve itching.
entries.translation: Weka kitambaa baridi ikiwa inahitajika ili kupunguza kuwashwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Contact us immediately if you experience any severe reactions after leaving the clinic.
entries.translation: Wasiliana nasi mara moja ikiwa unapata athari zozote mbaya baada ya kuondoka kliniki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will discuss the results of your allergy test with you and develop a personalized treatment plan.
entries.translation: Tutajadili matokeo ya kipimo chako cha mzio (aleji) na wewe na kuunda mpango wa matibabu uliobinafsishwa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Ikiwa una maswali au wasiwasi wowote, tafadhali usisite kuuliza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Hello, Mrs. Malhotra. I understand you've been experiencing some changes in your urination. Can you tell me a bit more about what's going on?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Habari, Bi. Malhotra. Naelewa umekuwa ukiwa na mabadiliko fulani katika kukojoa kwako. Je, unaweza kunielezea zaidi kuhusu kinachoendelea?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Malhotra: Yes, well, lately I've been needing to go to the bathroom much more often than usual. And sometimes when I do go, there's hardly anything there. It's been quite disruptive, especially during class.
entries.translation: Bi. Malhotra: Ndio, vyema, hivi karibuni nimekuwa nikihitaji kwenda bafuni mara nyingi zaidi kuliko kawaida. Na wakati mwingine ninapokwenda, hakuna kitu pale. Imekuwa ya usumbufu kabisa, hasa wakati wa darasa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I can imagine that's frustrating. Have you noticed any other changes, like the color or smell of your urine?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Naweza kufikiria hilo linakatisha tamaa. Je, umegundua mabadiliko mengine yoyote, kama rangi au harufu ya mkojo wako?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Malhotra: Now that you mention it, my urine has looked a bit foamy lately. And sometimes it's darker than usual.
entries.translation: Bi. Malhotra: Sasa kwa kuwa umetaja, mkojo wangu umekuwa na povu kidogo hivi karibuni. Na wakati mwingine ni yeusi kuliko kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, thank you for sharing that. Foamy urine can sometimes be a sign of protein in the urine, which we should investigate further. Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa, asante kwa kushiriki hilo. Mkojo wenye povu wakati mwingine unaweza kuwa ishara ya protini kwenye mkojo, ambayo tunafaa kuchunguza zaidi. Je, una maumivu yoyote au mwasho unapokojoa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Malhotra: No, no pain. Just the frequency and the changes in appearance.
entries.translation: Bi. Malhotra: Hapana, hakuna maumivu. Marudio tu na mabadiliko ya mwonekano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's good to know. And have you noticed any swelling in your legs or ankles recently?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hilo ni nzuri kujua. Na je, umegundua uvimbe wowote kwenye miguu au vifundo vya mguu hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Malhotra: Actually, yes. My ankles have been a bit puffy lately, especially after standing all day in the classroom.
entries.translation: Bi. Malhotra: Kweli, ndio. Vifundo vyangu vya mguu vimekuwa na uvimbe kidogo hivi karibuni, hasa baada ya kusimama siku nzima darasani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Malhotra: Thank you, nurse. I appreciate you taking the time to listen. I was starting to get worried.
entries.translation: Bi. Malhotra: Asante, muuguzi. Nashukuru kwa kuchukua muda kusikiliza. Nilikuwa nimeanza kuwa na wasiwasi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Of course, Mrs. Malhotra. We'll do our best to figure out what's going on and get you feeling better soon.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Bila shaka, Bi. Malhotra. Tutafanya tuwezalo ili kujua kinachoendelea na kukufanya uhisi vizuri hivi karibuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a brief dialogue between a home health nurse and a young patient named Emily about blood in her stool:
entries.translation: Hapa kuna mazungumzo mafupi kati ya nesi wa afya ya nyumbani na mgonjwa mdogo anayeitwa Emily kuhusu damu kwenye kinyesi chake:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Nurse:** Hi Emily, I'm Nonhlanhla, the home health nurse. I understand you've noticed some blood in your stool recently. Can you tell me a little more about it?
entries.translation: **Muuguzi:** Hujambo Emily, mimi ni Nonhlanhla, nesi wa afya ya nyumbani. Ninaelewa kuwa umegundua damu kwenye kinyesi chako hivi karibuni. Unaweza kuniambia zaidi kidogo kuhusu hilo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Emily:** Yeah, it's been happening for a few days now. It's mostly bright red, and it hurts a little when I go to the bathroom.
entries.translation: **Emily:** Ndio, imekuwa ikitokea kwa siku chache sasa. Mara nyingi ni nyekundu angavu, na inauma kidogo ninapoenda bafuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Nurse:** Okay, thank you for telling me. Have you had any other symptoms, like stomach pain, diarrhea, or fever?
entries.translation: **Muuguzi:** Sawa, asante kwa kuniambia. Umekuwa na dalili nyingine zozote, kama maumivu ya tumbo, kuhara, au homa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Emily:** My stomach hurts a little sometimes, but no diarrhea or fever.
entries.translation: **Emily:** Tumbo langu linauma kidogo wakati mwingine, lakini hakuna kuhara au homa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Nurse:** Have you eaten anything unusual or been taking any new medications lately?
entries.translation: **Muuguzi:** Je, umekula kitu chochote kisicho cha kawaida au umekuwa ukitumia dawa mpya hivi karibuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Emily:** No, not really. Just the usual stuff.
entries.translation: **Emily:** Hapana, sio kweli. Vitu vya kawaida tu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Nurse:** Alright. I'm going to take your vital signs now, and then I'll call your doctor to let them know what's going on. They might want you to come in for some tests or maybe adjust your diet.
entries.translation: **Muuguzi:** Sawa. Nitapima vipimo vyako muhimu sasa, kisha nitampigia daktari wako kumjulisha kinachoendelea. Huenda akataka uje kwa vipimo au labda ubadilishe lishe yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Emily:** Okay, thanks Nonhlanhla. Is it serious?
entries.translation: **Emily:** Sawa, asante Nonhlanhla. Je, ni mbaya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good morning, Mr. Bauer. I see you're here for a mandatory DOT physical for your mindfulness practice.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Bauer. Nimeona umefika hapa kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa kimwili wa DOT wa lazima kwa mazoezi yako ya utambuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Yes, that's correct. I've been practicing mindfulness for years, but apparently, to drive a commercial vehicle, I need to be mindful enough to pass a physical.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Ndiyo, ni sahihi. Nimekuwa nikifanya mazoezi ya utambuzi kwa miaka mingi, lakini inaonekana, ili kuendesha gari la kibiashara, nahitaji kuwa mwangalifu wa kutosha kupita uchunguzi wa kimwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Well, let's see how mindful you are. Have you experienced any health changes since your last physical?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa, hebu tuone jinsi ulivyo mwangalifu. Je, umepata mabadiliko yoyote ya kiafya tangu uchunguzi wako wa kimwili wa mwisho?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Just a few aches and pains, you know, getting older and all. But my mindfulness helps me manage them.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Ni maumivu kidogo tu, unajua, ninazeeka na yote hayo. Lakini utambuzi wangu unanisaidia kuyadhibiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's good to hear. Are you currently taking any medications?
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hiyo ni nzuri kusikia. Je, unatumia dawa zozote kwa sasa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Just a daily vitamin and some fish oil for my joints. Nothing prescription.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Ni vitamini ya kila siku na mafuta ya samaki kwa ajili ya viungo vyangu. Hakuna dawa ya kuandikiwa na daktari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay. Let's check your vitals. Please step on the scale.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Sawa. Hebu tuangalie vitals zako. Tafadhali panda kwenye mzani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: (Steps on scale) Oh, look at that number. I guess all that mindful eating hasn't paid off as much as I'd hoped.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: (Anapanda kwenye mzani) Ah, angalia namba hiyo. Nadhani kula kwa uangalifu hakujalipa kama nilivyotarajia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: (Chuckles) Don't worry, Mr. Bauer. Weight is just a number. Now, let's check your blood pressure.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: (Anacheka) Usijali, Bw. Bauer. Uzito ni namba tu. Sasa, hebu tuangalie shinikizo la damu yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: (Sits down and extends arm) I bet my blood pressure is lower than a zen master's.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: (Anakaa chini na kunyoosha mkono) Naweka dau shinikizo la damu yangu ni chini kuliko la mtaalamu wa zen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: (Takes blood pressure) 120 over 80. Not bad, Mr. Bauer. Looks like your mindfulness is working.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: (Anachukua shinikizo la damu) 120 kwa 80. Si mbaya, Bw. Bauer. Inaonekana utambuzi wako unafanya kazi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: See? I told you. Now, about that vision test...
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Unaona? Nilikwambia. Sasa, kuhusu kipimo cha macho...
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: One step at a time, Mr. Bauer. Let's finish checking your vitals first.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hatua moja kwa wakati, Bw. Bauer. Hebu tumalize kuangalia vitals zako kwanza.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Fair enough. But I'm telling you, my vision is as sharp as a hawk's. I can spot a distracted driver from a mile away.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Sawa kabisa. Lakini nakwambia, macho yangu ni makali kama ya mwewe. Naweza kumuona dereva asiye makini kutoka maili moja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: We'll see about that. Now, take a deep breath and let it out slowly.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Tutaona kuhusu hilo. Sasa, vuta pumzi ndefu na uitoe polepole.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: (Takes deep breath and exhales) Ah, that's the stuff. Mindfulness in action.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: (Anavuta pumzi ndefu na kutoa) Ah, hiyo ndiyo yenyewe. Utambuzi katika vitendo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're doing great, Mr. Bauer. Just a few more checks and you'll be on your way.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Unafanya vizuri sana, Bw. Bauer. Vipimo vichache zaidi na utakuwa njiani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Excellent. I can't wait to get back on the road and spread some mindfulness to all those stressed-out drivers.
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Vizuri sana. Siwezi kusubiri kurudi barabarani na kueneza utambuzi kwa madereva wote wenye msongo wa mawazo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's a noble goal, Mr. Bauer. Just remember to keep your eyes on the road and your mind on your driving.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: Hilo ni lengo tukufu, Bw. Bauer. Kumbuka tu kuweka macho yako barabarani na akili yako kwenye kuendesha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Bauer: Of course, of course. Safety first, mindfulness second. Or is it the other way around?
entries.translation: Bw. Bauer: Bila shaka, bila shaka. Usalama kwanza, utambuzi pili. Au ni kinyume chake?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: (Smiles) I think they go hand in hand, Mr. Bauer. Now, let's move on to the next part of your physical.
entries.translation: Muuguzi: (Anatabasamu) Nadhani vinaenda pamoja, Bw. Bauer. Sasa, hebu tuendelee na sehemu inayofuata ya uchunguzi wako wa kimwili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Dalili: Maumivu ya tumbo, uchovu, upungufu wa damu
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: That sounds really helpful. I'm willing to try anything at this point. I just want to feel like myself again.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa: Hiyo inasikika kuwa ya msaada sana. Niko tayari kujaribu chochote wakati huu. Nataka tu kujisikia kama mimi tena.
