entries.english: 1. Wound Care: Keep the wound clean and dry. Apply antibiotic ointment twice daily as prescribed. Cover with a bandage until the sutures are removed.
entries.translation: 1. Huduma ya Jeraha: Weka jeraha likiwa safi na kavu. Paka mafuta ya antibiotiki mara mbili kwa siku kama ilivyoagizwa. Funika na bandeji hadi nyuzi zitakapoondolewa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Activity Restrictions: Avoid strenuous activity involving the right arm for 48 hours. No heavy lifting or repetitive motions.
entries.translation: 2. Vizuizi vya Shughuli: Epuka shughuli nzito zinazohusisha mkono wa kulia kwa saa 48. Hakuna kunyanyua vitu vizito au harakati za kurudiarudia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. Pain Management: Take over-the-counter pain relievers as needed (acetaminophen or ibuprofen).
entries.translation: 3. Udhibiti wa Maumivu: Tumia dawa za kutuliza maumivu zinazopatikana bila kuandikiwa na daktari kama inavyohitajika (acetaminophen au ibuprofen).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Suture Removal: Return to the clinic in 7-10 days for suture removal.
entries.translation: 4. Kuondoa Nyuzi: Rudi kliniki baada ya siku 7-10 ili kuondoa nyuzi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Biopsy Results: You will be contacted with the results of the biopsy within 7-10 days.
entries.translation: 5. Matokeo ya Biopsi: Utawasiliana nawe kuhusu matokeo ya biopsi ndani ya siku 7-10.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Congenital lung abnormalities are lung problems that are present at birth. They can affect the airways, the blood vessels in the lungs, or the lung tissue itself. Some common types include:
entries.translation: Matatizo ya kuzaliwa ya mapafu ni shida za mapafu ambazo zipo wakati wa kuzaliwa. Wanaweza kuathiri njia ya hewa, mishipa ya damu kwenye mapafu, au tishu ya mapafu yenyewe. Aina zingine za kawaida ni pamoja na:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation (CCAM): A collection of cysts in the lung tissue.
entries.translation: Uundaji mbaya wa uvimbe wa kuzaliwa (CCAM): Mkusanyiko wa uvimbe kwenye tishu ya mapafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bronchopulmonary sequestration (BPS): A piece of lung tissue that doesn't have a normal connection to the airways or blood supply.
entries.translation: Utenganisho wa bronkopulmonari (BPS): Kipande cha tishu ya mapafu ambayo haina uhusiano wa kawaida na njia ya hewa au usambazaji wa damu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Congenital lobar emphysema (CLE): Overinflation of one or more lobes of the lung.
entries.translation: Emphysema ya kuzaliwa ya tundu (CLE): Mfumuko wa bei wa tundu moja au zaidi ya mapafu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The exact cause is often unknown, but it's thought to be related to problems during fetal development. Sometimes, genetic factors play a role.

entries.english: What is the outlook? with proper treatment, most children with congenital lung abnormalities lead normal, healthy lives. Regular follow-up with a specialist is important to monitor lung function and growth.
entries.translation: Mtazamo ni nini? kwa matibabu sahihi, watoto wengi walio na matatizo ya kuzaliwa ya mapafu wanaishi maisha ya kawaida, yenye afya. Ufuatiliaji wa mara kwa mara na mtaalamu ni muhimu kufuatilia kazi ya mapafu na ukuaji.

entries.english: Remember: You are not alone. Our team is here to support you and your child every step of the way. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to ask.

entries.translation: Daktari Li: Hiyo ni kawaida. Hakikisha tu unaitumia kama ulivyoelekezwa. Na weka chale safi na kavu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Sayavong: Will do. When can I go back to work?
entries.translation: Bw. Sayavong: Nitafanya hivyo. Lini ninaweza kurudi kazini?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Li: I'd recommend taking it easy for at least another week. No heavy lifting or strenuous activity. After that, you can gradually start getting back to your normal routine.
entries.translation: Daktari Li: Ningependekeza upumzike kwa angalau wiki nyingine moja. Usibebe vitu vizito au kufanya shughuli ngumu. Baada ya hapo, unaweza kuanza kurudi polepole kwenye ratiba yako ya kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Sayavong: Okay, sounds good. Is there anything else I should know?
entries.translation: Bw. Sayavong: Sawa, inaonekana vizuri. Kuna kitu kingine chochote ninachopaswa kujua?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Li: Just keep an eye out for any redness, swelling, or drainage from the incision. And call us if you have any fever or chills.
entries.translation: Daktari Li: Angalia tu ikiwa kuna wekundu, uvimbe, au majimaji yanayotoka kwenye chale. Na tupigie simu ikiwa una homa au baridi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Sayavong: Got it. Thanks, Doctor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor Li: You're welcome. We'll schedule a follow-up appointment in a few weeks to check on your progress.
entries.translation: Daktari Li: Karibu. Tutapanga miadi ya ufuatiliaji katika wiki chache ili kuangalia maendeleo yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Sayavong: Okay, see you then.
entries.translation: Bw. Sayavong: Sawa, tutaonana wakati huo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Understanding Spinal Cord Stimulation for Chronic Pain
entries.translation: Kuelewa Kichocheo cha Uti wa Mgongo kwa Maumivu Sugu
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: SCS is often considered when other treatments, such as medication or physical therapy, haven't provided enough relief. It's commonly used for:
entries.translation: SCS mara nyingi huzingatiwa wakati matibabu mengine, kama vile dawa au tiba ya mwili, hayajatoa unafuu wa kutosha. Inatumika sana kwa:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Failed Back Surgery Syndrome: Pain that persists after back surgery.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa wa Upasuaji wa Mgongo Uliofeli: Maumivu yanayoendelea baada ya upasuaji wa mgongo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS): A chronic pain condition often affecting a limb after injury.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa Uliokithiri wa Maumivu ya Viungo (CRPS): Hali ya maumivu sugu ambayo mara nyingi huathiri kiungo baada ya kuumia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Peripheral Neuropathy: Nerve damage causing pain, tingling, or numbness in the hands and feet.
entries.translation: Ugonjwa wa Neva Mwilini: Uharibifu wa neva unaosababisha maumivu, kuchonyota, au kufa ganzi mikononi na miguuni.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Maumivu sugu ya mguu au mkono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trial Period: Before permanent implantation, you'll undergo a trial period (usually 3-7 days). Temporary leads are placed, and you wear an external stimulator to see if the therapy helps your pain.
entries.translation: Kipindi cha Jaribio: Kabla ya kupandikizwa kwa kudumu, utapitia kipindi cha jaribio (kawaida siku 3-7). Miongozo ya muda huwekwa, na unavaa kichocheo cha nje ili kuona ikiwa tiba inasaidia kwa maumivu yako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Implantation: If the trial is successful, the permanent system is implanted during a minor surgical procedure. You'll likely go home the same day.
entries.translation: Kupandikiza: Ikiwa jaribio limefanikiwa, mfumo wa kudumu hupandikizwa wakati wa utaratibu mdogo wa upasuaji. Huenda ukaenda nyumbani siku hiyo hiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain Relief: While not a cure, SCS can significantly reduce pain, allowing you to be more active and potentially reduce pain medication.
entries.translation: Kupungua kwa Maumivu: Ingawa si tiba, SCS inaweza kupunguza maumivu kwa kiasi kikubwa, hivyo kukuwezesha kutekeleza shughuli za kawaida na pana uwezekano wa kupunguza dawa za maumivu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adjustments: It may take time to find the right settings. You'll work closely with your doctor to optimize the stimulation.
entries.translation: Marekebisho: Inaweza kuchukua muda kupata mipangilio sahihi. Utafanya kazi kwa karibu na daktari wako ili kuboresha kichocheo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lifestyle: Most activities are safe with SCS, but some restrictions may apply (e.g., certain medical procedures like MRI).
entries.translation: Mtindo wa maisha: Shughuli nyingi ni salama na SCS, lakini vizuizi vingine vinaweza kutumika (k.m., taratibu fulani za matibabu kama MRI).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Is SCS right for my type of pain?
entries.translation: Je, SCS inafaa kwa aina yangu ya maumivu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What are the risks and benefits?
entries.translation: Je, Matibabu yana hatari na faida gani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What does the recovery process look like?
entries.translation: Je, hali ya kupona iko vipi?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, you're not alone in managing chronic pain. Talk to your doctor to see if spinal cord stimulation could be an option for you.
entries.translation: Kumbuka, hauko peke yako katika kudhibiti maumivu sugu. Zungumza na daktari wako ili kuona ikiwa kichocheo cha uti wa mgongo kinaweza kuwa chaguo kwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ly: Good morning, Ms. Filali. I understand you've been experiencing some difficulty focusing up close lately. Can you tell me a little more about when this started?
entries.translation: Dkt. Ly: Habari ya asubuhi, Bi. Filali. Naelewa umekuwa na ugumu wa kuona vitu vya karibu hivi karibuni. Je, unaweza kunieleza zaidi kuhusu lini hali hii ilianza?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Filali: It's been a gradual thing, Doctor. I first noticed it a few months ago while reading the newspaper. The print just seemed blurry, and I found myself holding it further away to see clearly.
entries.translation: Bi. Filali: Imekuwa ikitokea taratibu, Daktari. Mara ya kwanza niliona miezi michache iliyopita wakati nikisoma gazeti. Maandishi yalionekana kuwa na ukungu, na nikajikuta nikishika mbali zaidi ili kuona vizuri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Botha: Yes, and she's been squinting a lot when reading labels at the grocery store too. I'm really worried about her eyesight.
entries.translation: Bw. Botha: Ndio, na amekuwa akifinya macho sana anaposoma lebo kwenye duka la vyakula pia. Nina wasiwasi sana kuhusu uwezo wake wa kuona.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Filali: So, it's nothing serious?
entries.translation: Bi. Filali: Kwa hiyo, siyo jambo zito?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ly: Not at all. Presbyopia is easily corrected with reading glasses or bifocals. We can perform a simple eye exam right here to confirm the diagnosis and determine the best prescription for you.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ly: Hata kidogo. Presbyopia inarekebishwa kwa urahisi na miwani ya kusomea au bifokali. Tunaweza kufanya uchunguzi wa macho hapa hapa ili kuthibitisha utambuzi na kuamua dawa bora kwako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Botha: Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried it might be something more serious.
entries.translation: Bw. Botha: Oh, asante Mungu! Nilikuwa na wasiwasi sana kwamba inaweza kuwa kitu kibaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ly: No need to worry. Presbyopia is very common and easily manageable. Let's get that eye exam started and get you seeing clearly again, Ms. Filali.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ly: Hakuna haja ya kuwa na wasiwasi. Presbyopia ni ya kawaida sana na inadhibitiwa kwa urahisi. Hebu tuanze uchunguzi huo wa macho na kukufanya uone vizuri tena, Bi. Filali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: Good morning, Mr. Okonkwo. I see you're here today with some concerns about kidney cancer. Can you tell me a little bit more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Okonkwo. Naona uko hapa leo ukiwa na wasiwasi kuhusu saratani ya figo. Je, unaweza kuniambia zaidi kuhusu kinachoendelea?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: Yeah, doc, it's been keeping me up at night. My uncle had it, and I've been having this weird pain in my side... and, well, with the baby on the way, I just want to make sure everything's okay.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Ndio, daktari, imekuwa ikininyima usingizi usiku. Mjomba wangu alikuwa nayo, na nimekuwa na maumivu ya ajabu upande wangu... na, kweli, kwa kuwa mtoto anakuja, nataka tu kuhakikisha kila kitu kiko sawa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: I understand completely. It's natural to be worried, especially with a family history. Let's talk about the pain first. Where exactly is it located, and does it come and go?
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Naelewa kabisa. Ni kawaida kuwa na wasiwasi, hasa ukiwa na historia ya familia. Hebu tuzungumzie maumivu kwanza. Yako wapi hasa, na je, yanakuja na kwenda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: It's mostly on my right side, kind of near my ribs. Sometimes it's dull, other times it's sharper. And I've been feeling a bit tired lately, more than usual.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Yako zaidi upande wangu wa kulia, karibu na mbavu zangu. Wakati mwingine ni maumivu makali, wakati mwingine ni makali zaidi. Na nimekuwa nikihisi uchovu kidogo hivi karibuni, zaidi kuliko kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: Okay, fatigue can be common during pregnancy, but we'll definitely keep that in mind. Have you noticed any blood in your urine or changes in your bathroom habits?
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Sawa, uchovu unaweza kuwa wa kawaida wakati wa ujauzito, lakini hakika tutazingatia hilo. Je, umeona damu yoyote kwenye mkojo wako au mabadiliko katika tabia yako ya bafuni?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: No blood, thankfully. Just peeing a lot more, but I figured that's just... you know.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Hakuna damu, kwa bahati nzuri. Nimekuwa nikikojoa sana, lakini nilidhani hiyo ni... unajua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: Of course. Increased urination is expected. Now, regarding your uncle, do you know what type of kidney cancer he had or at what age he was diagnosed?
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Bila shaka. Kuongezeka kwa mkojo kunatarajiwa. Sasa, kuhusu mjomba wako, unajua alikuwa na aina gani ya saratani ya figo au aligunduliwa akiwa na umri gani?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: I think it was renal cell carcinoma? He was in his late 50s.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Nadhani ilikuwa saratani ya seli ya figo? Alikuwa katika miaka yake ya 50 hivi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: That's helpful information. While family history is a factor, it doesn't mean you'll definitely develop it. We can run some tests to rule things out and give you peace of mind.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Hizo ni habari muhimu. Ingawa historia ya familia ni sababu, haimaanishi kuwa utapata saratani. Tunaweza kufanya vipimo kadhaa ili kuondoa shaka na kukupa amani ya akili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: Tests? Like what kind? Will they hurt the baby?
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Vipimo? Aina gani? Vitamuumiza mtoto?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: We'll start with a physical exam and some blood work. We might also consider an ultrasound, which is safe for both you and the baby. It uses sound waves to create images of your kidneys.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Tutaanza na uchunguzi wa kimwili na vipimo vya damu. Tunaweza pia kufikiria ultrasound, ambayo ni salama kwako na kwa mtoto. Inatumia mawimbi ya sauti kuunda picha za figo zako.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: Okay, that sounds alright. An ultrasound sounds better than... other things.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Sawa, hiyo inaonekana sawa. Ultrasound inaonekana bora kuliko... mambo mengine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: Exactly. We want to be thorough but gentle. And remember, most back or side pain during pregnancy is unrelated to cancer. It could be muscle strain or simply the baby growing.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Hasa. Tunataka kuwa makini lakini wapole. Na kumbuka, maumivu mengi ya mgongo au upande wakati wa ujauzito hayahusiani na saratani. Inaweza kuwa mkazo wa misuli au tu mtoto anayekua.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Okonkwo: That's reassuring to hear. I've been so focused on the worst-case scenario.
entries.translation: Bw. Okonkwo: Hiyo inafariji kusikia. Nimekuwa nikizingatia hali mbaya zaidi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ilunga: It's easy to do that. But we'll take this one step at a time. Let's get you checked out and see what we find. We'll get to the bottom of this together.
entries.translation: Dkt. Ilunga: Ni rahisi kufanya hivyo. Lakini tutachukua hatua moja baada ya nyingine. Hebu tukuchunguze na tuone tutakachopata. Tutafika mwisho wa hili pamoja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient (Mr. Weber): Good morning, Doctor. I'm worried about my heart. I have diabetes, and I've heard it can increase the risk of heart problems.
entries.translation: Mgonjwa (Bwana Weber): Habari za asubuhi, Daktari. Nina wasiwasi kuhusu moyo wangu. Nina ugonjwa wa kisukari, na nimesikia unaweza kuongeza hatari ya matatizo ya moyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Weber: No, nothing like that. Just a general feeling of unease, and maybe a bit more tired than usual.
entries.translation: Bwana Weber: Hapana, hakuna kitu kama hicho. Hali ya wasiwasi tu, na labda nimechoka zaidi kuliko kawaida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Weber: That sounds thorough. Will I get the results today?
entries.translation: Bwana Weber: Hilo linaonekana kuwa la kina. Je, nitapata matokeo leo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Weber: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate you taking the time to check everything out.
entries.translation: Bwana Weber: Asante, Daktari. Ninashukuru kwa kutenga muda wa kuangalia kila kitu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Mercier: You're welcome, Mr. Weber. We'll do our best to get to the bottom of your concerns and ensure your heart is healthy.
entries.translation: Dkt. Mercier: Karibu, Bwana Weber. Tutafanya kila tuwezalo ili kufikia kiini cha wasiwasi wako na kuhakikisha moyo wako uko na afya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Ferrari. I understand you're feeling frustrated about having to be here today. Can you tell me a little more about what's bothering you?
entries.translation: Daktari: Habari za asubuhi, Bw. Ferrari. Naelewa unavurugika hisia kwa kulazimika kuwa hapa leo. Je, unaweza kuniambia zaidi kuhusu kile kinachokusumbua?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ferrari: I know, I know. It's just hard not to worry. Every little ache or pain makes me wonder...
entries.translation: Bw. Ferrari: Najua, najua. Ni vigumu tu kutokuwa na wasiwasi. Kila maumivu kidogo yananifanya nishangae...
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Of course. And that's why we're here. To address those worries and provide you with the best care possible. We'll take things one step at a time, and I'll be here to answer any questions you have along the way.
entries.translation: Daktari: Bila shaka. Na ndiyo maana tuko hapa. Kushughulikia wasiwasi huo na kukupa huduma bora iwezekanavyo. Tutachukua hatua moja baada ya nyingine, na nitakuwa hapa kujibu maswali yoyote uliyo nayo njiani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ferrari: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate you listening. It helps to know I'm not alone in this.
entries.translation: Bw. Ferrari: Asante, Daktari. Nashukuru kwa kunisikiliza. Inasaidia kujua siko peke yangu katika hili.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're definitely not alone, Mr. Ferrari. We're in this together. Now, let's get started with the exam, shall we? And please, don't hesitate to stop me if you have any questions or concerns.
entries.translation: Daktari: Hakika hauko peke yako, Bw. Ferrari. Tuko pamoja katika hili. Sasa, tuanze na uchunguzi, sawa? Na tafadhali, usisite kunisimamisha ikiwa una maswali au wasiwasi wowote.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_sw, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For God so loved the world (John 3:16 — 1915 Mombasa Kimvita #469 & 1921 Zanzibar Kiunguja #470 in Roman & Arabic Script)
entries.translation: Kimvita (1915): Kwani Mwenyiezi Mngu jinsi alivyoupenda ulimwengu, amewapa watu Mwanawe mzaliwa pekee, killa mwenyi kuamini kwakwe asipotee, awe na uzima wa milele. • Kiunguja (1921): Kwa maana jinsi hii Mungu aliupenda ulimwengu, hatta akampeleka Mwana wake wa pekee, illi mtu aliye yote amwaminiye asipotee, bali apate uzima wa milele.
entries.context: British and Foreign Bible Society (1921) The Gospel in Many Tongues: Specimens of 543 Languages (London — Public Domain)
